# 601: Onions, I Added Onions

Battle with Alder?

"That doesn't seem quite appropriate," Johan said.

No matter what, even if Alder's strongest ace had passed away, he was still a genuine Champion.

As everyone knows, many trainers in the Pokémon world don't raise just one of the same Pokémon.

For example, Lance's Dragonite.

And Alder still had his signature Pokémon like Volcarona. His strength might have diminished from his peak, but that didn't mean he was weak.

"It's just an exhibition match," Alder smiled.

It was obvious that he was quite keen on this proposal.

"Who was Mr. Alder originally scheduled to have the exhibition match with?" Johan asked.

"I think it was Shaga's grandson?" Alder looked toward Teacher Briar.

Briar nodded, "Yes, Dulse is only a first-year student at our Blueberry Academy, but his skills are outstanding. He's already become the president of the League Union and holds the position of Blueberry League Champion. He's the student representative."

Dulse?

Johan had a slight impression of this grandson of Shaga.

In the games, he was very strong. If Kukui hadn't returned from the northern camp with greatly improved skills to replace Dulse as Champion, he probably would have held the Champion's seat for four consecutive years.

"...so, it doesn't seem right, does it?" Johan said again.

After all, the original plan was for an exhibition match between Alder and Dulse.

As the so-called Blueberry League Champion, a match between him and the real Unova League Champion—it didn't seem appropriate for Johan to replace him in the battle with Alder.

After all, as a student, how many chances would he have to battle a Champion?

"Oh, so that's what you're worried about," Alder waved dismissively. "That's no problem, I can have two matches."

After a pause, he added:

"Or... we could both have two matches? I've heard that many students at Blueberry Academy admire you, and I'm sure they'd be delighted with such an opening."

Johan: "??"

How did one match suddenly become two?

"I think Champion Alder's proposal is excellent," Teacher Briar said.

Shauntal: "I agree."

Johan: "..."

Easy for you to say when you're not the ones battling...

"Ahem." Johan placed his fist near his mouth and coughed once, "For two matches, well, hmm... hmm."

Briar, as a teacher and the person in charge of this internal competition, had good perception. She seemed to understand Johan's meaning and immediately said:

"Of course, Teacher Johan's 'teaching fee' will be substantial."

Alder and Shauntal both understood.

That made sense.

As a teacher at Kanaz Pokémon Academy, coming to Blueberry Academy for exhibition matches would naturally require some compensation—reasonable.

Johan immediately waved his hands, "Hey, talking about money hurts the relationship."

"Oh?"

"I was thinking... are two matches enough?"

?

Later, Briar went to prepare for the opening of the internal competition.

Meanwhile, Alder continued immersing himself in studying Blueberry Academy's teaching methods.

Johan took his little ones to visit Blueberry Academy's ecological dome to see the school's "specialty."

Ecological Dome, Grassland Area.

Though called a grassland area, it wasn't completely just endless grass. There were also marshes, rocky mountains, and other artificial natural landscapes.

A breeze passed through, creating a "rustle" in the lush grass that rose above the ankles, stirring waves of green ripples one after another.

Taking a deep breath, the scent of fresh grass mixed with a hint of moist soil entered the nostrils, making one's pores instinctively open.

"This ecological dome... is indeed well-simulated."

Finding a relatively dry patch of grass to sit on, Johan took out his Poké Balls and summoned all his little ones.

"How beautiful, Roto~~"

Rotom instantly transformed into photography mode again, snapping away at the scenery before them.

"Yoji~~"

"Nii-mi~~"

Larvitar and Victini exchanged glances, simultaneously eyeing a tree laden with fruits not far away.

The plump Pecha Berries couldn't be completely hidden even by the broad leaves. Larvitar stood beneath the tree, its seemingly short arms embracing the trunk, trying to shake the tree to get the fruits down.

Fortunately, Victini moved more quickly, flying up to grab a fruit almost as big as itself, plucking it with a gentle tug.

The two little ones, one berry each, sat beneath the tree and began munching away heartily, even burying their heads directly into the Pecha Berries.

"Nii-mi~~(^^)"

So tasty~~

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar also floated to the tree but didn't immediately pick any fruit. Instead, it parted the leaves and spotted a Spinarak hiding among them.

This was a Pokémon Gengar had never seen before, so it displayed what it considered a very friendly smile and waved a greeting.

"Ka-kaah~(｀Д*)"

Spinarak: Σ(дlll)

The little creature immediately fell from the tree, landing in front of Larvitar and Victini.

Both little ones simultaneously pulled their heads out of the Pecha Berries and looked at Spinarak with confusion, and then...

Spinarak's whole body trembled, its eyes rolled back, and it fainted from fright.

This was because Larvitar and Victini's faces were covered with the red juice of the Pecha Berries, making them look like "bloodthirsty maniacs."

"Yoji?"

Larvitar reached out and gently nudged Spinarak, finding it still unresponsive but thankfully still breathing. It waved at Victini.

No worries, still breathing.

"Spinarak, the String Spit Pokémon, Bug-type, it's said the string it spits has strength comparable to metal. The secret to this strength is still being researched by scientists. That string can even bounce back a Scyther's scythes, Roto!"

Rotom, while photographing, didn't forget to do its main job.

"It seems the Blueberry Academy's ecological dome indeed has quite a few Pokémon from the Paldea region..."

Johan nodded to himself after seeing this.

Though he still hadn't discovered why Blueberry Academy could charge Terastal Orbs.

Just as he was about to take out his Terastal Orb to examine it, he heard a voice from behind.

"Stop right there!"

A boy of about fourteen or fifteen with short red hair, dressed in chef's attire and carrying a frying pan, ran over quickly.

He shouted indignantly:

"Don't you know these berries were planted by someone else?"

Hmm?

Planted by someone else?

No wonder these berries grew so abundantly without being eaten by wild Pokémon...

The boy's face was serious as he continued:

"Moreover, eating such luscious berries without proper preparation is a waste of ingredients!"

The boy glanced at Johan, feeling this person looked somewhat familiar, but he didn't dwell on it. Upon seeing Gengar and the others, he immediately shouted:

"I see you're also a trainer. Let's battle! If you win against me, I'll forgive the berry theft!"

As he spoke, his hand that wasn't holding the frying pan produced a Poké Ball.

This series of words, actions, and reactions... made Johan instinctively think of someone: Flint!

Johan stood up and said with some apology:

"I'm sorry, young man. I didn't know these berries were cultivated. How about I compensate you?"

"Compensation?" The boy was taken aback, hesitated slightly, then nodded, "Compensation is fine, but a battle... I want to battle you!"

Truly a miniature version of Flint... Johan rubbed his temples, somewhat exasperated.

Noticing the boy's attire and the frying pan in his hand, Johan had a thought.

"Are you... a chef?"

Hearing this, the boy actually showed some embarrassment, scratching the back of his head.

"Is it that obvious? Hahaha—Yes, I'm a chef! A real chef!"

That obvious?

Johan looked at the boy's white chef's uniform and frying pan, thinking it would be difficult not to notice.

"Then how about we have a cooking contest instead?" Johan suggested.

Cooking!

The boy's eyes lit up.

But recalling the earlier scene of Larvitar and Victini eating berries, he showed some skepticism.

"You know how to cook?"

Johan smiled slightly, "A little, just a little."

Come on, haven't you heard of the "Poké Puff Demon"?

"Alright!" The boy seemed quite confident in his culinary skills and didn't forget to introduce himself:

"I am Akane, from Virbank City in the Unova region. I'll be a first-year student at Blueberry Academy next semester and am currently working part-time in the cafeteria!"

Akane?

Johan showed a hint of realization, remembering the identity of this young man.

By the time the Blueberry Academy storyline unfolds, Akane would already be one of the Blueberry League Elite Four as a first-year student, ranked fifth, with his home field being the Grassland Plaza.

He was a straightforward, outspoken fellow.

Simply put: he said what he thought and did what he wanted.

"You are..." Akane looked at Johan, finding him increasingly familiar.

"Johan, nice to meet you, Student Akane," Johan smiled.

"Teacher Johan?!!"

Spicy cooking contest!

Half an hour later.

Akane stared at his Blaziken, his expression wooden.

Blaziken was devouring a plate of bright red, glistening mapo tofu with gusto, with crystalline tears even flowing from the corners of its eyes—a sign of extreme deliciousness.

Is it really that good?

Akane took a spoon, scooped up a spoonful, and put it in his mouth.

Spicy, numbing, hot—though it stimulated his taste buds and burned his mouth so much he could barely close it, he refused to spit it out.

After swallowing, he wiped the corner of his eye and found it also glistening.

"Huh?" Akane looked at Johan, who was putting away his apron, with disbelief. "How... how did you do that..."

Johan was about to answer but seemed to think of something and smiled, saying:

"Onions, I added onions."

"I see..." Akane murmured.

The next second.

Thud——

Akane suddenly knelt on the ground, the action startling Johan.

"Teacher Johan, please teach me your culinary skills!"

Am I in the Pokémon world or some cooking anime? Johan thought.

Why does the style feel a bit off?

If Darkrai were here, it would certainly approve of Akane's behavior.

Young man, you've chosen the right path. This guy's food... does indeed have something special.

Johan quickly pulled Akane up, leaving Akane even more dazed.

He had used all his strength, yet Teacher Johan pulled him up with one hand—was this the physical prowess of a "Fighting Master"?

Cooking and cuisine are just one of our "rabbit heart" instincts, how can I teach that?

So Johan used a phrase open to Akane's interpretation: "Culinary arts, like Pokémon, are all about 'heart.'"

"Heart?"

Akane's face showed confusion, then contemplation, gradually turning to understanding, and finally realization.

"I understand, Teacher Johan!"

What did you understand?

Saying this, Akane carefully took out a scroll from his pocket. Just from its appearance, one could tell it had some age to it.

What's this?

Before Johan could ask, Akane explained: "Teacher Johan, this is the 'Secret Cooking Scroll' left by my grandfather. Thank you for your guidance!"

Secret Cooking Scroll?

Akane greatly respected, even revered his grandfather, and continued:

"This scroll records my grandfather's experiences during his youthful travels, which he transformed into recipes. He—"

As Akane spoke, Johan curiously opened a corner of the scroll, looking at the first recipe—Spectrier's Snack!

Hmm?

Hmm?!

A drop of sweat formed on Johan's forehead.

This scroll... shouldn't be looked at...

Gengar, with its head next to Johan's, also saw the recipe in the scroll. Its eyes spun rapidly as it revealed a sinister smile.

"Ka-kaah..."

Beep beep——

At this moment, his phone rang, showing a call from Teacher Briar.

After answering.

"Teacher Johan, you can come to the arena to prepare. Our opening ceremony will begin soon," Briar said.

"Alright."

After hanging up, Akane curiously asked:

"Is Teacher Johan here to watch our Blueberry League internal competition?"

"No, I've been invited to participate in an exhibition match."

Exhibition match?

Akane's eyes immediately lit up, and he volunteered:

"Teacher Johan, I'll show you the way!"

On the way, he looked quite disappointed.

"Too bad I couldn't have a match with Teacher Johan..."

Johan patted his shoulder, consoling him: "Don't worry, next time I'll bring my students along, and you can try your skills against them first."

Blueberry Academy, School Arena, Blueberry League Internal Competition Venue.

Almost all of Blueberry Academy's students, except those who had applied for leave, had gathered here.

Most students had their Pokémon out accompanying them, which was one of the teaching principles—to nurture the relationship between Pokémon and trainers.

Johan was invited by Briar to the guest room, where Alder was already seated, brewing tea.

"Ka-kaah?"

Seeing the tea, Gengar immediately became interested. It eagerly sat across from Alder, and after tasting the tea, it wagged its finger at Alder.

This won't do, you should see how the old master brews tea.

"Oh?"

And so, Alder tasted... Energy Root tea brewed by Gengar, so bitter that tears nearly flowed from his eyes.

Meanwhile, Johan faced a student who appeared lazy and spiritless on the outside but was politely introducing himself.

"Teacher Johan, I'm delighted to have an exhibition match with you. I'm Dulse."

Blueberry Academy first-year student, League Union president, current Blueberry League Champion, and Shaga's grandson—Dulse!

Akane had followed along thanks to his connection with Johan. Seeing Dulse, he quickly said:

"I know him, Teacher Johan! Dulse! Although he's a first-year student, actually... he's been held back three times."

Dulse: "..."

Briar: "..."

"Akane, that's not very nice~~"

Lacey, who had faced Johan in the "Youth Master World Championship," also arrived, making an "X" gesture with her hands and smiling at Akane.

Then she greeted Johan with a smile.

"Hello, Teacher Johan~~"

"L-Lacey..." Seeing Lacey, Akane's face immediately flushed, and he became fidgety.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar's suspicious gaze swept between Akane and Lacey, examining them for a moment before showing a look of realization.

It punched its palm with its fist.

"Ka-kaah!"

I get it now, unrequited love!

Akane stumbled, nearly falling to the ground.

"Hahaha——" Alder laughed heartily.

Teacher Briar also curled her lips into a smile.

The straightforward Akane had met his match in the even more outspoken Gengar.

# 602: VS Alder, Terastallize!

"It seems it's our turn to take the stage, Johan."

Alder, sitting at the tea table, suddenly stood up and said.

The announcer's voice had already come through from the arena, followed by the cheers of Blueberry Academy students.

Although this arena at Blueberry Academy was far smaller than the one used for the "Youth Master World Championship," the enthusiasm and cheers from the students were just as intense.

Following the staff's directions, the two walked towards the player tunnels on opposite sides.

Meanwhile, Shauntal, Dulse, Lacey, and Akane stood by the floor-to-ceiling windows of the VIP room, taking in the entire arena.

"Between Teacher Johan and Champion Alder, who's actually stronger?" Akane asked excitedly, full of anticipation for this "battle of the century" about to unfold.

"I think... it should be Champion Alder..." Lacey said, somewhat uncertainly.

Although she had battled Teacher Johan before and lost quite thoroughly, experiencing the gap in strength between them firsthand.

But Mr. Alder was, after all, the Champion of the Unova League.

And "Champion" represented "the strongest."

Of course, what she said aloud and what she hoped for might differ slightly—Lacey was still supporting Teacher Johan a bit more.

Beside her, Dulse shed his previous lethargy, looking exceptionally serious.

Despite his usual laziness, when it came to battles, his attitude was quite good—otherwise, he couldn't have become the Champion of the Blueberry League at Blueberry Academy.

"Champion Alder," Dulse stated with certainty.

As Shaga's grandson, Dulse had witnessed Alder's strength firsthand.

Moreover, as a fellow "Champion," albeit with a different prefix, he still believed Mr. Alder was stronger.

All three turned to look at Shauntal.

As the Elite Four candidate of the Unova League, almost certainly the next Elite Four member, Shauntal should have the broadest perspective among them.

Noticing their gazes, Shauntal opened her mouth.

She had initially wanted to say Alder too, but then remembered what she had seen at Giant Chasm...

Shauntal pursed her lips and shook her head, "Not certain."

Not certain?

Even the next Elite Four member wasn't certain who was stronger between Mr. Alder and Teacher Johan?

Everyone exchanged glances.

"Let's welcome the two special guests for the Blueberry League Internal Competition!!" the announcer's voice echoed throughout the arena.

"First, the Champion of our Unova League, our invincible—Champion Alder!!!"

Boom!!

The entire arena erupted in cheers as spotlights shone down, and a platform slowly rose on one side of the field. Alder stood with his arms crossed, a smile on his face, six Poké Balls hanging around his neck.

"Champion Alder!!"

The Blueberry Academy students shouted.

For the vast majority of students from the Unova region, their ultimate goal was to stand on the stage of the Unova League Champion Challenge and face Champion Alder directly!

This was their dream!

It's no exaggeration to say that Alder's appearance greatly inspired the enthusiasm of the Blueberry Academy students.

Even someone as lazy as Dulse also yearned to battle Alder.

Alder didn't put on airs as a League Champion, smiling and waving to the students in the audience.

"Next, let's welcome the champion of this 'Youth Master World Championship,' Teacher Johan!!"

Whoosh——!!!

Most students actually didn't know that Teacher Johan was among the special guests for the opening exhibition match of the internal competition, as this was a last-minute addition to the "program."

They had thought Dulse would be battling Champion Alder.

"Teacher Johan!! It's Teacher Johan!!"

As the platform gradually rose, Johan, adjusting his monocle, appeared in the audience's view, and the cheers immediately grew more enthusiastic.

The Blueberry Academy students were certainly familiar with Johan; some even knew more about Teacher Johan than they did about Champion Alder.

After all, they were part of the same "system."

Teacher Johan was a famous "star teacher," the headline (crossed out) trademark of Kanaz Pokémon Academy.

Listening to the announcer's introduction, Johan felt something was odd.

How could the "Youth Master World Championship" champion be equated with a League Champion?

It's not like we're trying to compare ourselves unfairly...

Since this was an exhibition match, and a one-on-one exhibition at that, there weren't any so-called "win-lose" rules, so no referee was needed—the announcer could decide when the battle would begin.

Facing Johan, the young trainer he had come to admire most in recent times, Alder showed no condescension as a senior or elder, only respect and seriousness.

He really wanted to know.

What exactly had enabled Johan to grow to his current level in such a short time?

This was what he, as the Unova League Champion, wanted to explore and pursue—it would benefit his training of Unova's young people.

Of course, if Johan would stay in Unova, then none of this would be necessary—he could retire.

As for Johan, when facing Alder, he had already given it some thought.

Against a Champion, it would still have to be Gengar...

"Would the two guests please summon their Pokémon!" the announcer's voice rang out.

Johan tilted his head slightly and gestured, saying:

"Go, Gengar!"

Black mist floated out from his shadow, transforming into a shadow that quickly swept onto the field, and then Gengar, wearing sunglasses, leaped out.

"Ka-kaah! (▼O▼)/"

Clang clang clang!! Gengar makes a dazzling entrance!

A tongue quickly extended, curling up the sunglasses from its face. Looking toward Alder, it showed its trademark smile.

"Ka-kaah!"

Come on!

Seeing Gengar's smile, seeing Johan's smile, Alder couldn't help but smile even more broadly.

What a wonderful pair—the purest bond between trainer and Pokémon, displayed vividly in this human and Pokémon, made Alder think of his own departed partner.

But Alder quickly adjusted his mindset, his gaze burning as he looked at Johan and Gengar.

"Johan."

He reached for a Poké Ball hanging around his neck, "We won't be holding back!"

As he spoke, a rare fire seemed to light up in his eyes, and he threw out a Poké Ball.

"Go, embodiment of the sun, Volcarona!!"

Roar!!

As soon as it appeared, an incredibly scorching heat wave swept across the entire arena. Sparks of fire scattered with each flap of Volcarona's wings, as if the air itself might ignite.

"Volcarona! It's Champion Alder's ace Volcarona!"

"This, this pressure... this heat wave—"

"Is this the strength of a League Champion?"

The audience gasped in amazement. Many were seeing a Volcarona for the first time and were deeply impressed.

Not to mention that this was a Champion's ace Pokémon, leaving an impression of "power" on their hearts from this first encounter.

"Ka-kaah..."

Seeing Volcarona, Gengar's expression immediately became serious.

This one was even stronger than the one they had encountered in the "Ancient City"!

Johan's expression was also somewhat solemn.

Tsk, it's just an exhibition match, yet Mr. Alder actually sent out Volcarona. In this case... not losing within the time limit would be considered a success!

Gengar, this is a genuine Champion's ace. Now you can see how much of a gap there still is between you and a Champion's ace...

As the announcer loudly declared the start of the exhibition match, a large countdown appeared on the big screen.

"Johan, show me your full strength!"

Unlike his usual self, Alder shouted before commanding, "Volcarona, Fiery Dance!"

Facing Teacher Johan, the Champion was taking the initiative first!

"Wooo——"

Volcarona flapped its six fire-red wings that seemed to radiate sunlight, quickly rising higher and scattering countless scales.

Roar!!

In an instant.

All the scales ignited, transforming into small fire moths that danced and spiraled, creating a heat wave that seemed to distort space as it surged toward Gengar.

At the same time, flames rose around Volcarona's body and quickly condensed, but its aura continued to rise without any sign of diminishing.

[Fiery Dance: Volcarona's signature move, covering its body in flames and attacking the opponent by flapping its wings. Sometimes raises the user's Special Attack!]

This was one of Volcarona's most iconic moves, capable of both attacking and self-enhancement!

Just now, Volcarona's Special Attack had been raised by one stage!

Facing these large and small fire moths fluttering and dancing toward it, Gengar wore a stern expression, feeling a strong sense of threat.

"Shadow Sneak!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar made a slash in the air before it, opening a rift and immediately diving in, disappearing from the field.

Seeing this, Alder smiled slightly and called out again, "Quiver Dance!"

"Wooo——"

Volcarona quickly flapped its wings again, performing a dance with special rhythm at extremely high speed in the air. Its entire state and presence seemed to rise once more as the dance continued.

[Quiver Dance: Lightly dancing a mysterious and beautiful dance, raising the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage!]

A Champion was indeed a Champion. Although Alder was advanced in age, his reaction speed wasn't slow at all.

Seeing that Fiery Dance had missed and Gengar had disappeared from view, he immediately chose to enhance with Quiver Dance.

Whether Gengar was going for a sneak attack or evasion, for Volcarona, as long as it could perform Quiver Dance, the potential damage versus the gained enhancement would be worth it.

Moreover—

Zzzzt——

Behind Volcarona, a thin dotted line appeared, quickly opening to reveal Gengar sneakily crawling out from another dimension, attempting to interrupt Volcarona's Quiver Dance.

"Fiery Dance!" Alder smiled.

Roar!!

Almost instantly, large flames erupted where Gengar appeared, or rather... around Volcarona, with fire moths forming a barrier.

While performing Quiver Dance, Volcarona hadn't stopped scattering scales. As soon as Gengar dared to appear... a bit of flame would ignite all the scales surrounding Volcarona, creating the perfect fire defense.

However.

Gengar wasn't burned by the flames because... the open dimensional rift had swallowed some of the flames created by Volcarona!

A gap had been opened in Volcarona's flame barrier through space manipulation!

"I'll take that!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar, hiding by the dimensional rift, flashed a cunning look in its eyes. From the shadowy corners around Volcarona, four or five tiny shadow bats trembled and flew out.

"Under the sun, there are no shadows, Volcarona!" Alder clenched his fist upon seeing this.

"Wooo!!"

Volcarona's six wings flashed with incredibly bright light, the black dots on them like sunspots...

Under the intense light, the shadow bats "stolen" by Gengar turned into wisps of smoke and eventually dissipated into nothingness.

Hmm?

You can even extinguish "Thief" like that?

Although Gengar couldn't gain Volcarona's enhancement boost, Volcarona... also couldn't keep this power.

Both sides seemed to have returned to square one.

"Evenly matched?" Dulse's face showed surprise.

He actually felt... the two sides seemed to be in a state of equal strength!

Was that really true?

"No, strictly speaking... the initiative is still in Champion Alder's hands," Shauntal shook her head.

Having the initiative meant controlling the rhythm.

But... Teacher Johan has never liked losing control of the rhythm in a battle. That way... it's not sustainable...

"Volcarona, Fiery Dance once more, then whip up a Heat Wave!" Alder was certainly not one to surrender the rhythm.

"Wooo!!"

The fire moths danced again, even more numerous than before. They spiraled and danced under an incredibly hot wave, becoming larger and denser as they surged toward Gengar.

Moreover.

Under the convergence of heat waves and light, all the shadows around Gengar were dispersed completely in a short time!

No shadows!

Which meant no dimensions!

Volcarona, bringing warmth and light, shattered all darkness with flames!

Seeing this, the audience couldn't help but swallow.

"So-so strong... Champion Alder is really going all out—"

"Even completely eliminating the shadows, this—"

"What will Teacher Johan do?"

What to do?

Johan adjusted his monocle, feeling the heat wave and inwardly complaining—

This is really unreasonable. Interrupting "Thief" is one thing, but now even eliminating shadows? This doesn't comply with basic principles!

No choice then.

Johan took a slight breath, reaching for the Key Stone at the end of his monocle's anti-slip chain, but suddenly paused.

Dispersed the shadows?

No!

Where there is light, there are shadows. No matter how strong the light, shadows always exist—at most, they might be diluted or compressed to their minimum...

If that's the case.

Then let the darkness come more fiercely!

Johan abandoned the Key Stone and instead took out a black transparent sphere that emitted colorful light, resembling a Poké Ball.

Seeing this object, the audience collectively stirred.

"A-a Terastal Orb!"

"Teacher Johan actually has a Terastal Orb?!"

"What?! I thought it would be Mega Evolution, but instead it's..."

Swish——

With his black suit fluttering and hair ends swaying, his gaze suddenly becoming sharp, Johan threw the Terastal Orb in his hand, landing it on Gengar's head.

"Become a shadow, envelope everything, Gengar!"

Crack-crack-crack-crack——

Layer upon layer of crystals rose from beneath Gengar's feet, rapidly piling up to form a small crystal mountain. The mischievous-faced Gengar was vividly visible within the crystal mountain.

Crack——

Suddenly.

A crack appeared on the crystal mountain, and then all the crystals shattered into dust in an instant.

What appeared before everyone's eyes was a Gengar that seemed carved from crystal—its purple skin covered by a layer of smooth, light-reflecting crystal, and on its head, a ghost gem like a crown.

Tera Ghost, Terastallized Gengar!

Hum——

With the Terastallized Gengar at its center, an extremely powerful shadow covered the entire field!

# 603: Could It Be That Teacher Johan Has Another Trump Card?!

"Ka! Kaah——!"

Gengar cackled, looking at its crystal-like body, feeling a change different from Mega Evolution.

If one were to say...

Mega Evolution provides Pokémon with an all-around enhancement of abilities, while Terastallization strengthens a single type.

Since Gengar Terastallized into the Ghost type, setting aside Terastallization's feature of changing a Pokémon's type, Gengar's mastery of Ghost-type abilities had also increased tremendously.

The best evidence was how it spread black mist across the entire field, forming what seemed like a special "Ghost Terrain," despite Volcarona's intense sunlight that was like the sun scorching the earth.

"So this is Terastallization..."

Johan also felt the changes brought by Terastallization.

Compared to Mega Evolution, Terastallization placed much less burden on the trainer.

Thinking about it carefully, it made sense.

Although Mega Evolution required a Key Stone and Mega Stone, using the bond as a key to unlock the Mega Evolution energy within the Mega Stone through the Key Stone's power.

But what Mega Evolution truly relied on was the bond between trainer and Pokémon, allowing them to achieve a unity of hearts and minds.

Terastallization, on the other hand, consumed energy from the Terastal Orb, making it a one-time "consumable," thus placing much less burden on the trainer.

Of course.

Using Terastallization for the first time wasn't exactly easy for Gengar and Johan, but it was also a novel experience.

However, for Blueberry Academy students, Terastallization was a more familiar enhancement method, although even at Blueberry Academy, not many people were recognized and allowed to use it.

But that didn't stop them from cheering for Johan and the Terastallized Gengar.

Meanwhile, the battle continued.

Volcarona used Heat Wave to command the fire moths, sweeping across the entire field.

Looking at the Terastallized Gengar, Alder's eyes showed a hint of surprise. He had thought Johan and Gengar would use Mega Evolution, not Terastallization...

But this made things more interesting, didn't it?

"Volcarona, let the flames burn even more fiercely!" Alder laughed loudly before shouting.

Whoosh!!

The surging flames, enhanced by the heat wave, made the temperature in the entire arena rise uncontrollably. Since light couldn't completely dispel darkness, then a direct confrontation would resolve everything!

"Gengar!"

After giving Gengar a little time to adjust to the changes brought by Terastallization and feeling the incoming heat waves and fire moths, Johan also called out.

Hum——

Gengar spread its hands, with dense black mist swirling between them, then slashed downward, creating a dimensional rift within the black mist.

At the same time.

In the Distortion World, Giratina was leisurely lying on a relatively intact island, holding Energy Root tea sent by Gengar, watching a TV show projected on a glass screen—the picture of relaxation.

Hmm?

Suddenly, Giratina instinctively turned its head to see a small rift opening in the distorted space, followed by a heat wave carrying dancing fire moths surging in.

Seeing this, Giratina raised an eyebrow slightly, then calmly took a sip of Energy Root tea.

[Oh, more fireworks? Tsk—so bitter!]

From the perspective of the Blueberry Academy students, thick black mist rose from around the field, enveloping the fire moths, and when the black mist dispersed... the fire moths had vanished with it.

"Whoa—what move is that?"

"Why isn't it in our school's teaching move list?"

"I want to learn it! Please teach me!"

"..."

Others might not know, but Alder knew something.

From the precious, confidential video footage preserved from the Opelucid City incident, Gengar had used this move to swallow Team Plasma's entire warship.

"Our turn," Johan's eyes flashed as he said in a deep voice:

"Gengar, Shadow Ball!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar called out, immediately forming a massive Shadow Ball between its hands, but after kneading it a couple more times, the huge Shadow Ball visibly shrank to just palm-sized.

Alder and Volcarona immediately sensed the threat from that Shadow Ball.

In other battles, Alder might have taken a more cautious approach, but this was an exhibition match, so...

Alder's smile revealed a touch of excitement that he himself hadn't noticed.

It had been who knows how long—how long since he had felt this way, this feeling of being completely immersed in battle, with his blood gradually boiling with excitement.

And in this exhibition match with Johan, he felt it again!

"Volcarona, Fire Blast!"

"Wooo!!"

As Alder's partner, Volcarona naturally sensed Alder's change, and its azure eyes lit up with fire.

Its six wings, radiating sunlight-like brilliance, flapped to create a scalding flame that condensed into an enormous "大" character, surging toward Gengar.

The audience in the stands all rose to their feet.

This was the most direct collision, with neither side choosing to dodge or use complex tactics—just pure power against power.

The enormous flames exploded thunderously, and even the scattered rolling heat waves made Gengar feel scorched, giving it a sense of being surrounded by flames, showing how powerful Volcarona's Fire Blast truly was.

BOOM!!!

"Ev-evenly matched?"

"What terrifying energy collision—"

"The heat wave aftereffect can even harm Gengar; it seems Champion Alder might be more powerful?"

"No! Look! The Shadow Ball hasn't completely dissipated!"

Amid the audience's exclamations, from the rising flames, a fist-sized Shadow Ball shot out "whoosh," heading straight for Volcarona.

"Volcarona!" Alder cried out in alarm.

Volcarona, worthy of being Alder's ace, reacted quickly enough, its wings immediately flapping again as flames rose from its body, instantly enveloping it, trying to block Gengar's Shadow Ball.

But the next second.

To everyone's amazement, the Shadow Ball "popped" through the flames, striking Volcarona.

The feeling... was like being punched directly by a Fighting-type Pokémon!

"It's a physical attack!"

The overall quality of Blueberry Academy students was a bit higher than that of ordinary spectators, and someone quickly discovered the key.

"It's actually a physical attack!"

"How can a Shadow Ball be a physical attack?!"

"This move... Teacher Johan seems to have used it in the 'Youth Master World Championship'!"

Special Attack transformed into Physical Attack?

This was Mewtwo's Psystrike technique!

As everyone knows, Volcarona is also a Special Attack-oriented Pokémon with fairly good Special Defense, but in terms of Physical Attack and Defense... it's relatively weak.

This Shadow Ball hit Volcarona quite hard.

Could Teacher Johan actually hold some advantage in this clash with Champion Alder?

Even if it was due to the element of surprise, an advantage was an advantage.

"Volcarona!" Alder's gaze burned like fire. He wasn't angry; rather, a strong fighting spirit surged in his heart. "Our opponent is strong, so we... absolutely cannot fall behind!"

Whoosh!!

Volcarona closed and opened its eyes, and its aura began to rise, its wings continuously flapping, its body rising with it as large patches of sparks scattered.

Seeing this, Johan's eye twitched.

Blaze?

"Artificial" Blaze?

Cheating!

The mighty Champion, actually cheating in front of so many people!

Report him! Referee, I'm reporting him—he's cheating!

This is why Johan really disliked battling "emotional-type" trainers. How are you supposed to play when the other person suddenly gains an extra ability mid-battle?

"Gengar!" Johan gritted his teeth, his eyes fierce, "Maximum power, Shadow Ball!"

The Terastallized Gengar took a deep breath, and the black mist shadows spread across the field flowed back like water, quickly converging into its body.

Then it raised both hands, hurling a massive Shadow Ball as solid as crystal.

Crystal?

Alder was slightly surprised, and even Johan felt somewhat unexpected.

But Alder didn't lose focus because of this, only shouting: "Volcarona, Fiery Dance!"

Whoosh——

All the previously scattered scales instantly ignited, flames and fire moths intertwining to form a spiral fire pillar that surged forward.

The next moment.

Flames collided with the black ball.

BOOM!!!

With the violent explosion, the entire field shook uncontrollably. Cracks appeared on the sturdy battlefield barrier, as if it might shatter at any moment.

It's worth noting that because Blueberry Academy's arena was relatively small, the battlefield barrier's range was also small, but this didn't mean the barrier was weak—in fact, because of the smaller range, the barrier's durability was even stronger.

Could it really be about to break under the impact of the collision?

Just as the announcer was feeling terrified, the countdown on the big screen finally reached zero, and he immediately breathed a sigh of relief, promptly announcing:

"Exhibition time is over!! Thank you to both guests for the wonderful battle!! Let's give them the warmest applause!"

After saying this, the announcer vigorously wiped his forehead.

Good thing they hadn't assigned a referee, otherwise, their life would have been in danger...

Clap-clap-clap——

The entire arena erupted in enthusiastic applause.

And amid this wave of applause, the dust raised by the collision in the arena finally began to settle.

Revealing Volcarona with its burning gaze, and the crystal-like Gengar.

"Ka-kaah~~"

The crystalline form receded from Gengar's body. It glanced at Volcarona, pulled out its sunglasses, and ran back to Johan's side in a few steps, hands on its hips.

"Ka-kaah?"

Was the old master brave or what?

Johan smiled and patted the little fatty's head, "Absolutely brave."

"Nii-mi~Nii-mi~~"

Victini also happily circled around Gengar.

In the VIP room.

Akane swallowed hard with a "gulp" and murmured: "They really were... evenly matched..."

Evenly matched?

Dulse shook his head, saying solemnly: "Although Teacher Johan used Terastallization while Champion Alder didn't, it was indeed Teacher Johan and Gengar who held a slight advantage."

Although the advantage wasn't large, Gengar was definitely ahead by a small margin in terms of stamina.

However, Terastallization did indeed have a significant impact.

Lacey clasped her hands to her chest, her glasses flashing with a touch of admiration as she said:

"But... it's obvious that this must be the first time Teacher Johan and Gengar have used Terastallization, right? Being able to use it like this is already very good..."

Indeed.

The Blueberry Academy group nodded.

If Teacher Johan and Gengar were to become proficient in using Terastallization, then the result would be hard to predict...

Of course, they also noticed Champion Alder and Volcarona's "slow-starting" state.

At this moment.

Shauntal, standing by the floor-to-ceiling window, suddenly said:

"But this isn't Teacher Johan and Gengar's preferred battle style. If it wasn't an exhibition match..."

Everyone: "!!!"

Dulse and the others naturally understood Shauntal's meaning—Gengar isn't the type of Pokémon for direct confrontation...

On the field.

Johan and Alder stood together, smiling, as the announcer interviewed them.

"Teacher Johan, may I ask how you feel?" The announcer held the microphone in front of Johan.

"Ka-kaah! Ka-kaah!" Gengar tried to stand on tiptoe beside him but was held down by Johan's hand on its head.

With his smile unchanged, Johan said:

"We were being clever, taking advantage of Terastallization. In a real battle... between me and Champion Alder, it would be at most... 20-80."

20-80?

"Teacher Johan is being modest," the announcer quickly said.

Indeed.

Gengar had the enhancement of Terastallization, but 20-80 was a bit extreme—at most... 30-70.

They had all witnessed Teacher Johan and Gengar's strength.

"Champion Alder, do you have anything to say?" The announcer then held the microphone in front of Alder.

"zzZ"

A snot bubble hung from Alder's nose—he was actually snoring!

"Wooo!"

Volcarona gently flapped a wing, and Alder's eyes immediately widened as he cried out, "Hot hot hot hot!!"

Everyone: "..."

Fortunately, Alder quickly came to his senses, "Oh, what I want to say..."

He coughed twice.

"Johan is very strong. Without him using his full power, I'd only have a 50% chance of winning against him."

Whoosh!!

The entire arena was in an uproar.

A 50% chance?

50-50?

Everyone stand up!

What an incredibly high evaluation!

Even Johan beside him looked at Alder with some surprise.

Champion Alder, you're... basically praising me to death here!

In Johan's view, if both sides were to fight without holding back... between him and Alder, purely Gengar against Volcarona, it would be at most 40-60.

If it were a full team battle, the odds might be even lower, possibly not even 30-70.

After all, even having lost his strongest ace, a Champion was still a Champion.

50-50 was definitely too high.

However, Johan now had a more accurate understanding and positioning of Gengar's strength.

Without enhancements, it was about on par with a Champion's main team Pokémon.

With enhancements, whether Mega Evolution or Terastallization, it was roughly at the normal level of an ordinary Champion's ace Pokémon.

But with both Mega Evolution and Terastallization, perhaps it could compete with peak Cynthia's normal-state Garchomp.

However, Johan wasn't yet certain if Mega Evolution could be used simultaneously with Terastallization.

As far as he knew now, it was merely a possibility.

When the time came that Gengar, without any enhancements, could compete with peak Cynthia's Mega Garchomp, then he could rest easy.

In short, the road ahead was long, with heavy responsibilities.

"Wait!"

But soon someone noticed another key point in Champion Alder's words, including the announcer, who quickly asked:

"Champion Alder, you just said... 'without Teacher Johan using his full power'... does that mean...?"

"Ah." Alder cheerfully scratched the back of his head and candidly said:

"If Johan were to use his true full power, between him and me, it would probably be... 90-10, or perhaps 100-0."

Johan: "???"

Whoosh!!

The arena was once again in an uproar, with everyone's jaws practically hitting the floor.

Teacher Johan's "true full power"... could crush a Champion?

Johan also looked at Alder with complete astonishment.

Boss, you can eat whatever you want, but you can't just say whatever pops into your head!

100-0 against a Champion?

Not even in his dreams.

Faced with Johan's gaze, Alder just smiled and winked, then shrugged his shoulders.

Alder felt what he said...

Was perfectly accurate!

"Peak" Johan: Left hand White Dragon Reshiram, right hand Black Dragon Zekrom, standing on Kyurem, with Darkrai behind him, Victini on his chest, and Giratina above his head—forget being a Champion, even if he were the Champion of Champions, he wouldn't stand a chance!

Saying it was 90-10 was already flattering himself.

Of course, all this... wasn't really within the ordinary spectators' range of consideration.

They just thought—

Could it be that Teacher Johan has another trump card?!

# 604: Teacher Johan, Is Your Pokémon Legal?

The arena was buzzing with excitement, as Alder and Johan's exhibition match had instantly ignited the audience's enthusiasm.

Of course, the post-match interview also sparked endless imagination among the Blueberry Academy students.

Just how strong was Teacher Johan?

Amid the audience's cheers, Johan temporarily left the stage, yielding it to Dulse who was preparing to enter.

Originally, the exhibition match was supposed to be between League Champion Alder and Academy Champion Dulse, but Johan's "intrusion" had extended the schedule.

But the audience actually quite enjoyed this type of exhibition match.

They expressed: If they could continue watching Champion Alder versus Teacher Johan battle, please give us more!

Of course, a League Champion versus an Academy Champion also had some appeal.

Johan stood by the player tunnel without immediately leaving, instead walking toward the Pokémon Center set up inside the arena.

At the same time, he was pondering something.

Using Gengar against Alder was a no-brainer, but for an exhibition match against Dulse, who specialized in Dragon-type Pokémon, he couldn't very well use Ice Ninetales, could he?

That would be somewhat inhumane.

It seemed Dragonite was his only option.

After all, when facing Dragon-type Pokémon, his Dragonite always showed particular excitement.

While he was considering this, the second exhibition match on the field had already begun.

Alder was using his Bouffalant, while Dulse was using his ace Duralodon.

"Shine with brilliant metallic luster, Duralodon!"

Dulse threw out a Terastal Orb, and crystals formed around Duralodon. Already made entirely of duralumin steel, with an added layer of Terastal sheen, Duralodon now looked even more valuable.

"Teacher Johan, do you need your Terastal Orb recharged?"

At this moment, Nurse Joy's soft voice came from beside Johan.

At Blueberry Academy, the best way to recharge a Terastal Orb was through the Pokémon Center.

"Thank you, Nurse Joy," Johan smiled slightly, handing over the Terastal Orb that had lost its energy.

"It-it's my duty—"

Nurse Joy took the Terastal Orb and turned to walk into the Pokémon Center with Chansey.

"By the way... where does Blueberry Academy's Terastal energy come from?"

Terastallization originated from the ancient legendary Pokémon Terapagos, but if Johan remembered correctly, Terapagos had become extinct two million years ago, with only one remaining due to crustal movement.

And this last remaining Terapagos had fallen into slumber, currently likely with the grandmother of Riko, one of the protagonists of "Pokémon Horizons."

"But then again, if Terapagos is sleeping... where does the Paldea region's Terastal energy come from?"

Thinking of this, Johan shook his head.

Who cares where it comes from? Anyway, he didn't believe Terapagos would suddenly appear before him.

But just at that moment.

Ding-ding-ding——

The crisp sound of ice crystals colliding rang in Johan's ears, growing closer and closer. The sound was like when Gengar Terastallized, only more delicate.

"No way—" Johan's mouth twitched.

Could his random thought actually come true?

His vision briefly blurred, and a Pokémon resembling a land turtle, deep blue all over, with eyes like stars and a hexagonal crystalline shell, suddenly appeared before him and Gengar.

Terapagos?!

"Ka-ka-kaah? (⊙_⊙)"

Gengar rubbed its eyes twice, then its eyes lit up.

It-it looks so valuable...

Hum——

With a red flash, Larvitar automatically came out, looking at the "Terapagos" floating in the air. Its eyes were even brighter than Gengar's, and drool even flowed from the corner of its mouth.

"Yo-Yoji...(@ρ@)"

It-it looks so delicious...

Johan: "..."

He covered his face. This was bad—Larvitar really was interested in Terapagos's crystals.

If Larvitar were to Terastallize in the future... would this little thing get so carried away it might even try to eat itself?

Normally, when Pokémon face Gengar's money-obsessed ghost eyes or Larvitar's starving-ghost eyes, they would feel scared.

But this "Terapagos" before them not only wasn't afraid, but even playfully winked, showing a "got you" smile.

"Mew~~"

Hmm?

A clear, ethereal voice rang out, making Johan instinctively pause. Gengar and Larvitar also came to their senses, showing puzzled expressions.

This voice... sounded so familiar.

Johan was the first to react, looking at the "Terapagos" and tentatively calling out:

"Mew?"

"Mew~~(＾▽＾)"

The "Terapagos" glowed with a strange light, and its appearance indeed changed into Mew!

A slightly plumper Mew looked even more adorable.

"Nii-mi?!"

Victini on Johan's shoulder revealed itself, watching as "Terapagos" transformed back into Mew, rubbing its eyes with its little hands.

So amazing!

This was Victini's first time seeing Mew.

"Mew~~"

Mew swished its long, slender tail and dove into Johan's arms. He immediately felt the soft, slightly plump little one.

"You've gotten fatter," Johan rubbed Mew's head, laughing. "Nice to see you, Mew."

"Mew~!"

Hearing Johan say "fatter," Mew immediately puffed up its cheeks, pretending to be angry, which drew laughter from Johan and Gengar.

Come to think of it, the last time Mew came to find him, although they had fun together, Johan had promised Mew he would bring it to play again at the next academy Spring Festival.

But later, due to a series of events in the Unova region, plus the "Youth Master World Championship," Johan hadn't made it to the academy's Spring Festival.

So, Mew, having waited for a long time, came looking for him itself.

"Mew? Mew?"

After burrowing into Johan's arms, Mew suddenly twitched its little nose and began sniffing him.

"Mew?"

The more it sniffed, the more puzzled its expression became, with a hint of curiosity.

"What's wrong, Mew?" Johan couldn't help but ask, seeing this.

"Mew—" Mew showed a thoughtful expression, "Mew?"

It had detected from Johan's body... a scent that was somewhat familiar yet somewhat strange, a very... odd scent.

Have you been secretly seeing other little Mews?

Hearing this, Johan couldn't help but laugh.

How many Mews were there in this world? He... wasn't really sure.

However, Johan also understood what scent Mew had detected. It wasn't Mew's, but Mewtwo's.

But explaining Mewtwo's existence also posed a challenge for him.

Fortunately, little Mew was only curious for a moment before its attention was drawn to Victini.

After the two little ones curiously sized each other up for a few moments, a mischievous gleam flashed in Mew's eyes.

"Mew~~" (Rock-paper-scissors!)

"Nii-nii mi?" Victini instinctively extended its hand—scissors.

Mew extended a small, clenched pink fist.

"Mew~~" (Rock, I win~~)

Victini: ...

The little one dove into Johan's clothes.

"Teacher Johan, your Terastal Orb—" Nurse Joy's voice came from behind.

"Mew~!"

Mew reacted quickly, immediately transforming into an Eevee and landing in Johan's arms.

"What was that sound?" Nurse Joy looked puzzled.

"Ee-vui~~"

Johan turned around, and the Eevee in his arms casually licked its paw.

"What?"

"Nothing, I must have misheard," Nurse Joy said, holding a tray with the fully recharged Terastal Orb in the center—a transparent black crystal ball with rippling waves inside.

"Teacher Johan, your Terastal Orb is fully charged."

"Thank you, Nurse Joy," Johan smiled.

"Ee-vui~~"

Mew also called out.

"How cute, this little Eevee, so plump—obviously well-fed," Nurse Joy remarked.

"Ee-Ee-vui?!"

Johan quickly pressed his hand on Mew's head, hurriedly saying, "Um... Nurse Joy, I need to go prepare."

"Alright."

Johan then carried Mew, pulling Gengar and Larvitar along as he quickly walked away.

"Ee-vui!"

The Eevee that Mew had transformed into puffed up its cheeks.

Johan directly inserted his hand into its fluffy fur, saying with a smile: "But you are quite cute."

With its fleshiness and smooth fur, wasn't it much better to pet than something like Garchomp?

Hearing Johan's words, Mew's expression immediately improved. It raised its paw to paw at Johan's clothes.

Knowing what it wanted, Johan immediately took out some Poké Puffs and macarons.

"Nii-mi?"

Smelling the aroma of the macarons, Victini, who had suffered a thousand-mile defeat on the "rock-paper-scissors" road, also came out.

Before long.

The "crunch-crunch" sounds and "Ee-vui Ee-vui" voices became the main theme.

"Yoji~~"

Larvitar, with a mineral in one hand and a macaron in the other, indicated: Macarons paired with minerals is the perfect combination, you guys just don't understand.

However, Mew's sudden appearance gave Johan some new ideas.

"Mew, would you be interested in... participating in the exhibition match?" Johan asked.

"Ee-vui?"

The Eevee blinked twice.

When it came to battles and fighting, Mew actually didn't have much desire for it, as it wasn't a Pokémon that particularly enjoyed fighting—quite different from Mewtwo in this regard.

But an "exhibition match," or rather a "performance," immediately caught little Mew's interest.

After all, it was just an exhibition match, so winning or losing didn't matter, nor did the fighting style.

"Ee-vui~~"

Mew hopped and changed back to its original form, then became invisible as it passed through the player tunnel to the edge of the field. Hearing the cheers of the entire arena, its little eyes immediately showed interest.

Returning to Johan's side.

"We can do... this and that..." Johan said in a low voice.

"Mew~~" Mew covered its mouth with both hands, revealing a sly smile.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar scratched its butt, tilting its head slightly.

Why does it feel like this little Mew is also learning from me?

Johan also showed a similar "Johan family style" smile.

"Let's give them a little shock."

"Thank you, Champion Alder and Student Dulse, for bringing us such an exciting exhibition match!"

The entire arena erupted in cheers.

It had to be said that while Dulse VS Alder wasn't quite as thrilling as Teacher Johan VS Alder, it still gave the audience a different feeling.

Johan VS Alder gave them the excitement of watching a celebrity match.

Dulse VS Alder gave them more immersion, allowing them to imagine themselves in Dulse's position, fantasizing about the future scene where they themselves would reach the hall of the Champion Cup and face Champion Alder.

As for the upcoming Dulse VS Teacher Johan—why did it mysteriously feel like a subject teacher giving one-on-one individual guidance to a student?

After giving Dulse some rest time, as well as time to recharge the Terastal Orb, Johan and Dulse slowly appeared on the field under the announcer's introduction.

"Teacher Johan! Dulse has been held back for three years, you need to give him a good 'remedial lesson'!"

"Teacher Johan, Dulse likes to doze off and has a lazy personality, you need to 'cure' him properly!"

"..."

Many students cupped their hands like megaphones, shouting to Johan on the field.

Dulse: "..."

Before Johan could react, Dulse had already inserted his hands into his hair, covering his forehead.

Headache.

Although Dulse was strong, being the undisputed Champion of Blueberry Academy's Blueberry League, as well as the president of the League Union.

If this were translated to the real League, it would be equivalent to combining Leon and Rose—Champion and League Chairman in one person.

But Dulse's laziness was also well-known. For studying and going to school... he really couldn't muster much interest.

Those who didn't know better might think he was Alder's grandson, rather than the grandson of Mr. Shaga, the strict Gym Leader and teacher.

Because Dulse and Alder actually had some similarities.

Dulse quickly adjusted his state. He knew that those voices were just Blueberry Academy students joking around. Rather than these jokes, he was more concerned about his match with Teacher Johan.

"Teacher Johan, my grandfather has mentioned more than once on the phone that I should learn well from you, and I've actually been looking forward to battling you for a long time!"

Dulse held a Poké Ball in his hand and threw it without hesitation.

"Go, Kingdra!"

When battling Alder, Dulse's Pokémon was Duralodon, but facing Johan, he chose Kingdra, a Water and Dragon-type Pokémon!

Clearly.

This was a precaution against Johan's Ice Ninetales.

Kingdra was quite talented in terms of weather, and its Water-type also made it less afraid of Ice-type moves.

It seemed Dulse had a good understanding of Johan.

But...

Johan smiled.

It was just an exhibition match, no need to be so serious. Even if Mew hadn't come, he probably wouldn't have used Ice Ninetales, which would be too targeted against Dulse's Pokémon.

But now...

"Go, 'Eevee'."

"Ee-vui~!"

'Eevee', transformed by Mew, jumped from Johan's arms onto the field.

"Eevee?" Dulse was taken aback.

The audience was also stunned.

"Eevee?"

"Does Teacher Johan have an Eevee Pokémon?"

"I think... I heard someone mention it before?"

But what shocked them even more was Johan's first command.

"'Eevee', Misty Terrain!"

"Ee-vui——"

A pink field spread from 'Eevee', expanding in all directions.

Everyone: ???

Wait.

Eevee... can use Misty Terrain?

Teacher Johan, is your Pokémon legal?

# 605: So This Is Teacher Johan's True 'Trump Card'?

Eevee?

Seeing the Pokémon summoned by Teacher Johan, Dulse was obviously taken aback.

In the information he had obtained, there was no mention of Teacher Johan having an Eevee.

Could it be a Pokémon Teacher Johan had just captured?

Although this was an exhibition match, using a newly captured Pokémon to battle him—wasn't that a bit disrespectful?

Dulse couldn't help but have such thoughts.

In fact, he wasn't the only one thinking this way; many Blueberry Academy audience members shared similar thoughts.

"Dulse, show Teacher Johan what you're made of!"

"Dulse, show Teacher Johan the experience you've accumulated from being held back three times!"

"Come on, defeat Teacher Johan, Dulse!"

"..."

Saying it was "mass excitement" might be an exaggeration, but this rare opportunity to defeat Teacher Johan—Dulse, you must seize it!

Some people even wished they could replace Dulse on the field. How did such a "good" opportunity fall to Dulse?

However.

As the announcer declared the official start of this exhibition match, after Johan issued his first command, everyone including Dulse did a complete 180-degree turn on their previous opinions.

"'Eevee', Misty Terrain!"

"Ee-vui~~"

With 'Eevee's' gentle call, the light pink Misty Terrain immediately spread rapidly, covering the entire field at incredible speed.

This left everyone stunned.

"Wait! I may not be well-read, but Teacher Johan, don't fool me—can Eevee use Misty Terrain?!"

"Eevee? This isn't the Eevee I know!"

"Teacher Johan! Is your Eevee legal?!"

Eevee could actually use Misty Terrain?

Then Groudon could probably fly too!

But the facts were right before their eyes. The Blueberry Academy students couldn't help but feel amazed and began to doubt... whether the knowledge in their textbooks was wrong?

At this moment, Dulse also realized.

Perhaps... Teacher Johan's Eevee wasn't as he had imagined.

Instantly, Dulse focused all his attention, clearing all extraneous thoughts from his mind.

"Kingdra, Rain Dance!"

"Doru~!"

Kingdra raised its head, blue light flickering in its eyes. Dark clouds quickly gathered above the arena, and torrential rain began to pour down.

Large raindrops fell on Kingdra's body, soaking its scales while creating a thin mist around its body.

In an instant, Kingdra's gills and the fins on its back fluttered, and bathed in the rain, its body seemed to become more agile and flexible.

Swift Swim!

[Swift Swim: Pokémon with this ability have their Speed doubled in rain or heavy rain weather!]

Undoubtedly, this was an ability that perfectly complemented rainy weather.

Immediately after, Dulse unhesitatingly took out his fully charged Terastal Orb and threw it toward Kingdra.

"Splash freely in the rain, Kingdra!"

Crack-crack-crack——

Crystals rose from beneath Kingdra's feet, completely enveloping it before quickly shattering and scattering into glittering points that disappeared. Kingdra's appearance also changed somewhat.

Its entire body was covered with a layer of transparent crystals, making it look as if it were carved from crystal.

At the same time, on Kingdra's head was a crown representing the Water type, carved from brilliant blue crystal gems.

Terastallization! Tera Water, Kingdra!

Surprisingly, it didn't choose its most proficient Dragon-type Terastallization, which was somewhat unexpected.

However, combined with the rainy weather and Kingdra's natural Water typing, it made sense.

Enhanced by Terastallization, plus the benefits of rain, Kingdra was now in peak condition.

Seeing that Teacher Johan's Eevee had only used Misty Terrain and then made no further moves, Dulse immediately understood—Teacher Johan was letting him go first, giving full "performance" opportunity to this exhibition match!

Naturally, Dulse wouldn't waste this chance. He had already abandoned any previous thoughts of underestimation.

"Kingdra, move! Dragon Dance!"

Splash-splash——

Rainwater had accumulated in a thin layer on the field. Kingdra rode the current like walking on waves, its body dancing with special rhythm, its aura beginning to soar, and its already considerable speed was enhanced once more.

"Ee-vui~~"

'Eevee' sat in front of Johan, watching the imposing Kingdra with apparent leisure as it licked its paw and groomed its fur, looking completely relaxed.

Seeing this, Dulse's brow furrowed slightly.

Just allowing the opponent to strengthen without any other action?

Dulse took a deep breath and suddenly swung his hand, shouting: "Hydro Pump!"

Although Dragon Dance strengthened physical attack, Dulse cautiously chose the long-range Hydro Pump to probe, trying to gather more information about the opposing 'Eevee'—know yourself and know your enemy.

"Doru~!"

Kingdra coiled its body, immediately spitting out a powerful, thick water column from its mouth, surging toward the petite 'Eevee'.

The water column, enhanced by the rainwater as it flowed, gained even more power.

Johan smiled slightly and said: "'Eevee', dodge."

"Ee-vui~"

Hearing Johan's words, the leisurely 'Eevee' finally moved.

Just as the water column from Hydro Pump was about to hit 'Eevee'.

How could it dodge... the audience thought.

The next second.

'Eevee' turned into a white flash, actually managing to sidestep just before the Hydro Pump hit, precisely and skillfully "brushing" past the water column to avoid it.

Even the water droplets kicked up by the column didn't manage to wet its fur.

"Such incredible speed!" Dulse's pupils contracted as he exclaimed in surprise.

But then the two words that came from Teacher Johan's mouth surprised him even more.

"Thunderbolt!"

Eevee?

Thunderbolt?

This...

Before the audience could process their confusion...

"Ee-vui!"

Zzzt-zzzt-zzzt——

The fine sound of electric current suddenly rang out as brilliant golden electricity burst from 'Eevee's' body, shooting toward Kingdra at a speed faster than Hydro Pump.

"Kingdra!" Dulse shouted loudly.

But the electricity gathered by Thunderbolt struck Kingdra precisely, bathing it in lightning!

For a moment, the entire arena fell silent.

The announcer held the microphone, mouth agape, stammering for a long time before managing to say: "What an excellent Thunderbolt! It dealt massive damage to Kingdra!"

Eevee's Thunderbolt—everyone kept repeating these words in their minds.

"Too-too fake..."

"Eevee can actually use Thunderbolt?"

"Honestly, since Eevee can already use Misty Terrain, what's wrong with using Thunderbolt?"

"This Eevee... couldn't it know all of Eevee's moves?"

"Huh?! Huh?! Don't say that, you really shouldn't say that..."

Someone proposed a bold hypothesis—Teacher Johan's Eevee... might be able to use all Eevee evolution moves. Misty Terrain belonged to Sylveon, Thunderbolt belonged to Jolteon...

Even Dulse was starting to think this way.

Johan just wanted to say that their imagination was quite rich, so please make their imagination even bolder and richer.

"Kingdra, Wave Crash!"

Splash-splash——

Water flowed from the scattered raindrops, from the accumulated water on the field, from the streams Kingdra spat out, quickly wrapping and entwining around it, forming a huge water ball.

At the same time, Kingdra began moving rapidly around the field. The water ball seemed to continuously absorb more water during movement, making it even more powerful!

[Wave Crash: Cover the whole body with water and tackle the opponent with tremendous force. The user also sustains serious damage.]

This was an extremely powerful Water-type physical move, which could be considered the Water-type version of Double-Edge, with comparable power.

With Rain Dance and Swift Swim ability, Kingdra's speed was extremely fast. The enhancements from Tera Water, rain, and Dragon Dance also made this move exceptionally powerful.

"Ee-vui!"

'Eevee' finally got somewhat serious. Facing the charging Kingdra, it turned and ran!

Moreover, Kingdra, whose speed had been enhanced by rain and Swift Swim, actually couldn't catch up to this 'Eevee'!

For a moment, the audience seemed to be watching a scene of a cat chasing a mouse but never being able to catch it...

This speed...

The audience expressed: We're used to it, really, we're already used to it. If this Eevee uses Extreme Speed next, we could accept it... like hell we could!

If such a Kingdra couldn't catch up to 'Eevee', how could they fight?

Forget the audience—even Dulse was dumbfounded.

This was unlike any battle he had ever participated in...

Even when battling Champion Alder earlier, although he could feel pressure and the gap in strength between them, it wasn't to the point where... he couldn't even touch his opponent.

This wasn't just a gap in strength—this was a chasm!

"Ahem," Johan cleared his throat, feeling that since this was an exhibition match, this fighting style really wasn't appropriate.

So.

"'Eevee', Thunder!"

End it.

"Ee-vui!!"

'Eevee' suddenly accelerated to temporarily distance itself from Kingdra, then lightning burst from its body into the dark clouds above.

The next moment.

BOOM!

A bolt of lightning tore through the dark sky like ripping open black silk, precisely striking Kingdra wrapped in water.

Brilliant lightning instantly bathed Kingdra, earning a pained cry.

"Doru..."

Splash-splash——

Water scattered everywhere as Kingdra's eyes rolled back and it collapsed on the ground.

This time the audience was truly "used to it"—whether they liked it or not, they had to get used to it. Eevee using Thunderbolt and Thunder—what was wrong with that?

Very reasonable!

"King-Kingdra is unable to battle—"

Just as the announcer was about to declare the result, Johan on the side gave 'Eevee' on the field a look.

It was just an exhibition match—the fight was... ahem, a bit much, so...

'Eevee' immediately understood. Facing the water scattered from around Kingdra, it "ran into" it, then "splash," fell to the ground.

"Ee-vui~!"

With a dramatic cry, it fell down alongside Kingdra.

Announcer: "..."

Audience: "..."

Dulse: "..."

After falling down, 'Eevee' even opened its eyes and winked at Johan, as if asking—was my acting standard? Then it went completely still.

Johan covered his face.

Holding his forehead, he didn't know what to say for a moment.

Mew needed to work on its acting skills.

"Ahem!" Johan cleared his throat again.

The announcer immediately reacted, hurriedly declaring: "Kingdra and Eevee are both unable to battle!"

Hearing this, if the announcer wasn't a teacher they recognized, the audience would probably be jumping up and cursing right now.

But they had to admit...

"As expected, this really was a true 'teaching match.' It reminds me of when I first captured my Pokémon and faced my first battle class teacher..."

"Teacher Johan is really... so gentle. I'm crying!"

"Calculate Dulse's psychological trauma area—no prize competition!"

"..."

Johan and Dulse walked to the side of the field under the announcer's direction, shook hands, and accepted interviews.

"Teacher Johan, I've learned a lot," Dulse said seriously.

He understood Teacher Johan's meaning—just becoming first at Blueberry Academy was nothing. The world was vast; don't be a frog in a well. Feel the strength of trainers from the outside world.

What did you understand... Johan thought confusedly, but still maintained his gentle smile, holding 'Eevee' with one hand while patting Dulse's shoulder with the other.

"Keep it up. Your talent will serve you well in the future."

"Yes!" Dulse nodded seriously, looking completely "reformed and educated."

"Ahem." The announcer began the interview with the microphone, starting with Johan:

"Teacher Johan, how would you evaluate Dulse? How would you evaluate Blueberry Academy?"

Johan smiled: "Dulse is excellent, and so is Blueberry Academy. The students here are well-behaved, speak nicely, and are all talented individuals. I really like it here."

These words immediately earned Johan another wave of adoration from the Blueberry Academy students.

"Teacher Johan! Why not stay at Blueberry Academy!"

"Teacher Johan, Blueberry Academy welcomes you!"

"..."

Then the announcer interviewed Dulse with a smile, asking about his thoughts on this encounter with Teacher Johan.

Dulse pondered for a long while before saying:

"Before battling Teacher Johan, I actually... had some doubts about Champion Alder's statement about a 100-0 match."

He took a deep breath and continued:

"But after this encounter, I somewhat understand why Champion Alder said that."

Looking at the Eevee in Johan's arms, Dulse's eyes flickered.

This was probably... just part of Teacher Johan's full power that Champion Alder mentioned...

Hearing Dulse's words, the audience finally reacted, each showing looks of realization.

So what Champion Alder was talking about was Teacher Johan's ace like this? This Eevee was just one of them?

If Teacher Johan had other Pokémon like this Eevee, then Teacher Johan's strength might... truly be immeasurable!

Champion Alder was indeed knowledgeable and experienced!

Alder: ???

Regarding Johan's 'Eevee', Alder could only say: I have no idea...

Actually, seeing Johan's 'Eevee', the most excited person was probably someone in the Galar region.
