# 606: Through Fire and Water, Boss Giovanni!

"Little Leon, what's up?"

"Master, look quickly! Teacher Johan's exhibition match video at Blueberry Academy—he used Eevee!"

Above the cloudless skies of the Paldea region, Leon was holding his phone, somewhat excitedly calling Mustard.

"Little Johan? Eevee?" Mustard was stunned for a moment, then realized, "Is it that Eevee you've always talked about?"

"Yes."

Leon sat on Charizard's back, his cape flapping behind him, clenching his fist with an expression of finally having waited for this moment.

Ever since that battle with Johan by the seaside, Leon had been constantly thinking about having another match with Johan's Eevee.

But even at the "Youth Master World Championship," Leon had never seen Johan summon Eevee once.

Moreover, he had never heard any information about Johan's Eevee from anyone else. Leon was even starting to think... he had remembered wrong.

Until now!

Mustard looked through the video Leon sent, and when he saw Misty Terrain, Thunderbolt, and Thunder, Mustard couldn't help but scratch his smooth, bald head.

This Eevee...

Even Mustard was somewhat stumped.

It wasn't reasonable!

"Johan's Eevee seems a bit..."

Had Eevee undergone new "mutations" during his retirement?

After all, when he was still Champion, Eevee could only evolve into Vaporeon, Flareon, and Jolteon, but now Eevee had many more evolution forms.

"It's unreasonable, right?" Leon picked up Mustard's words. "I used to think so too."

But soon Leon smiled with relief: "However, since it's Teacher Johan's Pokémon, it's actually 'reasonable.' After all, there's also a shapeshifting Ceruledge and Urshifu."

"True enough."

Mustard nodded.

Young people these days are really getting more amazing one by one~~

"Master, there's one more thing," Leon added.

"What?"

"Could you help me contact that Flying Taxi driver? I... don't know where I am again."

Mustard: "..."

The exhibition match ended.

Johan had perfectly completed his "work," and next was watching Blueberry Academy students conduct their internal competition, deciding the strongest five to serve as Champion and Elite Four respectively.

Compared to the nervous students, Johan seemed very relaxed.

It was quite like... watching students nervously preparing for exams while he, as a teacher, didn't need to prepare—that kind of schadenfreude happiness.

It's great not being a student.

At this time, Briar, who had arranged the schedule, found Johan.

"Teacher Johan, about this exhibition match's compensation..."

"Hey! How embarrassing!"

Johan, who had been half-lying on the sofa, immediately sat up straight.

Briar: "..."

Seeing Teacher Johan's "expectant" expression, Briar couldn't tell if he was genuinely embarrassed or just pretending.

But regardless of what Teacher Johan thought, Blueberry Academy had to show their appreciation.

Then Briar took out a box, and when opened, it contained a complete set of "Evolution Stones"!

Briar smiled: "Considering your 'Eevee,' Teacher Johan, although we don't know what you'll evolve it into, we thought these Evolution Stones should be what you need."

This was a complete set of high-quality Evolution Stones that would be hard to buy even in the market, consisting of:

Fire Stone, Water Stone, Thunder Stone, Moon Stone, Sun Stone, Leaf Stone, Ice Stone, Shiny Stone, Dusk Stone, and Dawn Stone—ten in total!

Seeing these Evolution Stones, Johan's cheek twitched.

As a "heavy Evolution Stone consumer," he naturally knew the quality of these "Evolution Stones." Even the lowest-valued one would probably cost over a million on the market.

Not to mention rarer "Evolution Stones" like "Shiny Stone" and "Dawn Stone," which could cost over three million or even more!

This complete set of "Evolution Stones" definitely exceeded ten million Pokédollars, possibly around twenty million.

It was definitely a grand gesture, and Blueberry Academy was impressively generous, but...

Our "Eevee" is fake!

Johan was somewhat caught between laughter and tears.

But the value of this Evolution Stone set was truly high.

For just two exhibition matches, receiving such compensation meant...

His exhibition match appearance fee had nearly reached ten million Pokédollars per match?

Hiss—

After calculating the price, Johan quietly drew in a sharp breath.

With this net worth... he wanted to sell himself immediately.

"Teacher Johan?" Seeing Johan spacing out, Briar waved her pale hand in front of him.

Johan came back to his senses, clearing his throat: "Well... your academy is really too kind. There's really no need to be so formal."

Although he said this, his movements were very skilled as he took the box, pried open Gengar's mouth, and stuffed it right in.

From taking the box to prying open the mouth to stuffing it in, the movements were smooth and seamless, so practiced that Briar couldn't even get a word in.

But Briar soon smiled with relief, saying: "As long as you're satisfied, Teacher Johan."

A complete set of "Evolution Stones" was just pocket change for Blueberry Academy.

After Briar left, Gengar immediately spat out the box and opened it, then with a tongue roll, immediately took the high-quality "Dusk Stone."

Throwing it in its mouth, it made "gurgle gurgle" rolling sounds, making it seem like it was eating candy.

Then Ice Ninetales took the "Ice Stone."

Ceruledge took the "Fire Stone" and "Dawn Stone."

Urshifu took the "Water Stone."

Tinkaton took the "Moon Stone."

Six of the ten "Evolution Stones" were divided in an instant. Seeing this, Victini glanced at Johan's twitching eye, then happily picked up the "Sun Stone."

Although Dragonite was curious about these "Evolution Stones," none really interested it much, so it didn't move.

Then Rotom quietly looked at Johan, then lightning-fast grabbed the "Thunder Stone."

Larvitar on the side seemed quite calm.

Not because it wasn't interested in these "Evolution Stones," but because...

"Yoji!" It waved magnanimously.

You pick first, I'll help digest whatever's left, nothing will be wasted!

So after everyone had chosen, Larvitar opened its mouth wide, preparing to stuff both the "Leaf Stone" and "Shiny Stone" into its mouth.

For Larvitar, "Evolution Stones" were also stones, just with different energy inside.

Since they were stones, they were within its menu range!

Only the Leaf Stone and Shiny Stone remained.

Seeing this, Johan quickly intervened.

"At least leave me one to sell for money!"

Finally getting ten "Evolution Stones," and you've divided them all—leave one for me to sell and buy your daily food!

While others might snatch food from a tiger's mouth, Johan was snatching food from a Desert Tyrant cub's mouth.

"Yoji..."

In the end, Larvitar only got one "Leaf Stone."

Having eaten branches from the Tree of Beginning, a mere "Leaf Stone" was nothing, and it could even strengthen its resistance to Grass-type moves.

Johan kept the relatively more valuable "Shiny Stone."

However, before he could breathe a sigh of relief, he noticed Mew's eager gaze after it had transformed back.

"Mew~~"

Everyone had chosen, so it naturally had to participate to fit in.

Johan smiled wryly, patted Mew's head, and stuffed the last "Shiny Stone" into its arms: "Here, saved this for you."

"Mew~! o(^▽^)o"

Mew immediately accepted it happily.

After all, the little one had contributed to this exhibition match.

And if it wanted it, could Johan really not give it?

Only, a whole box of ten "Evolution Stones" hadn't even warmed his hands—no, Johan hadn't even touched them—before they were all divided up by these "bandit-like" little ones.

Not one left!

Didn't even leave the room!

Johan looked up at the sky, feeling the sun above Blueberry Academy was particularly dim and gloomy.

Meanwhile, the guest room was filled with continuous sounds: "crunch crunch," "gurgle gurgle," "slurp slurp," "gulp gulp"—if one didn't know better, they'd think Teacher Johan was distributing snacks to his Pokémon.

"Draaa~~"

The only one who hadn't taken an "Evolution Stone," Dragonite, seeing everyone eating so happily, immediately took out a Dragon Scale from its little "pocket" and ate it like a crispy cookie.

"Draaa~~(ˊˋ)"

Happily flapping its little wings, squinting its eyes with a simple expression.

However, whether intentionally or not, when Dragonite took out its "Dragon Scale cookie," it let Johan see its little "pocket's" inventory.

Not much left.

Johan's heart ached as he silently took out a Leppa Berry Poké Puff and put it in his mouth.

He felt... the prize money from winning the "Youth Master World Championship," the remaining forty million plus, wouldn't last much longer.

Tightening his belt...

"When will this end..." Johan sighed inwardly.

At this moment.

Beep beep—

His phone suddenly received a message. After a quick glance, Johan immediately sat up straight.

[Ten million Pokédollars deposited by Rocket Media Entertainment Corporation!]

The transfer also included a note.

[Storm Plan (winking emoji)]

Without question, the transfer was definitely from Boss Giovanni's assistant and general manager, financial director, marketing director, and operations director of Rocket Media Entertainment Corporation—Matori, who had just returned to Kanto.

The reason for this transfer was... Johan's compensation as temporary commander of Team Rocket members in the Unova region for settling the "Storm Plan" remnants.

Johan took a deep breath.

Indeed, Boss Giovanni understood him best. He loved this feeling of being corrupted by money...

Through fire and water, Boss Giovanni!

June 1st, Monday.

Johan finally returned to Kanaz City in Hoenn, which he had left for so long. When he left it was mid-April, and when he returned it was already June.

The Hoenn region's temperature had completely warmed up, at the transition between spring and summer, with quite pleasant climate and temperature.

Johan had stayed at Blueberry Academy for several days, mainly to let little Mew have a good time and enjoy itself fully.

After Mew left, he also took a plane back to Hoenn.

"Ka-kaah~!"

I, Gengar the Great, am back!!

Wearing sunglasses, Gengar stood outside the airport, excitedly shouting.

This trip to Unova was quite an experience.

Beside it, Larvitar, also wearing matching sunglasses like Gengar, held a branch longer than itself, eating it bite by bite, looking quite like it was eating... sugar cane!

Except it ate the "sugar cane" without spitting out the "pulp."

Johan walked quickly, pretending not to know these two particularly attention-grabbing little ones, immediately hailed a taxi—back to the café!

Fortunately, Gengar and Larvitar followed closely without being left behind.

The Café.

Although he'd been away for over a month, the café hadn't changed much from when Johan left. Even the upstairs residential area hadn't accumulated much dust, showing that the Indeedee siblings and Alcremie had managed the café excellently.

"Indeedee~!"

Receiving the gifts Johan had specifically brought, the Indeedee siblings and Alcremie were all very happy, especially the female Indeedee, who directly clung to Johan affectionately.

Then came the welcome ceremony—everyone together welcomed Victini's joining!

Although Johan hadn't used a Poké Ball to capture Victini, humans and Pokémon didn't necessarily need Poké Balls as a "medium."

"Crunch crunch——"

To welcome Victini, the male Indeedee and Alcremie specially made its favorite macarons—various flavored macarons, including cream macarons.

Johan looked at Victini sitting on the table, with cream and crumbs at the corners of its mouth, contentedly munching macarons, and smiled gently.

"Nii-mi~~"

Victini happily closed its eyes, the V on its head glowing with gentle light, seemingly radiating "victory" waves to all the Pokémon in the café.

Victini now felt that following Johan was incredibly happy!

So happy it felt like flying!

Gengar patted Victini's small shoulder, eyes gleaming cunningly as it spoke.

"Ka-kaah~~"

Don't rush, tonight I'll show you the empire I've built here!

"Nii-mi?"

Victini tilted its head, blinking twice.

Empire?

Johan was also considering something.

Now that he'd suddenly returned from Unova to Hoenn, where should his group of little ones train in the future?

It felt like the academy's training facilities and fields couldn't keep up with his little ones' progress...

He couldn't train near home, could he?

Forget about those powerful Normal-type moves the Unova League had given him—just a few kicks from Larvitar would destroy the house!

"If only I could have a small island..."

Johan was becoming increasingly interested in owning his own island and being an "island master."

He also had a rather bold idea.

What if, if, hypothetically... after befriending the awakened Groudon in the future, could he ask it to help create a small island?

Building islands... he'd probably need to discuss it with the fat fish too.

But thinking about those two guys... Johan felt quite a headache.

He didn't know when they'd wake up, and they were both hot-tempered creatures, not easy to communicate with.

"Forget it."

Johan temporarily set aside the thought. "Although the Pokémon world doesn't have this celebration, but... June 1st is Children's Day, we should celebrate properly."

Who isn't a "child"?

# 607: Who Still Isn't a Top-Level Trainer?

THESE CHAPTERS WERE SUPPOSED TO COME OUT TODAY. UPLOADED MORE THAN NEEDED YESTERDAY.

-------------

June 2nd, clear weather.

"Hey, Johan."

Glacia's voice came through the phone.

"Hmm?"

Johan, who hadn't been to the office in a long time, had just sat down after brewing a cup of coffee.

In the past, he couldn't quite understand how his neighbor Professor Cozmo could disappear for a month or even longer, only thinking... are "side jobs" really that busy?

Now he understood - sometimes things really weren't up to you to decide.

As these thoughts flashed through his mind, he also pulled his attention back to this phone call with Elite Four Glacia.

Speaking of which, the Hoenn League was actually quite humane. He had returned to Hoenn yesterday, and Glacia, representing the Hoenn League, was only calling him now - that definitely counted as "humane."

"When do you have time to come to League headquarters?" Glacia said.

"For what?"

Johan became alert, causing Victini, who was sitting on his shoulder munching on macarons, to stop its actions and prick up its ears.

Nearby, Gengar's eyes also rolled around twice before slowly approaching.

"Nothing much, it's just that the appointment notice from the International Police Department came through..." Glacia coughed and said.

"I don't have time recently," Johan said, pushing away Gengar's approaching head.

"Didn't you already come back? What are you still busy with? School matters?" Glacia fired off a series of questions.

"Not entirely."

After thinking for a moment, Johan said: "Ahem, mainly I'm busy accompanying the little one."

"Accompanying the little one?" Glacia was stunned.

"Mew," Johan exchanged a glance with Gengar and smiled.

Although Mew had already gone back, others didn't know that. Sometimes using it as a "shield" was quite nice.

Next time.

When Mew comes next time, he'll give it extra meals!

Gengar's eyes rolled, then it grabbed its throat with its hand and called out.

"Mew~~"

Honestly, the imitation wasn't convincing at all - it sounded like its throat had been scratched with a small knife.

Johan shot it an annoyed glance. Gengar covered its mouth and snickered, thinking it had cooperated perfectly with Johan!

Fortunately, Glacia couldn't understand. After an obvious pause, she hurriedly said:

"Oh oh oh, okay, okay, then you go ahead and stay busy."

After saying that, she hung up the phone.

At the same time, in an office at Hoenn League headquarters, a group of League executives watched Glacia hang up the phone with a shocked expression.

Among them were Elite Four Phoebe, Elite Four Drake, Hoenn Gym Leader Winona, and Steven, who had become a reserve member.

Although called a reserve member, Steven was already performing part of the Elite Four's duties, sitting in the position that originally belonged to Elite Four Drake.

After all, whether Champion or Elite Four, these were very important positions in a regional league. Some people's strength and ability had already met the standards, but there was always a gradual process.

For example, the current Steven, Unova's Iris and Marshal, Sinnoh's Lucian, and so on.

Of course, some reserves were truly just reserves, while others were only nominally reserves but actually had little difference in authority and duties from the Elite Four, including Lucian.

After Steven returned to Hoenn following the "World Junior Championship," he became a so-called "reserve member," but his work and role were essentially that of an Elite Four member.

It wasn't that Steven couldn't be promoted officially, nor that Drake hadn't retired yet.

No exaggeration - since Steven returned, Drake called Glacia almost daily applying to retire, but was rejected by Glacia and the Hoenn League.

They felt that with Steven's talent, perhaps after staying as a reserve for half a year or even a year, he could directly attempt to challenge the "Champion's Road."

Of course, Johan's existence was also part of the reason.

At this moment, seeing Glacia's expression, Phoebe asked curiously:

"What did Johan say?"

Glacia put down her phone, scanned everyone in the office, and said helplessly: "He said... he's accompanying Mew and doesn't have time."

Everyone: "..."

Accompanying Mew?!

What kind of 21st-century excuse was this?

If it were someone else, Glacia might have started cursing immediately. If you're going to make excuses, couldn't you find a better one?

But since it was Johan saying this... they really couldn't doubt it, because he might actually have such a relationship.

The legendary Mew!

Steven laughed heartily, "Teacher is dedicated to teaching and educating. He's really not very interested in these League duties."

Steven understood Johan quite well.

"Right, duties..." Glacia looked at Phoebe and Drake with considerable "resentment."

If not for these duties, her Elite Four life would definitely be quite comfortable too.

Noticing her gaze, Phoebe looked up and started whistling, while Drake lowered her head to play with the Duskull in her shadow.

"However, Teacher isn't someone who shirks responsibility. He once told me that with great power comes great responsibility - some things can't be avoided."

Steven was the most proper one among everyone in the office. He continued:

"If something really serious happened in our Hoenn, Teacher definitely wouldn't stand by and watch."

On this point, everyone agreed.

After all, such big events had happened in Sinnoh and Unova, and these League executives knew something about them.

Moreover, the recent battle between Rayquaza and Deoxys was also mediated by Teacher Johan.

When there were real big issues, Teacher Johan wouldn't shirk responsibility.

But the problem was...

Glacia rubbed her temples with a headache.

She felt that if they didn't "tie" Johan to the Hoenn League's ship soon, Teacher Johan would be poached by other regions!

The "covetous" Sinnoh League - they heard Teacher Johan had a close relationship with Miss Cynthia.

Previously it was just the Sinnoh League, now there was also the Unova League.

It was said that Unova League Champion Alder greatly appreciated Teacher Johan, and had even proposed more than once that he wanted Teacher Johan to replace him...

This made Glacia, who served as Hoenn League's personnel manager, financial manager, operations manager... feel a huge "threat."

Most importantly...

Teacher Johan was obviously a natural at handling administrative matters!

My vacation... so far away... Glacia sighed deeply.

Glacia looked at Steven, preparing to extend her "claws" toward him.

Steven smiled slightly. Although he didn't understand Glacia's look, he still said with some apology:

"I also need to apologize to everyone, because my studies aren't finished yet, so..."

Glacia: "..."

"Ah..." Glacia sighed softly, leaning back in her chair with a look of "despair."

At the same time, at Sinnoh League headquarters in the Sinnoh region, Lucian sat in Elite Four Bertha's office, looking at the matters she was handing over to him, and similarly leaned back in his chair with a despairing expression.

Though they were far apart, both simultaneously murmured:

"Teacher Johan, when are you coming..."

"Achoo—"

At Kanaz Pokémon Academy, in the brand new training facility, Johan couldn't help but sneeze.

"What's wrong, catching a cold?" Director Martin, who was introducing the new facilities to Johan, couldn't help but ask.

"No." Johan rubbed his nose and said: "Probably someone's thinking about me."

"Oh." Martin nodded. "That's basically it. If you think there's anything lacking, just tell me later."

"So polite?" Johan felt a bit embarrassed.

To put it bluntly, this training building at Kanaz Pokémon Academy was practically built specifically for him alone, or rather for his entire team. It was too extravagant!

"Hahaha, no need to be so formal!" Martin laughed and waved his hand, looking extremely generous.

"Hmm?"

The more he acted this way, the more Johan couldn't help showing a suspicious expression.

Director Martin wasn't such a generous person, especially considering the financial resources and materials consumed in building such a training facility...

Perhaps feeling a bit uncomfortable under his gaze, Martin coughed lightly and lowered his voice:

"It's all sponsored."

"Sponsored?"

"Sponsored by parents of students enrolling next year."

This explanation made Johan understand.

Because of his current fame, he could be said to be Kanaz Pokémon Academy's flagship (crossed out) trademark. Many people came seeking his teaching, such as Penny, daughter of Galar Champion Peony, who was Johan's student.

Many people came to study at Kanaz Pokémon Academy, including many wealthy families.

"Anyway, if there's anything wrong, just tell me..."

BOOM!!!

Before he could finish speaking, a huge roar came from inside the training facility. Larvitar was stomping hard on the new ground.

But it had to be said, the materials used for this training facility were really good. After Larvitar's stomp... the ground didn't collapse, only cracking with a not-too-large fissure and some scattered debris.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar immediately happily picked up a larger piece of debris and put it in its mouth, "crunch crunch," eating while nodding with satisfaction.

This ground - it tasted right!

Johan gently nudged Martin with his elbow: "Director Martin, if the ground covering gets eaten, can it be repaired promptly?"

Looking at Larvitar's posture, it was planning to devour the entire facility.

Martin: "..."

He was sweating profusely.

After Martin left, Johan also brought his little ones into training.

Regarding training, Johan always maintained an attitude of moderation without excess.

He now had a fairly clear understanding of his own strength. Ordinary Elite Four members or newly promoted Elite Four members would probably not be his opponents.

But facing some veteran Elite Four members, like Drake or Agatha, he wasn't very confident, or rather his chances of winning weren't high.

Facing Champions, using Alder as an example, he probably wasn't an opponent in a full team battle yet.

Of course, veteran Elite Four like Agatha and Drake actually had Champion-level strength.

His current state was... slightly stronger than ordinary Elite Four but slightly weaker than Champions. If he really had to serve as a newly promoted Champion of a region, he could barely try, provided he didn't have to challenge the "Champion's Road."

Taking the "Champion's Road" was definitely out of the question.

Actually, Johan felt his team was already very strong, especially in some aspects where they might even be more impressive than Champions.

For example, Gengar's use of Ghost-type energy and ability to open dimensional spaces, Ninetales' pure ice freezing abilities, Tinkaton's hammer weight, Dragonite maintaining rationality after activating Outrage, and so on.

With explosive power plus careless opponents, he might not be unable to surprisingly defeat a Champion.

After all, Pokémon battles weren't games - it wasn't about who had higher stats automatically winning. There were also tactical factors, explosive moments, and many other aspects.

So his training requirements for his little ones had always been moderate.

But the problem was...

With Victini's addition and its "infinite energy," the little ones became even more extreme and hardworking in training.

However, Victini's "infinite energy" also had limits.

On one hand, there was Victini's own energy recovery limit.

On the other hand, Victini's infinite energy could only provide energy recovery benefits to the little ones, but was inadequate on the mental level.

Coincidentally...

What Johan was best at was helping his little ones ease mental fatigue.

But Johan didn't support their endless training like this.

Constantly pushing themselves would also pose unnecessary risks to their bodies and minds.

But during training with his little ones, Johan discovered their "abnormal" state.

It couldn't really be called abnormal, only... they were working a bit too hard.

Actually, thinking about it carefully, the reason was clear.

After witnessing the power of so many legendary and mythical Pokémon, and solving problems with the help of these legendary and mythical Pokémon, his little ones felt their own inadequacy.

Whether it was Gengar, Ninetales, Tinkaton, Dragonite, Urshifu, Ceruledge, or Larvitar, everyone had a drive in their hearts - a drive to prove they weren't inferior to legendary and mythical Pokémon.

Although setting their goal at the level of legendary and mythical Pokémon was quite extreme.

But Johan understood his little ones' aspirations.

It was good that they had aspirations. Without aspirations... wouldn't that be like himself, wanting to slack off?

Besides, their bear coach was itself a "legendary Pokémon," just without so-called "authority."

Moreover, their Gengar could already engage with true first-class legends like Kyurem, as long as it didn't take direct hits.

This was their progress.

"Honestly, that a 'lazy' person like me could raise such a team, even I find it surprising."

He originally just wanted to slack off.

But somehow, from some point on, he was being "pushed" forward by his own Pokémon.

It seemed to start with Gengar?

"I feel like I need to change my attitude a bit too. Within the bounds of not overtraining, appropriately use some 'reasonable' methods to improve everyone's strength."

Johan felt his "awareness" had been elevated.

Who still isn't a top-level trainer?

"Come on, Larvitar, Ninetales, let's try whether Sandstorm and Snow can be combined."

"Vii~~"

Nearby, Victini happily squinted its eyes, the V on its head glowing faintly, releasing an aura of desire for victory.

Great, Johan had become more hardworking too~~

"Dinner time! Dinner time!"

People are iron, food is steel. Besides training, ensuring adequate nutritional intake was necessary for steady progress.

Looking at the fifty million Pokédollars in his bank account, Johan gritted his teeth.

At worst, he'd spend it all and earn more!

After all, the money he earned was originally meant to be spent on his little ones.

Money - you can't take it with you when you're born or when you die.

Even if poor, you can't skimp on education.

While being a trainer, Johan was unknowingly also becoming an excellent breeder and coordinator...

# 608: Busy Yet Warm

THESE CHAPTERS WERE SUPPOSED TO COME OUT TODAY. UPLOADED MORE THAN NEEDED YESTERDAY.

-------------

June 9th, Sunday.

Since returning to Hoenn, Johan's life had gradually become more regular - going between the academy and café in a two-point routine, his days were quite fulfilling.

It was just unfortunate for his students.

Although "Pokémon Psychology" was an elective course, Johan still adhered to the principle of not misleading students, cramming all the previously missed lessons into his schedule.

It was highly efficient, but also made his students cry out in misery.

Studying Pokémon psychology was truly exhausting.

But fortunately, tired as they were, the students remained very focused in class, notably not daring to slack off or doze, creating an extremely good learning environment and atmosphere.

Besides teaching, Johan had also resumed his online "Pokémon psychological consultation."

However, he was now very different from before - too many people wanted consultations, and a large portion were actually fans who just wanted to chat with him, so efficiency had actually decreased.

Of course, he spent most of his time training with his Pokémon and on daily life.

Speaking of which, Johan had just gotten off work and brought Gengar and Dragonite to the supermarket for big and small bags of groceries, then returned home to prepare dinner.

Tonight's main dish was Tomato Bouffalant Braised Beef Rice, along with various other menu items like Flame-Grilled Blaziken Whole Leg, Scallion Wooloo Roll Wraps, Frozen Luvdisc Sashimi, Salt-Baked Shellder with Vermicelli, Mousse Fresh Milk Mille-feuille, and so on.

Of course, these dishes sounded quite extravagant, but they were actually just the common naming style for restaurant menus in the Pokémon world, and didn't really have much to do with actual Pokémon.

Hmm.

"Rotom, oven mode."

In the café's backyard, Johan, wearing an apron, said without looking back.

"Understood, Roto~ Super transformation! Oven mode!"

Rotom called out as it entered the oven, emphasizing a sense of "ceremony."

The oven was already stuffed full of prepared ingredients, requiring only temperature control.

"Little brother, yours can be cooked a bit rarer - Dragonite likes it medium-rare."

"Aidii~"

Besides Rotom's oven, Armarouge's "teppanyaki" was also one of Johan's most reliable "cooking utensils" at the moment.

High temperature combined with metal armor panels - whoever grilled knew how good it was, creating aromatic dishes every time.

"Coach, the beef is mashed enough - if you keep going there won't even be residue left."

"Garruu zzZ"

Coach Urshifu's hand-pounded beef balls had become one of the household's specialty foods during this time.

Johan discovered that while awake Urshifu pounded faster, the beef balls made by sleeping Urshifu had a unique flavor - two different textures.

"Ninetales, don't make the ice too cold - if it's too cold, the sashimi will freeze solid and be impossible to chew."

"Oowoo~~"

Ninetales obediently nodded, gently breathing on the ice in front of it. The ice blocks that had shown signs of melting due to the high temperature from the on-site grilling froze again.

The little one stared seriously at the ice blocks, ready to breathe on them again at the slightest sign of melting.

It was extremely meticulous, as if the world would collapse if the ice melted.

"Hammer sis, is the pot fixed? I need to start cooking."

"Cha!!"

Tinkaton immediately raised the perfectly repaired pot, showing no trace of repair work - it was perfect.

After fixing the pot, Tinkaton turned back to its own tinkering.

During this time, whenever it had free time, it would start hammering, planning to forge a new set of more resilient and sharp blades for Ceruledge - though the results remained to be seen.

"Larvitar, stop eating! You've almost finished all the scallions!" Johan bent down to look under the table.

The tiger-headed Larvitar was hugging several scallions and munching on them.

A Pokémon like Larvitar actually liking to eat scallions - you probably couldn't find a second one in the entire Pokémon world.

Perhaps because it had eaten so many branches from the Tree of Beginning, Larvitar discovered that eating more green plants could actually help it digest faster!

The faster it could digest, the more it could eat - perfect!

"Yoji..."

Larvitar looked at the scallions in its hands and reluctantly took out two.

Eating meat without garlic reduces the flavor by half...

Johan looked helpless, consoling himself that at least Larvitar's resistance to Grass-types should be maxed out.

But speaking of Grass-types, Johan remembered his desire to catch a Grass-type Pokémon.

Preferably one that required little food and could even produce "food" in return.

Tropius would be quite nice...

Gogoat was actually pretty good too, and could produce goat milk.

But he quickly suppressed this thought.

Catching Pokémon required careful consideration.

"Dragonite, go borrow some more salt from Salt King - we need it for the salt-baked dish."

"Woo~~ (ˊˋ)"

Dragonite flapped its small wings twice and flew to the nearby Garganacl.

Garganacl had already resigned itself, honestly taking a large chunk of salt from its body and giving it to Dragonite.

Salt King had been pondering a question lately.

This salt was taken from its own body, then used to cook food, which it then ate - did that count as eating itself?

"Gengar, don't secretly inject toxins into the meat!" Johan looked up and caught Gengar preparing to make mischief.

"Ka, Ka-kaah..."

Gengar immediately put its hands behind its back, looked up at a forty-five-degree angle, and started whistling, though its eyes still occasionally glanced at Johan, seemingly trying to confirm if he was still watching.

Johan shook his head. This purple chubby little guy - last time out of curiosity, it almost caused the whole family to be "poisoned," depleting Johan's already limited supply of Pecha Berries.

"Ka-kaah~~"

Seeing Johan still watching, Gengar grinned mischievously, then obediently stuck out its tongue and produced a scroll.

Seeing this scroll, Johan recognized it almost immediately.

"That 'ancestral recipe' from Lacey?"

This was exactly the "apprenticeship gift" that Lacey from Blueberry Academy had wanted to give Johan.

However, because Johan had glimpsed that the recipes inside were too extreme, he had refused it. He didn't expect this chubby little Gengar to secretly accept it.

Then Gengar spat on its hands, slowly unrolled the scroll, found one of the recipes, and showed it to Johan.

Recipe - Pecharunt's Chain Mochi.

Ingredients: ...poison, Ghost-type energy...

Johan: "???"

There was this stuff in the recipes?!

The control mochi that Pecharunt used to control those three things - Okidogi, Munkidori, and Fezandipiti?

No way...

But reading further, he discovered the recipe ended with a note - "All of the above is pure speculation, do not attempt lightly."

Johan: "..."

He immediately said irritably: "Give me the recipe - don't experiment randomly in the future."

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar hung its head, trying to look down at its toes, only to discover - hey, it couldn't see them!

However, Johan understood its personality well - in less than two minutes, it would recover.

"Vii~ Vii~"

Victini floated in mid-air, clenching its fists in a posture of cheering everyone on.

It had to be said.

Since Victini joined, the already energetic team had become even more energetic. How to exhaust Dragonite's energy had become a daily problem for Johan - simple flying circles were no longer enough.

"Puri!"

Jigglypuff sat to the side with puffed cheeks and crossed arms.

Tonight's concert was ruined again! All they knew was eat, eat, eat...

"Jigglypuff, come help me taste this."

Jigglypuff rolled on the ground and quickly stood up, taking quick steps toward Johan with its "pat-pat" footsteps.

"Puri! ε===(っ≧ω≦)っ"

Let me handle this!

In the midst of the busy activity, a long-absent "guest" suddenly came to the door.

Flutter flutter—

A Delibird was seen pulling its bag-like tail, swaying as it flew over.

"Ka-kaah?"

Seeing this guy, Gengar immediately went to greet it.

"Woo~" Delibird landed in the yard and waved at Johan and the others.

Long time no see...

Smack!

Gengar slapped it, making it stumble, then grinned with laughter.

"Ka-kaah!"

How's it going!

It was indeed Team Rocket's, or rather Boss Giovanni's message-delivering Delibird.

"Oh, perfect timing - join us for dinner, Delibird." Johan looked up and smiled amidst his busy work.

Smelling the aroma in the yard, Delibird swallowed.

"Woo~"

I could smell the fragrance from far away...

"By the way, big sister, take out the gifts I prepared." Johan said.

"Aidii~~"

Sister Indeedee quickly put down her garlic-peeling task, wiped her hands on her apron, and went inside. Under Delibird's curious gaze, she brought out some items from the house.

There were CDs for Boss Giovanni, a maid dress for Matori, dolls for Porygon2 and Mewtwo, and of course something for Delibird too.

"Just some little trinkets I bought in the Unova region."

The CDs were currently popular records from Unova - Boss Giovanni could listen to music during his work breaks.

As for Matori's maid dress - it was well known that Matori was quite open-minded.

"Woo?"

Do I... do I have something too?

Looking at the crystal carving of itself in its hands, Delibird couldn't help but show a moved expression.

"Of course." Johan smiled and bent down to pat its little head. "We're all friends. Though it's nothing expensive - please don't mind it~"

"Woo!!"

Delibird shook its head repeatedly, solemnly and carefully placing the crystal Delibird in a corner of its bag. Even if the bag got messy in the future, this corner would never be messy!

After putting away the items, Delibird remembered the mission it came for.

It hurriedly rummaged through its bag again.

It produced a transparent sealed glass container. Between several layers of transparent glass was placed a thumb-sized black crystal.

"Hmm?"

Seeing this thing, Johan was stunned.

"This is..."

Gengar leaned its head over, its eyes almost pressed against the glass.

"Ka-kaah..."

Black and shiny - you can tell at a glance it has great affinity with this old ghost.

"Yoji?"

Larvitar poked its head out from under the table, its small eyes slightly glowing.

This is ore, right? I think it definitely won't taste bad.

"Oowoo!"

But Ninetales seemed to sense some threat from it, showing a serious expression and suggesting Johan freeze it first.

It had a feeling that was both familiar and strange but definitely not simple.

"Woo!"

However, Delibird soon pulled out a report from its bag. Johan took it and looked - his pupils suddenly contracted.

"Necrozma crystal?!"

The report didn't specify it was Necrozma's crystal, but it indicated it came from the Aether Foundation.

It seemed that when Team Rocket was creating Mewtwo and collecting genes, they had cooperated with the Aether Foundation, obtaining this crystal from them. But after research, they found this crystal too dangerous and ultimately couldn't utilize it.

Combined with Team Plasma's Colress using Aether Foundation crystals to reverse-engineer the [Fusion] device, and Boss Giovanni's methods...

It wasn't hard to deduce that this small crystal belonged to the legendary cosmic Pokémon from the Alola region - Necrozma!

"Team Rocket and Team Plasma were both seduced by the Aether Foundation - President Lusamine is quite capable..."

Then Johan realized and slightly shrank his neck.

"Good thing, good thing Team Rocket didn't incorporate this crystal's genes into Mewtwo's creation process, otherwise..."

Mew's genes plus Necrozma's genes plus human genes - what would be created would be truly terrifying.

"But why is Boss Giovanni giving me this thing?"

Johan looked at the pitch-black crystal.

Did Boss Giovanni think he had an affinity with legendary Pokémon and wanted him to try?

Try and die?

"Ninetales, freeze it!" Johan said decisively.

"Oowoo!" Ninetales showed a relieved expression and immediately breathed on the glass container.

Such "dangerous" things were safest when frozen!

Thinking of this, Ninetales breathed on the container several more times.

"Woo~"

Delibird watched as the originally palm-sized glass container turned into a person-tall ice sculpture, its eye twitching.

This is... too safe, isn't it?

"Ka-kaah~~"

Gengar opened its mouth wide and stuffed the huge ice sculpture into its mouth, storing it in dimensional space.

Johan also withdrew his gaze.

For now, he'd pretend not to know about this matter.

"Almost ready - time to eat." Johan clapped his hands and announced.

"Yoji!!"

Power!!

The big family sat around the enlarged round table in the garden. As Johan removed his apron, took the beef rice that Sister Indeedee had served and the berry juice Rotom handed him, Johan raised his cup.

"Let's dig in!"

Although in the Pokémon world, Johan had experienced all kinds of storms and waves, even riding legendary Pokémon at his peak.

But in his view, this feeling of everyone gathering together happily was incomparable and irreplaceable.

"Hey!!! Larvitar, don't get carried away! Put Salt King down, put him down!"

"Yoji! ψ(｀∀′)ψ"

Garganacl: (:3」∠)

That night, under the bright moon and sparse stars.

Johan slept soundly in bed, with gentle breezes blowing past, his dreams both real and absurd.

He dreamed he encountered an extremely rare Pokémon and spent tremendous effort to capture it.

"Arceufabric, I choose you!"

Huh?

"Is something wrong here?" Johan murmured in his sleep.

# 609: It Moved! It Moved!

Time flowed unknowingly through his fingers, and in the blink of an eye, it was already the end of June.

Johan had also lived a month of stable life, regular and fulfilling, though perhaps slightly lazy for a trainer.

At this stage, Kanaz Pokémon Academy was gradually entering the final exam sprint phase. As an elective course teacher, Johan had prepared his exam papers early, looking forward to the arrival of summer vacation.

He had already decided.

This summer vacation, he would take his little ones traveling to appreciate some of the special landscapes of the Pokémon world.

This was the benefit of being an elective course teacher - having two complete holidays every year, winter and summer vacation. How wonderful~~

Of course, amid the tranquility, some things would still happen.

For example...

Johan was sitting in the café's backyard, drinking coffee and reading a book, enjoying a leisurely afternoon.

Beside him sat Penny, looking serious.

Her gaze was fixed intently on the laptop in front of her, her slender fingers dancing across the keyboard like a dance.

"Buii~~"

Penny's Eevee lightly leaped onto Johan's lap, its soft paws stepping around on him, seemingly searching for a comfortable position.

"Oowoo?"

Ninetales, lying beside Johan, slightly opened its azure eyes, glanced at the Eevee on Johan's lap, then slowly closed them again.

No threat~

However, the tail wrapped around Johan's arm tightened slightly.

The video of Johan using "Eevee" to easily defeat Lacey at Blueberry Academy had eventually appeared online. That "Eevee's" overwhelming strength and abilities that seemed almost illegal had left people stunned, causing quite a stir online during the past period.

It also made that interview with Alder become "legendary," with countless people speculating just how outrageous Teacher Johan's "true strength" might be.

Some even said: I originally thought Teacher Johan had stopped being human, but it turns out Teacher Johan has been trying hard to disguise himself as an "ordinary" trainer. He really... I'm crying...

Johan had tried to refute these claims, but... it was useless.

He eventually just let it be.

However, as Johan's student, Penny, who had a special fondness for Eevee, felt her goals and direction for effort.

Facing the not-so-talkative Penny, Johan turned a page and said somewhat helplessly:

"Next time there's a chance... I'll let you meet it, then you'll understand."

"Mm." Penny nodded slightly, her gaze still fixed on the computer screen.

"The exam is in a few days, but you keep fiddling with the computer. What are you busy with?" As a teacher, Johan asked with rare concern, tilting his head over.

Penny's cheeks turned slightly red, and she quickly pressed down the laptop screen. Facing Johan's inquiring gaze, she quickly shook her head:

"No, nothing..."

"So mysterious..."

Naturally, Johan wouldn't pry into his student's secrets - he had to give people privacy and space.

Seeing Johan turn his attention back to his book, Penny breathed a slight sigh of relief, reopened her laptop, and continued skillfully and seriously programming.

What was displayed on her screen was a website named - Teacher Johan Fan Club!

Under her management, the website's registered users had already exceeded one hundred thousand!

And the numbers were still continuously increasing.

Penny had also become the president of the "Teacher Johan Fan Club."

"Are you confident about the final exam?" Johan suddenly asked without looking up.

"Mm." Penny quietly responded again.

For the battle course assessment, even the battle teachers weren't her opponents, so getting full marks was naturally no problem.

As for cultural courses... let's just say full marks were the test paper's limit, not hers.

"What about relationships with classmates?" Johan asked again.

"Mm." Still the same voice, though the emotion was slightly more uplifted.

Since transferring to Kanaz Pokémon Academy, Penny was obviously in much better condition than when she first arrived.

With Champion Peony backing her, plus Teacher Johan, and seniors like Steven, Roxanne, and Flannery, plus her own strength... it would be strange if anyone dared to bully her.

Moreover, the atmosphere at Kanaz Pokémon Academy was indeed much better than Orange Academy in the Paldea region.

"That's good."

"Yoji!! ヽ(°〇°)"

Suddenly, Larvitar's exclamation came from the yard.

It moved! It moved! It can move!

It was standing in front of a wooden sculpture located in the center of the yard's planting area, pointing at the wooden carving and shouting excitedly.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar rolled over and floated down from the swing, coming to Larvitar's side.

It moved? Which one moved? Let this old ghost see~~

Tinkaton, Dragonite, Urshifu, Ceruledge, and Victini all gathered around, surrounding the wooden carving.

It moved?

Johan, sitting in his chair, also stood up, holding Eevee, and walked over with Ninetales and Penny.

That wooden carving... was something Sonia had brought over for Johan some time ago, suggested by Penny.

Penny's father and sister had gone exploring the Crown Tundra, reaching a village in the ice and snow.

They learned that this village once worshipped a deity that could bless bountiful harvests.

As a researcher of ancient Galar legends, Sonia had some understanding of various legends in the Galar region.

So the two of them decided to give Teacher Johan a gift - this wooden carving.

The appearance of this wooden carving was exactly... the King of Bountiful Harvests of the Galar region, Calyrex (crossed out cauliflower head)!

At the time, Sonia and Penny hadn't actually said it was a Calyrex carving, only saying they wanted to give him a gift after seeing so many things planted in Johan's backyard.

Later, when Sonia and Penny brought the item over, could Johan refuse a student's thoughtful gesture?

Fortunately, this wooden carving had been placed in the yard for almost half a month without any movement, so Johan gradually stopped paying much attention to it.

Who would have thought...

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar put on its glasses and leaned in to take a closer look, then spread its hands.

It didn't move?

"Yoji! Yoji!" Larvitar waved its small arms.

It moved! It really seemed to move just now!

"How did it move?" Johan asked.

"Yoji..."

Larvitar bit its finger and tilted its head.

How did it move again?

Larvitar fell into brief recollection.

Just before, it had eaten quite a lot of ore and was thinking of chewing on a Tree of Beginning branch that Mew had recently delivered to aid digestion.

Then it wandered around the yard while chewing, promoting digestion through dual methods.

As it wandered, it strolled to the center of the "vegetable garden," standing in front of the wooden carving, then it looked at the carving while chewing the branch and contemplating life - the tree fruits in the "vegetable garden" would grow quickly, and then it could eat them!

Then, this wooden carving inexplicably flashed.

"Yoji!" Larvitar indicated it remembered.

It flashed, the wooden carving seemed to flash just now!

Johan wasn't worried about what Larvitar was thinking - it was probably considering food problems anyway.

But Larvitar said the wooden carving flashed?

Johan looked at that Calyrex wooden carving...

Honestly, the carving craftsman's skill was quite good, but Sonia and Penny knew too little about Calyrex, resulting in a carving that wasn't very accurate.

Rather than Calyrex, it looked more like a cauliflower.

In Johan's memory, Calyrex seemed to have fallen into slumber due to decreasing faith caused by some past "behavioral issues."

Speaking of which, Calyrex had somewhat of a "faith-based deity" feeling.

Could it be because of... the Tree of Beginning branch?!

"Larvitar, take out one of your teething sticks."

"Yoji..."

Larvitar obediently produced a Tree of Beginning branch.

Johan took it and slowly approached the wooden carving.

But even when the branch touched the wooden carving, nothing happened.

Shy?

"Goka?"

Are you hallucinating?

Ceruledge looked at Larvitar.

Larvitar scratched its little head, momentarily uncertain whether it had really seen wrong.

"Yoji..."

Maybe it's been eating too many branches lately, making everything look a bit green?

Look, even Johan's hair has been faintly turning green recently.

Johan shook his head and returned the Tree of Beginning branch to Larvitar.

Honestly, even if Calyrex could really "descend" to the Hoenn region from such a distance, it shouldn't "manifest" to a Pokémon like Larvitar that was four times weak to Grass, right?

However, out of "respect" for Calyrex, Johan still had his little ones restrain themselves a bit.

"After all, it's the deity blessing our family's 'vegetable garden,' so let's be respectful."

With that, he led his little ones in a slight bow toward the Calyrex wooden carving.

If you can really hear this, Calyrex, please ensure our family's 'vegetable garden' grows a few more batches of tree fruits, radishes, and such... Johan thought to himself.

If it could grow one more batch, the family's pressure would decrease by one batch.

"Incoming call, Roto!"

At this moment, Rotom floated over holding Johan's phone, the caller ID showing Elite Four Glacia.

Johan took the phone and walked away. His little ones also dispersed, leaving only Larvitar chewing on its branch while staring at the wooden carving.

"Yoji..."

Did I really see things?

Buzz—

Suddenly, a faint green glow flashed across the wooden carving again.

"Yojii!"

Larvitar was about to shout but quickly covered its own mouth with its hands, then ran away carrying its branch.

While running, it kept shaking its head.

It's over, eating too many plants lately has really made everything look green. Better eat some ore to make up for it...

Calyrex wooden carving: ?

In the distant Galar region, among the vast snowy mountains, on an ancient and massive but bare tree that seemed withered, a green branch the size of a pinky finger had miraculously sprouted.

At the center of this huge withered tree, a small and delicate Pokémon slumbered deep within the trunk.

Although asleep, one could still sense the dignity and elegance emanating from it.

Suddenly, its tightly closed eyes trembled slightly.

A ethereal voice across vast distances rang in its ears - If you can really hear this, Calyrex, please ensure our family's 'vegetable garden' grows a few more batches of tree fruits, radishes, and such...

It turned its head with some difficulty, feeling the withered power within its body showing faint signs of revival.

It was faith.

Although weak and distant, but...

"This king will fulfill your wish!"

"Johan, on a small island south of Petalburg City's waters, a ruins expedition team accidentally awakened the sleeping Ice Pillar Regice. You're relatively close, so go take a look?" Glacia's voice came through the phone.

Having its sleep disturbed, Regice was quite irritable.

A small island south of Petalburg City? Regice?

Was this... the "island cave" mentioned in the Sealed Chamber?

In the Adventures manga, Steven commanded the three pillars to battle Groudon and Kyogre, and the Ice Pillar seemed to have been awakened in an unknown island cave.

Before Johan could speak, Glacia continued:

"Norman has already gone, but when it comes to calming Pokémon, you have more experience."

Teacher Johan had even calmed the awakened Regigigas in the Sinnoh region. Just a single Ice Pillar shouldn't be too much of a problem, right?

When saying this, Glacia felt bitter inside.

Clearly their Hoenn was so capable - besides the current Elite Four, look at trainers like Teacher Johan, Norman, and Wallace.

But...

Norman valued family, Teacher Johan valued teaching, and Wallace was busy with romance.

Even Steven, who had become a reserve member, was either busy with studies or busy digging holes...

What a tragedy!

Fortunately, while these people were unwilling to take on tedious duties, when something really happened, they would genuinely step up.

"Alright."

Looking at his little ones' eager expressions, Johan nodded and accepted the job.

After all, they had been training for almost a month. Although his little ones still had tremendous enthusiasm for training, occasionally they needed to find some battles to test their training results, right?

Regice was a good target.

Just by looking at Gengar and the others' expressions, you could tell they were already getting "restless."

Slurp—

Gengar stuck out its tongue, revealing an "evil" smile.

Moreover, based on Johan's own intentions - helping Pokémon in need and calming irritable Pokémon was also one of his "missions."

"The helicopter should already be near your house."

Buzz buzz buzz—

As soon as Glacia finished speaking, the sound of the League helicopter's rotating propellers came from above the yard.

That was really fast.

"By the way, where has Elite Four Drake been lately?" Johan suddenly asked.

Generally speaking, for this kind of maritime incident, if Elite Four Drake was nearby, he would be quite proactive.

But recently, it seemed like there hadn't been any news about him for some time.

"You're so concerned about him? He's been wandering around the sea every day, I don't know what he's busy with either." Glacia said.

"It's not really concern..."

Mainly, if they couldn't contact Elite Four Drake, who would reimburse expenses for this operation?

But thinking he couldn't say it like that, Johan quickly changed his words:

"Ahem, caring for the elderly, isn't this a traditional virtue that every Hoenn person should have?"

"Oh~~" Glacia's voice was melodious, as if she understood something.

"Ka-kaah! Ka-kaah!"

Gengar tugged at Johan's clothes, indicating:

Hurry up, or the "prey" will be snatched away by Mr. Norman!

"I'll let you know when I hear from him."

"Alright."

With that, the call ended.

"Teacher, then I'll... come again tomorrow." Penny said.

Johan glanced at the time and waved his hand with a smile, "No need, it shouldn't take too long. Have Sister Indeedee help me brew a cup of coffee first, then study on your own for a while."

A phrase inexplicably surfaced in his mind -

In ancient times, there was Guan Yu warming wine while slaying Hua Xiong; now there's Teacher Johan warming coffee while subduing Regice.

# 610: Subdue First, Then Soothe

Buzz buzz buzz—

The League helicopter's propellers spun rapidly, carrying Johan from Kanaz City all the way south, over Petalburg Woods, over Petalburg City, arriving above the ocean.

In the distance, he could already see the target island and the ice and snow covering the entire island.

Even part of the sea surface near the island had been frozen into ice blocks.

"Oowoo~~"

Looking at that island and the frozen waters, Ninetales' expression became serious as it called out low.

This guy's Ice-type energy is quite strong.

This island wasn't actually very large, and there was almost no vegetation on it, with not many wild Pokémon living there either.

As they continued approaching, they could see some League ships and speedboats docked outside the small island, blocked by the frozen seawater.

Some personnel wearing International Police and League Police uniforms had already abandoned their vessels, stepping on the thick ice to prepare for landing.

At the same time, they could hear rumbling sounds coming from within the island, as if something was causing destruction.

Johan's earpiece crackled to life.

"Target is inside the island, approaching from the northwest direction!"

"The cold is still intensifying, current temperature inside the island has dropped to minus five degrees Celsius!"

"Expedition team members are evacuating, requesting assistance! Requesting assistance!"

This situation was quite serious.

However, the Hoenn League's response speed was still quite fast.

"By the way, where is Mr. Norman..."

"Teacher Johan?" Officer Jenny recognized Johan's voice through the earpiece and couldn't help but call out in delight.

"It's me." Johan was still sitting in the helicopter, not far from the small island now.

"Mr. Norman was training in Petalburg Woods earlier. After receiving the message, he left the forest immediately, but he's still on his way." Officer Jenny explained.

Petalburg City wasn't a big city, but it was just right for Norman because he could train in Petalburg Woods without causing too much damage to the city.

But this meant that Norman's arrival time was actually slower than Johan's.

After all, Norman's Staraptor couldn't carry him in flight, and helicopters couldn't land within Petalburg Woods.

"Alright then."

"Teacher Johan, what should we do? Please command us!"

As someone who had just been promoted to Police Superintendent, Johan currently had the highest authority among all the League personnel present.

Moreover, whether International Police or League Police, they were all very willing to follow his commands.

Command?

Johan looked outside the window. The small island was close at hand, and the outline of Regice on the island was already somewhat visible.

"Evacuate the expedition team members and wait outside the island."

After saying this, he opened the helicopter door with a "whoosh," and a cold wind rushed in.

"Whew, it really is quite cool..."

Just when the pilot thought Teacher Johan was going to make a cool parachute jump—no wait, helicopter jump...

He closed the door again.

"Please go down a bit more, thank you."

"O-okay." The pilot was stunned for a moment, then quickly moved the control stick downward.

Johan wasn't afraid of heights; he just felt that there was still some distance, and flying over on Dragonite might not be very safe... hmm.

Besides, even if he jumped down like this, he couldn't transform into a Gundam.

Soon.

The helicopter arrived directly above the small island, and Regice's appearance was completely visible to Johan. He took out a Poké Ball and threw it.

"Go, Dragonite, say hello to Regice."

Red light flashed, and Dragonite appeared outside the helicopter. After a cheerful roar, a thick dragon coat suddenly appeared on its body, and it charged straight toward the furious Regice.

BOOM!!!

A huge rumble, accompanied by the trembling of ice and snow on the island, kicked off this "soothing operation."

"REGI!!"

Regice suddenly suffered an impact from above, staggering while roaring angrily.

Crack crack crack—

An extremely cold aura surged from its body, and white mist instantly swirled around Regice, stirring up a mighty storm.

"REGI!!"

The seven light orbs on Regice's body kept flashing, indicating its current emotional instability.

However, in the rolling wind, snow, and frost, a figure in thin black clothing stepped into it while holding down his hat, seemingly unaffected.

The wind and snow whipped at his clothes, but it seemed to have little impact on the newcomer.

"It's Teacher Johan!"

"Teacher Johan is here!"

The evacuating expedition team members saw the appearing figure and immediately breathed a sigh of relief.

Teacher Johan's reputation was definitely significant now. Although he didn't hold any high position in the Hoenn League, just his performance in the "World Junior Championship" and Champion Alder's "win rate theory" were enough to prove Teacher Johan's strength.

It was well known that although the Hoenn region only had four Elite Four positions, this didn't prevent Hoenn people from viewing Teacher Johan as the fifth Elite Four member!

Four Elite Four members, but five people—wasn't that perfectly normal?

Moreover, because of Champion Alder's interview, many people believed Teacher Johan's strength was at least stronger than the Elite Four!

With such a person arriving, this Regice crisis should be no problem...

At the same time.

"Vii~~"

An ethereal voice rang out from the newcomer's apparently empty shoulder.

A bit of warmth dispelled the chill of ice and snow.

Although this cold wasn't really much for the current Johan, he still smiled and said:

"Thank you, Victini."

"Vii~~"

Victini revealed itself on Johan's shoulder, smiling as it made a "yeah" gesture toward Johan, showing its cute little fangs.

"REGI!!"

The angry voice came again, and Johan's eyes flickered as he looked at it.

"What a troublesome fellow..."

Although the three pillars and the Dragon Pillar and Electric Pillar were all created by Regigigas, the three pillars weren't limited to just three. In fact, each region had more or less sleeping three pillars.

For example, the three pillars in Sinnoh's Snowpoint Temple, the three pillars captured by Battle Frontier Pyramid King Brandon...

In the Adventures manga, Steven, with his own strength and the awakened three pillars, could actually resist Groudon and Kyogre for 22 days!

While this certainly involved Steven's own powerful strength, it also couldn't deny the power of these three pillars sleeping in various corners of the Hoenn region.

They might be among the most original three pillars, and might even be the same three pillars that helped Regigigas drag and move the continental plates.

After all, in ancient Hoenn legends, Regigigas slept in Snowpoint Temple, while the three pillars that awakened Regigigas were left in Hoenn.

Of course, this legend was still debatable.

However, the fact that these three pillars in Hoenn were powerful was certain.

Just their size alone was much larger than the Regice that Johan had seen belonging to Brandon.

"So the Pokédex really is just for fooling kids," Johan complained internally.

He had reason to suspect that Brandon's three pillars were made by Regigigas from scraps.

"Calm down, Regice!" Johan extended one hand, blue light flashing in his eyes.

Aura, residing in the heart!

"REGI—!!"

But not only did Regice not quiet down, it became even more agitated, raising both arms and immediately shooting out a blue freezing beam!

"Oowoo!"

Ninetales leaped out, its nine tails slowly spreading like fans. The wind and snow in the air immediately became more fierce while colorful light screens fell from the sky.

Then, an ice wall rose under Ninetales' control, standing in front of Johan.

Crack crack crack—

Regice's Ice Beam was blocked by the Aurora Veil and "Permanent Ice Wall."

Seeing this, Johan sighed softly.

"Then there's no choice..."

He slowly raised his head, his eyes suddenly becoming sharp as he said in a deep voice:

"Gengar, Thunder Wave!"

"Ka-kaah!"

The long-impatient Gengar suddenly floated out from Johan's shadow, creating a fluffy golden electric current but not throwing it out. Instead, it flashed and appeared behind Regice, directly pressing it onto its body.

Zzzzt—

Golden electric arcs immediately appeared on Regice's body.

"Ka-kaah~~"

So cold~~

Gengar blew on its hands, pulling away from Regice.

Regice seemed to have locked onto Johan, or rather, locked onto the human who had disturbed its sleep.

But because it was hit by Thunder Wave, its body speed slowed considerably as it swung its arm at Johan again.

Crack crack crack—

Huge icicles formed out of nowhere, shooting toward Johan.

"Cha!"

Tinkaton jumped out of its Poké Ball on its own, facing the incoming icicles without retreating as it swung its hammer and smashed out heavily.

BANG!!

In an instant, the icicles shot by Regice shattered into ice crystal dust of various sizes.

In the scattered dust, a blue flame flashed briefly as Ceruledge, holding its blades, charged through the misty ice crystal dust straight at Regice.

"Goka!"

The Bitter Blade quickly swept across Regice's body, leaving a blue wound while also absorbing Regice's stamina.

"REGI—!!"

The pained Regice roared angrily.

Indeed.

For Ice-type Pokémon, Fire-type moves could often deal very outstanding damage.

Moreover, Regice was a typical Pokémon whose Special Defense was far stronger than its Defense.

Of course, this didn't mean Regice's Defense was poor, but just from base stats, Regice's Special Defense had an outrageous 200 points, while its Defense was 100 points, making it a being with high stats in both defenses.

However, because of the Hail that Ninetales had created, Regice's Defense ability was enhanced.

Zzzzt—

Electric current surged, and Regice's movements became stiff.

"Garruu! zzZ"

Taking advantage of Regice's pained roaring, Urshifu, with its eyes tightly closed, stepped forward. Riding the wind and snow, it unhesitatingly threw a straight punch, smashing into Regice's body.

BANG!!

Crack—

On the massive Regice's crystal-like body, a fist print and a crack appeared.

"REGI!!"

When Regice came to its senses, it saw...

Gengar grinning evilly with sunglasses, Tinkaton carrying a metal hammer, Dragonite patting its belly with a silly smile, Ceruledge holding twin swords with cold eyes, and Urshifu clenching its fists while snoring... had already surrounded it.

"Re, Regi..."

Although angry, Regice's instincts still told it that this situation...

Was wrong, very wrong!

This group of Pokémon from the opponent looked very difficult to deal with, especially that floating ghost that kept applying debuffs to it.

And their coordination was quite seamless.

Johan placed his hand on Ninetales beside him, his eyes asking "aren't you going up?"

"Oowoo~~"

Ninetales obediently shook its head, indicating that Johan's safety was more important, and besides, in terms of Ice-type abilities, it wasn't very interested in Regice.

Hearing this, Johan was speechless. After experiencing Kyurem, Ninetales' standards had really gotten much higher.

Of course, what Ninetales cared about most was definitely still his safety.

If they could get something good from the Ice Pillar later, Ninetales definitely wouldn't refuse.

"Regice." Johan spoke again.

"REGI—"

Regice seemed to have calmed down somewhat, turning its gaze toward him.

It vaguely sensed Regigigas' aura from Johan's body.

But this time Johan didn't continue speaking, just waved his hand and said:

"Forget it, let's finish the fight first."

?

Finally having a worthy opponent with good strength, such a big size, and so suitable for Gengar and the others' training direction...

"Gengar." Johan called out.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar looked at him.

Johan smiled: "Attack."

"Ka-kaah! (▼⊿▼)"

"Vi, Vii! (/ε＼*)"

Victini quickly covered its eyes—the scene was a bit too "cruel" for a little one to watch.

"Yoji!"

At this moment, even Larvitar felt it could participate, so it ran out on its own and stomped on the ground.

Rumble rumble—

The ice layer covering the island, and even the ice layer extending to the sea, gradually cracked under this stomp, and the entire ground shook.

"This, this is a move used by Larvitar?"

"Too, too outrageous..."

"An unevolved baby can actually hurt a legendary Pokémon, this is just..."

"I heard, I just heard, that Teacher Johan likes to play in baby cups, and this Larvitar was prepared for baby cups."

"Good, good thing Teacher Johan is one of us Hoenn people..."

"This proves that Teacher Johan's Eevee wasn't an isolated case."

The International Police and League Police watching this scene from afar through high-definition cameras were all swallowing nervously.

Such a terrifying Regice actually had little ability to fight back against Teacher Johan?

In fact, this Regice's strength really wasn't weak—at least comparable to Alder's Volcarona.

But because it had just awakened and was cranky, its emotions were unstable, and it fought without any strategy.

A Pokémon's strength didn't just depend on its own power, but also on its battle tactics and fighting style.

More importantly, no matter how powerful it was, it was still just one Pokémon.

Its strength wasn't so outrageous that it could fight Johan's six Pokémon alone.

Not to mention there was Victini, an excellent support Pokémon.

With advantages in both numbers and strength, of course the situation looked completely one-sided.

On the island, Johan grabbed Larvitar's blunt horn and brought it in front of him, seriously reminding:

"Larvitar, don't forget what we trained—learn to control your power, don't just unleash everything at once, learn to focus!"

"Yo, Yoji!"

Larvitar scratched its head with an embarrassed smile.

Got excited and forgot, wasn't I afraid the damage would be stolen by everyone?

In a one-sided team fight, of course you had to use your skills quickly, or there wouldn't be anything left.

Johan shook his head and let go of the little one.

Thud—

Larvitar landed on the ground with a dull sound. The little one's weight gain had been quite dramatic during this period of eating and growing.

Johan checked the time and said:

"This guy won't be defeated so easily, and besides..."

With that, Johan said to Victini on his shoulder:

"Victini."

"Vii?"

Victini fluttered and floated up, blinking its round eyes and showing its little fangs.

Was it time for it to perform?

Should it energize everyone?

Johan nodded, "Uh, no, listen to my command later, and be ready to energize and restore the Ice Pillar's condition."

To soothe, you first have to subdue, right?

"Vi, Vii?"

Regice: (*°°)=3
