# 611: Regice & Johan: This Was Worth It

"REGI!!!"

The enormous roar echoed across the small island, a terrifying aura wrapped in frost sweeping everywhere. The ice titan Regice, standing at least seven or eight meters tall, had all seven lights on its face flashing.

"Don't stand so tall, crouch down a bit."

Suddenly, a voice came from the shadow at Regice's feet, with a hint of resignation in the tone.

Hearing this, Regice immediately stopped its howling and obediently crouched down, trying to maintain eye level with the human at its feet, though this was almost impossible to achieve.

At this moment, the area around the small island was completely covered in a hazy frost mist, preventing the International Police and League Police outside from seeing what was happening inside. If they could see, their jaws would certainly drop.

The previously raging Regice, who seemed to control all the cold in the world, was now so docilely crouching on the ground that it looked somewhat comical.

Moreover, if anyone could understand Regice's "expression" right now, they would definitely notice that its gaze was exceptionally clear.

Clearly obedient.

To be honest, Regice didn't want to be like this, but the human before it was somewhat inhuman. It had lost count of how many times it had recovered its condition.

Plus, all of his Pokémon were like they were on steroids, hitting it with attacks while going "Ku ku" at it, using all sorts of moves without repeating, and somehow coordinating with each other quite well.

Especially that little one with the V-shape on its head that sat on the human's shoulder.

It looked harmless and was always smiling, with a "I'm so worried about you" expression, and then each time it would energize Regice, allowing it to recover, only to continue being tormented.

The key point was...

While its body's energy was restored, the mental impact hadn't improved at all.

Regice now felt physically fine, but mentally extremely fatigued, somewhat wanting to sleep...

Actually...

Regice could have continued resisting, but as it gradually regained clarity, it increasingly sensed the aura of Regigigas from this human.

That was the aura of their "creator," along with a friendly aura from the human. This was the main reason why Regice had become so obedient now.

And the person standing beside Regice's feet was, of course, Johan.

Johan glanced at his phone and sighed helplessly, "This coffee is completely cold."

Calculating the time, even with the recent rise in temperature, the coffee prepared by Gardevoir must have gone completely cold by now.

This is what happens when you try to show off unnecessarily. If you fail, you only embarrass yourself.

To think he'd try to warm coffee while taking down Regice...

Johan looked at the now docile Regice and said using his aura power:

"You need to compensate me."

"Regi?"

Regice's lights flashed back and forth, as if a Psyduck-style question mark appeared above its head.

Compensate?

Wait, I'm the victim here...

"Tell me, how did you wake up?" Johan found a relatively clean ice block nearby, brushed off the snow, and sat down.

To be fair, in the special episodes, Steven had expended considerable effort to awaken the three titans sleeping in the Hoenn region.

Although this world must have significant differences from the special episodes Johan knew, he didn't believe that a simple ruin exploration team could easily awaken Regice and make it so angry.

"Regi..."

Regice's lights flashed again. It didn't know what had happened either.

It just felt like it had a strange dream, dreaming that a large number of meteorites fell from the sky, boundless fury was released in the sky, the earth began to sink, and all their previous efforts were destroyed in an instant.

Then, tensing up in the dream, it woke up.

"A dream?" Johan looked puzzled.

And what kind of strange dream was this?

A large number of meteorites falling...

Was it referring to the meteorite incident?

Or maybe...

Unfortunately, although Johan could construct dreams through hypnosis, he was completely clueless about interpreting the meaning of dreams.

In any case, Regice had a nightmare and then jolted itself awake?

As for the League's ruin exploration team, was it purely bad luck?

"It feels like it's foretelling something..." Johan gently rubbed his chin.

At this moment.

Larvitar cautiously walked to Regice's feet and tapped its icy pillar-like foot a couple of times with its small hand.

"Yoji!"

Time to eat!

"Regi..."

Regice moved its foot, causing Larvitar to bite at empty air, and Johan immediately gave a "stern" look.

"Yo-Yoji..."

Larvitar tucked in its head and gave an embarrassed smile.

I was just checking if it was ice or mineral...

Johan shook his head. If you're already like this when meeting Regice, what would happen if you met Regirock? You'd probably jump right at it.

He then stood up and patted Regice's lowered arm, saying:

"Thank you for this training session."

As he spoke, he dug out two boxes of Poké Blocks from Gengar's mouth, suitable for Ice-type Pokémon with good flavor.

Although he didn't know how these titan Pokémon like Regice ate, Regigigas had once made Rotom so busy that a Berry Blender almost started smoking.

"REGI!"

Sensing the aroma of the Poké Blocks, Regice's lights flashed more frequently, suggesting increased emotional fluctuation.

"Alright, are you going back to sleep now?"

Seeing Regice carefully extend its hand to "absorb" the two boxes of Poké Blocks into the ice crystals of its arm, Johan asked.

"Regi?"

Regice cautiously asked back.

Should I continue sleeping?

Johan was speechless, paused for a moment, and then said: "You don't have to sleep. We'll come find you to 'play' next time when we're free."

As he spoke, he revealed a "kind" smile.

"Ka-kaah~ (▼益▼)"

Gengar and all the other little ones also showed similar smiles.

This was the ultimate "training partner."

As for capturing Regice or taking it back?

Take it back to use as a refrigerator?

A seven or eight-meter-tall Regice would be too extravagant.

Besides, it could sleep perfectly well on its own, so why give it a different place to sleep? When they really needed it... Johan believed it wouldn't refuse.

The Regi clan, possibly due to Regigigas, were powerful but mostly simple-minded, making them relatively easy to communicate with.

Between humans and Pokémon, building a friendly relationship didn't necessarily require capturing them with Poké Balls.

Take Victini, for example.

Until now, Johan hadn't captured it with a Poké Ball, instead letting it wander and move around freely.

Seeing the smiles of Johan and Gengar and the others, Regice seemed to shrink its head.

"Regi..."

Then I'll go back to sleep.

This "play" didn't sound like a good thing.

As they spoke, the ice crystals on Regice's body moved again, and two empty boxes fell out, with all the Poké Blocks inside having disappeared.

So that's how it eats?

"That works too." Johan nodded and took out three more boxes of Poké Blocks, placing them in front of Regice.

"REGI!"

Regice's lights flashed with some excitement.

This battle seemed worth it.

After a pause, the ice crystals on Regice's body fluctuated again, and then one, two, three... a total of four blocks of never-melting ice, plus a mineral that seemed to contain special minerals, fell in front of Johan.

"This is..."

"Regi..."

Compensation...

Regice answered honestly.

These never-melting ice blocks were produced from the accumulated ice energy at its sleeping place over many years, and that mineral was a rare stone it had collected, rich in energy.

Johan was somewhat moved.

He had only made a joke, but Regice had taken it seriously. What a straightforward creature...

Then he dug out five more boxes of Poké Blocks from Gengar's mouth.

Give and take, that's how to better establish a friendly relationship.

In Johan's view, exchanging merely ten boxes of Poké Blocks for four blocks of never-melting ice and an extremely rare special mineral was absolutely profitable.

While in Regice's view, exchanging a few slightly harder pieces of ice for such food was also a huge win.

The two looked at each other, both showing smiles.

Regice put away the eight boxes of Poké Blocks, stood in place for a while, scanned the area for a moment, apparently finding its bearings, then brushed away the snow on the ground, revealing a hole leading below the small island.

At the same time, the ice and snow on the sea surface and the island receded like a tide.

Noticing this scene, the International Police and League Police outside all let out sighs of relief, knowing that the situation had been resolved by Teacher Johan.

Watching Regice, who had regained consciousness and become honest and simple, slowly walking towards the cave, Gengar waved vigorously.

"Ka-kaah!!"

Goodbye! We'll come play with you again in a few days!

As soon as those words were spoken, Regice's speed suddenly increased, as if turning into a cold current, disappearing into the hole in a flash.

Then "crack crack crack" a layer of ice crystals covered the entrance.

Sealed!

Seeing this, Gengar's expression froze for a moment, then it stuck out its tongue proudly and made a couple of mocking sounds.

Just a little ice crystal, it can't stop me.

"Yoji..."

Larvitar smacked its lips.

What a nice "Gundam"...

Johan stretched lazily, "Alright, issue resolved. Now let's think about how to fill out the reimbursement form."

Larvitar and Victini weren't very familiar with this process, but Gengar was already well-versed.

It counted on its fingers.

"Ka-kaah, Ka-kaah, Ka-kaah..."

One box, twenty boxes, three hundred boxes...

Not only was there no loss in Poké Blocks, they gained never-melting ice and minerals, and could even claim reimbursement for more berries to make Poké Blocks...

Pure profit!

"Kaah kaah kaah kaah~~"

Gengar laughed smugly.

"Teacher Johan!"

At this moment, Officer Jenny and the others finally arrived on the island, looking at the island that had almost turned into an ice island, secretly amazed at Regice's power, and even more amazed at Teacher Johan's strength.

Even such a powerful Regice could be easily pacified...

Having Teacher Johan in Hoenn was truly reassuring.

"You're here."

"Regice, it..."

"Went back to sleep." Johan pointed at the ice-sealed cave, "Don't disturb it again unless necessary. Being woken up before it's ready to wake makes for a bad temper."

"Yes!" Officer Jenny nodded repeatedly.

Before they didn't know, but now knowing that the powerful Regice was sleeping here, who would dare approach carelessly?

The League would even set up a restricted area here, prohibiting ordinary people from approaching.

In this aspect, Johan didn't need to worry. He boarded the helicopter that had brought him here and returned to Kanaz City.

As for Anabel, who was supposed to act together with him but learned that Johan had already handled the situation before she arrived, she remarked, "Teacher Johan has grown stronger again," and promptly went home to accompany her wife and child.

"Steven."

Sitting in the helicopter, Johan called Steven.

"Teacher?"

Besides Steven's voice on the phone, there seemed to be some sounds of stones being broken and things being excavated.

It seemed that even with finals approaching, nothing could hinder his enthusiasm for digging stones.

"Can you help me check if the Verdanturf Space Center has recently discovered any huge meteorites heading toward us?" Johan said.

"Meteorites?" Steven was stunned for a moment, then replied: "Give me three minutes."

Then he hung up.

Regice's words had reminded him of some things. Confirming certain matters would help with early prevention if it really was a "meteorite incident."

However, Steven quickly called back and indicated that the Verdanturf Space Center had not recently discovered any large meteorites approaching them.

This made Johan feel somewhat relieved.

"That's good..."

Back in Kanaz City, in the backyard of the coffee shop.

"Tsk, it really went cold." Johan smacked his lips.

"Aii~~"

Gardevoir immediately offered to brew him another cup.

"It's fine, Ninetales can put some ice cubes in for me."

Penny was still waiting for him in the yard, sitting obediently on the side tinkering with her computer.

Regarding Penny's questions about Eevee training, to be honest, Johan couldn't raise such an exaggerated "Eevee" either, but he could offer some suggestions.

"Penny, you can try to learn about the Z-Moves unique to the Alola region. Among them, there are exclusive Z-Moves and Z-Crystals that are particularly suited for Eevee," Johan said, taking a sip of his iced coffee.

"Z-Moves?"

Penny's fingers lightly tapped the keyboard, quickly finding information about Alola's Z-Moves. After a brief review, she understood the basic principles of Z-Moves.

"Ahem, although... the Z-Move dance is a bit embarrassing, Eevee's exclusive Z-Move is indeed worth learning about."

Just as Dynamaxing has exclusive Gigantamax forms, Z-Moves also have exclusive moves for certain Pokémon.

And Eevee's exclusive Z-Move is called—Extreme Evoboost.

[Extreme Evoboost: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 2 stages each!]

An extremely impressive boost effect. Combined with Baton Pass, Eevee would become an excellent passer in the system.

"Mmm!" Penny nodded seriously, noting this point.

Although Johan had some aversion to the "awkward dance," he didn't deny that Z-Moves indeed had their unique and powerful aspects.

He even wondered...

Would it be possible to combine Mega Evolution with Terastallization and Z-Moves?

Or would that just drain the trainer into a dried corpse?

He quickly banished these "bold" thoughts from his mind.

Too dangerous, feels like it would be lethal.

Two days later.

Johan originally thought that Regice's awakening might simply be due to an accident, or perhaps it had a random, senseless dream.

Until he received a call from Lucian.

"Teacher Johan, Regigigas... it's awake."

# 612: Hope Everything Goes Well

July 1st, Snowpoint City in the Sinnoh region, clear skies and beautiful sunshine.

As the northernmost city in the Sinnoh region, Snowpoint City's temperature remained below freezing year-round. Natural snowfall and snow drifting down from Mt. Coronet kept Snowpoint City perpetually covered in pristine white snow.

With July approaching, signaling the arrival of summer, combined with warm sunshine, Snowpoint City's temperature briefly rose above ten degrees.

Wearing a burgundy velvet suit, with light purple long hair, carrying a book, and sporting light-colored sunglasses, Lucian walked on the white snow, making "crunch crunch" sounds.

Lucian gazed at Snowpoint City in the distance, muttering to himself.

"Must the capable always do more work? How come the boss and Teacher Johan don't have to work extra? Flint and Aaron may not be bright, but they're certainly capable..."

He walked to the entrance of the Snowpoint Gym.

The Snowpoint Gym Leader, dressed in a school uniform, was running toward him from outside.

"Elite Four Lucian," Candice called out with a smile, her breath visible in the cold air.

That's right, Elite Four Lucian.

Lucian was the first from the "Sinnoh small team" to pass the "evaluation" and officially become an Elite Four member, ending his probationary period. The others, Flint and Aaron, were still probationary members. As for Cynthia...

Cynthia was an exception.

Lucian: Evaluation? What evaluation? Was there such a procedure? Wasn't I just brought in to serve as an Elite Four member and assigned work directly?

Lucian's purpose in coming to Snowpoint City and the Snowpoint Gym was simple: he had taken on the job of "Gym Auditing."

Every year in each region, the League needed to audit the region's gyms, including revenue, badge distribution, the likelihood of trainers with badges participating in conferences, the strength of gym trainers themselves, their qualities, and so on.

Taking advantage of the decent weather, Lucian had come to Snowpoint City to evaluate the Snowpoint Gym.

"Gym Leader Candice," Lucian greeted with a smile.

They knew each other well enough to get straight to the point.

"Gym audit."

Candice then led Lucian into the gym. For Snowpoint Gym, the biggest "achievement" this year should be Teacher Johan.

Teacher Johan had successfully obtained a badge at Snowpoint Gym and participated in the "Lily of the Valley Conference," winning the championship.

Lucian reviewed Snowpoint Gym's badge distribution records and couldn't help but furrow his brows.

"There's a rather low number of badges distributed..."

Candice seemed unfazed, explaining somewhat helplessly: "Snowpoint City is in a remote location with an extremely cold environment. The highest temperature throughout the year doesn't exceed fifteen degrees, so many young trainers choose to bypass Snowpoint Gym."

This was unavoidable.

After all, there weren't only eight gyms in the Sinnoh region, but the conference only required eight badges, so trainers inevitably made choices.

Some chose gyms that favored their specialized type, while others simply didn't want to visit such a cold place.

Lucian nodded.

Distributing fewer badges was better than handing them out carelessly.

Like Sunyshore Gym in Sunyshore City, which last year distributed more badges than three or four gyms combined. Although Gym Leader Volkner had become more restrained afterward, his restraint had made Sunyshore Gym the most difficult gym from which to earn a badge.

The contrast was striking.

That said, Volkner from Sunyshore City was indeed very powerful, so even though some aspects didn't meet requirements, the League chose to "let it slide" appropriately.

"Alright then."

Lucian put away the records, preparing to take them back to the League headquarters.

As for evaluating the Gym Leader's strength and quality—

BOOM—

Suddenly.

A disturbance came from outside Snowpoint City, and the entire city seemed to shake slightly.

"Hmm?"

Lucian and Candice both raised their heads almost simultaneously, looking in the same direction.

"That's..." Lucian began.

Candice immediately responded: "Snowpoint Temple!"

Hiss—

The two exchanged glances.

Previously, they had witnessed Regigigas awakening in Snowpoint Temple firsthand. At that time, if Teacher Johan hadn't pacified Regigigas, perhaps...

"Let's go!"

Lucian and Candice immediately headed toward Snowpoint Temple.

From a distance.

Lucian saw that familiar yet terrifying figure—none other than the legendary titan that pulled continents: Regigigas!

"It-it's awake, Regigigas is awake again?" Candice murmured.

Lucian immediately took out his phone, preparing to report this to the Sinnoh League.

At the same time, as an Elite Four member, he would go to the scene and do his best to minimize any damage and impact Regigigas might cause. This was his responsibility as an Elite Four member!

"So I have to face Regigigas alone this time?" Lucian felt bitter but didn't know who to tell.

Just as he took out his phone, before even reporting to the League, he suddenly thought of someone and quickly dialed his number.

"Teacher Johan, Regigigas... it's awake."

To translate Lucian's words simply:

Help! Save us!

When Johan received Lucian's call, he was training with his Pokémon.

It was Sunday, and after training, he had planned to take his little ones out for a meal.

Given his current status and how recognizable his Pokémon were, Johan really wished he could bring back the name "Wuda" to the scene.

But Lucian's call disrupted his plans.

Regigigas was awake?

Johan immediately thought of the incident two days ago when the ice titan Regice mysteriously awakened.

He couldn't believe these two events weren't connected.

Before Lucian could finish speaking, Gengar, who was training nearby, ran over and tugged at Johan's clothes, then placed its own phone in front of him.

On the small screen sat Giratina, drinking tea.

It held a teacup, with pastries placed beside it. If not for the Distortion World in the background, Johan would have thought he was watching some wellness TV program.

"Giratina?"

Giratina slowly raised its head, and several words appeared on Gengar's phone screen.

[It is about to awaken.]

Johan: "!!!"

If Johan understood correctly, this "it" Giratina referred to should be... the Original One, Arceus, right?

Wait.

Arceus was about to wake up, and Giratina was this calm?

Did you pick up the wrong script?

Seemingly sensing Johan's confusion, another line of text appeared on the phone screen.

[Being anxious won't help. What will come will come. Let me finish this cup of tea first.]

Johan looked at Gengar.

What have you been watching with your "electronic pet"?

Gengar scratched its bottom.

"Ka-kaah..."

Nothing much, just some "Let the Soul Travel" kind of stuff...

Johan: "..."

He couldn't help giving Gengar a thumbs up.

Impressive.

"So, when will it arrive?" Johan asked.

Giratina shook its head.

[Don't know, but... the ones who should be most nervous aren't me, but those two.]

Arceus's anger had caused a certain degree of tremor throughout the Pokémon world. This tremor would spread from weak to strong, gradually extending from some corners to the entire world.

The first to suffer this angry impact would be Dialga's domain of time and Palkia's domain of space.

As for Giratina's "Distortion World," being in the shadow on the reverse side of the Pokémon world, it was actually the least affected and influenced.

"So, there's still time?"

Johan gently rubbed his chin.

Actually...

Johan did know something about Arceus's situation.

In ancient times, Arceus received help from humans. To repay them, it combined its Ground, Water, Grass, Electric, and Dragon-type plates into the "Jewel of Life" and lent it to a person.

But when Arceus came to reclaim the "Jewel of Life" at the agreed time, it was betrayed by that person, ultimately leaving severely injured and forced into slumber.

This was the source of Arceus's fury.

In the movie "Arceus and the Jewel of Life," Ash and his friends used the power of the time deity Dialga to travel back in time, change the past, and ultimately eliminate Arceus's anger.

But there was one issue.

If Arceus had fallen into slumber very early on, then who was the "Sinnoh Legend" summoned to Spear Pillar hundreds of years ago during the Michina era?

Moreover, if the almighty creator could be killed with mercury and electricity from a few hundred Electric-type Pokémon, then wouldn't that mean...

He might have a chance...

A bold and dangerous light flashed in Johan's eyes.

"Hello? Hello! Teacher Johan, are you listening? Hello?!"

Lucian's alarmed voice from the phone brought Johan back from his wandering thoughts.

"Ahem..." He coughed lightly, suppressing those unrealistic ideas in his mind.

Joke.

The idea that Arceus could be suppressed by mercury was one of the biggest jokes in this world.

Rather than believe that—

"I'd rather believe I could live forever," Johan muttered.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar's eyes immediately lit up, looking at Johan hopefully.

You've finally started looking forward to living forever?

I'm so pleased!

"I heard you, go on, Lucian."

"I've already finished! Regigigas is awake. Do you have any solution, Teacher Johan?"

"Solution? Is Regigigas causing havoc?" Johan asked back, as he hadn't heard much commotion or huge disturbances from Lucian's call.

"Uh..."

Hearing this, Lucian was slightly stunned, then looked toward Regigigas.

Concern breeds confusion.

Actually, after awakening, apart from the initial large disturbance, Regigigas had been quite quiet.

"Phew—" Lucian let out a slight sigh of relief and said: "It's not."

After speaking, he took out his phone, took a picture of Regigigas, and sent it to Johan.

When Johan received the message and looked at it.

His mouth twitched.

Regigigas was being so well-behaved, what are you getting so excited about...

"So there's no problem then?" Lucian asked.

"Hmm..." Johan made a sound through his nose, drawing it out before saying: "It's hard to say. Regigigas might still be in its 'Slow Start' state."

Lucian wiped his forehead.

He had almost forgotten about that.

"Anyway, I'll come to Sinnoh," Johan said.

With that, Johan hung up the phone.

This time, facing the Arceus awakening event, he chose not to evade.

On one hand, there was nowhere to escape to.

On the other hand, he also felt that Arceus, in its rage, might need help.

Hatred and anger shouldn't erupt from others' schemes. Some things needed to be clarified.

In fact.

Regarding the Arceus awakening event, Johan had anticipated it and had already prepared some contingency plans.

The first option:

Perhaps the most stable and secure method was to follow Ash's approach—have Dialga help twist time, send him back to the past, then resolve Arceus's inner conflict, thereby dissolving its anger.

The second option:

Although Arceus's "Jewel of Life" had been embezzled by Damos's subordinate Marcus, the jewel still existed. Finding it might alleviate some of Arceus's anger.

The third option, which Johan felt was best avoided:

Directly confronting Arceus!

"I wonder if Arceus would give face to a 'nobody' like me..." Johan muttered to himself.

"Goka?"

Ceruledge glanced at him, its sword blade gently swiping down from top to bottom, creating a shallow arc of blue light that slowly faded in the air, accompanied by a hint of scorching heat.

Isn't respect earned through one's own strength?

Johan's cheek twitched. The "respect" from Arceus wasn't so easily earned.

For the three contingency plans he had envisioned, he felt that... implementing all three simultaneously would be most secure!

So, Johan took out his phone and dialed a number.

"Teacher Johan?"

Through the phone came Matori's voice, tinged with surprise and confusion.

"Matori," Johan said slowly. "I think there's a place in the Sinnoh region with very nice scenery, quite suitable for photography or tourism..."

"Eh?" Matori's voice rose a few notches. "How did Teacher Johan know we were planning a team-building trip to Sinnoh?"

Hmm?

Team-building trip?

To Sinnoh?

Wait, does Team Rocket offer such good benefits?

Ahem, pulling back his wandering thoughts, Johan cautiously asked: "Where in Sinnoh are you planning to go for team building?"

"Michina. I heard the scenery is quite nice. We're planning to go rock climbing and hiking," Matori said without thinking.

Well, all guesses and doubts were dispelled. The Arceus event was definitely happening!

Johan said: "Michina is good, Michina is good..."

"By the way, what did you want to say earlier, Teacher Johan?"

"Nothing now. Just enjoy yourselves."

"Okay~(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧"

Hanging up the phone, Johan let out a slight breath.

With the trio there, at least... they could block four of Arceus's "Judgment" attacks. Secure.

Four immunities to attacks, how could they lose?

Plus, if Johan remembered correctly, when the trio were rummaging through the ruins in Michina, they likely found the staff of Damos's subordinate Marcus, which contained the "Jewel of Life."

If all went well, the "second option" might be achievable.

Hopefully...

"Everything goes well," Johan said softly.

# 613: Preparing a Little 'Surprise' for the Llama

July 1st, evening, the sun slanting westward.

Twinleaf Town.

Ding dong—Ding dong—

The towering Space-Time Towers played a melodious tune that echoed throughout Twinleaf Town, announcing the coming sunset.

At this moment, a dark figure stood atop the twin towers, casting a long shadow in the setting sun.

Darkrai's body flowed like clouds, with a faint light flickering deep in its azure eyes, carrying a trace of confusion and a hint of gravity.

Something was about to happen, something big!

As the guardian of Twinleaf Town, Darkrai, who was once the first to sense the anomalies in time and space, once again detected a disturbance in the space-time continuum.

Could those two be fighting again?

Hmm?

Just as the thought arose, Darkrai sensed a familiar aura entering the Sinnoh region.

It was all too familiar with this aura.

Although sensing this aura often accompanied some not-so-good events, the Poké Blocks that person brought were truly delicious...

Moreover, through confrontations with some powerful beings, Darkrai could feel that its strength, which hadn't changed in decades, had improved somewhat.

This was probably what that guy often said... when life encounters life, something is always born.

"Is it Dialga or Palkia this time?" Darkrai felt a subtle rise of fighting spirit within.

It was no longer the same being that had to face the Space-Time Dragon duo alone!

A black mist surged from its body as Darkrai rode the shadows of the Space-Time Towers, soaring on the evening breeze toward the direction of that aura.

Be it Dialga or Palkia...

"As long as it's not Arceus, I'll crush them all!"

With a long howl, Darkrai disappeared into the shadows of Twinleaf Town.

Night fell.

Treading on the pristine snow, Johan arrived at Snowpoint City in the Sinnoh region.

Waiting for him there, besides Lucian who had come for work, were several familiar faces.

The current probationary Elite Four members of the Sinnoh region, Flint and Aaron.

"Teacher Johan!"

They were all quite familiar with each other, but having not met for over a month since parting in Unova, they appeared rather enthusiastic.

After briefly exchanging greetings, Lucian said:

"The boss is still on Mt. Coronet. She supposedly discovered some hidden mysterious ruins and should be here soon."

As he spoke, he glanced at the time.

Johan nodded, "I know."

Although one was in Sinnoh and the other in Hoenn after parting in Unova, they had maintained contact.

After returning to Sinnoh, Cynthia had taken her Pokémon to Mt. Coronet for training.

At the summit of Mt. Coronet, the coldest and harshest environment in the entire Sinnoh region, wild Pokémon were few, but whenever one appeared, it was usually extremely powerful.

Battling against nature and powerful wild Pokémon—this was Cynthia's current goal and direction.

Of course, there were rumors of ancient ruins at the mysterious summit of Mt. Coronet, which was also one of the things Cynthia, as a mythology scholar, wanted to pursue and explore.

"Let's go see Regigigas first," Johan said.

So, the group headed to Snowpoint Temple.

Although night had fallen, because Regigigas's presence was so important, Sinnoh League staff had already set up a cordon outside Snowpoint Temple under Lucian's arrangement, and brightened the lights.

From a distance, one could see the ten-meter-tall Regigigas sitting in the snow, staring blankly, motionless.

Since Regigigas hadn't shown any hostility or done anything out of line, the League didn't dare make too many moves.

Outside the cordon, Johan encountered another familiar face.

The Pyramid King of the Hoenn Battle Frontier, Brandon!

He seemed to be discussing something with the Snowpoint Temple Shrine Maiden.

"Mr. Brandon?"

"Ah, Teacher Johan, you've arrived." Brandon and the Shrine Maiden also noticed Johan.

As the owner of the three Regi titans and someone with a keen interest in ruins and historical matters, Brandon had immediately flown in on his Battle Pyramid upon learning of Regigigas's awakening in Snowpoint Temple.

The Snowpoint Temple Shrine Maiden visibly relaxed upon seeing Johan.

Last time, when Regigigas awakened, it was this Teacher Johan who had pacified it.

The Shrine Maiden said: "After awakening, Regigigas just sat there motionless. We couldn't communicate with it, so..."

She had already tried to communicate with Regigigas but to no avail.

"Is it possible," Johan glanced at the obedient giant, "that it's just awake but not fully awake?"

Hmm?

Both the Shrine Maiden and Brandon were taken aback.

"I'll go check."

Saying this, Johan walked alone toward the cordon. Just as he was about to present his "International Police Inspector" credentials, the staff had already lifted the cordon.

"Teacher Johan!" The person seemed somewhat excited.

"Thank you," Johan expressed his gratitude.

Feeling that my face is more effective than my ID, he thought as he entered the restricted area.

"Ka-kaah~~"

Gengar floated out from the shadows, gazing up and down at the giant before them.

"Regigigas."

Johan approached Regigigas, feeling a pressure entirely different from Regice, and attempted communication using his aura power.

However, Regigigas remained motionless, with only its signal lights flashing at an extremely slow pace. Otherwise, Johan would have thought it was still asleep.

After a brief contemplation, he gave Gengar a look.

Gengar immediately understood, opening its mouth to produce a box of Poké Blocks which it handed to Johan.

"Ka-kaah~~(ω`)_且~"

"Regigigas, dinner time!" Johan used his aura again.

"REGI—"

This time, Regigigas finally responded, its body trembling slightly as it bent down to look at Johan.

At the same time, the frequency of its signal lights gradually quickened a bit.

"GIGAS!!"

Regigigas scratched its head with its giant palm, seemingly finally recovering from its "frozen" state.

Indeed a "glutton."

Johan shook his head and stepped forward, placing his palm on Regigigas.

Glutton, here's some aura!

Aura, residing within the heart!

Woosh—

A bluish light emerged from Johan's body. Regigigas's current expression:

(￣▽￣)

Done.

Johan waved at Regigigas, turning to walk back to the somewhat dumbfounded Lucian and the others.

Regigigas did react, and then nothing else?

"Is-is it over?" Lucian couldn't help but ask.

Everyone else also cast puzzled looks.

"Not yet," Johan shrugged. "It's just woken up, right? Let its system fly a little longer—no, let its system operate a bit more."

Slow Start, truly the "top-tier" ability in the entire Pokémon world.

The mighty legendary beast capable of pulling continents, rendered ineffective because of "Slow Start."

But once its "Slow Start" passes, then...

Johan had once seen a "theory" suggesting that Regigigas's original ability wasn't "Slow Start." Only after completing the feat of dragging continents, which drained it greatly, was its original ability replaced by "Slow Start."

He didn't comment on this "theory" as it couldn't be verified.

But he had roughly figured out a characteristic of Regigigas's "Slow Start."

That is... the longer it rests, the more terrifying Regigigas's destructive power might be after "Slow Start" ends. In the real Pokémon world, this might not be purely a negative ability.

"Prepare some food for it, replenish... replenish its energy, speed up its 'system' recovery. We might need it for a tough battle later," Johan told the Shrine Maiden.

"Yes." The Shrine Maiden nodded and hurried to make arrangements.

"Tough battle?"

Lucian and the others, however, focused more on the "tough battle" Johan mentioned.

Not many battles could be termed "tough" by the current Teacher Johan, let alone requiring Regigigas's power.

Could it be that the Space-Time Dragon duo was at it again?

Previously, most of the incidents Johan encountered put him in passive situations, as he only learned of the events when he arrived or made contact.

But this time.

Since he knew in advance what would happen, he decided to prepare beforehand.

If events unfolded as in the movie, then he would give Arceus a little "surprise."

At this moment.

"ROAR—"

A resonant howl quickly approached from a distance.

Looking up.

A Garchomp was seen riding the snowy winds from Mt. Coronet, rapidly approaching Snowpoint Temple in the night.

On Garchomp's back was a golden-haired, black coat-wearing, stern-faced beauty—Sinnoh's Cynthia!

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar by Johan's side looked at the Garchomp, waving while quietly muttering.

Feels like old Garci-girl's strength has gotten even stronger.

Old Garci-girl?

Hearing Gengar's new "nickname" for Garchomp, Johan's mouth twitched slightly.

He better not let Garchomp hear that, otherwise that ferocious mother dragon would blame him again.

Whoosh—

"Boss!" Flint and the others waved at the descending Cynthia.

BOOM!!

Garchomp landed heavily on the ground, raising large patches of snow dust, swirling up a misty white fog.

Undeniably, Cynthia's training of Garchomp was indeed excellent. The fact that she could adapt a Garchomp, with its quadruple weakness to ice, to an extremely cold place like Mt. Coronet, was testament to their joint efforts.

It had a similar effect to Johan feeding Larvitar branches from the Tree of Beginning.

It was a perfect alignment of heaven, earth, and human factors for them.

Stepping in leather shoes, with a spirited demeanor and one hand in her pocket, Cynthia emerged. The valiant Garchomp followed right behind her, casting a disdainful glance at Johan.

Johan: "..."

Why are you staring at me?

Upon seeing Johan, the frost on Cynthia's face quickly receded, revealing a smile.

"You're here."

"Yes."

Johan nodded.

Flint, Lucian, and Aaron exchanged glances, their eyes conveying:

Shouldn't we not be here?

"What's the situation now?" Cynthia asked, glancing at the simple-minded Regigigas sitting in the snow.

"Regigigas is fine, but other places might be in trouble."

"Other places?" Cynthia's fine eyebrows furrowed slightly.

"Let's talk as we go. We need to head somewhere first," Johan said.

"Where?"

"Michina."

Speaking, Johan turned to Brandon: "Mr. Brandon, can I borrow your pyramid?"

Brandon, who was considering whether he should step aside, was startled by the question and nodded instinctively:

"Oh, sure, sure."

But then he realized, "Do you know how to pilot it?"

"I think so," Johan smiled.

Then the group entered Brandon's Battle Pyramid.

I think so?

"Rotom, Battle Pyramid mode, activate!"

"Ro-Rotom?! (_)"

PokéDex Rotom floated out from Johan's pocket, eyes wide.

"Am I really going to pilot it, Rotom?"

Without waiting for Johan's answer, Rotom directly floated out from the PokéDex, slipping into the Battle Pyramid's system through its circuits.

At the same time, excited shouts were heard.

"Battle Pyramid mode, activate!! (〇*)"

"Ka-kaah!!"

Gengar spread its arms, appearing even more excited than Rotom.

Brandon, standing in the snow, watched his Battle Pyramid slowly, wobbingly rise into the air with a "huff-puff" sound, and couldn't help but swallow.

Why... did he have a feeling... that this was the last time he would see it?

From a distance, Brandon heard voices from the Battle Pyramid's system—

"Urgent! Where's the transformation button, Rotom?"

"A-Arceus?!"

Inside the now steadily flying Battle Pyramid, Flint's exclamation was heard.

Even Cynthia, after listening to Johan's explanation, couldn't help but show a shocked expression upon hearing this name.

After a pause, Flint sat down and asked:

"So, who is Arceus?"

Slap—

Lucian slapped his forehead.

Flint, don't tell people you're from Sinnoh when you go out, we can't bear this embarrassment.

Though thinking this, Lucian still said:

"I've seen it in some ancient books."

"Before the Pokémon world appeared, in the midst of chaos and fluctuations, an egg appeared. This egg hatched into Arceus, who created the entire Pokémon universe. The fragments from creation formed plates, bestowing different powers to all things..."

This was Sinnoh's "Arceus Creation Legend," which is why Arceus is honored as the "Original One."

"The Original One..."

Flint seemed to somewhat understand the significance of the name "Arceus," murmuring.

According to Johan's account, Arceus was deceived by humans in ancient times, wounded and forced into slumber. This awakening was to vent its fury on humans.

Lucian, Flint, and Aaron exchanged glances.

This trouble... is a bit big.

"No worries, if Arceus really comes, Flint, you're up first."

Flint: Σ(дlll)

Cynthia looked at Johan and calmly said: "You must have a plan, right?"

Otherwise, he wouldn't appear so calm.

But Johan wanted to say... there's no point in being anxious, what will come will come.

Hmm? Where had he heard that before?

"Ahem, fortunately, we know about this in advance, so we still have time to prepare."

Actually, Arceus initially held goodwill toward humans, considering them one of its "creations," but unfortunately, some misunderstandings arose.

As the group nodded, Aaron's cowlick suddenly stood up, and he exclaimed:

"Arceus!"

Everyone: "..."

With this reaction speed, becoming an Elite Four member was truly...

However, to reassure everyone, Johan, while patting Larvitar's head, said with some authority:

"Just a llama. Let's prepare a little 'surprise' for it!"

# 614: I'm Shudao Mountain!

July 2nd, clouds drifted across the azure sky.

Sinnoh, Michina.

This was a small town located in the central region of Sinnoh. Although the urban area wasn't large, Michina's natural scenery was quite impressive.

Michina had many towering rocky mountains, flowing lakes, and fertile fields. The residents living in Michina could be completely self-sufficient based on this land.

At the same time, among those scattered rocky mountains were abundant mineral deposits, evident from Larvitar's expression after disembarking from the Battle Pyramid.

However, Michina's residents didn't mine these deposits, as the fertile soil was enough to sustain their comfortable, leisurely lives.

This was a "gift" left by Arceus's plates.

Flint took a deep breath, spreading his arms, "What a wonderful place! How have I never been here before?"

The Battle Pyramid had landed on a vast meadow in Michina where wild Pokémon were active.

Beside the meadow was a large, sparkling lake where Bibarel played at the water's edge, building and comparing their "mansions."

The lake water came from a rocky mountain in the distance, flowing through the entire Michina area to reach this point.

Several Marill and Buizel poked their heads out of the water, curiously observing Johan's group and the huge pyramid, seemingly puzzled about how such a large object could fly without wings.

On the way here, Johan had already informed Cynthia and the others about his general plan.

This included using Dialga's power to return to the past and change history.

As well as searching for Marcus's staff that might have been left in the ruins of Michina, including the "Jewel of Life" inside the staff.

As for the final contingency plan Johan had prepared, he hadn't told everyone yet to prevent them from feeling too much pressure.

"So, will Dialga and Palkia appear here?" Lucian pushed up his glasses and asked.

"Most likely," Johan said.

He walked toward the rocky mountain where the water flowed from, and continued:

"All of Arceus's anger stems from here. This is the place it cares about most, so if its awakening brings temporal and spatial disturbances, Michina will definitely be affected first."

While Johan was explaining to Cynthia and the others, nearby...

"Yoji?"

Larvitar ran to the riverside, looking at the gently flowing, sparkling water. It crouched down, bringing its head close to the water's surface, which reflected its image.

Suddenly.

The water surface broke as a Buizel abruptly poked its head out from the water, startling Larvitar.

"Yoji!!"

The mischievous Buizel grinned at Larvitar, then spun around and dove back into the water.

"Yoji! (｀Д)"

Larvitar puffed up its cheeks, calling out to the Buizel underwater.

Come fight me one-on-one!

The water surface gradually parted again, and an adorable blue Pokémon with a balloon-like tail—Phione—floated up, curiously looking at the exasperated Larvitar, tilting its head.

"Phio?"

"Yoji!"

Caught you!

Larvitar thought it was the naughty Buizel, immediately raising its paw. Streams of sand floated from the riverbank and wrapped around Phione.

"PHIO!!"

Phione, caught and wrapped in sand, cried out in fear, causing ripples across the water surface.

It wasn't until Larvitar "caught" Phione and brought it to shore that it realized it had caught the wrong Pokémon.

Looking at the cute Phione continuously dropping pearl-sized tears, Larvitar felt at a loss, scratching its head...

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar approached Phione, wanting to investigate what kind of Pokémon it was. However, when Phione opened its eyes and saw the magnified ghost face before it, it nearly had a stress response, bouncing up on its ball-shaped tail.

Unfortunately, since Gengar was a Ghost-type Pokémon, Phione passed right through it.

Larvitar and Gengar exchanged glances... both discovering the secret of Phione's tail, and simultaneously revealed mischievous grins.

"Vii~~"

Seeing Phione crying uncontrollably, Victini revealed itself and shared one of its treasured macarons.

Sure enough, after smelling the aroma of the macaron, Phione stopped crying and stared blankly at Victini.

And then...

"Yoji, Yoji."

Larvitar tugged at Johan's pants.

"What's wrong?"

Johan turned around and saw a scene that made him sweat.

Larvitar was patting Phione's tail like a ball, while Phione itself was "crunch crunch" eating macarons with Victini.

"Yoji! (Д)σ"

Look, a bouncy ball!

Saying this, Larvitar grabbed Phione's tail and threw it toward Gengar, who had been waiting.

Basketball!

"Ka-kaah! Ka-kaah!"

Gengar stuck out its tongue, ready to catch it.

Meanwhile, Phione was drawing a parabolic arc through the air with a bewildered expression, though the macaron in its mouth didn't fall out.

Johan: "..."

Splash splash—

By the riverside, the water stirred again. An intimidating Azumarill with clenched fists and bulging muscles appeared, accompanied by several Marill and Phione, glaring menacingly at Larvitar and Gengar who were playing ball.

The parent had arrived!

The expression and posture of this Azumarill made an image instinctively flash through Johan's mind.

Damn, a real dragon slayer!

Azumarill was originally a pure Water-type Pokémon, but later in the sixth generation of Pokémon, it gained the Fairy-type attribute.

As is well-known, Fairy-type is very effective against Dragon-type Pokémon. Besides having the Fairy-type attribute, Azumarill also had the "Huge Power" ability.

Combined with its inheritable moves like Belly Drum and Play Rough, Azumarill had earned the title of "Dragon Slayer."

It was said that one punch could take down a dragon—none could withstand it.

"Yo-Yoji..."

Seemingly sensing the hostile gaze, Larvitar and Gengar stopped their ball game, their heads stiffly turning toward the riverside.

Seeing Azumarill's bulging muscles, the two little ones...

Σ()

Gengar reacted fastest, shrieking as it dove into Johan's shadow.

"Yo-Yoji..." Larvitar carefully placed the confused Phione on the ground and forced a friendly smile.

Mis-misunderstanding...

"MARILL!!" Azumarill clenched its fists, making "crack crack" sounds.

"Vii~~"

"Phio?"

Fortunately, thanks to the naturally friendly Victini and Phione's own explanation, Azumarill gave Larvitar a few suspicious glances before letting it go.

But...

The Buizel in this river wouldn't have peace today!

Clenching its fists, Azumarill turned back to the river, lightly punching the water surface and creating a significant splash.

The Buizel in the river trembled in fear.

"Yoji—" Larvitar immediately let out a long sigh of relief.

Somehow, it had felt from that Azumarill the same sensation as facing Cynthia's Garchomp.

Not in terms of strength, but that protective parental feeling—creepy...

Larvitar sneakily glanced at Garchomp.

"ROAR—"

Garchomp snorted white air from its nostrils, arms crossed, looking down at Johan.

How did this boomerang back to me again?

Johan shook his head.

"Well, let's just eat here then. At the current rate, Dialga and Palkia haven't appeared yet. If they do show up, we can go over there in time."

Under a large tree by the river, the dense shade blocked the intense sunlight, and a picnic blanket was spread out on the soft grass.

Johan, as the chef, put on an apron and began cooking.

This time, not only were Johan's group and their Pokémon eating together, but also the previously encountered Azumarill family and the bump-headed-but-still-hungry Buizel.

Of course, other wild Pokémon from Michina joined as well, multiplying Johan's pressure.

"Yoji!"

Eat up everyone, don't be shy!

Larvitar alternated between a bite of mineral and a bite of macaron, not forgetting to "warmly" welcome everyone.

"This kid..."

Clearly hasn't experienced "hard times" together, doesn't know how difficult it is to accumulate our resources.

That was until Johan saw Larvitar accepting "gifts" from these wild Pokémon—things like berries, minerals, pearls, nuggets, and other return gifts.

This made him speechless, reflecting that wearing Uxie's claw truly hadn't been in vain.

"Johan."

Cynthia came over with a cake, whispering: "Do you have other plans that you're not telling us?"

Johan was stunned.

Had Cynthia seen through him?

Then he heard her continue: "You said find Dialga to go back to the past and change it. You're planning to go alone, aren't you?"

Johan blinked.

He hadn't said that.

Originally, he had considered this as one plan, but the main direction was still to find the "Jewel of Life" in the present era, avoiding a time-traveling adventure.

Time wasn't something to be trifled with, especially going back to the past to change history—it could easily produce unforeseeable consequences.

It might trigger a butterfly effect.

After all, whether a being like Arceus slept for hundreds or thousands of years would have significant impacts.

Besides, he wasn't Daigo and didn't want to be boiled into soup...

Before Johan could answer, Cynthia looked into his eyes with determination:

"I'm going with you!"

We might not need to go at all... thinking this, Johan nodded and said: "Alright!"

Hearing this, Cynthia smiled with satisfaction and scooped up a spoonful of cake, eating it delightedly.

"Mmm, delicious!"

"Made by Gardevoir and Alcremie. Next time I'll bring more for you," Johan smiled.

"Yes, please!"

"Toge piii~~"

At this moment, an egg-shaped little creature waddled over to Cynthia's side, gently tugging at her coat and gazing longingly at the cake in her hand.

"You want some too?" Cynthia crouched down, smiling as she stroked its chin with her finger.

"To-Togepi~o(^▽^)o"

Johan had noticed this little one earlier—a Togepi, Cynthia's newly caught Pokémon.

"So you really caught a Togepi."

He remembered suggesting that Cynthia catch this Pokémon, and was surprised she had done so so quickly.

Togepi was a relatively rare Pokémon symbolizing good luck. Not everyone was fortunate enough to encounter one.

"Yes." Cynthia carefully picked up the little one, preparing to feed it cake.

"Perfect," Johan glanced at Togepi and teased: "I was just needing an egg to crack."

"To-Togepi?! d(д)"

Crack... an egg?

"Ka-kaah?" Gengar emerged.

Crack an egg? Where's the egg that needs cracking? I'm an expert at cracking eggs!

Cynthia gave Johan an annoyed look, hugging Togepi tightly as she ran away, with Johan and Gengar's teasing laughter trailing behind.

Splash splash—

On the rocky mountain where the Michina Shrine was located, a lake situated on the mountain suddenly began to churn. A spiral water column abruptly twisted upward into the sky.

Then.

More and more spiral water columns swirled skyward, while a strong gust of wind swept through, bending the already sparse trees around.

Woosh—

The next moment.

A massive black hole-like vortex appeared above the lake, with water flowing upward into it.

Such a disturbance naturally caught the attention of Johan's group, who had been keeping an eye on the rocky mountain.

"That is..." Lucian stared blankly at the suddenly appearing black hole that seemed ready to devour everything. This was definitely not a natural phenomenon.

"They're here!" Johan said gravely.

This was the effect of Arceus gradually awakening, driving the collision of time and space between Dialga and Palkia in the Pokémon world.

After exchanging glances.

"Garchomp!"

"Dragonite!"

"Bronzong!"

"Yanmega!"

Flint: "..."

"Bronzong, take him too," Lucian adjusted his glasses.

"RAWR—!!"

A time rift appeared above Michina, and Dialga, covered in sapphire-like blue scales, flew out, looking toward the massive black hole.

But before it could act.

"ROAR—!!"

Another roar sounded as a spatial rift appeared, from which the Space Dragon Palkia, covered in gray scales, emerged.

The two merely glanced at each other before losing control of their emotions.

Dialga: What are you looking at?!

Palkia: What's it to you if I look?!

Dialga: Try looking one more time!

Palkia: I'll try—

"RAWR—!!"

Before Palkia could finish, Dialga directly unleashed a wave of azure light.

Roar of Time!

"ROAR!!"

Palkia: You're freaking ambushing me!

Woosh—

The red pearl on Palkia's shoulder emitted a faint light, its arm sweeping like a blade, suddenly slashing out a spatial edge.

Spacial Rend!

BOOM!!

The powers of time and space collided. The already turbulent sky above Michina saw the black hole instantly grow larger.

Just as Johan's group was rapidly approaching, a black mist swiftly arrived from the distance at extreme speed, accompanied by a roar.

"You two again! And you've stolen my black hole!"

It was—Darkrai, coming from Twinleaf Town!

Watching the three Pokémon battling, Johan was momentarily distracted.

Why did this scene feel so familiar?

Darkrai suddenly turned around, looking at Johan, "What are you standing there for? It's not these two this time? Deal with them!"

Although its strength had improved, it still couldn't match the gods of time and space.

But it wasn't afraid.

Dialga, Palkia were here, Johan and his companions were here—all the "codes" were correct.

Can't win?

Impossible.

Hurry up with your specialty of binding play, Darkrai's eyes suggested.

Johan held onto Dragonite's armor as Dragonite slowly stopped flying. His expression became somewhat strange.

But soon Johan took a deep breath, his expression turning serious as he declared:

"I'm Shudao Mountain!"

"One!"

"Two!"

Clink clink clink—

The sound of chains echoed above Michina, while the disturbance brought by the black hole grew increasingly stronger.

# 615: Did I Say You Could Leave?

Clink clink clink—

Hearing the sound of the red chains, Dialga and Palkia immediately stopped their actions, almost like a conditioned response, looking in unison toward Johan.

When they saw the red chains floating in Johan's hands, both creatures' eyes twitched simultaneously.

You're really addicted to this binding play, aren't you?

Dialga and Palkia exchanged glances, the two legendary deities rarely agreeing on anything, but this time reaching consensus.

Let's get out of here!

This place isn't safe, time to flee!

Immediately, Dialga roared, opening a time rift, while Palkia swung its arms, slashing open a spatial crack.

Just as they were preparing to leave.

Whoosh—

Darkrai's form flashed, black mist surging as it spread its arms between Dialga and the time rift. With blazing eyes fixed on Dialga, it sternly shouted:

"Did I say you could leave?!"

Simultaneously.

Gengar slipped through space and when Palkia was about to rush into the spatial crack, it found Gengar's mischievous head poking out, raising its eyebrows at Palkia.

"Ka-kaah~|ω)"

Don't be in such a hurry to leave!

Darkrai and Gengar had actually blocked Dialga and Palkia's escape routes.

[Ridiculous! You think this can stop me?]

Palkia scoffed. Could a mere Gengar stop it?

Although Palkia acknowledged Gengar had spatial talent—extraordinary for an ordinary Pokémon to interfere with the spatial crack it had opened.

But...

[I am the God of Space!]

Gengar grabbed the edges of the spatial crack with both hands, calling out to Johan.

"Ka-kaah! (Д)σ"

Look, it's getting agitated!

"Gengar may not be able to stop you, but it can definitely delay you for a few seconds. Are you sure I won't do something in those seconds?" Johan's expression remained unchanged as he spoke clearly.

Palkia's expression shifted slightly. Before it could look at Johan, it heard him continue:

"Besides, look at your crack—where does it lead?"

Hearing this, Palkia looked carefully and saw that the spatial crack it had opened actually... led to the Distortion World!

And in the Distortion World, Giratina was holding a teacup, leisurely taking a sip before waving at it.

What's up, Palkia.

Palkia's expression immediately soured.

It had thought Gengar merely possessed some spatial talent, but never imagined it could redirect its spatial crack to the Distortion World.

This one...

Palkia had to take Gengar more seriously.

On the other side, although Darkrai was no match for Dialga, it was handling the situation much more smoothly than Gengar. When it said you can't leave, you can't leave—unless you kill me!

"Dialga, Palkia, I have no ill intentions. Why not hear me out?" Johan said.

Dialga and Palkia exchanged glances, then looked back at Johan.

Dialga: [Human, don't think that just because you possess the chains formed by the Emotion God, you can use us as you please!]

Palkia: [That's right!]

When Arceus created the world, it also created the gods of time and space, Dialga and Palkia.

It also created the "Distortion World" representing the reverse side of the entire world, along with Giratina who controls antimatter.

To restrain them, and also to bestow emotions upon the Pokémon world, it created the three Lake Guardians: Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf.

The power of the Lake Guardians, representing emotion, when combined, could restrain any one of the three deities.

But only one at a time.

Moreover, the red chains in Johan's hands weren't truly complete. If they really fought with all their might, they couldn't be completely restrained.

Even with the red chains, they could still take him down!

"You've got it wrong," Johan spread his hands. "It's not that I need your help, but that you need mine?"

Dialga: [We would need help from a mere human? Laughable!]

Palkia: [Laughable!]

Johan's expression remained unchanged as he pointed to the black vortex that continued to draw in lake water, asking:

"Then tell me, how did this thing appear?"

With these words, Dialga and Palkia fell silent.

No one knew better than they did why these black vortices formed.

They were space-time vortices created by the collision of Dialga's time domain and Palkia's space domain. Even if they accidentally got caught in one, it would be troublesome.

And the cause of the time and space collision... was Arceus's awakening and fury!

"Now, can we sit down and talk?" Johan asked.

Dialga and Palkia exchanged glances again.

Finally, the energy fluctuations around the two beings gradually subsided, and they slowly flew toward Johan's position.

Darkrai, Gengar, and Cynthia's group all showed serious expressions.

If Dialga and Palkia suddenly went berserk, it wouldn't be easy to stop them...

Dialga: [We can give you three minutes to explain your plan.]

Palkia: [Three minutes.]

Dialga suddenly glared at Palkia.

[Can you stop copying me?]

Palkia turned its head away, pretending not to hear.

"Wait," Darkrai suddenly spoke up: "Johan, you mean our opponents this time aren't these two?"

We're not here to beat up these two?

"Of course not," Johan gestured to Gengar and Cynthia's group not to be tense.

"Then who?" Darkrai pressed.

Johan shrugged, "The one you often mention—Arceus."

Darkrai: "??!!"

Damn! You've really leveled up, to be able to provoke such a being now?

Darkrai was about to start cursing when a box of fragrant Poké Blocks was placed in front of it.

Seeing the Poké Blocks, Darkrai's eye twitched, and it couldn't help but swallow, though it still said:

"This isn't about Poké Blocks or not. You actually—"

Another box.

"Even if you give me—"

Three more boxes!

Five boxes total now.

Darkrai took a deep breath, "Don't you understand the severity of this? The opponent is..."

Three more boxes, making eight!

Darkrai's eyes flickered, clouds rushing through its azure eyes. Before it could speak again, Johan said directly:

"Five times more."

Darkrai: "!!"

After a brief moment of shock, Darkrai said gravely: "Let's do this! It's just a llama after all!"

Dialga and Palkia looked at this scene in astonishment.

This guy... has gone mad?

But why did it feel like this guy's aura and energy fluctuations seemed even stronger than before?

Poké Blocks in place, crush the llama?

Johan smiled and patted Darkrai's shoulder, then took out more Poké Blocks, macarons, and Poffins, placing them on the ground. He sat down cross-legged and said:

"Don't be shy, eat while we talk. These don't count toward your 'payment'."

With that said, Darkrai became enthusiastic.

Dialga and Palkia were still dazed, unconsciously accepting the macarons that Victini handed them and putting them in their mouths.

Hmm?!

The two great beings' eyes widened slightly.

Then they simultaneously looked at Darkrai who was feasting heartily.

At this moment, they seemed to somewhat understand Darkrai's behavior and actions.

Questioning Darkrai, understanding Darkrai, becoming Darkrai.

No wonder this guy fought so desperately each time—it was because of food like this... unbelievable!

Dialga and Palkia gave Darkrai a "fierce" glare before joining the feast.

As for their "angry glares," Darkrai simply chose to ignore them.

Ridiculous. If you're not enthusiastic about eating, there's something wrong with your thinking. Who has time to bother with you two?

In an instant, Dialga and Palkia forgot about their so-called "three minutes."

Three minutes? More like three hours!

Nearby, Flint, Lucian, and Aaron watched this scene with wide eyes and open mouths.

"Is-is this really Teacher Johan's secret to maintaining friendly relationships with legendary Pokémon?" Flint murmured.

Lucian gave him a sideways glance, "First, you need to have the ability and strength to make them willing to listen to you."

After a pause, he continued:

"Second, you need to master the methods for making top-tier Poké Blocks, macarons, Poffins, and other foods."

"Finally, you need to know what flavors they like."

Is that simple?

Just the first condition would make people give up.

Earlier, Dialga and Palkia were ready to leave at the first sign of disagreement. Only Teacher Johan could stop them.

Aaron suddenly raised his head, pointing up a finger to add: "And a sincere heart that considers the Pokémon's welfare!"

That's the key!

Through aura, Dialga and Palkia could feel Johan's "goodwill."

"By the way, before we discuss the plan, could you first deal with the space-time vortex here?" Johan said.

Hearing this, Dialga and Palkia looked toward the black vortex in the sky that continued to draw in lake water.

"RAWR!!"

Dialga roared, unleashing a unique temporal force.

Then Palkia, holding a macaron in one hand, swung its other hand to execute Spacial Rend, slicing and sealing the space around the black vortex.

With the combined efforts of the two deities, the black vortex instantly dissipated.

"Palkia, let me ask you something," Johan said.

Palkia looked at him.

"If I give you coordinates, can you directly fold space to teleport someone from that location to here?"

Like how Hoopa could summon others with just a ring.

[Ksssh—depends on their strength, ksssh—]

"Someone about your level?"

[Ksssh—not possible.]

Palkia shook its head, [It goes against the rules of space, ksssh—of course, if they willingly enter, then it's possible, ksssh—]

Johan gave it a somewhat "disdainful" look.

Some God of Space you are.

Not even worth a strand of Hoopa's hair.

Doesn't even qualify to be called "Little Hoopa."

Palkia felt somewhat bewildered by his look.

Hoopa could not only bring others over directly but could also control them, and multiple beings at once.

"Dialga, you know why Arceus is angry, right?" Johan turned to Dialga.

Hearing this, Dialga nodded.

Others might not know the various reasons, but as the God of Time, floating in the river of time, Dialga had looked into some information about this.

"Can you transport us to that time point?" Johan showed a serious expression, looking at Dialga.

Hearing these words, Dialga was visibly stunned, even stopping its chewing of the Poffin.

It looked at Johan with some disbelief in its eyes.

[You want to go back to the past and change it?]

"Is that not possible?"

Dialga fell into a brief silence.

After a good while, it finally spoke again:

[Do you know about time paradoxes? Do you understand the 'dangers' of changing the past? More importantly, even if you do change the past, it may not achieve the effect you want.]

Johan naturally knew about time paradoxes.

As for the "dangers"...

What concerned Johan more was what Dialga said about changing the past not necessarily achieving the desired effect.

Was it referring to the convergence of the world?

But in the movie, Ash had resolved Arceus's hatred through this method.

Yet movies are just movies, and the real world was very different.

"So, there's still a chance to try, right?" Johan asked again.

Dialga was silent again for a moment.

It nodded slightly:

[I can only say, there's a chance.]

"A chance is enough."

So his Plan A could be attempted.

He and Cynthia would go back to the past with Dialga's power, while Lucian, Flint, and Aaron would implement Plan B, searching for the possibly lost "Jewel of Life" in the Michina ruins.

As for the Team Rocket trio who had also arrived in Michina, he would let them do their thing—they might produce surprising results.

After arranging with Dialga and Palkia, Johan found Cynthia.

"The Adamant Orb and Lustrous Orb? I understand."

After hearing Johan's intention, Cynthia looked at the now "docile" Dialga and Palkia, nodding slightly.

Johan wasn't sure what would happen to Dialga and Palkia after he and Cynthia went back to the past. If the two got into a fight again, it would be troublesome.

But if they could use the power of the Adamant Orb and Lustrous Orb, even if Johan wasn't present, they might be able to somewhat restrain Dialga and Palkia—at least prevent the two from fighting each other.

Cynthia contacted the Sinnoh League and her grandmother, Professor Carolina.

Meanwhile.

Sinnoh region, Team Galactic Headquarters.

"Leader Cyrus, it's happening again—the collision of time and space! The location is Michina," Team Galactic researcher Charon reported immediately.

Since the previous incident in Twinleaf Town, Team Galactic's attention to time and space collisions had skyrocketed.

Now, after a long silence, Team Galactic had detected space-time collision waves again.

Cyrus, sitting in his office chair with hands supporting his chin, stood up expressionlessly, adjusting his clothes slightly.

Although he didn't speak, the Team Galactic members and executives before him all stood straight.

Time to act!
