# 616: Arceus, Let's Battle!

Ancient times, Michina.

Johan slowly opened his eyes, raising his hand to block the warm but blinding sunlight. The fragrance of fields filled his nostrils, and melodious birdsong reached his ears.

As his eyes fully opened, he saw verdant fields, trees laden with fruit, flowing waters, and the towering temple.

"Have we... returned to the past?"

Cynthia's voice came through, looking at the scene before them with awe on her face.

"It seems so," Johan nodded, adjusting his clothes and suppressing the discomfort caused by the space-time travel.

Using the power of the Time God Dialga, Johan and Cynthia had, according to plan, traveled back to ancient Michina—back to where Arceus's hatred began.

"Then we—"

Johan looked up at the sky.

According to the plot, Arceus would appear in the evening during the total lunar eclipse. If Dialga hadn't sent them to the wrong time, it would be tonight.

The sun was already setting, casting a golden hue over the fields, covering the entire town in a hazy yellow veil.

Time was limited.

"We need to enter the temple, find Marcus who betrayed Damos, and retrieve the 'Jewel of Life.'"

This was their ultimate goal.

But it wouldn't be an easy task.

Although nominally the Michina Temple was built by Damos and the people of Michina to thank Arceus, in reality, the temple was controlled by Marcus, who posed as Damos's subordinate.

To counter Arceus, Marcus had already made numerous preparations in the temple, gathering many Pokémon under his control.

Although losing the power of the plates made Arceus vulnerable to attacks of the types those plates would normally nullify, to think that just dozens or hundreds of Pokémon's attacks and some mercury could take down Arceus...

These Pokémon must be quite powerful.

Getting caught in an ambush would be troublesome.

Most importantly—

The temple was enormous, with a complex interior. Blind searching might waste precious time.

"Hmm."

The two began weaving through the alleys of Michina, steadily approaching the location of the Michina Temple.

Soon.

They arrived at an alley in a corner of the temple. Before them stood the towering temple. How to enter without being discovered was a critical issue.

"It's best to wait until dinner time. Guards in such temples usually change shifts at that time, so the chance of being discovered will be smaller," Cynthia suggested.

As a mythology scholar, Cynthia had a certain understanding of ancient human life.

At the same time, Cynthia had made some mental preparations.

If necessary, to save time... she would try to attract the attention of the entire temple's guards, creating time for Johan.

But just after she spoke, she noticed Johan acknowledging her words but then looking for something in the nooks and crannies of the temple.

Meanwhile.

The Poké Ball at Johan's waist opened by itself, and Larvitar ran out.

It walked to a wall, gazing at the majestic temple before it, and couldn't help but swallow.

"Yoji..."

I think... I could chew out a hole without anyone knowing. What do you think?

The soft muttering didn't catch the attention of the two humans. The little one nodded to itself.

Since you're not objecting, I'll take that as agreement.

Then Larvitar found a corner that seemed like it wouldn't attract much attention, zeroing in on a stone brick that looked particularly tasty, and prepared to bite.

However.

Before it could act, the stone brick moved on its own, then fell down and was caught by Larvitar.

"Yoji? (ω`)?"

Next, a golden little head poked out from the hole where the brick had been.

It locked eyes with Larvitar.

"Pi-Pichu?"

It was an adorable little Pichu, with black fur on one ear forming a spiky shape.

Pichu and Larvitar stared at each other for a moment, and just as Larvitar was about to call out, Pichu hurriedly covered its mouth.

"Pichu Pichu!"

Signaling it not to make noise.

Larvitar's eyes rolled around twice, and it nodded with its mouth still covered.

The Spiky-eared Pichu, seeing this, gave a sly smile, beckoned to Larvitar, and ducked back into the hole it had emerged from.

Larvitar scratched its head and tried to follow.

But Pichu seemed much smaller than Larvitar, and while Pichu could dart in at once, Larvitar's little bottom got stuck outside.

"Yo-Yoji! Yoji!"

At this moment, a Gengar that had witnessed the whole process floated out from the shadows. It gave an evil grin and raised its foot.

THUMP—

Larvitar tumbled into the passage with a "roll roll roll."

Gengar licked its tongue and also turned into a black mist, slipping inside.

After entering, Larvitar, Spiky-eared Pichu, and Gengar found themselves in a secluded corridor within the temple.

"Yoji?" Larvitar stood up, dusting off its bottom while fixing its gaze on Gengar with suspicion.

Did you just kick me?

Gengar put on a clueless expression.

"Ka-kaah?"

Kick you? Who? Where?

Larvitar began to doubt its judgment.

Maybe I felt wrong?

"Pichu Pichu?" Pichu waved its tiny hands, asking Larvitar and Gengar where they came from and how they got to the temple, warning that it was very dangerous here.

"Yoji! Yoji!"

Larvitar also waved its little hands, putting on a fierce look, then pointed at Gengar.

As if to match Larvitar's narrative, Gengar's black mist surged, transforming to look somewhat like... Dialga—well, Dialgar.

Then the two little ones spoke back and forth, leaving Pichu tilting its head, its ears drooping together, utterly bewildered.

What are you talking about? What's time swoosh swoosh, space zoom zoom, electronic pet roar roar...

Larvitar and Gengar exchanged glances.

"Ka-kaah!" Gengar raised a finger.

Wait for me.

With that, Gengar turned back into black mist, floating out of the corridor to the temple exterior, where Johan and Cynthia were already waiting at the spot where the brick had fallen.

Johan couldn't have missed his Pokémon's movements.

"Ka-kaah~Ka-kaah~"

Gengar spread its arms, gesturing something.

"So, you've met that Spiky-eared Pichu, right?" Johan asked.

He had been looking for Spiky-eared Pichu, knowing that with the little one's curiosity, it might encounter them as newcomers.

And given Spiky-eared Pichu's familiarity with the temple, having it as a guide would save them a lot of unnecessary trouble.

Gengar nodded repeatedly.

"Spiky-eared Pichu?" Cynthia looked puzzled.

"That's Damos's partner," Johan explained briefly.

After all, about Spiky-eared Pichu... it would be hard to explain in a short time. This was a Pichu that could "travel through time and space."

"Pichu?"

"Yoji?"

While Gengar was explaining to Johan and Cynthia, Spiky-eared Pichu and Larvitar poked their heads out of the hole again.

But the already small hole, with two little ones poking their heads out simultaneously...

"Pi-Pichu!"

"Yoji!!"

Spiky-eared Pichu and Larvitar were stuck, their cheeks red!

After much effort to "rescue" the two little ones, Pichu was breathing heavily, while Larvitar once again eyed the temple walls, noting that the bricks were quite hard.

"Pichu, could you please lead us to Damos, to Marcus? We want to help Damos," Johan bent down, asking in a gentle voice.

"Pichu?"

Pichu tilted its ear, looking at Johan, then at Cynthia, seemingly sensing goodwill from them. It then got down on all fours, turning toward a back door and running.

"Pichu~!"

After a few steps, it didn't forget to wave at them.

"Yoji~~"

Larvitar and Gengar immediately followed.

"Vii~~"

Victini, finding it fun, also happily floated along.

Under Spiky-eared Pichu's guidance, Johan and Cynthia bypassed most of the temple's guards, arriving at the prison where Damos was held.

Of course, there were guards outside the prison, which was unavoidable.

But for Johan and Cynthia, a few such guards...

"Ka-kaah~"

In the blink of an eye, several unprepared guards were on the ground.

It's worth noting that humans of this ancient time didn't have advanced tools like Poké Balls to "contain" Pokémon, but rather restrained them like tamed animals, placing restrictive shackles on them.

Moreover, in this period, humans referred to Pokémon as "magical beasts."

So, as long as they didn't cause too much commotion or let the large number of Pokémon imprisoned in the temple be released, they would be relatively successful.

Damos sat in the prison with his head in his hands, his expression painful and conflicted.

He wanted to return the "Jewel of Life" to Arceus, but his subordinate Marcus's betrayal prevented him from doing so. Now he was suffering from the guilt of failing Arceus's trust.

Until he heard the sound of guards falling outside the prison.

Looking up.

He saw a man and a woman in "strange attire" standing at the door, along with his partner Pichu and other "magical beasts."

"Mr. Damos, the time for your appointment with Arceus is approaching," Johan said.

At the steps of the high tower in the Michina Temple.

"Marcus should be up there. There's only one way up, and the guards are much stricter now than before," Damos said grimly, gritting his teeth.

Johan and Cynthia stood at the foot of the stairs, exchanged a glance, and both smiled.

Earlier, they were concerned about wasting time, but now...

The sun hadn't completely set yet.

There was enough time.

Johan threw out a Poké Ball, summoning Urshifu.

Cynthia also summoned Lucario.

For this relatively narrow terrain where it was difficult to maneuver, these two were undoubtedly the most suitable.

"Garruu!"

"Lucari!"

Urshifu and Lucario looked at each other, and Lucario smiled.

Shall we compete?

Urshifu clenched its fists, also grinning.

Let's do this!

The next second.

"Intruder! There's—"

"Someone! Come—"

BOOM—

In Marcus's palace, he heard a faint commotion from outside, furrowing his brow.

"What's all this noise outside?" he asked.

As soon as he opened the door.

He saw Urshifu and Lucario standing at his doorway, fists raised.

Seeing these two Pokémon, Marcus's pupils contracted sharply.

But his reaction was quick, or perhaps due to the critical moment, his alertness was good. At the instant he saw Urshifu and Lucario, his body dodged to the side while shouting:

"Kill them!"

As Marcus moved aside, a Pokémon wearing a chair-like apparatus and shackles on its back appeared behind him... Heatran!

"Heatran?" Cynthia was surprised to see this Pokémon.

"ROAR—!!"

Heatran let out a roar, its mouth opening wide as a scorching magma flame erupted from its mouth, instantly engulfing the entire doorway.

Marcus stood up with a cold face.

Although he hadn't figured out what was happening, the fact that they dared to come here so openly indicated that the intruders were no ordinary people, and might not be instantly defeated by Heatran. So...

He took up his staff, "I will make you pay for your recklessness!"

Marcus prepared to wake all the "magical beasts" imprisoned in the temple, to make these people food for the beasts!

But just as he raised the staff, he suddenly felt his hand loosen.

Hmm?

Looking back, he saw his staff somehow in Gengar's hands.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar played with the staff, tossing it lightly, revealing a smile.

Not light at all—clearly good quality metal. Tinkaton would be very satisfied.

Marcus's expression changed drastically, and he immediately called out: "Bronzong, Hypnosis!"

A Bronzong with shackles flew out from the corner, attempting to use Hypnosis on Gengar, but...

Gengar indicated that it had been a long time since any Pokémon had tried to use Hypnosis on it.

Then Gengar raised its hand with an evil grin, a faint light appearing in its crimson eyes.

Hypnosis?

Reflect!

Bronzong fell into a deep sleep.

Marcus looked dumbfounded at this scene.

The next second.

BOOM!!!

The magma flame spewed by Heatran exploded, accompanied by the sound of flowing water.

Urshifu assumed a stance, water flowing around its fists and feet.

Beside it, a stern-faced Lucario held a blue bone staff horizontally in front.

"Aqua Jet!" Johan's voice came from behind the door, along with Cynthia's.

"Bone Rush!"

BANG BANG BANG—

Marcus's trusted Heatran retreated step by step under the impact of water fists and bone staff. As Urshifu delivered its final punch and Lucario landed its final bone staff strike.

BOOM—!!

Heatran flew backward, embedding into the solid wall of the temple.

"How-how is this possible..." Marcus stared in disbelief, his face filled with inability to accept what he was seeing.

Heatran was a powerful magical beast he had captured from a volcano!

In the entire Michina, there wasn't a single magical beast that could match it, yet it didn't even have a chance to fight back against this bear and dog combination?

"Garruu!"

"Lucari!"

Urshifu lowered its fists, and Lucario's bone staff dissolved into dust. The two exchanged a glance and bumped fists.

A draw.

"You-you who exactly are—"

Before Marcus could finish, Johan said: "Gengar, let him have a long, deep 'dream.'"

"Ka-kaah~"

THUD—

Marcus fell stiffly to the ground, his body twitching slightly, foam coming from his mouth.

At the same time, Johan took the staff from Gengar's hand, lightly turned the mechanism, revealing the orb at the top of the staff emitting a strange light—the Jewel of Life!

The treasure formed by combining the Ground, Water, Grass, Electric, and Dragon-type plates.

"Yoji..."

Larvitar looked at the jewel, swallowing.

Why did it have a feeling... that eating this jewel would make it invincible?

"Is this the item?" Cynthia asked softly.

"Yes," Johan nodded, then took a deep breath, "Whether it works or not... depends on this time."

"Thank you both."

Damos looked at the brilliant "Jewel of Life," expressing sincere gratitude to Johan and Cynthia.

"Mr. Damos, I believe you understand the consequences of not returning the jewel," Johan said, slowly looking up as night fell and the bright moon was gradually being swallowed by shadows.

The lunar eclipse had begun!

Damos tightened his grip on the staff, saying gravely:

"Arceus is our benefactor. We cannot repay kindness with betrayal for the sake of some so-called 'risks'!"

"Vii~"

Victini, sitting on Johan's shoulder, nodded.

The little one could feel the sincerity from Damos.

"Ka-kaah!"

Suddenly.

Gengar pointed to the night sky.

And there.

After the moon was completely covered by shadow, a beautiful light appeared in the dark sky, followed by a sacred, pure four-legged deity radiating a gentle glow, descending through the air.

The sacred light made everyone feel a warmth flowing through their hearts, bringing a sense of sublime tranquility.

"Is this the legendary Original One, Arceus?" Cynthia gazed at the white figure, feeling an inexplicable stirring in her heart, as if... she had some connection with such a being.

"Arceus!" Damos's face lit up with joy as he raised the staff, revealing the "Jewel of Life." "This is our promise!"

[Damos]

Arceus's voice was neither male nor female, but sounded extremely gentle and magnetic, inspiring no hostility.

Seeing the "Jewel of Life" that Damos brought out, Arceus's expression became even gentler, but when its peripheral vision caught Johan and Cynthia behind the platform...

Woosh—

Whether it was an illusion or not.

Johan felt as if Arceus's body momentarily showed afterimages, flashing and quickly recovering, but Arceus's previously gentle tone and expression changed, becoming serious.

[You should not be here, humans!]

The voice resonated in Johan and Cynthia's minds, though Damos didn't seem to hear it.

As a light flickered in Arceus's eyes, it seemed to "see" everything, understanding the process and reasons.

Since Arceus had raised this point, Johan knew he couldn't just stand by and watch Damos return the "Jewel of Life" for a happy ending.

He stepped forward, releasing his aura to convey goodwill, saying:

"We came for you, Arceus."

[You think changing history will end everything?]

Arceus slowly descended, its four feet lightly touching down on the platform, even ignoring Damos who stood beside it with the "Jewel of Life," looking somewhat confused.

Hearing this, Johan's expression shifted slightly.

From Arceus's words, it seemed to already know what would happen in the future?

If it could foresee the future, then why...

Arceus seemed to read his thoughts and spoke again.

[You have disturbed the river of time, so of course I can know.]

This explanation made sense to Johan.

Their arrival had changed history to some extent, and they had used the power of the Time God Dialga, but where did Dialga's power come from?

Arceus.

If the time river hadn't been disturbed, could Arceus not foresee the distant future?

Wait a minute—Ash could come and it's fine, but when we come it's not? Is this targeted discrimination?

Setting aside his jumbled thoughts, Johan looked directly at Arceus and said:

"Arceus, we just want to resolve your misunderstanding about humans."

[Misunderstanding?]

Arceus even laughed contemptuously.

Woosh—

A "screen" that only Johan, Cynthia, and their Pokémon could see appeared before them.

What it showed was... the Michina where Johan and the others had originally been!

Lucian, Flint, and Aaron, at Johan's instruction, were searching for the lost "Jewel of Life" in the Michina ruins, part of Plan B.

Meanwhile, Dialga and Palkia, having eaten and drunk their fill, were lying on the ground nearby for a short rest.

As the "camera" focused on them, they seemed to sense something, opening their eyes and raising their heads in confusion.

What was wrong with this scene?

Johan frowned slightly.

But the next second.

The image on the screen changed.

In the sky far outside Michina, a flying battleship was approaching at high speed. From the insignia on the ship, it was clear they were—

"Team Galactic!" Cynthia's voice was grave.

The camera zoomed in, showing a scene inside the battleship: sitting in the command chair was the Team Galactic leader—

"Cyrus?!"

Cynthia's eyes widened.

She was no stranger to Cyrus, a famous businessman in the Sinnoh region who had invested in many Sinnoh industries with his vast wealth, considered part of Sinnoh's upper class.

Many League higher-ups had good relationships with him, such as Cynthia's grandmother, Professor Carolina, whose research institute had received funding from Cyrus.

Cyrus was the leader of Team Galactic?

For Cynthia, this was a completely unexpected revelation.

But Johan's focus was more on the two items in glass cases on either side of Cyrus: two brilliant spheres.

"The Lustrous Orb and Adamant Orb!"

With his prompt, Cynthia also noticed the two orbs.

But weren't these orbs supposed to be one with the Celestic Historical Research Center—her grandmother's place—and the other in the Eterna Historical Museum?

Just before she and Johan traveled to the past, she had sought her grandmother Professor Carolina's help to borrow the two orbs. How could they be in Team Galactic's hands?

In the image.

Team Galactic researcher Charon wore a sinister smile, manipulating a screen while saying:

"Leader, we've detected the source of time and space."

The usually impassive Cyrus showed unprecedented fervor on his face, along with boundless desire for Dialga and Palkia.

He slowly stood up, his gaze seemingly penetrating the vast distance to land on Dialga and Palkia, his fist gradually clenching.

The human heart is imperfect; only by destroying the current world can a new, perfect world be created!

The screen image disappeared.

Arceus's gaze fell on Johan again. It didn't speak, yet seemed to say so much.

That look seemed to ask: Is this what you call a misunderstanding about humans?

Cynthia bit her lip. She stepped forward to say something but was stopped by Johan's outstretched hand.

Johan stared at Arceus, "As the Original One, is your understanding of humans so one-sided?"

[Hmm?]

Arceus's voice deepened, seemingly detecting a questioning tone in Johan's voice.

But Arceus soon laughed again.

[You seem very eager to prove something?]

"Emotion," Johan said gravely.

At the same time, Gengar floated out from his shadow, landing in front of him, wearing sunglasses with hands on its hips, facing Arceus directly.

Johan continued, unaffected by its presence:

"Which you bestowed upon humans and Pokémon."

Then more Poké Balls opened.

Ninetales, Tinkaton, Dragonite, Urshifu, Ceruledge, and Larvitar all appeared before him, looking up at Arceus.

"But you."

Victini, Rotom, and a grim-faced Darkrai all appeared before him.

They formed a row, seemingly wanting to become a wall between Johan and Arceus.

"Know nothing about this emotion."

[Know nothing?]

Arceus laughed in anger, its gaze sweeping over the Pokémon in front of Johan, a pressure emanating from its status as the Original One.

Emotion was just an insignificant part of its long existence...

As the Original One, when did even ordinary Pokémon dare to face it directly?

Even Dialga and Palkia wouldn't dare!

Except for that rebellious dragon...

Right, this human did have Giratina's aura about him.

On the other side.

The Poké Balls at Cynthia's waist also all opened, and her Pokémon—Garchomp, Lucario, and other companions—all stood in front of her.

They sensed the threat from Arceus and felt its strong pressure, but...

"Ka-kaah!!"

Gengar had one hand on its hip, the other pointing at Arceus.

Are you thinking of hurting Johan? You'll have to get through us first!

The little ones were all united in hostility, even the unevolved Larvitar, baring its teeth and waving its claws, showing no fear of the Original One.

At this moment.

Arceus was momentarily stunned.

It seemed to feel the pure bond between these humans and their Pokémon.

A bond as bright as the sun in the night.

Not just the Pokémon that Johan had captured.

Even Victini and Darkrai, two mythical Pokémon with decent power, shared a similar strong bond with him.

The girl on the other side and her Pokémon were equally impressive.

Woosh—

Suddenly.

Brilliant light of Mega Evolution burst forth from Gengar and Garchomp, materializing the power of their bonds.

"You ask what I want to prove?" Johan said.

His clothes billowed though there was no wind, his gaze serious and determined.

He didn't deny that in the Pokémon world, he had seen many dark, infuriating, and even disturbing villains, but...

To define all humans and Pokémon in the Pokémon world, to measure human and Pokémon emotions based on just a few people, was too one-sided.

The righteous Lance, the wealthy but gentle Steven, the beautiful and kind Cynthia, the chuunibyou but passionate Flint, the complaining but diligent Lucian...

They and their Pokémon shouldn't be defined by a minority.

Johan and his Pokémon certainly shouldn't be represented by these people!

"Arceus!" Johan stared at Arceus without backing down.

"Let's battle!"

Darkrai: "OOOOOOOOOHHHHHHHHH!!!!!"

"Gengar, Mega Evolve!"

"Garchomp, Mega Evolve!"

"Ka-kaah!!"

Brilliant light fully bloomed on Gengar, black mist surging forth, instantly enveloping it before receding in a flash, becoming internalized.

"ROAR!!"

Garchomp spread its arms and roared to the sky, its eyes blood-red and aura gushing forth, the power of Mega Evolution becoming its best fuel at this moment.

This contradicted Johan's plan and was completely unexpected, but...

There were some things he had to do, had to prove. Otherwise, what did his time with his Pokémon mean?

This was for everyone, and even more for their little one!

Arceus watched the scene before it, waves rippling in its eyes, its heart involuntarily stirring with surging emotion.

This was the first time a human had, in such a forthright manner, led his Pokémon to challenge it.

It was in this moment that Arceus suddenly felt that it too was a Pokémon—just a special kind of Pokémon.

Arceus didn't move, nor did Johan, Cynthia, and their teams rush to attack.

Their opponent was Arceus, after all. In a real battle...

Arceus slowly closed its eyes, and when the anger and disappointment in its heart slightly receded, its "vision" seemed to broaden somewhat.

[Human, I must admit, your bond shines like a rainbow.]

After a pause, it continued:

[If you truly have the determination, you shouldn't try to prove anything to me in this way, but rather... to the "me" of the future.]

To put it simply...

Why not just confront the "me" of your time directly?

Why come back to the past and stir up temporal chaos?

Johan: "..."

Wasn't this trying to make things as simple as possible while minimizing risk?

[Go back and prove it to the one who needs proof.]

Arceus's voice seemed to be receding into the distance, and the vision of Johan, Cynthia, and their Pokémon seemed to be blurring.

Hmm?

Johan felt disoriented.

Why did it feel like this Arceus was not the same as the one that had awakened?

After a brief daze.

"Teacher Johan? Boss?"

Flint looked at the two who had suddenly appeared, showing some surprise.

"Is it over?" Lucian couldn't help but ask.

"No."

Johan and Cynthia exchanged a glance, then began unbuttoning their shirts, looking at the gradually setting sun, and said softly:

"Just came to let you know."

"It's raid time."

----------

# 617: Calling in Help Like Crazy! (2-in-one Chapter)

Sinnoh region, Michina.

"So there's a ruin here too. During our vacation, we might find some treasures in these ruins!"

Jessie's eyes sparkled at the thought of ancient treasures and jewelry.

"If we find treasures to give to Teacher Johan, maybe he'll 'speak up for us,' meow!"

Meowth gritted his teeth at the thought of that Pichu, but that Pichu had Matori behind it, and he couldn't mess with that...

Hearing this, Jessie naturally thought of the "haughty" Matori. If she could please Teacher Johan, perhaps he would help her kick that melon-headed glasses girl's butt!

Nearby, James opened his mouth to say something, but seeing the "evil" smiles on Meowth and Jessie's faces, he wisely shrank his neck and stayed silent.

However, on second thought, he might also find some ancient vessel lids in the ruins, or even bottle caps, which wouldn't be a bad thing.

"Alright! The treasure hunting mission officially begins!" Jessie declared forcefully.

"Wobbuffet~! ∠(°ゝ°)"

Johan and Cynthia's sudden return surprised Lucian, Flint, and the others.

Had the situation been resolved?

However, the feedback they received was... it's time for a raid.

What raid?

As they wondered...

Woosh—

A large shadow suddenly appeared on the sun high in the sky, gradually devouring it like it would swallow the entire sun.

Solar eclipse!

The mountains gradually darkened, and the sky slowly lost its color. Johan and Cynthia exchanged glances, both showing serious expressions.

It's here!

"RAWR?"

"ROAR?"

Dialga and Palkia, who had been resting on the ground after eating their fill, had much stronger reactions than Johan and the others. They hastily stood up, looking toward the sky, and couldn't help but swallow.

[It's coming?]

The awakening process was much faster than they had anticipated.

At this moment.

A strange rift appeared at the edge of the eclipse-darkened sky, and a radiance representing holiness and divinity emerged from the rift.

Arceus awakened from its slumber, and as soon as it regained consciousness, it arrived at this place that felt familiar—a place that filled its heart with anger and disappointment.

[Michina, Damos]

For Arceus, the disappointment and sadness in its heart actually far exceeded its anger.

It had once trusted a human so much, only to be betrayed. As the creator of everything, it believed humans must be punished to understand how terribly wrong they were.

As they say, the deeper the love, the harsher the discipline. If it hadn't paid so much attention to humans, if it hadn't placed so much hope and care in them, how could it feel such profound disappointment?

[Humans, accept your judgment!]

Arceus's gaze suddenly turned cold, truly becoming a deity without emotion in this moment, to deliver so-called divine punishment and judgment.

Woosh—

The "Thousand Arms" on its back, shaped like a diagonal cross, glowed brilliantly, gathering dazzling white beams of light.

This was the power Arceus wielded—divine judgment, filled with destructive power beyond the reach of ordinary people and Pokémon.

[Judgment!!]

BOOM—

The falling light beams were like meteorites, like falling stars, scattered across Michina's land—soil made fertile by Arceus's power!

For this fertile land, it had suffered unprecedented betrayal and "seen" the ugly side of humanity.

Such a disturbance naturally caught the attention of not only Johan's group who witnessed Arceus's descent, but also the residents of Michina, including Damos's descendant—Sheena!

"How could it awaken at this time?"

Sheena looked at Arceus, her face filled with shock.

This differed from what she had expected and from the warnings of the time-space apparatus beneath the temple. It was much earlier.

But regardless...

Sheena took out the "Jewel of Life" that had been preserved by her family for generations and ran out of the temple.

"Arceus! Please stop!" she called.

Seeing Sheena, hearing her voice, and noticing what she held in her hand, Arceus's expression momentarily faltered.

[Damos]

But it quickly realized this wasn't Damos.

"Arceus, I know my ancestor disappointed you, but please give us another chance. This 'Jewel of Life'..."

[Jewel of Life?]

Arceus's voice turned cold again as it stared at Sheena, the anger suppressed in its heart rising once more.

[Human, what gives you the confidence to try to deceive me again and again!]

"Deceive?"

Sheena was stunned, then her expression changed drastically as she looked at the "Jewel of Life" in her hand. Could it be...

Crack—

The "Jewel of Life" in her hand developed a crack, then shattered into crystalline fragments.

A fake!

Sheena's face immediately paled, her mouth open, not knowing how to explain.

[Foolish humans!]

Arceus roared, the Thousand Arms on its back once again glowing with brilliant light, gathering white beams for another Judgment attack.

But at this moment.

"RAWR—!!"

A fierce roar transformed into a wave of azure time energy, charging toward Arceus's position.

Hmm?

Feeling this familiar power, Arceus's expression shifted slightly. As it dodged Dialga's Roar of Time, it looked up to see Dialga approaching through the air!

Simultaneously.

"ROAR!!!"

The silver-white Palkia swung its arms, creating spatial barriers where Judgment was about to fall, blocking the descent of the attack!

BOOM BOOM BOOM—

[It's you]

Arceus's expression faltered slightly, then it roared.

[You also wish to stand with the humans?!]

Seeing Arceus's angry appearance, Dialga and Palkia instinctively shrank their necks, exchanging glances.

Palkia: [Don't think we can win...]

Dialga: [Be more confident, remove the 'think.']

Palkia: [So we still fight?]

Dialga: [What's to fear! Worst case, we surrender later. At most we'll be sealed for a few hundred or thousand years!]

Like Giratina was.

At this moment.

A black shadow darted past them, and Darkrai, with a stern expression, gave the two a "disdainful" glance.

"Keep talking and there won't be any food for you!"

Hearing this, Dialga's expression immediately became solemn, and Palkia's gaze grew determined.

Humans should not perish like this!

[It seems you don't understand what you're doing!]

Facing Dialga, Palkia, and Darkrai, Arceus didn't show any decline in momentum. Instead, its already terrifying aura grew even stronger.

As the Original One, the lineup before it posed no significant threat.

"It's you who doesn't understand what you're doing, Arceus!"

At this moment.

A voice came from below.

"You've been blinded by anger and hatred, thinking what you see is the whole truth, not knowing that humans are the beings least representable by a single individual!"

Arceus looked down.

Dialga, Palkia, and Darkrai slightly moved aside, revealing the black-haired young man wearing a white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a monocle, standing on the Michina ruins platform.

The young man's expression was calm, his eyes stern, as he stood on the platform of the Michina ruins.

Behind him was a sneering Gengar wearing sunglasses, a golden-haired beauty in a black coat, a youth in a burgundy suit adjusting his glasses, a chuunibyou-like boy with exploding hair and hands in his pockets, and a bewildered young man with a cowlick...

Though their posture looked cool and imposing, Lucian couldn't help but quietly say:

"Is this really Arceus? Are we really going to battle such a being?"

Flint twisted his lips, "What's the big deal with Arceus? Teacher Johan already said, just think of it as a llama. Let's take it down together!"

Aaron: "Oh~~ Arceus..."

Johan gave a slight smile.

"It's fine, Flint, you go first to test its strength."

Flint's expression froze as he looked at the destruction caused by Judgment, and couldn't help but swallow.

They're really sending him first?

Meanwhile.

Team Rocket, who had nearly been blown away by Arceus's Judgment, was about to flee when they saw Johan and the others standing on the ruins platform.

"Wow, it's Teacher Johan, so cool!" James exclaimed.

"Where, where, where?" Jessie quickly looked around.

"Teacher Johan is here, so everything will be fine. Let's hurry and bring him the treasures we found, meow~"

"Wobbuffet~! ∠(°ゝ°)"

In the sky, when Arceus saw Johan, a light flashed in its eyes, as if it "remembered" something.

[If you want to prove something, they alone are not enough!]

Arceus's voice resonated in everyone's minds.

"How about adding this one?" Johan gave Gengar a look.

"Ka-kaah~~"

Gengar stuck out its tongue, winking provocatively at Arceus, then made a slash in the air behind it.

A pitch-black rift appeared out of nowhere.

The next second.

A pair of hellish wings emerged from the rift, and Giratina's massive body moved out, roaring excitedly at Arceus in the sky.

Finally waited for you!!

The Renegade Pokémon, Giratina!

Johan seemed to hear this BGM in his ears: "Waited so long, finally waited for today..."

The rebellious dragon had appeared again!

Gone was its previous laid-back tea-drinking demeanor, now its heart was filled with excitement.

Johan hadn't lied to it!

Since Giratina first met Johan, he had been telling it "there will be a chance," and the patiently waiting Giratina hadn't expected... that this opportunity would really come!

The slave will rise up and sing, today! Right now!

"ROAR—!!"

Giratina roared, moving its body without hesitation, heading straight for Arceus.

Having Dialga and Palkia lead the charge? Those two were too cautious with too many concerns. Darkrai had no concerns but its strength was slightly lacking. But with Giratina acting as the main tank, wasn't that perfect?

Like in a raid, if no one actively takes the front line as the tank, doesn't... the slowest runner become the tank?

Let's go!!

Seeing Giratina, Arceus's expression immediately became more serious.

[You've earned the approval of these beings?]

Giratina, Dialga, Palkia, Darkrai...

[This is getting a bit interesting.]

But Arceus was, after all, the Original One. Strictly speaking, all these beings were its creations!

How could a creator fear what it had created?

Woosh—

The golden Thousand Arms glowed brilliantly again, extending countless meteor-like beams of light, shooting like raindrops toward the three dragons.

Giratina roared again, black mist surging from its body, seemingly expanding its already formidable wings to envelop those beams of light.

Dialga followed with a great roar, azure time beams shooting toward Arceus.

Roar of Time!

Palkia's red pearl on its shoulder flashed, as it swung out two dazzling blades of light, slashing toward Arceus.

Spacial Rend!

"I don't fear anything! After today, Johan better bring a truck to my place! OOOHHH—!!"

Darkrai shouted while forming a massive black hole, also trying to envelop Arceus.

"Vii~(≧≦)v"

Victini made a victory sign, showing its adorable fangs, covering the entire area with its "Victory Star" power.

BOOM!!

An incredibly terrifying noise seemed about to explode at this moment.

"Gengar, Shadow Ball!"

"Garchomp, Draco Meteor!"

"Bronzong, Psychic!"

"Infernape, Blast Burn!"

"Yanmega, Bug Buzz!"

Johan and the others, along with their Pokémon, also unleashed their moves.

Although their attacks might not seem to cause significant damage compared to those above, but...

This conflict was between humans and Arceus. To just stand and watch clearly wasn't the way Johan's group operated.

Of course, as for the result—

BOOM!!

As the massive rumble dissipated and the terrifying shockwaves scattered, Arceus remained undamaged, hovering in mid-air. A barrier had appeared around it, almost blocking all attacks.

This was an almost cheat-like "Protect."

Dialga and Palkia exchanged helpless glances.

There it is again...

Nothing they could do. Arceus possessed plates, which meant the plates could block all power impacts.

At this point, Johan also remembered...

He found it puzzling that Arceus, as the mighty Original One, would lose immunity to attacks of certain types after losing the plates. That was genuinely confusing.

Was it the Original One Arceus with eighteen plates that ruled, or eighteen plates carrying an Arceus that dominated?

You're the Original One, not the Plate One!

But at this moment, there seemed to be only one method to try.

"Attack it with Ground, Water, Grass, Electric, and Dragon-type moves!"

If history hadn't been changed, then Arceus's plates wouldn't have been fully restored.

Hearing this, Arceus's expression slightly changed. After giving Johan a deep look, it didn't show much panic.

At the same time, Giratina, Dialga, Palkia, and Darkrai launched another attack.

They might not be able to do much else, but weren't Roar of Time and Spacial Rend Dragon-type moves?

"The powers of time and space aren't needed, as they originate from Arceus itself."

However, just as they were about to launch another full-scale attack, Johan used his aura power to speak in their minds:

"Don't just attack all at once. Learn to attack in phases and with rhythm. Listen to my commands!"

Dialga and Palkia exchanged glances again.

Listen to his commands?

[Listen to him!]

Giratina spoke gravely, while its form flashed, a terrifying dragon aura manifesting outside its body, dragging its formidable wings as it charged directly at Arceus.

Dragon Rush!

Arceus's eyes gleamed, and the jewel on its cross-shaped Thousand Arms flashed to a light blue color.

Ice-type!

Even without the Dragon plate to be immune to Dragon-type moves, Ice-type could counter Dragon-type attacks.

Seeing this, Johan adjusted his monocle.

So... Arceus doesn't have a Fairy plate, right?

That... makes things much easier.

Arceus seemed to notice the smile on Johan's face from the corner of its eye.

Smiling?

The next second.

Palkia crossed through folded space, appearing behind Arceus, launching a huge blue aura bomb like an energy wave.

In front of Dialga, a membrane of time appeared, and a silvery Hyper Beam shot from its mouth, manipulated by temporal power to ensure it would hit simultaneously with Palkia and Giratina's attacks.

Fighting? Steel?

These were extremely effective against an Ice-type Arceus.

The smile on Johan's face grew wider.

If you use a barrier to block, you won't stop Giratina's charge. If you don't use a barrier, you'll take Dialga and Palkia's attacks head-on.

There's something for everyone, Arceus!

Arceus felt quite speechless. It feared not the reckless thug, but the educated thug with strategy!

BOOM—!!!

Another rumble, less dramatic than before but causing real damage to Arceus.

[Cunning human!]

Arceus's golden pupils flashed.

"Cunning?" Johan's smile remained.

The real "cunning" was just beginning.

Woosh—

Just when Arceus thought the attack was over, Darkrai appeared behind it, its massive Dark Void enveloping Arceus.

"Hmph!" Darkrai snorted coldly, "Even if you are Arceus..."

I'll still grab you!

"ROAR—!!!"

Giratina roared excitedly.

[Great! Great!!! (voice cracking)]

Although it was under the most pressure, as long as it could pummel Arceus, that was enough.

Whoosh—

As the smoke cleared.

A cold snort filled with authority exploded in everyone's hearts.

[Hmph!]

Arceus reappeared in everyone's sight.

Johan looked at Darkrai.

Even with Victini's Victory Star boosting your Dark Void, you couldn't put it to sleep? Has your accuracy been nerfed too?

Darkrai shot back an irritated look—only you would dare to think of putting Arceus to sleep!

[Even with coordination, you alone are far from enough!]

Arceus somewhat arrogantly swept its gaze over the three dragons, Darkrai, and Johan's group.

With such a lineup, even without plates, it still had absolute confidence.

"Then let's add more!" Johan shouted without backing down as soon as Arceus finished:

"Palkia!"

Woosh—

Kanto, Viridian City, Team Rocket Headquarters.

Mewtwo looked at the cloned Charmander, Squirtle, and Bulbasaur before it, its expression gentle.

"Charmander Two, Squirtle Two, Bulbasaur Two..."

These were among the few companions in its memory.

"Just missing Ai Two," Mewtwo took a deep breath and said gravely.

What it wanted to do was restore all its former companions, and for this, it was willing to pay a price.

"Char~"

"Squirtle~"

"Bulba~~"

The three little ones approached Mewtwo, bringing a slight smile to its face.

Suddenly.

Mewtwo's expression paused. It crouched down, patting the three little ones' heads, saying softly:

"Wait for me here. Someone very important to me needs my help."

Hearing this, the three little ones immediately let go of Mewtwo, giving encouraging, supportive looks.

Feeling their encouragement and recalling what that person had said to it, Mewtwo felt an indescribable power surging from its heart.

Woosh—

A rift appeared beside it, and Mewtwo held its head high, striding into it.

The laboratory staff immediately reported this to Boss Giovanni, receiving the response...

Mewtwo has its own choices, don't interfere too much.

Unova region, on the roof of N's Castle, former Team Plasma headquarters.

N, wearing a cap, sat on the railing of the roof, feeling the warm breeze and looking at the scene before him with a satisfied smile.

Outside what was once N's Castle was a wasteland, almost a desert, but now...

Patches of green had been added, with many former Team Plasma followers busy changing the environment.

And the environmental change had brought... a place where wild Pokémon, released Pokémon, and abandoned Pokémon could live.

Beside N, a massive black dragon suddenly raised its head. Above, what seemed like a black cloud appeared, with lightning plasma faintly visible within.

"What's wrong, Zekrom?" N keenly sensed Zekrom's change.

Zekrom lowered its head.

[He needs me.]

N was momentarily stunned, then reacted with some delight: "Teacher?"

Zekrom nodded.

"Then go quickly," N stood up, stretching a bit. "I'm rested enough and should join the work too."

With that, N leaped off the railing. A bird Pokémon flew up from below, catching him and carrying him down to the busy crowd.

After giving N one last look, Zekrom turned and walked into a spatial rift that had appeared nearby.

Unova region, Eindoak Town.

The white dragon Reshiram, lying atop the Sword of the Vale, yawned out of boredom, looking at the respectful People of the Vale before it, not knowing what to say.

It felt this boring life was worse than returning to slumber inside the "Light Stone."

"Lord Reshiram, we're planning to build a statue of Teacher Johan in town. Do you think your image should be—"

The mayor of Eindoak Town cautiously asked.

Should it be a statue of Teacher Johan riding Reshiram, or Reshiram standing beside Teacher Johan...

Suddenly.

Reshiram's expression straightened as it stood up, flapping its snow-white wings.

It gave a sideways glance at the mayor and the People of the Vale.

It really wanted to ask, does it have to be ridden?

Couldn't they...

Reshiram didn't speak, but to everyone's astonishment, it turned and walked into a spatial rift that had appeared.

[Truth, I feel an incredibly strong truth!]

On the vast ocean, a mysterious island shrouded in mist.

"Bwooo—"

The small Lugia flapped its wings, skimming over the sea surface near the island, stirring up layers of water spray, having a wonderful time.

Suddenly.

It stopped, looking toward its mother resting on the shore.

The former blackness on its mother had completely faded, restored to a snow-white crystalline appearance.

And now, Lugia had raised its head, looking into the distance, its gaze seemingly crossing vast distances to land somewhere.

"Bwooo?"

Baby Lugia quickly flew to its mother's side, only to be held back by its wing.

Lugia smiled slightly at Baby Lugia.

[You're still young. Wait until you grow up before going.]

"Bwooo..." Baby Lugia drooped its head.

At this moment, it truly longed to grow up.

Lugia gently embraced the little one, soothing its emotions.

[Wait for me here, don't wander off.]

With that, Lugia spread its wings, becoming a streak of light, seemingly carrying countless streams of water as it entered the rift.

"Bwooo!"

Watching its mother disappear, Baby Lugia's expression became exceptionally serious as it let out a long cry toward the island.

It must work hard to grow stronger!

On this day, the wild Pokémon on the mysterious Lugia Island all seemed to have a nightmare.

Sinnoh region, Michina.

Under Arceus's puzzled gaze, Palkia opened several spatial rifts leading to unknown destinations.

To be honest, even Palkia wasn't completely sure. It was just following Johan's instructions to open these rifts.

But the next second.

Palkia's mouth slowly opened wide, and nearby, Dialga couldn't help but swallow. Only Giratina's expression grew more excited and increasingly uncontainable.

[Is this what Johan promised?]

Truly a man of his word!

He said he'd gather help to deal with Arceus, and indeed, he brought in a large group!

Giratina glared fiercely at Arceus.

Today! Right now!

After a brief confusion, Arceus also showed some astonishment.

Whoosh—

Mewtwo appeared first, its psychic power immediately sweeping across the field. After exchanging a glance with Johan and giving a slight nod, it fixed its piercing gaze on Arceus.

The Original One?

It wanted to know what difference there was between Pokémon created by humans and those created by the Original One.

It wanted to know even more if the Original One... could help resurrect Ai Two!

Most importantly...

Even if you are the Original One, you can't just bully Johan!

Woosh—

The Dragon of Ideals, Zekrom, and the Dragon of Truth, Reshiram, simultaneously flew out from two spatial rifts on either side of Johan, hovering to his left and right.

Facing Arceus and striving for humanity's future—this ideal has been received!

Zekrom seemed to feel limitless power surging in its heart.

The stronger the ideal, the stronger the Dragon of Ideals!

Fearlessly facing the Original One without the slightest hesitation, recognizing reality is recognizing truth—this truth presented with courage, I have also felt!

The stronger the truth, the stronger the Dragon of Truth!

"Bwooo—"

The bright white Lugia appeared last. It gave Johan a deep look, sending grateful thoughts.

The debt for saving its child, the debt of help—this kindness is beyond repayment. Even if the opponent is Arceus, I will give my all!

In the sky, it seemed rain and wind were about to fall.

"This-this..." Flint's mouth hung open, unable to believe what he was seeing.

"Zekrom, Reshiram, Lugia, and other legendary Pokémon I don't recognize but that are no less imposing, plus the ones from before..."

Lucian was equally shocked.

He thought Teacher Johan was already impressive, but he turned out to be even more so!

Calling in so many legendary Pokémon!

"And you said you weren't a legendary magnet!"

No wonder he dared to face the Original One.

Now, things are really getting interesting...

Lucian pushed his glasses, excitement rising uncontrollably in his eyes.

"Phew—"

Johan let out a light sigh.

Although he had called in so many beings at once, the pressure was truly immense.

If just a few of them didn't respect him, the commotion they could cause would be more than enough to devastate the entire Sinnoh region.

Suddenly.

He felt his palm warm slightly as a slender but firm hand slipped into his. Looking over, he saw Cynthia's encouraging and supportive smile.

Johan's heart steadied.

Damn it! At worst... they could destroy Sinnoh, and he could trick Cynthia into coming home with him!

"Arceus!" Johan stepped forward and shouted.

Arceus's eye twitched.

It really wanted to say, are you really just an ordinary person?

Could an ordinary person call in so many legendary Pokémon?

Even Arceus felt the pressure.

However, it still remained calm.

Its gaze passed over the many legendary and mythical Pokémon, past Johan and his group, looking into the distance.

[You say what I've seen doesn't represent all of humanity. But no matter how hard you try, there will always be 'betrayers' among humans.]

In the distance, a Team Galactic aircraft was approaching.

The aura of the Adamant Orb and Lustrous Orb on board made Dialga and Palkia's expressions change.

If someone were to use the power of these two orbs...

They both swallowed.

Would they have to fight against one, two, three... legendary Pokémon?

Then...

Palkia: [We'd be beaten to death, right?]

Dialga: [Be more confident, remove the 'right.']

Palkia: [...]

Even if they were "turned," Arceus's side would still be outnumbered...

"Team Galactic," Cynthia said gravely.

Although the aircraft was just a small black dot, she and Johan had "seen" it in the ancient past, and this was her greatest concern so far.

Johan patted the back of her hand, indicating she shouldn't worry.

Looking at Arceus, Johan nodded and said:

"Indeed. So... human issues, human shortcomings, why not let humans solve them themselves?"

The next second.

Beneath Team Galactic's rapidly approaching aircraft, at the last rift Palkia had left, two enormous arms suddenly stretched out, striking the Team Galactic aircraft.

Hmm?

Everyone was startled, except for Johan who smiled.

"REGI—"

A honest but firm voice came from the rift.

"GIGAS!!"

BOOM!

Under the incredibly terrifying force, Team Galactic's aircraft was swatted like a fly...

Then, an ancient giant wobbled out of the final rift—none other than the King of the Regis, Regigigas!!!

Palkia looked enlightened; no wonder Johan had asked it to open five rifts earlier.

This was his plan.

Regigigas, the King of the Regis, whose "Slow Start"... had been slow for quite a while.

Seeing Regigigas appear, Arceus's expression changed once more.

[Even the King of the Regis...]

Johan looked at Arceus again, smiling:

"You see, humans can actually solve problems quite simply."

Arceus's expression froze as its gaze swept over:

Giratina, Dialga, Palkia, Darkrai, Mewtwo, Zekrom, Reshiram, Lugia, Regigigas, plus... Victini whose Victory Star buff had been maximized.

Even for Arceus, facing such a lineup made it sweat a little.

"Arceus, why not do me a favor and let's talk?"

# 618: Johan: I Almost Threw a Ball at Arceus! (2-in-one Chapter)

Talk?

A hot wind swept through this gunpowder-scented yet strangely calm place.

Arceus hovered in the air, the anger and disappointment in its eyes gradually subsiding as it observed the seemingly small human before it.

It must be said.

Even as Arceus, facing such a lineup made its head spin a little.

Giratina was understandable—that one always had a rebellious nature and wouldn't miss a chance to confront Arceus.

Dialga and Palkia were also explainable. Arceus's awakening, especially one wrapped in anger and dissatisfaction, had caused Dialga's time domain and Palkia's space domain to continually collide. They had fought fiercely over this, and to solve this problem, they needed to address the source.

But what about Darkrai? What about Victini?

Two mythical Pokémon that weren't unique.

Darkrai had even displayed strength that rivaled either Dialga or Palkia.

And Victini, while seemingly the least noticeable presence, provided enhancements to all the legendary and mythical Pokémon that exceeded the value of adding another legendary Pokémon to the battle.

From these two mythical Pokémon, Arceus sensed their bond with this human before it.

Is this... what you wanted to prove, the emotion between humans and Pokémon, the bond between humans and Pokémon?

Arceus's mind flashed back to what Johan had said when confronting "it" in ancient times.

As for those who appeared later...

Zekrom and Reshiram needed no explanation—two of the Tao trio, representing ideals and truth, with seemingly intricate connections to this human.

The same was true for Lugia—gratitude for saving its life and its child, as well as recognition for him, were all reasons for Lugia's appearance.

Even the "simple" King of the Regis, Regigigas...

However, what truly caught Arceus's attention was Mewtwo, hovering in mid-air, staring intensely at Arceus.

Arceus saw Mew's shadow in it.

It didn't remember creating such a Pokémon, but Mewtwo's aura...

More importantly, Mewtwo's relationship with that human... was even closer than Darkrai's or Victini's, and more dependent than Zekrom's or Reshiram's.

A mere human, yet able to gain the support of so many legendary and mythical Pokémon?

Even willing to face Arceus, the Original One.

While Arceus was amazed by the lineup before it, Sheena, Damos's descendant from Michina, along with Lucian, Flint, and the others, were even more astonished.

So many legendary and mythical Pokémon... such a terrifying lineup never seen before. Sheena stared with wide eyes and an open mouth, unable to make a sound.

"It feels like... if Teacher Johan wanted to destroy Sinnoh, it would just take one word," Flint whispered.

The shock hadn't yet faded from Lucian's eyes. Hearing Flint's muttering, he smiled confidently and said, "Don't worry, we have the boss."

Not that the boss could stop so many legendary Pokémon, but would Teacher Johan ever harm what the boss wanted to protect?

What is confidence?

There, that's confidence!

Arceus looked at Johan again, its gaze seeming somewhat calmer.

And Johan looked back at Arceus without backing down.

[I never expected you could summon so many legendary and mythical Pokémon.]

Johan smiled and said, "We're all friends, just looking out for each other."

The Pokémon world isn't just about fighting and killing; it's more about human relations, Arceus. You still have a long way to go.

Arceus nodded slightly, but its gaze gradually became sharp again.

[But if you think with just them... we'll see after the battle!]

Woosh—

Behind Arceus appeared circular plates of light, flowing with colorful radiance and emanating a terrifying aura.

Due to the loss of the Ground, Water, Grass, Electric, and Dragon-type plates, Arceus's power had decreased somewhat, but its confidence and ability as the Original One remained.

Just summoning a few legendary Pokémon to subdue it?

Arceus wasn't so easily intimidated!

The plates flashed and then entered Arceus's body, with the Thousand Arms bursting into light.

Judgment!!

Still want to fight?

Cynthia tightened her grip, and Johan gave her a reassuring look.

"Don't worry."

Woosh—

As Arceus expressed its battle intent, Giratina let out a long howl, being the first to charge at Arceus again.

In its lifetime... it had never fought such a favorable battle. If not now, when would it go all out?

Giratina had waited for this moment for a long time!

Dialga and Palkia followed closely.

They might have been nervous before, but seeing so many allies arrive...

What's there to fear!

Take it down!

[Hmph!]

Arceus snorted coldly.

In terms of understanding, it perhaps knew Giratina, Dialga, and Palkia better than they knew themselves.

"Reshiram, Blue Flare!"

"Zekrom, Fusion Bolt!"

Johan indicated that regardless of Giratina, Dialga, and Palkia, Zekrom and Reshiram were the main force against the current Arceus!

Take that for not having an Electric plate!

Cross-patterned flames surged from Reshiram's mouth, following the three dragons closely, while Zekrom, as its brother, had its Fusion Bolt enhanced by Reshiram, suddenly increasing in power.

Hum hum hum—

The engine in its tail spun at high speed, terrible lightning churning forth.

Without the Electric plate, the Ground plate, and without the Grass and Dragon plates that resist Electric attacks, Arceus had no choice but to endure Zekrom's Fusion Bolt!

Johan had only refrained from calling Kyurem for safety's sake. Otherwise, using [DNA Splicers] to initiate [Fusion] and have Kyurem merge with Zekrom to become Black Kyurem... it might have been able to solo the current state of Arceus!

But it must be said, Zekrom's Electric-type moves indeed posed a great threat to Arceus.

After blocking the impact from the three dragons, Arceus's barrier was shattered by Zekrom's Fusion Bolt.

Woosh—

At this moment, seizing the opportunity, Lugia suddenly appeared behind Arceus, stirring up massive lightning.

Along with it was Darkrai, concentrating a huge Dark Void.

This wave.

"This wave, I'm taking the credit!" Darkrai shouted.

BOOM—!!

With a tremendous rumble, Arceus roared.

[Presumptuous!]

Brilliant light once again erupted from Arceus's body. This time, Arceus fully activated the power of its plates, but its target wasn't focused on Darkrai or Lugia.

Not even Reshiram and Zekrom, but rather the three dragons.

You three were the loudest!

"Mewtwo, Psystrike!"

Johan watched everything on the battlefield, seizing the brief interval when Arceus was releasing its move.

If it were someone else, Mewtwo probably wouldn't even pay attention, but for Johan... Mewtwo's reaction was quick. It immediately flashed to a position above Arceus, transforming powerful psychic energy into a direct impact.

However, Arceus's reaction speed was still fast. Just as Mewtwo's attack was about to land, a barrier appeared around its body.

But the next second, the usually "calm" Arceus showed a hint of surprise.

Its barrier couldn't block Mewtwo's attack.

Mewtwo looked down at it from above, watching as Arceus fell toward the ground under its impact, and said calmly:

"I am not a Pokémon created by you."

In fact, not only was Mewtwo not created by Arceus, but even Mew, whose genes it was based on, was considered an existence that didn't rely on Arceus to be born.

"Regigigas!" Johan shouted, seizing this opportunity.

"REGI—!!"

Regigigas clenched its giant palms—these terrifying hands that once dragged continents, now reaching toward the falling Arceus like mountain ranges collapsing!

Even the Original One, Arceus, was caught in its hands.

"GIGAS!!!"

With Regigigas's roar, its two hands quickly closed together, the signal lights frantically flashing dangerous red.

It had a terrifying aura as if it would crush Arceus directly in its palms!

"GI! GAS!!"

In terms of pure strength, Regigigas was definitely the strongest among all the legendary and mythical Pokémon present. Even Arceus couldn't compare.

More importantly, the current Regigigas had ended the burden of "Slow Start," becoming a being "completely unsealed"!

However, under the gaze of everyone, as Regigigas's palms closed to their limit, a strong white light burst from within, continuously flowing out from the gaps.

Bang! Bang! Bang—

Inside Regigigas's hands, continuous rumbling exploded. No matter how Regigigas roared, its palms were ultimately forced open by this powerful impact.

Judgment!!

Countless white beams shot out. Arceus broke free from Regigigas's restraint, and the remaining impact knocked Regigigas staggering backward until it finally sat down in a mountain valley.

"REGI!"

Regigigas, looking somewhat angry, slammed the ground before preparing to stand up.

[King of the Regis]

Arceus exhaled slightly, giving Regigigas a somewhat complex look.

This was also a major threat.

Without the constraint of "Slow Start," Regigigas's fists were not something anyone could withstand.

The key point was... pure physical impact was completely unaffected by the plates' immunity and couldn't be blocked by the plates' barriers.

Arceus flew back into the air, looking around.

The legendary and mythical Pokémon surrounded it in the middle.

Johan stood on the platform of Michina, looking up at Arceus.

"Want to fight a war of attrition?"

As he spoke, Victini on his shoulder lit up the V-shaped flame on its head, making a "yeah" gesture at Arceus, then infusing energy into Regigigas, Giratina, Dialga, and Palkia.

Recharge!

Giratina: [OOOOHHH!!! Getting pumped!!]

Regigigas even stood up, beckoning to Arceus in the sky.

Come down here!

Arceus: [...]

It looked at Johan again.

To be honest.

For Arceus, the number of legendary and mythical Pokémon wasn't frightening.

What was frightening was that these legendary and mythical Pokémon were willing to follow a human's commands and could coordinate attacks seamlessly...

Plus Victini, an infinite Pokémon charger providing buffs.

Even with Arceus's confidence, it felt a headache coming on.

It couldn't possibly defeat all the legendary Pokémon like this, could it?

Leaving aside whether it could win or not...

Even if it did win, who would be responsible for certain aspects of order and authority in the Pokémon world afterward?

But what if... it eliminated this human first?

No, no, Arceus shook its head inwardly. Before factually refuting what the opponent wanted to prove, Arceus's pride wouldn't allow it to do so.

Woosh—

Sacred white light surged once more.

Judgment!

"Teacher Johan!" a familiar voice suddenly came from a corner of the Michina Temple. Looking over, they saw familiar faces.

"You?" Cynthia looked surprised.

Wasn't that... the owner and staff of the ice cream stall that made delicious ice cream?

It was none other than Team Rocket!

"Teacher Johan, we, we found something good, meow!"

Meowth presented a decayed staff like a treasure, containing a emerald-green jewel emitting radiance—the Jewel of Life!

Johan was astonished.

"You actually found this thing?"

Team Rocket had really found the lost "Jewel of Life"!

"Hehehehehe—"×3

"Wobbuffet~! ∠(°ゝ°)"

The trio exchanged glances, as if already seeing the moment they would rise to power.

"Look out!"

Cynthia suddenly exclaimed, pulling Johan behind her, then moving in front of him with Garchomp.

Apparently, as Arceus tried to break free from the legendary Pokémon's encirclement with Judgment, stray beams accidentally shot toward Johan and the others.

"Ka-kaah!"

"Oowoo!"

Gengar and Ninetales also reacted quickly, but... due to the angle, the Judgment beams were coming from the direction where Team Rocket was running.

"Wobbuffet!"

Facing the white beams, Wobbuffet looked blank, touching its head and instantly breaking into a cold sweat.

"Wobbu! Wobbuffet!!"

Woosh—

Strange light flickered on its body, and as the Judgment beam hit, the two forces actually seemed to counterbalance on Wobbuffet's body.

The next second.

To everyone's surprise, the beam was reflected back!

"Wobbu... wobbuffet..." Wobbuffet was completely dumbfounded, sweating profusely.

"It-it bounced back?" Lucian and Flint were utterly shocked.

What was up with this Wobbuffet?

It could actually reflect Arceus's Judgment?!

Although it was just one insignificant beam that had already been weakened, still...

Could these people be hidden masters?

Lucian fell into thought.

Indeed, people associated with Teacher Johan wouldn't be simple.

Flint's eyes burned with intensity.

Masters?

After this is over, perhaps he could challenge them!

Woosh—

In front of Johan, space folded.

Darkrai, Mewtwo, Zekrom, Reshiram, and Lugia suddenly appeared, looking at Arceus with increasingly hostile gazes.

"I'm fine," Johan said calmly. Even if Wobbuffet couldn't block it, there was still Gengar and Ninetales, plus Victini, as well as Cynthia and Garchomp.

However, Wobbuffet and Team Rocket had indeed played a major role.

It seemed his estimate of them being able to block three attacks was an underestimate.

Maybe he should bring them along in future major events for safety.

Afterward, he'd need to report to Boss Giovanni; if their positions didn't get promoted, at least their salaries should increase, Johan thought.

Meanwhile, Arceus felt the pressure mounting.

Though it had briefly entertained the thought of taking Johan down directly, it quickly suppressed the idea. But coincidentally, the deflected impact had headed toward Johan.

This resulted in...

From Mewtwo and Darkrai's perspective, Arceus was trying to flip the table.

Trying to kill Johan?

This was unforgivable!

Not just them—if Johan hadn't held them back, Gengar, Ninetales, and the others would have charged forward.

And the angry emotions drew forth even greater power, especially from Mewtwo, doubling Arceus's pressure.

It suddenly felt somewhat grateful.

Grateful that it hadn't truly intended to directly attack Johan, otherwise the consequences...

Arceus's body trembled slightly, feeling that this human couldn't die. No matter how great the grudge, he couldn't die, or else the world it had painstakingly created might be gone!

Moreover, it didn't actually harbor any resentment toward Johan.

Hiss—

For the first time, Arceus felt that a human could be so troublesome.

Actually, it wasn't just Arceus; Dialga, Palkia, and Giratina had also panicked just now.

Apart from Giratina, Dialga and Palkia's relationship with Johan could only be described as average.

But in that moment, they both had a strong premonition.

If Johan died, wouldn't their time domain and space domain be torn apart by these completely enraged, out-of-control legendary Pokémon?

Why did it feel like the trouble of killing Arceus would be less than the trouble if Johan died?

At this moment, Dialga, Palkia, and Arceus shared the same thought.

This human... must not come to harm!

But simultaneously.

In that instant, Arceus had also felt the strong bond between this human and these Pokémon.

Not just with the legendary and mythical ones...

This emotion...

Perhaps it truly was something it didn't understand?

While Arceus was still battling the legendary Pokémon, its voice resonated in Johan's mind.

[I'll give you one chance to prove yourself.]

A chance?

Johan was slightly taken aback.

Woosh—

Then he felt a gentle, sacred light bloom before his eyes, so bright and striking.

This white light grew increasingly bright, as if pulling him into a mysterious mental space.

Here was a circular platform, surrounded by towering ancient pillars, with hazy gray mist beyond the pillars.

Opposite him stood Arceus, standing on all fours on the ground, with golden Thousand Arms, its size reduced several times.

Hmm?

The scene before him gave Johan the feeling of... playing the final battle against Arceus in "Pokémon Legends: Arceus."

Is this...

A projection?

Four-dimensional space?

Or had Arceus's true form arrived?

[Your name, human.]

Arceus looked at Johan, speaking slowly, with no trace of anger in its voice.

"Johan," he replied, facing Arceus directly.

Arceus nodded slightly.

[Johan, you said it before, didn't you?]

"What?" Johan was puzzled again.

[Battle.]

Battle?

[Show me this so-called 'bond between humans and Pokémon,' prove to me that what you said isn't wrong.] Arceus said calmly.

Actually battle Arceus?

Could they win?

Seeming to sense Johan's doubt, Arceus spoke again.

[Don't worry, my current power shouldn't far exceed what you can handle.]

Woosh—

Gengar, Ninetales, Tinkaton, Dragonite, Urshifu, Ceruledge, Larvitar... all of Johan's Pokémon appeared in the space.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar scratched its head, looking curiously at the scene before it.

Then it quickly understood, revealing a sinister grin as it glared at Arceus.

This looks like a battle arena, right?

And the opponent is that llama?

It almost attacked Johan earlier!

"Oowoo!"

Ninetales rarely showed a serious expression, but now snow storms swirled in this space, with multiple layers of light screens descending.

Johan had nearly been attacked, and Ninetales now had zero goodwill toward Arceus.

"Cha!"

Tinkaton pointed its hammer handle at Arceus—I'll bend all those edges on its body!

"Garrr!"

Dragonite stuck out its big belly, a dark red aura rising from its feet, a fierce aura gradually emerging as it glared fiercely at Arceus.

You have a Dragon plate, right? Plus what happened earlier, we need to have a good "chat"!

Crack crack—

Urshifu didn't make a sound, but its clenched fists made "crack crack" noises, its entire body's fur taking on a floating appearance, aura surging.

"Goka!"

Ceruledge turned the dial on its armor, its left arm's blade retracting to form a golden cannon barrel. Its two eyes showed different colors—one fiery red, the other spectral blue.

Then it aimed the cannon at Arceus.

"Yoji! Yoji!"

Larvitar jumped around, baring its teeth and waving its claws. Though it seemed less threatening compared to Gengar and the others, its aura was already taking shape.

As a pseudo-legendary Pokémon's baby, it showed no fear facing Arceus, even appearing to "have its eye on your plates."

Everyone.

Faced with Arceus without cowering, instead showing high fighting spirit, seemingly with anger waiting to be vented.

Seeing this, Arceus was moved.

Is this... the bond between humans and Pokémon?

Under this bond, even ordinary Pokémon could... face legendary Pokémon, and even... defeat them!

"A battle, you say?" Johan's gaze swept over the little ones before him. He lightly adjusted his glasses, revealing a smile.

"Then let's go, Arceus!"

"Ka-kaah!!"

A one-on-one? You're taking on all of us!

Arceus took a deep breath, its momentum also beginning to rise, eyes fixed on the human and Pokémon before it.

[As you wish!]

Woosh—

The Thousand Arms once again burst into white light.

Judgment!!

It was clearly noticeable that although Arceus was still using Judgment, its power was significantly weaker than when facing Giratina and the others.

This was a test belonging solely to Johan and his Pokémon from Arceus, a "proof battle"!

"Gengar!"

Johan took out a key, his hair fluttering, voice rising high.

"Mega Evolve!!"

"Ka-kaah—!!"

The bond formed a bridge, using the Key Stone to unlock the Mega Stone on Gengar. Brilliant purifying light burst forth, transforming the intangible bond into tangible form!

At the same time.

Outside the mental space, Mewtwo, still battling Arceus, seemed to sense something. It looked back at the stationary "Johan," nodded slightly, then also erupted with Mega Evolution light.

Mega Mewtwo Y!

This power, this transformation, made the other legendary Pokémon take notice.

Giratina: Holy crap, he's using cheats!

No wonder he once claimed to be the "strongest."

Within the mental space.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

Arceus's Judgment came down like raindrops, but before the attacks could land, they were blocked by layers of light screens.

"Oowoo!!"

Ninetales's pale blue eyes were filled with seriousness.

This level of seriousness... wasn't even shown during the "Junior Masters World Championship."

But this time, it had momentarily felt Johan's life threatened, stimulating Ninetales's state.

Want to attack Johan? You'll have to get through me first!

This was Ninetales at full power!

Even Johan and Gengar rarely saw it.

"Oowoo—!!!"

Ninetales's tails fully extended, a violent snowstorm swept forth, and the terrible cold caused the temperature to plummet. As numerous light screens fell, ice walls formed simultaneously.

"Yoji!!"

Larvitar stomped the ground hard, stirring up sand. In the embrace of ice, snow, and extreme cold, each grain of sand was covered with a layer of ice crystals, becoming... hailstones!

Hail and Sandstorm!

This way, the initiative was in Ninetales's hands, with Larvitar providing support.

But for such a little one, being able to play a supporting role in such a battle... was enough!

[Hmm?]

Arceus looked surprised.

Its attacks could be blocked?

Of course not completely—after all, these were Arceus's attacks. But after being greatly weakened, the threat level to Gengar and the others was significantly reduced.

More importantly.

Arceus also felt that on the opposing side, there wasn't just the bond between humans and Pokémon, but also between Pokémon and Pokémon.

They coordinated perfectly, completely trusting each other, even more than trusting themselves.

Defense was entirely entrusted to Ninetales, completely freeing up Gengar and the others.

"Ka-kaah!"

Mega Gengar launched a Shadow Ball, the huge black sphere carrying dense malice, as if it would devour the entire mental space.

Arceus's body lit up with sacred light, using light to dispel darkness.

But just as the darkness dissipated, Dragonite flashed through the white light, appearing before Arceus, jumping from its back with a huge hammer that crashed down heavily.

At the same time.

Water flow wrapped in an unstoppable aura, the stern-faced Urshifu quickly ambushed from behind, its fist striking out.

Woosh—

Concentrated flames mixed with aura energy rolled up in a crimson tide. The armcannon fired, with Ceruledge appearing on Arceus's other side, forming a strong pincer attack with sword blade and flame.

Arceus sensed the coordination between the Pokémon and felt the bond between Johan and them.

This power...

[Not bad.]

Arceus spoke calmly.

Woosh—

A white light appeared again on Arceus's body.

BOOM!!!

Attack after attack landed, seemingly leaving wounds on Arceus, but with the baptism of that white light, all injuries were restored.

Recover!

Tap—

Its four feet lightly touched the ground, and Arceus, wrapped in white light, increased its speed to the extreme.

Extreme Speed!

Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang—

Except for Mega Gengar and Ninetales and Larvitar who remained by Johan's side, all the other little ones were sent flying!

[But if you think I only know one move, you're greatly mistaken!]

"Of course not," Johan said.

The eyes beneath his glasses gleamed.

Without using plate powers, Arceus was a Normal-type Pokémon, and weren't Normal-types just toys for Gengar?

Besides...

You're not the only one who knows Extreme Speed!

Dragonite, with a faint green glow, twisted in mid-air and suddenly appeared behind Arceus!

Outrage!

"Garrr!!"

Dragonite's sturdy arms directly grabbed both of Arceus's hind legs!

Such fast speed!

Even Arceus was surprised.

Next, thanks to Dragonite's delay, layers of frost spread from Arceus's feet upward. The extreme cold seemed able to freeze even the sacred light Arceus emitted.

Freezing even light?

Arceus's speed was slowed once more.

The next moment.

"Cha!"

Tinkaton jumped off Dragonite's back, landing on Arceus's back.

Could even Tinkaton use control-type moves?

Just as this thought crossed Arceus's mind, Tinkaton quite simply wedged its hammer into the gap of Arceus's Thousand Arms.

When Tinkaton let go, Arceus almost bent its knees and crouched down.

So heavy?!

Before Arceus could react.

"Garruu!"

"Goka!"

Urshifu and Ceruledge returned to Arceus's sides.

A fist emanating black light, seeming to carry the sound of flowing water, pressed against its abdomen on one side.

On the other side, a blue sword blade and a golden cannon barrel emitting heat pressed against its other side.

All angles, no blind spots, restricting Arceus!

Wait.

Even Arceus was a bit surprised that Johan's Pokémon all seemed somewhat abnormal.

Were these the abilities and states that normal Pokémon should possess?

[Restricting me? Is this all preparation for that Gengar?]

Arceus looked ahead, where Mega Gengar wore a sinister smile, black mist gathering in its hands one after another.

Normal-type can't damage Ghost-type, but can Ghost-type be effective against Normal-type?

No.

This seemed to be Dark Void?

[Hypnosis won't work on me.]

Arceus, seemingly out of goodwill, couldn't help but remind them.

Having temporarily restricted it due to Johan's lack of understanding of Arceus and its Pokémon, yet using a move that wouldn't affect it...

Such a waste of opportunity.

At this moment, Arceus seemed to return to that sacred and just Original One form.

"No," Johan's smile remained unchanged.

In his hand was a black orb like obsidian.

"The best way to deal with light is darkness. Release your energy, Gengar!"

Terastallization!

Using Terastallization on Mega Gengar after Mega Evolution?

Crack crack crack—

Brilliant ice crystals completely enveloped Mega Gengar, then quickly shattered and scattered, revealing to Arceus...

Terastallized Mega Gengar!

Crystalline in appearance, like the embodiment of night.

Johan's eyes sharpened as he raised his hand and commanded:

"Gengar!"

"Ka-kaah!"

The crystalline Mega Gengar flashed to Arceus's front, releasing the huge Dark Void, completely engulfing the light Arceus emitted.

Simultaneously.

Johan stepped forward, as if crossing a vast distance, arriving before Arceus.

With his right hand raised horizontally, as the Dark Void descended, he hovered it before Arceus.

Even if you're a legendary Pokémon, even if you're the Original One, you're still a Pokémon, and we are... Pokémon psychologists!

"Sleep, Arceus, have a good rest. Your anger, your disappointment, your sadness, will dissipate completely with this sleep."

"Don't let obsession guide you anymore. You are the Original One after all."

"Arceus, you need... a journey of the mind..."

For some reason.

At this moment, Arceus felt its mind was clear despite the drowsiness brought by Dark Void; its thoughts remained active.

But hearing Johan's words, feeling the gentle, benevolent aura continuously releasing from him, and the magnetic voice echoing in its ears, it felt as if something heavy in its heart was slowly being put down.

Especially that bond surrounding it, belonging to Johan and his Pokémon, like the warm sun of spring, making it unable to resist yawning.

Arceus's eyes slowly closed, yet a faint smile appeared at the corners of its mouth.

It seemed to see...

In the fields, children and Pokémon running joyfully.

By the stream, humans and Pokémon playing in the water, splashing colorful water droplets.

In houses, Pokémon sitting at dining tables, waiting for delicious food to arrive.

In battle arenas, everyone sweating together, together tasting the joy of victory, the curtain of defeat, experiencing the hardships and happiness of the process...

Perhaps humans weren't so deplorable after all.

Perhaps I truly don't understand emotion as well as Johan.

Perhaps...

I can try to let go.

Light emanated from Arceus again, but without any aggression, without even consciousness, only bringing the gradual dissipation of this mental space.

[You have indeed proven the emotion you spoke of. Your bond makes me envious.]

The light was gentle, and as Johan and his Pokémon's consciousness gradually returned, Arceus's final voice grew distant.

[Perhaps we truly can have a good talk.]

But Johan had another thought.

Looking at the gradually dissipating Arceus, he couldn't help but smack his lips.

Tsk, it really was just a mental space. Otherwise... who knows what might happen if I tried throwing a ball at Arceus...
