# 619: Mewtwo: Being Human Is Difficult (2-in-one Chapter)

What happened in the mental space remained unknown to the people and Pokémon outside, who only assumed that Teacher Johan was focused on commanding the legendary Pokémon in battle, or perhaps communicating with them.

The evidence proved that even an Arceus with all its plates intact would have a difficult time facing so many legendary and mythical Pokémon combined.

By the time Johan regained awareness...

Arceus already appeared somewhat disheveled.

Being surrounded and attacked by a group would naturally cause dishevelment, especially with Giratina so willing to take the brunt of fire and actively serve as the tank.

However, Arceus was still Arceus, an existence above first-tier deities, and had inflicted considerable trouble and damage on the legendary and mythical Pokémon.

Even though it was likely just one of many avatars of the true Arceus.

But even as just an avatar, it still wielded important authority, ranking above all first-tier gods.

In the current Pokémon world, perhaps only the fully restored "Radiant God" Ultra Necrozma from Ultra Space could directly match it, as they were on the same level in terms of authority.

Maybe the fully combined Tao Trio from Unova could also try, but it was unclear whether Kyurem could still simultaneously merge with both Zekrom and Reshiram.

In any case, the true complete Arceus was undoubtedly an existence above all others, worthy of the title "Original One."

Not something that Eternatus from Galar, with merely high base stats but few notable feats, could compare to.

Johan wondered what Giratina's reaction would be if it knew that the opponent it had been fighting so vigorously was just an avatar, and not even one at full power.

Though Mewtwo also seemed to be fighting enthusiastically, having Mega Evolved into Mega Mewtwo Y and outputting damage against Arceus, taking advantage of not being a Pokémon created by Arceus.

Perhaps Mewtwo was venting all its "resentment" toward the "creator" on Arceus?

BOOM!!!!!

With a Psystrike from Mega Mewtwo Y, Arceus's body shattered like a mirror, turning into sparkles of light that scattered away.

This scene left everyone stunned, including the legendary Pokémon battling Arceus.

They all turned to look at Mega Mewtwo Y.

Wha-what, you shattered Arceus?

This was likely the meaning behind the looks most legendary Pokémon gave.

That powerful?

Faced with their gazes, Mega Mewtwo Y didn't even acknowledge them, only watching where Arceus had disappeared before returning to Johan's side as the Mega evolution energy unwound from its body like threads being unraveled.

Giratina, Dialga, and Palkia looked at each other in bewilderment.

Arceus was shattered?

Wouldn't that mean the world was theirs now?!

But before they could rejoice, the sky suddenly opened again, and with sacred light scattering down, a perfectly intact Arceus descended once more.

Another one?

This time, Arceus's state was noticeably gentler compared to before, without the burning anger or arrogant attitude.

It didn't even look at the three dragons who stood dumbfounded, but instead descended toward Johan.

Johan wasn't particularly surprised by Arceus's current state.

Just like how the Arceus in the mental space dissipated after being defeated by them, now that its anger and disappointment had been appeased, Arceus's mindset had completely balanced out.

As for what was shattered earlier...

That was merely an avatar.

Landing in front of Johan, Arceus's expression was gentle.

[You win, Johan.]

It remembered this name, naturally also acknowledging Johan and his Pokémon.

Hearing this, Johan gave a reassuring look to Cynthia, Lucian, and others nearby, as well as Reshiram and the other legendary Pokémon, then smiled and said:

"There's no so-called winning or losing; isn't mutual help between friends only natural?"

As he spoke, he took out the "Jewel of Life" found by Team Rocket, opening the mechanism on the staff to reveal the glowing emerald-green jewel inside.

[Friends?]

Arceus paused slightly, then the "Jewel of Life" separated into Ground, Water, Grass, Electric, and Dragon plates that flew back to join Arceus.

With the return of the plates, Arceus fully regained its peak form.

At this moment.

Dialga and Palkia suddenly felt their time domain and space domain stop colliding, and their respective realms returned to calmness.

This made them realize that Arceus had truly returned.

Dialga and Palkia exchanged glances, one opening a time rift, the other a spatial crack, both returning to their own territories.

Not just them—Giratina felt it even more clearly.

It distinctly felt the restrictions from the Distortion World, the reverse side of the world, returning, and the Pokémon world gradually beginning to reject it, the feeling growing stronger.

Giratina's expression changed, turning fierce. It didn't want to be confined to that broken-down place again!

Sensing Giratina's change, Johan spoke:

"Giratina is actually quite obedient. I believe it won't do anything excessive again."

Arceus looked at Giratina.

Giratina instinctively shrank its neck, but then its eyes widened, showing an undefeated expression.

[Is that so?]

"It's also my friend," Johan said.

Hearing this, not only was Arceus taken aback, but Giratina was also surprised.

Friend?

Giratina wondered... did it have a friend now?

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar, wearing sunglasses, suddenly appeared on Giratina's back, laughing as it patted its hard back.

This "virtual pet" growing to such a degree—I can say my contribution has been significant!

If not for its diligent daily "feeding," the "virtual pet" would never have grown so big!

Woosh—

Suddenly.

Giratina felt the Pokémon world's rejection weakening until it disappeared, and the Distortion World's restrictions also dissipated.

It could once again freely enter and exit the Pokémon world.

[Since you vouch for it, Johan, I'll trust it once more.]

Johan waved his hand.

"I believe Giratina won't actively cause any more damage to the Pokémon world."

No joke.

Giratina had experienced "Let the Soul Travel" even earlier than Arceus.

A Pokémon that spends its days either drinking tea and eating pastries or watching TV shows—how threatening could it be?

Gengar trusted Giratina, Johan trusted Giratina, and as for Giratina...

"ROAR—"

It let out a soft roar, giving a deep look at Johan and Arceus before opening a passage to the Distortion World in front of it.

At this moment, Johan called out with a smile:

"Giratina, come over for dinner in a couple of days. Don't forget."

Giratina, about to enter the passage, paused, showing a hint of delight in its eyes. After nodding, it let out a long howl and happily returned to the Distortion World.

Although it hadn't overthrown Arceus's "rule" this time, Giratina had still vented some frustration and fought to its satisfaction.

At least it had blown Arceus up, right?

Plus, it could somewhat sense that as long as the Pokémon world existed, Arceus... probably couldn't die.

Although defeating Arceus had always been its obsession.

But after interacting with Johan and spending time with Gengar lately, it discovered there were many things more fun and interesting than "defeating Arceus" in this world.

And as the Distortion World's restrictions on it dissipated, the obsession in its heart completely faded away.

Now it could watch TV shows in peace. Happy!

Arceus looked at Johan again.

[Thank you, Johan. You've let me experience the beauty of the Pokémon world again, and understand the meaning of emotions.]

The gratitude in its words was quite sincere.

Honestly.

Johan hadn't expected that he would... actually be able to provide psychological therapy to Arceus.

This achievement alone was enough for a golden signboard!

Unique in the entire Pokémon world.

Claiming the title of "Number One Pokémon Psychologist in the Pokémon World" wouldn't be wrong, would it?

While feeling somewhat self-satisfied, Johan smiled and waved his hand.

"Oh, saying all that, we're all—"

[All friends.]

Before Johan could finish, Arceus completed his sentence, which startled him momentarily before his smile widened.

"That's right."

After recovering, Arceus could "see" some of the events that had happened to Johan previously.

Whether it was calming the dragons in Twinleaf Town, handling the Tao Trio in the Giant Chasm, or facing Rayquaza and others.

This was a person with a strong sense of responsibility and dedication—this was Arceus's assessment of Johan.

[As thanks.]

A light emanated from Arceus, and a palm-sized golden Thousand Arms flew from its body, slowly descending toward Johan.

Hmm?

Instinctively catching it, Johan looked at the still slightly warm Thousand Arms in his hand.

This was the symbol of the Original One, Arceus!

In the Pokémon world, there were naturally many who worshipped Arceus.

Although Arceus's creation legend originated from the Sinnoh region, it didn't mean other regions didn't have it. For example, in the Kalos region, there was a place called "Azure Valley."

Within "Azure Valley," there was a group of followers who worshipped Arceus, using the Thousand Arms as their totem of faith.

The Thousand Arms in Johan's hand now looked no different from those totems worn by those people.

But one thing was certain: something given personally by Arceus wouldn't be so simple.

"This is..." Johan began.

[Power derived from me, capable of balancing the order of time and space. It will bring you good fortune.]

Good... fortune?

Johan's heart stirred.

Could it be that his bad luck was finally going to turn around completely? Would he become lucky now?

Arceus didn't specify exactly what it did, feeling that Johan could figure it out slowly by himself.

But one thing.

[Through it, you can contact me.]

Arceus emphasized the word 'me'.

Could it be Arceus's true form? Johan wondered.

So in the future... if he encountered major events he couldn't handle, could he bring Arceus out for a spin?

Perhaps seeing through Johan's thoughts, or maybe it was planning to say this anyway, Arceus spoke again.

[After this event concludes, I'll need to rest for a while to recover myself. During this time, I'll leave things to you.]

"Wait," Johan suddenly felt something was off and hurriedly raised his hand to stop Arceus from continuing.

What did "leave things to you" mean?

Although Johan now felt that due to his presence, or perhaps due to the inherent "differences" in this world, many plots that should have happened to Ash somehow involved him instead.

Saying "world convergence is amazing" wouldn't be an exaggeration.

But that didn't mean he wanted to become like Daigo, rushing to wherever trouble was brewing.

Given a choice, he'd rather stay at home cooking, watching TV with his little ones, chatting, and when bored, training to burn off some of their excess energy.

Arceus smiled slightly.

[Don't worry, some things that are meant to happen will happen eventually. You might resist internally, but your sense of responsibility and commitment won't let you be a mere spectator.]

Johan: "..."

Do you want to bet that if something doesn't happen in Hoenn or Sinnoh, or doesn't affect me, you'll see whether I get involved or not.

Arceus looked up slightly, murmuring:

[The awakening and collision of life and destruction, mountains rising and oceans overturning, the rift of time and space spreading, the inevitable descent of night, the ancient—]

"Stop stop stop!" Johan quickly interrupted.

Please, I'm begging you, I'll kneel down!

The more he heard, the more frightened he became.

You can plant your own flags, but don't plant them on me!

[If you have time, go to Kalos. You and your companions will gain 'power' there, and 'power' will give you more confidence.]

Kalos?

Power?

Azure Valley?

Hoopa?

Johan's heart trembled.

Of course, these were just his guesses.

Arceus lowered its head again.

[As a friend, before I fall into slumber again, if there's anything you need my help with, you can ask.]

Its voice was gentle, its tone familiar. If Giratina, Dialga, and Palkia heard this, they would surely exclaim—is this your son or what?

Help?

Johan rubbed his chin gently.

Looking at his little ones, he immediately had an idea.

"Well, can I borrow about ten or so plates? No particular reason, mainly because my Larvitar wants to taste—ahem, wants to experience the power of the plates."

With ten or so plates at his disposal, Johan wouldn't fear anything anymore.

Whoever came, he could smack them in the face with the plates!

How satisfying.

"Yo-Yoji? (_)"

Larvitar was startled, then its eyes lit up.

Re-really?

Gulp—

It swallowed hard.

[?]

"Ahem, just kidding," Johan coughed lightly, pulling Mewtwo over and saying:

"Help Mewtwo fulfill a wish."

Suddenly being pulled over by Johan, Mewtwo was clearly surprised.

It gave Johan a complex look, then shook its head at Arceus:

"No need. Through the battle just now, I've understood the meaning of your existence. That's not something you should do."

Reviving Ai Two was what Mewtwo wanted to do.

As Mewtwo's primary "doctor," Johan naturally guessed its wish.

But...

Ai Two wasn't a naturally born existence, and couldn't even be considered a life form. Even the Original One, Arceus, couldn't possibly revive it.

If it were Ai, perhaps it would be possible, but Ai Two...

That was a "clone" like itself, or rather, merely a cloned consciousness.

Mewtwo's eyes were determined as it said: "I will accomplish it myself!"

It glanced at Johan, silently adding: Just as I will protect Johan.

Arceus gazed at Mewtwo, showing a pleased smile.

[I cannot fulfill its wish, but I believe with your help... perhaps it's possible.]

After a pause, Arceus said:

[That being the case, I'll bestow some of the plates' power.]

Woosh—

Larvitar suddenly produced the Earth plate fragment that had shrunk, and Urshifu also took out its treasured Fist plate fragment.

"Yoji?"

Larvitar's eyes widened in delight, discovering that the Earth plate fragment it had nibbled on... was restored, even larger than before!

It could nibble for a long time now!

[The power of the plates isn't necessarily better the more you have, nor do all Pokémon need to rely on the plates' power.]

For instance, Ninetales. In Arceus's view, its Ice-type power didn't need the plates.

The Ice-type power derived from the Tao Trio was essentially on the same level as the plates.

"Ka-kaah?" Gengar pointed at itself.

What about me?

Arceus pursed its lips, gave Gengar a look, and a fist-sized dark plate fragment floated toward it.

[For Gengar, it's acceptable.]

A Fairy plate fragment!

Seeing this, Gengar was delighted, sticking out its tongue to roll the Fairy plate fragment onto it, and began "swallowing" it with a "blurp blurp" sound.

"Ka-kaah~"

Tastes good~

[...]

So you really do eat them.

Arceus lightly tapped its golden foreleg in the air, and its entire form, like a deer, rose toward the sky.

[I look forward to our next meeting, Johan.]

Better not meet again, I'm afraid... Johan thought silently.

[Before I leave, let me give you one last gift.]

As it spoke, a gentle beam of light fell from Arceus, seemingly containing mysterious power. Johan immediately felt the aura power within him, which hadn't shown much activity for a long time...

Suddenly begin to grow rapidly!

Aura?

Woosh—

Johan instinctively closed his eyes, and the aura power immediately spread outward with him at the center.

Cynthia, Lucian, Flint, Aaron... Mewtwo, Zekrom, Reshiram, Regigigas, Darkrai...

Everything was reflected in his heart.

Even.

In the distance, those Team Galactic members struggling to escape from the shattered aircraft that Regigigas had smashed with one palm—all living beings, inanimate objects, everything manifested.

Johan's aura power had taken a qualitative leap.

This kind of aura... perhaps he could really hand-form an "Aura Sphere" now?

At the very least...

Urshifu and Armarouge received epic-level enhancements!

And on Johan's body, the Rainbow Wing was clearly the most "excited," emitting an incredibly brilliant light.

But the aura that used to be "exclusively" for the Rainbow Wing now had a competitor—the Thousand Arms!

Rainbow Wing: (▼皿▼)

Through the Thousand Arms and aura, Johan seemed able to "see" the direction Arceus was leaving in, and where it wanted to go.

Indeed, the most basic "function" of this Thousand Arms should be an "Arceus Communicator."

However, besides sensing Arceus's presence, Johan also discovered that this Thousand Arms seemed to be subtly guiding him in a direction, a place quite distant from the Sinnoh region, hinting at something.

Woosh—

The aura receded, and Johan slowly opened his eyes.

He raised his hand, trying to materialize the aura power, and then...

Nothing happened.

Johan: "..."

Damn, if I can't even use it, what's the point of it being stronger!

Of course, this was just a mental complaint. The enhancement of aura power allowed Johan to better sense the inner changes of each Pokémon.

For instance, Mewtwo's persistence in reviving Ai Two.

Regigigas wondering: they all flew away, what about me?

Lugia: Is my kid running around everywhere?

Gengar's curiosity about the Fairy plate fragment, Ninetales's gradually calming worry, Larvitar guessing what's for dinner... it bet it was barbecue!

Ahem.

As a Pokémon psychologist, the enhancement of aura power was undoubtedly very helpful.

Thoughts returning to the present, facing the gazes of everyone and all the Pokémon, Johan finally showed a relaxed smile.

"It's over."

Hearing this, Lucian and Flint immediately let out long sighs of relief.

Finally...

"But not completely over."

Hmm?

The two simultaneously tensed up, while Aaron exhaled loudly beside them.

Johan pointed behind him, to the distance. "Team Galactic hasn't been fully dealt with."

Cynthia frowned slightly, nodding:

"Leave it to me."

With that, she flipped onto Garchomp's back, heading toward where the Team Galactic aircraft had crashed.

Her expression was stern.

The Adamant Orb and Lustrous Orb falling into Team Galactic's hands was unexpected, and she didn't know if they had done anything to her grandmother.

"Boss, we're coming too!"

Lucian and Flint quickly called out.

To be honest, in this incident... they hadn't contributed much.

Mainly because they were facing legendary Pokémon, mythical Pokémon, and even the Original One, leaving them few opportunities to act. Lucian could at least provide some support, but Flint...

"What about you?" Johan asked, looking at Zekrom and Reshiram.

Before leaving, Palkia had been very considerate, opening spatial rifts for them to return, saving them the trouble of flying back to Unova.

Zekrom looked at Reshiram, and Reshiram looked at Zekrom.

Normally, Sinnoh was the territory of the Space-Time Trio, and the Tao Trio would be rejected, but this was an exception.

Since they were already here...

Reshiram looked up at the sky and said softly:

[I heard there would be dinner?]

Zekrom also tilted its head, looking toward the direction of the foothills, saying:

[Surely there's room for us two brothers?]

Johan smiled.

He looked at Regigigas.

To his surprise, Regigigas stretched lazily, seemingly yawning.

[Next time, next time call me again]

With those words.

Regigigas transformed into a "Light Stone" and fell into slumber.

Clearly, this clash with Arceus had taken quite a toll on Regigigas, understandably since it had nearly crushed Arceus.

"Alright," Johan nodded slightly, acknowledging Regigigas's words.

Though Johan suspected... Regigigas was worried that if it didn't turn into a "Light Stone," it wouldn't be able to return?

Would it have to run back?

"I'm going back first," said Lugia, concerned about its child. It nodded to Johan, then flew into the rift, returning to Lugia Island.

"Don't look at me," Darkrai noticed Johan's gaze, folded its arms, and snorted lightly. "I'm definitely having this dinner!"

Johan laughed.

He wasn't sure when it started, but Darkrai had gradually been labeled as a "glutton" by him.

"I'm going back," Mewtwo said using telepathy with its psychic power.

But before it could move, Johan grabbed its arm.

Faced with Mewtwo's puzzled look, Johan used a commanding tone:

"Don't put too much pressure on yourself. You have plenty of time to do what you want to do. Take a couple of days to relax at my place."

Mewtwo was visibly moved, warmth flowing through its heart.

Although Johan used a commanding tone, Mewtwo was capable of Mega Evolution with Johan, so how could it not sense his true thoughts?

After a slight hesitation, it nodded.

The Arceus incident sent shockwaves through the entire Sinnoh League and other Leagues.

The Original One Arceus, filled with anger and intent on punishing humanity, was forcefully "subdued" by the "Legendary Tamer" Teacher Johan, who called upon numerous legendary Pokémon.

Team Galactic tried to take advantage of the situation, only to have their aircraft smashed by the King of the Regis, Regigigas, with a single palm strike, after which the Team Galactic executives were captured by Cynthia, Lucian, Flint, and Aaron.

And Team Galactic leader Cyrus was allegedly sent to the Distortion World by Teacher Johan!

These events had a significant impact on the Pokémon Leagues throughout the Pokémon world.

Teacher Johan's name once again appeared before all League executives.

And the League executives had to reassess the importance of this person to the entire League and the Pokémon world.

Rumors.

Teacher Johan had apparently earned the recognition of the Original One Arceus and was granted the status of "Messenger of God," walking the Pokémon world on Arceus's behalf.

Johan also gained a new title because of this—Messenger of God!

Johan didn't care about these so-called rumors or the reactions of the League executives.

He had actually come to terms with it.

Look.

As the Black and White Hero, he had already earned the respect of many League executives. Adding associations with Regigigas, Lugia, or even Arceus... what difference did it make?

No difference.

After all, they were all legendary Pokémon that others couldn't handle.

So...

Johan was very open about it and didn't pay much attention to the aftermath.

The impact wasn't that significant anyway.

After all, those who truly knew the entire process of this incident were only Cynthia and the others. Even the so-called League executives only made some reasonable guesses based on the results.

Moreover, to avoid unnecessary trouble and panic, the Arceus incident wasn't made known to the general public, remaining only among the League executives.

The day after the incident ended.

Sinnoh region, Celestic Town.

On a meadow at the border between Celestic Town and the Mt. Coronet range.

Mewtwo, wearing an adorable Jigglypuff apron, held skewers and a brush in its hands, its face smudged with some black soot, expressionlessly staring at the... barbecue grill before it.

It searched its mind... why did I choose to stay?

Why am I here?

Relaxation?

Relaxation means... barbecuing here?

"Mewtwo, the meat was a bit overcooked earlier, and add more cumin next time," Darkrai called out, holding a skewer.

Mewtwo gave it a "killer" look.

But Johan quickly appeared in front of it, blocking its view.

Johan also wore a Gengar apron, holding a spatula, and smiled:

"This is what it feels like to be human. How is it?"

Wasn't Mewtwo always unsure whether it belonged to humans or Pokémon?

Then try both.

Hearing this, Mewtwo lowered its gaze, looking at the meat sizzling over the charcoal, dripping with oil and emitting a tempting aroma.

Raising its head, it looked at Team Rocket, who were also busy but seemed to be enjoying themselves, or at least looked very skilled. It felt "the gap between people."

"Being human... isn't easy either."

Johan laughed.

He hadn't expected Mewtwo to realize that being human wasn't easy either, which was somewhat beyond his expectations.

"Your awareness is quite high."

Mewtwo's eye twitched.

High awareness?

It glanced to the side at the mountain of various ingredients—meat, vegetables, as well as berries, fresh milk, and other Pokémon food ingredients.

A mountain of them!

Faced with so many ingredients, anyone would find it challenging, right?

Regarding this.

Johan also indicated there was nothing he could do.

This was already quite manageable.

Besides his own and Cynthia's group's Pokémon, only Darkrai, Giratina, Zekrom, and Reshiram had come for the gathering.

If Regigigas, Dialga, Palkia, Lugia, and the others were added, he might cook until he died.

Even so, it was only because the Sinnoh League had covered the cost of the ingredients; otherwise, Johan would have bled money.

This was also one reason why he didn't dare keep Reshiram by his side.

Mewtwo gave Johan a deep look.

For some reason, it had a feeling... that a major reason Johan had kept it behind was to share the "pressure"—the pressure of cooking.

"Here, put on these arm covers," Johan said, seeing some oil stains on Mewtwo's arms, and took off his own arm covers.

Mewtwo didn't say anything, just raised its arms and let Johan put the arm covers on.

Looking at Mewtwo's current outfit, Johan nodded with satisfaction.

It seemed that in the future, the sign on his kitchen door wouldn't need to add a new name besides "Gengar and Cynthia Not Allowed."

# 620: Various Parties Shaken (Two-in-One Chapter)

Night fell.

Zekrom, Reshiram, and Giratina lay sprawled on the grass of Michina Town, gazing up at the starry sky with satisfied expressions.

To be honest, this should be the most satisfying meal they'd had since their birth. Not only was it delicious, but it was also filling!

Giratina glanced at the black and white brothers beside it, and suddenly a rather bold idea formed in its mind.

Giratina: How about... the three of us form a team?

Reshiram & Zekrom: ?

Giratina: The three of us have worked together before, and not just once...

In the Unova region, after Kyurem devoured and fused with Zekrom, Giratina was called by Johan to help. At that time, they joined forces only to be beaten down by Kyurem, who was known as the "strongest dragon on Earth's surface."

This time, during the Arceus incident, the three of them cooperated again - Giratina took the hits while Zekrom and Reshiram handled the offense. Perfect!

Giratina: Look, you two still have Kyurem bothering you in Unova, and I have Dialga and Palkia interfering in Sinnoh. How about the three of us form a... New Three Dragons!

New Three Dragons?

Reshiram and Zekrom exchanged glances, then shuffled their butts to distance themselves from Giratina.

This guy... hadn't been beaten enough yet?

New Three Dragons indeed. Did it really think Arceus had gone to sleep?

After eating and drinking their fill, Reshiram planned to go back and sleep well, waiting for Johan's next summons, while Zekrom still had to continue helping N realize his ideals.

Elsewhere, Darkrai and Gengar sat shoulder to shoulder on a bare tree branch, gazing at the bright moon.

At this moment, Darkrai was in high spirits. Having beaten even Arceus, what other legendary Pokémon was there to fear?

Just go for it!

"Gengar, do you think I'm brave?"

"Ka-kaah ka-kaah~~" Gengar reached out and touched Darkrai's forehead.

Brave, brave, brave - wait, shouldn't I be the one asking that question?

Also, did you take the wrong medicine or drink too much? No wait, we were drinking milk - could you get drunk on milk?

"Gengar, they're all in groups of three. How about... we form one too? With a catchy name, like the Darkrai Special Forces!"

"Ka-kaah?"

Why not call it the "Gengar Trio"?

Besides, there are only two of us - how can we form a trio?

"Isn't there still that guy?" Darkrai tilted its head slightly, glancing at Mewtwo, who still had soot on its face and was diligently grilling.

"I think it's pretty good."

Gengar gave Darkrai a sideways look.

You sure know how to pick! After crushing Arceus, Mewtwo had certainly made an impression among all the legendary and mythical Pokémon, letting everyone know of its existence.

"Ka-kaah?" Gengar rubbed its chin. So how would we rank the three of us?

Gengar held up its hand and counted on its fingers.

By strength: Mewtwo, Darkrai, Gengar. By age: Gengar, Darkrai, Mewtwo. By size: Gengar, Darkrai, Mewtwo. By tongue: Gengar, Darkrai, Mewtwo. By color: Mewtwo, Darkrai, Gengar.

"..."

"So I'm forever second place?" Darkrai discovered the "secret" of Gengar's rankings.

Darkrai the Second?

Gengar nodded thoughtfully. Not bad, not bad.

"Wait, but in terms of strength, Mewtwo is strong, but as a Dark-type Pokémon, I should completely counter it, right?"

Gengar indicated: Have you heard of a move called "Miracle Eye"?

"Well, by age, logically—"

Darkrai stopped mid-sentence because Gengar was also a thousand-year-old ghost, and one whose current age was unknown.

"Ranking by color is really going too far..."

Gengar stuck out its tongue, revealing the fragment of Arceus's Spooky Plate, playing with it on its tongue while also showing its attitude to Darkrai.

Blehhh~~

Darkrai: "..."

"Togekiss~~"

Cynthia's Togepi waddled along on tiny steps, following closely behind Larvitar, while Victini floated nearby, looking ready to catch it if it fell.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar suddenly stopped and put its hands on its hips.

Bang—

Togepi couldn't stop in time and bumped head-first into Larvitar, wobbling before falling backward onto the ground.

"Togekiss... (︿)"

"Vii..."

Victini watching from the side looked helpless - who would have thought it would fall like that without being caught?

"Yoji!"

Larvitar turned around, looking at its two current "little brothers," nodding with satisfaction.

Either way, I'm now someone who's a big brother! I'll look after you guys from now on!

"Togekiss~(≧≦)"

Togepi sitting on the ground showed an expression of complete admiration.

"Garrr—!"

Cynthia's Garchomp suddenly walked over, picked up Togepi from the ground, and bared its teeth at Larvitar.

Don't corrupt our little egg!

"Yoji!"

Larvitar hurried to follow. Little egg! My little egg! You have to teach me a move before you can take the little egg away—

On yet another side.

"Oowoo~~" "Bui~~"

Ninetales and Glaceon sat together, with Ninetales's tails spread out covering Glaceon, while Glaceon carefully groomed the bristled fur on Ninetales's tails from their recent battle.

Nearby, Flint's Houndoom watched this scene with longing eyes, tongue hanging out and tail wagging rapidly. But it didn't dare approach.

"Be brave, Houndoom!" Flint, sitting in a chair not far away, cheered on his Houndoom while gripping his fist, a piece of grilled meat in his mouth and fire in his eyes.

Go bravely pursue your ideal type! Whether it's Teacher Johan's Ninetales or Big Sister's Glaceon, if you can win over either one, we're set!

"Hound..."

Encouraged by its trainer, Houndoom finally mustered its courage, took a deep breath, and strode toward Ninetales and Glaceon with determination.

Its expression was resolute, its attitude serious, and it wore what it thought was a very friendly smile.

"Oowoo?"

Ninetales keenly sensed "danger" - there was fire approaching, and it had "ill intentions."

Almost instinctively, Ninetales turned its head and fired an unreasonable Ice Beam at Houndoom.

Crack crack crack—

Houndoom was instantly covered in snow-white transparent ice crystals, all its expressions frozen on its face.

"Bui?"

Only then did Glaceon look toward Houndoom, with some confusion. What did it want to do?

Ninetales shook its head. Don't know, but somehow... it felt unsafe, a Fire-type Pokémon sneaking up like that...

Bang—

The ice crystals on Houndoom shattered, its eyes filled with the crystalline tears of "heartbreak" as it turned and ran toward the nearby grove.

Though it couldn't really be called "heartbreak" since it never even began.

"Hound..." Flint opened his mouth but didn't know how to comfort it, since he had no experience in this area either.

Could it be that Fire-type and Ice-type Pokémon really weren't compatible?

"Bui~~"

Glaceon, having discovered his ulterior motives, mercilessly breathed out a puff of cold air, and Flint followed Houndoom's fate, becoming an ice sculpture.

Clang clang clang—

"Cha!"

Finished!

Tinkaton clapped its hands with satisfaction, looking at Ceruledge's newly repaired armor and nodding contentedly.

This was its most prideful masterpiece to date.

But after finishing Ceruledge's armor, Tinkaton once again immersed itself in the joy of metalworking.

Although Tinkaton seemed to have gained the least from this Arceus incident - after all, Larvitar, Urshifu, and Gengar had all obtained or repaired Plate fragments - in reality, Tinkaton's gains were no less than theirs, because Team Galactic had sent another airship!

Thanks to Team Galactic's bosses for the rocket donation!

Even though Team Galactic's airship wasn't as big as Team Plasma's destroyer, Team Galactic's airship was made of better materials!

And Team Plasma's destroyer was more like a ship, using a lot of wooden structures, but Team Galactic's airship was mostly metal, which made Tinkaton extremely happy.

As for Dragonite... with so many Dragon-type legendary Pokémon present, scraping a scale from each one was a great tonic for Dragonite.

The one with truly smaller gains was actually Ninetales and Ceruledge.

Ninetales couldn't help it - as an Ice and Fairy-type Pokémon, even Arceus acknowledged its extraordinary potential in Ice-type abilities, not needing the power of the Ice Plate.

And in Fairy-type aspects... even Arceus itself was lacking in Fairy-type, not even having the Fairy Plate - whether it hadn't found it or had lost it was unknown.

As for Ceruledge, it had been learning "flame explosion" techniques from Victini all along. While the progress wasn't immediately obvious, it was constantly improving.

Moreover, when it switched to Armarouge form, it could also learn some psychic techniques from Mewtwo, so it wouldn't stagnate.

"Honestly, there's really a lack in Fairy-type aspects."

Johan had also noticed the deficiencies in some aspects of his Pokémon team.

Not having certain types was one thing - like Grass, Bug, and Normal types that none of his Pokémon possessed, so there wasn't much to say about those. But in Fairy-type... his team had two Fairy-type Pokémon!

Ninetales and Tinkaton.

However, both Ninetales and Tinkaton were lacking in developing their Fairy-type abilities.

On one hand, Fairy-type resources were relatively hard to find, being rare and precious.

On the other hand, their Fairy-type deficiency was also because, compared to their other types, ordinary materials and resources really didn't help them much.

Of course, in Johan's view, it was actually because there was no Fairy-type before Generation VI! The patch wasn't comprehensive enough.

"Fairy-type, huh?"

Cynthia, sitting nearby, heard Johan's muttering and said softly, "Perhaps you could ask Valerie about it."

"Valerie?"

The Gym Leader of Laverre Gym in the Kalos region, an expert specializing in Fairy-types, and one of the few top trainers in the Pokémon world who specialized in Fairy-types.

"You know her?"

"Mm, of course." Cynthia nodded. "Many of my performance outfits were designed with Valerie's help."

Contest outfits?

Johan's eyes lit up. He remembered that Cynthia had quite a few contest outfits, including not only Garchomp and Altaria contest outfits, but even Arceus and Giratina contest outfits.

Each contest outfit brought obvious changes to Cynthia. The Garchomp outfit showed wildness and boldness, the Altaria outfit showed efficiency and nobility, the Arceus outfit showed holiness and radiance, and the Giratina outfit...

Undoubtedly, Johan's favorite was still Cynthia in the Giratina contest outfit. It not only had a dark wedding dress style but was also an unprecedented combination of Cynthia + black stockings... cough cough.

"What are you thinking about?"

Cynthia waved her hand in front of Johan, vaguely sensing he was thinking about something inappropriate.

"Cough, no, nothing." Johan regained his composure and said seriously, "Actually, I have a little bit of talent in fashion design."

"Oh?" Cynthia showed a somewhat suspicious expression.

Johan maintained his "upright" appearance and said earnestly:

"Maybe I could even give Valerie some suggestions to help her design very suitable uniforms - no, outfits for you."

No, if he could get involved in Cynthia's fashion design, who needed contest outfits?

JK, maid, cat girl...

Damn.

Johan quickly shook his head, driving some impractical thoughts from his mind.

If he really did that, he'd be treated as a pervert, right? He might wake up at night with Garchomp's scythe at his throat.

But some contest outfits could indeed be worth trying.

Cynthia naturally didn't know what Johan was thinking, but hearing that Johan could help design clothes for her, she curved her eyes and smiled:

"Alright then, you can try. I can wear them for the next performance battle."

"Anything goes?" Johan asked tentatively.

"Mm-hmm."

Target: Laverre City in the Kalos region!

Speaking of which, Arceus had also suggested that if he had time, he could visit the Kalos region...

But Johan felt that any place Arceus suggested definitely had problems!

Did it really think he couldn't understand Arceus's final "prophecy"?

"The awakening and collision of life and destruction" most likely referred to the revival event of Xerneas, the God of Life, and Yveltal, the God of Destruction or Death.

But honestly, to quote Darkrai: having beaten even Arceus, what other legendary Pokémon was there to fear?

Of course, fear was still there - after all, when legendary Pokémon erupted, many things were truly unpredictable.

Unlike this time, Johan had prepared various countermeasures for Arceus's awakening well in advance, with three different Plans, which allowed him to get through it safely.

But the Kalos region was the "birthplace" of Fairy-type, so it was indeed a good place to improve Fairy-type abilities.

We'll see... Kanaz Pokémon Academy was also entering the final sprint stage for finals. During summer vacation, he'd see whether to take the little ones on a trip to the Kalos region.

After all, the Hoenn and Kalos regions had an unclear relationship.

Similar abilities like Mega Evolution had two theories of origin: meteors from Hoenn and the "Ultimate Weapon" from the Kalos region.

And Steven had recently been quite obsessed with going to Kalos to dig for stones. In the games, Steven liked to give Mega Stones in the Kalos region.

"I'm planning to..." Cynthia rested her chin on her hand, looking at the stars in the sky, and said softly, "train for a while longer, then try to challenge for Champion."

Whether it was this incident or previous events, they all made Cynthia realize one thing... she had the heart to protect a region - that was the responsibility of a Champion.

Johan wasn't surprised to hear her words. In his impression, Cynthia and Champion were two words that naturally went together.

"Good." Johan nodded. "And I think you can definitely do it."

A Champion's heart?

Steven's determination to single-handedly battle Groudon and Kyogre for 22 days, Leon's confidence to face Eternatus head-on...

"However, once you become Champion, many things won't be up to you anymore," Johan said.

Unova's Alder was the best example.

Cynthia smiled gently and said, "Isn't there still Lucian?"

"Eh, that's true."

After the incident ended, Lucian, the only official Elite Four member, was busy representing the League in handling the aftermath.

This included but wasn't limited to cleaning up Michina's mess, reporting and explaining the general course of events, approving Teacher Johan's reimbursement form, and transporting various ingredients and materials to Michina Town...

The ingredients for treating Giratina and the others to a meal couldn't come out of Johan's own pocket, right? Besides, Johan didn't have that many materials.

The Sinnoh League had to provide the materials themselves.

After solving such a big problem for the Sinnoh region, what was wrong with providing a little bit of materials?

"Achoo—"

Lucian, busy in his office, looked miserable as he sneezed and glanced at the night outside the window.

"They're probably having a great time eating right now..."

Lucian felt bitter but didn't know who to complain to.

Looking at the reimbursement form in his hand, his eye twitched.

"Is this... is this the legendary 'Reimbursement King'?"

"Need a sparring partner?" Johan blinked and asked.

"You want to be a sparring partner?" Cynthia tilted her head and asked back.

Johan glanced at Garchomp not far away and shrank his neck.

Never mind, never mind...

"I mean Flint would be a good sparring partner," Johan laughed awkwardly.

"Achoo—"

Flint nearby sneezed, rubbing his arms and shivering from the cold.

"Oh no, oh no, I hope I'm not catching a cold..."

Cynthia gave Johan a slightly reproachful glance and said:

"Actually, it's not necessary. I already understand the remaining direction with Garchomp and the others."

Cynthia's direction?

When in doubt, let Garchomp sweep the team?

If Cynthia was going to take the Champion route... Garchomp alone probably had a good chance of sweeping through three Elite Four members, right?

Johan silently mourned for Lucian, Flint, and the others for three seconds.

"By the way, when did you catch an Eevee?" Cynthia brought up the Eevee that Johan had shown during the performance battle at Blueberry Academy.

Why wasn't that Eevee seen this time?

Hearing this, Johan's smile gradually became strange. He lowered his voice, leaned close to Cynthia's ear, and whispered a couple of sentences.

After hearing his explanation, Cynthia first looked enlightened, then couldn't help but cover her mouth and laugh.

"Shh, this matter - heaven knows, earth knows, you know, I know..."

That "Eevee" was an ace card.

"You..."

July 4th, Kanto region, Viridian City, Team Rocket base.

"So many legendary Pokémon?"

Giovanni sat at his office desk, picked up a slightly charred cookie and put it in his mouth, showing a rather pleased smile.

"Truly worthy of Johan."

He actually wanted to pat himself on the shoulder and say, "Truly worthy of my judgment."

Buzz—

Psychic waves suddenly appeared in Giovanni's office.

As the psychic light faded, Mewtwo had appeared before Giovanni, its eyes directly meeting this man who had orchestrated its creation.

Facing Mewtwo, Giovanni put away his previous smile and assumed an expressionless demeanor.

Although the League's blockade meant that detailed information about Teacher Johan VS Arceus hadn't been made public, Team Rocket had still obtained some information.

This included... Mewtwo had Mega Evolved with Johan, and then Mega Mewtwo Y had shattered Arceus's avatar with one punch.

Mewtwo had displayed strength far beyond what Giovanni had originally expected.

And with such strength, plus Mewtwo's awakened self-awareness, Team Rocket actually had little ability to restrict Mewtwo anymore.

Even if Mewtwo wanted to, it could destroy Team Rocket's secret base under Viridian City at any time.

One human and one Pokémon stared at each other, neither speaking.

After a while, Mewtwo finally spoke.

"Your bloodline is currently in New Bark Town, the town of beginnings, in the Johto region."

Crack—

Giovanni's wrist trembled slightly, and the charred cookie in his hand immediately crumbled into pieces. He also rarely showed a loss of composure.

His bloodline! Silver!

Originally, Giovanni had strongly supported the creation of the genetic Pokémon Mewtwo partly to give Team Rocket absolute combat power, but more importantly, he wanted to use the genetic Pokémon's abilities to find his child.

For this, Giovanni had even relaxed restrictions on Mewtwo, which was almost equivalent to giving up control over Mewtwo.

After waiting so long, he had finally heard the answer he wanted from Mewtwo.

Johto region, New Bark Town!

Giovanni took a deep breath, trying to calm the waves in his heart.

Usually, he was the leader of Team Rocket, the sole head of the largest dark organization in the Pokémon world, the leader of a force that could confront the League to a certain extent.

But at this moment, he was just a father. A father who had lost his child for years and wanted to find his lost child, nothing more.

But before Giovanni could act, Mewtwo spoke again.

"Johan asked me to ask you: are you ready? Or rather, do you think he's ready?"

Hearing this, Giovanni froze in place.

Was he ready? Was Silver ready?

No.

Giovanni knew his answer clearly.

Team Rocket hadn't completed its transformation yet, and he was still the Team Rocket leader wanted by the League, that "unforgivable" person.

Would Silver be willing to acknowledge such a person as his father?

Not to mention what state Silver was in, whether he was on the right or wrong path - Giovanni couldn't afford to gamble...

Giovanni's lips trembled slightly, his voice somewhat hoarse as he asked:

"What's Johan's suggestion?"

Mewtwo, sensing Giovanni's inner turmoil, nodded secretly while saying:

"He said: Why not observe first, don't make contact, and see what he wants."

"Observe first, no contact?"

Giovanni took a deep breath, slowly closed his eyes, and nodded slightly:

"It seems that's the only way for now."

At least... he had found his child, and this time he would definitely keep a close watch!

Mewtwo nodded and turned to head toward the laboratory, but just as it turned around, it stopped again.

Looking deeply at Giovanni, it said slowly:

"Your time seems limited."

Giovanni looked at Mewtwo, not surprised that Mewtwo could see through him - after all, this was someone who could even find Silver, so how could it not see his problems?

But Giovanni just laughed heartily.

"It's enough."

Enough for him to understand what Silver wanted, to recognize Silver.

And enough for him to entrust Team Rocket to the person he had high hopes for.

Seeing Giovanni say this, Mewtwo said nothing more and turned to leave.

Watching Mewtwo's departing figure, Giovanni loosened his collar and chuckled:

"This guy is becoming more and more 'human.'"

Unova region, N's castle.

"Back?"

N gently wiped the sweat from his forehead, straightened up from the tilled field, and smiled at Zekrom flying back from the distance.

Zekrom nodded and slowly landed beside N.

Although only a few days had passed, the wasteland in front of N's castle had undergone considerable changes. Green plants had sprouted, and former Team Plasma members and Pokémon were working diligently on them.

Ideals were distant, but N was working toward his ideals step by step, bit by bit. Each day's changes were N's motivation to move forward.

As the Dragon of Ideals that recognized N's ideals, Zekrom could clearly feel this.

N sat on a nearby ridge, half-tilting his head. "Can you tell me about it?"

Zekrom didn't refuse and briefly recounted the general course of events.

"Arceus?" N looked shocked.

But what shocked him even more was that Teacher Johan had summoned nearly ten legendary and mythical Pokémon at once!

Then... "Beat Arceus down and even defeated it?" N swallowed.

Even as the Black Hero recognized by the Dragon of Ideals, N couldn't help but be deeply shaken when hearing about such a battle.

Was this... his teacher's true strength?

"Really amazing." N said admiringly.

Zekrom neither agreed nor disagreed, smacking its lips.

"Speaking of which... Zekrom, have you gained weight?" N tilted his head.

[Where? Where have I? Burp~]

Zekrom's old face turned red.

Fortunately, it was completely black, so it wasn't very noticeable.

"Hahaha—"

"What's so funny?"

Suddenly, a hearty voice came.

Hearing this voice, N quickly stood up, dusted off his clothes, and formally greeted the newcomer.

"Mr. Alder."

What came was a jeep.

Besides Officer Jenny, who looked helpless and even a bit disgusted, there was the Champion of the Unova region, Mr. Alder.

Through Johan's connection, N and Alder had established contact, and under their joint efforts, Team Plasma in the Unova region had been almost completely eliminated.

What remained, besides N's loyal supporters who were willing to support him in completing his great ideal, were those hiding in certain corners of the Unova region, unable to cause much trouble anymore.

During this process, Alder had gradually come to know, understand, and recognize N's existence and ideals.

The fact that this castle, originally Team Plasma's headquarters, could be preserved was largely due to Alder's efforts.

"You look in good spirits, N."

"So do you."

N was quite respectful toward Alder, this Champion who had devoted himself to Unova.

"How are you considering my last proposal, N?" Alder got straight to the point.

Last time, having recognized N's abilities, Alder had recommended him to join the Unova League. Whether he could become Champion remained to be seen, but taking on an Elite Four position - just based on Zekrom's existence alone - would be absolutely no problem.

If it had been before, N would most likely have refused.

After all, he didn't have much pursuit regarding being a trainer, and he wouldn't catch Pokémon either.

However, after learning about Teacher Johan's incident with Arceus, N had slightly changed some of his views.

Perhaps when Teacher Johan needed help in the future, he and Zekrom could rush over together?

As for catching Pokémon... with N's abilities, whether or not he used Poké Balls to catch them really didn't matter much.

Of course, before that, N would need to train some Pokémon first, and even if he joined the Unova League, his main energy would still be focused on building his "ideal nation."

"I—"

"ZzZ"

N had just started to speak when he noticed Alder had fallen asleep, not only snoring but even hanging a snot bubble from his nose.

Seeing this, N didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

Officer Jenny nearby took this opportunity to "clang" punch Alder on the back of his head.

"Old man! Cough, well, Champion Alder, someone's talking to you!"

N: "..."

Hoenn, Rustboro City, Devon Corporation building.

"Teacher is really amazing..."

Steven looked at the brief internal League intelligence report and couldn't help but click his tongue in amazement.

Nearly ten legendary and mythical Pokémon? Defeating the Creator God Arceus?

Were these things that an ordinary trainer could accomplish?

Even Joseph Stone, Steven's experienced father and Devon's president, couldn't help but be amazed by such news.

The old man was very grateful.

As a father, he was grateful that his son could have such a teacher.

As a company executive, he was also grateful that Devon had established friendly relations with Teacher Johan long ago, and that Teacher Johan was also Devon's special consultant.

With such an existence, while there was still opportunity, Devon should seize the time to increase their "investment."

It's just... he wondered what Teacher Johan still lacked...

"Father." Steven suddenly said, "After the academy exams are over, I'm planning to go to Kalos again."

"Looking for stones?"

The old man not only didn't object to his son's hobby but was very supportive.

"Partly." Steven smiled. "I heard that the Battle Chateau in the Kalos region sometimes has Elite Four members or even Champions appear. It should be a good place."

Mr. Stone understood. So there was also training involved.

"Very well."

The old man waved his hand. "Go ahead."

After a pause, he added:

"By the way, when you have time, go to Petalburg City. We have a batch of orders from Devon there."

"Alright."

# 621: Bountiful Harvest

July 4th, Wednesday, sunny and bright, the weather gradually becoming hot.

Hoenn, Rustboro City.

"Yoji, Yoji! (°口°)"

Larvitar stared wide-eyed at the "vegetable garden" before it, completely incredulous.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar couldn't help but lift up its sunglasses, looking at the garden scene with equal amazement.

Actually, not just them - Johan's expression wasn't much better at this moment.

How many days had it been?

From rushing to Sinnoh from Hoenn, resolving the "Arceus incident" and returning - it had only been... three or four days total, right?

The berry trees that had previously only produced a tiny bit of fruit were now laden with plump, crystal-clear berries, and the crops planted in the ground had similarly grown to maturity.

Everything had ripened at once?

"Hatt~~"

Hatterene explained that she hadn't done anything special, just watered them at regular intervals as Johan had originally instructed...

"Gar!"

At this moment, the "Salt Lord" Garganacl crouching in the corner of the garden indicated it had something to say.

It pointed at the wooden carving standing in the center of the garden, calling out with some reverence.

The Broccolish wooden carving?

No.

Calyrex's wooden carving?

When his gaze fell on that wooden carving, Johan also noticed changes in it.

Originally, although Penny and Sonia knew there was such a deity that could bring abundance, the Calyrex they had carved could only be described by Johan as looking more like broccoli.

But now, for some reason, Johan felt that wooden carving... looked more like a majestic Calyrex.

Calyrex!

Hmm?

Had it really caught the attention of Calyrex sleeping in the Crown Tundra of the distant Galar region?

Had Calyrex bestowed "abundance," making the crops in his garden grow faster and better?

It seemed that was the only explanation.

However, Johan stared at the wooden carving for quite a while, even using his aura powers enhanced by Arceus to sense it, but couldn't detect much from the carving.

Apart from the more refined carved appearance, there seemed to be no other changes.

There were no residual divine powers, nor any presence of Calyrex's thoughts.

Clearly, the last time... Calyrex's wooden carving hadn't changed at all.

So where was the problem?

Johan looked at Larvitar. After its initial surprise, the little one had now run to Calyrex's wooden carving, looking here and touching there, seemingly quite curious.

At that time, it seemed that Larvitar had developed an appetite for Calyrex's wooden carving, which caused the reaction?

Snap—

Suddenly, Larvitar stood before Calyrex's wooden carving, then put its hands together in a devout pose.

"Yoji!"

Great "God of Food," please grant me more food!

Clap! Clap! Clap!

Larvitar clapped its hands three times, utterly devout and serious.

"Yoji!"

Please!

Seeing this scene, Johan suddenly had a realization...

Right, faith!

Due to Calyrex's own "antics," the faith in it had gradually diminished, to the point where even the villagers of the town that originally worshipped it had forgotten why the Calyrex wooden carving existed at the village entrance.

Even its two beloved steeds had run away.

As Calyrex drew part of its power from faith, it inevitably fell into slumber after losing that faith.

But now, because of his words, because of his little ones' "prayer," had it caught Calyrex's attention?

"It's possible..."

That seemed to be the only explanation.

But... regardless, this was a great harvest!

Johan collected his wandering thoughts.

No matter what Calyrex's situation was, no matter whether it could really influence the distant Hoenn region, this harvest was right before his eyes.

"If you can really help us have a great harvest every time, then what's wrong with having faith in you?"

Johan threw out Poké Balls, summoning all his little ones.

"Harvest! Today's battle plan is - gathering the bountiful fruits!"

The little ones immediately cheered excitedly.

Eating was always an essential part of their lives.

So Johan put on a straw hat, changed into farmer's clothes, and began the joyful "harvest journey" with his little ones.

"Hatt~~"

Hatterene spread her arms, a slight psychic glow appearing in her eyes.

In an instant, plump fruits from a lush berry tree all fell down simultaneously.

Below.

"Yoji yoji!"

Larvitar hugged a basket bigger than itself, running back and forth under the tree, catching the falling berries in the basket.

The joy of harvest filled its face with smiles.

However, with so many berries falling at once, Larvitar felt it couldn't keep up. One plump berry was about to miss and fall to the ground.

"Vii~(>o<)"

Victini caught that berry and gave Larvitar a victory sign.

"Yoji——"

Larvitar breathed a long sigh of relief, looking at the basket full of plump berries, tears of joy flowing from the corners of its mouth.

"Super harvester mode!"

Rotom entered the lawnmower, quickly harvesting various plants and fruits growing on the ground.

The harvested fruits and some roots were then ejected from the top of the lawnmower.

Dragonite flew behind Rotom's harvester with a large net bag, solidly catching all the crops in the net.

"Goka~(ˊωˋ)"

"Cha!"

"Garruu!"

Ceruledge and Urshifu made eye contact, and after a brief exchange of glances, both nearly simultaneously disappeared from their spots.

Swish swish swish—

Ghostly blue arcs of light flashed through the garden like silk threads.

Plump berries fell down.

Then a burly but swift figure flashed continuously, collecting every single berry without missing one, finally placing them all in baskets under Urshifu's care, creating pleasant "thump thump" sounds of fruit collisions.

Witnessing this scene, Johan couldn't help but click his tongue.

"Fruit slicing?"

"Cha?" Tinkaton inquired.

Johan snapped back to attention, looked at the tools in his hands, and said with a twitching mouth:

"Pretty useful."

For the harvest and replanting, Tinkaton had forged him a complete set of farming tools.

Honestly... they were quite useful, but... it gave Johan the feeling of being a servant to "young masters and misses."

"Cha~"

Tinkaton nodded with satisfaction.

However, looking at these tools, Johan had some new ideas, for example...

"How about placing an order with the trio?"

With the trio's abilities, combined with their talents and sufficient funding, creating an intelligent robot for integrated planting and harvesting should be completely feasible, right?

"Larvitar, come till this area."

Johan called out.

"Yoji——"

Larvitar quickly raised its hand in response, indicating it understood.

But Johan still reminded it: "Remember, just till the soil. Don't eat all the dirt, or we won't have anything to plant later!"

In this area, Johan planned to develop land to try growing Revival Herbs.

Originally, Revival Herbs were extremely difficult to cultivate, with considerable requirements for climate, soil, and even cultivation techniques, and Johan didn't know much about this aspect of planting.

But now, with Calyrex's care, there might really be a chance to grow them successfully.

Then... Revival Herbs could be self-sufficient, and Gengar could have its fill of Revival Herb tea!

"If that doesn't work..." Johan lightly rubbed his chin, "if that doesn't work, I'll invite the Forces of Nature over to help."

Calyrex wasn't the only one who governed abundance - there were also the Forces of Nature.

In the anime, the Forces of Nature working together could even make "Revival Grass" grow in patches. A mere Revival Herb shouldn't be difficult.

"Ka-kaah~~"

While Johan was pondering how to grow Revival Herbs, Gengar carried two large watermelons to the garden's water pool, its eyes darting around.

It called to Ninetales.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales lightly breathed out, and ice crystals of various sizes immediately appeared at the bottom of the pool.

Seeing this, Gengar gave a thumbs up.

This kind of ice-type energy control that could create ice blocks at the bottom while keeping the entire water surface intact showed that Ninetales' mastery of ice-type energy had obviously become more skillful.

Then Gengar happily put both large watermelons in the water.

Chilled watermelon!

It was already July, and having a bite of chilled watermelon at this time would be... slurp

Gengar couldn't help but swallow its saliva.

Two hours later.

Johan wiped the sweat from his forehead and embraced Ninetales' tails, immediately feeling coolness that dispelled his post-labor fatigue.

"Comfortable..."

"Oowoo~~"

Ninetales had now mastered its ice-type energy control to perfection, able to maintain a temperature that would cool Johan without freezing him.

It was simply... the best summer mobile air conditioning, and intelligent too.

On the garden's large round table, various fruits were arranged.

There were berries, as well as some ordinary crops like corn, pumpkins, sweet potatoes, carrots, and other produce.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar placed two large watermelons on the table, and with Hatterene's swift knife work, the watermelons were evenly divided into dozens of similarly-sized pieces.

Red flesh, black seeds, fragrant juices seeping from the flesh, reflecting crystal-like light.

"Thanks to everyone's hard work, and Calyrex's gift!"

Johan led by example, putting his hands together in devout gratitude.

Not just thanking Calyrex, but also appreciating everyone's hard work.

The little ones followed suit and did the same.

Buzz—

The Calyrex wooden carving standing in the center of the garden flickered with a faint green glow that passed quickly without drawing much attention.

"Dig in!"

Johan was first to grab a piece of watermelon and take a bite.

The cool, crisp texture, the juice bursting in his mouth, the sweet nectar... definitely summer's number one fruit!

"Yoji!"

So sneaky!

Larvitar reacted slowest, and when it shouted, it found everyone had already started munching on their respective watermelons.

The little one immediately refused to be outdone, burying its head directly into the watermelon. Soon its cheeks were stained half-red.

When it lifted its head somewhat unsatisfied, smacking its lips and wondering if it could have another piece, it found Johan puffing his cheeks, looking at it with mischievous eyes.

Hm?

The next second.

Pew pew pew pew—

Black watermelon seeds shot from Johan's mouth.

"Taste my Seed Machine Gun!"

They hit Larvitar's little head, making crisp "tap tap tap" sounds.

For Larvitar, this naturally couldn't hurt, but it also realized...

You're supposed to spit out the seeds?!

Then it saw others like Gengar, Dragonite, Tinkaton, Urshifu, all unleashing their respective "Seed Machine Guns."

Even Victini, with its smaller mouth and unfinished watermelon, was now going pew, pew, pew...

One seed per bite, eating and spitting alternately, having great fun.

Eh?

Suddenly, everyone looked at Ceruledge, who wore a metal mask.

"Goka..."

Under everyone's gaze, Ceruledge half-turned its head, pretending not to see.

Gengar's eyes darted, and taking advantage of everyone's attention being on Ceruledge, it quickly grabbed another piece of watermelon from the table and stuffed it whole into its mouth.

Though its movements were swift, they couldn't escape everyone's perception.

So everyone rejoined the watermelon-eating "brigade."

Only this time, when everyone wanted to use "Seed Machine Gun," their target was surprisingly unanimous.

"Yoji~~"

Larvitar grinned mischievously.

Johan's expression immediately changed.

"No, don't, we should..."

Pew pew pew pew—

Countless watermelon seeds came flying at him.

Larvitar still found it insufficient and shouted, "Yoji!"

Taste my Mount Tai Crush!

"No, Larvitar, with your weight——!!"

CRASH——!!

The sun set westward, dusk illuminating half the sky.

After playing around for a while.

Johan straightened his glasses, brushed the dirt off his body, and looked with annoyance at the little ones in front of him who were "focused" on eliminating food, as if nothing had happened before.

"Garruu~"

Dragonite patted its belly with satisfaction.

Whew—

Johan slowly exhaled, looking at the round table that had been piled with food and was now mostly consumed.

At this rate, one harvest from the garden wouldn't be enough for this group of "big eaters" for even two or three meals.

Of course, this didn't include ordinary foods like pumpkins and sweet potatoes that needed cooking before being edible.

"Well, having something is better than nothing."

Johan was philosophical about it.

What kind of situation and appetite his little ones had - others might not know, but how could he not?

Every little bit helped.

"Puri~Puri puri puri puri puri~Puri puri puri~~"

Well-fed and satisfied, Jigglypuff found a decent spot, picked up its microphone marker, and began singing, sharing its post-meal joy.

Its singing was indeed very beautiful, and for other Pokémon it might have strong hypnotic effects, but for Old Johan's family Pokémon...

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar immediately became interested and stood together with Jigglypuff.

"Ka-kaah~Ka-kaah~"

Its voice cough cough, really wasn't worth complimenting, but this time it restrained itself from using Perish Song, which made Johan quite pleased.

Our little ghost has finally grown up...

If only its singing could be a bit better...

Johan smiled, gently stroking Ninetales' soft fur, and hummed along softly.

On a summer night, as cicada calls gradually faded, cheerful melodies drifted from the courtyard, making anyone - human or Pokémon - who happened to hear them unconsciously smile.
