# 622: Devon Corporation Spokesperson (Two-in-One Chapter)

July 11th, Wednesday.

"Anyway, I've already highlighted all the key points for the exam. Good luck, everyone!"

Johan held a thick book and gestured encouragingly to the densely packed students in the lecture hall below.

"Vii!!"

Victini made a rare appearance, sending "Victory's Blessing" to the students.

However, the students below already wore expressions of defeat, even despair.

Key points?

Highlighting most of the book?

As an experienced teacher, Roxanne commented:

"You'll get used to it. Last semester Teacher Johan highlighted an entire book. This time it's only most of the book - that already counts as 'key points.'"

As a top student, Roxanne naturally had no major problems, but Flannery beside her... her hair was getting so frazzled it was approaching Flint's level.

"Teacher."

Johan was caught up to by Steven as he left the classroom.

In terms of academics, Steven naturally had no issues.

"What's up?"

"After final exams end, I'm planning to go to Kalos again. Do you still need diamonds, Teacher?" Steven asked while walking toward the training room alongside Johan.

Diamonds...

The image of Larvitar eating diamonds like candy flashed through Johan's mind.

Even though diamonds in the Pokémon world weren't ridiculously overpriced due to marketing, they were still much more expensive than ordinary minerals.

But there was no choice...

Johan thought of his bank account balance and gritted his teeth:

"Please bring me some."

"Alright." Steven made a mental note of this.

The two arrived at the training room to see...

"Aggron!" Steven's Aggron stood with a serious expression, its body like a small mountain while covered in a brilliant metallic sheen.

Iron Defense!

"Yoji!"

Larvitar, looking tiny next to Aggron, mimicked Aggron's movements with an adorable roar, its body similarly covered in metallic luster.

Iron Defense!

Seeing this, Steven's eyes lit up with admiration:

"Larvitar's progress is really fast. That Iron Defense already looks quite solid."

As someone passionate about Steel and Rock-type Pokémon, Steven could tell at a glance how strong Larvitar's Iron Defense was.

"After eating so many minerals, even if it's just the accumulated minerals, the hardness shouldn't be low," Johan said.

The investment he'd made in Larvitar... he'd really spent a fortune.

Both being pseudo-legendary Pokémon, when Dragonite was still a Dratini, compared to Larvitar, Johan's training pressure had been so much lighter.

Facts proved that not everyone could easily raise pseudo-legendary Pokémon.

"Teacher, aren't you planning to let Larvitar evolve yet?"

Steven noticed the Everstone hanging around Larvitar's neck and looked somewhat puzzled.

With Larvitar's current strength and the energy accumulated in its body, it could definitely evolve into Pupitar.

But due to the Everstone's restriction, Larvitar remained in its initial form.

"Let's wait a bit longer. Even after evolving into Pupitar, it would need to accumulate power for transformation anyway, so it's better to let it accumulate more while still a Larvitar."

Although after evolving into Pupitar it would temporarily stop eating, once it evolved into Tyranitar...

Moreover, Giovanni's "Earth's Mysteries" had mentioned more than once that early accumulation was very important for Larvitar-type Pokémon. If necessary, delaying its evolution progress was acceptable.

However... cases like Johan's where he "delayed" evolution while providing so much food were truly rare, almost nonexistent.

Even Larvitar's "diet" included fragments of the Earth Plate - this was absolutely unique in the Pokémon world.

Steven nodded with understanding.

Every trainer had their own plans and directions for raising their Pokémon. Steven wouldn't say much about it, just gained some insight.

After chatting a bit more, Steven excused himself to prepare for final exams.

Johan then turned to lead his little ones in consuming energy - no, training.

"Ka-kaah!"

After finishing basic training, Gengar lay on the ceiling scrolling through its phone.

In this regard, Gengar was also part of the heavy internet surfing demographic. For current events and news, it often learned about them first before telling Johan.

Sure enough, it floated over excitedly to show Johan the news it had just seen.

Johan glanced at it...

"'Pokémon Triathlon Competition'?"

In the Pokémon world, the so-called "triathlon" wasn't the traditional bicycle, running, and swimming.

Instead, it referred to: racing, strength, and swimming.

"No." Johan pressed Gengar's head, leaned closer to the screen, and pointed at the first event "racing" in the triathlon: "Do you think any of our family could serve as this 'mount'?"

Everything else was fine, but for racing you at least needed a mount, right?

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar scratched its butt and looked toward Rotom.

Hey? Doesn't Rotom-Bike count as a mount?

"What do you think?" Johan said irritably.

If it were a "real triathlon" that would be fine - Rotom-Bike's horsepower was definitely top-tier, but racing...

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar pounded its fist into its palm and pointed toward Ninetales, who was practicing Moonblast nearby.

"Oowoo?"

Ninetales seemed to sense something and cast a puzzled glance over.

Johan's mouth twitched.

Forget about whether they could even ride Ninetales due to its size - who could withstand the unconscious cold emanating from Ninetales when it ran at full speed?

Others got hot spring eggs; you'd get frozen eggs, right?

"Gengar, you have bad intentions, don't you? You can just say it directly - no need to drag Ninetales into this."

Johan pressed his fists against both sides of Gengar's head, giving it a left-right temple massage.

"Ka-, Ka-kaah..."

Gengar quickly laughed awkwardly while escaping Johan's "restraint," its eyes spinning around.

If, if that doesn't work... I'll do it!

"You?"

Johan looked up and down at this purple little fatty.

Black mist suddenly swirled around Gengar, and then "Transforming Gengar" made its debut.

"Ka-kaah!"

Tell me, what kind of mount do you want? Rapidash? Mudsdale? Zebstrika?

Sure enough, after the black mist swirled around Gengar's body, it really simulated the appearance of several equine Pokémon.

It wasn't just equine Pokémon either - it also transformed into Dodrio, Rhyhorn, and other Pokémon that could participate in "racing."

"You think you're Spectrier," Johan lightly rubbed his forehead.

But since Gengar was willing to make such a "sacrifice," it showed that it was genuinely interested in this kind of fun competition.

Johan scanned through the Pokémon used by contestants in the previous "Pokémon Triathlon" racing events.

Rapidash, Mudsdale, Zebstrika, Galarian Rapidash...

Speaking of which, Galarian Rapidash was the most "eye-catching," making him hum the "Sunshine Rainbow Little White Horse" tune unconsciously.

"What about the swimming event then?"

The strength event went without saying - Johan's family might not have much else, but they had plenty of strong ones. Even Gengar could throw punches.

But the swimming event...

They couldn't have Urshifu swim with Johan riding on its back, right?

Others used Blastoise, Lapras, Sharpedo, Gyarados... at worst, they could ride a Starmie.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar rested its chin on its hand and tentatively spoke.

How about I transform into a Blastoise for you?

Johan: "..."

So you're going to handle everything yourself?

"We'll think about it later," Johan waved his hand.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar's ears drooped dejectedly, and it let out a deflated "oh" before turning to walk away.

Seeing it like this, even though he knew it was acting, Johan still asked: "Where's it being held?"

Gengar's drooping ears immediately perked up.

"Ka-kaah!"

It pointed at the "Pokémon Triathlon" venue on the screen - the Kalos region!

And one of the organizers was even the Flare-Life Laboratory.

Why did everything recently point to the Kalos region?

Johan was planning to take his little ones on a vacation during summer break, though he hadn't decided on the location yet. His first choice was actually the Alola region.

Sunshine, beaches, islands, bikinis...

Honestly, in the entire Pokémon world, there was nowhere better for vacation than the Alola region.

After all, without much major development, Alola's pristine landscapes and environment were quite attractive, and Johan had never been to the Alola region either.

But going to Alola in summer carried certain "risks" - easy to get tanned, with excessive temperature and sunlight.

In terms of "danger" levels, the Alola and Kalos regions really weren't that different.

Alola often had random Ultra Beast crossing incidents, with Anabel serving as head of the "UB Task Force" handling such matters.

Additionally, Alola had... a mysterious girl who might fish up Dhelmise or Lugia.

As for other regions... they temporarily didn't have as much appeal.

And the Kalos region, besides tourism and vacation, what attracted Johan most - aside from his beloved coffee and being the birthplace of Fairy-types - should be Carbink.

Carbink that could produce diamonds!

Not considering Diancie, the legendary mythical Pokémon, but Carbink... was still worth coveting.

"If nothing else works... maybe take a trip to the Kalos region?"

Last time Professor Sycamore was planning to convene a research conference, but later due to the "World Coronation Series," Johan and many Pokémon professors like Professor Oak and Professor Rowan focused more attention on the tournament, so the conference was temporarily postponed.

"Teacher."

Steven suddenly returned.

"What's wrong?"

"I forgot to mention earlier... I wonder when you'd have time? My father wants to invite you to dinner at home." Steven smiled.

Dinner?

"It's just ordinary dinner. Roxanne and the others should be coming too." Perhaps worried Johan might overthink it, Steven added.

Johan had been to Steven's house more than once or twice, but before he could react, Gengar and the other little foodies immediately expressed their positions.

"Ka-kaah!"

I'm free today!

Not just Gengar - Larvitar, Dragonite, and Urshifu all nodded in agreement.

Steven looked at Johan.

Johan lightly rubbed his forehead, feeling somewhat embarrassed, but still said: "I should be free anytime recently."

"How about tonight then?"

"Fine."

Getting a definitive answer, Steven quickly left again, saying he needed to inform Joseph Stone so the house could start preparations.

As for why Gengar and the others were so eager to eat at Steven's house...

Please, the richest person in Rustboro City, even the richest in the Hoenn region - aside from good and abundant food, wouldn't this save money on a meal?

Even Gengar would eat and take extras, saving money on late-night snacks.

Only their eating habits whenever they went for meals made Johan feel like... he was sorry for not feeding his little ones properly.

"Let's think about vacation destinations later then."

Not being enthusiastic about eating shows problematic thinking.

Johan clapped his hands and called out:

"Increase training intensity! Move, move, move!"

Clear your stomachs - that's the greatest respect for your host!

Evening, as the sun set westward.

The hazy sunset covered the entire city with a layer of faint orange-red gauze, with light and shadow weaving together into an evening glow symphony.

At the Stone family estate in Rustboro City, after driving through the grounds for some time, the car stopped in front of a castle-like building.

"Teacher."

Steven had been waiting at the entrance and came forward to open the car door for Johan.

Joseph Stone, who had been busy rolling up his sleeves on the lawn, also walked over with a cheerful smile.

"Teacher Johan."

"Mr. Stone."

They were quite familiar with each other, so no excessive pleasantries were needed - just a simple greeting.

Later, Roxanne, Flannery, and even Sonia and Penny arrived.

Compared to Roxanne and Flannery, who were "regulars," this was Sonia and Penny's first time at Steven's house.

Sonia was fine, but Penny was naturally introverted and shy. She had improved considerably under Johan's guidance, otherwise she probably wouldn't have dared come to tonight's dinner.

According to "tradition," Steven would show everyone his "collection" as a little pre-dinner program.

Before the group headed to Steven's storage room:

"Teacher, I heard you crushed Arceus?" Flannery seemed to have just learned this news and asked with some excitement.

Arceus?

Roxanne, walking alongside, looked stunned.

Was this... the Arceus she knew of?

Unlike Roxanne, Sonia and Penny showed confusion.

"Arceus? Is that some kind of Pokémon?"

As Galarians, while Sonia came to Hoenn for advanced studies, she hadn't yet begun learning about Sinnoh region's mythology.

"The Creator God, Arceus..." Steven briefly explained what Arceus was to them.

After hearing this...

Sonia's eyes widened, and even the usually shy Penny looked utterly incredulous.

This was the legendary Creator God!

Their teacher had crushed it?

Johan rubbed his forehead somewhat helplessly: "Where did you hear that?"

Wasn't this news supposed to be blocked?

Even if Flannery's grandfather was a former Fire-type Elite Four of Hoenn...

"Some fiery-haired guy online said it," Flannery blinked.

Johan: "..."

Damn, it's Flint again...

During the Alamos Town incident, the rumor "Teacher Johan punched Dialga and Palkia to pieces" was also spread by Flint.

Flint, just wait... Johan made a mental note with gritted teeth.

Next time I'll definitely call Arceus over so you two can have a nice chat!

"You believe whatever people say? Is Arceus something that can just be crushed?" Johan said irritably.

Steven glanced at Johan and smiled without saying anything.

Others might not know the situation, but as Hoenn's prospective Elite Four member, even considered a Champion candidate, and with his status as Devon's young heir, Steven knew the truth.

Arceus had indeed been crushed, though it later reformed.

"I thought it was real..." Flannery pouted quietly.

Johan shook his head.

The group arrived at Steven's storage room, which displayed various stones in dazzling array - some placed on shelves, others in individual glass-sealed containers.

Johan firmly gripped Larvitar's trembling Luxury Ball, then "clicked" it locked.

He couldn't let Larvitar out to cause havoc - these were all stones Steven had painstakingly collected.

Some stones might not be worth much, but each one was Steven's treasure.

"This is..."

Sonia noticed a strangely shaped stone in a glass-sealed container, one that faintly emanated pale red glowing patterns, and said with surprise:

"A Wishing Star?"

"Yes," Steven said. "I found it at a meteor crash site after a meteor shower."

"It really is a Wishing Star..." Johan stepped closer.

"Teacher Johan knows about it too?" Sonia asked.

Steven, Roxanne, and Flannery also cast puzzled glances.

Although he'd collected this Wishing Star, honestly Steven just considered it a rather special meteorite.

"Professor Magnolia's research findings. Apparently Wishing Stars are the main material for making Dynamax Bands in the Galar region, capable of absorbing Galar particles."

In the Galar region, the popularization of Dynamax was largely thanks to the joint research between Professor Magnolia and Macro Cosmos - creating Dynamax Bands from Wishing Stars.

However, Professor Magnolia gradually saw through Macro Cosmos President Rose's unscrupulous methods and stopped cooperating with them.

But because of this, aside from Macro Cosmos, only Sonia's grandmother Professor Magnolia could make Dynamax Bands in the Galar region.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar pressed against the glass, looking at the faintly glowing Wishing Star inside, feeling like...

it seemed to have some connection with him...

"What's this thing that looks similar to the Wishing Star..." Flannery pointed at a nearby meteorite-like stone.

"Those are shells shed by Minior," Steven smiled.

Minior and Wishing Stars did look somewhat similar.

"More meteorites..." Flannery murmured.

"From a certain perspective, Minior can't really be considered a type of meteorite," Roxanne said seriously while holding her books.

"Hm?"

Facing Flannery's confusion, Roxanne continued:

"According to research, Minior actually originate in the stratosphere, living in the ozone layer as special Pokémon born from mutated nanoparticles."

"Roxanne's advanced Pokémon knowledge is quite good," Teacher Johan praised.

"It's, it's nothing much..."

Hearing praise, Roxanne's cheeks reddened.

"Steven, it looks like your collection is missing two colors?" Johan counted five Minior shells total.

Minior lived by absorbing floating dust around them, determining their core's color based on the composition of atmospheric dust they consumed.

They could display seven completely different core colors: red, orange, yellow, green, light blue, blue, and purple, corresponding to rainbow colors.

It was said that when Minior absorbed many dust particles and became heavy, they would fall to the ground. Their shells were extremely hard, but the intense impact of hitting the ground would shatter them into fragments.

So complete Minior shells were very rare and precious, let alone collecting shells of all seven different core colors.

Moreover, if Minior's core remained exposed after falling, it would quickly dissipate, becoming invisible nanoparticles returning to the ozone layer.

Of course, if Minior were captured, they wouldn't dissipate.

They had a very special and unique ability - Shields Down!

[Shields Down: When HP is above 50%, maintains meteor form and won't fall into abnormal or drowsy states. When HP is below 50%, changes to core form - Defense and Special Defense stats decrease, but Attack, Special Attack, and Speed stats greatly increase.]

Somewhat similar to Aegislash's form switching.

But unlike Aegislash, the switching condition depended on HP status, and when switching to core form, Minior's total base stats would increase by 60 points!

Equivalent to a mini-Mega Evolution.

However, Johan's biggest impression of Minior was...

They were Rayquaza's "snacks."

"Mm, still missing green and purple. I haven't been able to find them," Steven said.

Minior were rare enough, complete shells even rarer, let alone collecting all seven colors.

Even Steven hadn't managed to collect them all.

It was one of his current pursuits.

Johan rubbed his chin thoughtfully.

If there's a chance... maybe he could ask Rayquaza for help, he thought.

After all, Minior that were hard for others to find were just "snacks" in Rayquaza's eyes - the ozone layer was Rayquaza's territory.

"Oh right."

Steven seemed to remember something and walked to a nearby cabinet, opening a drawer and taking out two wooden boxes.

Under everyone's somewhat puzzled gazes, Steven smiled and opened the boxes, revealing their contents.

"Vii?" Victini emerged from invisibility, sensing a rather pure energy fluctuation.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar seemed to notice something too and squeezed its head over.

"This is..." Sonia looked surprised.

"Z-Crystals." Even the usually quiet Penny unconsciously whispered.

Z-Crystals!

Johan naturally recognized at first glance what these two pigeon egg-sized diamonds in the wooden boxes were, so his expression became somewhat stiff.

But his locked Larvitar Luxury Ball began shaking again.

Z-Crystals were essential items for using Z-Moves, and from a certain perspective, their value... equaled Mega Stones.

It was just that compared to the currently popular Mega Evolution, perhaps because the Alola region was relatively remote, not many people knew about Z-Moves.

As for Penny...

It was because Johan had mentioned the Eevee-exclusive "Eevium Z" to her once, so she paid special attention to Z-Crystals and Z-Moves.

Steven nodded: "That's right, these are two Z-Crystals. One is Groundium Z, the other I'm not sure about - it looks like Ghostium Z, but something doesn't feel quite right..."

The two Z-Crystals flowed with earthy yellow earth patterns and deep, dark patterns respectively.

Steven pushed both wooden boxes toward Johan.

Hm?

Johan was stunned.

"I already have one Groundium Z, and I'm not sure if the other is Ghostium Z. I thought Teacher would know better than me," Steven said.

The young philanthropist is at it again?

Johan straightened his expression and said seriously: "Steven, you don't know what kind of person I am—"

Although his student was famously a "philanthropist," as a teacher, Johan could only reluctantly try to maintain his principles and not let money "corrupt" his inner "standards."

Before he could finish speaking, Steven quickly said:

"Teacher, this is payment."

"Payment?"

"Devon's Pokémon Ecological Park that we built wants you to be our spokesperson," Steven said seriously.

Pokémon Ecological Park?

Johan knew about this.

When Devon Corporation took on the "Rusturf Tunnel" project, at his suggestion, they had already started building the ecological park, which seemed to be fully completed now.

But...

Spokesperson?

Johan's expression was complex.

Z-Crystals currently commanded outrageous prices on the market, not much less than Mega Stones.

While Z-Crystals' enhancement effects weren't as strong as Mega Evolution, Z-Crystals had broader applicability - most didn't require specific Pokémon, and compared to Mega Evolution, usage conditions were somewhat lower.

These two were easily worth tens of millions.

Being a spokesperson once for tens of millions would definitely be good business, but the problem was... Z-Crystals!

No matter what Z-Crystal, no matter how much benefit it brought, using Z-Moves required dancing embarrassing dances!

So annoying.

But thinking again...

Z-Crystals were extremely rare. Currently, the only known way to obtain them was through "Island Trials" in the Alola region.

How could trainers who obtained Z-Crystals this way possibly sell them?

Only someone like Steven, whose family literally owned mines, and lots of them, might have an extremely small chance of mining Z-Crystals while extracting ore.

Most Z-Crystals appearing on the market were produced this way.

So even if he didn't use them... he could sell them for high prices.

Thinking this way, he felt much better.

Johan stopped restricting Larvitar and unlocked the Luxury Ball - it ran out on its own.

It stared longingly at the wooden box containing Groundium Z, drool flowing from the corner of its mouth.

"This is a Z-Crystal. You really can't eat this," Johan said righteously.

This one alone was worth ten million - if you really took a bite, he truly couldn't afford to raise you anymore.

Moreover, could Larvitar even digest Z-Crystals?

But remembering Larvitar's Earth Plate fragment, Johan immediately dismissed such "dismissive" thoughts.

Maybe Larvitar really could digest it for you to see.

"Yo-, Yoji..." Larvitar laughed awkwardly.

I, I won't eat it, I'll just lick it...

Johan: "..."

The little one's awkward expression drew laughter from Johan's students.

"So cute," Roxanne made no effort to hide her affection for Larvitar.

"Yo-, Yoji... (ˊˋ)*"

Well, it's alright...

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar's attention focused more on the other box containing what seemed to flow with ghostly energy - the dark Z-Crystal.

This definitely wasn't Ghostium Z.

Steven's judgment in this area wouldn't be wrong.

But Gengar felt like it had some connection to this Z-Crystal.

Not really a connection - it just felt like it could resonate with it somehow.

Strange.

Gengar scratched its butt.

"No need to think about it - this is the rarer Marshadium Z," Johan provided the answer.

"Marshadium Z?" Everyone looked confused.

Among Z-Crystals, there was a batch of special Z-Crystals that could only be used by specific Pokémon, such as: Eevium Z, Pikanium Z, Snorlium Z, etc., including Marshadium Z.

It could enhance Marshadow's Spectral Thief move to - Seven-Star Soul-Stealing Kick.

Cough, the name wasn't particularly important - just know that this move had 195 power!

Specific Z-Crystals were rarer than ordinary Z-Crystals, and undoubtedly more expensive.

But!

If it were exclusive Eevium Z, Pikanium Z, Snorlium Z, that would be fine.

But Marshadium Z - how many people in the entire Pokémon world could capture Marshadow?

This Z-Crystal, no matter how rare, couldn't be used by anyone, so it couldn't sell for a good price.

Unless someone collected it.

Johan felt he'd been "tricked."

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar didn't feel tricked at all, just enlightened.

I see...

Wonder if I could use this Z-Crystal?

Although Gengar hadn't fully learned Marshadow's Spectral Thief - like learning Dark Void from Darkrai, it had found an alternative way to master it.

But mastered was mastered - Gengar's "Spectral Thief" wasn't much inferior to Marshadow's genuine version.

Perhaps...

Gengar could also use this Marshadium Z?

If so, this Marshadium Z would be quite interesting.

However, regardless...

While Marshadium Z might not have many people in the Pokémon world who could use it, Johan barely qualified as someone with that slight chance.

After all, he was the "Rainbow Hero" recognized by both Ho-Oh and Marshadow, and his relationship with "Shadow Guide" Marshadow wasn't ordinarily close.

It was just that Marshadow had gone off to handle its own business recently, otherwise Johan could have taken Marshadow home to try it out.

Steven's gift this time hadn't gone to the wrong person.

"Everyone."

Joseph Stone appeared at Steven's storage room entrance and called out:

"Dinner is ready."

# 623: Father and Son (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Thank you for the hospitality." Johan bowed slightly toward Joseph Stone with a serious expression.

"Hahaha—"

The old gentleman looked delighted. He loved this kind of lively atmosphere - everyone gathering to eat together, chatting about ideals and discussing life. This was truly what the old man enjoyed most.

Unfortunately, he had his son late in life, and only one son at that. More importantly, this son hadn't yet reached marriageable age, preventing him from holding grandchildren, which worried him so much his hair had turned white.

So today, inviting Johan and Steven's good classmates and friends for dinner made him very happy.

After dinner ended, everyone chatted together in the garden for a while before concluding. The time was already quite late.

As a private car took Johan and the others away, Joseph Stone and Steven, this father and son pair, walked side by side back to their residence under the night sky.

"Steven," the old gentleman looked gratified, "having such a teacher to guide you puts my mind at ease."

Steven used to struggle between being a trainer, inheriting the family business, and searching for stones, but since meeting Johan, the confusion and hesitation on Steven's face had disappeared, replaced by full confidence.

"That's Teacher Johan for you." Steven looked proud.

"I remember when you were only this tall, crying every day for me to take you stone hunting."

The old gentleman bent down, gesturing Steven's childhood height with his hand, then looked at his son beside him with some emotion:

"Now you're taller than me..."

Hearing the old gentleman's description, Steven didn't know whether to laugh or cry. "Did I really cry?"

"Didn't you?" The old gentleman turned his head. "I think it was when you were in first grade? Whether you fell down or what, your face was all dirty, with snot and tears..."

Steven's face reddened, and he quickly looked back to make sure no one heard before sighing with relief, saying somewhat helplessly:

"That was when I was little. Besides, Dad, you've gotten fatter than back then too..."

Steven silently added: And older too.

"Eh? Fatter?" The old gentleman patted his round belly without feeling it. "I'm still the looks and center-stage star among us old buddies."

As he spoke, he took out a recent photograph.

Definitely the center-stage star, with the other three from left to right being: Drake, Ultima, and Hachi.

"See?"

But Steven couldn't help breaking out in a cold sweat... When I get old, I won't be like this, will I?

Looking at the photo, Joseph Stone was still quite satisfied, patting his belly with a smile: "Chatting with Johan and the others made me hungry. Come on, father and son, let's get some late-night snacks."

Steven: "..."

Now he understood why his father's physique had changed so much.

However, when the two arrived at the kitchen and saw five professional chefs sitting back-to-back on the ground, completely exhausted, they couldn't help but twitch their eyes.

One dinner... exhausted five professional chefs?

When they learned that Joseph Stone and young master Steven wanted a bowl of noodles, the head chef indicated:

"...There really are no ingredients left, nothing at all..."

The old gentleman said: "Nothing left again? Didn't I say... to purchase ingredients at five times the previous amount?"

Last time they invited Teacher Johan for dinner, all the kitchen ingredients were completely consumed, making the old gentleman feel embarrassed and worried that Johan and his Pokémon hadn't eaten enough, so this time he specifically ordered a super increase.

Unexpectedly...

The father and son looked at each other.

During dinner just now... they really hadn't paid much attention to this aspect.

The head chef looked ashen: "Gone, completely gone..."

The old gentleman opened his mouth: "Son, how many cooks does Teacher Johan's house usually have?"

"One, I think." Steven scratched his head somewhat embarrassedly: "I remember it's all cooked by the teacher himself..."

The two unconsciously looked at each other, the same word rising in both their hearts.

Impressive!

The father and son both revealed knowing smiles.

This father and son pair...

July 16th, light rain fell from the sky.

Kanaz Pokémon Academy's final exams were in full swing.

With summer vacation approaching, Johan was spending more time training with his family's Pokémon.

Summer travel was a set plan. After leaving Hoenn, there might not be suitable training facilities everywhere.

The main issue was that his little ones were too destructive - one careless moment might require compensation, so it was better to do more training before departure.

After arranging training tasks for his little ones, Johan sat aside and took out the Wheel of Time that Arceus had given him.

The golden Wheel of Time emitted a faint white glow, clearly valuable at first glance... cough.

"Gave me the thing but didn't explain how to use it or what it does..."

Johan couldn't help complaining internally.

When did riddle-speakers invade the Pokémon world?

However, there was one thing he had discovered when he first received the Wheel of Time.

Focusing his attention slightly, a powerful aura spread outward from Johan in all directions.

Buzz—

In just an instant, most of the vast Kanaz Pokémon Academy almost "appeared" in his field of vision.

After receiving Arceus's "blessing," Johan's aura had greatly improved.

Although he still couldn't hand-rub Aura Spheres like Ash, his aura sensing ability had improved remarkably, both in range and detail.

For example, right now he was clearly sitting in the training room, but his aura could sense the distant teaching building...

Third-year Class 5, the student sitting in the fourth row, fourth seat - yes, you! Take out that cheat sheet!

He could even "see" clearly what was written on the sheet.

"It's good that this ability fell into the hands of someone like me, otherwise... probably not a single bathhouse in Rustboro City would be safe..." Johan felt he was truly a teacher who maintained his principles.

Moreover, and more importantly, besides superficial sensing, Johan's ability to sense emotions had become clearer.

Not only could he feel the inner emotions of Pokémon and humans, but he could also better transmit his own emotions, goodwill, malice, etc., to others, even influence their emotions.

"It's simply a 'relationship artifact,' no, a plus version at that."

Of course, such aura could also play a huge role in battle.

Setting aside enhancement, by observing opponents' expressions and inner emotions meticulously, taking in opponents' Pokémon's movements, emotions, and expressions completely, he could roughly predict what opponents wanted to do.

"Riley once said that every Aura Guardian's aura has its own focus."

Riley's aura characteristic was application - he could project his aura to create barrier-like abilities or hand-rub aura attacks, which was the result of his continuous training as an Aura Guardian.

Ash's aura... Johan guessed it was justice. When justice and sense of mission exploded, Ash's aura would also explode.

And Johan's own aura - as a Pokémon psychologist, what he was best at was interpreting Pokémon psychology, so his aura might be influence? Or inner strengthening? In any case, it was emotional and perceptual abilities.

"I feel like I'm going further and further down the path of being a Pokémon 'charmer'..." Johan couldn't help complaining internally.

Anyway, the [Pokédex] was becoming increasingly irrelevant.

Putting aside scattered thoughts, Johan looked at the Wheel of Time in his hand and gradually injected aura into it.

Soon, he actually felt the Wheel of Time feedback an emotion of... more, a little more, give me more.

Wheel of Time: (´∀`)

Johan: "..."

He took out the Rainbow Wing and slowly injected aura. The feedback was: full, already full, can't hold anymore, going to overflow!

Rainbow Wing: (>﹏<)

So all these things are "alive," right?

However, as aura was injected, through the Wheel of Time, Johan vaguely sensed Arceus's existence, seemingly sleeping in a very mysterious place.

At the same time, he also felt the Wheel of Time's faint guidance, directing him toward a distant direction.

If nothing unexpected, it was probably the Kalos region.

More importantly...

Buzz—

One of the four emerald green diamonds embedded in the corners of the Wheel of Time emitted a faint light, and a milky white barrier centered on the Wheel of Time appeared, enveloping Johan.

Hm?

"This is..."

"Oowoo?"

Ninetales, who was relatively close to Johan, noticed the changes around his body and couldn't help trotting over.

Seeing this, Johan quickly comforted: "Ninetales, I'm fine."

But his words were obviously unnecessary. Ninetales looked at the milky white glow around him, its light blue crystalline eyes flowing with light, and let out a gentle whine.

Around Ninetales's body, a similar glow gradually appeared, completely enveloping it while making the already crystalline-looking Ninetales gradually become mysterious and hazy.

"Safeguard?"

Johan understood the move Ninetales had used.

But this was a move Ninetales had never mastered before!

At the same time, Johan realized that the glow enveloping him through the Wheel of Time was also Safeguard.

Was this one of the Wheel of Time's functions?

After activating with aura, it could protect the user.

Honestly, this ability seemed quite useful in the wild, for wild battles, or unrestricted battles.

After all, the rules only restricted Pokémon to carrying one item, but didn't restrict how many items trainers could carry, right?

"Oowoo~~"

Ninetales nodded with realization, and the Safeguard around its body gradually faded.

Wait.

Johan's expression gradually became strange.

Ninetales definitely hadn't mastered Safeguard before, but now after just one look... it learned it.

Your learning ability...

Even for our own family's Pokémon, I can't help wanting to report this.

Watching Ninetales run off happily, Johan thought of something else.

"Safeguard - if I could really learn to hand-rub aura and construct aura barriers, wouldn't I... be going further and further down the path of 'humanoid Pokémon'?"

Maybe a new term would be born.

Super Hoenn Human?

"Tsk, quite interesting..."

Café, private Pokémon Psychology Clinic.

A woman dressed as a lady, wearing a wide-brimmed round hat, looked worriedly at the Pokémon beside her.

Johan, sitting in the main seat, maintained a professional smile and said:

"Madam, don't worry. It's just some emotional issues."

The lady held a handkerchief and looked stunned: "Emotional issues?"

Johan spread his hands: "Commonly known as heartbreak."

"So little Meow was heartbroken? I remember it used to play quite well with a Persian. After little Meow evolved, it seems like it rarely saw that Persian..."

Johan was also helpless about this. He looked at the Pokémon lying at the lady's feet with a lifeless expression - this was a... Purrloin!

As everyone knew, Purrloin was the evolved form of Glameow. Before evolution, Glameow indeed had outstanding looks as its name suggested, but after evolution...

Johan remembered there was a similar plot in the anime. Meowth should have deep understanding of this.

"Cough, it's fine. Usually, one 'hypnotherapy session' is enough." Johan coughed lightly.

"Really?" The lady's eyes immediately lit up. "Then please, Teacher Johan!"

Johan was about to call Ninetales.

But thinking about it, if he let Purrloin see Ninetales, it might... suffer a critical hit to its heart.

So he called: "Jigglypuff."

"Puri?"

Jigglypuff, who had been hiding outside the door, heard Johan call and knew it had a chance to "perform." It immediately trotted in with "puff puff" steps.

Jumping onto the table, it picked up the microphone and began to sing.

Although the audience was small, it didn't prevent Jigglypuff from being fully committed.

"Puri~Puri puri puri puri puri~Puri puri puri~~"

After one song, both the lady and Purrloin on the ground were fast asleep.

"Puri! (｀∀´)︻デ═一"

Seeing this, Jigglypuff's entire body puffed up like a balloon.

It pulled out the microphone and began its "operation."

Soon, when Johan finished his aura "treatment," he saw that both the lady and Purrloin's faces had been covered with Jigglypuff's signature graffiti.

However, Johan was already skilled at this - this was just a "side effect" of having Jigglypuff help with hypnosis.

"Rotom, come wash the floor - no, wash faces."

"Roger, Rotom!"

When the lady and Purrloin woke up, Johan happily earned a substantial "consultation fee," adding another brick to this family's foundation.

He didn't know when it started, but Johan's "Pokémon Psychology Clinic" was gradually trending toward becoming a "Pokémon Relationship Counseling Room."

Among the people and Pokémon seeking help, there were increasingly more Pokémon with psychological problems due to emotional issues.

But it wasn't surprising.

After all, Pokémon themselves were beings with independent consciousness and intelligence. Talking about love wasn't abnormal.

Heartbreak, unrequited love, secret crushes, puppy love - everything existed.

Cross-species and cross-group romances weren't uncommon either.

Like his own Gengar, hadn't it always liked Cinccino?

Every time it watched "Cinccino Adventures," it had that perverted look: hehe, Cinccino, hehe, my Cinccino...

"Why don't you learn from me..."

Johan took out his phone and called Cynthia.

Time passed quickly during the call.

"I have another call coming in." Johan looked at his phone.

"Okay, take care of yourself~"

"Mm."

He ended the call.

The incoming call showed Officer Jenny - Rustboro City's Officer Jenny.

He pressed the answer button.

"Teacher Johan." Officer Jenny's slightly serious voice came through.

Hearing this, Johan's heart skipped a beat.

Could it be... Team Magma or Team Aqua were causing trouble again?

"Officer Jenny, please go ahead. I'm listening."

But Officer Jenny's voice quickly relaxed.

"There's good news and even better news. Which would you like to hear first?"

Johan: "..."

If it's all good news, why was your voice so serious before?

How scary...

Seeing Johan didn't respond, Officer Jenny on the other end playfully stuck out her tongue and stopped teasing him, saying:

"The good news is that our League Police Department is planning a simulation exercise and wants to invite Teacher Johan to participate as a special instructor."

Simulation exercise?

Special instructor?

"I don't think I'm suitable."

Although Johan held the rank of Inspector in the International Police - a very high rank - he knew his own situation and really knew nothing about this area.

"Suitable, how could you not be suitable?" Officer Jenny quickly said.

"Cough cough. What about the other even better news?" Johan decided to hear about the second matter first.

When mentioning the second piece of news, Officer Jenny's voice became heavy.

"Teacher Johan, about the Pokémon hunter matter you asked us to investigate - we have leads."

Hm?

Hearing this, Johan frowned, sat up straight, and his expression became serious.

The only Pokémon hunter matter he had asked Rustboro City's Officer Jenny to investigate was - the full story of how his Ninetales was captured and sold to the Hoenn region.

That little Vulpix who had once huddled timidly in the garbage pile had now fully grown into an elegant and beautiful Ninetales.

But this didn't mean Johan had forgotten the culprits who caused Vulpix's condition.

It wasn't an exaggeration to say that Johan's dedication to fighting Pokémon hunters was largely related to Vulpix's experience and the Hatterene siblings' experiences.

"So... who is it? Or which group of Pokémon hunters?" Johan asked.

"Who it is or which group, we haven't fully investigated yet, but the information we received suggests that group might currently be in the Kalos region."

"Kalos again?" Johan frowned even more.

Why did everything recently involve the Kalos region?

"What's wrong?"

"Nothing."

Johan took a deep breath.

Actually, he knew it wasn't that recent events were all happening in Kalos. Other regions, including the Hoenn region where he was located, also had various matters.

For example, the Hoenn region's Slateport City was about to hold the Slateport Contest, and they invited him as a guest for the opening speech.

Also, the Kanto region's Cerulean City had surfing competitions, Johto's Ecruteak City had summer fireworks festivals, Sinnoh's Hearthome City was preparing the largest Contest spectacular yet, also inviting him as a guest, etc.

It was just that, due to Arceus's words and the Wheel of Time, he had indeed been paying more attention to events in the Kalos region recently.

It seemed this trip was unavoidable.

"Officer Jenny, please send me a copy of the materials you've collected," Johan said.

"No problem."

As an Inspector in the International Police, Johan naturally had the authority to access such materials.

"Thank you for your hard work."

"By the way, Teacher Johan, if you're going to the Kalos region, you could check out our Jenny family's simulation exercise," Officer Jenny quickly added.

"The exercise is also in the Kalos region?"

"That's right."

Otherwise, why would Officer Jenny bring up both matters together?

"I'll see how it goes."

"Alright."

After hanging up, Johan quickly received information from Nurse Joy.

The information wasn't much - Officer Jenny didn't even know the opposing group's name, simply calling them the "Mysterious Pokémon Poaching Group."

Additionally, there were some scattered action traces of the opposing group, barely piecing together... the case involving Ninetales's initial theft.

Johan rested his chin on his hand.

"In the Kalos region, there are indeed one or two relatively famous Pokémon poaching groups..."

When he participated in the ice sculpture competition held in the Kalos region, he had inadvertently arrested two Pokémon hunters who targeted the Abomasnow clan.

"For this kind of information... Team Rocket might be more well-informed."

In certain aspects, the League's information channels were obviously not as good as Team Rocket's, especially these "underground channels."

Fortunately, Johan was not only an Inspector in the League's International Police but also a special advisor to Team Rocket's boss, belonging to the highest executive category.

With this thought, Johan directly called Giovanni in the distant Kanto region.

"Johan?"

When receiving Johan's call, Giovanni was still somewhat surprised.

After all, Giovanni's identity was rather special. Most of the time, they would choose Matori as an intermediary.

Of course, Giovanni hadn't revealed his identity yet, and Team Rocket was already beginning to transform, so occasional phone calls wouldn't raise suspicions.

"Gym Leader Giovanni." Johan got straight to the point. "I heard Gym Leader Giovanni is quite well-informed. I wonder if you could help me understand some matters..."

Giovanni's expression became somewhat strange.

Me, Giovanni? Well-informed?

Ridiculous.

When did Giovanni become a "know-it-all"?

However, since Johan rarely sought help, Giovanni naturally wouldn't refuse.

As for why Giovanni, as a Kanto region Viridian Gym Leader, would be well-informed, neither Johan nor Giovanni delved deeply into this matter, showing extremely synchronized understanding.

"I'd like to know some information about Pokémon poaching groups in the Kalos region, and I have some materials here, but can't determine which Pokémon poaching group..."

"Pokémon poaching?"

Giovanni nodded thoughtfully.

Giovanni also knew about Johan's dislike and hatred of Pokémon poaching groups.

And Team Rocket had actually "optimized out" this part of their "business." The last executive who secretly engaged in poaching, the Marauder, was personally arrested by Johan.

The largest poaching group in the Sinnoh region, Pokémon Hunter J's group, was destroyed by Johan.

Now Team Rocket had opened many breeding houses internally, and the Pokémon needed by Team Rocket members were mostly distributed through their own breeding methods - essentially "self-produced and self-consumed."

Actually, Team Rocket's breeding technology wasn't bad. After all, Giovanni himself was a top-tier Pokémon trainer and breeder. Any bit of his "Earth's Mysteries" leaked out would be enough for Team Rocket's breeding houses to raise Pokémon well.

"I understand."

Giovanni agreed.

After finishing the call with Johan, he could just pass this to Matori.

Compared to this, Giovanni was actually more concerned about another matter. Since Johan had actively called, Giovanni also said:

"Speaking of which, it helped me find my boy."

Giovanni's tone carried complexity and emotion.

Clearly having searched for his son for so long, even spending enormous energy, financial resources, and material resources for this, but when he really found him, he inevitably became anxious about gains and losses.

As the Team Rocket boss who dominated the Pokémon world, he would actually have such emotions - probably no one would believe it if told.

This was only with Johan, one of the few people in the entire Pokémon world Giovanni could speak his heart to.

Johan could hear some emotion in Giovanni's tone, and he also knew about this matter, since he had originally asked Mewtwo to help find Silver.

"Have you met him?" Johan asked.

"No."

Giovanni smiled bitterly.

It seemed Giovanni was still following his advice, Johan noted silently.

"Then... you must have had some contact, right?"

"Mm."

Giovanni didn't deny this. He had indeed sent Team Rocket members to try contacting Silver...

But that Team Rocket member was directly beaten up by Silver.

Initially, Giovanni was actually quite happy about this - his son could defeat a formal Team Rocket member at such a young age.

But later he gradually realized that Silver held some hostility toward Team Rocket.

And this hostility wasn't weak.

At the same time, through some investigation, Giovanni also noticed that Silver seemed to particularly care about several people - one called Gold, one called Crystal, and another he called "sister" - Blue.

After hearing Giovanni's brief account, Johan's expression gradually became strange.

The world's convergence was indeed powerful - Silver had still ended up meeting Gold and Crystal.

Gold...

This kid wasn't exactly a good "thing."

However, Gold indeed possessed qualities that Silver lacked.

For this pair of "frenemies," Johan suggested binding them together for life.

"So what are Gym Leader Giovanni's thoughts?" Johan asked again.

Giovanni took a deep breath, put away the various complex emotions in his heart, picked up a cookie from the table and put it in his mouth, saying calmly:

"My established plan won't change - transform what needs transforming, cut off what needs cutting off."

After a pause, he continued:

"After doing these things, I'll try inviting him to join."

"If he doesn't agree..."

Before Johan could finish, Giovanni narrowed his eyes and interrupted:

"If he doesn't agree, there are only two results - either I defeat him, or... he personally defeats me!"

Johan: "..."

He secretly gave a thumbs up.

Truly worthy of you, Boss Giovanni - you have a way with being tsundere.

Let Silver personally defeat you?

Are you planning to throw the fight?

Giovanni had his own plans.

His time was limited.

In this limited time, he would use his own methods to help Silver grow as much as possible.

Then, he would be personally defeated by Silver!

The final step for Team Rocket's complete transformation was for him, as Team Rocket's boss, to completely disappear.

Only when he disappeared could the labels attached to Team Rocket be completely erased.

And only when Silver defeated him could the label of "Team Rocket boss's son" on Silver disappear, allowing Silver to live the life he truly wanted.

Then... everything will be entrusted to you, Johan, Giovanni thought silently.

"If possible, Johan, I hope you can take him as your student."

"I—"

"Then it's settled. I'll find information for you later."

With that, Giovanni directly hung up.

Johan: "???"

He looked at his phone with his mouth open - he hadn't even finished saying "I" when the call was hung up?

No...

Who took away Silver and Blue?

The supposed companions Bugsy and Karen had no problems, and Bugsy and Karen were much older than Silver and Blue.

"This chaotic timeline..."

Johan rubbed his nose bridge with his fingertip.

Not one of them could give him peace of mind.

This father and son pair...

"Boss Giovanni?"

"Matori, Johan's side..."

Then Giovanni briefly recounted the information Johan wanted to know and hoped Team Rocket would help investigate.

"Understood! I'll contract a few more mines right away!"

"The previous mine workers are all at full capacity. Contract a few more, and when Teacher Johan destroys those Pokémon poaching groups, we can throw them all into the mines for labor reform."

Matori seemed very familiar with this process, skipping the intermediate steps and directly arranging mine workers.

It had to be said, mineral development had become a very successful project in Team Rocket's transformation process.

Others had to worry about costs, but they didn't have such concerns, making them more competitive.

"There's one more thing. The trio's benefits should also be slightly increased," Giovanni said.

# 624: Gengar: I Haven't Even Used My Full Power Yet

July 18th, Wednesday, clear weather.

Kalos region, Lumiose City.

"So I came here after all." Johan looked up at the blue sky with its rolling clouds and sighed wistfully.

Although Kanaz Pokémon Academy's final exams weren't over yet, what remained were mainly battle and Pokémon breeding exams, which had little to do with him as an elective course instructor.

The benefits of being an elective teacher were fully displayed during winter and summer breaks - over two months of long vacation...

"Rotom—"

Johan was about to call out Rotom to transform into Rotom-Bike when he saw Gengar had already gone to the roadside and hailed a Gogoat taxi.

"This guy..." Johan shook his head helplessly.

Having come here just once, this fellow was already familiar with everything.

"Doesn't even try to save money for the family..."

After all, Lumiose City was indeed too big and complex. Even with a map, getting lost was quite normal.

Back when he played "Pokémon XY," he got lost constantly - there were cafés everywhere, and just one Lysandre Café had him going in circles for ages before he finally had to rely on taxis.

"Ka-kaah~Ka-kaah~~"

Gengar cheerfully led over two Gogoat - one for it, one for Johan.

Destination - Professor Sycamore's Pokémon Laboratory!

There were many things to do on this trip to the Kalos region: League Police simulation exercises, visiting Laverre City's Valerie to design clothes and learn about Fairy-type Pokémon training, searching for Pokémon hunters, etc.

But regardless, greeting the "local boss" Professor Sycamore first was never wrong.

Clip-clop, clip-clop—

The Gogoat's steps were steady and rhythmic, and its speed wasn't slow at all. As long as you didn't "speed," it was quite safe.

"Vii?"

Victini sat on Johan's shoulder, looking at the buildings on both sides of the street and the architectural styles different from Unova, Sinnoh, and Hoenn, its eyes full of curiosity.

"Ka-kaah~─=≡Σ(((°Д°)))"

Nearby, Gengar rode its Gogoat and whooshed past.

It was just a bit hard on the goats.

Before long, Johan and the others arrived at the entrance of Professor Sycamore's Pokémon Laboratory.

Looking at one Gogoat in good condition and another with its tongue hanging out, eyes rolled back, covered in sweat and seemingly exhausted, plus several times the normal fare, the staff member responsible for collecting the Gogoat was full of question marks.

Wasn't this supposed to be from Lumiose Airport to Professor Sycamore's Pokémon Laboratory? How did it seem like they'd circled Lumiose City?

"Johan, you're here."

Entering Professor Sycamore's Pokémon Laboratory, the stubble-faced, disheveled middle-aged Professor Sycamore immediately came out to greet them.

Since Johan had called ahead, Professor Sycamore had been waiting in the laboratory early.

However, looking at the laboratory that was obviously much dimmer than during his last visit, Johan showed some curiosity.

What was going on?

Could Professor Sycamore's funding be so tight recently that he was even saving on laboratory lights?

Seeming to notice Johan's confusion, Professor Sycamore smiled helplessly:

"I don't know what's been happening lately, but Lumiose City's power supply facilities seem to have problems and frequently lose power."

Power outages?

Johan showed some understanding.

No wonder he'd seen many coffee shops on the way that were pitch black - he couldn't tell if they were open or closed.

But this brought even more confusion.

With Lumiose City's scale, power outages or insufficient power supply shouldn't happen, right?

Moreover, Lumiose City's Gym was an Electric-type Gym. Although he wasn't sure if it was currently Clemont, but... an Electric-type Gym Leader's city having power outages was probably a bigger "humiliation" than having the Gym Leader beaten to the ground.

Furthermore, even if Professor Sycamore's Pokémon Laboratory wasn't as large as Professor Oak's, it was still a Pokémon Professor's laboratory. Didn't they have some Electric-type Pokémon to generate power?

Johan voiced this confusion, and Professor Sycamore immediately explained:

"It's not that. It's just that some instruments have particularly high power demands, so we've shut off some unnecessary electrical outputs to save some energy for the Pokémon working hard to generate electricity and reduce their pressure."

In Pokémon research, extremely precise instruments were inevitably needed, and the more precise these instruments were, the greater their power consumption.

"I see."

Johan nodded. He didn't delve too deeply into this matter since he wasn't Volkner and his knowledge of electronics and circuits only extended to series and parallel circuits.

"Ka-kaah~~"

At this moment, Gengar beside Johan suddenly bent down and pulled two unusually large watermelons from Johan's shadow, grinning as it offered them to Professor Sycamore.

"These are..."

Johan smiled: "Two watermelons we grew ourselves. I didn't know what to bring, so I hope Professor Sycamore won't mind."

"Johan, you can grow crops too?"

Professor Sycamore was even more surprised. Looking at those two watermelons larger than Gengar's head, he unconsciously clicked his tongue and exclaimed:

"And, and these two watermelons... aren't they a bit too big?"

Honestly, this was the first time he'd seen watermelons this large.

Johan smiled.

Just kidding - watermelons blessed by Calyrex, how could they not be big?

"We chilled them at home beforehand. Gengar kept them in its shadow, so the temperature should be just right. Eat them while they're cool - summer and chilled watermelon are a perfect match~"

"Oh, oh..."

Professor Sycamore quickly had his assistant help carry the watermelons.

"By the way, where's Alain?"

Today, the one who came with Professor Sycamore to greet them was a cute young lady, but he didn't see Alain, who would be Ash's future rival.

Speaking of Alain, Professor Sycamore handed the watermelons to several researchers and smiled:

"That guy has been helping me a lot lately, finding many Mega Stones from outside."

"Oh?"

Was Alain already helping Professor Sycamore collect Mega Stones at this stage?

In contrast, Ash... at this stage, Ash should still be playing in the mud in Pallet Town.

No wonder he could bring out a Charizard later (not really).

"Come on, Johan, let me show you my recent research results!" Professor Sycamore rolled up his sleeves, changing from his previous disheveled appearance and becoming energetic.

So, under Professor Sycamore's guidance, the two came to a research room in the laboratory.

Sure enough, compared to the dim lighting outside, this research room was brightly lit. Many researchers in white coats were buried in their work, and neat rows of precision instruments were constantly operating, faintly making "buzzing" sounds.

Then Johan noticed that on the central table of the research room, transparent glass covers were placed, and inside them were Mega Stones that countless Pokémon trainers dreamed of!

Each one of these, regardless of which Pokémon's Mega Stone it was, was worth no less than eight figures.

Just what was on the table was probably worth seventy to eighty million Pokédollars.

Even Alain could help Professor Sycamore collect Mega Stones, so he should be able to casually "obtain" some, right?

"Johan?"

Professor Sycamore walked to an instrument and, seeing Johan staring blankly at the Mega Stones, called out.

"Hm? Hm."

Behind the instrument was an isolated room with transparent glass on the wall that allowed a clear view of everything inside.

As Professor Sycamore pressed a button, virtual images appeared in the sealed compartment.

"This is the latest holographic projection technology developed by Lysandre Labs." Professor Sycamore explained.

Johan nodded, not unfamiliar with this.

Although Lysandre Labs' holographic projection technology hadn't been truly popularized, some high-end individuals or organizations had already obtained usage rights for this technology.

Not only Professor Sycamore's Pokémon Laboratory, but even Team Rocket internally used holographic projection technology.

A burly middle-aged man wearing a Blaziken mask, and a Blaziken standing in front of him!

Blaziken Mask?

Clemont and Bonnie's dad?

Professor Sycamore operated while explaining:

"This is a trainer who didn't want to reveal his name. What's being played now is footage of their Mega Evolution..."

In the sealed room, Blaziken Mask looked excited and shouted:

"Blaziken, Mega Evolve!"

Buzz—

Brilliant light was displayed through holographic projection technology as Blaziken evolved under the embrace of Mega Evolution energy.

When the energy dispersed, what appeared before them was a majestic Mega Blaziken!

And the Mega Evolution symbol that flashed briefly in front of it.

"Ka-kaah~!"

Gengar pointed at the holographic projection on the glass and turned to look at Johan.

Hey, their evolution isn't as cool as ours!

What Professor Sycamore really wanted to show Johan was some data on the instruments.

The data was very complex, but Professor Sycamore summarized it.

"Through our analysis, we found that Mega Evolution is not only closely related to the physical condition of the Pokémon and trainer at the time, but the emotional state of the Pokémon and trainer might even account for a larger proportion of influence."

"Generally speaking, the most basic Mega Evolution might bring ten to twenty percent improvement to Pokémon."

"But this Blaziken Mask - after he and his Blaziken underwent Mega Evolution, Mega Blaziken's overall stats improved by at least thirty percent!"

"This is the highest among all our research cases so far."

Thirty percent?

Johan nodded silently.

The reason Mega Evolution was, in his mind, a superior enhancement method compared to Z-Moves, Dynamax, and Terastalization was because Mega Evolution brought comprehensive improvements.

Unlike Z-Moves that only enhanced moves, Dynamax that enhanced HP and some moves, or Terastalization that changed types and enhanced some move power...

Of course, Mega Evolution's drawbacks were also unavoidable - only certain specific Pokémon could undergo Mega Evolution.

And it required higher standards for trainers and Pokémon, placing greater burden on trainers.

An assistant brought over a plate of chilled watermelon.

"Ka-kaah~"

"Vii~"

Gengar and Victini weren't shy and immediately took some and started eating.

Professor Sycamore also picked up a piece of watermelon and took a bite.

Instantly, the cool, crisp sensation made him squint his eyes, and he continued:

"Johan, if possible, could I collect some Mega Evolution data from you and Gengar?"

Although Johan and Gengar had demonstrated Mega Evolution once before, Professor Sycamore's laboratory equipment was obviously insufficient at the time and couldn't record it.

Moreover... Professor Sycamore had a premonition.

Although Blaziken Mask and Blaziken had left the highest Mega Evolution values so far, if it were Johan and Gengar...

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar, with watermelon juice on its face, looked up at Johan and blinked its eager eyes twice.

How about giving them a little shock?

Shock?

He wasn't particularly interested in shocking anyone.

He was just... somewhat curious about how much his Gengar's overall stats could improve after Mega Evolution.

Could it reach an exaggerated fifty percent?

Before Johan could speak, Professor Sycamore quickly added:

"Of course, such data collection is compensated..."

Hm?

Johan immediately coughed lightly and said seriously:

"Professor Sycamore, that's too formal. Contributing to Pokémon research is something every League trainer should do!"

Clap clap clap—

Applause rang out throughout the research room.

Teacher Johan was truly Teacher Johan, showing everyone the "teacher's brilliance."

So, Johan and Gengar were led by staff to the previous sealed space, under the lenses of many instruments.

For a moment, after Gengar's form briefly blurred, it struck completely different poses for all the cameras.

"Johan, Gengar." Professor Sycamore's voice came through speakers on the wall.

"You can start anytime."

"Gengar." Johan took a deep breath and looked at the purple little fatty in front of him.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar cheerfully made an "OK" gesture.

At the same time, it subtly winked at the invisible Victini on Johan's shoulder.

Give them a little shock!

Don't slack off, Victini~

"Vii~(>ω<)"

Here we go!

Johan and Gengar's expressions suddenly synchronized, both revealing smiles with identical mouth curves.

Unbuttoning his clothes, his coat fluttering without wind, Johan took out the Key Stone hanging at the end of his monocle chain.

"Ka-kaah——!!"

Buzz—

Seven-colored Mega Evolution energy opened from the Key Stone in Johan's hand, responding to the Mega Stone on Gengar's tongue.

Hm?

Johan suddenly felt that the connection between him and Gengar seemed to become closer.

It was his aura!

This was the first time he had Mega Evolved with Gengar after his aura was enhanced by Arceus.

His current feeling was as if even without the Key Stone and Mega Stone, he and Gengar had some probability of achieving Mega Evolution?

Bond Evolution?

Like Ash and his Greninja?

His aura leaned toward emotions, so it further stimulated Mega Evolution which was influenced by emotions and bonds?

But as Mega Gengar appeared before him, Professor Sycamore and all the researchers in the research room nearly dropped their jaws.

The commotion from the explosion was heard by Johan and Mega Gengar in the sealed laboratory.

"Ka-kaah?"

Did you use too much force?

"Vii, Vii..."

It hadn't even used its power yet...

Mega Gengar floated directly to the wall, stuck its head through the glass, then immediately pulled it back.

"Ka-kaah?"

You say you didn't? The instrument exploded!

Then Gengar shed the Mega Evolution energy and tugged at Johan's pants.

"Ka-kaah?"

Do we have to pay compensation? Should we run away?
