# 625: Camping and Dual-Gun Gengar!

Stealing electricity?

Johan looked at Professor Sycamore, who also looked puzzled.

That didn't make sense. If there were Pokémon stealing electricity, wouldn't the many Electric-type Pokémon generating power in the laboratory have noticed?

Moreover... could stealing electricity really cause power shortages in a city as large as Lumiose?

After all, Lumiose City was powered by the Kalos Power Plant, one of the largest power stations in the entire Kalos region, plus there was the Lumiose Electric-type Gym...

Rotom indicated it might have been mistaken.

But Johan felt that Rotom was most likely correct.

Other Electric-type Pokémon might not sense it, but that didn't mean his Rotom couldn't.

Although Rotom wasn't Johan's main battling Pokémon and was just a "utility mon," it never lacked good food and drink.

Plus, Rotom had received Raikou's Thunder Stone and been infused with Zekrom's electricity - it was an Electric-type Pokémon with considerable power.

It was just that Rotom wasn't very interested in battles, otherwise... it probably didn't even have an accurate understanding of how strong its current abilities were.

But Johan still trusted Rotom's judgment.

On one hand, it was due to his trust in Rotom's abilities.

On the other hand, in the Pokémon world, whenever power plants or power stations were involved, problems always seemed to arise.

For example, a Zapdos mysteriously taking up residence in a power plant.

"Anyway, this could be an investigation direction. Professor, if it's convenient for you, perhaps you could remind the workers checking Lumiose City's circuit problems," Johan said.

Professor Sycamore nodded.

It was just an investigation direction anyway. If there really were Pokémon stealing electricity, they'd have identified the source of the problem. If not... it wouldn't delay much, just ruling out an incorrect option early.

He took out a sealed envelope from his lab coat's inner pocket and smiled: "Johan, this is the compensation I promised you earlier."

There really was compensation?

An envelope?

Could it be a check?

Was Professor Sycamore so high-end now that he used checks?

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar reacted faster than Johan, eagerly taking the envelope and opening it, revealing a gold-embossed card.

Hm?

"This is..."

Gengar picked up the card and flipped it over, revealing an invitation.

A golden invitation!

This invitation was issued by the famous "Battle Chateau," a well-known battle facility in the Kalos region. The content was quite simple, summarized as:

Inviting Teacher Johan to participate in the "Battle Chateau" and directly granting Johan the rank of Count!

Staring at the invitation in his hand, Johan's expression was strange.

"This is the compensation?"

Completely different from what he'd expected.

The Battle Chateau in the Kalos region was renowned not only throughout Kalos but had considerable fame throughout the entire Pokémon world.

It used the traditional "Duke, Marquis, Count, Viscount, Baron" ranking system, emphasizing Pokémon battle etiquette and promoting traditional Kalos culture.

In Johan's memory, the future Kalos Champion, Elite Four members, and Gym Leaders were all important guests of the "Battle Chateau."

Among them, Diantha, who would become Kalos Champion, was the unique Grand Duchess of the "Battle Chateau."

And the Elite Four were all Dukes and Duchesses of the "Battle Chateau."

Additionally, trainers from other regions would also register to participate in the "Battle Chateau" when visiting Kalos.

However, due to geographical limitations and inconvenience of participation, their ranks might be slightly lower than local Kalos trainers.

The "Battle Chateau" used a point system where strength was one factor, while the number of battles and matches was another.

Of course, this didn't mean that having more battles and matches would guarantee a high rank - personal strength was the main factor.

What made the "Battle Chateau" so attractive was not only the excitement of battles and being matched with opponents of equal strength, but also the exchange system for "Battle Points," which was one of the reasons the "Battle Chateau" remained popular and increasingly hot.

It was said that with enough points and matching rank, one could even exchange points for Mega Stones at the "Battle Chateau"!

Currently, the [Grand Duke/Grand Duchess] position at the "Battle Chateau" was vacant, with the highest-ranked and most famous being Wikstrom, one of Kalos's Elite Four who called himself the "Steel-Clad Warrior"!

"I helped you apply directly for Count rank. I figured the boring battles from Baron to Viscount wouldn't mean much to you," Professor Sycamore said with a "considerate" expression, patting Johan's shoulder.

Hearing this, Johan's mouth twitched.

Who said that?

Baron and Viscount... how could they be boring? They were clearly enjoyable...

"I heard," Professor Sycamore lowered his voice, "that among the Mega Stones collected by the 'Battle Chateau,' there might be... a Tyranitar Mega Stone."

Tyranitar?!

Johan tried to cover Professor Sycamore's mouth but it was too late.

The Poké Ball at his waist trembled and opened on its own, and Larvitar came running out urgently with a mineral in its mouth, staring with wide eyes.

"Yoji, Yoji!"

I, I heard it!

Tyranitar's Mega Stone!

As the Desert Tyrant's cub, Larvitar even dreamed at night of evolving into the formidable Desert Tyrant Tyranitar!

Wasn't this Tyranitar Mega Stone prepared just for it?

Everyone had seen how cool big brother Gengar looked during Mega Evolution.

Unfortunately, Mega Evolution required matching Mega Stones, and not all Pokémon could undergo Mega Evolution.

And Larvitar was definitely among those who envied it.

Hearing that Tyranitar actually had a compatible Mega Stone, how could it not be excited?

Larvitar put on the sunglasses Gengar had given it, lowered its voice, and said:

"Yoji~!"

Desert, your tyrant~ has returned!

Bonk!

"Ow!"

Larvitar held its head and looked pitifully at Johan, who said irritably:

"Don't be so dramatic. We're not even sure it really exists."

But this matter... not knowing about it was one thing, but now that he knew... both Larvitar and Johan were indeed tempted to try.

After all, it was a Mega Stone worth at least eight figures - definitely worth attempting.

Seeing Larvitar's cute appearance, Professor Sycamore smiled:

"I originally had the idea of helping you look for a Tyranitar Mega Stone, but Mega Stones are not only hard to find, matching is also completely based on luck."

If he had a Tyranitar Mega Stone in hand, he wouldn't mind giving it directly to Johan.

"As for exchanging Mega Stones at the 'Battle Chateau,' you'd probably need to reach 'Duke' rank first to be eligible for exchange."

Duke...

According to the invitation, Johan was already a Count. Above Count was Marquis, and above Marquis was Duke.

Just two ranks away...

However, judging from the fact that currently only Kalos's Elite Four held Duke ranks, the "Battle Chateau's" ranking system was quite prestigious.

Wanting to reach Duke rank was almost equivalent to having Elite Four-level strength.

We'll see.

Anyway, this trip to Kalos was for vacation, while incidentally solving some lingering problems. He had plenty of time, and the "Battle Chateau" was such a famous place that he'd definitely visit.

At worst... he'd just take Larvitar there for some leveling up.

"Professor, please help upgrade the Pokédex's Kalos region map," Johan changed the subject.

"No problem."

Although the Pokédex contained a map of the Kalos region, this public version still had some differences from the internal Kalos League version that Professor Sycamore possessed.

Moreover, the League was constantly changing, with regions undergoing significant changes periodically. Timely updates would benefit Johan's upcoming travels.

After upgrading the Pokédex map and continuing to impose on Professor Sycamore's laboratory for a while longer, Johan took his leave.

His primary objective in coming to the Kalos region was to find the Pokémon hunter group that had originally captured and sold Ninetales.

However, considering not wanting to touch on Ninetales's past sorrows, Johan temporarily hadn't told his little ones about this main purpose, to avoid making them too agitated.

Therefore, he used the pretense of traveling and searching for diamond mines for Larvitar, letting everyone have as much fun as possible.

Of course, he had also obtained some information about Pokémon hunter groups active in the Kalos region from Team Rocket, using this as a secondary objective for the trip, so his little ones wouldn't be completely without vigilance.

So, temporarily targeting Route 7 where the "Battle Chateau" was located, Johan rode his Rotom-Bike and leisurely left Lumiose City.

"Rotom, off-road vehicle mode."

"Roger! Super transformation mode, Rotom!"

Rotom shouted, and the bicycle's tires immediately became mountain bike tires suitable for outdoor environments, plus a super shock absorption system, allowing Johan to ride on uneven terrain without much pressure.

Soon, Johan rode his bike to a stream.

He immediately changed direction, following the stream southward.

The clear stream babbled, its surface rippling with sparkling waves. The fragrance of grass and flowers was refreshing, giving the feeling of traveling across vast, boundless wilderness.

Johan's riding speed wasn't fast, and he summoned out all the little ones who wanted to come out and wander.

"Draaa~~"

Dragonite flew in the sky while Ninetales ran lightly beside the bicycle.

On the bicycle's back seat, Larvitar and Tinkaton squeezed together, each holding ice cream, swinging their little feet while eating vanilla-flavored ice cream.

Gengar floated at the back, its eyes darting around, probably thinking up some mischievous scheme again.

"Vii~~"

Victini lay on Johan's head, one hand gripping his hair, the other eating macarons, always excitedly calling out when seeing something interesting.

"I won't start balding at a young age because of Victini, will I?" Johan thought.

After riding for a while, Johan stopped at a relatively gentle terrain area.

"How about we camp here tonight?" Johan suggested.

As soon as he said this, he immediately got approval from all the little ones.

Camping! Camping! Camping! It's been so long since we camped~

Gengar called out excitedly - it was already somewhat eager for nightfall so it could greet the wild Pokémon in the area.

"Gengar, take out the tent. The tent-setting task is yours and Instructor Bear's."

"Ka-kaah!"

"Garruu!"

Gengar and Urshifu immediately accepted the mission.

Gengar dug a sizeable tent out of its shadow, and with Urshifu's help, the two little ones quickly set up a tent.

For some reason, Johan glanced at the tent and felt strangely ominous.

Gengar eagerly crawled inside, tested the soft padding, then stuck its head out and gave Johan a "perfect" gesture.

"Ka-kaah~!"

I'm definitely a tent-setting genius!

Seeing its silly, dramatic grin, Johan suddenly didn't feel ominous anymore.

Johan smiled and shook his head, rolling up his sleeves and walking into the babbling stream. The cool water flow brought the refreshing sensation unique to summer.

"Vii..."

Victini lay on his shoulder, looking at the stream below with an expression of wanting to touch but not quite daring.

"It's okay, it's just stream water," Johan encouraged.

However, before Victini could react, Larvitar nearby seemed to take this as permission for itself, raised its hands above its head in a diving pose, then—

SPLASH!!

Shallow water bomb!

As water splashed everywhere, Larvitar's head went straight into the stream, its blunt horn even penetrating into the riverbed.

Seeing this made Victini, who had been eager to try, shake its head repeatedly.

Johan: "..."

Grabbing one of Larvitar's constantly kicking feet, Johan lifted it upside down.

"Yoji~(￣~￣)"

The green little one's mouth was puffed up, apparently chewing something.

Then Johan saw that a large chunk was missing from the riverbed.

Johan: "...Does it taste good?"

"Yoji~Yoji~"

Larvitar shook its head, indicating it had a fishy taste and wasn't very good.

"Then why did you swallow it?"

Johan rubbed his forehead and placed the little one on the shore.

Unbelievable.

A gentle breeze passed by.

"Draaa——"

Dragonite happily skimmed across the water's surface, its round belly touching the water and splashing white droplets.

Ninetales lay on the soft grass pile by the shore, looking serene and well-behaved.

After setting up the tent with Gengar, Urshifu stood by the stream silently practicing punches, as if returning to the days of training at the Tower of Waters on the Isle of Armor.

Ceruledge was arranging cooking utensils with Tinkaton - Ceruledge handled the charcoal while Tinkaton temporarily forged what it considered perfect "legendary cookware."

"You're setting up too early..." Johan reminded them, but seeing they didn't react much, he shook his head.

"Forget it. In this environment... not fishing a few fish would be doing a disservice to my nature as an angler."

With that, he took out his newly purchased "Good Rod"!

Since they were traveling, with tents and everything configured, how could they lack a fishing rod?

As for why not the "Super Rod," that was naturally because the "Super Rod" was too expensive.

"(ˉ▽￣～) Hmph~~"

Johan found a large pebble by the stream to sit on. "A true master wouldn't be affected by external objects?"

He cast confidently.

Plop—

With a crisp sound, the hook carrying Johan's specially prepared bait sank into the water.

Half an hour later...

"Damn it, I should have bought the 'Super Rod.' This 'Good Rod' definitely can't match my skill level!"

Looking at the seaweed hanging on his hook, Johan muttered.

Throwing the seaweed aside, he took a deep breath and said somewhat wistfully:

"Indeed, a true master should always maintain the heart of an apprentice..."

As an apprentice, one should use the finest fishing rod.

"Vii~ヾ(￣▽￣)"

Victini flew around him cheering, thinking Johan's words were really stylish.

Several Fletchling flew overhead. Johan turned around and finally saw the scene that made his teeth itch.

Gengar, Tinkaton, and Larvitar were building a small dam upstream!

No wonder he couldn't even catch a Magikarp!

This feeling was like someone downstream who had drunk their fill discovering that someone upstream was relieving themselves - countless complaints galloped through his mind.

"Yoji~Yoji~"

Larvitar somehow managed to stand by the dam, continuously waving at something behind it. Two Bunnelby from who knows where were using their ears to pass soil to it.

Gengar was responsible for stacking the soil Larvitar passed along onto the dam, while Tinkaton stood in the center of the dam, using its hammer to compact and strengthen the dam.

Johan: "..."

"You guys..." Johan didn't know what to say.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar grinned and signaled Johan to relax - today definitely wouldn't be a shutout!

"Don't you think you're damaging the environment?" Johan showed an "angry" expression.

Eh?

The three little ones looked at each other and scratched their heads.

Are, are we?

"Ninetales," Johan could only use his "ultimate move" and called out.

"Oowoo?"

Ninetales, who had been resting on the grass pile, immediately opened its eyes upon hearing Johan's call, sat up, and showed some fierce light in its eyes.

Danger?

It had actually dozed off carelessly - how imprudent!

Seeing Johan actually call Ninetales, Gengar, Tinkaton, and Larvitar immediately indicated - we're being good, please spare us!

Splash splash—

The stream returned to its previous slightly rapid flow.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar, who had been drooping its head and ears dejectedly just a second ago, suddenly seemed to discover something and immediately dove into the stream with a "hungry ghost pounce."

When Gengar emerged from the water surface again, it was actually holding two light blue prawns about half a meter long.

Gengar held one in each hand.

Putting on swimming goggles, it actually struck a dual-gunslinger pose!

Because what it held were two Clauncher!

"Ka-kaah! ψ(`∇´)ψ"

Gengar grabbed their smaller claws and held up their large claws. With a light flick and pressure of its hands, two water streams shot from the Clauncher's pincers.

"Yoji! (☆_☆)"

Good heavens, this scene made all the little ones' eyes light up.

Gengar even showed off with poses, and with the cape and belt it pulled out, it really had the feeling of a future warrior.

"Clauncher, the Water Gun Pokémon, Water-type. It's said to be a type of lobster with very delicious meat, deeply popular in the Kalos region, Rotom! slurp—"

Delicious meat?

Hearing this phrase, the attention of Gengar, Larvitar, and other little ones immediately shifted direction.

The two Clauncher in Gengar's hands shrank even more, sensing unprecedented "threat."

Clauncher: Σ(ﾟдﾟlll)

Buzz—

Blue light waves appeared on the two Clauncher's pincers. Unlike the previous Water Gun, this light wave was... aura!

Aura Sphere!

"Garruu!!"

Sensing the aura, Urshifu immediately shouted.

Let go, let me handle this!

At the same time, light flowed back and forth on the Clauncher's pincers, as if charging up and gathering power.

This was because of the ability Clauncher possessed - Mega Launcher!

[Mega Launcher: Pokémon with this ability have their pulse and aura-based moves (except Heal Pulse) increased in power by 50%, and Heal Pulse's recovery effect is also increased by 50%!]

This ability, besides Mega Blastoise, was only possessed by Clauncher and its evolution Clawitzer, as far as Johan knew.

It was an ability perfectly suited for pulse-type moves including Aura Sphere.

Bang! Bang!

Under Gengar's control, two Aura Spheres immediately exploded on the water's surface, creating two huge splashes with water droplets scattering around.

"Ka! Kaah——!"

Invincible!!

Not just Gengar - Tinkaton, Dragonite, Urshifu, and even Larvitar all looked eager to try, wanting to snatch them and test it out.

It had to be said... Clauncher and Clawitzer were indeed very suitable for those who possessed aura.

Even Johan had a thought...

With my aura, although I can't hand-rub Aura Spheres yet, if I added Clauncher, wouldn't that be...

"Oowoo..."

Ninetales's tail gently tugged Johan's hand and pointed at the water surface.

He saw two adult Clawitzer, one male and one female, poking their heads above the water, watching Gengar "mess with" their two children. They didn't make a sound, just wore cold smiles.

At the same time, two "cannons" larger, more imposing, and more intimidating than Clauncher's rose from the water, light flowing within them.

Johan: "..."

"Cough cough, Gengar, Gengar!"

Johan called twice.

But Gengar, already immersed in its "Holy Gun Ranger" role, didn't notice the situation behind it.

The next second.

Bang—Bang—

Two surging Water Pulses shot from those massive pincers—

A few minutes later.

Johan pressed Gengar's head down, expressing apologies to the two wild Clawitzer and offering energy cubes as sincere compensation.

"Sorry..."

"Ka-kaah..."

The two bruised and battered Clauncher looked at each other.

We can't accept this, we can't accept this...

"Goka..."

Ceruledge, who had been silent throughout, suddenly murmured. In its mind appeared the scene of "Mega Launcher" enhanced Water Pulse and Aura Sphere, and it seemed to have an epiphany.

Click click—

It turned the dial on its body, immediately switching from Ceruledge to Armarouge form.

Cannon, aura - all set!

Water flow could be replaced with flames, and Armarouge already possessed aura, so the process of making aura pulses more powerful, theoretically...

# 626: Well Well, Lance, You With Those Thick Eyebrows

Buzz—

Armarouge began gathering aura, holding it back without releasing. The azure aura power condensed within its golden cannon.

Aura - Johan's most familiar ability, so when Armarouge began gathering aura, he noticed immediately.

Not just him - Urshifu and the two Clawitzer in the stream also noticed.

Hm?

Clearly, Armarouge was trying to simulate the "Mega Launcher" ability of Clawitzer and Clauncher, but...

This was, after all, an ability belonging to Clawitzer and Clauncher. It wasn't something Armarouge could simply imitate.

BOOM—

Finally, the aura power in Armarouge's cannon fired out as an Aura Sphere.

"Goka?"

Armarouge tilted its head slightly.

The power had indeed improved compared to directly firing Aura Sphere before, but obviously hadn't reached the 50% boost of "Mega Launcher."

This improvement was more due to Armarouge's gathering, suppressing, and holding back of the aura power.

Trading slower move execution speed for increased move power.

The two Clawitzer looked at each other and both breathed slight sighs of relief.

See, it's not that easy to learn...

"Armarouge, try using psychic power," Johan had a thought and suggested.

"Goka!"

Hearing this, Armarouge's eyes lit up. Use psychic power to simulate "Mega Launcher"?

Buzz—

Following Johan's suggestion, Armarouge tried again. Its eyes glowed with psychic light while the raised golden cannon was covered with a thin film of psychic power, further compressing the gathered aura.

BOOM!!

The power increased by another ten percent.

But there was still an obvious gap compared to "Mega Launcher."

"If that doesn't work, try observing and studying them up close," Johan said.

Immediately, the two Clawitzer who had been "watching the show" suddenly trembled, sensing multiple "ill-intentioned" gazes.

The two Clawitzer looked at each other again.

We should have... left earlier. What was there to watch?

"Goka!"

Armarouge, wearing golden armor and glowing with the deep luster of red-hot charcoal, shouldered two deep blue cannons.

It had to be said, Armarouge's stance had even more of a future warrior feel than Gengar's dual guns earlier.

Buzz—

Azure aura power gathered again, shooting toward the water surface.

BOOM! BOOM!

The two Clawitzer were on the verge of tears, demonstrating Aura Sphere release under "Mega Launcher" while being... roasted over the fire.

Clawitzer: We're almost cooked, almost cooked, really almost cooked...

Armarouge went all out with aura and psychic power, carefully sensing the entire process of Clawitzer releasing Aura Spheres, seeming to gain some understanding.

"Ka-kaah~" Gengar stood to the side with arms crossed.

If you ask me, if that doesn't work, just remove those cannon barrels and use them yourself.

Clawitzer: Σ(°△°|||)

"Cha~"

Tinkaton bounced its hammer, showing a thoughtful expression.

I should... have a chance to operate on this.

But my suggestion is to let me crack open one claw to study it. There's a good chance I could modify Armarouge's cannon to work like that...

The two Clawitzer were about to cry.

What kind of devils are these people...

Fortunately, Johan spoke up: "Alright, stop scaring them. Armarouge, you've sensed enough. Put them back. I can see they're almost cooked."

The Clawitzer tails mounted on Armarouge's shoulders were already turning orange-red.

"Goka..."

Armarouge nodded.

Finally, the two Clawitzer and two Clauncher took plenty of energy cubes and dove back into the water, their feelings quite complex.

Hey, you know what? These guys might be fierce like devils, but they're... actually pretty nice.

Evening time.

Sizzle—

Johan put on an apron, set up the pot stand, sprayed some oil, and soon the sounds of stir-frying filled the air, adding some kitchen atmosphere to this peaceful wilderness.

Today's dinner was curry.

A Paldean berry curry set meal, with the recipe from Cyrano's "ancestral recipe" from Blueberry Academy. The main ingredients were the berries and vegetables they had grown themselves, improved and cooked by Johan.

Of course, it also included the most crucial ingredient - curry powder.

As he stirred, the golden curry gradually thickened, and its unique aroma began to waft.

This was Johan's first time cooking according to Cyrano's "ancestral recipe." Although he had added some improvements...

"I have to say, at least it smells... very good."

Talking to himself, Johan scooped up a small spoonful of thick curry sauce, blew on it, and put it in his mouth. His taste buds immediately felt stimulated, making Johan's spirits lift.

It tasted much better than he had imagined.

Speaking of which, Johan wasn't really someone who particularly liked curry, but this pot of curry gave him a new understanding of curry.

"And this was made with ordinary 'curry powder'..."

The original recipe should have used better curry powder ingredients, requiring Watercress and Super Powder.

However, Johan hadn't put much thought into making curry powder before, so he had used some substitute ingredients.

"Even so, this curry has reached at least 'Charizard' level."

Now Johan was truly surprised.

Because looking at it this way, some of the seemingly outrageous recipes in Cyrano's "ancestral recipe," like the recipe that could attract Spectrier, might... really have a small chance of working?

While Johan was tasting, his little ones had already gathered around, watching eagerly. Especially Gengar and Larvitar - their drool was about to hit the ground.

Seeing this, Johan stopped teasing their appetites and smiled as he used a large spoon to ladle the thick curry sauce over rice, finally sprinkling secret seasoning. A perfect curry was ready.

"I made quite a lot. If it's not enough, I'll add more."

On a picnic table, steaming portions of curry were neatly arranged. The little ones were already in position to eat, just waiting for Johan's command.

"Dig in!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar immediately threw away its spoon and grabbed the plate to pour into its mouth.

"Ka-kaah~(￣～￣)"

Seeing this, Dragonite, Urshifu, and Larvitar, who had originally planned to use spoons, immediately followed suit.

The next second, while they were still chewing, four clean plates were placed in front of Johan.

Johan: "..."

Why did he feel like breaking out in a cold sweat?

After eating their fill, they threw the plates and utensils into Rotom's dishwasher.

The advantage of having Rotom now was that when going out, they could just throw electrical equipment into Gengar's shadow without worrying about power consumption.

Moreover, with Rotom around, they had basically achieved full automation.

The evening breeze was gentle, the stream babbled, and the water rippled under the moonlight.

Johan lay back on the soft grass with his little ones, gazing up at the night sky.

Memories flowed like water.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar pointed at the brightest star in the sky.

That star looks like Jirachi...

Jirachi.

Except for Larvitar and other little ones who hadn't met Jirachi, the other little ones all recalled Jirachi's cute appearance.

[Johan~ play~ Johan~ come play~~]

Jirachi's voice seemed to echo in his mind.

Johan's lips unconsciously curved upward slowly.

Although Jirachi had fallen into slumber, the memories of those few days together wouldn't disappear.

Whenever he thought of those memories, he couldn't help but smile.

For a moment, the grass became somewhat quiet.

Apart from the rustling of evening wind through grass, the babbling of the stream, and the performance sounds of Hoothoot from nearby bushes, there were no other sounds.

It was also at this time that in the not-so-dense bushes, on a seemingly unremarkable branch, the bark on an ordinary tree trunk began to curl slightly.

A small diamond-shaped piece of bark gradually became more vivid, taking on an emerald green color.

"Ka-kaah?"

Suddenly, Gengar sitting beside Johan seemed to sense something and whipped its head around.

"What's wrong?" Seeing it like this, Johan asked with his hands behind his head.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar scratched its head and shook it.

As someone skilled at "sneak attacks from behind," Gengar had a strong sixth sense about what was behind it. It had just felt like something was watching them from behind.

Hearing Gengar say this, Johan's mind stirred, and aura spread out from his body.

After Arceus's blessing enhancement, Johan's aura might not be the absolute best in the entire Pokémon world, but it was definitely top-tier (there weren't many people who had it anyway).

Under his aura perception, the bushes behind them weren't entirely empty.

Three Hoothoot, two Bunnelby, four Scatterbug, and one Fletchling.

Apart from that, there wasn't anything else.

Maybe one of them had just glanced their way.

Speaking of the Kalos region, what mainly needed to be watched out for were Xerneas the Life Pokémon, Yveltal the Destruction Pokémon, and those Team Flare people.

Oh right, there was also the "Gundam" - Zygarde, the legendary Z-God, Order Pokémon.

Zygarde was to Xerneas and Yveltal what Rayquaza was to Groudon and Kyogre in Hoenn, and what Kyurem was to Reshiram and Zekrom in Unova.

However, most of the time, Zygarde existed in cellular form scattered throughout the Pokémon world, monitoring while maintaining the balance of the natural environment.

When large-scale natural environmental changes occurred somewhere, Zygarde would gather a certain number of cells according to different situations, transforming into different forms to respond.

"Speaking of which, does a Shiny Zygarde exist in the Paldea region?"

Even Rayquaza had a Shiny form, so a second Zygarde that was also Shiny wouldn't be too hard to accept.

"Let's sleep."

Johan got up and brushed off the grass stuck to his back. "If things go smoothly, we can reach the 'Battle Chateau' tomorrow and see if we can get matched for a battle."

Then they could use the "Battle Chateau" as a base to investigate the surrounding forests and see if they could find traces of Pokémon hunters.

"Yoji~"

Larvitar yawned long and loud.

It had been getting sleepy for a while.

Eat your fill, drink your fill, then sleep - this was probably the carefree happiness of children.

The small tent could fit Johan and all his little ones squeezed together.

Everyone huddled together in a group - it was a different kind of experience.

Dragonite and Urshifu stayed by the entrance, their backs forming yellow and brown doors that completely sealed the tent.

Such "door gods" brought exceptional peace of mind.

The next morning, Johan woke to the chirping of Fletchling and suddenly lifted Larvitar, who had somehow ended up on his chest, sitting up and breathing heavily.

He rubbed his chest with lingering fear.

No wonder he had dreamed last night that he had become a monkey and during the Summit War was slapped to the ground by a golden Buddha. Even activating his golden form couldn't break free, giving him the feeling of being held underwater unable to breathe.

Walking out of the tent, he found Urshifu with hands together, "devoutly" thanking nature for this long-missed "gift."

After simply washing up by the stream and having breakfast, they set off again.

"Riding my beloved bicycle, it will never get stuck in traffic~"

After riding for a while, Johan and the others gradually moved from wilderness to roads.

Route 7!

In the distance, they could even see a huge castle situated on a distant hillside - the famous Battle Chateau of the Kalos region!

Just then, another bicycle suddenly came up rapidly from behind Johan, moving quite fast.

"Hey! Friend, want to race?" The young man who caught up to Johan turned his head and shouted with some excitement.

The person appeared to be about twenty years old, with dark skin and a black short-sleeved shirt, wearing athletic pants. His hair looked like an upside-down ice cream cone, decorated with red, yellow, and blue stone ornaments.

Facing Johan's puzzled look, the young man grinned and introduced himself:

"I'm Grant, Cyllage Gym Leader. I'm good at rock climbing and cycling. Seeing you riding so fast, I couldn't help but want to compete. No other meaning intended."

"Cyllage Gym? Grant?"

"That's right." Grant held the handlebars with one hand and extended the other toward Johan, both bicycles maintaining parallel positions.

"Hello."

Johan nodded and also extended his hand to shake with the other person.

Cyllage City Gym Leader in the Kalos region, Rock-type Pokémon specialist trainer, Grant.

Main job: Gym Leader and trainer. Side job: climbing and cycling.

Called the "Rock-solid Climber," his most common saying was "I'll climb every wall that stands in my way."

In the Kalos region, any Pokémon trainer who didn't have some side business would be embarrassed to go out.

For example, Diantha's side job was acting, Elite Four Siebold's side job was cooking, Grant's side job was climbing, Viola's side job was photography, etc.

In some ways, being a Pokémon trainer might actually be their side job.

"Hello, Johan." Johan smiled and introduced himself.

Screech—

The brakes were suddenly pulled tight. Grant's bicycle carved two black marks on the ground as he stared wide-eyed and opened his mouth:

"Jo- Teacher Johan?"

Looks like I have some fame in the Kalos region too, Johan thought, also stopping his bicycle and smiling:

"You shouldn't have mistaken me."

Grant understood: "No wonder I thought Teacher Johan looked familiar earlier, but didn't think in that direction..."

He looked up at the direction they were both heading, seeming to understand something. His surprised expression grew stronger as he carefully asked:

"Teacher Johan, you're not... also going to the 'Battle Chateau,' are you?"

"Yes."

Johan didn't deny this.

The two set off again.

"So Teacher Johan, your current rank is..."

"Count."

Count...

Grant breathed a slight sigh of relief.

Good, he was currently a Marquis. According to the normal Battle Chateau matching mechanism, they shouldn't encounter each other for now.

However, with Teacher Johan's strength, reaching Marquis or even higher ranks wouldn't be surprising.

Perhaps there would be a chance for a battle before Teacher Johan advanced to Duke?

Grant, who had been worried about encountering Johan just a second ago, became eager to try the next second.

At this moment, Johan appeared to him as a towering mountain, and as a "climber" facing such a peak, he naturally wanted to challenge it.

Worry was instinct, but overcoming fear to face challenges directly was his determination as a climber!

As for Grant, Johan had no intention of underestimating him.

If nothing else, at least in the anime, Grant was the only trainer who advanced from Duke to Grand Duke in front of Ash!

At that time, the Elite Four were only Dukes, with Champion Diantha being the only Grand Duchess.

Of course, this didn't mean Grant was stronger than the Elite Four, but it showed his strength wasn't weak.

The two were traveling the same route, so Grant accompanied Johan while explaining some information about the "Battle Chateau."

"Siebold?"

Johan heard news about Siebold, one of the Kalos Elite Four, from Grant.

"That's right, Siebold's Duke promotion battle is in the next few days." Grant nodded seriously.

Duke was a very rare rank in the "Battle Chateau," and combined with his Elite Four status, this promotion battle had gained considerable attention.

Actually, with Siebold's strength, advancing to Duke wasn't very difficult.

It was just that Siebold was quite busy, often working in rotation at his various chain restaurants, and being busy with cooking naturally left little time to come to the "Battle Chateau."

This time he came for two reasons:

One was that he had indeed been matched with a suitable opponent.

The other was that the "Battle Chateau" butler had invited Siebold to cook a feast in the castle, while also inviting many "Battle Chateau" contestants for a battle-promoting banquet.

"I see..."

After hearing Grant's explanation, Johan understood.

The Battle Chateau was somewhat like a Pokémon Center, providing free food and lodging for trainers who had obtained ranks.

Moreover, the quality of food and lodging was quite good, at least better than Pokémon Centers.

At the same time, as a traditional program passed down from ancient times that promoted chivalric spirit and emphasized battle etiquette, the Battle Chateau often held some "noble" activities, like this banquet.

"So during the banquet period, it would be relatively easier to get matched with opponents?"

"Of course."

Screech—

Grant braked again, stopping in front of a cliff. Above was the Battle Chateau, with a winding upward road in between.

But Grant skillfully took out his climbing equipment, sprinkled magnesium powder on his hands, and turned to Johan:

"However, if Teacher Johan is in a hurry, you can also choose the 'designated challenge' method."

While speaking, he began nimbly climbing upward without using much safety protection, seeming very confident in himself.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar looked up at Grant and murmured.

If he missed a grip and fell...

Johan shot the purple little fatty an annoyed look.

Don't jinx it!

Then said: "Designated challenge?"

"It's a method similar to medieval dueling, where challengers designate who they want to challenge, and the challenged party usually won't refuse. But if the challenge fails, the punishment for the challenger is also severe."

High risk, high reward.

It might even offend people.

Apart from "designated challenges," most people would choose "random matching," where the Battle Chateau butler arranged opponents of equal rank or suitable opponents who were also looking for matches.

Aside from potentially taking longer, the risks and rewards were relatively smaller.

"Such an 'ancient' matching system..."

"Teacher Johan, see you at the castle entrance—"

Grant's voice came from afar - he had already climbed nearly halfway up the mountain.

Johan opened his mouth and held it for a while, finally managing one word:

"Wow."

The Battle Chateau stood tall. Passing through the castle's front garden and fountains, walking up white marble steps, they reached the castle's main entrance.

White jade pillars stood on both sides, and Grant was climbing up from one side.

An elderly butler wearing a monocle saw Johan approaching. Looking at Johan's attire, especially Johan's own monocle, his eyes lit up slightly.

"Sir, I am Hennessy, Battle Chateau butler. How may I serve you?"

Johan smiled and handed over the invitation from Professor Sycamore.

"So it's Count Johan." Hennessy accepted the invitation and said in a mild voice:

"Count Johan, would you like to be matched with an opponent, make a designated challenge, or rest and dine first? Today's main course is—"

"Johan?"

Before he could finish, another voice suddenly came from behind.

Hearing this voice, Johan showed some surprise.

Turning around, he saw a young man in a blue coat with a red cape on his back and short red hair, jumping down from a Dragonite's back and landing at the Battle Chateau entrance.

"Lance?"

Seeing that familiar cape-swishing gesture, Johan was truly surprised.

The great "Dragon Master" - instead of properly governing Kanto, what was he doing in Kalos?

Hennessy bowed slightly to Lance again, politely saying:

"Duke Lance, it's an honor to serve you."

Hm?

Well well, Lance, you with those thick eyebrows - as a Kanto region trainer, you've been secretly climbing ranks to Duke?!

# 627: The Lively Battle Chateau (Two-in-One Chapter)

"How did you end up in Kalos?" Johan asked.

Lance laughed heartily and said: "I happened to be executing a mission in Kalos. After completing it, I still had some time left, so I thought I'd come to the 'Battle Chateau' for a couple of matches before heading back."

Johan wanted to give a thumbs up and say "truly worthy of the 'Dragon Master'" - really persistent about battles.

But then he thought, "Wait, weren't you on an undercover mission?"

Wasn't Lance undercover in Team Rocket?

Speaking of this, Lance couldn't help but show some helplessness, scratching his head with some distress.

"Sigh, don't mention it. My undercover mission wasn't even complete when I was ordered to stop and hurry back to challenge for Elite Four position - an old veteran wants to retire."

Lance becoming Elite Four wasn't surprising - it was inevitable.

However, when Lance became Elite Four and wanted to challenge for Champion, his "good days" would come.

Actually, what Johan was more curious about was...

"You were ordered to stop?"

"Yeah." Lance shrugged. "I thought I was doing pretty well, sending reports back regularly. I had even infiltrated Team Rocket's middle-upper management and was preparing to push for an executive position."

Middle-upper management? Pushing for executive position?

Lance, when you say these things... why do you sound so enthusiastic?

"How was Team Rocket?" Johan probed.

Since it was Johan, an International Police Inspector, and their relationship was good with mutual understanding, Lance didn't hide anything.

"Strangely enough, Team Rocket internally... aside from competitive pressure being quite high, the benefits... were actually pretty good."

No delayed wages, fixed holidays for festivals, gifts and subsidies for major holidays, and if you went on field missions, there were field allowances and overtime pay...

"Johan, you don't know - if you become a Team Rocket executive, not only does your salary double, but also..."

Lance enthusiastically explained to Johan.

The more he talked, the more animated Lance's expression became, and Johan suddenly understood why the League ordered the undercover operation to stop and why they urgently called Lance back.

If they didn't call him back... the great "Dragon Master" Lance might really become a Team Rocket executive!

Could they actually see a Special manga version Lance recreation?

What a pity...

However, Team Rocket was indeed "honest" - regardless of who you were or your background, within Team Rocket it was merit-based, providing sufficient competition while giving enough advancement opportunities and benefits.

No wonder so many people were willing to fight desperately for Team Rocket and Giovanni.

Moreover, now that Team Rocket was beginning to transform, Lance had been undercover for so long but couldn't find much "evidence" against Team Rocket. Instead, his own beliefs and views about Team Rocket had changed somewhat.

"Perhaps..."

When Lance became Elite Four, then Champion, would be when Team Rocket completed its transformation...

This might also be one of Boss Giovanni's far-reaching strategies.

"Speaking of which, Johan, how did you come to Kalos and end up at the 'Battle Chateau'?" Lance asked in return.

"Oh." Johan snapped back to attention and shrugged casually: "Me? We're here for vacation."

Vacation...

Lance: "..."

Both coming to Kalos - he was here for a mission, Johan for vacation. How could the difference be so great?

While the two were talking, Grant had finally climbed to the Battle Chateau entrance.

"Marquis Grant, it's an honor to serve you." Castle butler Hennessy maintained his gentle, polite demeanor.

Grant was obviously familiar with Lance - not only one of the few Dukes in the Battle Chateau but after simple greetings, they walked toward the castle together.

The vast Battle Chateau was decorated quite luxuriously but not ostentatiously. Inside stood towering white jade pillars, and melodious cello and piano ensemble music drifted from the hall's corners.

When the three entered the hall, quite a few eyes gathered, with some people obviously recognizing Johan and Lance.

"Teacher Johan?"

"Teacher Johan came to the Battle Chateau too?"

"There's also Duke Lance - this is getting lively..."

"Duke Lance isn't worrying, but I wonder if Teacher Johan will get matched?"

"If he gets matched, there's nothing we can do."

Groups of people in the hall whispered among themselves.

"It's Elite Four Siebold! He came out too..."

From inside the castle walked a young man with fluffy blonde hair wearing white chef's attire - none other than Siebold, Kalos region's Water-type Elite Four member!

Siebold hadn't participated in Unova's "World Coronation Series" because he was already Kalos's Elite Four at that time.

However, Johan wasn't unfamiliar with Siebold - they'd had some interactions.

Like during the ice sculpture competition, Siebold was a special guest and had briefly interacted with Johan when presenting awards to him and Vulpix.

"Would the three of you like to dine?" Siebold maintained his smile.

As today's special invited chef for the Battle Chateau, Siebold was dedicated to his duties.

For him, compared to his Water-type Elite Four identity, Siebold preferred his work as a chef.

Johan was actually used to this.

The Kalos region, based on France, was filled with a tranquil, lazy romantic atmosphere throughout.

This was why many trainers were more enthusiastic about their "side jobs" and why so many trainers had side jobs.

Hadn't future Champion Diantha and the Elite Four set a good "example"?

Therefore, in many people's subconscious perception, Kalos region trainers' strength... was somewhat inferior to other Leagues.

This was understandable.

Sitting in a corner of the hall, Siebold and the castle staff began serving the three men food personally prepared by Siebold.

Johan wasn't actually hungry, but if you asked whether he could eat... he could definitely always eat.

After all, whose family didn't have several babies that could never be fed enough?

"Ka-kaah~!"

Gengar swallowed the exquisitely decorated pastry on its plate in one bite, smacking its lips - it seemed to taste quite good.

But while Gengar thought it tasted good, the portion was way too small.

Meanwhile, Larvitar looked eager to try - according to "rules," the next portion should be its, hehe!

"Excuse me, could we share a table?" a voice came from behind Johan.

Looking toward the voice, they saw a middle-aged beautiful woman around thirty, with purple hair in an updo, wearing a black form-fitting bodysuit and a white flowing cape.

Seeing the newcomer, Grant quickly introduced: "Teacher Johan, this is Ms. Olympia, Gym Leader of Anistar City."

Anistar Gym Leader, Olympia...

Olympia seemed quite familiar, sitting in the chair beside Johan while smiling and greeting: "Teacher Johan, Mr. Lance, Gym Leader Grant."

After sitting down, Olympia continued: "The starlight guided me to the Battle Chateau - I didn't expect to really meet the person I was meant to see."

Hm?

Olympia wasn't just a Gym Leader but also a psychic, with fortune telling as a side job, often helping people with astrology and predictions, known as "the one who lights the way with starlight."

This day was really getting lively...

Johan asked with some confusion: "Ms. Olympia, what do you mean by 'the person I was meant to see'?"

Could a fortune teller... predict what was about to happen in the Kalos region?

If she could predict it, that would be great - Johan could time his escape to avoid getting involved if possible.

Olympia smiled mysteriously, her wrist moving slightly as miniature stars seemed to twinkle in her hand.

"The starlight will guide everything. For Teacher Johan, the time has not yet come."

Johan: "..."

Could riddling people please get out of the Pokémon world?

Johan was quite speechless about this, pouring the food the waiter had just brought into Larvitar's mouth to prevent it from eating the plate too.

"Today is truly lively," Olympia said meaningfully.

Clang clang clang—

The ringing collision of metal armor echoed as everyone's attention was drawn to the sound from the castle entrance.

Bright silver heavy knight armor, a tall sturdy figure, Poké Balls hanging at the waist like a long sword...

"Elite Four Wikstrom?"

"Elite Four Wikstrom came too... today is really lively..."

The newcomer was none other than another Elite Four member from the Kalos region - the Steel-type Elite Four member who called himself "Man of Steel," Wikstrom!

Johan looked at Lance, Grant, and Olympia in front of him, then at knight Wikstrom standing at the entrance, plus Siebold currently busy in the back kitchen.

Good heavens...

Tell him this was a Masters tournament venue and he'd believe it.

Today truly was... everyone and their ghost had to make an appearance...

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar stared blankly at Wikstrom's imposing armor, its dazed expression gradually bursting with irrepressible brilliance.

Knight, armor!

Wasn't this exactly what it had dreamed of?

Gengar spun around, rummaging through Johan's waist, quickly finding Tinkaton's Poké Ball, opening it and pulling Tinkaton out.

"Cha?"

Tinkaton was napping and, being called out by Gengar, drowsily rubbed its eyes twice. Following Gengar's indication, it looked toward Wikstrom walking into the castle.

"Cha!"

The moment it saw Wikstrom, Tinkaton perked up, even unconsciously tightening its grip on the hammer handle.

Fine metal!

Not giving it a couple of hammer strikes would be such a waste...

"Ka-kaah!"

Make me a set like this one!

Gengar called out.

"Cha?"

Tinkaton glanced at Gengar's chubby, round appearance, then at the majestic Wikstrom across the way...

This style?

"Yoji..."

Seeing Gengar's attention completely captured by the armor, Larvitar's eyes darted around as it quickly poured what should have been Gengar's portion into its mouth.

Then it immediately put on a "watching the show" expression, nodding in agreement.

Yes! Yes yes! Right right right! This set is good! This style is good!

Lance and the other two couldn't help but find it amusing.

Johan's Pokémon really were a bunch of treasures - not only full of strange ideas but actually planning to act on them when they had such thoughts.

This might be what made Johan's Pokémon training different from others.

Other trainers' Pokémon, while not rigid, were more or less influenced by their trainers and learned so-called rules to better integrate into human society.

This wasn't actually problematic - like riding Rapidash and Gogoat following traffic rules.

But Johan's family?

Facing traffic lights, they wouldn't run red lights, but... Dragonite would choose to fly overhead, Larvitar would wonder if digging through counted as running a red light, and if Johan didn't stop Gengar, it would probably... well, turn the red-green light into a green-white light.

The Pokémon's natural instincts weren't overly constrained.

"Count Johan, sorry to interrupt your meal, but your opponent has been matched." Castle butler Hennessy approached the dining table with some apology.

"Matched?"

So fast?

Although this was Johan's first time at the Battle Chateau, Grant had explained quite a bit along the way.

Normal Battle Chateau matching was usually slow - even for Counts, waiting two or three days was considered fast. By Marquis and Duke levels, you might not get even a few battles per year.

However, Johan reconsidered - because Siebold came as head chef, plus Siebold's Duke promotion battle, attracting many people, faster matching made sense.

Butler Hennessy said: "Yes, your opponent is fellow Count Viola. The rules will be 2v2 singles mode, though if both parties agree, rules can be changed."

Countess Viola?

Another Gym Leader...

Were Kalos region's Gym Leaders and Elite Four planning to hold a convention at the Battle Chateau?

"Thank you for your trouble," Johan said.

The opponent didn't matter anyway - with his current rank, he couldn't match against Siebold, Wikstrom, or Lance.

"You're too kind." Butler Hennessy bowed slightly. "However, before the battle, please change into these dueling clothes..."

This was Battle Chateau tradition.

Both sides needed to change into Battle Chateau attire before battles - traditional clothing similar to formal wear and robes with capes, to demonstrate chivalric etiquette.

Johan naturally wouldn't refuse.

Soon, he changed into brand new black formal wear and a light green cape, immediately transforming his entire aura.

Johan was quite satisfied with this outfit, except for the cape's color...

"To make life bearable, you must have some green on you..."

The Battle Chateau's capes represented respective ranks to some extent.

Baron corresponded to white, Viscount to blue, Count to green, Marquis to yellow, Duke to red, and the highest Grand Duke to purple.

Led by Hennessy, they came to the castle's back garden with spacious, solid battle grounds surrounded by waterways and towering jade pillars.

Three sides of this battle field were open space, with one side being the castle's viewing building where many trainers, learning of the battle, had hurried over to secure the best viewing positions.

Lance, Grant, and others were naturally among them.

"It's Teacher Johan..."

"Teacher Johan got matched with an opponent on his first visit to the Battle Chateau? Wonder which 'lucky' person it is."

"The opponent... seems to be Gym Leader Viola?"

When Johan arrived at the battle field, his opponent appeared across from him - a girl around twenty with short silver-gray hair, also wearing battle attire and a light green cape.

None other than Viola, Gym Leader of Santalune Gym in the Kalos region.

She held a camera, aimed at Johan's side, apparently preparing to take a beautiful photo of her opponent.

However, when she saw her opponent's appearance through the viewfinder, Viola's mood immediately became complicated.

How could it be Teacher Johan?!

If I surrender now... can I lose fewer points?

Viola made a crying face while forcing a smile: "He-hello, Teacher Johan..."

She had come to the Battle Chateau, applied for battle matching with the castle butler, then went behind the castle to take photos, only to be notified she'd been matched with an opponent. Who knew it would be the famous Teacher Johan!

Supposedly, this Teacher Johan could punch legendary Pokémon to pieces.

Moreover, she'd heard that this Teacher Johan seemed quite enthusiastic about "baby cup" battles to fulfill his "teaching responsibilities," even specifically making a Larvitar wear an Everstone to maintain its "baby" appearance.

Seeing Viola's expression, Johan seemed to guess what she was thinking and sighed inwardly...

My reputation has been completely ruined by those fan-turned-hater fans.

But he still smiled and said: "Nice to meet you, Gym Leader Viola. I heard you're skilled in photography?"

Speaking of photography, Viola immediately got distracted and became somewhat excited.

"Teacher Johan is also good at photography?"

Johan shook his head. "I don't understand it, but I have a little one at home who loves photography..."

"Rotom~~"

Rotom-Dex popped out of Johan's pocket and playfully greeted Viola.

Johan also continued: "Its dream is to become the world's number one 'photographer.'"

Ho-Oh: Feeling somewhat offended.

Viola's eyes sparkled: "Oh? Then after the battle ends, we must have a good photography competition!"

"Ready anytime, Rotom!"

Rotom also perked up immediately.

Johan's face showed a strange expression.

Just for photographing Gengar, Viola would probably get quite a scare.

However, through Johan's conversation, Viola's pressure immediately decreased significantly.

It's just Teacher Johan... Hmph! If you're capable... if you're capable, I'll just lie down for you to see!

"Go, Vivillon!"

Whoosh—

The light and agile Vivillon fluttered its wings, stirring up a breeze as it appeared on the field, accompanied by falling crystalline dust.

As a Gym Leader, Viola specialized in Bug-types, which was somewhat related to her years of walking and photographing in forests.

"Gym Leader Viola's Vivillon is quite powerful."

Among the watching trainers, some had challenged Santalune Gym and naturally understood Viola's strength.

In the Battle Chateau, rank didn't completely represent strength.

"Tsk tsk, too bad the opponent is Teacher Johan..."

"Indeed."

Teacher Johan, while still considering himself an "ordinary trainer" and "ordinary teacher," no one dared actually see him that way.

Supposedly, Teacher Johan had at least Elite Four-level strength, possibly Champion level or stronger.

Champion Alder of Unova had once said in an interview that if he faced Teacher Johan at full power, his win rate might not even be ten percent.

Excluding exaggeration and mutual flattery, Teacher Johan might truly have Champion-comparable strength.

Champion versus Gym Leader... the gap was obvious.

After all, Gym Leaders' strength might vary due to age, inheritance methods, and other factors, but Champions... were definitely among the strongest trainers in a region.

Facing Viola and her Vivillon, Johan raised an eyebrow.

This... really isn't me wanting to bully people...

"Go, Larvitar."

"Yoji!!"

Hearing Johan, Larvitar immediately ran in with its little legs, full of momentum.

Vivillon, being Bug and Flying-type, was immune to Ground-type but had a 4x weakness to Rock-type.

Johan didn't want to take such a huge type advantage, but the problem was if he didn't send out Larvitar, the advantage would be even greater.

Whoosh—

Vivillon flapped its wings, its wing patterns like fierce eyes releasing a terrifying aura.

Intimidate!

Sensing the aura from Vivillon and seeing those eye-like wing patterns, Larvitar froze.

But the next second, the little one clenched its fists and "bang bang" punched its own head twice, then roared at Vivillon.

"Yoji——!!"

I wasn't raised to be scared!!

Vivillon's round little eyes unconsciously contracted, especially seeing the two red marks on Larvitar's head, feeling somewhat stunned.

This guy... so scary, it even hits itself when it gets serious...

"Mm, a tough little one, I like that." Wikstrom in his armor laughed from the viewing area.

As a knight, he valued chivalric spirit most, and facing Intimidate with this method was very appealing to him.

Lance also smiled broadly: "Johan's Larvitar really has a rough style."

Rough style?

If Larvitar knew Lance evaluated it this way, it would definitely want to have a good discussion with Lance.

I'm the Desert Tyrant's cub and quite smart too!

Besides, what do you mean rough style?

This is clearly a tyrant's royal dominance!

Didn't you see how that Vivillon got scared?

"Vivillon, Water Pulse!"

Although Vivillon was Bug and Flying-type, having "rain" in its name and being active on water surfaces during its Surskit stage, it wasn't like it couldn't use Water-type moves.

Buzz—

Water vapor gathered around Vivillon, forming a glowing water orb in front of it that shot straight toward Larvitar.

Using its flying ability and agile form, Vivillon confronted Larvitar for a moment, found Larvitar's "opening," and immediately struck without hesitation.

As the Water Pulse was thrown, Vivillon didn't stop moving but quickly circled behind Larvitar.

Even if this attack missed, the initiative advantage remained with Viola.

From this, it was clear Viola's practical battle level wasn't bad.

However...

"Larvitar, block it," Johan commanded.

Block it?

How?

Larvitar grinned, showing a "fierce" smile, and raised its foot to stomp hard.

BOOM!!

The solid battle field ground suddenly shook, and a huge rock rose like a seesaw after Larvitar's stomp.

Bang—

The water flow hit the risen rock and scattered.

"So... so Rock-types can counter Water-type moves like this..."

Some trainers said they'd learned something new and felt enlightened.

"Dragon Dance!"

Taking advantage of the blocking moment, Larvitar's momentum began rising continuously. Seeing this, Viola's heart jumped, not daring to hesitate:

"Vivillon, Energy Ball, interrupt it!"

Green fluorescent light flickered as Vivillon, positioned behind Larvitar, quickly condensed an Energy Ball and hurled it at Larvitar's back, trying to interrupt its Dragon Dance.

But it was too late.

"Crunch!"

"Yoji!!"

Larvitar called out "viciously," spun around sharply, and opened its mouth wide to meet the incoming green Energy Ball.

Under Viola's astonished gaze, the Energy Ball condensed with Grass-type energy was... crunched to pieces by Larvitar!

"Cru-, crunched? Grass-type Energy Ball is... this easy to crunch?"

Many trainers exclaimed in shock.

"Yoji... (￣~￣)"

Larvitar indicated: Doesn't taste as good as the World Tree's branches.

Buzz—

Simultaneously, Larvitar's body glowed again, its momentum rising once more!

"We-, Weakness Policy?"

Someone recognized the item Larvitar was holding.

[Weakness Policy: When the Pokémon holding this item is hit by a super effective attack, its Attack and Special Attack are raised by 2 stages each!]

"No, we understand the logic, but..."

"How dare Teacher Johan give Larvitar a 'Weakness Policy'!"

With 4x weakness to Grass and Water, with Larvitar's small first-stage body, wouldn't a 4x super effective move one-shot it?

Yet the reality was Larvitar not only took it but also crunched the Energy Ball.

Johan smiled slightly.

His Larvitar used World Tree branches as teething toys and Leaf Stones as snacks.

Through such unreserved intensive training, the little one's resistance to Grass-types had indeed improved considerably.

Of course, being able to take the Energy Ball and appear relatively unharmed was also because Larvitar had crunched it.

"Stone Edge!"

Since everything was ready, it was time to counterattack.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar raised its foot again and stomped toward the ground.

Rumble rumble—

Sharp rock spires rose from the ground one after another, shooting toward Vivillon like spears.

"Vivillon, dodge quickly!" Viola waved her hand urgently.

Whoosh—

Wings beating, Vivillon maximized its agility, and the seemingly powerful Stone Edge attack missed completely under the audience's surprised and admiring gazes.

"Damn, confirmed by eye contact - definitely the real Teacher Johan."

"Great power, but useless."

"Hahaha— 80% accuracy move whiffing, truly worthy of Teacher Johan."

Johan coughed awkwardly and softly said to the chest-thumping Viola:

"Rock Slide."

Good thing he'd calculated this possibility - if 80% accuracy wasn't enough, use 90% accuracy moves!

There's always one that... there's always one move that can hit.

Sure enough, Vivillon, already forced into a corner dodging Stone Edge, faced Larvitar's determined Rock Slide - rocks flying like cannonballs at extreme speed - and finally ran out of dodging space.

BANG!!

Rocks shattered, Vivillon cried out and fluttered down from the air, losing fighting ability!

"Yoji!!"

Larvitar roared powerfully again.

I, the Desert Tyrant's cub, am very strong and very smart!!

It had to be said, setting aside Larvitar's self-proclaimed statements, it truly displayed some Desert Tyrant momentum and bearing at this moment.

One-shot KO!

The watching trainers had various expressions.

Although Vivillon had a 4x Rock weakness, plus Larvitar's boosts, a one-shot seemed normal.

But... they unconsciously looked at the huge rock fragments scattered on the ground and couldn't help swallowing.

So this was supposedly Rock Slide? Those who didn't know might think it was Rock Wrecker.

"Vivillon is unable to battle," butler and referee Hennessy announced. "Countess Viola, please send out your next Pokémon."

Viola recalled Vivillon, muttering quietly:

"It's all lies. This Larvitar... is definitely a Tyranitar wearing Larvitar skin."

Though muttering, her movements weren't slow - she'd been mentally prepared anyway.

"Go, Spewpa!"

Spewpa was the Kalos region's "regional bug," and due to living and growing in different environments, its wing patterns would vary greatly.

Currently known were 20 different Spewpa wing patterns, making it a popular Bug-type for many Bug-type trainers to collect.

Viola's Spewpa was the relatively common "Garden Pattern" form.

However, Spewpa, like Vivillon, was Bug and Flying-type, with 4x Rock weakness.

Also unable to take one hit from Larvitar - how to battle?

"Spewpa, Poison Powder! Stun Spore!" Viola changed tactics.

Colorful wings fluttered, scales falling with poison and paralysis effects.

She was trying to limit Larvitar's mobility before slowly wearing it down.

"Using 'status' tactics against the most 'status' trainer?"

"But logically, Larvitar has no countermeasures, right?"

Countermeasures?

"Larvitar, Sandstorm!" Johan waved his hand.

Scales?

Wonder if they could fall normally in a sandstorm.

"Yoji!"

Sand rose rapidly from under Larvitar's feet, instantly filling the air with terrible dust that immediately swept across the entire battle field.

Those colorful scales from Spewpa were immediately scattered by the raging sandstorm.

Even Spewpa itself swayed in the sandstorm.

Though the battle wasn't over, the outcome was decided.

Spewpa's methods couldn't restrict Larvitar, so it just came down to when Larvitar's moves would hit Spewpa.

After two Rock Slides missed and the third hit Spewpa, the battle ended!

"Spewpa is unable to battle!"

Hennessy announced the battle result: "The winner is Count Johan!"

After brief silence, applause erupted.

Then Hennessy announced again: "In view of Count Johan's strength and this battle's points, Count Johan is promoted to Marquis Johan!"

Some commotion in the venue.

Promoted to Marquis in one battle?

But when the sandstorm cleared and people saw the field, they stopped talking.

With this kind of strength and destructive power... suggest direct promotion to Duke.

The Battle Chateau Marquises waiting in the matching queue suddenly felt a chill.

Oh no... they wouldn't get matched with Teacher Johan, would they?

Can we cancel matching now? Is there still time?
