# 628: The Legendary Other Two Pillars (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Yoji!!"

Larvitar vibrated its arms and shouted excitedly.

Awesome!

This battle, while not particularly thrilling or exciting for Larvitar, gave it a sense of satisfaction.

Ever since birth, the little one had been eating and drinking well while growing, never missing daily training. Every time it watched Gengar and the others battle, it would get excited too, but...

Larvitar didn't have much concept of its own strength.

It had appeared in the "World Coronation Series" but hadn't battled since then.

It didn't know if this period of effort (crazy eating) had been effective, or if its training had been successful.

It had no accurate concept of this.

Anyway, during internal team sparring, it was always the one being shown mercy.

But this battle made it feel its own progress.

Mm, truly awesome!

It could eat even more enthusiastically later.

Facts proved that eating hard and strength improvement were related. Thinking of this, the little one couldn't help swallowing again.

"Unfortunately, we couldn't test the effects of Larvitar's recent 'Iron Defense' training," Johan looked at the excited little one with a smile.

However, it was better not to get injured. Although he wanted to test the Iron Defense training effects, who would want to watch their Pokémon risk injury?

Best if they never had to "verify" the Iron Defense training effects.

"Teacher Johan, could we take a photo with you and Larvitar?"

Viola recalled her defeated Spewpa, packed away her disappointment from losing, and picked up her camera with renewed excitement.

Losing to Teacher Johan... wasn't embarrassing.

But the scene of her first battle with Teacher Johan had to be preserved.

"No problem." Johan straightened his clothes slightly, and Larvitar also flexed its arms in a strongman pose, standing beside Johan.

"Get ready..."

Click—

The shutter quickly clicked, continuous shots ended, and Viola eagerly wanted to see the results.

But her expression gradually changed from initial excitement and anticipation to bewilderment, surprise, and finally horror.

Where did this Gengar come from?!

Every frame captured showed Gengar in different poses!

This was supernatural.

Oh right, Gengar was already a ghost, so never mind...

Seeing Viola's expression, Johan knew what she had photographed and immediately gave up the idea of asking for copies.

Their family already had piles of Gengar photos taken by Rotom that they couldn't store anymore.

"Congratulations, Marquis Johan, on successfully advancing to Marquis rank."

Butler Hennessy, representing the Battle Chateau, offered congratulations.

"Thank you."

Marquis!

He wondered if, with so many people gathering at the Battle Chateau this time, there might be a chance to directly break through to Duke?

Johan's gaze swept over those trainers watching from the second floor, but most of them averted their eyes.

Don't look at me!

Even an unevolved Larvitar cub could "destroy" a Gym Leader, and while there was type advantage... it was hard to imagine how strong Teacher Johan's Gengar would be.

Evening time.

The melodious music continued in the Battle Chateau, and the cuisine prepared by head chef Cilan received unanimous praise.

Johan seriously suspected that so many people gathering at the Battle Chateau this time were all here to freeload food and drinks.

Don't look at everyone acting like they weren't short of money - they wouldn't lack money to eat at Cilan's restaurant, but... who could refuse free gourmet food?

Just like his own little ones.

Today's several battles had also become dinner conversation topics, naturally including Johan's battle with Viola.

"Teacher Johan's Larvitar... although it hasn't evolved, I suspect it already has at least senior Gym Leader-level main Pokémon strength."

"Speaking of which, Teacher Johan wouldn't be planning to train Larvitar to Elite Four level or higher, right? I noticed Larvitar wearing an Everstone."

"Hiss—just for baby cup battles?"

"Cough, is it possible that we're all 'babies'?"

Johan pretended not to hear these discussions, having grown used to them anyway.

Heh, for baby cup battles? The League had already promoted his trainer level to Master rank - which baby cup would let Master-level trainers participate?

You say Master-level trainers are also babies? Then never mind...

"Johan, how many more days are you staying here?" Lance asked during dinner.

"Not sure." Johan put down his fork. "If things go smoothly, let's see if I can advance to Duke while taking advantage of this opportunity."

"Duke?"

Nearby Grant and Viola exchanged glances without speaking.

They knew very well how difficult advancing to Duke was, but the one speaking was Teacher Johan, and for him, as long as he could get matched with opponents, it should be quite fast.

Lance was different - he immediately became interested.

"Duke? I was originally planning to wait for Cilan to advance to Duke to see if I could battle him, but if you advance to Duke, we could spar."

Last time during the "World Coronation Series," Lance hadn't encountered Johan before being eliminated, which he still found very regrettable.

This time might be an opportunity...

Facing Lance's suggestion, Johan smiled politely without speaking.

Battle you?

Let's see if you can still find me after I advance to Duke.

Battling passionate battle-type trainers like Lance and Flint was what Johan least wanted to see - they'd power up at the drop of a hat, and who could handle that?

Nearby, Drasna was elegantly enjoying her food and smiled slightly, seeming to "predict" something.

Eating away, Johan's phone suddenly rang.

The caller ID showed Cynthia.

After answering, her gentle voice came through: "I heard you went to the Battle Chateau in the Kalos region?"

"You know about this already?"

The news spread so fast?

He'd only arrived this afternoon, had one battle, and Cynthia already knew?

"Battle Chateau battles are uploaded online." Cynthia chuckled. "Didn't you know?"

"Uh... I really didn't know."

Recently he hadn't been surfing the internet much, so he hadn't thought Cynthia would be paying such close attention.

While talking, Johan took his phone from Gengar, got up and walked toward the balcony, opening a webpage.

"The Possibility of Gengar Changing Egg Groups" "How Long Can a Ghost Float in the Sky" "How to Make Trainers Sleep More Soundly at Night"

Johan: "..."

He glared at Gengar through the window - what have you been browsing online?

Gengar shrank its head, pretending not to see, and continued devouring food.

"How's head chef Cilan's cooking?" Cynthia asked.

"Pretty good."

Johan seemed to see the little glutton licking her lips and couldn't help smiling.

At the same time, he found the Battle Chateau category page with his battle video.

There were quite a few comments below.

"Compared to me?" Cynthia asked curiously again.

"Me?"

Johan opened his mouth, but before he could finish speaking, he suddenly saw a comment from Cynthia under the video.

[Eevee Eats Cabbage]: Hmm... wonder whether Cilan or Johan cooks better...

As a public figure, Cynthia's comment naturally drew heated discussion.

"Wait, Teacher Johan can cook too?"

"Hold on! Why would Cynthia compare them? Could it be she's eaten his cooking before?"

"Cut it out, you're behind the times. Cynthia and Teacher Johan are a couple, don't you know?"

"What?!!"

Then came a chorus of wailing, as if Johan had stolen someone's precious cabbage, with "challenges" to Johan everywhere.

But one comment caught Johan's attention, or rather, this comment already had high engagement and likes because the commenter was Cilan himself!

[Three-Star Chef Cilan]: I'm quite curious too.

Wait!

A head chef not busy cooking but surfing the internet?

Johan felt like he'd been backstabbed by Cynthia.

"Johan? Johan?" Johan snapped back to attention hearing his phone calling.

"Oh, cough cough, I spaced out for a moment."

"Spaced out?"

"Mm, probably missing you."

"Hmm..."

What kind of reaction was that?

But soon, Johan understood why.

Flint's voice came through the phone.

"Big sis, the meeting isn't over yet, why'd you leave?"

Then came the sound of shoes tapping on the floor.

Johan: "..."

"You're in a meeting? With the speaker on?"

"...No." Cynthia said quietly.

Johan let out a long sigh of relief.

That was close - if Flint had heard that, tomorrow all of Sinnoh would know.

"That's good." Johan felt cold sweat. "In that case, help me beat up Flint."

"Hm?"

"Nothing, just feel like beating him up. Can't reach him myself, so please help."

"...Okay."

After chatting briefly, Cynthia finally said:

"Take care of yourself in Kalos. And... I miss you too."

After hanging up, Johan put away his phone with an unconscious smile.

Returning to the hall, Grant and Viola had buried their heads even lower, Lance wore a pig-like grin about to speak, and Johan's heart jumped - he'd forgotten about this equally perceptive person. Although Lance's style shouldn't lead to excessive behavior...

He immediately pointed at him:

"You speak up, and I'll post all your and Clair's embarrassing stories online."

Lance: "!!"

Such heavy resentment.

Nearby, Drasna smiled and sighed: "Youth truly is more beautiful than starlight."

Suddenly—

Buzz buzz—

The Battle Chateau hall's chandelier suddenly flickered.

Hm?

Everyone instinctively looked up.

What was happening?

Pop!

The next second, the lights went completely out, leaving only moonlight streaming through windows.

Power outage?

Soon, butler Hennessy led a group of maid-dressed attendants carrying candles into the hall, giving the dim hall a different ambiance.

"Apologies, everyone." Hennessy bowed to the surrounding area. "The castle's power system seems to have problems. We're finding someone for emergency repairs."

Power system again?

Johan frowned.

Lumiose City also had power system problems.

Drasna suddenly stood, walked to the balcony, spread her arms as starlight scattered down from the clear night sky, her eyes glowing with psychic light.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar tilted its head, looking at Drasna with interested eyes.

This was stargazing?

Interesting!

"Starlight guidance shows the cause is northward, probably... the Kalos Power Plant. The trouble isn't small." Drasna rarely showed a serious expression.

North? Kalos Power Plant?

The trainers in the hall looked at each other.

"Serious trouble?" Justice-driven Lance stood up, turning to Johan: "Johan, let's make a trip to check it out."

Johan: "???"

No, why are you dragging me into this?

But there was no choice.

Lance was a League investigator, and Johan was an International Police Inspector!

In terms of authority, when necessary, he could even mobilize Elite Four and below forces in a region.

Strictly speaking, Johan had the highest authority present.

"You two."

Another voice rang out, accompanied by "clank clank" armor sounds - clearly Elite Four Wikstrom!

As a follower of "chivalric spirit," he also had his sense of responsibility, especially since he was a Kalos region Elite Four.

"Let me join you two!"

Without waiting for their agreement, Wikstrom assumed a knight's solemn oath posture, one hand at his waist, the other holding a Poké Ball to his chest.

"I swear by the moon, I will definitely resolve this problem!"

"Then we'll trouble you, Elite Four Wikstrom!" Lance said seriously.

As someone with a righteous heart, Lance and Wikstrom were kindred spirits.

"It's my honor to fight alongside you two!"

Johan: No, could you let me say something?

Butler Hennessy also said: "I'll arrange a helicopter immediately."

Johan opened his mouth but couldn't speak.

Fine, fine, power plant it is. At most it's just a Zapdos - with Lance and Wikstrom charging ahead, he could just slack off.

Soon.

A helicopter rose from the Battle Chateau, flying toward the power plant.

As for Cilan...

A power outage didn't mean no fire - he still didn't know what was causing the outage.

Buzz buzz buzz—

The helicopter's rotor spun rapidly. Johan leaned against the window, watching the scenery pass below while listening to Lance and Wikstrom chatting through his headset, feeling incredibly helpless.

These two grown men... how could they talk so much?

They'd even gotten into family histories of the Dragon Tamer clan and Wikstrom's family.

Actually, their families did have some connection.

Three thousand years ago, when King AZ tried to use the Ultimate Weapon to revive his beloved deceased Floette, the resulting war destroyed everything.

The battle that took place near the Tree of Beginning, around Cameran Palace, was actually related to this.

Wikstrom's family included knights who served King AZ, and Cameran Palace wasn't far from Lance's Dragon Tamer clan territory...

The two great families had even worked together to overthrow King AZ.

However, after being revived, Floette learned that AZ had consumed numerous lives to revive it, became disappointed and left him.

King AZ suffered greatly, left his kingdom alone, but possibly due to the Ultimate Weapon's influence, gained eternal life. Where he lives now, no one knows.

"Ka-kaah! Ka-kaah!"

Johan found it tedious, but Gengar was quite interested, nodding along.

The purple fatty only remembered a few points: Ultimate Weapon, revival, eternal life!

Its little brain couldn't help imagining... if Johan ever aged and died, could it use this method to revive him?

Or... it could fake death, then have Johan use this method to revive it?

That way, affected by the Ultimate Weapon, could Johan live forever?

Bonk!!

Johan irritably knocked its head.

Ow!

Gengar held its head, meeting Johan's serious gaze.

"Gengar, I know what you're thinking, but this method - neither I nor you are allowed to use it!"

Seeing him so serious, Gengar shrank and nodded obediently.

Oh...

But for Gengar, forget millions or billions of lives - none compared to Johan.

The little one had its own stubbornness in its heart.

Johan rubbed his temples.

He could suppress Gengar now, but what if later he...

Was he really going to leave a bunch of lawless "demon kings" for the Pokémon world?

The pressure was getting heavy.

"We're here." Wikstrom said.

The three looked down.

Kalos Power Plant was one of the largest power plants in the Kalos region, fully meeting the electricity needs of nearby cities, including the massive Lumiose City.

However.

The huge power plant, which should have been brightly lit even at night, was now pitch black from above. If Lance hadn't pointed it out, Johan wouldn't have recognized it as a power plant.

The Battle Chateau helicopter landed outside the power plant, and the three disembarked.

Their arrival naturally attracted the attention of Officer Jenny and others who had arrived earlier.

Earlier, when Lumiose City had power problems, the League sent many electricians to search Lumiose City for issues, thinking it was aging circuits or some malfunction, especially since Lumiose City was only having intermittent outages.

It wasn't until Johan gave Professor Sycamore a direction that League investigations slowly shifted toward the power plant.

But when Officer Jenny investigated near the power plant... the entire power plant suddenly lost power.

This caused the sudden outage at the Battle Chateau.

"Teacher Johan, Elite Four Wikstrom, Lance." Seeing the three appear, Officer Jenny visibly relaxed.

"What's the situation?" Lance asked.

Officer Jenny briefly explained the situation.

Kalos Power Plant had never had major problems since construction. This kind of large-scale outage without obvious damage like explosions was most likely caused by Pokémon.

But for Pokémon to drain the entire Kalos Power Plant's electricity... could it be a group of Electric-types?

"Where's the Lumiose Gym Leader?" Wikstrom frowned.

Lumiose Gym was an Electric-type gym. As the Gym Leader, shouldn't they investigate when outages occurred?

Officer Jenny looked somewhat embarrassed, glancing at Wikstrom before saying:

"Well... Lumiose Gym's Clemont retired last month due to his age and returned to his hometown. The new Gym Leader is still awaiting League approval."

Wikstrom's expression stiffened.

Johan and Lance exchanged glances.

Not knowing this as an Elite Four was... a bit embarrassing.

But thinking about it carefully.

Of the four Kalos Elite Four: Wikstrom was busy with knight training, Cilan was everywhere cooking, Drasna was a journalist busy with interviews, leaving one Dragon-type Elite Four Malva whose hometown was the Sinnoh region...

It wasn't much different from Hoenn, Sinnoh, situations - like they were cut from the same mold.

And Malva's side job was currently unknown, not necessarily handling main Kalos League affairs.

In Johan's view, Kalos League might match its own laid-back, tranquil atmosphere - emphasizing... going with the flow.

Otherwise, how could Lumiose City, the largest city in Kalos, lack a Gym Leader for a month?

Too damn "romantic"...

"Cough cough." Wikstrom coughed. "Then we can only investigate ourselves."

"I might be able to try." Johan said.

Everyone's attention turned to him as Johan took out his Rotom Pokédex.

Back at Professor Sycamore's Pokémon lab, when checking instruments, Rotom had vaguely sensed someone stealing electricity. Now at the power plant entrance, Rotom should sense it more clearly.

"Rotom, check the situation."

"Understood, Rotom!"

Rotom flew out of the Pokédex, found an electrical cable and dove in.

Buzz buzz buzz—

Golden arcs danced as it disappeared into the power plant in a flash.

Seeing this, Lance smacked his lips: "The League started promoting Rotom half a year ago. Looks really necessary now."

For any electrical, electronic, or current problems, having a Rotom was very convenient.

Plus Rotom could enter phones, Pokédexes, and special Rotom motor-equipped appliances.

Truly the "ultimate utility Pokémon."

However, Rotom training wasn't simple. Although being promoted, getting everyone one was still far away.

With Lance's status, applying for one shouldn't be difficult.

Wikstrom and Officer Jenny agreed completely.

Soon.

Rotom, which had rapidly entered the power plant, emerged even faster along the cables, like escaping for its life.

Hm?

"Help, help, Rotom! There's a big guy!"

Whoosh—

Rotom that flew out of the cables quickly dove into Johan's pocket.

This reaction, this escape speed...

"Big guy?" Several people looked puzzled.

The next second.

Buzz buzz buzz—

Massive golden arcs leaped up, terrifying electricity instantly filling all cables. The originally dark power plant became brightly lit again.

Buzz buzz buzz—

But as electrical output suddenly increased, lamp after lamp exploded with mournful sounds.

"Regieleki—!!"

An angry roar came from inside the power plant.

Hearing this clearly, Johan and the others' expressions changed, especially Johan who looked surprised.

The next moment.

BOOM!!

A massive rumbling sound erupted.

A completely golden figure made of electronic currents, with blue rings on both shoulders and abdomen, seven signal lights on its face, a golden giant bathed in lightning leaped out of the power plant!

Electric Pillar, Regieleki!

"This is..." Lance and Wikstrom looked surprised.

What Pokémon was this?

"Eleki!!"

Regieleki roared, its seven flashing signal lights violently jumping with red light, seemingly in a state of furious rage from interrupted dining.

Rotom's "big guy," the cause of the power plant outage, the culprit behind urban blackouts, was actually this legendary Electric Pillar, Regieleki?!

"Regieleki."

While the several people retreated, dodging jumping electrical arcs, Johan quickly explained.

"One of the legendary titans, said to be created by the King of Toilets—no, by Regigigas the Colossal Pokémon, called the 'Electric Pillar.' It's a Pokémon that lives by consuming electrons, but can also produce terrifying electrical currents."

Electric Pillar?

Legendary Pokémon?

Created by Regigigas the Colossal?

"Wasn't Regigigas said to have created only the three legendary titans?"

Regirock the Rock Peak, Regice the Iceberg, Registeel the Iron, how did an Electric Pillar appear?

Johan could only say he didn't know - later generations patching earlier generations wasn't new.

"Not just that. Besides the three legendary titans and the Electric Pillar Regieleki before us, there's also a Dragon Pillar, Regidrago!"

"Dragon Pillar?!" Lance's eyes burst with light.

Johan glanced at him.

No, you're a Flying-type Elite Four - why are you so interested in Dragon Pillar just because it has "Dragon" in the name?

Besides, Dragon Pillar was just called that - it was actually just a "dragon head." When Regigigas was creating Regidrago, it ran out of dragon crystals.

If it had been completed... who would be the King of Toilets would be hard to say.

However, whether Dragon Pillar Regidrago or Electric Pillar Regieleki, because they were too dangerous, they were both restrained.

Like the blue rings on Electric Pillar Regieleki - supposedly devices to suppress electrical currents, because ancient people feared Regieleki's power.

If fully unleashed, Regieleki's power would be further released.

Of course, the truth of such claims needed verification.

"Let's worry about Dragon Pillar later - this guy seems like we can only face it head-on."

Wikstrom's armor "clanked" as he showed no fear facing the imposing Regieleki.

He threw a Poké Ball, red light flashing as a Aegislash maintaining shield form appeared before him.

Bang!!

A golden arc like a whip suddenly swept over, blocked by the shield and deflected to the ground, leaving a crater with scorch marks and smoke.

"Seems so."

Lance said seriously, also throwing a Poké Ball, summoning his Dragonite. Its small wings flapped powerfully, creating gusts that blew away the sweeping electrical currents.

Why would Regieleki suddenly appear at Kalos Power Plant? This was temporarily unclear, but stopping the rampaging Regieleki was definitely right.

"Regi—!!"

Seeing Aegislash and Dragonite suddenly appear, Regieleki felt somewhat threatened.

This made the already angry creature from interrupted feeding even more furious.

Buzz buzz buzz—

Its seven signal lights faintly glowed purple.

Zap—

One of Regieleki's arms exploded, becoming countless snake-like golden currents, like thunder whips, lashing toward Aegislash and Dragonite while quickly weaving into a sky-covering net.

Thunder Cage!

Regieleki's exclusive move!

"Aegislash, King's Shield!"

Wikstrom's expression grew serious as he solemnly said to Lance and Johan: "Guarding is a knight's duty. Please leave defense to me!"

Clang!

With the ringing of blade against shield, a thick metallic luster appeared around Aegislash, the shield phantom expanding to seemingly envelope all of them.

"Good!" Lance responded without doubt, waving his arm and cape: "Dragonite, Dragon Dance, then Dragon Rush!"

"Draaa—"

Lance's Dragonite flapped its wings, rapidly ascending while surrounded by blue-purple dragon energy, its momentum surging as it transformed into a giant dragon diving toward Regieleki.

This guy - wasn't it also awakened by Arceus like Regice and Regigigas?

Johan had this thought but his hands weren't slow, directly throwing two Poké Balls.

"Armarouge, Aura Sphere!"

"Urshifu, Swords Dance!"

However, while throwing two Poké Balls, one at Johan's waist opened itself as Larvitar ran out on its own.

"Yoji!"

The little one spread its arms, shouting at Regieleki without courtesy.

Come on if you dare!

It even beckoned with its finger.

Come fight me!

"Regi—!!"

Regieleki's gaze fell on Larvitar.

Hm?

Seeing this, Johan raised an eyebrow.

Could it hear Larvitar's taunts and provocations?

Could he try communicating?

Because of the previous Regice incident, Johan didn't immediately try communicating, thinking he should subdue it first.

But now it seemed Regieleki wasn't completely enraged?

BOOM!!

Dragonite's Dragon Rush and Armarouge's Aura Sphere hit Regieleki solidly.

Massive rumbling accompanied countless scattering electrical arcs as the entire power plant sky erupted with golden serpents and soaring flames.

"Eleki!!!" Regieleki cried out in pain.

Aura exists in the heart!

Johan used his aura, his voice echoing in Regieleki's mind—

"Hey! Regigigas is calling you home for dinner!"

# 629: Regieleki? Just a Simple One! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Regi?"

Hearing Johan's words, Regieleki immediately forgot its pain and whipped around, seemingly searching for Regigigas's figure.

But how could it find Regigigas like this? Behind it was only the power plant and empty space.

In an instant, Regieleki felt like it had been tricked, and its anger flared even higher.

"Eleki!!"

However, for Johan, this was good news.

Regieleki indeed hadn't become so furious that it completely couldn't listen to reason - it wasn't at the point where it needed to be beaten into submission first.

After all, it was a legendary Pokémon, and an even rarer Electric Pillar compared to the three legendary titans. Plus, having absorbed the entire Kalos Power Plant's electricity, its displayed strength was considerably stronger than that rampaging Regice from before.

You had to know, Kalos Power Plant was later targeted by Team Flare, with Lysandre planning to use its energy to activate the Ultimate Weapon!

Although the operational method was different from Team Flare's, it was enough to prove the massive electrical current of Kalos Power Plant. Having received such enhancement, the current Regieleki could be said to have both attacks at +6, and that was conservative.

No wonder its current size was so exaggerated - nearly ten meters tall.

"Elite Four Wikstrom, Lance, I want to get a bit closer," Johan called out loudly.

Get closer?

Wikstrom and Lance exchanged glances.

Wikstrom was somewhat puzzled by this, but Lance understood.

Right.

Johan was a Pokémon psychologist - he was best at calming rampaging Pokémon, and he had unclear, mysterious relationships with numerous legendary Pokémon.

If Johan could calm Regieleki, there would be no need for a life-or-death battle.

After all, this was Kalos Power Plant - if any part got damaged, repairs wouldn't be easy.

"Good!" Lance grinned heartily. "Dragonite, Dragon Rush, tie it down!"

Seeing Lance's reaction, Wikstrom seemed to understand as well, waving his hand: "Aegislash, show the unyielding spirit of a knight - full power King's Shield!"

With Lance and Wikstrom's help, amid the racing thunder serpents, they opened a safe path for Johan to approach.

Armarouge and Urshifu followed at his sides, preventing any stray electrical arcs from getting through.

However, everything went quite smoothly.

After all, there were Wikstrom and Lance providing distraction.

Johan's aura rose again.

"Regieleki." He called out once more, silently regretting in his heart.

Too bad Regigigas hadn't given him any credentials. If he had some kind of token that would make all the legendary titans bow down when brandished, that would be interesting.

However, while Regigigas hadn't given him so-called credentials, someone else had.

Johan took out the Wheel of Time that Arceus had given him, injected aura into it, and summoned a dim glow.

"Regi?"

This time, Regieleki sensed Arceus's aura and looked intently toward Johan.

It saw Johan's gentle smile, and through his aura came full goodwill and friendliness.

"Sorry for interrupting your 'meal.' How about I compensate you with a proper feast?"

"Eleki?"

"Regigigas has eaten it too, the three legendary titans have eaten it too. Everyone who's tried it says it's good."

"Regi..."

Regieleki's seven signal lights flickered, slowly changing from purple back to red, then gradually fading from red until they became bright white.

The scattered electrical arcs also slowly gathered and finally returned to Regieleki's body.

Its massive form gradually shrank.

Lance and Wikstrom exchanged glances, watching the originally seven-to-eight-meter-tall towering giant gradually become this less than 1.5-meter height, both showing surprise in their eyes.

This small?

And...

It was settled?

They felt like they hadn't even fought much.

Lance and Wikstrom both had a feeling... like they were about to engage in a three-hundred-round battle, only for the opponent to surrender in just a few rounds. There was an uncomfortable feeling of not being able to use their strength.

Although it was a good thing, it wasn't... satisfying.

"Regi..."

Honestly, Johan hadn't expected Regieleki to become this small either.

Didn't this mean... Professor Oak's Pokédex was finally accurate for once?

However, that said, the seven-to-eight-meter Regieleki looked intimidating, but the less than 1.5-meter Regieleki bouncing on the ground... actually looked somewhat cute?

Even Larvitar came forward and patted its own head, then stood on tiptoes trying to reach Regieleki's head.

"Yoji~!"

Hey, we're about the same height!

Zap—

Regieleki got "annoyed" and shot out a small electrical current that hit Larvitar.

It still remembered Larvitar's provocative behavior from earlier.

However...

Pop!!

The electrical arc exploded on Larvitar's chest. The little one tilted its head and touched its chest.

"Yoji?"

What's this? Giving me a massage? Hey, don't mention it, it feels pretty comfortable~

"Regi?"

Regieleki tilted its head, showing some confusion.

No reaction?

Could this little thing really be a master?

Johan's mouth twitched.

His Larvitar was a Ground-type Pokémon - even if you were Regieleki, just that little bit of electrical current really couldn't shock it.

However, Johan didn't dwell on this matter. He was more curious about how Regieleki had appeared here.

So he used his aura to transmit this question.

"Eleki..."

Toward Johan, this being with powerful aura who was also an "Arceus messenger," plus having promised to treat it to a meal, Regieleki's attitude was quite friendly.

Its signal lights slowly flickered, as if it too was thinking about how it had ended up here.

The reason Regieleki had run to Kalos Power Plant was actually quite simple.

It was hungry and needed electrical current to replenish itself.

As for why it had awakened from its sleeping state... it seemed like a group of people had rashly intruded into its resting place and woken it up.

This differed from Johan's guess that it had been awakened by Arceus's revival.

"A group of people?"

In Johan's memory, Regieleki and Regidrago slept in the "Split-Decision Ruins" in the Crown Tundra of the Galar region.

Of course, while Regieleki and Regidrago weren't as numerous as the three legendary titans, there definitely wouldn't be just one of each.

Having Regieleki explain it itself, it couldn't say where exactly it had been sleeping.

It only knew... it was quite far from here, and it had even crossed a large body of water. The reason it hadn't eaten at its awakening location was because there simply weren't many electrical currents and electrons there.

There was quite a bit of snow though.

Hm?

Snow?

Could it really have awakened in the Crown Tundra of the Galar region?

Crossed the ocean to reach the Kalos region?

Crown Tundra naturally wouldn't have much electrical current for it to eat.

Not just Crown Tundra - actually the entire Galar region didn't have much, because Galar region's energy was provided by Macro Cosmos Energy Company, using Galar particles as raw materials.

This made Johan somewhat troubled.

Where should this Regieleki go?

Take it home?

It would probably drain all of Rustboro City's electricity in minutes.

While thinking, Johan sat cross-legged on the ground and took out his most skilled "communication tool" - energy cubes!

Johan felt like being called a "Pokémon psychologist" was somewhat undeserved. He should probably be called... an energy cube communication specialist.

However, that said, energy cubes - this high-energy and delicious food created by modern human technology - held tremendous appeal for Pokémon like Regieleki who had slept for hundreds or thousands of years.

Not just Regieleki - didn't even Darkrai from Alamos Town get completely mesmerized?

A truckload of energy cubes was enough to take on Arceus.

It wasn't that the Pokémon weren't strong enough or brave enough - purely that the "payment" wasn't tempting enough.

"Regi~"

Obviously, after tasting the energy cubes, Regieleki's mood immediately became happy and pleasant.

And once its mood improved and it calmed down, it sensed Johan's aura - besides the Arceus aura from the Wheel of Time, there were other legendary Pokémon auras remaining.

Among them were ones Regieleki recognized, like their creator Regigigas, and ones Regieleki didn't recognize, such as space, time, antimatter, ideals, reality...

This sensing didn't matter much, but once it sensed them, Regieleki immediately broke out in a cold sweat.

Its eyes instantly became clear.

Regieleki: ('Θ')

Good heavens!

Big brother, have you eaten yet?

Johan suddenly sensed thick goodwill from Regieleki.

Hm?

Your attitude changed a bit fast there.

I actually prefer your previous rebellious appearance.

Were energy cubes really this powerful?

Johan was starting to suspect whether he had accidentally put some inappropriate ingredients into the energy cubes while making them...

However, the "legendary titan family" had simple minds or thinking patterns due to Regigigas's influence.

That was understandable - after all, it was an XP system.

So Johan didn't think much about it. Simple thinking made communication easier.

And with Regieleki's improved attitude, Johan began thinking again about where to place this guy.

He certainly couldn't personally escort it back to Crown Tundra, right?

Actually, that wasn't impossible either.

Taking it home was definitely out of the question - he couldn't afford to feed it.

Don't look at how small Regieleki was after shrinking - it was still an "ancient giant." Didn't you see how it drained the entire Kalos Power Plant's electricity in one go?

Even if it didn't absorb electricity and just ate energy cubes, that would still be a huge expense.

How about sending it back to Sinnoh to reunite with Regigigas?

Or... partner with the League to build a power station?

Feed Regieleki energy cubes and have it produce electricity?

Supposedly, the electricity Regieleki could produce could meet the entire Galar region's power needs.

After thinking for a moment, Johan decided to respect Regieleki's own wishes.

No matter what, Regieleki was still a Pokémon. It had the right to choose its own path. They couldn't imprison or confine it just because humans feared its power.

They could restrict it from causing destruction, but they couldn't imprison it.

When it felt human goodwill, it would naturally return goodwill.

After all, Regieleki wasn't an inherently evil Pokémon - it was neutral.

So Johan transmitted his thoughts to Regieleki.

"Regi?"

Regieleki tilted its head.

Where to go?

Don't know...

But if it really had to say, it still wanted to go "home" to sleep.

Home...

Crown Tundra in the Galar region.

Leaving it here definitely wouldn't work. Send it to Professor Sycamore's lab?

If Regieleki threw a tantrum, Professor Sycamore definitely couldn't stop it.

Hand it over to the Kalos League?

That wasn't much different.

Moreover, while the Kalos League was used to being laid-back and easygoing, seeing such an "obedient and well-behaved" legendary Pokémon, they might not resist having some ideas.

So it could only be carried along?

But that raised a new problem - how to carry it?

Although Regieleki was entirely composed of electrons, it could theoretically enter electrical equipment like Rotom.

But those blue rings on Regieleki's body weren't electronic.

Short-term travel through circuits might be fine, but extended periods... probably wouldn't work.

Moreover, with Regieleki's electrical intensity, what electrical equipment could stably contain it? A little too much force would probably cause an explosion.

So... Poké Ball?

It seemed like only Poké Balls would work.

Johan asked Regieleki's opinion again and took out a pristine Luxury Ball from his pocket, explaining the pros and cons clearly.

"When I eventually get to Crown Tundra, I'll send you back. Or..."

"If friends are going to Crown Tundra, I'll have them take you there."

"Eleki!"

Regieleki nodded and directly reached out to touch the enlarged Luxury Ball in Johan's hand.

Buzz—

In an instant, red light shot from the Luxury Ball, enveloping Regieleki before flying into the Luxury Ball.

Click!

The Luxury Ball didn't even flash red light - it directly "clicked" shut.

And this scene was perfectly witnessed by Lance, Wikstrom, and Officer Jenny, who had finished checking the power plant.

"Ca-captured?" Officer Jenny's eyes widened.

The legendary Pokémon Electric Pillar Regieleki, which had absorbed the entire Kalos Power Plant's electricity, was just captured by Teacher Johan like that?

Officer Jenny had the strongest reaction, but Lance and Wikstrom's reactions weren't small either.

Wikstrom murmured: "Is this Teacher Johan's 'charm'?"

He'd only heard about Teacher Johan's "legendary Pokémon man" reputation before but never seen it. This time... he'd witnessed it.

Lance took out his phone, trying to capture this scene to use as future evidence of Johan's "legendary Pokémon man" status.

But when he pressed the shutter, he found the photo was occupied by a tongue-sticking-out Gengar.

Lance: "???"

Buzz—

After being captured, Regieleki came back out on its own to continue eating the unfinished energy cubes.

"Regi~~"

The more contact they had, the more Johan felt these "ancient giants" had simple thoughts.

Didn't it consider that he might "sell" it?

But looking at Regieleki rapidly eliminating the food, Johan broke out in a cold sweat.

Oh no, he'd overlooked something.

How would Regieleki's meals be handled during the time it was with him?

Meanwhile, the eating Regieleki's signal lights flickered, transmitting its joyful emotions.

Free "boat ticket," plus room and board, not to mention how delicious this food was...

I, Regieleki, am quite clever, you know!

Should he ask the Kalos League for reimbursement?

After all, he was helping them solve their problems.

Johan's gaze inevitably looked toward Wikstrom and Officer Jenny.

Before Wikstrom could speak, Officer Jenny quickly straightened up, her cheeks flushed as she said:

"Te-Teacher Johan, about the simulation exercise..."

Simulation exercise?

If Officer Jenny hadn't mentioned it, Johan would have almost forgotten about this.

Previously, Johan hadn't quite understood why the League Police or Officer Jenny's simulation exercise was arranged in the Kalos region.

But after seeing the Kalos region's Officer Jenny, Johan understood...

Each region's Officer Jenny dressed differently. If you asked which was the "ugliest," it was probably Unova, but if you asked which was the best-looking... Kalos definitely ranked high.

Cough cough, jokes aside, since Officer Jenny had brought it up, and Johan's pursuit of Pokémon hunter groups really did need Officer Jenny's help, plus he was already in the Kalos region, he nodded:

"No problem."

Speaking of which, what was he trying to say earlier? It slipped his mind for a moment.

With the Kalos Power Plant matter resolved, on the return helicopter, Johan briefly recounted the information he'd obtained from Regieleki, including his arrangements for it.

"So it wasn't actually captured?" Lance said, surprised.

Johan shrugged. "We still need to respect the Pokémon's own wishes."

If the Dragon Tamer clan was willing to reimburse meal expenses, he wouldn't have said that.

"Exactly!" This statement earned Wikstrom's approval.

He said seriously and solemnly:

"Pokémon will respond to us wholeheartedly. They are our friends. Since that's the case, to live up to the name of 'friends,' I believe we should treat each other sincerely!"

Johan's mouth twitched.

Fine, this reimbursement is coming from you Kalos people.

"However," Lance frowned, "there are several issues here."

He held up a finger.

"First, how did Regieleki get from Galar to Kalos? This can't be simple flying through the air, and the League couldn't have had no detection at all."

He held up a second finger.

"Second, if it was Crown Tundra, then what people - and moreover, a group of people - would go to that extremely cold place? What was their purpose?"

Then he held up a third finger.

"Third, and finally, if there really are an Electric Pillar and Dragon Pillar, then where is the Dragon Pillar Regidrago?"

These were all questions.

Actually, not just Lance - Johan was very curious about the answers too.

But obviously Regieleki couldn't provide much substantial information, unless they made a trip to Crown Tundra.

"In any case," Johan pressed his lips together, "let's report this matter and have everyone pay attention to traces of the Dragon Pillar Regidrago."

He'd already decided to call Leon later, and Peony who was investigating in Crown Tundra, to briefly explain the situation.

"Mm."

Lance and Wikstrom both nodded in agreement.

When Johan and the others returned to the Battle Chateau, the castle's lights had already been restored.

This was because Regieleki hadn't caused much damage to Kalos Power Plant - it had just been crouching in the depths of the power plant "eating," and the previous battle had been stopped in time by Johan without destroying much.

This was also why Johan hadn't scolded Regieleki much.

It was just hungry, and the power plant had the most "food." It didn't know its eating would have such a big impact on humans. It could only be said that ignorance wasn't a crime.

Moreover, later when the power plant was able to quickly resume operation, Regieleki had also contributed some effort.

After Johan and the others returned, under butler Hennessy's arrangements, they stayed at the Battle Chateau.

The spacious, comfortable rooms were honestly quite a bit better than Pokémon Centers. No wonder so many people were willing to register at the Battle Chateau.

Johan summoned all his little ones, including Regieleki.

"From now on, you can't randomly 'eat' electricity. If you really can't help it, just hug Rotom and suck a couple mouthfuls."

"Ro-Rotom?! Σ(°Д°;)"

"Regi?"

Regieleki looked toward Rotom, its signal lights flickering as if it was smacking its lips, looking quite interested.

It had sensed earlier that the electrical current and electrons on Rotom weren't simple...

"Cough, just kidding."

Johan quickly waved his hands, almost forgetting that Regieleki, like his Larvitar, was simple-minded by nature. Don't let it actually hug Rotom and drain it dry.

"Yoji?"

Larvitar, sitting on the ground, looked up puzzledly and glanced around twice.

It felt like someone was talking about it.

Hearing this, Rotom breathed a long sigh of relief but still quickly hid behind big brother Gengar.

It felt... this guy's gaze toward it wasn't quite right.

I consider you a brother, but you can't actually want to "eat" me, right?

"If you're hungry, find Rotom or Gengar for energy cubes."

Rotom's Electric-type energy cubes were perfect for feeding Regieleki and suited its taste.

"Eleki—"

Regieleki nodded repeatedly.

In summary, find Rotom for meals.

Sure enough, not having eaten enough earlier, it immediately got another box of energy cubes.

In terms of eating effort, Regieleki and Larvitar were exactly the same.

"Rotom, record how much Regieleki eats," Johan instructed.

Having him temporarily raise such a one, he could barely manage it. After all, it had eaten an entire power plant's worth of electricity and was at least half full even if not completely satisfied. But raising it long-term would be real pressure.

Fortunately, in Johan's view, the expenses for feeding Regieleki could all be reimbursed.

As for who to seek reimbursement from, that could be discussed later.

"Understood, Rotom!"

Rotom nodded seriously.

Watching Regieleki eat a crystalline pale yellow energy cube, it immediately recorded in the Pokédex—

July 19th, evening, Regieleki consumed Electric-type energy cubes... ×1 (crossed out) ×10.

Mm, seeing that final "×10," nearby Gengar nodded with satisfaction.

Right on.

Reimbursement, especially for food items, having some fluctuation was very normal.

Regieleki saw Rotom busy recording and turned its head, realizing this was the "quartermaster"?

Zap—

A thin golden electrical current shot from its body into Rotom.

"Ro-Rotom?"

Initially Rotom was startled, thinking it was going to attack, but slowly realized...

This felt good?

What was this?

Buzz buzz buzz—

The signal lights on Regieleki's body rhythmically jumped, as if winking at it.

Rotom understood - this was "bribery"?

It immediately perked up, deleting the previous "×10" and changing it to "×20."

Perfect!

Regieleki and Rotom looked at each other and simultaneously smiled.

For this, Regieleki indicated that being simple was just an appearance - it was actually quite clever!

Watching the two Electric-types "communicating" with electrical currents, Johan just felt...

They got along quite well.

Who said Pokémon only fought each other?

Wasn't this just social etiquette?

"...Congratulations Marquis Johan on your victory!"

Hennessy stood at the edge of the ruined battlefield, adjusting his monocle and suppressing his twitching eyebrow as he announced the battle result.

This was Johan's first victory in a Marquis-level battle after advancing to Marquis.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar stood in the center of the field with hands on its hips, happily grinning with its blunt horn gleaming.

"Vii~"

Victini, invisible on Johan's shoulder, happily ran from his left shoulder to his right, making a victory sign.

Yeah! Helped out again!

The opposing Battle Chateau Marquis wore a helpless expression - the strength gap was still too large.

Being fellow Marquises, the strength difference between them was too great.

This was inevitable.

People like Johan, Lance, and occasionally visiting Cynthia and Steven belonged to the typical category of "rank might not be high, but strength should at least be Duke level or higher."

Meanwhile, as Kalos natives without Gym Leader or other League responsibilities interfering, with enough battles fought, their rank might be somewhat inflated.

Because the points gained from victories were considerably more than points lost from defeats, as long as you kept matching and had a win rate above 40%, you could gradually improve your rank.

Of course, once you reached Marquis level, this method became somewhat unworkable.

Marquis was like a threshold.

However, for most trainers, reaching Marquis was already sufficient.

This current Marquis, while having a high rank and being much older than Viola, actually had weaker strength than yesterday's Viola.

To put it in more mystical terms...

Johan's current rank was "newly entered Marquis," his opponent was also a "newly entered Marquis" who had mixed points to get there, so they were "evenly matched."

Within Marquis, there were things like "veteran Marquis," "Marquis peak," "half-step Duke," etc., which was another matter entirely... cough cough.

Once reaching Duke level, those were all ranks earned through real, solid strength.

During lunch.

"Johan, you've got people scared. I've already heard several Marquises quietly saying they hope not to get matched with you," Lance said with a grin.

Johan shrugged, indicating there was nothing he could do about it.

The joy of seal-clubbing - you wouldn't understand.

He wasn't like Lance, who had previously come to Kalos on missions and fought a few battles, with rank and strength rising in sync.

"It's fine. Challenging the strong is also a manifestation of knightly determination!"

Armored Wikstrom also joined their "dining brigade."

Johan looked at these two grinning guys in front of him and understood their thoughts perfectly.

They were just waiting for him to advance to Duke so they could come "designate challenge" him.

"Everyone, today's dessert is Abomasnow in the Snow."

Head chef Siebold led several servers carrying plates to the dining table, presenting today's after-meal dessert to Johan and the others with considerable ceremony.

Lifting the cover, white frost and cold air wafted up. A lifelike Abomasnow stood among ice fragments, emanating a faint grassy fragrance mixed with the coolness of cold air - truly one of summer's most refreshing desserts.

"Yoji..."

Larvitar looked at the Abomasnow dessert with sparkling eyes.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar also smacked its lips and stuck out its tongue, looking eager.

Seeing their expressions, Siebold's smile grew even broader.

Nothing made a chef happier than seeing smiles at their food.

"This smile, this anticipation - this is the best moment to experience cuisine! Smiles can enhance food's taste by dozens of times!"

Johan deeply agreed with this.

If Cynthia were here and saw this dessert, she'd probably eat it very happily too, right?

"Thank you for your hard work, Mr. Siebold," Lance and Wikstrom said in unison.

Honestly, the reason Siebold's cuisine was so famous in the Kalos region was inseparable from his serious attitude toward food.

Siebold smiled slightly, then paused before saying: "Actually, today there's also a 'hidden menu item.' I wonder if Teacher Johan would be interested in 'tasting' it?"

Hm?

Johan, who had just spooned a bite of dessert into his mouth, looked up somewhat bewildered.

Hidden menu?

Others might not know what Siebold meant by this "hidden menu," but how could he not know?

Oh no, was Cynthia's "backstab" going to take effect today?

Castle butler Hennessy appeared beside the dining table at some point, adjusting his glasses with a smile: "May I ask, Marquis Siebold, are you issuing a 'designated challenge'?"

Noticing the commotion, many people in the hall perked up their heads.

Designated challenge?

Elite Four Siebold challenging Teacher Johan?

Oh right, both Elite Four Siebold and Teacher Johan were currently just... Marquises!

Siebold nodded with a smile. "Yes."

He looked seriously at Johan. "I just heard that Teacher Johan is also an excellent chef. Although I'd love to compete with Teacher Johan in culinary skills, this is the Battle Chateau after all..."

He took a deep breath and struck a pose: "But I think for us, who are both chefs and trainers, demonstrating our respective culinary arts through Pokémon battles is the same thing!"

"I wonder what you think - would you be willing to taste my 'hidden menu,' Teacher Johan?"

Johan: "..."

He bit the spoon and gently smacked his lips.

So it wasn't Lance and Wikstrom waiting for him at "Duke" - it was Siebold waiting for him at "Marquis"...

Taking out the spoon, Johan looked toward Gengar and Larvitar.

"Yoji! (＾◡＾)"

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar even showed a wicked grin, taking Johan's spoon and, through mysterious power, slightly bending it.

Eating someone else's cooking, then beating up the cook - this is my first time too!

Johan smiled helplessly and rubbed his temples, then stood up with a smile: "In terms of 'culinary arts,' I do have some confidence."

# 630: VS Siebold! Battle? Culinary Showdown! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Designated challenge, accepted!"

Hennessy swept his hands and announced the result.

Whoosh—

Some murmurs of excitement rippled through the hall.

Although Siebold was a Marquis, that was because he was busy with League affairs and his chef career, having no time for Battle Chateau matches.

This visit was also because the Battle Chateau had invited him to serve as temporary head chef, and he could conveniently get matched for a battle to challenge for Duke rank.

And Teacher Johan?

No one doubted Teacher Johan's strength - at least solid Elite Four level.

They were actually going to witness at least an Elite Four-level showdown?

This excitement was well worth it, truly well worth it!

Everyone put down their knives and forks, streaming toward the castle's back courtyard.

Have them battle Teacher Johan? No way, no way.

Have them watch Teacher Johan battle Elite Four Siebold? Let's go, let's go.

Damn, Siebold "beat him to it."

For trainers whose strength obviously exceeded their rank, the Battle Chateau would also appropriately accelerate their promotion speed. Otherwise, if everyone came to "bully weaklings," other ranked people wouldn't come for matches.

After Johan and Siebold finished their battle, he'd rest for half a day, then make a designated challenge!

Lance made up his mind.

"I heard that after obtaining Duke rank, you can get discounts when staying at major hotels in the Kalos region."

"Ka-kaah?"

Discounts? I love discounts the most!

Seeing its expression, Johan's mouth twitched.

"People with Duke rank worrying about these little discounts - there really is no one else."

"Yoji! Yoji!"

Larvitar strode forward confidently, looking ready to fight at any moment.

"Yoji..."

Never mind anything else, his little ones had really learned a lot of acting skills from Gengar.

Even Larvitar could act now.

However, against Siebold, Larvitar really couldn't participate.

No matter how gifted Larvitar was, plus Johan's unreserved training and massive amounts of rare minerals and diamonds invested, it was still just a Larvitar.

And still a cub born less than half a year ago.

Moreover.

If Johan remembered correctly, Siebold's ace was a Blastoise, and one that possessed a Mega Stone - Mega Blastoise!

Let Larvitar go?

Block Mega Blastoise's cannon barrels?

He didn't even know if it would fit snugly.

Not letting it participate was for its own good.

Regarding this, Larvitar naturally understood. It pouted, just feeling frustrated with its own strength.

Hmph! I need to keep working hard at eating!

Grumble grumble—

Once I finish eating this stone, I'll pin those big guys to the ground and beat them up!

Grumble grumble—

The Earth Plate fragment rubbed against Larvitar's sharp teeth, tiny powder fragments being scraped off and swallowed with the little one's saliva, immediately making it feel energetic.

The Earth Plate fragment that Arceus had repaired should be able to "last" for a while longer, right?

Last a bit longer...

For some reason, Johan felt like there was a Sword of Damocles hanging over his head.

No, over his wallet, hanging a Sword of Damocles that would pierce through his wallet the moment it fell.

Little Larvitar gnawed just a tiny bit of Earth Plate fragment daily and already ate like a bottomless pit. It was hard to imagine how much it would eat per day without the Earth Plate fragment...

Worried in his heart, Johan felt his battle condition today would definitely be somewhat poor.

If it's poor... should he let Regieleki make an appearance?

Anyway, the Kalos League already knew about him taking in (temporarily) Regieleki, and there was nothing to hide.

Against Water-type Pokémon, Electric and Grass-types were perfect.

As a fallback, Grass-type starters could also be "reluctantly" considered.

Hm?

Wait, although our Rotom wasn't Grass-type, it could temporarily transform to have Grass-type properties...

Johan looked toward Rotom-Dex floating beside him, ready to take photos at any moment.

A kindred spirit!

"Whether cooking or Pokémon battles, both are instantaneous beauty, but the time spent before investing in that instant is definitely more than a blink of an eye."

Siebold's voice was passionate. "I wonder if Teacher Johan has prepared to 'taste' this hard-earned 'hidden menu' of mine."

"I couldn't ask for more!"

Castle butler Hennessy: "Please both sides summon your Pokémon!"

This was a battle between Marquises, with rules still being 2v2 singles mode.

"Rotom?"

Mow Rotom!

Electric and Grass-type attributes!

Seeing this scene, Siebold became more serious.

In terms of typing, he was at a considerable disadvantage.

"Rotom!!"

After diving into the lawnmower and transforming into Mow Rotom, the little one's aura also changed somewhat, becoming more confident and gaining some aggression.

The battle begins!

Siebold swept his cape: "Please taste the first dish of the 'hidden menu' - the chef's artistry Water Pulse!"

Boom!!

A sound like tearing silk erupted as surging waves rolled forward.

Mega Launcher!

Paralyzed status!

Victory and defeat decided in an instant.

Clawitzer, unable to battle!

Indeed it was close. If anyone else had commanded, this battle would have been very difficult to win.

However, through this battle, both Johan and Rotom gained some understanding of their respective strengths.

Roughly at a level slightly weaker than ordinary Elite Four main Pokémon. Being able to win this time was due to type advantage, surprise tactics, and Johan's commanding playing key roles.

Ultimately, Pokémon strength wasn't measured by data and numbers. Otherwise, there would be no need for battles - everyone could just compare numbers to see who won.

The Pokémon's own condition, the advantages and disadvantages of abilities and types, the trainer's condition and commanding ability - all would influence strength to some extent.

But overall, the result was considerably better than Johan's expectations. He had been prepared for Rotom to use Volt Switch.

Win or lose didn't matter - just don't let the little one get seriously injured.

"Well done, Rotom," Johan praised without reservation.

"It-it was just okay, Rotom~" Rotom laughed sheepishly.

"I'll hold down Gengar for five hundred shots later."

He had originally promised three hundred shots. Since they won, naturally there should be a "reward."

"Long live, Rotom!!"

This excited Rotom more than winning the battle.

Gengar: ???

Siebold across the field had already recalled Clawitzer, wearing an intoxicated expression.

"Is this Teacher Johan's 'cooking'? Truly a lingering instant that leaves one wanting more. However..."

Siebold held another Poké Ball, his expression more serious and full of anticipation:

"My final main course is just about to take the stage!"

"Go, Blastoise!"

Bang!!!

The robust Blastoise landed heavily on the field, raising large clouds of dust.

Thick shell, sturdy and powerful limbs, the two cannons on its shell were especially eye-catching, gleaming with bright metallic luster.

Most attention-grabbing was undoubtedly what Blastoise wore on its forehead - a sphere emitting brilliant light, a Mega Stone!

"Here it comes! It's Elite Four Siebold's ace Blastoise!"

"See that Mega Stone on its forehead? Elite Four Siebold's Blastoise can Mega Evolve!"

"Truly worthy of an ace Pokémon. Wonder which Pokémon Teacher Johan will send to respond."

"Could it be Gengar? Might we see a battle between Mega Pokémon today?"

"But I heard Teacher Johan's Mega Gengar is so strong that even Unova Champion Alder wouldn't dare claim certain victory..."

Blastoise's appearance immediately caused considerable discussion.

This Blastoise's strength was also visibly formidable, worthy of being an Elite Four's ace Pokémon.

"Blastoise!!"

Blastoise's low but imposing roar again stirred up dust. Influenced by Siebold, Blastoise's fighting spirit was extremely high.

Regarding Blastoise's appearance, Johan wasn't surprised at all, and he had already decided who should face it.

However.

When he reached for the Poké Ball at his waist, one of them shook with some excitement.

Hm?

Even without looking, Johan knew who was so excited.

But regarding its excitement, Johan was inevitably somewhat surprised.

Ceruledge!

That was a starter Water-type's final evolution, and it was equipped with a Mega Stone, definitely capable of Mega Evolution. You, a Fire-type Pokémon, want to battle - isn't that...

Although having Siebold, an Elite Four of the Kalos region, use a Kanto starter as his ace was somewhat questionable, Johan was still very familiar with and fond of Pokémon like Blastoise.

Ceruledge going up could be said to have no advantage whatsoever, and would actually be at complete disadvantage due to typing.

But Ceruledge's aura passed through the Poké Ball, expressing a strong desire to battle Johan.

It wanted to fight this Blastoise!

It had heard Johan mention information about the "Mega Launcher" ability before. Besides Clawitzer and Clauncher, only Mega Blastoise possessed it, as far as Johan knew.

During this time, Ceruledge... or rather Armarouge, had tried quite a bit to simulate the characteristics of "Mega Launcher," but honestly the results weren't very significant.

So it thought there was nothing... better than battling a Pokémon with this ability to gain insights, right?

The previous Clawitzer was unavoidable - it didn't know Siebold's first Pokémon would be Clawitzer, with both sides summoning Pokémon simultaneously.

But this time... it wanted to try!

Buzz—

Johan could even feel Ceruledge's Poké Ball becoming somewhat hot, as if extremely strong flames were burning freely inside, just like its high fighting spirit and desire for battle.

Faced with this situation, Johan could only chuckle and moved his hand from the other Poké Ball to grasp the one containing Ceruledge.

When his own Pokémon made such a strong request for battle, what else could he say?

It was just a battle, one victory or defeat.

Having fun was most important.

Moreover... they wouldn't necessarily lose!

"Then it's decided - you're up, Ceruledge!"

Whoosh!!

Red light flashed as a burst of flame suddenly appeared on the field. Blazing fire erupted from Ceruledge's armor, rising into scorching firelight.

"Fire-type, Ceruledge?"

Seeing the Pokémon Johan summoned, everyone was stunned.

Fire versus Water, and going second at that. This...

"Could it be that Teacher Johan is also a reverse-type master?"

Sending out Fire-type against Water-type Pokémon - besides Fire-type specialists, who would do this?

Even kids just starting Pokémon school knew water beats fire.

Actually, Lance and Wikstrom in the stands were also very surprised.

But when they noticed Ceruledge's eyes and condition, their surprise lessened somewhat, replaced by understanding.

"Such high fighting spirit!" Wikstrom said. "Advancing courageously despite difficulties - this is a respectable knight!"

Both wearing armor, Wikstrom was full of admiration for Ceruledge's condition.

Lance wasn't a knight, but he also saw the passion for Pokémon battles in Ceruledge.

So what if typing was disadvantageous? It wouldn't necessarily lose!

A cold face flashed in his mind.

Actually, Siebold was also very surprised when he saw Ceruledge, but when he noticed Ceruledge's condition, he immediately understood.

"I see, this is Teacher Johan's cooking method? High-temperature cooking, fierce fire stir-frying, concentrating essence in one body!"

Siebold was obviously the typical Western head chef type - beautiful plating, delicious taste, but lacking a bit of smoky atmosphere, missing some warmth.

It had to be said that under Siebold's "enlightened" words, the audience also "saw" the characteristics of this battle from another angle.

"Wait, I thought it was just gimmick and jokes. They're really comparing cooking?"
