# 631: Tyranitar Mega Stone! (Two-in-One Chapter)

Blastoise VS Ceruledge.

No matter how high Ceruledge's fighting spirit was, the type advantage belonged to Siebold, who naturally wouldn't be intimidated by Ceruledge.

"Blastoise, Water Spout!"

Water Spout was similar to Fire-type moves like Eruption - the better the condition and more HP, the stronger the power. Using Water Spout right after entering the field had a terrifying power of 150!

Combined with an Elite Four's ace Pokémon using it, that momentum and power...

Rumble—

The vast battle field seemed to raise waves, like surging tides, overwhelming as they crashed toward Ceruledge. Unless it could fly, there was absolutely no room for maneuvering.

But Ceruledge wasn't just Fire - it was also Ghost!

"Shadow Sneak!"

Whoosh—

A blade burning with ghostly blue flames slashed through the air, immediately opening a rift. As Ceruledge flashed through, it instantly disappeared from the field.

The surging water flow immediately missed its target.

"Behind!" Siebold didn't panic, immediately spotting where Ceruledge's Shadow Sneak would emerge - right behind Blastoise.

"Blastoise!"

Blastoise grinned, gripping both arms tight, its body tensing as it presented its shell directly to Ceruledge.

Clang!!

The blade collided with Blastoise's shell, actually producing the sound of metal striking metal, accompanied by scattered sparks as a shallow scratch was left on Blastoise's shell.

So hard!

Ceruledge felt like it had struck a thick piece of metal.

Meanwhile, Blastoise, which had been quite confident earlier, couldn't help but grit its teeth.

Don't look at it as just a small shallow scratch - this was a Ghost-type move, which it had no resistance to. The eerie chill constantly transmitted through the blade was what truly made it uncomfortable.

"Right now, Blastoise, Whirlpool! Bind it!"

"Blastoise!"

Swirling water rose from beneath Blastoise's feet. The water rapidly expanded, enveloping both it and Ceruledge right behind it.

Hiss—

Splashing water droplets fell on Ceruledge's blade and armor, instantly turning to steam.

A single drop of water naturally wouldn't greatly affect Ceruledge, but that constantly contracting whirlpool wasn't just one drop.

If Ceruledge got trapped and bound by the whirlpool, it would truly have no chance to fight.

"Break out!" Johan called out in a low voice.

Buzz—

Psychic power emanated from Ceruledge's eyes, and the ghostly blue flames on its twin swords seemed to gain an additional layer of psychic energy.

Psycho Cut!

Whoosh!!

Cross-shaped sword marks appeared on the constantly contracting surging whirlpool. The originally continuous water flow seemed instantly severed, creating a gap in the vortex as Ceruledge flashed out.

The whirlpool failed to "catch" Ceruledge. Siebold thought it was a pity, but as an Elite Four member, his adaptability was naturally strong.

"Blastoise, gather the water flow, Hydro Cannon!"

Splash splash—

The water raised by the whirlpool flowed into Blastoise's body like swallows returning to their nest, with the water flow finally appearing faintly in the two large cannons on Blastoise's back.

"Goka!"

Ceruledge crossed its twin swords in front of its chest, its expression serious.

Boom!!

Two water columns shot from Blastoise's cannon barrels, the rapid water flow condensed without any dispersion.

Other Pokémon's Hydro Cannon was one water column - Blastoise's was basically cheating with two.

"Why isn't Ceruledge dodging?"

"It's not planning to take Hydro Cannon head-on, is it?"

"Or is Teacher Johan gambling on accuracy?"

Gambling on accuracy? That rare phrase could apply to Teacher Johan?

In Pokémon battles, if it was tactical battling, then the trainer's intent was naturally the Pokémon's intent - trainers made tactics and strategies, Pokémon executed them.

But if it reached the type of battle relying on passion and power-ups, then trainer and Pokémon wills became one.

Not dodging was naturally because...

No need to dodge!

Clang!!

The twin blades crossed in front of its chest gleamed with brilliant golden luster, vibrant life force leaping on the sword edges.

Suddenly.

Everyone looked up at the blazing sun hanging high in the July noon sky, understanding dawning in their hearts.

The sunlight was intense.

Facing the incoming water columns, Ceruledge fiercely slashed with its crossed twin blades. Condensed golden sunlight formed two crossing slashes that collided head-on with the Hydro Cannon.

Solar Blade!

Bang!!

In an instant, water droplets scattered, water mist roiled, brilliant golden light and rushing water flow produced the most intense collision at this moment.

The unity of trainer and Pokémon will was displayed to the fullest at this moment!

"Good!" Lance shouted, his face full of excitement.

He loved this kind of honorable head-to-head confrontation, direct collision between opposing forces. Who cared about type advantages - just fight!

When trainer and Pokémon hearts were completely united, there was nothing they couldn't face.

"Truly... admirable knightly spirit!"

Wikstrom also gave extremely high praise. Knights should be unafraid of difficulties, advancing against adversity and fighting to the death.

The more he watched, the more he felt Ceruledge embodied the "knightly spirit" he followed.

Even their reactions were like this, let alone Siebold who was currently battling Johan. His heart's passion seemed driven by that previous scene, his blood seemingly boiling - this was a feeling he'd missed for so long!

Siebold broke into a wide smile, fire lighting in his eyes.

"To actually cleave through Blastoise's Hydro Cannon - such a collision is like the dance between hot oil and water droplets!"

"Blastoise and I will definitely present our most skilled 'secret recipe'!"

As he spoke, Siebold took out the Key Stone pendant hanging around his neck. Brilliant rainbow light rose in the battle field, making everyone feel their blood pumping.

He shouted loudly:

"Blastoise, Mega Evolve!!"

"Blastoise!!"

Blastoise responded to Siebold's call.

Water flowed, a fierce aura swept up all the accumulated water on the field. Under the rainbow light's embrace, purifying light was born, making hearts tremble involuntarily.

Here it comes!

"Elite Four Siebold's Mega Blastoise!"

"Ohhhhh—I don't know why, but I'm getting fired up!"

"This is what battling should be!"

If Cynthia were here, she would definitely sense the similarity between Lance and Flint.

Both passionate, both charging forward without hesitation, using passion to drive themselves, their Pokémon, and even their opponents, then...

Using rich experience to crush their opponents.

This was what passionate battle-type Pokémon trainers were "best at." Because in battle, when opponents got completely fired up, it was really hard for the other party to remain calm and composed.

When emotions got involved, things like battle rhythm and initiative became difficult to control.

This wasn't just Flint's "experience" - Lance was the same.

So at this moment, Lance wished he was the one battling Johan.

"Blast—oise—!!!"

Brilliant light scattered like stardust, the Mega Evolution symbol flashed briefly, and what appeared before everyone's eyes was - Mega Blastoise!

Its originally solid shell was now like a fortress stronghold. The previous two cannon barrels had become one, but much thicker and sturdier, with the dark cannon mouth seemingly containing endless power.

Additionally, shell-like armor appeared on Mega Blastoise's arms, each equipped with smaller cannon barrels that could move with the arms' rotation, much more flexible.

At first glance, Blastoise seemed to have one less cannon barrel after Mega Evolution, but counting the ones on its arms, it actually had one more.

The original "Parent and Child Love" cannons were already abnormal enough - now going from two to three made it even more intimidating.

Mega Blastoise!

Seeing Mega Blastoise in this form, Ceruledge's eyes blazed with fire. Without hesitation, it turned the dial on its armor. Orange flames shot skyward, and when the flames settled, what appeared was Armarouge!

"Goka!"

Armarouge's eyes burned intensely - this was what it had been waiting for, Mega Blastoise. Now it finally got its chance!

"I see? You want to battle Mega Blastoise?" Siebold seemed to understand Armarouge's eyes and shouted with a smile: "Then as you wish! Mega Blastoise, Water Pulse!"

Click! Click click—

The three cannon barrels adjusted direction, dark cannon mouths showing water flow condensing into pulses, faintly accompanied by pulse-like sounds.

While Water Pulse had less power than Hydro Cannon, enhanced by Mega Blastoise's "Mega Launcher," the power was considerable. The key point was... it was more accurate than Hydro Cannon.

Simultaneously.

Bang!

Armarouge clasped its hands together, a bright golden cannon appearing with firelight flickering within, seemingly determined to have a fire versus water clash with Mega Blastoise.

As a Fire-type Pokémon, Armarouge wasn't afraid, so as the advantaged Water-type Pokémon, Mega Blastoise naturally feared nothing.

Water flow instantly shot from the three cannon barrels.

"Flamethrower!"

Whoosh!!

Meeting the water flow, crimson flames erupted, forming a massive fire column.

Hiss—

The moment water flow and flames collided, intense "hissing" sounds erupted, as if large amounts of water were instantly boiled by flames, raising massive clouds of scalding steam.

But simultaneously, more flames were directly extinguished by water flow. If not for Armarouge continuously spouting flames, it would have been doused long ago.

Even so, using flames against water flow was still unwise. In just one breath, Armarouge fell into disadvantage.

"Vii! Vii!"

Victini, invisible on Johan's shoulder, kept cheering for Armarouge.

If this wasn't a one-on-one battle where Victini couldn't interfere, it would directly inject Armarouge with "V-create" energy, and Armarouge might not lose to Mega Blastoise in direct confrontation.

"Goka!"

Armarouge's psychic power and aura completely spread, sensing the immense pressure from Mega Blastoise.

It had to admit that in pure strength, Mega Blastoise was superior, plus the type advantage made it currently at absolute disadvantage.

But...

Battles weren't decided by these things alone!

"Armor Cannon!" Johan's brow furrowed as he spoke grimly.

The flames spouting from the golden cannon barrel suddenly surged, crimson firelight gradually showing traces of golden flame.

Boom!!!

The sudden flame surge surprised both Siebold and Mega Blastoise, especially Mega Blastoise.

Not only was its water flow pushed back, but it somehow felt the flames from that cannon barrel were somewhat similar to its own "Mega Launcher"!

Although only superficially similar, it really did make the flames more powerful!

What was going on?

Could abilities be imitated?

Ridiculous - then after Mega Evolution, couldn't it also gain its original form's "Torrent" ability, or even freely activate and deactivate "Torrent"?

Whoosh!!

The suddenly surging flames completely overwhelmed Mega Blastoise's Water Pulse, covering most of the field with flames that engulfed Mega Blastoise.

However, after the previous exchange, the flames' power had been reduced by more than half, so they didn't cause massive damage to Mega Blastoise.

"Mega Blastoise, Hydro Cannon!"

"Armarouge, Fire Blast!"

Water and fire once again collided intensely in the field center.

But this time, Armarouge fell into disadvantage, covered by water flow with most of its flames extinguished.

Unlike flames barely damaging Mega Blastoise, Mega Blastoise caused significant damage to Armarouge.

Anyone could see that in direct confrontation, Mega Blastoise's advantage was too great.

This raised more questions.

"Can't understand why Teacher Johan is fighting like this. Is there some tactic?"

"Tactic? Right now Teacher Johan seems like a 'brute.'"

"Don't tell me 'brute force' counts as tactics?"

Siebold kept a straight face - his perception differed from the audience.

Johan and Armarouge across from him, while clearly disadvantaged, gave him a feeling... like opponents who could explode at any moment, extremely dangerous.

As if they were the passive party.

To be safe, Siebold called out:

"Mega Blastoise, Aqua Ring!"

Water on the field gathered toward Blastoise, forming rings of water flow around it, slowly replenishing its stamina.

"Even in attrition battles, Blastoise has more advantage."

"What exactly is Teacher Johan trying to do?"

Johan stood motionless at the field edge, eyes focused on Armarouge.

How is it?

"Goka!"

Armarouge called out grimly and shook its head firmly. Large amounts of steam rose from its body as white mist ascended, then flames erupted again, directly evaporating the absorbed water.

Johan lowered his eyes.

Then let's continue!

Whoosh!!

Armarouge's flames surged again, even more dramatically than before, with more and more golden flames gradually appearing in the blazing fire.

Correspondingly, Armarouge's condition was slowly recovering.

Armarouge wasn't lacking in recovery ability!

"Ar-Armarouge is also recovering stamina? How?"

"Golden flames - what are those?"

"Fire, fire, fire..."

Someone pointed at Armarouge and suddenly exclaimed.

Those flames... were getting a bit exaggerated!

"What's happening? Is this 'Blaze' ability?"

"What Blaze? Armarouge's ability is Weak Armor!"

"Holy crap, hand-rubbing Blaze - Teacher Johan, your Pokémon isn't reasonable!"

Amid the exclamations, Armarouge clasped its arms together again.

The flames around its body frantically gathered toward the cannon barrel.

It had been passively counterattacking before - this time, it would take the initiative!

Direct combat with Mega Blastoise made it understand that the "Mega Launcher" ability really wasn't easy to imitate.

But that was fine!

It had its own fighting style!

Johan and Armarouge were now perfectly in sync.

Although lacking a Mega Stone and Mega Evolution, through aura and the bond between him and Armarouge, their figures seemed to overlap at this moment.

At this moment, Johan vaguely felt like Ash's bond evolution with Greninja, his palms also growing hot.

Armarouge's appearance hadn't changed, but... the aura was real.

Aura, flow into me!

Buzz buzz buzz—

"Buzzing" sounds emerged from Armarouge's golden cannon barrel, as if some terrifying power was constantly being injected, compressed, condensed...

At this moment, both Siebold and Mega Blastoise's expressions changed.

They sensed tremendous threat.

"Mega Blastoise, maximum power Hydro Cannon!"

"Blastoise!"

Hearing this, Mega Blastoise naturally didn't dare slack off. All three cannon barrels turned in the same direction.

Previously, Hydro Cannon was split into three streams for wider coverage and better accuracy, but this time the three barrels' water columns merged into one, greatly increasing power.

Boom!!!

Brilliant light erupted from the cannon mouth. Armarouge's dimmed body was like a cannon mounted on the ground, with terrifying recoil force sliding it backward, leaving two extremely scorched furrows.

If the recoil was this dramatic, then the Armor Cannon fusing flames, life force, and aura was naturally terrifyingly powerful.

Plants in the castle outside the battle field, despite the distance, instantly changed from fresh green to scorched yellow with signs of burning.

Trainers on the second floor retreated one after another, summoning their respective Pokémon to resist the overflowing flame aftermath.

This was Johan's first time injecting his own aura into Armarouge after receiving Arceus's blessing and his aura power greatly increasing.

Although Johan couldn't hand-rub Aura Spheres, this didn't mean his aura wasn't strong. In fact, regarding pure aura, Armarouge and Urshifu combined might not match him - he just wasn't a Pokémon, so his usage differed from Pokémon.

But injecting it into Armarouge, it knew how to use it.

The firelight illuminated faces orange-red. Siebold and Mega Blastoise, in their Mega Evolution state, shared the same heart and both sensed the flames' terror.

What to do?

Only resist with full force!

Boom!!

Water flow and flames collided once more in the battle field, but the commotion far exceeded the previous exchanges.

Rumble rumble!!

Watching spectators looked horrified, swallowing nervously.

This, this power was truly terrifying.

Probably even legendary Pokémon weren't more impressive?

"While the Mega Launcher simulation failed, it did teach Armarouge how to compress and increase power, plus with aura... won't this develop into a planet-destroyer cannon?"

Johan's eye twitched.

Boom!!

After another violent explosion, thick white mist rose as the devastated battle field first appeared in everyone's sight.

Butler Hennessy's mouth twitched.

This was a field specially reinforced for Duke and Marquis battles, and one battle completely destroyed it...

The white mist gradually cleared.

Dark flames rose again within Armarouge's dimmed body, though obviously much fainter than before. It supported itself on its knees, breathing heavily.

Across the field.

Blastoise sat on the ground, with no obvious wounds visible, but its originally azure body showed patches of scorching red spots scattered around.

The Aqua Ring around it had long since disappeared, and water droplets touching those red spots immediately turned to steam.

"Blastoise..."

Blastoise's Mega Evolution energy had already faded. It looked uninjured but was actually wounded all over, similarly breathing heavily without its previous momentum.

Both sides were clearly exhausted.

Seeing this, Siebold sighed softly.

It seemed evenly matched, but actually...

"This match, we lose." Siebold sighed again, but his face showed a smile, displaying his easy-going nature.

Hearing this, Johan was stunned.

Both sides were still capable of fighting.

Seeming to understand his confusion, Siebold said wistfully:

"Teacher Johan used more 'ordinary ingredients' yet created such amazing 'cuisine.' This match, we indeed lost."

He and Blastoise not only had type advantage but also used Mega Evolution, yet they only achieved a draw after fighting this long - no, not even a draw, but clear disadvantage.

And Johan and Armarouge?

Type disadvantage, couldn't Mega Evolve, didn't use other enhancement methods either.

This was what Siebold called more "ordinary ingredients."

Moreover, whether in momentum, attitude, or final impact, they had lost.

So Siebold conceded quite readily.

Losing meant losing - no point in being stubborn.

Johan was first confused, then understanding, nodding slightly.

This might not work in other regions, but in Kalos... it was quite reasonable.

Indeed, continuing the fight might not determine who would win between Armarouge and Blastoise, but Johan still had a Rotom with little stamina remaining.

After confirming Siebold's forfeit, butler Hennessy quickly announced the result.

Moreover, he directly declared with a wave... Johan's rank would advance from Marquis to Duke!

Please stop showing off - our field can't take much more!

In just a few days, Johan's rank jumped directly from Count to Duke. This dramatic promotion speed should have caused dissatisfaction, but no one present questioned it.

After all, Teacher Johan's strength was clear to see. Staying at Marquis rank any longer... there would be no opponents.

Even some trainers with Marquis rank applauded and celebrated - hurry up and promote him! Once promoted, they wouldn't get matched against him!

You had to know this was just Teacher Johan's Armarouge. They knew Teacher Johan's ace was a Gengar.

If even his main force was this dramatic, how terrifying would his ace be?

Quickly promote him to fight those Elite Four and Champions - they couldn't handle it.

Originally, many people came to watch Siebold's promotion to Duke, but unexpectedly Teacher Johan overtook him, promoting to Duke at faster speed.

However, this battle was truly exciting to watch.

Battles, after all.

Tactics were nice to watch, but not everyone could understand them.

But direct confrontation was better - simple, easy to understand, and could drive everyone's emotions.

Clap clap clap—

Everyone applauded together, including Lance and Wikstrom.

Finally Duke rank!

The two looked at each other, sensing competition.

Once butler Hennessy finished Johan's rank promotion ceremony, they'd quickly apply for matches, let Johan rest half a day, then apply for "designated challenges."

First come, first served!

Wearing the red cape and receiving his "Duke" certificate, Johan immediately felt red capes looked much better than green and yellow ones.

"Congratulations, Duke Johan." Hennessy bowed congratulations.

Secretly relieved - Duke rank... should be about right? Peace at last...

"Butler Hennessy." Johan quickly called him back.

"How may I serve Duke Johan?" Hennessy's heart jumped as he asked tentatively.

Surely he wouldn't want to continue matching?

At least let the field get repaired first.

But when Johan asked his question, he relaxed.

"Mega Stones?"

Previously, before Mega Evolution became widespread, the Battle Chateau's exchange list didn't include Mega Stones.

But as Mega Evolution gained popularity and many trainers pursued it enthusiastically, the Battle Chateau also used its influence to collect some Mega Stones.

However, Mega Stones were extremely rare. The Battle Chateau set rules that only trainers with Duke rank or above could exchange them. Johan was the first person at the Battle Chateau to want to exchange for Mega Stones.

"I wonder what Mega Stones the Battle Chateau has?" Johan asked.

"Please wait a moment."

Hennessy took out his phone, adjusted his monocle, and scanned the Battle Chateau's exchange list.

"Manectric Mega Stone, Abomasnow Mega Stone, Sceptile Mega Stone..."

Sceptile Mega Stone?

Hearing this Mega Stone, Johan's thoughts stirred.

He was just considering getting a Grass-type Pokémon. If there was a Sceptile Mega Stone, he could consider Hoenn's Grass starter Sceptile.

Speaking of which, as a Hoenn native, he didn't have a single signature Hoenn Pokémon, which was somewhat embarrassing.

"...Pidgeot Mega Stone and Tyranitar Mega Stone."

There it was!

Tyranitar Mega Stone!

It seemed Professor Sycamore's information was correct.

Hennessy added somewhat apologetically: "The Battle Chateau hasn't been collecting Mega Stones for long. I wonder if any meet Duke Johan's needs..."

Being able to collect five Mega Stones already showed the Battle Chateau's capabilities.

Moreover, one was the pseudo-legendary Pokémon Tyranitar's Mega Stone.

"I want to exchange for Tyranitar's Mega Stone," Johan said directly.

While Sceptile's Mega Stone was nice, catching a Grass-type Pokémon was still theoretical.

More importantly, if Larvitar learned there was a Tyranitar Mega Stone right in front of them but they didn't exchange for it, it might throw a tantrum and literally turn the house to powder.

If he really caught a Treecko in the future, he could consider Sceptile's Mega Stone then.

"Alright." Hennessy nodded, adjusting his glasses. "Let me check if Duke Johan has enough points..."

The Battle Chateau operated on a point system. Each battle earned points, with more wins than losses allowing point accumulation for desired exchanges.

"Points?" Johan rubbed his chin. "No problem. If I don't have enough, I'll just fight two more battles."

Hennessy's finger froze mid-scroll, a cold sweat dropping from his forehead.

Fight two more battles?

Click—

Hennessy decisively turned off his phone screen and quickly said: "Enough, more than enough! I'll fetch it for you right away."

"Hm? Already enough?" Johan was somewhat surprised.

He'd only fought three battles and already had enough points?

It seemed earning money at the Battle Chateau really was an option.

Three battles could exchange for one Mega Stone worth eight figures!

The only downside was that after reaching Duke rank, battle opponents were all Elite Four level, making fights exhausting.

Plus they were hard to match with.

However, Johan learned the Battle Chateau held periods each year where they invited various Counts, Marquises, and Dukes to gather for five days of intensive battles, with considerable live streaming and broadcasting, generating heat comparable to regional conferences.

"We'll see then..."

Soon.

Hennessy returned carrying a box containing the Mega Stone.

Opening the box to look.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar immediately ran out from Johan's waist, standing on tiptoes and stretching its little neck to peek, tears of joy flowing from its mouth.

"It's definitely Tyranitar's Mega Stone."

Never mind anything else - just looking at Larvitar's reaction confirmed this was undoubtedly Tyranitar's Mega Stone.

"You can't eat this!"

Johan closed the box and told the eagerly watching little one.

"Yo-Yoji!" Larvitar rubbed its hands with a serious expression.

I-I won't eat it! I'm just looking, at most I'll taste it!

Taste it?

Johan's mouth twitched.

I'll believe that when pigs fly.

"When you evolve someday, I'll give this to you. Don't you still have Earth Plate fragments? Chew on those first."

"Yoji..."

Larvitar drooped its head pitifully.

Didn't big brother Gengar keep the Mega Stone in its mouth? Taking it out only when needed...

I see, so that's why Larvitar wanted to taste it.

Johan decided to ignore it.

The little one had been playing with Gengar and really learned the acting skills.

Besides.

Earth Plate fragments were one thing, but what if Larvitar could actually digest the Mega Stone?

Strictly speaking, Plates were much more valuable than Mega Stones.

# 632: Gengar & Larvitar's Adventure (Two-in-One Chapter)

Kalos region, Battle Chateau, evening.

As the sun set in the west, Lance and Wikstrom stood on opposite sides of the battle field, staring at each other.

Wait.

They had clearly agreed to challenge Johan who had just become a Duke, so how did it end up... with the two of them fighting each other?

This wasn't right!

Where was Johan?

Meanwhile, on Kalos Route 10, heading toward Coumarine City, a Rotom-Bike was leisurely cycling along.

"Riding my beloved bicycle~ I'll never get stuck in traffic~"

Johan hummed an off-key tune, his lips curved in a slight smile.

Want to challenge me? You think I don't know what Lance and Wikstrom are thinking?

The "mission" of challenging for Duke rank to exchange for a Mega Stone was complete. There was no point staying at the Battle Chateau - he wasn't planning to challenge for "Grand Duke" rank, he'd eaten Siebold's free cuisine several times, and feeling satisfied, he naturally left.

"Rotom, accelerate!"

"Understood, Rotom!"

After recovering from the battle, Rotom was now in good spirits, having gained some understanding of its own strength.

While it still didn't particularly like battling, it wasn't as resistant anymore.

Zzzt—

Golden electrical current appeared on the bicycle's rear motor. Rotom-Bike's speed immediately increased considerably, but remained within Johan's acceptable range.

However, at this moment, Regieleki in the Luxury Ball at his waist seemed to sense something. An electrical current shot from the Poké Ball into the bicycle's motor.

Whoosh—

The bicycle's speed increased again.

"Rotom, that's a bit too fast!" Johan gripped the handlebars tightly, his expression immediately changing.

"It's not me, Rotom—"

Rotom-Bike's speed continued climbing, quickly exceeding Johan's control range.

The next second.

Bang—

The bicycle shot through the guardrail, tracing a beautiful arc through the air. Larvitar, sitting in the back seat, gripped the seat firmly and blinked its bewildered eyes twice.

"Yoji?"

Flying again?

Then it heard Johan shout:

"Dragonite, save—!!"

On a grassy area where a not-too-dense forest met a stream, Johan stood with his arms crossed and a serious expression.

In front of him, Regieleki, less than 1.5 meters tall - more accurately, only 1.2 meters - hung its head low, its signal lights flashing embarrassedly.

"...So, without my permission, don't randomly charge Rotom in the future!" Johan said seriously.

"Regi... Regieleki..."

Regieleki nodded honestly.

It didn't know either - it had just felt Rotom increase its electrical output earlier and thought it was trying to do something, so it helped out. Who knew...

"Draaa~~"

Dragonite smiled foolishly nearby, patting Regieleki's shoulder to indicate it was fine.

Johan was in great shape and couldn't be seriously hurt by a fall. Rotom-Bike's quality was excellent too, and if worst came to worst, Tinkaton could help repair it. No big problem.

"Eleki..." Regieleki cautiously glanced at Johan and nodded again.

Johan knew Regieleki hadn't done it intentionally, but he still needed to give proper warnings. Otherwise... this time it was just a bicycle, but next time if it was a car or airplane, wouldn't that... make them fly even faster?

He looked up at the sky. The sun was already hanging on the treetops, its dim yellow light like an oversized candle flame, swaying as if it might fall at any moment.

"It's getting late. Let's camp here tonight."

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar reacted fastest, immediately springing into action to set up the tent!

Then the other little ones also started moving, leaving only Regieleki standing in place, not knowing what to do.

"It's fine. Watch what everyone's doing, learn from them. When you've learned and want to help, then help."

Johan said this while taking out his fishing rod. This time... he definitely wouldn't come up empty!

There happened to be a river nearby, and it even flowed toward the ocean. This would surely yield good catches!

"Regi..."

Regieleki looked at the busy little ones, its signal lights flashing.

When its gaze fell on Larvitar, who was heartily gnawing on minerals, it suddenly gained some understanding.

Eating!

I know how to do that!

It immediately sat on the ground with Larvitar, enjoying energy cubes while Rotom appeared beside it to record.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar finished the pile of minerals in front of it and immediately clapped its hands, scratched its bottom, and stood up.

That pile was just a pre-dinner snack for it.

It glanced at Johan, who was still "battling" with his fishing rod, rubbed its chin thoughtfully twice.

What to do next?

"Yoji!"

Got it!

Larvitar slapped its palm with its fist, immediately having an idea.

The blunt horn on its head glowed slightly as it lowered its head, looking like it was searching for something on the ground.

This was its unique "ability." After eating some Earth Plate fragments, Larvitar had developed a special sensitivity to the earth, allowing it to sense some underground networks and the earth's rhythm.

Put more simply - finding minerals.

Larvitar didn't understand the principle of sitting idle and eating away resources, but it knew that in a situation of only eating without bringing anything in, the family savings would eventually be depleted. So Larvitar worried about the distant future despite no immediate concerns, checking every new place for mineable minerals.

Johan was aware of this.

Although Larvitar couldn't dig up much each time, every little bit helped. As long as it filled in the ground afterward, he let it be.

Larvitar kept its head down, like sweeping for mines, taking small steps and gradually searching the surroundings with the camp as the center.

However, the soil around here seemed quite good. Larvitar couldn't find any mineral-rich ores and immediately lost some interest.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar, having finished setting up the tent, saw this scene and patted the little one's head.

It indicated not to be discouraged - tonight they'd explore a bit farther. Earlier in the forest, it seemed to have seen something glowing that looked like minerals.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar nodded vigorously.

Following big brother Gengar, there was no need to worry about having no "food"!

Night fell.

In the temporarily erected tent, Johan crawled into his sleeping bag, still muttering about his fishing experience.

"There's definitely something wrong with that river!"

First, let him clarify - he definitely didn't come up empty!

Catching seaweed still counted as catching something.

In the not-too-large tent, the little ones huddled together. Rather than being uncomfortable, it felt quite cozy. Plus with Ceruledge constantly radiating heat, there was no worry about the night being too cold.

"Gengar, lights out," Johan said.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar took a deep breath and blew hard at the electric lamp. Regieleki nearby immediately cut power to the lamp.

Since Regieleki temporarily joined the team, the power supply for various electrical equipment changed from Rotom to Regieleki.

Then Gengar took out a Poké Ball and recalled Regieleki.

That yellow fellow was the biggest light source after all.

Soon, steady breathing sounds came from the sleeping bags.

A pair of crimson eyes suddenly lit up in the quiet tent.

Then came another pair of slightly confused but alert eyes - undoubtedly Larvitar's.

Gengar glanced at Urshifu and Dragonite sitting at the entrance, floated to a corner of the tent, and lifted the blanket laid on the ground. This was what it had prepared in advance - a hole for Larvitar to dig out.

Gengar itself could directly phase through the tent and float out.

This time, they wouldn't bring Tinkaton or Urshifu, because tonight's main objective was mining!

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales, curled up beside Johan, opened its eyes a crack and glanced at Gengar and Larvitar preparing to go out.

It wasn't afraid of anyone else, but when it came to Johan and Ninetales as Johan's "representative," Gengar was still a bit intimidated. It immediately put on what it thought was a "harmless" smile.

However, Ninetales didn't mean anything else. It knew what Gengar was like, so it just reminded Gengar not to make too much noise.

Gengar immediately made an "OK" gesture and said quietly:

"Ka-kaah~"

Trust me to handle this~

With that, it ran out of the tent with Larvitar.

Dark and windy night.

Two shadows, one large and one small, tiptoed away from the tent toward the forest not far from camp.

When they had gone far enough, the two little ones became bolder in their movements.

"Yoji?"

Larvitar stared hard at the pitch-black forest but couldn't see the "glowing thing" Gengar mentioned.

Gengar squinted and scanned around, also finding that the glowing thing it saw earlier was gone. But it patted its chest confidently, indicating they should get closer to look - there definitely was something!

So.

The two little ones entered the forest under the moonlight.

The nighttime forest wasn't quiet. Rustling sounds continued constantly. Tonight's sky had many clouds, with moonlight only occasionally peeking through, leaving only blurry spots when it fell into the forest.

"Yo-Yoji!"

Suddenly, Larvitar spotted the "glowing thing" Gengar mentioned, pointing toward the distance with excitement in its eyes.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar put on a mature expression, raising its hand and pressing down to signal Larvitar to stay calm. Then...

Its body turned into black mist, swiftly rushing toward the glowing location.

The next second.

"Pumpkaboo!!"

A Pumpkaboo looked terrified at Gengar, who had suddenly appeared behind it. The "glowing thing" Larvitar and Gengar had seen earlier was the light emanating from Pumpkaboo's pumpkin-like body.

There's a ghost!!

Pumpkaboo screamed and ran away, sweating profusely.

"Ka-kaah?"

Watching the fleeing Pumpkaboo, Gengar scratched its head.

But isn't that guy a ghost too?

"Yoji~"

Larvitar trotted over, also seeing the rapidly disappearing Pumpkaboo.

This is the mineral big brother Gengar mentioned?

Larvitar picked up a stone and ground it against its teeth, tilting its head.

Doesn't seem like very hard mineral, and it can run...

Gengar coughed lightly, knowing it had misjudged. But its eyes rolled as it patted Larvitar's head.

"Ka-kaah!"

Don't worry! First check if there are any minerals underground nearby!

Oh...

Larvitar nodded, its horn glowing slightly again as it lowered its head to search.

Gengar rubbed its chin, brain spinning rapidly, thinking about how to get past this awkward situation.

But unexpectedly, Larvitar suddenly cried out in surprise.

"Yoji!"

There's something!

Hm?

Gengar was stunned and quickly floated to Larvitar's side, finding it staring at the ground covered with rotting leaves. Then it immediately dove underground.

Before long, it floated back out.

There really was something!

"Ka-kaah?"

What are you waiting for? Dig!

Larvitar also reacted and immediately started digging.

Truth be told, while both knew the move Dig, Larvitar was simply faster at digging than Ninetales.

"Yoji!"

When Larvitar poked its head out, it was full of excitement, holding a... diamond in its hand!

About half the size of its palm, even under the dim moonlight, it sparkled slightly.

A diamond!

Since Johan's last purchase from Steven, Larvitar had deeply appreciated diamonds' deliciousness - much better than some so-called rare minerals!

However, Johan hadn't bought "many," and they were long since eaten by Larvitar.

It never expected to dig one up here.

Gengar had somehow put on sunglasses and stood with hands on its hips, laughing proudly.

"Ka-kaah?"

See? I didn't lie to you, did I?

"Yoji!"

Larvitar also mimicked by putting on sunglasses and nodding repeatedly.

Big brother Gengar is amazing!

Hearing this, Gengar secretly sighed in relief.

That was close...

"Yoji?" Larvitar scratched its head.

But big brother Gengar, did you turn off the lights? Why is it so dark?

Hearing this, Gengar immediately removed Larvitar's sunglasses. Only then did Larvitar understand and show a silly grin.

As a Ghost-type Pokémon, Gengar's vision was the same whether wearing sunglasses or not, but Larvitar was different.

"Ka-kaah~~"

Gengar shook its head, then called down into the hole.

There might be more underground~

That made sense. Larvitar quickly threw the diamond in its mouth and dove back down.

Gengar scanned the surroundings, quietly filled in the hole Larvitar had dug, then followed underground.

So...

"Yoji!"

There really was more!

Underground.

Larvitar found another diamond and showed it off to Gengar.

Like this, Gengar and Larvitar dug diamonds while going deeper underground. Soon Larvitar's mouth was full, and it started stuffing them into Gengar's mouth.

Bonk!

Gengar lightly tapped Larvitar's head.

Just eat them - why stuff them in your mouth without eating?

"Mm mm..."

Larvitar realized.

Oh right.

Its mouth moved as it chewed.

However, as they found more and more diamonds, even with Larvitar eating while digging, it couldn't keep up.

Rich! So rich!

The two little ones looked at each other, both seeing excitement in the other's eyes.

Had they hit a diamond vein?

Gengar's mind filled with images of future ice cream eating - wouldn't it be throwing away one for every one eaten?

Luxurious!

Larvitar's mind filled with images of bathing in diamonds in the future, not just that - diamond bowls! Diamond beds! Eating meals with the bowl, sleeping while gnawing the bed - absolutely perfect~

Just as the two little ones were lost in wild fantasies, Larvitar suddenly dug into empty space, unknowingly reaching an underground passage and falling down with a "thud."

"Yoji?"

The little one rubbed its head twice and stood up shakily.

Where is this?

Gengar also floated out from the passage Larvitar had dug, eyes full of curiosity.

Unlike Larvitar, it had heard Johan mention that beneath the Kalos region existed a massive underground Diamond Kingdom, inhabited by numerous Carbink, with the entire kingdom wrapped in countless diamonds, brilliantly dazzling.

Could this be the legendary Diamond Kingdom?

But...

Gengar scratched its head.

Where was the brilliant dazzling? Where was the bling bling?

"Yo-Yoji!"

Larvitar opened its mouth wide, pointing at a stone pillar in front, drool uncontrollably flowing.

Although it couldn't see clearly, it could confirm that pillar was covered with a thick layer of diamond ore!

Whoosh!

Gengar raised its palm, a ghostly blue flame appearing in its hand, illuminating the surroundings.

"Ka-kaah~(°ロ°)!"

"Yoji~w(°ｏ°)w"

Both little ones widened their eyes.

Under the ghostly blue flame's glow, the underground cavern's scenery appeared before them - dazzling, bling bling...

About three or four rock pillars in view were all covered with thick diamonds. The cavern walls were also covered with diamonds of various sizes, sparkling and refracting light under the flame's illumination.

Gulp—

Larvitar swallowed and stiffly turned to look at Gengar.

"Yo-Yoji?"

Can we fit it all?

Gengar snapped back to attention, its expression becoming serious as it nodded firmly.

"Ka-kaah!"

Of course! Don't underestimate my 'Shadow Empire'!

Larvitar looked worshipful.

Then what are we waiting for?

Start digging!

Without hesitation, Larvitar immediately crawled to a wall and began digging diamonds from it.

These crystalline diamonds were naturally irregular in shape, some large and some small, with most surfaces rather dull. But for Larvitar, it didn't matter - just the difference between eating in one bite versus several bites.

Meanwhile, Gengar wandered around the cavern.

Was this the Diamond Kingdom?

Where were the Carbink Johan mentioned, and that legendary Diamond Princess?

But after wandering half a circle, forget the Diamond Princess - it didn't see a single Carbink.

Moreover, although it and Larvitar had been amazed when the ghostly fire first lit up, after actually walking half a circle, it discovered... this place seemed much smaller than imagined.

"Ka-kaah?"

This isn't the Diamond Kingdom?

Then why are there so many diamonds...

Rumble rumble—

A stone suddenly rolled down from the wall.

Hm?

Gengar looked at Larvitar working hard as a diamond miner behind it, then at the stone that rolled to its feet.

How did digging over there make stones fall here?

Before Gengar could figure it out.

Crash—

Suddenly more stones fell, followed by a pink figure stepping on stones and sliding down with a somewhat panicked expression.

Its lower body resembled the Carbink Johan had mentioned, but the diamonds on its body were pink. It wore a white gauze dress, with pink diamonds forming a crown on its head, and red eyes filled with panic.

What Pokémon was this? Never seen it before.

Gengar's eyes showed confusion.

If Johan were here now, he would definitely recognize this pink diamond-crowned Pokémon as Diancie, princess of the Diamond Kingdom and legendary Mythical Pokémon!

However, while Gengar only felt confused seeing Diancie, Diancie was frightened seeing Gengar.

It was indeed the Diamond Kingdom's princess, shouldering the great responsibility of reviving the entire Diamond Kingdom.

You see, while Carbink belonged to the "Fairy" and "Mineral" egg groups, every Carbink was genderless.

In other words.

The Carbink population couldn't reproduce through mating.

Carbink birth theoretically had only two methods.

First, diamonds or mineral creatures buried thousands of meters deep underground would transform into Carbink through special changes.

This was how most Carbink populations or Carbink veins formed.

Second, the Diamond Kingdom's method - through "Eternal Crystals" created and condensed by Diancie with life energy, Carbink could be born.

All Carbink in the Diamond Kingdom were born this way, with "Eternal Crystals" as the kingdom's core.

However, in recent years, the Diamond Kingdom's "Eternal Crystals" had dimmed, with very few Carbink being born from them. The entire Diamond Kingdom faced a crisis of population continuation.

As the Diamond Kingdom's princess, young Diancie shouldered the responsibility of creating new "Eternal Crystals."

But Diancie was too young, and under the Diamond Kingdom's protection, it hadn't experienced much. It couldn't condense new "Eternal Crystals" no matter what.

From the Diamond Minister's accounts, Diancie learned that the legendary "Life God" Xerneas could grant life energy - exactly what Diancie lacked most.

So.

Shouldering the entire Diamond Kingdom's fate, Diancie embarked on a journey to find Xerneas.

During this journey, it needed places to rest and recover.

This cavern it entered was once a Carbink population's mine. It originally wanted to rest here briefly, but who knew... instead of seeing Carbink, it saw Gengar glowing with ghostly blue light upon entering...

"A ghost!"

Diancie screamed and tried to run toward the entrance passage.

But at this moment.

Larvitar, who had been busy mining diamonds, naturally saw Diancie's appearance.

Pink diamonds?

That taste...

Larvitar, mouth watering, immediately thought big brother Gengar had discovered even more remarkable minerals and pounced over.

This scene in Diancie's eyes...

Diancie: Σ(дlll)

My life is over!

Half an hour later.

"Ka-kaah~Ka-kaah~"

"Yoji~Yoji~"

Gengar and Larvitar sat almost identically, rubbing their chins and nodding.

In front of them, Diancie's pink eyes were filled with grievance. Through halting explanations, it finally made them understand it was a Pokémon, not a diamond.

Larvitar looked regretful.

Too bad.

It thought it was some unprecedented pink diamond. Now it turned out... to be a Pokémon.

You couldn't eat Pokémon - if Johan found out, forget getting its butt beaten, its head would be smashed.

Gengar thought a bit more than Larvitar.

"Ka-kaah?" It looked at Diancie with consideration.

You say you're a diamond mine princess, so you can also produce diamonds, right? Pink diamonds?

Hearing Gengar say this, Larvitar perked up again.

Pink diamonds? Really possible?

Hearing this, Diancie looked troubled, but facing this fierce-looking "evil ghost" and vicious "little dinosaur," it seemed to have no right to refuse?

It said quietly: "I can, but please... don't be disappointed."

With that, it closed its eyes, raised both hands, brilliant pink radiance appearing between its palms. As it lowered its head and brought its hands together, the pink light also converged.

When it opened its hands again, a crystalline and regular pink diamond appeared in its palms.

"Yo-Yoji?"

Witnessing the entire process, Larvitar vigorously rubbed its eyes twice, opened its mouth, somewhat disbelieving.

The diamonds it longed for could be created just like that with a wave of the hands?

And it was an unprecedented pink diamond!

Carefully taking it from Diancie's hands, Larvitar held the pink diamond up to Gengar's ghostly fire to examine.

Sparkling and twinkling.

It really was a diamond!

Without hesitation, it threw it in its mouth, eager to taste the pink diamond's flavor.

However...

Crack—

Larvitar's teeth clamped down, and with slight pressure, the pink diamond immediately crumbled into crystalline pink dust that dispersed. Larvitar only felt its upper teeth hit its lower teeth.

Eh?

It smacked its lips twice.

No taste?

No.

The diamond disappeared on its own!

Witnessing the process, Gengar and Larvitar, who bit empty air, looked at Diancie in unison.

Diancie unconsciously stepped back and said haltingly:

"I-I said before, don't be disappointed. I can't control my power yet, so the diamonds I create can't maintain themselves for long."

Can't control its own power?

Gengar and Larvitar looked at each other.

What do you do when a Pokémon can't control its power?

Find a trainer!

Where could they find a trainer who could help Diancie control its power?

Right here in front of them!

Johan!

"Ka-kaah~Ka-kaah~"

"Yoji~Yoji~"

So Gengar and Larvitar gestured extensively, gradually making Diancie understand their meaning.

At the same time, Diancie slowly realized these two Pokémon who looked like bad guys at first glance... didn't seem as "evil" as they appeared on the surface. They actually seemed like good guys?

Simple Diancie, inexperienced in worldly matters, could still sense that besides being interested in diamonds, Gengar and Larvitar held no malice toward it.

Moreover, it became curious about the so-called "trainer" Gengar and Larvitar described.

"Can a trainer help me control my power?"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar raised one finger and shook it gently.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar copied, also raising one finger and shaking it.

An ordinary trainer definitely couldn't do it, but if it was Johan...

The two little ones looked at each other and spoke in unison.

That would definitely be easy!

"Johan..." Diancie softly repeated the name, hope shining in its eyes. "Can you take me to find him?"

No problem!

Both little ones simultaneously made "OK" gestures.

Diancie immediately rejoiced, lifting its dress and saying hurriedly: "Then please take me there!"

With that, it quickly ran toward the entrance passage.

Seeing this, Larvitar was about to say, wait for me to finish harvesting these diamonds first, no, mining them.

But nearby Gengar indicated it was fine - these diamonds had been here so long without anyone touching them. Besides, just the two of them digging was too slow. Tomorrow they'd bring everyone to dig together!

Larvitar immediately thought that made sense.

Tomorrow they'd bring everyone to share this harvest's joy. Seeing so many diamonds, Johan would probably be happy enough to jump five meters high.

So Gengar and Larvitar followed Diancie out one after the other.

Dark forest, dim environment.

Hoothoot and Noctowl played night's sad songs in the corners as Diancie excitedly ran out from a stone crevice, joy on its face.

However.

Just as it emerged from the crevice, a night breeze passed, and it gradually calmed down.

Why had it rushed into that Carbink mine earlier?

It suddenly shivered.

"Found you." A mocking voice came from behind a nearby tree trunk.

A woman in black magician robes with red hair and high heels emerged from behind the tree with a Delphox.

The orange flames at the tips of Delphox's branch-like arms brought some light to the dim forest.

"So you went underground."

On the other side, from the treetops, a man in ninja attire wearing a mask also spoke.

Beside him, in the shadowy leaves, stood an upright Greninja.

Both Delphox and Greninja's gazes locked onto Diancie, who had just emerged.

Only then did Diancie remember why it had hurriedly run into the underground crevice and the Carbink mine - wasn't it to escape these two guys who had been searching for and trying to capture it?

"Oh no..."

In its excitement, it had forgotten this important matter.

"Millis, I spotted it first this time!" the woman in magician robes with Delphox declared.

The ninja Millis on the treetop chuckled, his voice coming from behind the mask.

"Flame, I'm not playing your first-come-first-served house games."

These two were the famous hunters of the Kalos region - ninja Millis and magician Marilyn Flame.

"Ka-kaah?"

At this moment, a voice came from the crevice behind Diancie.

How lively!

Gengar grinned, showing white teeth, and floated out with a cheerful smile.

"Yo-Yoji~"

Larvitar followed close behind, still chewing diamonds it had grabbed along the way with "crunch crunch" sounds.

"Gengar and Larvitar?"

Millis and Flame looked at each other.

Helpers Diancie had found?

----------

Powerstones?

# 633: Diancie's Request (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar looked at the two people across from them, along with Delphox and Greninja, then at Diancie, who was backing away with a frightened expression.

It lightly scratched its head.

Friends?

Friends?

Larvitar "awakened" and raised its little hand to wave at them.

"Yoji!"

Hello there!

Millis and Marilyn Flame didn't understand what Gengar and Larvitar's situation was, but...

"They're here to catch me!" Diancie immediately shouted.

Hm?

Gengar and Larvitar's expressions immediately changed.

Catch Diancie?

This was their "friend," an existence that could produce rare and precious pink diamonds for them!

But Millis and Marilyn Flame were obviously faster.

Attack!

"Delphox, Mystical Fire!"

"Woo—!!"

Delphox, draped in red and yellow fur, let out a low cry, as if chanting a spell. The branch in its hand, or rather its wand, burning with flames, gently traced a circle of fire in the air, immediately causing a ball of flame wrapped in mysterious power to spew forth.

"Greninja, Water Shuriken!"

Standing on the treetop, Greninja maintained a cold expression, spreading both hands. Several water shuriken glowing with blue light immediately appeared in its hands, which it threw at Larvitar without hesitation.

"Be careful!" Diancie was the first to cry out in alarm.

Seeing the attacks incoming, although Johan wasn't commanding them, Gengar and Larvitar's reaction speed was still quite good.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar stomped heavily on the ground, and with a "rumble," numerous cracks appeared on the ground surface. Rocks of various sizes shot up, forming a dense stone wall.

Bang bang bang—

Greninja's Water Shuriken struck the broken rocks, shattering them further, but failed to attack Larvitar.

At the same time.

Gengar grinned maliciously, making strange sounds as black mist surged from its body, making the already dim forest even darker.

Simultaneously, within the black mist, a black sphere appeared, like a black hole. Delphox's Mystical Fire disappeared without a trace the moment it entered!

This...

Seeing this scene, both Millis and Marilyn Flame showed surprised expressions.

These two Pokémon that had appeared out of nowhere seemed to have considerable strength.

"Yoji! (Д)σ"

You saw it, they attacked first!

Larvitar looked at Diancie, then pointed at Millis and Greninja in the tree.

Hearing this, Diancie was stunned and unconsciously nodded.

"Mm-hmm."

Having found a "witness," Larvitar immediately became energized.

At the Battle Chateau, it hadn't had a chance to battle in the final match, and was still feeling unsatisfied. Now someone was delivering themselves to its doorstep!

Larvitar's gaze locked firmly onto Greninja.

For some unknown reason, being stared at by Larvitar like this, Millis's Greninja suddenly felt uncomfortable all over.

Moreover, the black mist spreading around them, and the disappeared Gengar, also made it quite uneasy.

Not only Greninja felt this way, but Millis and Marilyn Flame did too. Delphox's Mystical Fire had just been "devoured" like that?

"Join forces!" Marilyn Flame said in a low voice.

Millis wisely didn't refuse. "Deal with them first, then capture Diancie!"

Just then.

"Ka-kaah~(▼皿▼)" Gengar suddenly appeared between Marilyn Flame and Delphox, poking its head out from behind them.

You two have already been surrounded by us~

This cold feeling, combined with the sudden appearance, made Marilyn Flame and Delphox's faces change dramatically.

"Delphox!" Marilyn Flame hastily called out.

"Woo!"

Without needing Marilyn Flame's command, Delphox had already reacted. Its entire body was surrounded by psychic energy waves as it launched a Psychic attack mixed with mental power toward Gengar at its side.

Poof—

However.

Gengar dispersed like a bubble.

Fake?

At the same time.

Greninja on the treetop wrapped its scarf-like tongue around itself and spat out a Water Gun at Larvitar, then its body glowed with white light as it rushed toward Larvitar at extreme speed.

Bang!!

The Water Gun was once again blocked by the rocks Larvitar had shaken up.

But Greninja also used Quick Attack to reach Larvitar's side, where there were no rocks blocking it.

Greninja maintained its cold expression, glancing sideways at Larvitar while holding two large Water Shuriken in its palms, striking toward Larvitar's side at incredible speed.

Thwack! Thwack!

The large Water Shuriken grazed past Larvitar's small body.

Greninja's eyes showed some satisfaction.

It had seen Larvitar-type Pokémon before. They were 4x weak to Water-type moves. As long as attacks weren't blocked and hit accurately...

But the next second.

The satisfaction in Greninja's eyes was replaced by bewilderment.

Where its Water Shuriken had struck, Larvitar's body showed a metallic luster.

Iron Defense?

This hard?

"Yoji!"

That really hurt!!

Larvitar cried out in pain, making a pained expression.

Although it looked like Iron Defense had blocked the attack, it really did hurt!

However...

"Yoji!"

I caught you!

Larvitar's seemingly honest eyes showed some cunning.

Only then did Greninja seem to realize something. Looking down, it discovered that its tongue had somehow been grabbed by Larvitar!

When did this happen?!

"Yoji!!"

Power!!

Dragon Dance!

Taking advantage of the earlier rock cover blocking vision, Larvitar's Dragon Dance had already completed its boost!

It grabbed Greninja's tongue and then swung it hard toward the ground on the other side.

Bang!!

The seemingly small Larvitar unleashed unimaginable power, slamming Greninja heavily to the ground.

Moreover, the little one didn't hesitate to lift its foot again and stomp down heavily.

Rumble—

The ground suddenly shook as a huge crack rapidly spread from under Larvitar's foot, heading straight for Greninja lying on the ground.

Seeing this scene, Millis's pupils contracted sharply.

Fissure?!

He quickly shouted:

"Greninja!"

The Greninja on the ground also hastily tried to get up, but its tongue was still being held by Larvitar and couldn't break free.

The next moment.

Rumble!!!

The fissure, carrying rich Ground-type energy, completely "devoured" Greninja.

Witnessing the entire process, Millis stood in the tree with twitching eyes.

What the hell kind of Larvitar was this?

A Tyranitar wearing Larvitar skin?

It was clearly just a cub, yet it could display such strength...

Although he, Millis, couldn't claim to be an incredibly powerful Pokémon hunter, he had quite a reputation in the Kalos region. Never mind anything else, even some Gym Leaders in the Kalos region, he wouldn't fear.

Otherwise, he wouldn't have set his sights on Diancie.

But his main ace Greninja, despite having type advantage, was actually... taught a lesson by a Larvitar?

This result far exceeded his expectations.

Wait!

Millis suddenly realized - where was Marilyn Flame?

Weren't they supposed to fight together?

Millis quickly turned toward where Marilyn Flame and Delphox had been, only to see their previous location was pitch black with nothing left...

Hm?

Where did they go?

Then, a lazy voice suddenly came from behind Millis.

"Ka-kaah?"

Are you looking for them?

Thud—Thud—

He saw Marilyn Flame and Delphox being thrown out of the black mist, falling to the ground, having already lost their ability to move.

Seeing this scene, Millis's pupils contracted.

As fellow famous Pokémon hunters, Millis and Marilyn Flame were basically rivals, and they'd competed numerous times, so they were quite familiar with each other's strength.

Yet he never imagined that Marilyn Flame, whom he found quite troublesome, would be subdued without even making much of a commotion?

This Gengar, this Larvitar... what exactly were these two Pokémon...

Before his various thoughts could finish flashing through his mind, Millis felt his thinking becoming extremely muddled, his eyelids starting to fight each other.

Hyp... Hypnosis?

The next second, Millis fell straight down from the tree, landing on the ground together with Marilyn Flame and Delphox.

Clap clap clap—

Gengar grinned, clapping its hands as it emerged from the black mist. The fog that had been spreading around gradually dispersed, turning into wisps of mist that returned to its body.

Done.

It thought they were some big shots, but turned out... that's all?

Larvitar mimicked Gengar's clapping, feeling unsatisfied. It turned toward the ground and...

Ptui!

Diancie stared blankly at the nonchalant Gengar and Larvitar, opening its mouth but not knowing what to say.

It just felt these two Pokémon were really strong.

If they were its guards, it should be able to find Xerneas more safely, right?

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar waved its hand, drawing out several wisps of black mist from its body that wrapped around the unconscious Millis, Marilyn Flame, Delphox, and Greninja on the ground.

Let's go find Johan.

Larvitar moved a rock from the side, carefully covering the cracks in the stone, patting it firm.

Can't let someone else claim what they'd be coming back to dig later.

"Regieleki, stop electrifying, I'm numb..."

In the tent, Johan mumbled.

"Regi?"

Regieleki looked confused, looking left and right, then shrugged.

I didn't use electricity...

Johan groggily awakened from his dream, took out a Rawst Berry from his pocket and bit into it, then wiped his face and sat up, saying somewhat irritably:

"Gengar!"

Gengar, which had been crouched beside Johan preparing to continue licking, suddenly stood up, put its hands on its hips, pursed its lips and started whistling, with one foot constantly swaying, looking like it was saying "I don't know what you're talking about."

Johan shook his head, not wanting to say more about this. He was long used to it.

There was just one thing he didn't understand.

After being licked by Gengar for so long - almost a year now - how had he still not developed resistance?

With his current physical condition, plus aura, he shouldn't be considered an ordinary person anymore, right?

Johan lifted the tent flap and peeked outside. The moon hung in the west, the sun hadn't risen in the east yet, but there was a faint purple glow.

He picked up the Rotom Pokédex to check the time.

Great, 4 AM.

"You better have something important..." Putting on clothes while biting the Rawst Berry, Johan walked out of the tent irritably.

Although he said this, Johan understood Gengar's nature. Unless there was really something important, it would never wake him at this hour.

When he walked out of the tent, he was shocked by the scene before him.

Diamonds!

A pile of diamonds!

Various sizes, all irregular shapes, but undoubtedly all diamonds. The pile was... almost as tall as Urshifu, more than what he'd bought from Steven last time.

Beside that pile of diamonds, Larvitar sat with arms crossed and legs up, looking very proud.

"Did you guys... go rob the Diamond Kingdom?" Johan asked, taking the half-eaten Rawst Berry from his mouth.

"No, no... not from the Diamond Kingdom."

A soft, weak voice came from the side.

Following the voice.

"Diancie?" Johan's eyes widened slightly.

Then he looked toward Larvitar and Gengar. You two really did rob the Diamond Kingdom?

Even brought back Diamond Princess Diancie?

"Ka-kaah~Ka-kaah~"

Gengar quickly pointed behind the diamond pile.

Johan walked around the diamond pile with confusion, and saw the tied-up Millis and Marilyn Flame.

"They are..."

Looking at their appearance, Johan slowly frowned, feeling somewhat serious.

Then, Gengar and Larvitar took turns telling their story in a jumbled manner.

Although their account was a bit chaotic, Johan roughly understood the sequence and general process.

Last night, Gengar and Larvitar went out to mine minerals, accidentally dug into a diamond vein, then encountered the pursued Diancie and her two pursuers. Gengar and Larvitar helped Diancie and defeated these two.

Watching Gengar stick out its tongue around its neck and throw black shuriken, Johan's mouth twitched.

With that pose, any Pokémon fan would know what it was imitating.

Greninja!

Combined with Larvitar beside it holding a branch pretending to breathe fire, plus the two people on the ground...

"So it's them." Johan crouched in front of the two people, recognizing them.

These were exactly the thieves from the movie "Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction" who tried to capture Diancie, attempting to make it create diamonds.

They even accidentally entered the sleeping place of Yveltal's "Cocoon of Destruction" while pursuing Diancie later, awakening Yveltal.

However, when the plot completely ended, the two seemed to have reformed and even became a couple, opening a cosplay clothing store together.

Millis and Marilyn Flame had already awakened. When they saw that the person who walked out of the tent was actually Teacher Johan, they knew they were doomed.

The two looked at each other.

Both saw shock in the other's eyes.

It was actually Teacher Johan!

They should have thought of it earlier, really. When they encountered such a powerful Gengar, they should have thought of it.

Teacher Johan!

Said to have at least Elite Four-level strength, even comparable to Champions!

They were screwed.

However, their mouths were also sealed, so they could only make "mmm" sounds.

Johan smiled slightly, took out his International Police Inspector credentials from his clothes, and said:

"Sorry, you two are under arrest."

Millis and Marilyn Flame dejectedly hung their heads, accepting their fate.

There was no choice - they definitely couldn't win in a fight. No wait, they were already tied up and didn't even have a chance to fight.

He'd call Officer Jenny to take them away later.

However, Johan remembered that in the movie "Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction," there was another group of powerful Pokémon hunters, even more formidable than these two, and also knowledgeable.

It seemed to be a father-daughter pair.

Knowing that the current Diancie couldn't yet condense real diamonds, they even protected Diancie from Millis and Marilyn Flame's capture along the way, until Diancie met Xerneas. Only when they believed Diancie had "matured" did they make their move.

He just didn't know where this father-daughter pair was now.

Because they had an invisible airship, they weren't that easy to find.

"Gengar, let them have another good sleep." Johan said.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar casually waved, and the two people wrapped in black mist soon fell into deep sleep again.

Anyway...

"Let's go dig diamonds!" Johan dug out a pickaxe from Gengar's mouth and said excitedly.

Heaven knows how much he'd worried about Larvitar's food expenses.

Others said that to train an Elite Four-level Pokémon, besides investing enormous effort and patience, you also needed to invest at least fifty million Pokédollars in resources.

Pseudo-legendary Pokémon needed even more.

After all, pseudo-legendary Pokémon were famously "late bloomers." Only after training to their complete form would they experience an explosive growth in strength, truly worthy of the "pseudo-legendary" title.

But Johan had no idea how much money he'd thrown into training just Larvitar, a cub that hadn't even evolved yet.

This didn't even count what they dug up themselves, mining at every place they visited.

Not to mention top-tier resource materials like Earth Plate fragments and Soft Sand that couldn't be bought with money.

One of Johan's purposes in coming to the Kalos region was to see if he could find a Carbink diamond vein to get some food for Larvitar, comforting his spiritually wounded wallet.

He never expected to actually find one!

Leaving Regieleki to guard the sleeping two, Johan shouldered his pickaxe and took all his little ones mining!

Today, he'd be a gold miner - no, a diamond miner!

Led by Gengar and Larvitar, Johan's group quickly found the passage to the underground diamond vein and entered it.

"Rotom, lights! Maximum power!"

"Understood, Rotom!"

Zzzt zzzt zzzt—

With some electrical current activity, the light illuminated half the underground cavern.

As the light appeared, the originally dark underground mine immediately brightened. Countless diamonds on stone pillars and walls sparkled brilliantly under the illumination, as if entering some kind of palace.

Looking at the cavern full of diamonds, all the Pokémon including Johan had the same expression:

($̀_$́)

"We're rich..."

Johan murmured softly.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar waved its hand dramatically.

Get to work!

The little ones immediately sprang into action.

Gengar manipulated black mist, Ninetales used psychic powers, Tinkaton swung its big hammer.

Dragonite and Urshifu had no special techniques but had strength, directly prying with their hands. Their efficiency wasn't low either.

Ceruledge's form flashed around the cavern as diamonds of various sizes fell one after another.

Larvitar was the most straightforward, most savage, but also most satisfying.

It directly latched onto a rock wall and used its teeth to gnaw, mining while eating, quite like picking strawberries in a strawberry field.

"Vii~"

Victini revealed its form, sitting on Johan's shoulder, cheering everyone on while not forgetting to add some energy boosts, making the "mining gang" even more motivated.

Diancie also came along, watching the "bandit"-like group with some bewilderment.

You could say they were just mining diamonds, but why did they want dirt and stones too? Were they... desperately poor?

"Ahem." Johan then remembered there was a Diamond Princess beside him.

"Diancie, what do you think of this diamond vein?" Johan asked.

Diancie snapped back to attention, looked at the diamonds that had been pried loose, and gently shook its head.

"Small village."

"Small village?"

Good grief.

So many diamonds, yet to Diancie, this was just a small village?

Diancie said softly: "According to records, originally about twenty Carbink should have lived here."

It picked up a diamond from the ground. "But these diamonds have rough, dull surfaces, obviously not polished for a long time. They're the poorest quality diamonds I've seen."

Tsk...

Johan clicked his tongue.

Poor quality...

For Diancie, or rather for Carbink Pokémon, diamonds needed polishing, whether the ones they left behind or the ones on their bodies.

If diamonds weren't polished, they'd become rough, as if covered with a layer of dust, neither bright nor beautiful. This was how they judged diamond quality.

But for Johan...

Whether diamonds were bright or not didn't matter - they'd all go into Larvitar's mouth anyway. After chewing and digesting, they'd all be the same in the end.

However, Johan also noticed the content in Diancie's words.

"About twenty Carbink?"

This diamond vein currently didn't show even a shadow of Carbink, and obviously hadn't shown signs of life for a very long time. Otherwise, Johan wouldn't have allowed his little ones to "destroy" other Pokémon's homes like this.

This was also why he was quite excited.

He'd originally thought finding a Carbink vein and trading some energy cubes for diamonds would be pretty good. He hadn't expected to encounter an abandoned vein where everything could be taken...

He just didn't know how much time those twenty-something Carbink had spent to produce so many diamonds.

It should take at least over a hundred years, right?

Diancie's expression became downcast.

"With no new Carbink being born, over time... it becomes like this."

Theoretically, Carbink also had a lifespan limit. After all, they were living beings, even if they were mineral creatures.

Although Carbink definitely lived longer than humans, in the face of the true river of time, they all ended up the same - the difference was just sooner or later.

Not only this Carbink "village," but wasn't its Diamond Kingdom the same?

After being melancholy for a while, Diancie suddenly reacted, looking toward Johan and hastily saying:

"Could, could you not take everything?"

"Hm?" Johan was stunned.

Diancie lowered its head slightly. "These diamonds, after hundreds or thousands of years, might... might give birth to new Carbink..."

Besides the Diamond Kingdom's "Eternal Crystal," wild Carbink were born this way.

If everything was taken... there'd never be a possibility of new Carbink being born here.

"And it might also collapse."

Johan understood.

You can't be too extreme in doing things.

He immediately became serious, turning to shout at his little ones:

"Don't dig everything out! We'll take fifty percent!"

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar and the other little ones all turned around, looking confused.

So many diamonds...

However, they wouldn't question Johan's words.

Fifty percent was fifty percent. It was already quite a lot.

Diancie visibly relaxed, looking at Johan with much more friendly eyes.

It had just noticed Johan and Larvitar's expressions when facing these diamonds - they obviously really wanted them.

Yet now when he said to give up half, he gave up half...

Mm, he's a good person.

Then...

Diancie looked hopeful and asked: "They said you could help me master my own power, help me find Xerneas. Can you help me?"

Hm?

They said?

Johan looked toward Gengar, half-squinting his eyes.

This purple fatty, making promises outside again?

Seeming to sense Johan's gaze, the spikes on Gengar's back stood up one by one, but it didn't turn around. Instead, it ran deeper to dig for diamonds.

Johan shook his head.

But... this was a Pokémon, Diancie, seeking help...

"Is it not possible..." Seeing Johan shake his head, Diancie thought he was refusing and became somewhat dejected.

Seeing this, Johan smiled. "I didn't say it wasn't possible, just... I'm not certain."

"Not certain?" Hope returned to Diancie's eyes, mixed with some confusion.

"I don't know if I can help you control your power." Johan's voice was gentle. "As for Xerneas... that's really not up to me."

He wasn't Ash, who could just say he'd help Diancie find Xerneas and actually find it. This depended on luck.

Moreover.

The movie proved that whether Diancie could create "Eternal Crystal" actually had little real relationship with whether it met Xerneas. It just couldn't find the knack, couldn't grasp its own power, so it couldn't condense "Eternal Crystal."

To use a more "anime" or "chunibyo" way of putting it, the current Diancie simply couldn't find what it truly wanted to protect.

It was working hard only because it was the Diamond Kingdom's princess, bearing responsibility. This responsibility also drove it to seek Xerneas.

Active versus passive - this was the difference.

"Of course, if you're willing... you could try observing how our little ones master their own power."

Couldn't find Xerneas?

This disappointed Diancie somewhat.

But thinking about the strength Gengar and Larvitar had displayed earlier...

Being able to command such power so skillfully, they must have great "techniques for mastering power," right?

Diancie was moved.

Finally, it nodded.

"Okay!"

Johan smiled.

Diancie's presence would likely lead to some complications.

But undeniably, it would also bring some benefits.

For example... the Pokémon hunters Johan was looking for.

Another example was places like this current one - small Carbink "villages" scattered throughout the Kalos region.

Even if not all were uninhabited, and he couldn't dig them all clean, there were so many of them.

Finding three or four such "villages" would probably mean he'd never need to worry about Larvitar's food again.

If he could find seven or eight, then even if Larvitar immediately evolved into Tyranitar right now, Johan could accept it without worrying too much about food.

As for the problems Diancie would bring...

Let them come.

It wasn't Hoopa, bringing a whole group at once. At most, just one Yveltal would be a bit harder to handle.

When Yveltal appeared, Xerneas would inevitably appear too. Just endure for a while.

Anyway...

One more Regieleki was a lot, one more Diancie was also a lot.

The current Johan wasn't really afraid of trouble to that extent.

Meanwhile, elsewhere.

Above Johan's camp, an invisible airship appeared near the clouds. Inside the ship were a middle-aged man and a young girl.

The father and daughter looked at the large screen showing the unconscious Millis and Marilyn Flame tied up on the ground, falling into contemplation.

"They..." the girl Millis Steel pointed at the screen.

The middle-aged man Argus Steel also looked at the screen, but secretly moved his finger away from the girl's sight toward a box of chocolates on the table.

But Argus's small movement was seen through by his daughter.

Bang!

Millis glanced at her father who was about to secretly eat chocolate, slapping the table with anger flashing behind her glasses.

Argus immediately withdrew his hand, laughing sheepishly while saying: "They, ahem, those two seem to have been captured?"

Millis adjusted her glasses. "We were originally planning to have them train Diancie a bit, but now..."

"But their strength isn't weak either. Who captured them?" Argus was somewhat confused.

They'd arrived at just the right time - only Millis, Marilyn Flame, and a tent remained at the camp.

Captured but no one watching - how convenient.

"Should we rescue them?" Argus looked at his daughter Millis.

These two still had some use, they could attract attention on the surface.

Millis's gaze swept across the screen, seeming to confirm there really was no one guarding.

"Resc—"

She'd just started speaking when her pupils suddenly contracted. She saw a golden figure suddenly appear in the tent, and then the entire screen became distorted and blurry.

What Pokémon was that?!

As master thieves, they'd never seen such a thing.

Could it be... a legendary Pokémon?

To interfere with their airship from such a distance.

Beep—beep—beep—

Red alarms immediately sounded in the airship, indicating problems with the ship's signals and circuits.

"Try again later, retreat first!"

Argus immediately decided.

Whoosh—

The airship immediately disappeared into the clouds. Due to its invisible state, there was no visible change, only some floating clouds swaying.

"Regi?"

Below, Regieleki raised its head and lightly scratched itself.

What was that about?

It had just entered the tent to see if there were any energy cubes to eat, when it suddenly felt... subtle electrical currents appearing in the air. It thought it was going to thunder and was preparing to come out for a feast.

But then that feeling suddenly disappeared...

"Eleki..."

Somewhat disinterested, Regieleki moved over a small stool and sat in front of Millis and Marilyn Flame, chin propped on its hand.

Johan told it to watch these two, so...

Mm.

Watching...
