# 634: Korrina Full of Energy

"We're rich..."

Looking at the large pile of irregularly shaped diamonds in front of him, Johan lightly licked his somewhat dry lips.

If this were his previous life, after diamonds were deliberately labeled as "precious," this pile of diamonds would have a terrifying value.

Even in the Pokémon world, so many diamonds were definitely a considerable sum.

This was only half the diamonds from one small Carbink "village."

No wait.

They hadn't even finished digging. They'd need to stay here for a while longer to continue mining.

Even with Pokémon's efficiency far exceeding ordinary people, so many diamonds couldn't be dug up in just a short time.

And faced with so many diamonds, the happiest was naturally Larvitar.

The little one now walked with its head held high, strutting proudly. Anyone who didn't know better would think it had already eaten and digested all these diamonds.

Thank goodness Gengar's shadow space was large enough, otherwise... how to transport so many diamonds would be a problem.

"Yoji?" Larvitar approached Johan, immediately dropping its previous "arrogant" attitude and asking quietly.

Can I eat freely this time?

Speaking of which, it was strange.

Johan usually didn't interfere much with Larvitar's eating. As long as there was nothing going on, the little one could eat whenever it wanted - walking and eating, resting and eating, watching TV and eating, listening to stories and eating, even eating during training.

But... he'd really never seen Larvitar eat its fill.

This "eating its fill" meant Larvitar filling its stomach until it couldn't stuff anything more in.

Although Gengar also "never got full," that was partly because Gengar's appetite was indeed large, and partly because Gengar liked to hoard.

When it couldn't eat anymore, it would stuff things in its mouth to hide them. No one knew whether it was still eating or already full.

But Larvitar was different. It didn't have Gengar's ability to traverse shadows and hide things in shadows. As long as there was food, it seemed able to keep eating.

Could it be... the little thing's digestion and absorption speed was proportional to its food intake, so it could never get full?

A drop of cold sweat appeared on Johan's forehead.

But facing the little one's hopeful eyes, then glancing at the "diamond mountain" in front of him, Johan didn't believe Larvitar's digestive ability was that exaggerated.

"Eat freely!" He waved his hand generously. "We dug so many diamonds just so you could eat your fill. Otherwise, wouldn't our digging be in vain?"

"Yoji!!"

Power!!

"But let's move them back first."

This diamond mine would need digging for a while longer, and they could wait here for Officer Jenny and the others. Johan would take his little ones back to camp for lunch first.

Whoosh—

Gengar took out large quantities of diamonds and placed them on the ground. Larvitar sat right beside them, stuffing large chunks into its mouth.

"Delicious!"

Tasting Johan's cooking for the first time, even as princess of the Diamond Kingdom, Diancie was immediately won over, its pink eyes sparkling.

However, compared to Gengar and Larvitar's eating habits, Diancie was undoubtedly much more refined, even elegant.

But the result was...

"It's... gone?" Diancie blinked at the empty plate, not knowing what to say for a moment.

"Oowoo~~"

Ninetales spread its tails, using one to bring over a piece of cake it had specifically saved to Diancie.

Pokémon like Diancie who hadn't experienced the "Old Johan Family's" eating habits definitely couldn't adapt. How much it could eat was unknown, so Ninetales thoughtfully saved a portion for Diancie.

"Th-thank you..." Diancie was a bit shy but very grateful.

"Oowoo~~"

Ninetales shook its head slightly, stretched its body in a long yawn, then curled up beside Johan for a post-meal nap.

Rest a bit, there was still daily training later.

"Someone came by?"

During the meal, Regieleki mentioned what it had sensed earlier, though it wasn't certain and just mentioned it casually.

Looking at Regieleki sitting obediently on its small stool, Johan gently stroked his chin.

In the sky, couldn't see anything, but there seemed to be electrical current fluctuations...

Wasn't this exactly the standard equipment of that father-daughter thief duo?

As expected.

Those targeting Diancie weren't just Millis and Marilyn Flame.

Why didn't they come down to fight?

If they had come down, Regieleki could definitely have taught them a lesson.

But it didn't matter.

Their target was Diancie anyway, while Johan's target was them.

"Burp~~"

Just as Johan was putting away his thoughts, he heard a burp that sounded like a roar.

Following the sound.

The scene he saw made his eye twitch.

Larvitar had finally eaten its fill. Its little belly was round and bulging, clearly unable to stuff anything more in, but the cost was...

A person-high pile of diamonds had been completely swept away by it.

These were diamonds, not just minerals. Small but dense. What he'd originally purchased from Steven was only about this much.

So this was only enough for Larvitar's one meal?

How did such a small body manage to stuff so much inside?

Larvitar leaned back sitting on the ground, holding a branch from the Tree of Beginning to pick its teeth. Seeing Johan's gaze, it grinned, showing white teeth.

Johan: "..."

Two days later.

Having finally finished digging half the diamonds from the small Carbink "village," Johan and his group prepared to set off again.

As for Millis and Marilyn Flame, Officer Jenny had taken them away early.

Johan also asked Officer Jenny to see if she could get information about other Pokémon hunter groups from them, especially that father-daughter thief duo.

"More solid."

After two days, looking at Larvitar in front of him, although it looked the same on the surface, Johan could clearly feel that Larvitar's rough shell had become more solid.

"Yoji?"

Larvitar tilted its head.

Really?

These past two days had been too comfortable for it. It was either eating or on the way to eat.

Besides mining and daily training, most of the time was spent eating. It ate so happily.

Tap tap tap...

Johan reached out and knocked on Larvitar's shell, producing dull sounds and... some metallic texture.

On Larvitar's body surface, a faint metallic luster appeared.

Iron Defense!

Under Johan's persistent emphasis and Larvitar's own efforts, it had really gradually normalized "Iron Defense."

This made its already excellent defense due to consuming large amounts of minerals even more outstanding.

"Wonder if... 'Iron Defense' in the ball counts as cheating..." Johan muttered quietly.

Other people's Pokémon came out in normal state, while Larvitar came out directly with a Defense +2 or even +4 or more buff. He didn't know if this would be penalized in competitions.

But if it was unlimited battle, then it didn't matter.

There were already hidden electrical charges in balls, so what was hiding an Iron Defense?

"Alright, let's go."

With Diancie added to the team, Johan could only temporarily give up riding his bicycle and switch to walking.

Fortunately, they weren't far from Geosenge Town. Once they reached Geosenge Town, he'd see if he could rent an off-road vehicle.

"By the way, is that cave entrance properly restored?"

Before leaving, Johan confirmed again.

"Garruu!"

Urshifu gave a thumbs up. It had personally filled that entrance and punched it solid. In terms of digging difficulty... reopening that passage would be much harder than digging a new one from the side.

"Then that's fine."

Johan was quite concerned about the environment.

Don't cause too much damage or affect wild Pokémon's living environment.

"Let's go."

Once again embarking on their summer journey.

Shortly after Johan and his group left, a diamond-shaped cell-like creature appeared on a tree in the forest. It seemed to have been observing for some time but hadn't been discovered by Johan's group.

In a forest in the eastern Kalos region.

Sunlight was filtering through gaps in the leaves, falling on the solid path covered with some fallen leaves that made soft sounds when stepped on.

The tall, straight trees on both sides had branches weaving an arched canopy in the air, shrouding the entire path in gentle greenery.

From time to time, several swift Fletchling flew overhead, and colorful Vivillon appeared and disappeared in the forest.

The air was filled with the moist scent of soil mixed with the faint fragrance of unknown wildflowers. Occasionally a breeze passed through, making the leaves rustle like countless tiny wind chimes swaying gently. Dappled light and shadow swayed with the movement of branches and leaves, weaving flowing nets of light on the ground.

The beautiful environment brought joy to their hearts.

Johan and his Pokémon's faces unconsciously showed smiles, as if their souls were being cleansed by the environment.

Even Diancie, who had originally been eager to find Xerneas, gradually slowed its pace.

"The Kalos region's environment, except for the undeveloped Alola region, should be considered quite good," Johan thought.

This might partly be due to the Kalos people's naturally laid-back and romantic nature, but probably also because of the life god Xerneas, and even the order god Zygarde played a very important role.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar floated around in the forest's tree shadows, gently parting grass clumps. Two Flabébé hiding inside were startled, tears welling in their eyes, even forgetting to run.

"Sorry."

Johan crouched down, offering two energy cubes with some apology.

The Flabébé blinked twice, their tears immediately stopped. They stared blankly holding the energy cubes, watching the gentle-smiling "good person" lead away the ghost by its spikes.

"Too bad Flabébé are Fairy-type Pokémon..." Johan lightly tapped Gengar's head, indicating it shouldn't bother these weak little ones.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar stuck out its tongue.

It hadn't expected there would be two Flabébé in the grass...

Flabébé were quite cute Pokémon - small, and you could tell their appetite definitely wouldn't be large.

Whether evolving into Floette or the final evolution Florges, their appearance wouldn't collapse either.

Trainers raising Flabébé could enjoy the "joy" of raising a child into a young woman, cough...

Unfortunately, whether Flabébé or its final evolution Florges, they were pure Fairy-type Pokémon.

Johan's family already had Ninetales and Tinkaton as Fairy-types. Training more... would be a bit much.

Moreover, for Fairy-type Pokémon training, Johan felt he was still lacking.

This was also why he planned to visit Laverre City to meet Valerie.

"Almost there, Rotom!"

Rotom in charge of navigation reminded them, indicating they weren't far from Geosenge Town.

Geosenge Town...

If Johan remembered correctly, the Ultimate Weapon that King AZ had originally created was in Geosenge Town.

However, after the Ultimate Weapon lost its energy supply, it became several stones, becoming one of Geosenge Town's famous attractions.

Geosenge Town was also famous for this reason.

Of course, Geosenge Town also produced many minerals and rare stones, often attracting mining and steel companies from around the world, or stone enthusiasts.

Below those stones was Team Flare's secret base, where Team Flare's leader Lysandre was working to activate the Ultimate Weapon.

Johan wasn't unwilling to get involved in this, since Team Flare and Lysandre's plans would have considerable impact on the environment and wild Pokémon.

He just didn't have any entry point right now.

He couldn't just storm into Team Flare's base alone, could he?

He wasn't a reckless person.

Moreover, Team Flare's strength and Lysandre's strength were both considerable.

As for telling the Kalos League about Team Flare...

Team Flare currently operated under the name "Lysandre Labs," a famous large company in the Kalos region. Their developed holographic projection technology was gradually being widely used. Since they hadn't done anything bad yet, what use would telling the League be?

Furthermore.

Team Flare was one of the few underground organizations that had infiltrated the League. Their executive Malva was openly a journalist and a candidate for the Kalos Elite Four, destined to become the Fire-type Elite Four.

Being able to get an organization executive to Elite Four position - besides Team Rocket, only Team Flare had achieved this.

In this regard, Lysandre's ability was still worth acknowledging.

So this trip to Geosenge Town was just passing through. Johan had no intention of confronting Team Flare, so there was no pressure.

After walking for a while longer.

Rumble—rumble—

Suddenly ahead on their path, the sound of roller skates appeared. A girl wearing roller skates and protective gear, with flowing golden hair full of vitality, came into view.

"Hey! Friend, want to have a battle?"

Before they could even see her clearly, an energetic voice called out.

Hearing this, Johan's expression became somewhat strange.

How was this like... "Hey! Buddy, want some tickets?"

Although he couldn't see the person's face yet, just from this outfit... Johan recognized her.

The Shalour City Gym Leader from the Kalos region, Korrina!

As she approached and Korrina saw Johan's appearance clearly, her expression immediately froze, then became overjoyed, her eyes sparkling as she exclaimed:

"Teacher Johan?!"

Korrina and Bea could be considered rising stars among young martial artists in the Pokémon world.

For some unknown reason, the number of female martial artists in the Pokémon world had gradually increased. Veteran Fighting masters were mostly male, while young martial artists tended to be more female.

Whether it was Korrina, Bea, or Sinnoh's Maylene, or Paldea's Nemona and Brassius from Orange Academy.

Among them, Bea could be considered Johan's student, having "studied" Fighting techniques with Johan for a while.

When Bea challenged world Fighting masters, she had also competed with Korrina. The two girls could be said to... respect each other?

Moreover, Bea was shy and introverted while Korrina was cheerful and outgoing. The two complemented each other to some extent.

"It really is Teacher Johan!"

Confirming Johan's identity, Korrina skated forward quickly, her face flushed either from excitement or the skating.

"Uh..."

Faced with such enthusiastic Korrina, Johan didn't know what to say for a moment, only nodding:

"...Hello, Korrina."

Another humanoid female Machamp...

Though Korrina was a bit better than Bea, not as exaggerated.

"Teacher Johan, you know me?"

Swoosh—

At the same time, a Lucario quickly moved through the forest, following behind Korrina. When she stopped, it also landed beside her.

When Lucario looked toward Johan...

"Lu-Lucario?" Korrina's Lucario's eyes widened slightly.

Such... such strong aura!

How could one person have such powerful aura?

This was the first time Lucario had seen a human with even more exaggerated aura than itself.

Noticing Lucario's expression change, Korrina looked puzzled.

"Lucario!"

Lucario shook its head, looking at Johan with more respect.

Only Pokémon with aura understood how difficult aura was to train. For a human to possess such powerful aura, they must be an remarkable aura master or Fighting master.

Actually, Johan really wanted to say training aura?

Wasn't it just... feeding the Rainbow Wing daily?

Recently there was a new "project" - also feeding the Wheel of Time.

Facing Korrina's question, Johan could only say: "Bea mentioned you."

He wasn't sure if Korrina had become Shalour Gym's Leader yet.

"Bea!"

Hearing Bea's name, Korrina's expression immediately became even more energetic, then showed curiosity.

"What did she say about me?"

Johan and Bea weren't completely out of contact.

Since Bea had worked for him for a while (crossed out) "trained" with him for a while, she went to challenge Fighting masters around the world.

They talked on the phone periodically, mainly Bea calling Johan to report on her studies and challenges.

She had indeed mentioned meeting Korrina in the Kalos region.

In Bea's words, roughly...

"An enthusiastic girl."

"Really? Really?"

Hearing this, Korrina raised both hands and laughed loudly: "Hahaha—"

Although he didn't know what she was laughing about... for some reason, Johan faintly saw Flint's shadow in Korrina.

"Teacher Johan!"

Suddenly, Korrina shouted again, her eyes hopeful: "Can I become your disciple? Please teach me Fighting techniques and Mega Evolution!"

Become a disciple?

This wasn't like being a school teacher taking students.

To take students, first you had to have something to teach them.

What if he got thrown with an over-shoulder throw? How could he teach anything?

As for Bea, strictly speaking, Johan was only Bea's teacher, not her master.

"Ahem." Johan coughed lightly. "I don't have plans to take disciples right now."

"Is that so..."

Korrina's head drooped, looking very disappointed.

Her family could be said to be the first in the entire Pokémon world to master Mega Evolution power. Before Mega Evolution was made public, people in Korrina's family already knew how to use Mega Evolution.

However, at that time they thought Mega Evolution was a power that Fighting masters and Pokémon mastered together after training to a certain level, rather than an ability that could be widely promoted.

In such a family, Korrina still couldn't master Mega Evolution with her partner Lucario.

For this, Korrina had been working hard training. Challenging trainers from various places on the road was her self-imposed training plan.

Just as Johan was thinking whether to comfort Korrina, she immediately perked up again.

"Then please battle me, Teacher Johan!"

Korrina clenched her fists, issuing another battle invitation.

In her view, if she could demonstrate her strength, perhaps she could earn Teacher Johan's recognition!

Johan rubbed his temples with some headache.

Another battle...

Battling Korrina with Gengar and the others seemed like bullying. Sending Larvitar... Larvitar had been battling quite frequently lately, its level wasn't low anymore.

"Yoji?"

Larvitar was chewing when it saw Lucario looking over. It somehow dug out another diamond and offered it.

Want some?

"Lu-Lucario?"

Lucario had been wondering who was making those "crunch crunch" sounds. So it was Larvitar eating something. But when it saw the diamond Larvitar offered, its expression froze.

A... diamond?

Eating it raw?

"Lucario! Lucario!"

Lucario waved its hands repeatedly.

No! Thank... thank you...

"Yoji..."

Larvitar didn't continue being polite, opening its mouth to toss the diamond in and chew again.

Crunch—crunch—

Lucario: "..."

Really treating it like candy?

Those teeth...

One bite would break hands and feet, right?

Beep beep—

"There's a call, Rotom!"

Suddenly, Rotom-Dex flew out of Johan's pocket holding a phone.

Hearing this, Johan immediately felt relieved, saying to Korrina: "Sorry, I need to take this call."

"Oh, okay!" Korrina waited obediently to the side.

Pressing the answer button.

"Teacher Johan, the exercise location is Orrans Forest." Officer Jenny's voice came through the phone.

Orrans Forest?

Where was that?

Johan looked at Rotom, indicating it should search.

In every region, there were numerous forests, but Johan couldn't remember every one.

He only knew the famous ones, like Viridian Forest and Kalos region's Santalune Forest.

However, Rotom quickly found it on the map.

"Orrans Forest, located in the northwest corner of the Kalos region, between Cyllage City and Laverre City, near the ocean. Famous attractions include the Ring Waterfall. Active Pokémon include Fletchling, Pangoro, Aromatisse..."

"Alright, I understand." Johan said to Officer Jenny on the phone.

After hanging up, Johan looked at Korrina again with an apologetic expression.

"Sorry Korrina, I have some business to handle. Could we... postpone the battle?"

Johan used the "delay" strategy.

When Bea came someday, he'd let Bea battle Korrina.

A duel between two humanoid female Machamps should be quite interesting.

"Okay!"

Korrina didn't show disappointment again, instead nodding vigorously.

But when Johan was about to leave, Korrina followed closely behind him.

"You're..."

"Orrans Forest! I know where that is. Teacher Johan, let me guide you there!" Korrina showed an energetic smile.

She hadn't heard what was said on the phone, but she heard Rotom's navigation.

After Teacher Johan finished handling his business, they could battle then!

Johan: "..."

Maybe we should just fight now...

Johan looked at Korrina, then at Diancie crouching by the roadside grass admiring flowers, then thought of Regieleki temporarily staying in the Luxury Ball.

This team...

----------

Powerstones?

# 635: New Product, Rhyhorn Cart (Two-in-One Chapter)

Kalos region, outside Geosenge Town.

At the plaza where Route 10 intersected with the town, several oddly-shaped jagged stones stood tall.

A young man in a small suit with silver-blue short hair stood in the plaza, looking at these stones that were considerably taller than him, feeling somewhat moved inside.

"It seems Mr. Steven is very interested in these stones."

At this moment, a man in a black suit with a lion-like hairstyle walked over with a gentle smile.

Beside him was a girl wearing a wide-brimmed round hat and a white dress, with a graceful figure.

Steven turned around, showing no surprise at seeing the man and woman, and greeted them with a smile:

"Representative Lysandre, Miss Diantha."

Then he looked back at the stones in front of him, saying softly:

"I'm just interested in different stones."

He gently raised his hand, slowly placing it on one of the stone pillars. The smile on his face gradually faded, replaced by a slightly furrowed brow.

"They..."

"What's wrong?" Diantha adjusted her hat and asked.

Steven shook his head, let out a light sigh, and smiled again. "Maybe it's just my imagination. I always feel... these stones carry a kind of 'heaviness.'"

"Heaviness?" Diantha didn't understand.

She couldn't comprehend Steven's ability to "read" things from stones.

However, Lysandre's eyes flashed slightly when he heard Steven say this.

"Speaking of which, why would Miss Diantha have time to come to Geosenge Town?" Steven changed the topic.

Hearing this, Diantha smiled slightly.

"I happened to be filming nearby. The little pastries at Geosenge Town's Ocean Snow Hotel are quite famous."

Balancing filming work with some League duties kept Diantha quite busy.

However, taking time out of her busy schedule to eat her favorite foods was one of Diantha's small pleasures.

Like many participants in the "Youth Master World Championship," Diantha had already become a candidate for the Kalos Elite Four.

Actually, in some ways, Diantha and Steven were quite similar.

In Hoenn, Steven could basically guarantee the Champion position due to his outstanding strength and talent, plus being backed by Devon Corporation, as long as Teacher Johan didn't suddenly develop "ambition."

In the Kalos region, Diantha was the same, except she was backed by Lysandre Labs, through her friendship with Lysandre.

However, Steven also had Teacher Johan's backing, while Diantha had Professor Sycamore.

"Mr. Steven, the items your company requested are all ready." Lysandre also spoke up.

"Thank you for the trouble." Steven bowed slightly, took another look at the stones, gave a simple farewell, and walked toward the town.

Devon Corporation had been cooperating with Geosenge Town for a long time. Starting from Steven's great-grandfather, Joseph Stone's grandfather's generation, they had gradually been cooperating with Geosenge Town.

It could be said that Devon Corporation's current massive scale owed much to Geosenge Town as a key component.

After Lysandre Labs gradually took over Geosenge Town's mineral share, Devon Corporation also had considerable cooperation with Lysandre Labs.

After Steven left, Diantha looked at Lysandre with a slight frown:

"You seem reluctant to let Steven stay here long?"

Others might not notice, but as Lysandre's good friend, Diantha could see some of Lysandre's thoughts.

To this, Lysandre remained noncommittal.

After a while, Diantha sighed softly.

Lysandre had changed.

He was gradually becoming someone she felt somewhat unfamiliar with.

She always had a feeling... that Lysandre seemed to be planning and preparing something, but she could never put her finger on it.

"Teacher Johan has come to Kalos." Diantha said.

Lysandre nodded.

Teacher Johan obtaining the "Duke" title at the Battle Chateau still had some influence in the Kalos region.

Looking at her old friend, Diantha said kindly:

"If you have time, meet with Teacher Johan."

After Lysandre's last meeting with Johan, Diantha could sense from his expressions and words that he held considerable approval for Teacher Johan.

Although there hadn't been much communication since, but...

"I definitely want to meet him." Lysandre showed a smile.

Lysandre's first impression of Johan was quite good. When they first met... they had gotten along well.

This might be someone he could win over, Lysandre thought.

Changing the world was destined to be a path full of thorns. If he could find more like-minded people on this path... that would undoubtedly be fortunate.

However, exactly how things would go depended on this meeting.

According to the news, he should be arriving at Geosenge Town soon, right?

"So delicious!"

Korrina held a piece of cream cake, with cream on her lips, unable to help crying out in shock, showing an expression of both surprise and happiness.

Her long hair hanging behind her head like bananas trembled.

Korrina, who had been "persistently following," never expected that "mixing" with the team would let her mooch food, and she certainly hadn't expected Teacher Johan's cake to be so delicious.

"Bea would definitely like this more."

Bea liked eating cake but often didn't dare eat it to maintain her figure and because she cared about others' opinions, frequently wanting to eat but not daring to.

"Ka-kaah~~"

Gengar had its arm around Korrina's Lucario's shoulder, telling it about other Lucario.

For example, the Lucario from Cameran Palace, and also Cynthia's Lucario - they were all its good brothers.

"Lucario..."

Korrina's Lucario immediately felt pressure, listening while nodding seriously.

"Yoji?"

Larvitar handed Diancie a diamond.

Want some?

"No, no thank you." Looking at the diamond, Diancie waved its hands repeatedly.

It was almost sick of diamonds back in the Diamond Kingdom, and besides, the diamonds in Larvitar's hand weren't even as high quality as those in the Diamond Kingdom.

More importantly...

Not everyone could have teeth good enough to eat diamonds like candy like Larvitar.

Even as princess of the Diamond Kingdom, if it wanted to digest a diamond, it would take... at least quite a while, and it mostly fed on other minerals.

Moreover, compared to diamonds and minerals... Diancie felt that Johan's energy cubes and those cakes and snacks were more tempting.

Larvitar didn't insist, tossing the diamond in its mouth. There was still a small pile beside it to eat slowly, something to pick at.

"Teacher Johan."

At this time, Korrina skated over to Johan's side and asked quietly: "I didn't notice earlier, but that pink Pokémon that looks like a princess - what Pokémon is that?"

Although she was from Kalos, Korrina had never seen Diancie.

You're just noticing now? Johan shook his head.

"Diancie, princess of the Diamond Kingdom, basically... a variant of Carbink."

"Carbink?"

Korrina looked at Diancie again. It did indeed have some Carbink features, but...

"...Variant, the difference is quite big..."

Johan smiled without explaining further.

"Little Cucumber, can you and Lucario perform Mega Evolution now?" He changed the topic.

"Little Cucumber?"

"Cough cough, well, got used to calling you that. Korrina."

"Oh..."

"Mega Evolution, I don't know either..." Korrina shook her head. "Grandpa says we're not ready yet."

She hadn't gotten Lucario's Mega Stone yet.

Another pair who haven't mastered their own power, Johan thought, involuntarily looking at Diancie.

Diancie was like this, and Korrina with her Lucario were the same.

Actually, in Johan's view, if Korrina got Lucario's Mega Stone, she and Lucario should be able to successfully Mega Evolve.

The difference was just how long they could maintain it and how much pressure Korrina would need to bear.

As a "Mega Evolution family," Korrina's grandfather Gurkinn definitely had different requirements for Mega Evolution than ordinary trainers.

Rustle rustle rustle—

The bushes lightly swayed.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar raised its head, locking onto the source of the disturbance. It looked toward Johan, but saw Johan also looking at it and slightly shaking his head.

Seeing this, Gengar immediately understood and continued joking around with Lucario.

For some reason, Lucario felt very cold staying near Gengar, feeling its hands and feet were freezing.

Just then.

Rumble rumble—

The previous subtle sounds immediately became heavy footsteps and rumbling, coming from behind Diancie!

Diancie, who had been eating energy cubes, finally reacted, turning around sharply to see...

"Roar!!"

A Rhyperior with scars on its face, fierce and menacing, wearing gray heavy armor, rushed out from the bushes behind it.

Following the Rhyperior were seven or eight quite robust-looking Rhyhorn!

This was a wild Rhyhorn herd!

As princess of the Diamond Kingdom, Diancie had never seen such a scene. Especially facing the Rhyperior's ferocious face, it froze in place, dropping the energy cube in its hand.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar, sitting not far away, reacted quickly.

Actually, when the ground had started shaking earlier, Larvitar had already felt it, but it thought it was an earthquake and didn't pay much attention.

"It's the Rhyhorn herd near Geosenge Town!" Korrina shouted.

Geosenge Town, famous for its stones, was surrounded by forests and large and small stone piles and stone forests, home to many Rock and Ground-type Pokémon.

For example, Onix, Geodude, Rhyhorn, Diggersby, and so on. It was even said that someone had once caught the pseudo-legendary Gible here.

Moreover, the Kalos region was known for horse and rhino racing. Like Serena's mother from the anime "Pokémon XY," she was an excellent Rhyhorn rider, and Serena could also manage it, if not expertly.

Therefore, many people came to the area around Geosenge Town to try catching Rhyhorn. Some succeeded, but more failed.

On one hand, the excellent natural environment and minerals around Geosenge Town made the local Rhyhorn grow quite well with considerable strength.

Plus, frequent battles from capture attempts naturally raised their experience and levels.

On the other hand, the Rhyhorn around Geosenge Town lived in large and small herds.

Like Ash catching Tauros, when facing a herd, either you catch one... or you catch a group, or don't catch any at all.

Thus, gradually, the Rhyhorn herds around Geosenge Town became targets that ordinary trainers didn't dare provoke.

This group of Rhyhorn and the leading Rhyperior appeared naturally because they smelled food.

The energy cubes Diancie was eating were the same ones Johan usually fed Larvitar, quite tempting to Rock and Ground-type Pokémon.

Facing the fierce Rhyperior, Diancie instinctively stepped back.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar was much smaller than Diancie, and compared to Rhyperior it was tiny, but it showed no weakness, instead coming in front of Diancie.

"Diancie."

At this moment, Johan spoke up.

"Hm?"

Diancie instinctively looked over, hearing Johan say:

"Diamond Storm!"

Diamond Storm?

Hearing Johan's words, Diancie slowly reacted.

It seemed like it could battle?

Right, it could battle too!

Diancie's expression gradually became serious. Pink light appeared on its hands, then it raised them. A storm like pink airflow spread from its hands in a spiral pattern, quite brilliant with pink crystalline sparkles.

But...

Even Korrina could clearly feel that Diancie's reaction speed, this move's release speed...

Was this really Teacher Johan's Pokémon?

However...

This move was truly beautiful.

She initially thought it was dust, but careful observation revealed it was all crystalline pink diamonds!

Actually using rare pink diamonds to create a storm?

No wonder this move was called Diamond Storm...

Moreover, Korrina was also puzzled. Diancie's move execution looked wrong everywhere, but the move's power wasn't weak!

But it was still too slow.

The fierce-faced Rhyperior had already attacked first, its horn spinning with a buzzing sound, glowing earth-yellow - clearly the Ground-type move Horn Drill!

But Diancie's reaction was slow, though Larvitar's wasn't.

The little one blocked in front of Diancie, facing the charging Horn Drill...

Bang!!

The ground exploded as Larvitar leaped up, then clapped its palms together, actually catching Rhyperior's horn in its palms!

Seeing this scene, Korrina's eyes widened.

Catching a blade with bare hands?

Worthy of a Fighting master's Pokémon!

However, this Rhyperior's strength really wasn't bad. Larvitar's small body and small palms really couldn't stop Rhyperior's Horn Drill.

Sizzle sizzle sizzle—

The ridged horn kept grinding against Larvitar's palms, making harsh, tooth-aching sounds.

"Roar!!"

Seeing a little one dare use its hands to grab its horn, Rhyperior felt looked down upon, roaring and using full force.

"Yoji?"

When Larvitar found its hands not only couldn't hold the rapidly spinning horn but were getting hot and painful from the friction, it also got serious, "growling" and biting down directly.

Crack!!

The sudden sound made Rhyperior stop moving, its expression becoming somewhat dazed.

Its, its horn... cracked?!

Lucario sitting next to Gengar shivered, gently rubbing the fur on its arms that was showing signs of standing up.

It really could bite through...

What kind of teeth were those?!

Rhyperior and the Rhyhorn behind it all froze.

You had to know, Rhyperior and Rhyhorn had "horn" in their names, showing how important horns were to them - this was their hardest body part!

"Yoji!"

After biting through Rhyperior's Horn Drill, Larvitar immediately released its mouth and landed.

Bang!

The ground kicked up dust.

Then Diancie's Diamond Storm swept over, carefully avoiding Larvitar and striking Rhyperior.

Boom—

Rhyperior was sent flying.

The pink crystalline diamonds turned to dust and dispersed.

"It worked!" Diancie cried out in delight.

It looked down at its hands.

It never expected... it could use moves with such power?

On Diancie's body, especially those pink diamonds, a faint glow appeared.

[Diamond Storm: Creates a storm of diamonds to deal damage, with a chance to greatly increase the user's Defense.]

Diancie's Defense +2!

"Roar!!"

Seeing their leader sent flying, the Rhyhorn immediately became angry. Following the middle one's roar, all the Rhyhorn lowered their heads and kept kicking with their hind feet.

Charge!!

Rumble rumble—

A group of Rhyhorn charged forward, the momentum even greater than Rhyperior's Horn Drill.

Diancie showed panic again.

But Johan's calm voice came again, seeming to echo in its heart, bringing comfort and reassurance, significantly reducing Diancie's panic.

"Diancie, Reflect."

"Larvitar... smash them."

"O-okay..."

Diancie pressed its lips together, reacting obviously faster than the first time. As its hands moved, a transparent wall appeared in front of it and Larvitar.

Larvitar was undoubtedly much more natural than Diancie, not even needing Johan's precise commands to know what to do.

It first lifted a foot and stomped heavily.

Rumble!!

The ground immediately cracked, and two charging Rhyhorn fell into the fissure.

Then it used the stomping's recoil to leap up, grabbing a bounced rock and hurling it at another Rhyhorn.

Boom!!

The rock shattered, the Rhyhorn became dizzy and fell over with spiraling eyes.

Finally, it stood among several Rhyhorn, grinning happily.

"Yoji! (ˊ〇ˋ*)"

Come at me together!

Rumble rumble—

Dust billowed.

Diancie stood to the side, pink eyes showing an expression that had never appeared in its life as a princess.

This was... battles between Pokémon?

This was... my power?

"Diancie, Diamond Storm to finish."

"Yes!"

This time Diancie's answer was decisive. It immediately raised both hands, and the storm of pink diamonds swept out once more...

"Yoji!"

Larvitar rode on Rhyperior's head, one hand grabbing its ear, the other raised in a fist, about to strike down.

Submit or not?!

"Roar..."

Rhyperior wanted to cry.

Big brother.

Little master.

Can't you understand Pokémon language?

I've already shouted "I submit, I submit" no less than seven or eight times.

My horn was almost bitten off, and including myself, the entire Rhyhorn herd was beaten down. How could I not submit?

This time we provoked the wrong targets...

"Yoji?!"

Submit or not?!

Larvitar asked again, its clenched fist already falling.

At this crucial moment, Rhyperior seemed to finally "understand," immediately producing a mineral from somewhere, its surface glowing slightly, obviously rich in minerals.

Sure enough, seeing this mineral, Larvitar immediately stopped and happily took the mineral, jumping down from Rhyperior's head.

"Yoji~"

Good that you submit.

Rhyperior: "..."

Under Larvitar's "tyranny," Rhyperior and the Rhyhorn all "submitted."

"This is part of your power." Johan walked to Diancie, who was looking down at its hands, saying gently.

"My... part of my power?"

Diancie clenched its palms, looking up at Johan, seeing his slight smile.

"To master your own power, you first need to understand what 'yourself' is, who you are."

These words left Diancie somewhat confused.

Johan didn't say more.

Diancie had been protected too well by the Diamond Kingdom, yet bore so-called responsibility and mission.

Perhaps even now it didn't know whether it was working hard for the Diamond Kingdom or to prove itself.

If you can't even recognize yourself clearly, how can you control yourself?

"Thank you..." Diancie said seriously.

It felt that Johan was helping it "master its own power," making it grateful from the heart.

"I... I don't have anything on me..."

Saying this, Diancie pressed its palms together, condensing a pink diamond about half a fist's size, looking into Johan's eyes:

"Although this diamond will disperse soon, but... I can only use this to show my thanks for now..."

Johan didn't mind, taking the diamond and putting it in his pocket before it dispersed.

Anyway, what he was after were the small Carbink mineral veins... cough cough, he was someone who helped others without expecting reward.

Korrina on the side finally understood.

So Diancie wasn't Teacher Johan's Pokémon, but like herself, came seeking help and training.

Then... could she also get some suitable training opportunities to better meet the Mega Evolution requirements for herself and Lucario?

Korrina looked at Lucario.

Only to see...

Lucario was shivering.

Gengar was really freaking cold...

"Yoji!"

Larvitar wore sunglasses, riding on Rhyperior's head, holding a branch from the Tree of Beginning and pointing forward.

Setting aside the props, it really had some "general" presence.

Rhyperior grimaced as it ran, with several Rhyhorn beside it.

On Rhyperior and several Rhyhorn were tied ropes connecting to a wooden cart behind.

Don't say.

This Rhyhorn cart... was actually pretty fast.

And the cart Tinkaton built actually had some "off-road" capability, not too bumpy.

On the cart sat Johan, Korrina, Gengar, Lucario, Diancie...

Korrina sat at the front, full of excitement.

She was obviously experiencing this kind of "transportation" for the first time, feeling... it was much more fun than roller skating.

Originally Johan planned to rent an off-road vehicle in Geosenge Town.

But since the Rhyperior herd delivered themselves, shouldn't he make good use of them?

Thus the "Rhyhorn Cart" was born - pure physical power, pollution-free, cost-free, and fast.

Traveling on the road, occasionally a car would pass, and people in the cars would inevitably cast envious glances.

Cars were common, but Rhyhorn carts weren't.

Moreover, this group of obviously strong Rhyhorn running together on the road was quite impressive.

So Johan simply didn't enter Geosenge Town, heading directly toward Orrans Forest.

They traveled with stops and starts, resting and eating.

Not particularly rushing, stopping to rest and admire unique scenery when they saw it.

Occasionally encountering some aggressive wild Pokémon, most would be taught to behave, no, taught to be well-behaved Pokémon.

This made the Rhyhorn quite "indignant" - why did other Pokémon only get beaten for misbehaving, while they had to pull carts for their mistakes?

But when Johan used aura to massage their tired bodies in the evening and they ate delicious energy cube food, the Rhyhorn's attitudes immediately changed, only wanting to say...

Pulling carts was truly wonderful.

This made the Rhyhorn and Rhyperior not only lose their resistance but actually hope to pull for longer.

Being tired was real, but the enjoyment was also real.

However, the journey the Rhyhorn hoped for ended after two days.

With their help, Johan successfully reached Orrans Forest and met Officer Jenny and the League police.

"Teacher Johan?"

When the Officer Jenny in charge of liaison saw the "Rhyhorn Cart," her mouth gaped, looking stunned.

This was possible too?

"Yoji~"

Larvitar gently patted Rhyperior's head, and they slowly stopped.

After two days together, Rhyperior and the Rhyhorn found that Larvitar was actually quite easy to get along with.

Being Ground and Rock-type Pokémon, their relationship had gotten much closer.

The League police exercise content was quite rich - Pokémon battles, Pokémon racing, scent tracking, one-against-many and many-against-few tactical drills, etc.

Not only Officer Jennys from Kalos, but also from Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh and other regions.

Being surrounded by a group of Officer Jennys asking for autographs, that scene really...

In the end, Johan couldn't tell which Officer Jenny was which.

This kind of thing probably only Brock could manage.

Johan had once seen a post saying you could distinguish Officer Jennys by skirt length, but...

What the hell skirt length - couldn't keep staring at Officer Jennys' skirts, right?

"Teacher Johan." An older Officer Jenny wearing the "Chief Inspector" rank called him over.

This one was the exercise's head supervisor.

The Chief Inspector rank also indicated she was from the Alliance Headquarters' Jenny higher-ups.

"Officer Jenny."

Johan nodded in greeting, since this was one of the few he could recognize.

She took out a box, smiling: "This is an internal reward for arresting two master thieves."

Internal reward?

Johan opened the box with some surprise - inside were actually two Rare Candies!

This stuff was scarce. Even Hoenn League headquarters didn't have many, and Johan had already taken two last time.

Something money couldn't buy.

Others getting Rare Candies, this kind of top-tier item, would probably immediately feed them to their Pokémon.

But for Johan, now he had sugar for cooking - perfect for braising pork. These Rare Candies were much better than rock sugar.

"By the way, Officer Jenny, although I was invited here, I still don't know what I should do in this exercise?" Johan couldn't help asking.

No one had told him what to do.

"You don't need to do anything." Officer Jenny said.

"Don't need to?" Johan was puzzled.

The older Officer Jenny smiled: "Teacher Johan, just by coming, those young Officer Jennys became much more motivated. That's the greatest help to the exercise."

Johan awkwardly touched his nose.

So he'd become a mascot?

Like the atmosphere-boosting mascot at sports events?

"Of course, if during the exercise Teacher Johan notices any shortcomings, we hope you could point them out."

The older Officer Jenny said seriously: "More sweat in peacetime training and exercises means less blood and fewer losses when facing real incidents."

Johan quite respected the Officer Jennys who worked diligently to protect each region.

Just this dedication deserved respect.

"If..." the older Officer Jenny showed some hesitation.

Seeing this, Johan said: "Officer Jenny, please speak directly if there's something."

"Ahem, it's like this..."

After choosing her words, the older Officer Jenny continued: "If possible, of course only if conditions allow, could Teacher Johan help the Officer Jennys and League police adapt to handling sudden legendary and mythical Pokémon incidents?"

"Hm?"

"Recently, legendary and mythical Pokémon incidents have been frequent in various regions, but whether Officer Jennys or League police lack experience in handling legendary Pokémon - we could even say we have none. And Teacher Johan, you..."

Are famously the "Legendary Pokémon Man."

The older Officer Jenny didn't say this last part.

Johan's expression became somewhat strange.

Good grief.

This was the real "objective," right?

Have the Officer Jennys adapt to handling legendary Pokémon situations?

The Pokémon world didn't have that many legendary Pokémon...

Besides.

Legendary Pokémon weren't something Johan could summon at will. What, call legendary Pokémon from other regions to fly over?

They'd definitely give him a talking-to.

Eh?

Wait.

Johan suddenly remembered.

He actually did have a suitable candidate on him, one that had recently caused quite a stir in the Kalos region before being suppressed.

Regieleki!

The older Officer Jenny wasn't demanding or requiring, but requesting - requesting assistance under suitable conditions.

Of course, if it wasn't appropriate, she wouldn't say anything and would completely understand.

After all, this was a legendary Pokémon, not some random cat or dog that could be casually brought for exercises.

"Well..."

Johan pressed his cap brim, looking at the older Officer Jenny and asking: "Would you... provide meals for the legendary Pokémon?"

Didn't he find his reimbursement target?

"Eh?"

# 636: You're the Kind of Friend I Approve Of! (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Regi—!!"

The immensely massive Regieleki stood like a thunder-formed giant in the vast forest.

In the cloud-covered sky, golden lightning bolts resembled rolling golden dragons. Any one that fell could cause tremendous destruction to the surrounding forest.

But they just wouldn't fall.

"Eleki!!"

Roar after roar that sounded angry echoed through the woods.

If someone looked carefully at this moment, they would discover that on the shoulder of the giant-like massive Regieleki sat a Gengar wearing sunglasses, with electrical arcs jumping from Regieleki's body reflecting light on its sunglasses.

"Ka-kaah~"

As Regieleki moved its feet, Gengar instinctively reached out to steady itself, but when its hand made contact with Regieleki...

Crackle crackle—

Electrical current flashed.

"Ka-kaah! o(TヘTo)"

Gengar immediately let go, vigorously "huffing and puffing," then tugged at the Spirit World cloth it was sitting on to prevent its bottom from suffering the same fate.

It loudly called out to Regieleki several times.

"Regi?"

The giant Regieleki paused, looking at the surrounding Officer Jennys, League police, and their Pokémon, scratching its head.

That's right.

The exercise was in progress.

But facing the massive and powerful Electric Pillar Regieleki, the Officer Jennys didn't have many good methods to resolve the situation.

However, when actually encountering legendary Pokémon "disasters," their task wasn't to directly confront the legendary Pokémon, but to evacuate civilians as quickly as possible to reduce casualties while trying to slow the legendary Pokémon's advance.

Everything was proceeding in an orderly fashion.

And under Gengar's "guidance," Regieleki was slowly mastering acting techniques.

At the same time.

In the vast Orrans Forest, an extremely tall man in tattered clothes emerged from a dilapidated cave, chewing on a piece of jerky that had been stored for who knows how long, looking up toward the thunder giant in the forest.

Seeing that towering Electric Pillar, the man's expression immediately became serious.

Without a word, he grabbed all his belongings - a tattered cloth bag - and strode quickly toward Regieleki's direction.

During this time, several wild Fletchling did take notice of the jerky in the man's mouth and wanted to approach to "share," but they quickly fled after flying only halfway.

The reason was simple - the slovenly man emanated a smell of decay and ruin. Having not bathed for who knows how long, he naturally carried an odor comparable to Gloom.

However, at this moment, the man's eyes held only that massive Regieleki, which was continuously "destroying."

"Why would the ancient Thunder Giant appear here?"

Under his disheveled grayish-silver hair, the man's gaze was resolute and serious.

"We really can summon legendary Pokémon..." The older Officer Jenny looked at Regieleki, her inner surprise lasting a long time.

Although she'd already heard about this from other Officer Jennys, seeing Regieleki actually cooperating with the exercise still inevitably shocked the older Officer Jenny.

Johan smiled helplessly.

You're the one who wanted legendary Pokémon to assist with the exercise, and you're also the one surprised by the legendary Pokémon. What do you want?

"I promised to send it back, but don't have time now, so... it will stay with me for a while." Johan said.

Anyway, the League police would reimburse Regieleki's food expenses, so he wasn't in a hurry now.

Moreover...

To be honest, Regieleki wasn't that shocking a legendary Pokémon.

Battle Frontier's Pyramid King Brandon still owned three legendary titans, though in Johan's view, those three might have been made from Regigigas's "scraps."

Cough...

Besides.

Among the Joy family, renowned alongside the Jenny family, wasn't there a Joy who had tamed a Latias?

The older Officer Jenny nodded. She didn't yet know how exaggerated Regieleki's "appetite" was, so she remained relatively calm.

"However, for the young Officer Jennys, the pressure of facing legendary Pokémon is still great." the older Officer Jenny said.

Although the Officer Jennys appeared to be acting in an orderly manner, the older Officer Jenny still noticed many areas where they were inadequate or incorrect.

These were inevitable distortions or oversights caused by pressure.

This was also why exercises were necessary.

Discovering problems early meant when they actually encountered situations, the League and residents would suffer fewer losses.

"That's about enough." the older Officer Jenny said.

The "legendary Pokémon disaster" exercise had lasted nearly half an hour. Any longer... would be unnecessary.

Johan nodded, just about to call off Gengar and Regieleki, when he suddenly saw...

A Golurk flew out from the nearby forest, its feet like jet engines, carrying powerful Ground-type energy as it charged directly at Regieleki.

"Ka-kaah?"

"Regi?"

Seeing the suddenly appearing Golurk, both Regieleki and Gengar sitting on its shoulder were stunned.

What was this?

The exercise plan they'd discussed earlier didn't include this...

The main content of the exercise was evacuation and guidance, not direct combat. This Golurk was...

However, Gengar and Regieleki could somewhat sense this Golurk's strength - not weak!

"Ka-kaah..." Gengar rubbed its round chin.

Could they have temporarily changed the exercise plan to include direct confrontation?

Gengar and Regieleki stared at each other as the Golurk was about to reach them. Johan's voice finally echoed in their minds.

"It's an enemy!"

This wasn't part of the exercise.

Actually, when they saw the Golurk appear, both Johan and the older Officer Jenny were somewhat surprised. After quickly exchanging information, they confirmed... this Golurk wasn't one of the Officer Jennys' or League police's Pokémon.

Since it was attacking like this, it was undoubtedly an enemy.

"Eleki!!"

Hearing it was an enemy, Regieleki immediately became eager to fight.

During the earlier exercise, it had been holding back its power to cooperate. If not exactly frustrating, it was at least unsatisfying.

Now with a Golurk charging up, it immediately had a "target" to vent on.

Zzzt zzzt zzzt—

Countless bolts of lightning burst from Regieleki's body, forming a giant net that wrapped toward the Golurk.

As a Ground-type Pokémon, Golurk actually wasn't afraid of Electric-type moves, but the prerequisite was that Golurk had to be standing on the ground.

Charging up like this...

The massive electric cage fell, and the charging Golurk was caught in the net and smashed downward before it could even attack Regieleki.

"Go Regieleki!" Korrina cupped her hands like a megaphone and shouted loudly.

"Lucario..."

Lucario beside her looked at Korrina, then at the Golurk that had been knocked back.

This... still needed cheering?

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar stood up, put away the Spirit World cloth it had been sitting on, and dove into a rift it had torn in space.

When it reappeared, it was already in the forest shadows, searching for traces of the "enemy."

At the same time.

The Officer Jennys also led teams into the woods to search for the culprit who had "disrupted" the exercise.

And that "culprit" was currently... staring at Diancie, who was wandering in the forest to see if she could encounter Xerneas.

"You are..."

Diancie, holding a bouquet of flowers, looked at the extremely burly but shabbily dressed man in front of her, tilting her head with curiosity.

When the man saw Diancie, his expression became slightly dazed.

The holy and beautiful Diancie holding flowers, combined with those brilliant crystalline pink diamonds, was like a sacred existence. Especially the gentle smile on its face made the man... involuntarily recall his former partner.

However, soon enough.

Gengar appeared first beside the man. Looking at the shabby man and smelling an odor comparable to Gloom, it didn't pay much attention. It was just somewhat curious - Gengar faintly sensed the "scent of history" from him.

"Ka-kaah?"

Then the Officer Jennys surrounded them.

Seeing so many people suddenly appear, the man instinctively lowered his head.

Finally, Johan, Korrina, and the older Officer Jenny also arrived.

"So... so tall..."

Seeing the man's stature, little Korrina couldn't help exclaiming.

He was almost twice as tall as her.

When Johan saw the man, he was also somewhat shocked.

"AZ?"

Hm?

Hearing someone call his name, the man looked toward Johan with surprise.

"Regi?"

The shrunken Regieleki came to Johan's side. The Golurk that had attacked them earlier now stood like a guardian behind the man.

But despite Golurk's nearly three-meter height, standing behind the man, it was still half a head shorter.

At this point, the man - AZ, as Johan had called him - finally understood... he seemed to have misunderstood.

But he was also somewhat surprised.

The ancient Thunder Giant actually listened to this man?

"Sorry..." AZ said heavily, then picked up his cloth bag and prepared to leave with Golurk.

"Wait!"

Johan quickly called out to stop him, then turned to the older Officer Jenny and said rapidly: "Officer Jenny, this is... my friend. Let me have a few words with him. Your exercise needs to continue."

The older Officer Jenny looked at AZ somewhat strangely.

Vaguely.

She felt this burly man named "AZ" seemed familiar, but since she wasn't from the Kalos region, she couldn't remember immediately.

Plus the exercise really did need to continue, so after telling Johan to call if he needed help, she led the puzzled Officer Jennys and League police to continue the next phase of the exercise.

And AZ did indeed stay in place.

Originally, he actually hadn't planned to pay attention, especially since the other party had recognized him.

But when he heard the word "friend" from Johan's mouth, AZ found his feet wouldn't obey him.

After the Officer Jennys left, Johan walked in front of AZ, looking up at this man who was at least three meters tall, unable to help clicking his tongue.

AZ, the king of the Kalos region from three thousand years ago!

The very king who had used the Ultimate Weapon to revive his own Pokémon, not hesitating to start a massive war.

Three thousand years had passed, yet he was still alive.

This was because he'd been affected by radiation from the Ultimate Weapon, not only gaining an unknown lifespan but even having his body undergo certain changes.

Johan had originally thought AZ's infinite lifespan was impressive, but now it seemed...

Besides a seemingly endless lifespan, Johan also sensed a ghostly aura from him, with a strange feeling... like a candle that had burned out but its flame still flickered.

Was this a strange state between life and death?

Not just him - Gengar actually had the same feeling.

While Johan observed AZ, AZ was also observing him.

A young monster user... no, in this era they should be called "trainers."

In the age AZ lived in, Pokémon were more often called "monsters," dangerous but powerful creatures that were often involved when major wars broke out.

A young trainer, powerful Pokémon, enviable companionship, and... was this the Creator God's aura?

"What are they doing?" Korrina looked at the two men staring at each other but not speaking, leaning over to ask quietly.

"Lucario..."

Lucario spread its hands, indicating it didn't know either.

However, after a period of silence and mutual observation, Johan slowly said: "King AZ..."

"You know me?" AZ finally spoke again, his voice somewhat low and hoarse.

Johan smiled slightly. "With your stature, it's hard not to recognize you."

AZ was silent for a while before saying again: "I'm no longer a king. Now I'm just someone seeking redemption."

Someone seeking redemption?

Johan didn't argue, instead changing the topic: "Then Mr. AZ, if you have time, why not sit down and chat?"

AZ looked at him deeply and nodded:

"As you wish, messenger of Arceus."

Hm?

This time it was Johan who was surprised.

AZ had met Arceus?

Splash splash—

By the babbling stream.

"Cha~"

Tinkaton shouldered its hammer, "clang clang clang" showing off the chair it had just custom-made for AZ, gesturing for him to sit and try it.

"Would you prefer coffee or tea, respected King AZ, Rotom~"

Rotom had somehow learned a set of "etiquette" and asked quite politely.

Sizzle—

Ceruledge lit charcoal to start a fire, adding fresh water just drawn from the stream and placing it on the stove.

"Garruu~"

Urshifu held a hand-crank coffee grinder, "whirr whirr" turning at a steady pace, quickly grinding full coffee beans into coffee powder.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar opened its mouth and took out a box of "treasured" Energy Root tea, waiting for the water to boil.

"Draaa~~"

Dragonite set up the tent by itself today. Without Gengar's help, it actually managed quite well.

Diancie and Ninetales sat beside Johan, the two little ones quietly sharing some private conversation.

As for Regieleki, it sat with Larvitar, busy eating.

For some reason, after eating with Larvitar for a while... Regieleki felt its appetite had increased.

That was actually a good thing.

AZ took in the entire scene, especially lingering a few extra seconds on Victini, who was sitting on Johan's shoulder munching macarons with "crunch crunch" sounds. He thanked Tinkaton and sat down.

Then, under Rotom's expectant gaze, after pondering for a moment, he said: "...Tea, if possible. Thank you."

"Roger, Rotom!"

"Ka-kaah! (Д)b"

Gengar slapped the picnic table and gave AZ a thumbs up.

Hey! Good choice! I admire people like you!

Energy Root tea - one sip refreshes your mind, two sips and you'll never tire, three sips and you'll live forever, yeah!

"Coffee! I want coffee!" Korrina quickly shouted before Rotom could ask.

Tea?

She had "recklessly" chosen tea two days ago, and then... it was so bitter her mouth tasted bitter all day.

"Coming right up, Rotom!"

Rotom handled the tea, but for coffee... Johan was more used to making it himself, unless Love Ball Maid was there.

"These monsters... they get along very well with you." AZ said with a somewhat complex expression.

Johan took the hand-ground coffee powder from Urshifu, poured it into cone-shaped filter paper, and smiled: "Of course, they're all my best partners, family."

"Goka~"

Ceruledge handed over a kettle, and Johan thanked it.

"Partners, family?"

AZ's voice was low and hoarse. "Aren't they servants?"

His eyes became especially bright at this moment, even somewhat sharp.

In ancient times, precisely in the ancient times he lived in three thousand years ago, monsters were beings enslaved by humans.

Just like in ancient Michina, Pokémon called "monsters" wore restraining shackles.

Johan slowly poured water into the coffee powder, watching the brown-yellow liquid slowly drip into the cup, rising with rich coffee aroma.

He didn't look at AZ's eyes, just calmly asked back:

"Mr. AZ, this question of yours... what do you think?"

After saying this, he looked up, meeting AZ's gaze directly.

Perhaps feeling guilty, AZ avoided Johan's gaze.

In ancient times, monsters were indeed often like that, but he, AZ, was an "exception" - he had a very good relationship with his Floette.

This was also why after Floette died, AZ still wanted to use the Ultimate Weapon to revive it.

He even couldn't forgive a world that had hurt Floette, trying to use the Ultimate Weapon to destroy everything.

Although AZ didn't answer, his silence seemed to answer everything.

"King AZ, your tea, Rotom~"

Rotom brought over a cup of tea with a bitter aroma.

"Thank you." AZ thanked it again and took the tea.

Looking at the... root-like things floating in the cup, AZ felt puzzled.

What kind of tea was this?

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar raised its teacup toward him, grinning with great spirit.

Friend, let's down this cup of Energy Root tea!

Friend...

AZ looked at Gengar, who was blowing on its teacup then sipping in small mouthfuls, and imitated it.

Under Korrina's "expectant," no, gleeful gaze, AZ took a big sip.

Gulp, swallowing.

Whoosh—

Some hot air drifted from his mouth.

For some reason, his condition seemed... much more energetic, even his listless eyes became somewhat livelier.

"Good tea!" AZ nodded.

"Ka-kaah! d(○)"

A connoisseur, my friend!

Gengar was delighted.

"Eh?" Korrina was greatly shocked.

This guy... had no sense of taste?

Johan wasn't surprised.

Someone who had experienced true suffering... the bitterness of mere Energy Root tea was nothing. That's you, Gao Jin!

AZ held the teacup with both hands, looking up slightly at the clear sky, murmuring:

"This is probably what you call 'trainers,' right?"

Trainers?

Korrina looked toward Lucario beside her, and Lucario looked back.

What were trainers?

This was a... overly broad question.

AZ turned to look at Johan again. "You seem to know quite a bit about me?"

Korrina perked up her ears, as if smelling "gossip."

Johan shrugged. "Pokémon and trainers - why use the word 'forgiveness' between them?"

"Hm?" AZ didn't understand.

Johan held his coffee, taking a sip, and like AZ, put both hands on his elbows resting on his knees, leaning forward slightly. Victini immediately seized the "opportunity," treating his back like a slide and "vii" sliding down.

"Since they're partners who trust each other, it understands why you did what you did, and you understand why it disappeared..."

"Rather than saying it forgives you, shouldn't it be when will Mr. AZ forgive yourself?"

After saying this, Johan quickly leaned back against his chair.

He had to admit, AZ really did smell pretty strong.

"Forgive... myself?" AZ was stunned, repeating in a low voice.

Johan shook his head.

Rather than saying Floette forgave AZ, it was more like Floette forgiving itself, because it was its death that brought about AZ's series of "revenge" actions.

At the same time, it was also AZ forgiving himself - he had caused too many casualties for one person, one Pokémon.

For a moment.

Only the sounds of the little ones playing and AZ drinking tea and Johan drinking coffee remained nearby.

After a while longer.

AZ stood up, looking at Johan seriously: "Thank you, messenger of Arceus."

After saying this, he picked up his cloth bag.

"Mr. AZ, why not have dinner together? As a friend's invitation." Johan said.

AZ paused.

"Alright."

"However... before that, have you considered taking a bath?"

"Eh?"

"Long, long ago, there was a man and a Pokémon who loved each other."

"War broke out, and the man's beloved Pokémon was used in the war. Years passed, and he only received a small box."

"The man wanted his Pokémon to be revived, no matter what, no matter how. The man created a machine..."

Under Korrina's persistent questioning, Johan briefly told some of AZ's story.

Not just Korrina - the little ones also gathered around and heard the entire story.

"I see... so that's how it is..."

After hearing it, Korrina's expression was somewhat dazed.

This was what trainers were, this was humans and Pokémon?

Although what AZ did was infuriating, AZ's methods, his way of reviving Floette, made Korrina admire him.

For some reason.

The previously cheerful Korrina suddenly had a moment of enlightenment.

So this was what "trainers" really were?

This time she didn't look at Lucario, and Lucario didn't look at her, but at this moment, the trainer and Pokémon's hearts produced a strange resonance.

Perhaps this was the bond forged between trainers and Pokémon?

Seeing the deeply moved Korrina and Lucario, Johan smiled.

This story wasn't told for nothing - Korrina and her Lucario sometimes might just lack that little bit, just that little bit.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar floating behind Johan rarely wasn't being mischievous, even its expression showing some seriousness and earnestness.

After hearing Johan's account, Gengar's form flickered slightly, and without anyone noticing, it silently drifted toward the other side of the forest.

At sunset, the dim yellow sunlight filtered through thin clouds, bringing scattered gold to the river surface.

The burly AZ sat in the river, leaning against rocks on the shore, letting the water wash over his body while repeatedly thinking about Johan's earlier words.

"Rather than waiting for Floette's forgiveness, it's more about forgiving myself?"

Buzz—

AZ's shadow in the sunset rippled with black mist as a serious-faced Gengar slowly floated out.

"It's you?"

Seeing Gengar, AZ was somewhat surprised.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar handed over a cup of Energy Root tea and sat on the rock AZ was leaning against.

"Thank you." After taking it, AZ still looked at Gengar with some puzzlement.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar didn't look at AZ, just watching the flowing water in front of them, speaking softly.

I heard Johan say you once revived your deceased Pokémon?

Strangely, AZ could understand Gengar's words.

He nodded. "Indeed."

Whoosh—

Suddenly, black mist surged from Gengar's body as it turned sharply to look at AZ, speaking with extreme seriousness:

"Ka-kaah!"

Teach me!

"Hm?" AZ frowned.

Only someone who had used the "Ultimate Weapon" knew how terrifying that thing truly was. That destructive power should absolutely not be mastered by anyone with impure intentions, human or Pokémon.

He hadn't expected Gengar to want to learn to use the "Ultimate Weapon"...

"What do you want to do?" AZ asked sternly.

Had he misjudged Johan, misjudged Arceus's messenger?

"Ka-kaah!"

Under AZ's gaze, Gengar clinked its teacup lightly against AZ's, then drained it in one gulp, roughly wiping its mouth.

Those who didn't know might think it was drinking alcohol instead of tea.

Nothing much! I'm just preparing for Johan's future!

AZ was stunned.

Preparing for Johan's... future?

Looking at the serious-faced Gengar, AZ's expression became dazed. He actually saw his former self reflected in a Pokémon's body and eyes?

It sounded somewhat laughable, but seeing Gengar's serious expression, he couldn't laugh at all, because he could feel... Gengar was serious.

"Do you..." AZ opened his mouth, "know what price you'll pay, what pressure and guilt you'll bear?"

"Ka-kaah! (▼皿▼)"

Gengar crossed its arms and snorted coldly.

As long as it's for Johan, I don't care about floods or world destruction or rebirth!

"What about Johan..."

Before AZ could finish, Gengar interrupted without hesitation.

"Ka-kaah!"

Of course Johan understands me and accepts me!

Full of confidence, even pride.

Gengar believed Johan would absolutely understand it and accept it - this was the bond between them, needing no words.

But this statement struck AZ like lightning.

This was... the difference between him and Floette, and Johan and Gengar?

AZ's expression gradually softened.

Looking at the "proud and spirited" Gengar in front of him, he suddenly wanted to laugh.

Not mockery, but genuine envious laughter.

Then his mind filled with images of the gentle, easy-going, kind Johan from earlier, connecting it with his identity as Arceus's messenger.

Perhaps this was destined.

Thinking this, AZ removed a pendant he wore close to his chest, shaped like a key, and handed it to Gengar.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar looked at what AZ offered, blinking twice.

What was this?

AZ said: "The key to activate the 'Ultimate Weapon.'"

"Ka-kaah?! (▼O▼)"

Gengar's mouth gaped open, eyes glowing golden as it immediately put down its cup, roughly wiped its hands on its body, and took the key AZ offered.

Examining it carefully.

This thing was what activated the "Ultimate Weapon"?

After giving away the key, AZ seemed much lighter overall. He drank some Energy Root tea, tasting some bitterness and also the sweetness that followed.

Wrinkles appeared on his aged face as he showed the first genuine smile from his heart in three thousand years.

"If it's you two, you should be able to protect this thing well."

Although Gengar claimed to prepare for contingencies, AZ believed Johan wouldn't give Gengar the chance to use it.

With such Pokémon accompanying and protecting him, how could Johan, as Arceus's messenger, possibly meet an early end?

But he didn't understand Gengar's meaning - Gengar was referring to... after Johan's hundred years...

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar quickly stuffed the key in its mouth, then grabbed AZ around the neck, showing a big smile.

You're the kind of friend I approve of!

AZ's smile grew even broader.

"Friend..."

Night fell.

Johan's temporary camp.

He looked somewhat puzzled at AZ and Gengar sitting together.

When had their relationship become so good?

Seeming to notice his gaze, AZ and Gengar both looked over simultaneously.

AZ showed a wrinkled smile, mm... somewhat unsettling.

While Gengar's eyes darted around evasively.

Hm?

Something fishy was going on.

As Gengar's trainer, how could Johan not understand this purple fatty?

Just by how it stuck out its butt, Johan knew whether it was going to fart or poop.

However, now wasn't the time for "interrogation." Johan still had some questions about AZ's appearance.

"Mr. AZ, how did you end up in this forest?" Johan voiced his confusion.

Wasn't AZ supposed to be wandering everywhere, then... captured by his descendant Lysandre and imprisoned in Team Flare's base?

For Johan's confusion, AZ had no intention of hiding anything. He said directly:

"Because I wanted to see Xerneas."

Wait!

Xerneas?

"This forest?"

Orrans Forest?

It sounded somewhat familiar.

"Xerneas?" Diancie suddenly stood up, looking somewhat excited.

AZ nodded. "Xerneas once slept in this forest. Now... perhaps it has awakened."

Johan: "..."
