# 637: The Life God, Xerneas!

Orrans Forest?

Johan had naturally seen the movie "Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction," but... had this forest been mentioned in the plot?

It had been too long, and he really didn't have a deep impression of such non-crucial information points.

However...

When AZ originally built the "Ultimate Weapon" and used it as a weapon to try destroying those creatures that had hurt Floette, he had utilized both Xerneas and Yveltal.

Going to see Xerneas, wasn't he afraid of being held accountable?

Seeing Johan's confusion, AZ pulled at his face, showing what might or might not have been a self-mocking smile.

"I've been living in this forest for who knows how long, but..."

He hadn't been able to see Xerneas.

Orrans Forest was vast. Looking for Xerneas in this forest was like finding a needle in a haystack. If Xerneas wanted to meet, that would be fine, but if it didn't want to meet, there were plenty of ways to hide.

Johan understood.

That made sense.

AZ probably wanted to find Xerneas to express his apology or to seek forgiveness, and Xerneas, as the "Life God," had a relatively gentle temperament.

It wouldn't easily forgive AZ, but it also wouldn't take AZ's life because of this.

In that case, it was better not to meet.

Fair enough.

Johan gently patted Diancie, indicating it should stay calm.

Since Xerneas was in this forest, and Diancie had found its way here, it would definitely be willing to meet this princess of the Diamond Kingdom.

They just needed to temporarily separate from AZ.

And AZ obviously understood this point as well. He looked at Diancie and said hoarsely:

"You go to the forest depths tomorrow, and I'll go in the opposite direction."

Diancie's pink pupils flickered slightly.

AZ had caused too much destruction three thousand years ago to revive Floette. While his heart in saving Floette wasn't wrong, his methods were obviously problematic.

Although AZ had been repenting and hoping for redemption for these three thousand years, no one had the right to forgive him on behalf of those Pokémon who had lost their lives. Diancie couldn't, Johan couldn't, and even Xerneas didn't have that right.

Actually, AZ himself knew that what he hoped for now... was just to see his Floette once more, and then he would have no regrets.

"Where are you planning to go?" Johan asked.

AZ sighed, looking up at the night sky, with countless stars reflected in his eyes.

"Nowhere, just want to let this little one meet who it wants to meet."

Three thousand years had already passed.

Time, for AZ, no longer had much meaning.

Consider it a way to clear his mind?

AZ stood up.

"Today... thank you for the hospitality. This was probably the happiest day I've had in three thousand years."

Saying this, he walked to a large tree nearby, pulled off his worn hat and covered his face with it, apparently preparing to sleep.

Johan looked deeply at AZ and couldn't help sighing softly.

"Diancie, tomorrow we'll enter the forest and see if we can encounter Xerneas." Johan said.

"Yes!" Diancie nodded vigorously.

Under the night sky.

Two tents sat quietly on the grassland. Johan lay on his back in the tent, hands pillowed behind his head, unusually unable to fall asleep quickly.

He was actually asking himself a question in his heart.

If...

One of his little ones also ended up like AZ's Floette, would he do the same thing as AZ?

He didn't think about this answer, but he couldn't deceive himself.

"Probably would." Johan murmured.

Don't judge others' goodness when you haven't experienced their suffering.

Having never experienced AZ's ordeal, how could he truly understand AZ's thoughts at the time?

"In the end, I'm also a selfish person." Johan smiled self-mockingly.

"Oowoo~~"

Ninetales, curled up beside him, seemed to sense Johan's thoughts. Its head gently nuzzled his cheek, then stuck out its tongue to carefully lick him.

Johan reached out with one hand to rub its head. The soft fur felt as good as always.

"It's fine." Johan said, scanning around the tent.

Tinkaton lying in a "big" character shape at the tent's edge, its hammer fallen to the sides, mallet planted in the ground.

Dragonite leaning against Urshifu's back, breathing steadily while gently scratching its round belly.

Urshifu with a snot bubble, clearly sleeping yet seeming to be meditating, though it didn't dare make too much noise, apparently afraid of disturbing the soundly sleeping Dragonite.

Ceruledge sitting cross-legged at Johan's feet, now able to perfectly control its temperature, bringing warmth to the nighttime tent with each breath.

Larvitar hugging its large bowl filled with diamonds, drool unstoppably dripping from the corner of its mouth. Victini lay sprawled on top of those diamonds - this was the "little brother's" duty to guard the "big brother's" treasure.

Gengar...

Johan's thoughts stirred as he looked toward the tent ceiling, where Gengar appeared to be sleeping wrapped in Spirit World cloth.

However, while the Spirit World cloth was barely adequate as a blanket, wrapping around its head... its bottom and feet were still exposed outside, its short tail gently swaying, seemingly in a good mood.

"Gengar." Johan called out.

"Ka-kaah zzZ"

"Stop pretending."

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar carefully lifted a corner of the Spirit World cloth, revealing its mischievous eyes, as if saying... you saw through me again.

Johan chuckled.

"What secret are you hiding this time, you little rascal?"

Earlier during dinner, he'd felt that AZ seemed quite trusting of Gengar.

Gengar scratched its bottom and tilted its head.

"Ka-kaah?"

What what secret? I don't know anything.

Johan naturally didn't believe this.

However, everyone had their little secrets. He didn't probe too deeply, anyway... Gengar couldn't possibly do anything bad to him.

"Stop fooling around, go to sleep early. Tomorrow we might see Xerneas, and who knows what the situation will be."

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar immediately nodded, opened its mouth, and stuffed a key-shaped object into its mouth.

A key?

Little one, you're showing your hand after all, aren't you?

Torchic crowed at dawn.

Purple appeared at the horizon's edge.

Johan got up early.

Not because he was eager to see Xerneas, but because...

"Teacher!"

Steven, wearing his signature outfit, stood outside the tent with some impatient excitement in his eyes.

He had received Johan's message earlier about a special Pokémon for him to see, so he hurriedly delivered the stones needed for Devon's cooperation with Geosenge Town back to Hoenn, then immediately rushed back.

What kind of Pokémon could make Teacher Johan call him to see personally?

Steven was very curious.

He'd traveled all over the world digging for stones - what Pokémon hadn't he seen?

Moreover, since meeting Teacher Johan, he'd experienced various big and small events, even seeing legendary and mythical Pokémon. What Pokémon could...

"Good morning, Johan."

Diancie walked out of Korrina's tent, obediently greeting Johan.

Johan looked toward Steven.

Steven also looked toward the Pokémon that had greeted them, momentarily losing his usually steady composure as a rare show of surprise, pupils contracting sharply as he opened his mouth: "Di-Diancie?"

Haha—

Seeing this, Johan showed a satisfied smile.

His thoughts were clear, his mood pleasant.

If Steven had a health bar, seeing Diancie at this moment should have dealt critical damage and quickly depleted it, right?

Besides Diancie, Johan guessed probably only Magearna could have a similar effect.

However.

It probably still wouldn't compare to Diancie.

After all, Steven's love for stones surpassed his love for metal.

"Who are you?" Diancie looked at Steven with confusion.

Steven quickly composed himself, placing his right hand on his chest and performing a nobleman's bow, saying:

"Princess Diancie, I am Steven Stone, Teacher Johan's student."

Seeing Steven's gesture, Diancie also instinctively lifted her skirt slightly and curtsied.

"So you're Teacher Johan's student. Then... I'll allow you to become my friend."

Steven grinned.

Bliss.

Johan suspected that even if Steven met a girl he was attracted to, he might not be as polite and friendly as he was to Diancie. That upward curve of his mouth was a bit exaggerated.

"Perfect timing. We're going to look for Xerneas later. Steven, come with us." Johan said.

Steven's strength was unquestionable.

The current him might not have reached the level where he could battle the twin gods for 22 days, but he was already more formidable than ordinary Elite Four members.

Just like Siebold at the Battle Chateau earlier.

If nothing unexpected happened, Steven facing Siebold in an all-out battle should have a ninety percent chance of winning.

If they encountered some kind of Xerneas rampage, having Steven hold out for 22 days might be difficult, but a discounted version of holding out for a while should be possible.

"Xerneas?"

Steven's eyes widened slightly.

As someone who frequently traveled between the Kalos and Hoenn regions, how could he not have heard legends about Xerneas?

Good grief.

Teacher Johan was indeed Teacher Johan - arriving and immediately encountering a "major event"?

Johan patted his shoulder without saying more, just turning to look toward one side of the camp. AZ, who had slept there last night, was already gone.

"Pack up. I'll go tell the Officer Jennys, then we'll enter the forest."

Theoretically, with Diancie, finding Xerneas shouldn't be difficult, but nothing was absolute. If they wandered around for several days without finding it, that would be quite normal.

Dappled shadows interweaved in the forest, hazy mist gradually spreading, with the "splash splash" sound of flowing water appearing by their ears.

AZ pushed through the irregular forest leaves, seeing barren ground and withered tree trunks everywhere.

In such a vast forest, the central area was this kind of withered dead land - quite miraculous when you thought about it.

At the center of this barren land was a huge circular pit. Tributaries and streams from throughout the forest finally converged here, forming a ring-shaped waterfall that raised large clouds of mist.

Looking at this scene before him, AZ sighed.

"Forgive myself?"

His eyes showed reminiscence, as if Floette's figure appeared before him, every smile and frown so lifelike.

However, Floette came quickly and left quickly, waving at AZ as it slowly drifted away.

AZ reached out trying to call it back, but it was just an illusion.

This was his only regret.

But his expression soon became resolute.

"Sorry, even myself... I probably can't forgive myself."

AZ stepped into the barren land, walking toward the giant pit, leaving footprints with each step.

"To truly forgive myself... perhaps only this way..."

"Senior Steven."

Korrina followed closely beside Steven.

"What is it?" Steven maintained a friendly smile toward Korrina.

"How exactly can one join Teacher Johan's tutelage?"

As Teacher Johan's "chief disciple," asking Steven was definitely right!

"Eh?"

Steven was puzzled, looking up at Johan walking ahead. "Teacher's tutelage?"

Was it done through formal apprenticeship?

Besides, Teacher Johan was a school teacher, not some fighting dojo or gym leader. There was no such thing as taking disciples.

As long as you'd been taught by Teacher Johan, calling yourself a "student" should be fine, right?

"Eh?!"

Korrina's voice immediately rose several octaves.

She blinked twice.

So it could be done that way?

"Has the teacher given you guidance?" Steven asked back.

"Yes... I think so."

Korrina thought about yesterday, after learning AZ's story and during Teacher Johan's conversation with AZ, she had gained new understanding of so-called "trainers and Pokémon."

Steven shrugged.

Then that's settled, isn't it?

Korrina nodded in seeming understanding.

So she and Bea... were fellow disciples?

Oh ho!

Korrina immediately became excited.

"This is..."

Suddenly, Diancie, walking ahead with Johan, sensed something. It closed its eyes and extended both hands.

"What's wrong, Diancie?" Johan's eyes flashed as he asked.

"I sense ahead, right in that forest ahead, extremely rich Fairy-type aura!"

"Found it?" Korrina skated forward, and Steven followed.

Johan looked at Ninetales and Tinkaton beside him.

"Oowoo..." Ninetales seemed to sense something.

"Cha?" Tinkaton shouldered its hammer and scratched its head.

Fairy-type aura?

What was that?

Johan: "..."

"Then if nothing unexpected happens, Xerneas should be up ahead."

Diancie immediately became unable to contain its excitement, running quickly toward the front.

"Teacher?" Steven couldn't help speaking.

Johan shook his head. "Should be no problem."

Xerneas... was probably the most reasonable among all the legendary Pokémon he knew. As the "Life God," it wouldn't bring destruction without any reason.

However, for safety's sake...

"Let's go."

Everyone also quickened their pace.

Hm?

Johan suddenly paused slightly, taking the golden Wheel of Time from his inner pocket.

A green gem on it was rippling slightly.

Arceus?

Xerneas?

Fairy Plate?

The clouds in the sky parted slightly, soft sunlight shining down, penetrating layers of forest leaves and casting bright beams of light with faint rainbow colors flowing within.

The wild Pokémon in the forest seemed to sense something, appearing one after another.

Flocks of Vivillon painted a winding path through the forest, two Pancham poked their heads out from a tree hole while sucking their fingers, a Gogoat led several Skiddo jumping out from the bushes, Aromatisse scattered faint fragrance...

In a clearing in the forest, a rainbow halo was dazzling.

The colorful branches seemed to come alive, with vibrant life energy surging through the forest.

"This is..." Korrina's eyes widened.

Behold.

A Pokémon resembling a deer with blue-black coloring appeared in their view. It had branch-like antlers on its head, a gentle expression that unconsciously relaxed one's mood.

This was indeed the legendary Pokémon, Xerneas!

Appearing so openly before them.

"Oowoo?"

Ninetales' light blue eyes glowed as it gazed at Xerneas, with rainbow light sparkling in its pupils.

"Cha?"

Tinkaton also seemed to finally sense the so-called Fairy-type aura at this moment, showing a look of understanding.

Oh~~ So this was Fairy-type aura.

Diancie quickly approached, running to Xerneas's front, while Xerneas also stopped, seemingly deliberately waiting for it.

"Xerneas!" Diancie called out.

The blue branch-like antlers atop Xerneas's head glowed with rainbow light, with seven colors flowing and appearing like blooming trees.

"Ka-kaah?"

It bloomed?

Gengar was greatly shocked.

"It really is Xerneas." Steven's eyes also reflected the seven colors, his expression quite amazed.

Wait, saying they were looking for Xerneas and actually finding Xerneas?

Indeed, being with the teacher... encountering anything shouldn't be surprising.

Diancie approached, eyes full of hope, hands clasped to its chest, speaking with a somewhat pleading tone:

"Xerneas, I finally get to see you..."

A seven-colored glow emanated from Xerneas as its voice echoed in everyone's mind.

[It is you who has been searching for me.]

The voice was gentle and warm, not inspiring much tension, only feelings of closeness and peace.

"I..." Diancie opened its mouth, saying seriously: "Please, please help me, let me save my kingdom and my people!"

[I know why you have come.]

Xerneas's eyes, which contained hidden "X" symbols, were full of wisdom, as if it already understood everything.

[I shall grant it to you.]

Saying this, Xerneas lifted its head slightly. The seven-colored branches atop its head burst with even brighter rainbow light. Life energy spread from its body to cover the surroundings, and some trees and grass quickly sprouted branches and leaves, growing rapidly.

Under this gentle radiance, Diancie maintained a prayer posture with closed eyes, silently feeling the power from Xerneas.

Ninetales and Tinkaton beside Johan also closed their eyes, sensing this power from the Life God.

Even Johan, Steven, and Korrina felt their bodies becoming lighter under the radiance, with even the slight fatigue from not sleeping well last night disappearing instantly.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar looked down at its left hand, then at its right hand.

Did I get younger?

This was the legendary "Life God"?

Gengar's eyes sparkled with intense interest.

If it was the Life God, couldn't it directly grant Johan eternal life?

Under the Fairy Aura's influence, Ninetales and Tinkaton's aura was also slowly improving, with faint glows emanating from their bodies.

They leveled up?

This was better than any "Rare Candy"!

The Fairy aura gradually dissipated as Diancie, Ninetales, and Tinkaton slowly opened their eyes.

"Can... can I do it now?"

Diancie gently clenched its fists, somewhat anxious, worried, and expectant.

Regarding Diancie's results, Xerneas was no longer concerned, having done what it should do. The rest was up to Diancie itself.

Its gaze fell on Johan.

The moment its gaze landed, Johan felt the Wheel of Time in his hand emanating intense heat.

[Messenger of Arceus, you are also seeking me.]

Steven and Korrina already knew about this identity, so there was no surprise.

Johan looked directly at Xerneas and stated his question directly.

"Xerneas, may I ask... is Arceus's Fairy Plate with you?"

Xerneas seemed unsurprised by this question, just gently shaking its head.

[I'm sorry, it is not with me.]

Hm?

Johan frowned slightly.

The Fairy Plate wasn't with the strongest Fairy-type Pokémon?

Then why was the Wheel of Time getting so hot?

However, Xerneas quickly provided an explanation.

[But it was indeed in my possession once.]

"Once?"

Johan caught the key point.

Xerneas nodded, showing no evasiveness.

[Long ago, with the power of the Fairy Plate, I calmed Yveltal's fury.]

The Death God, Yveltal!

The legendary Pokémon corresponding to Xerneas.

If Xerneas was the most reasonable legendary Pokémon, then Yveltal was probably the most difficult to communicate with.

As the embodiment of death, destruction, and ruin, Yveltal had only one goal after awakening: destruction.

Even among Hoenn's two fools, Groudon and Kyogre had their own objectives - building continents or having the ocean swallow everything. Even when they fought, their ultimate purposes were clear.

But Yveltal was pure destruction.

Regardless of what it was, anything with life was its target for destruction.

Everything shall be destroyed!

As corresponding legendary Pokémon, Xerneas and Yveltal's abilities were equal, their power was equal. Without external help like the Fairy Plate, it would be difficult for Xerneas and Yveltal to determine a victor.

Of course.

If the "Order God" Zygarde appeared, that would be a different story.

Xerneas continued explaining.

[After calming Yveltal's fury once, the Fairy Plate was borrowed.]

"Borrowed?" Johan was puzzled.

Wait.

Was the Fairy Plate Arceus's or Xerneas's?

[Yes.]

Xerneas continued:

[It was borrowed by four guardian deities from a distant region, under Zygarde's witness. They wanted to use the plate's power to resist invasion from beings beyond the distant universe.]

Wait!

Four guardian deities?

"Do you mean... the guardian deities of the four islands in the Alola region? The Tapu?"

Xerneas's eyes sparkled with wisdom as it looked deeply at Johan.

[It seems you know much.]

"Let me sort this out..."

Johan fell into thought.

Four guardian deities from the Alola region, the Tapu clan, borrowed the Fairy Plate's power to resist invasion from beings beyond the distant universe.

Then this being from beyond the distant universe referred to Ultra Beasts, right?

No.

The target should be more specific - the "Blinding One" Necrozma!

Necrozma's ultimate form was Psychic and Dragon-type, while the four Tapu guardians were Fairy-type. That made sense.

How did this get involved with such distant matters?

Moreover, there was Zygarde's involvement?

Xerneas said the borrowing was under Zygarde's witness...

As the Order God, Zygarde's purpose was maintaining balance in the Pokémon world. Ultra Beasts and Necrozma from beyond the universe would indeed affect balance.

Seeing Johan's expression gradually understanding, Xerneas knew he had figured out the key points.

[I don't have the Fairy Plate you seek, but...]

Buzz—

A fist-sized stone emanating weak light flew out from Xerneas's body.

"A Plate fragment?"

Johan was startled.

Others might not recognize it, but he was now very familiar with this thing.

Larvitar had an Earth Plate fragment, Urshifu had a Fist Plate fragment, and what Xerneas produced was...

A Fairy Plate fragment!

[This is a Plate fragment formed from excess energy when I carried the Fairy Plate. As Arceus's messenger, I'll give it to you.]

The Plate fragment flew toward Johan.

The temperature of the Wheel of Time in his hand gradually cooled down.

So the Wheel of Time's reaction was to this Fairy Plate fragment in Xerneas's possession.

Didn't this mean... the seemingly useless Wheel of Time that Arceus gave him was actually a "Plate fragment detector"?

Good grief!

Johan felt like he was about to strike it rich.

But then more questions followed.

Then why... when he first got the Wheel of Time and injected aura into it, did it give information about the Kalos region?

The Fairy Plate wasn't even here...

While thinking about this, Johan received the Plate fragment.

Mm, still warm.

Just one Plate fragment though.

Johan looked at Ninetales and Tinkaton beside him.

Two Pokémon, how to divide it?

"Xerneas." Johan held the Plate fragment.

[Yes?]

"Could you help me split this in half?"

Xerneas: "..."

[The power of Plates is difficult to divide.]

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales wrapped the Fairy Plate fragment in Johan's hand with its tail, bringing it to its eyes to examine carefully. It looked back and forth three or four times, scanned with psychic power three or four times, and froze it three or four times before nodding at Johan.

Really, no danger.

Xerneas moved its mouth but ultimately said nothing.

Then Ninetales handed the fragment to Tinkaton, gently patting Tinkaton's head with another tail, its expression gentle.

Tinkaton was one it and Gengar had watched grow up together - a companion and little sister. It naturally wouldn't compete with Tinkaton.

Moreover, it was best at Ice-type moves, and in Fairy-type aspects, it was also slightly better than Tinkaton.

"Cha!"

But Tinkaton shook its head repeatedly, also indicating it didn't want it.

In Fairy-type aspects, it acknowledged its talent wasn't as good as Ninetales. Rather than giving it to itself, it was better to give it to Ninetales.

Besides, it still preferred its hammer. Its talents were more in Steel-type aspects.

"Yoji..."

Larvitar's head followed the Fairy Plate being pushed back and forth, turning as it spoke while biting its finger.

If neither of you want it, you can give it to me. I guarantee I'll eat it all without leaving a trace, no worries!

Johan: "..."

You really dare to say that.

Even if Tyranitar was 2x weak to Fairy...

[If you still want more...]

Xerneas spoke again.

[Yveltal should also have one, left behind when I was appeasing it.]

Yveltal?

Johan shook his head.

Forget it.

That guy wasn't as easy to talk to as Xerneas.

Johan finally took the Fairy Plate fragment back.

"Simple. One person gets it for one day."

Just when he was wondering how to further develop Ninetales and Tinkaton's Fairy-type abilities, Xerneas delivered this "treasure."

[In that case, I shall depart.]

Xerneas nodded slightly at Johan, then looked past him to give Gengar a deep look before turning and walking gracefully toward the forest depths.

The seven-colored light on its body gradually faded as it left, and the surrounding wild Pokémon followed upon seeing this.

Wherever it walked, flowers bloomed, and butterflies followed.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar stuck out its tongue and repeatedly patted its chest.

What did that last look mean? Did it see through my thoughts? Close call, close call...

Johan handed the Fairy Plate fragment to Ninetales. Since it and Tinkaton would take turns one day each, starting with Ninetales.

Having agreed on the distribution method, Ninetales stopped being polite and wrapped the Plate fragment with its tail.

"Didn't expect this trip to yield quite a harvest." Johan sighed.

Not only had Ninetales and Tinkaton leveled up and received brief Fairy-type development, but he'd also obtained a Fairy Plate fragment.

As for the one at Yveltal's place...

"It's okay, Diancie." Korrina gently patted Diancie's shoulder, softly comforting: "My grandfather always says I'm not good enough and still haven't met his requirements to perform Mega Evolution, but we're all growing, aren't we?"

Diancie lowered its head, looking at its hands. "My... my power still hasn't..."

While Johan was communicating with Xerneas, Diancie, influenced by Xerneas's Fairy Aura, had tried to begin condensing real diamonds.

However.

Its hopeful expectation, its trusted Xerneas... it still couldn't condense real diamonds.

This left Diancie very disappointed.

But more than that, it was confused.

If even Xerneas's Fairy Aura couldn't help it create diamonds and condense "Eternal Crystal," then what else could it do to save its kingdom and its people?

Diancie seemed to suddenly lose direction and motivation.

Seeing Diancie's dejected state, Johan gently shook his head.

Actually, he had known early on that even if Diancie met Xerneas, it would probably be unable to condense real "Eternal Crystal."

To be honest... Diancie and Mewtwo were quite similar in having polarized states.

Mewtwo couldn't find direction and meaning of existence, thus couldn't find itself.

While Diancie had responsibilities and meaning that were too heavy, so heavy that it even ignored its own existence.

"Diancie..."

Johan walked to Diancie's side, half-crouching and about to comfort it, when suddenly a leaf-shaped object darted out from the nearby forest and landed on his shoulder.

"Vii?" Victini revealed its form, looking puzzled as it reached out to poke the green, soft-looking thing.

But a low voice echoed in Johan's ear.

[I can sense it's about to awaken!]

Rumble rumble—!!

In an instant.

All the trees in Orrans Forest seemed to tremble, the ground made rumbling sounds, and a fierce, violent aura spread from the depths of Orrans Forest.

# 638: The Awakening Yveltal! (Two-in-One Chapter)

Rumble rumble—

A violent explosion suddenly erupted from the depths of the forest, accompanied by harsh, ear-piercing shrieks and high-pitched cries that echoed across the sky!

Steven and Korrina's expressions both changed as they looked toward where the commotion originated. Due to the forest canopy blocking their view, they couldn't see clearly, only seeing black mist rising from below to the clouds at terrifying speed.

"What is that?" Steven frowned.

While Johan was also surprised by the sudden disturbance from the forest depths, he was more surprised by the small creature that had suddenly appeared on his shoulder.

Its appearance was somewhat like a green flatworm. If you didn't look carefully, you could even mistake it for a leaf or green bark.

But unlike a flatworm, it had a lively eye on its head, a red diamond-shaped spot on its abdomen that looked like a gem, and a small hook at its tail.

Squishy?

Johan unconsciously thought of this name.

Of course, "Squishy" wasn't its real name, but what Citron's sister Bonnie called it in the anime. Its real name should be—Zygarde!

The Order God, Zygarde!

If word got out that the legendary "Z God" Zygarde of the Kalos region was such a small thing, probably not many people would believe it.

Because Zygarde's form of existence was different from most Pokémon.

As the "Order God," Zygarde guarded the natural order and balance of the Kalos region, so normally, Zygarde's body would split into countless cells hidden throughout the Kalos region to monitor the entire region.

When situations arose, Zygarde would gather scattered cells and assemble them onto cores according to the severity of the situation, manifesting different forms.

Based on the number of assembled cells, the forms could be divided into 10% form, 50% form, and Complete form.

The one currently perched on his shoulder was one of the two cores among Zygarde's many cells!

The vast majority of Zygarde's cells had no self-awareness, only monitoring according to predetermined "programs." Only the two cores possessed independent thinking ability.

[Did you hear me speaking?]

Seeing Johan's lack of response, the Zygarde core tilted its head to look at him.

"Zygarde?" Johan established a telepathic connection with the Zygarde core using aura.

[You do recognize me.]

The Zygarde core wasn't surprised, just lifting its head slightly with some pride.

But it quickly crawled down and urged:

[Yveltal has awakened. Quickly go stop it!]

Johan: "..."

Stop Yveltal?

Me?

Rumble rumble!!

The trembling resumed.

Where the black mist had risen earlier, a pair of crimson eyes appeared faintly visible. At this moment, they were fully revealed—a massive bird black as ink with red stripes, spreading wings that blocked the sun, revealing a completely crimson underside as it screeched harshly!

The Death God, Yveltal!

"That is..." Korrina's eyes were full of shock.

"Yveltal!" Steven said heavily, his expression grave.

Screech—

A long cry rang out.

A bloody dark aura instantly spread, continuously expanding outward from the forest center.

Wherever it passed, all trees, branches, and grass turned to ash, leaving only dried, charred-looking trunks. Some wild Pokémon that couldn't escape in time were petrified by the dark aura's erosion, becoming stone statues.

"So powerful..." Steven frowned.

Just the spreading aura alone could cause such destruction...

More importantly.

All Pokémon touched by the aura were petrified, regardless of their strength. How could such a powerful being be dealt with?

Petrification.

This was much harder to handle than powerful moves or visible attacks.

Being touched meant petrification—you couldn't even make contact. The difficulty naturally skyrocketed.

[Aren't you Arceus's messenger?]

The Zygarde core glanced at the Wheel of Time on Johan's body.

Johan's mouth twitched.

Being Arceus's messenger didn't make him Ultraman who could transform, did it?

However.

He did need to go take a look.

Xerneas had just left. As the "Life God," Xerneas had more obligation than him to intervene after Yveltal's awakening.

With Xerneas present, the danger level would drop significantly.

Moreover.

Wasn't Zygarde here too?

Going against the fleeing wild Pokémon herds, Johan's group headed toward the forest center.

Orrans Forest, center.

Black mist intertwined with bloody crimson, continuously spreading like drawing an ever-expanding crimson circle in the vast forest.

Outside the circle was lush forest full of life; inside was withered earth and deathly silence.

As the circle continued expanding, more and more wild Pokémon were enveloped by the dark aura, petrified into sculptures.

But at the very center of this "hell," the core area covered by the dark aura, in a dim giant pit.

Beside the dark stagnant lake, a massive humanoid statue sat by the water's edge.

He held his head up slightly, holding what appeared to be a petrified root in his hand, his face showing relief and reminiscence, lifelike in detail.

At this moment, above the forest, in an invisible small airship, a father-daughter pair watched the scene before them with horror.

"Wh-what is that thing?"

Master thief Argus Steel gaped.

Just moments ago.

He had watched a pitch-black large cocoon slowly float up from the forest center's pit, thinking it might be some treasure. Who knew such a terrifying large bird would hatch from it.

His daughter Millis Steel had also lost her previous composure, piloting the airship while shouting:

"What else could it be—Yveltal!"

The father-daughter pair's original target was Diancie, but after an attempted approach, they were scared away by Regieleki.

Later they learned that Diancie was actually traveling with Teacher Johan!

As master thieves, they knew Teacher Johan's reputation all too well.

Powerful Pokémon hunter groups like Hunter J and pirate crews had all been captured by him.

Though they were master thieves rather than true Pokémon hunters, they... still counted as half, so naturally they didn't dare provoke Teacher Johan.

But Diancie was still their target.

So Argus's daughter Millis decided to wait until Diancie left Teacher Johan before making their move!

After all, they originally planned to wait until Diancie fully mastered her power and could condense real diamonds before acting. They might as well wait and see.

Besides, Teacher Johan hadn't used a Poké Ball to capture Diancie, so there was a high probability he hadn't captured her.

Since there was no capture, they would eventually separate.

They'd just wait until after the separation to act.

However.

The pair never expected that whether Diancie had mastered her power was unknown, but the sudden appearance of Yveltal completely disrupted their plans.

More importantly...

The Yveltal currently rampaging above the forest had set its sights on them!

Though their airship could turn invisible, when flying at high speed, the air currents it created couldn't escape Yveltal's detection.

Screech—!!

A clear, sharp cry.

Yveltal suddenly spread its wings, revealing the black "Y" pattern within the crimson of its abdomen. As its power activated, the "Y" burst with terrifying crimson, forming a beam of light shooting directly at their airship.

Couldn't dodge!

Making an instant decision.

"Jump!" Millis slammed the airship's control button. As the hatch opened, both jumped out simultaneously.

After they jumped, the crimson beam swept across the airship, instantly petrifying this airship that had cost who knows how much money to build. It finally crashed to the ground, splashing up large amounts of dirt.

The father-daughter pair who jumped from the airship relied on their Aegislash and Doublade's flying ability.

However, when the two frantically fled downward, they happened to encounter... the approaching Johan's group.

At the boundary between forest death and life, the hazy dark aura had thinned considerably due to expanded coverage but still existed.

The thinned aura wasn't as terrifying as before. As long as you were fast enough to avoid being entangled by the aura's energy, you wouldn't be instantly petrified.

This was best proven by the wild Pokémon running past them and breaking through the life-death boundary.

Of course, the closer to the forest center, the stronger the dark aura would be.

"Avoid this black-red mist." Steven warned.

"Ka-kaah?"

Compared to everyone's grave expressions, Gengar following beside Johan had somehow put on its Wise Glasses, sticking out its tongue with curiosity as it observed the black-red aura and spreading atmosphere.

Dark aura...

Just hearing it sounded like it matched its identity.

Moreover...

Black mist emanated from Gengar's body, centering on itself.

When its black mist contacted the outermost edge of the dark aura, instead of major collision, they directly merged together.

Seeing this, Gengar's eyes immediately lit up.

There was potential here!

It had done similar "things" before—ghost energy covering the entire field. It was like a field-type move but not quite, more like weather but that didn't fit either. Johan had jokingly called it "dark water" or something.

Now it seemed...

Wasn't that totally a "Ghost Aura"?

As the Pokémon world's "Gengar Kakashi," the "copy Pokémon," Gengar had already "copied" many moves, like Darkrai's Dark Void, Marshadow's Spectral Thief, Mewtwo's Psychic, and now Yveltal's Dark Aura...

Shouldn't be too difficult, right?

While Gengar was tinkering with the Dark Aura, Johan's group resolutely charged into the decayed, withered forest, already able to clearly see Yveltal's form from a distance.

While carefully approaching, Johan wasn't idle, communicating with the Zygarde core.

"Can't you handle it yourself?"

The core was right here. Even if it was just one core that could at most manifest 50% form, if combined with Xerneas, restraining Yveltal shouldn't be a problem, right?

[I... I have some problems with my condition.]

The Zygarde core said stiffly.

Some problems?

Had Lysandre already captured the other core?

In the original story, Lysandre captured one of Zygarde's cores and controlled it, ultimately causing massive destruction.

Seeing Johan's confusion, the Zygarde core thought for a moment before explaining.

[My partner doesn't trust humans.]

Zygarde's two cores—one was the current "Squishy," which was relatively willing to trust humans, while the other core... believed humans were destroyers of order and should be avoided.

One trusted humans, one didn't—this was probably the "balance" of the Order God.

Johan frowned: "But what does trusting or not trusting humans have to do with this?"

The opponent was Yveltal, the deity of destruction and death. The affected wouldn't be just humans.

[It also places more emphasis on balance, complete balance and order.]

Since it had spoken up, the Zygarde core had nothing left to hide.

[The Life God has been awakened too long, with life energy too abundant. My partner believes it's time for the Death God to take away some of the overly abundant life energy.]

Johan understood Zygarde's meaning.

Life and death corresponded.

Xerneas brought abundant life energy—forests rapidly growing and expanding, Pokémon quickly reproducing and developing.

When life reached a certain abundance, there was too much life on the scales of life and death.

To achieve balance on the scales, the Death God needed to step in.

So Yveltal's awakening was inevitable, and it would fulfill its "duty."

Simply put.

The "Squishy" on Johan was a more emotionally sensitive existence, while the other Zygarde core was more rational—rational to the point of being like a machine executing predetermined programs, working to maintain balance.

Xerneas had awakened much earlier than Yveltal—this was why Zygarde's other core wouldn't act.

[I have been observing you for some time.]

Observing?

When?

The Zygarde core continued:

[You carry not only Arceus's aura but also bonds with numerous legendary Pokémon. I believe you have the ability to resolve this incident!]

Its tone showed more confidence in Johan than Johan had in himself.

But the problem was...

If Zygarde's other core wouldn't come, couldn't it still gather 50% form for battle?

Johan didn't ask this question.

Because he could already sense that if the Zygarde core could deploy fifty percent of its power, it would have already done so.

Most likely it couldn't, or wasn't allowed.

Was it due to "predetermined programming" set by Complete Zygarde?

Or was it... the "order" that must be followed as the "Order God"?

If Lysandre also captured Zygarde's other core in the future and could successfully control and drive it to destroy part of life, was it also related to the current excessive abundance of life energy?

Various thoughts flashed through his mind.

Boom!!

A roar came from above as a crimson beam swept out an airship, directly petrifying it.

Then two figures fell from the sky.

Master thieves Argus and Millis, father and daughter?

Seeing their attire, Johan remembered their identities, but at this time... they obviously weren't here for Diancie but to escape.

Screech—!!

A piercing cry split the air.

Yveltal would absolutely not allow any life to exist within its dark aura.

The massive blood-colored wings flapped again, crimson beams sweeping over.

"Watch out, Oblivion Wing!"

Johan shouted loudly.

However.

This time Yveltal's Oblivion Wing was clearly not mainly targeting them, but the escaping Argus and his daughter.

"Aegislash, King's Shield!"

Clang!!

Aegislash maintained shield form, using its incredibly hard shield to resist the Oblivion Wing beam's sweep.

However.

As an "invincible" move with similar effects to Protect that could resist all attacks, King's Shield had almost no effect against Oblivion Wing.

Crack crack crack—

Petrification rapidly spread from the shield's center as Aegislash turned to stone.

"Aegislash!"

Seeing this, Argus and Millis were shocked.

But Yveltal's Oblivion Wing didn't end there. As it flew and moved, the crimson beam passed over the petrified shield. Doublade, Honedge—Argus's Pokémon were successively petrified.

Bang!!

Argus forcefully pushed his daughter Millis away, sending her tumbling away from the beam's center, then turned to stone himself while watching her with worry.

"Dad!!" Millis, who had fallen to the ground, ignored her pain as tears instantly burst forth.

But it was too late.

All that remained for her was Argus's stone statue, still looking at her with worry.

"Look out!"

Korrina didn't know Argus and Millis's identities. Seeing Yveltal attacking again, she quickly moved to help the girl Millis, with Lucario close beside her.

"Metagross! Aggron!"

Steven threw two Poké Balls, his expression extremely grave.

The previous scene had happened too quickly, but he'd seen it all.

Even Aegislash's King's Shield couldn't resist Yveltal's Oblivion Wing—Protect would probably have the same result.

Contact meant petrification, regardless of state or ability!

This was the most troublesome attack he'd ever seen.

"Yveltal's Oblivion Wing absorbs life force to supplement itself. Don't make contact—use energy to block it." Johan had watched the father-daughter petrification scene and secretly sighed.

Still too soft-hearted.

"Gengar, Dark Void!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Swoosh—

A black shadow swept past from Johan's side, quickly appearing in front of Korrina and Millis. With arms spread and a grinning smile, a massive black hole instantly formed.

Boom!!!

The crimson beam disappeared without a trace the moment it contacted the black hole, as if swallowed.

Seeing this scene, Korrina immediately showed delight and shouted:

"Gengar's amazing!"

Steven was also somewhat surprised.

He hadn't expected that the petrifying Oblivion Wing from Yveltal could be blocked!

Johan and Gengar demonstrated to everyone what it meant to block with energy rather than body.

At the same time.

In the Distortion World, Giratina, who was holding a teacup and watching the show, tilted its head slightly. As a gap opened, thick death aura poured in, petrifying everything on the already devastated island.

Death?

Tch~

Giratina calmly turned back to continue watching shows, carefully sipping its tea.

Calm down.

It was already used to this.

But while Giratina was calm, Yveltal, who had fired the Oblivion Wing beam, wasn't so calm.

Its crimson eyes swept over and fell on Gengar.

Screech—!!

Wings flapped with a long cry.

Massive dark aura surged wildly from its body, as if even the air was about to be petrified.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar grinned with hands on its hips.

Death God, just this?

"Don't get careless. Yveltal just awakened. That attack... probably didn't even have thirty percent of its full power." Johan immediately warned.

When true death power descended, even black holes would be petrified under Oblivion Wing!

"Ka-kaah?"

Thirty percent?

Gengar looked down and counted on its fingers—one times three equals three, two times three equals six, three times three equals fifteen, four times three equals twelve...

It shook its head vigorously.

Forget counting.

Anyway, it was very powerful!

"Teacher."

Steven halted atop his shiny Metagross, bringing his massive Aggron to Johan's side.

"Try to dodge as much as possible. If you really can't dodge, use life or death-side energy to counter." Johan said seriously.

Life and death-side?

This was quite difficult for Steven.

"We're not the main force against Yveltal—we're just buying time while it's newly awakened and weak, waiting for Xerneas to arrive."

Without Zygarde, only Xerneas could counter Yveltal.

But the problem was...

Where did that deer go?

They'd just been together. With Yveltal making such a commotion, it should have arrived by now, right?

"What... what should I do?" Diancie's eyes flickered as it clasped its hands to its chest, its voice trembling uncontrollably.

It didn't know what it could do or what it should do.

Earlier it had been immersed in the pain of being unable to save its kingdom and people. Now it had to face Yveltal.

Diancie, with no battle experience, was extremely panicked inside.

If not for Johan and the so-called "responsibility," it might have already run away.

"Run." Johan said flatly.

"Run... run?"

Diancie's face paled, hope appearing in its eyes, but its pride as a princess restrained the impulse to turn and flee.

"Johan..." Korrina wanted to speak.

Wasn't this a bit too hurtful, too damaging to self-esteem?

Even for her, Teacher Johan hadn't said to run...

But just as she was about to speak, Steven stopped her with his gaze.

Steven shook his head slightly.

Only one meaning.

Trust the teacher.

Indeed, just as Diancie was staggering and about to fall to the ground, Johan reached out to support it, his tone and expression gradually becoming gentle.

"If you can't do it..."

"Then believe in yourself."

"Believe in myself?" Diancie looked completely confused.

"Yes." Johan gently brushed away the dust that had settled on Diancie's pink diamonds, looking directly into its pink crystalline eyes with a magnetic voice:

"Believe in yourself. You are..."

"The Mythical Pokémon, Diancie!"

No need to be the Diamond Kingdom's princess, temporarily set aside the duty of saving the country and people, set aside the responsibility of fighting Yveltal, return to yourself, as a pure Pokémon—Diancie!

"I am... Diancie!"

Diancie's eyes burst with radiance.

Right.

I am Diancie, I am... a Mythical Pokémon!

Behold.

Diancie extended both hands, its gaze serious and determined. Facing Yveltal, which had gathered its dark aura and partially recovered its condition, facing the terrifying Oblivion Wing shooting toward them, brilliant light burst from its body.

A massive pink diamond instantly formed. When the Oblivion Wing beam struck it, it erupted with tremendous rumbling sounds.

Crack—

The enormous pink diamond shattered with a crash, and the Oblivion Wing beam dissipated as well. But Diancie showed no sign of discouragement.

I am Diancie, I am a Mythical Pokémon. I don't necessarily have to condense "Eternal Crystal"—as long as I can block Yveltal, that's success!

"Diancie's amazing." Korrina murmured.

She hadn't expected the usually gentle Diamond Kingdom Princess Diancie to possess such power.

"This is life-side power." Johan briefly explained to Steven.

Steven smiled helplessly.

Teacher, I can't do that.

"Ready?" Johan's expression became serious.

Steven also put away his helplessness and nodded firmly.

Every time he was with the teacher, he always faced this or that legendary power. He... was almost getting used to it.

Johan nodded approvingly.

Good. Get used to facing legendary Pokémon early—you'll need it when dealing with those fat fish later, Steven.

Steven had already taken out his pin, the key on it bursting with rainbow light.

"Metagross, Mega Evolution!"

"Gong—!!"

"Dragonite!"

Johan shouted, leaping up. A Poké Ball at his waist opened on its own as excited Dragonite appeared beneath him.

Smack!

He grabbed the protective gear.

Then he threw out another Poké Ball.

Ninetales and Tinkaton entered the field.

Facing the flying Yveltal with Dark and Flying-type attributes, Urshifu and Ceruledge would have difficulty performing.

"Cha!"

Seeing Yveltal, Tinkaton immediately felt filled with power, muscle definition appearing on its seemingly thin arms as it gripped its hammer handle tightly.

A big bird, hehe, it's a big bird!

This was much bigger than any Corviknight or Skarmory.

"Regieleki!"

He'd originally planned to find time to take it back to the Galar region, but didn't expect it to have another chance to battle.

Electric versus Flying—they had the basis to stall.

In Orrans Forest.

Xerneas, accompanied by dancing Vivillon and following Aromatisse, suddenly stopped.

Its blue eyes with hidden "X" symbols contracted as it looked toward the forest depths.

[Yveltal awakened?]

Yveltal's awakening was inevitable—Xerneas understood this clearly, and it could sense that Yveltal's awakening would be within the next few years.

It just hadn't expected it to be so sudden. It was somewhat unexpected.

However, regardless of when, since Yveltal had awakened, it had to go stop its destruction and damage to life. This was its duty as the "Life God."

It looked around the vibrant forest with some reluctance, then resolutely leaped toward the forest center.

Geosenge Town, in the Team Flare secret base beneath the Ultimate Weapon stone pillars.

"Lord Lysandre!"

Xerosic, one of Team Flare's five researchers wearing an orange-red suit and being quite portly, quickly found Team Flare's leader, Lysandre.

He was breathing heavily but his face was full of excitement.

"We've detected extraordinary energy fluctuations erupting from the center of Orrans Forest!"

"Energy?" Lysandre sat behind his desk with hands clasped under his chin, lifting his eyelids slightly to glance at Xerosic.

"Life energy! Massive life energy!" Xerosic's words were full of excitement.

Their planned "Ultimate Weapon" required powerful life energy to activate.

Orrans Forest, as a forest where Xerneas and Yveltal had once clashed, how could Team Flare, which had researched Kalos region history, not pay attention?

However.

In such a vast forest, even Team Flare would find it very difficult to locate Xerneas within it.

Moreover, even if they found Xerneas, they lacked the ability to capture it.

"This means Yveltal should have awakened again." Ripples appeared on Lysandre's calm face.

The Life God Xerneas and Death God Yveltal—the two legendary Pokémon of Kalos region legend!

But.

Many people didn't know that actually, in the Kalos region, there was another deity above these two legendary Pokémon!

That was from "The Legend of XYZ," the legendary "Z God" representing balance—Zygarde!

"We can't intervene in the clash between Xerneas and Yveltal."

Lysandre slowly stood up.

"But according to legend, when death awakens, life will fall into slumber." Xerosic said.

When the Life God slumbered, their Team Flare might have a chance to extract some life energy from it!

Of course.

This wasn't the most important thing right now.

Most importantly...

"Begin the operation." Lysandre waved his hand, issuing the highest order.

"Yes! Lord Lysandre!"

Not many people in the entire Pokémon world knew of the "Order God" Zygarde's existence.

And their Team Flare was already prepared to move against Zygarde!

Moreover, they had been preparing for this for a long time, just waiting for the right moment.

The clash between life and death attracted most attention—this was the perfect opportunity!

In a cave located at the edge corner of the Kalos region.

Dozens of Team Flare elite, led by three executives, finally cornered the legendary Zygarde in 50% form at the cave's depths!

"Finally driven it to a dead end!"

"Lord Lysandre's order—begin capture!"

Roar—

In the glowing green water, Zygarde's form was half-exposed as it roared, creating water waves with just its angry cry.

Team Flare's elite, along with their Pokémon, couldn't approach under this momentum-filled roar.

Buzz buzz buzz—

Zygarde's eyes flashed as it looked deeply at these people, then disappeared completely in the rolling waves.

[Humans are indeed untrustworthy—destroyers of order!]

"It escaped?"

"Where could it run to?"

"Search!"

"Screech!!!"

Yveltal, recovering better and better, flapped its wings violently, stirring up terrible storms that swept across the entire area.

"Regi—!!"

Rumble—

Massive thunder crashed down.

At this moment.

A graceful deer arrived stepping on seven-colored light, brilliant moonbeams shining down.

[I've come to help you!]

# 639: Nice to Meet You, Yveltal (Two-in-One Chapter)

[I've come to help you!]

Xerneas's voice echoed in Johan's mind.

"The main force is here!" Johan shouted to Steven.

The main force!

To truly restrain Yveltal, relying on just Johan and Steven, plus Regieleki, definitely wouldn't be enough. At most they could only delay for a while.

Unless Johan was willing to call for backup.

But given the current situation, at most he could only call Giratina.

The problem was, the Order God Zygarde was right there on his shoulder. Johan's understanding of it was limited to their previous communication and what he'd seen in anime. What kind of situation it really was... was hard to say.

If he called Giratina over, one representing death and one representing antimatter having a big battle... this forest would probably be completely destroyed. What Zygarde's reaction would be then...

Fortunately.

Xerneas was also in this forest. It was impossible for it not to sense Yveltal's awakening. As long as they could delay a bit until Xerneas arrived, things would be much easier.

Xerneas moved gracefully, leaping lightly like a deer, landing on a high slope with its antler-like branches blooming with seven-colored halos.

"Screech—!!"

Yveltal immediately noticed its "arch-nemesis" and temporarily abandoned its suppression of Regieleki, flapping its wings and stirring up black clouds while releasing wind blades that seemed almost physical.

Bang bang bang!!!

The air-formed blades were blocked by an invisible wall before they could reach Xerneas.

At the same time, the branch-like antlers atop Xerneas's head bloomed with moonlight-like radiance. In the dark clouds gathered by Yveltal, it was as if a hole had been torn open, with a beam of moonlight shining down.

Moonblast!

Boom!!

Yveltal raised its head and was immediately struck by the falling moonlight. It let out a long cry, using both wings to protect itself while bursting with thick blood-colored mist.

Bang—

Its wings suddenly spread open, the scattered moonlight shattering into crystalline fragments. Yveltal's wings showed some scorched marks, but under the floating blood-colored mist around it, they visibly recovered at an incredible speed.

Xerneas's attack completely enraged Yveltal, which let out a sharp cry and fired an extremely terrifying destructive beam.

Crack!!

Xerneas's barrier shattered instantly, the terrifying impact directly hitting its body, causing a mournful cry as its form was shrouded in mist.

However.

If even Yveltal could recover itself by absorbing life energy, then naturally Xerneas, as the Life God, could do the same. Another brilliant Moonblast fell.

But this time.

Yveltal, gradually recovering from its awakening, actually dodged with a flash, using blood mist as a substitute to avoid the Moonblast.

Buzz—

Vigorous life force spread from Xerneas's body, a circle of life-aura energy radiating outward with it at the center.

Wherever it passed.

The originally lush forest became even more abundant, trees sprouting new branches, flowers blooming new buds, grass growing tender shoots.

Even in those decayed areas destroyed by Yveltal, new life burst forth.

Fairy Aura!

It collided with Yveltal's Dark Aura on the level of auras.

But seeing this scene, Johan couldn't help frowning.

In the anime, Yveltal and Xerneas hadn't fought. After seeing Xerneas appear, Yveltal had immediately left.

Theoretically, the Life God and Death God, these corresponding Pokémon, should have similar strength.

Even more so, as a Fairy-type Pokémon facing the Dark-type Yveltal, Xerneas should have the attribute advantage.

And indeed, Xerneas's Moonblast left Yveltal only able to dodge and defend.

But the problem was...

Yveltal could fly.

This became quite troublesome.

As everyone knew, in Pokémon battles, flying was quite "cheap." When one side could fly while the other couldn't, the initiative often belonged to the flying side.

After all, this wasn't a game where moves could hit regardless of whether you could fly or not.

In the real Pokémon world, flying Pokémon simply had more mobility than those that couldn't fly.

Moreover.

Xerneas's signature move was Geomancy.

[Geomancy: Charges for a turn, then when charging ends, the user's Special Attack rises by 2 stages, Special Defense rises by 2 stages, and Speed rises by 2 stages.]

It looked like a very overpowered buff move.

If placed on an ordinary Pokémon, it would indeed be so, but placed on a legendary Pokémon that mastered partial authority...

Authority power was the foundation for them to defeat other legendary Pokémon.

In other words.

Xerneas had more than enough defense against Yveltal, but offense... depended on the situation.

No wonder last time Xerneas needed to borrow the power of the Fairy Plate to completely defeat Yveltal.

Screech!!!

Another long cry. Seeing its Dark Aura being pushed back by Xerneas's Fairy Aura, Yveltal didn't hesitate to release the beam of Oblivion Wing!

Buzz—

Xerneas once again raised a barrier constructed from life energy.

In terms of pure power confrontation, both sides were evenly matched.

"Still need to get involved..." Johan sighed lightly, nodding to Steven.

"Dragonite, Thunder!"

"Regieleki, Thunder Cage!"

"Victini, Victory Star!"

"Mega Metagross, Meteor Mash!"

Under the low, dark clouds, light from move releases flickered.

"Vii~!"

Victini revealed itself, showing a fang-toothed smile as it made a cheerful "yeah" gesture toward Yveltal.

Yveltal seemed to sense something, quickly folding its wings to abandon suppressing Xerneas, rapidly maneuvering. Regieleki's Thunder Cage barely grazed its edge as it dodged.

Bang!!

The Thunder Cage hit the ground, exploding large amounts of dirt.

Boom!!

Mega Metagross's Meteor Mash, fired from its crossed four massive arms, was also blocked by the rising blood-colored mist from Yveltal.

But these attacks from "insects" made Yveltal angry again, letting out a cry full of rage.

Bang!!

Before it could even cry out fully, a bright, massive lightning bolt struck straight down, hitting Yveltal and cutting off its cry abruptly.

Dragonite's Thunder!

Huh?

Steven, half-crouched on Mega Metagross's back, couldn't help looking at Teacher Johan and his Dragonite with surprise.

Regieleki's Thunder Cage and Mega Metagross's Meteor Mash hadn't hit, but Dragonite's Thunder had connected?

This move with naturally low accuracy without rain support...

Even more so.

Sizzle—

Sparks of electricity rose from Yveltal's body.

Paralysis?

Though it didn't affect Yveltal much, still...

"Worthy of being Teacher." Steven murmured.

"Xerneas, you said earlier... Yveltal also has a Plate fragment, right?" Johan asked using aura.

Hearing this, Xerneas was stunned.

[Yes, yes it does.]

"Then feel free to go all out. The matter of restraining Yveltal's mobility..."

Johan took out the key stone from his pocket that was radiating heat, glowing with rainbow colors!

Gengar grinned, appearing behind Yveltal under its somewhat surprised gaze.

"Ka-kaah!"

Johan held up the key stone: "Gengar, Mega Evolution!"

"Ka-kaah—!!"

Brilliant evolutionary light burst in mid-air.

Under everyone's gaze, Johan raised the key stone high, creating a resonance bond with Gengar.

Gengar showed a fierce grin, opening a golden eye on its forehead, fists sprouting spikes, body expanding while black mist spread.

"Is this Teacher Johan's Mega Evolution?" Korrina below watched with shining eyes, clenching her fists.

This was exactly the kind of Mega Evolution she and her Lucario longed for.

Though she'd seen it several times on TV broadcasts, witnessing it firsthand felt completely different.

"Johan... Gengar..."

Diancie clasped her hands to her chest, pink pupils reflecting the Gengar wrapped in brilliant colors.

Facing the legendary Yveltal, Diancie felt weak just looking directly at it. She hadn't expected Johan and Gengar to be able to confront it.

"Believing in your own power?"

In Diancie's pupils, a crystalline light faintly flickered, becoming brighter and brighter.

The most surprised was actually Xerneas.

What Korrina and Diancie couldn't sense, it could.

On Gengar's body, Xerneas sensed a power between life and death, and this power...

"Screech!!"

Being hit by Thunder and sensing the Mega-evolved Gengar appearing directly behind it, Yveltal became completely furious.

These weak insects not only dared attack it, but even dared come to its side?

Did they really not know how to write the word "death"?

Buzz—

Yveltal didn't even turn around, a surge of death aura spread out again, extending toward Gengar.

Johan's expression was odd.

Don't you know about "evolution invincibility"?

Moreover...

Gengar was already a ghost—what was there to fear from death aura?

"Ka-kaah!"

As the rainbow-colored Mega Evolution symbol flashed and disappeared, Gengar successfully evolved into Mega Gengar!

And.

A black mist also spread from its body.

This was Ghost-type energy.

Huh?

Xerneas raised its head, the surprise in its eyes growing stronger.

It felt like...

The Ghost-type energy released by Mega Gengar was somewhat similar to its Fairy Aura and Yveltal's Dark Aura?

Ghost Aura?

Similarly.

Yveltal, which had originally wanted to use Dark Aura to suppress Mega Gengar, also sensed Gengar's Ghost-type energy fluctuation.

Actually, if we traced Gengar's Ghost-type energy back to its origin, it started with Agatha, one of Kanto's Elite Four.

From Agatha's Gengar, or more precisely, from the "Ghost Legion" Gengar belonging to Agatha, it learned some applications of Ghost-type energy.

The difference was.

Agatha's Gengar relied on a massive "Ghost Legion" to provide Ghost energy supply, thus constructing Agatha's "Ghost Legion system."

Johan's Gengar didn't have such a massive legion, so under normal circumstances, Gengar couldn't release Ghost-type energy to this extent, but after Mega Evolution it could.

If someone looked down from satellite through the thick clouds right now, they would discover.

Yveltal's Dark Aura and Xerneas's Fairy Aura formed two colliding energy forces in the forest.

And at the center of these two energy forces, in the middle of the blood-colored death circle and emerald life circle, appeared another black energy circle, much smaller.

It really had figured out something... Johan was somewhat surprised.

Earlier he'd jokingly thought Gengar's ghost energy coverage was a "Ghost Field," but now it seemed more like a "Ghost Aura."

Yveltal's Dark Aura hadn't petrified Gengar as it intended.

Its aura was blocked by the equally "death"-attributed Ghost energy.

"Gengar, Will-O-Wisp!"

After Gengar completed Mega Evolution, Johan's commands didn't slow down.

"Ka-kaah~"

Mega Gengar smiled as it grabbed ghostly blue flames and threw them at Yveltal.

Sizzle—

Signs of burning appeared on Yveltal, which had failed to petrify Mega Gengar with its Dark Aura.

For Johan to truly confront Yveltal was a bit much, but if it was just slightly restraining Yveltal and creating output opportunities for Xerneas, that was Johan's specialty.

"Screech!!"

The burned Yveltal violently flapped its wings, wind stirring up wind blades that mercilessly slashed toward Mega Gengar.

"Ka-kaah~"

But Mega Gengar chuckled mischievously, having prepared long ago. It tore open the space beside it and dove in with a diving posture, avoiding Yveltal's attack.

Before Yveltal could use life energy to recover from the burn, another bright lightning bolt fell from the sky.

Rumble!!

Thunder rolled.

The golden sparks on Yveltal became even more intense.

Taking advantage of the sluggishness caused by the electric current, the interference and restraint brought by Mega Gengar, Regieleki's second Thunder Cage finally successfully bound Yveltal.

"Now!" Johan's voice exploded in Xerneas's mind.

Xerneas, surprised by Mega Gengar's abilities, quickly reacted. The clouds in the sky tore open another hole, moonlight shining down.

"Screech—!!"

The pained Yveltal roared.

"We really suppressed it?" Korrina rubbed her eyes.

This was the legendary "Death God"! According to some people, a first-class legendary!

It was actually being restrained by Teacher Johan leading his Pokémon?

Creating output opportunities for Xerneas.

Steven also smoothly joined in.

He and Mega Metagross couldn't restrain Yveltal, but they could output damage like Xerneas.

"Metagross, Meteor Mash!"

"Gong!!"

Mega Metagross clenched its four iron fists, metal-gleaming shock waves following the moonlight, smashing into Yveltal.

After successive attacks and restraints, Yveltal fell toward the ground.

But it quickly controlled its body, rapidly recovering through absorbed life energy while turning its vengeful gaze toward Johan.

Those crimson eyes made Johan's heart skip a beat.

Oh no.

I've become the MT.

"It's trying to recover!" Johan rode Dragonite to quickly distance himself while giving commands again.

"Ka-kaah!"

Mega Gengar emerged from a space rift, facing Yveltal which was trying to recover. Without hesitation, it threw Toxic, then turned and dove back into the rift.

Poison spread.

Regieleki transformed both arms into dozens of surging lightning bolts, full firepower!

Before Xerneas arrived, as the Electric Pillar, it had also been the "main damage dealer."

Rumble!!

Rampant lightning washed over Yveltal, interrupting its life energy recovery.

But Yveltal seemed fixated on Johan, recognizing that he was commanding from the center. It simply abandoned recovery, blood-colored wings flapping as it shot crimson Oblivion Wing beams.

"Run!"

Johan told Dragonite without hesitation.

"Garruu—!!"

Dragonite didn't hesitate either, violently flapping its wings. Its speed instantly peaked as it flew toward the distance.

The Oblivion Wing beam followed closely behind. Just as it was about to catch up, Dragonite's body glowed white with faint green mixed in.

Extreme Speed!

Damn.

Johan, gripping the protective gear tightly, cursed internally.

Too fast!

"Metagross, Hyper Beam!" Steven provided timely support.

The Yveltal releasing Oblivion Wing was the perfect target.

"Gong!!"

A bright white beam shot from Mega Metagross's pincers, the fierce impact directly catching Yveltal off guard and forcing it to interrupt its Oblivion Wing.

Xerneas, like Mega Metagross, wouldn't miss this opportunity, dropping another moonbeam.

But this time Yveltal seemed to have really lost its temper.

After forcibly taking attacks from Mega Metagross and Xerneas, it actually flapped its wings and chased after Dragonite.

"Son of a..."

This time Johan couldn't hold back and cursed aloud.

What the hell!

Yveltal was actually targeting him?

Then Korrina below watched as...

Teacher Johan rode Dragonite fleeing in front while Yveltal rolled blood mist chasing behind. Ninetales on the ground did its best to condense ice walls for interference, and Tinkaton threw large rocks...

Mega Gengar appeared behind Yveltal in completely unexpected ways, throwing restraint moves.

To prevent Yveltal's Dark Aura from further damaging the forest, Dragonite was still flying in circles in the sky.

Regieleki and Mega Metagross provided damage from the middle.

And the main force Xerneas, positioned at the edge and unable to reach Yveltal, could only provide ranged support.

Watching Yveltal's injuries worsen and the negative effects on it increase, yet it stubbornly refused to give up chasing Johan.

Korrina stood with her mouth agape, somewhat incredulous at this scene.

No matter how she thought about it, she never would have imagined the final situation would turn out like this.

Shouldn't it be Xerneas and Yveltal having a direct confrontation, with Teacher Johan and Senior Steven providing support from the sides?

But honestly...

"Teacher Johan is amazing."

Anyone else in his place definitely couldn't outfly Yveltal.

Screech!!!

Yveltal fired Oblivion Wing again.

And possibly because its awakening process continued, this time Yveltal's attack was not only not weaker due to physical damage, but actually became faster and stronger.

Johan's face was pale, his stomach very uncomfortable.

But there was no choice.

Facing Yveltal's "kamikaze" fighting style...

He patted Dragonite's back, preparing to enter Outrage state.

Being uncomfortable was better than being petrified.

Witnessing this process wasn't just Korrina, but also Diancie.

It found that it wanted to help Johan, but... seemed unable to do anything.

Just like when it wanted to save the kingdom as Diamond Kingdom's princess and condense new "Eternal Crystal," but could never manage it.

How am I so useless... Diancie's heart filled with dejection.

"Go Teacher Johan!!" Korrina cupped her hands like a megaphone and shouted toward the sky, then felt it wasn't enough. She said to Diancie beside her, "Diancie, let's cheer for Teacher Johan together."

"Cheer..." Diancie looked up, full of dejection.

"Can we... only cheer?"

Only cheer?

Korrina clenched her fists, contrasting sharply with Diancie's dejection.

"Right now... yes."

She raised her fist, extending her finger to point at Johan, "But in the future, I'll definitely become a trainer like Teacher Johan! My growth will definitely surprise the teacher!"

Seeing the fire in Korrina's eyes, Diancie was stunned.

"Believe in yourself, Diancie." Korrina gently punched Diancie's shoulder encouragingly.

"Believe... in myself."

Diancie looked down at its hands.

Slowly clenching them bit by bit.

At the same time.

Johan suddenly felt something heating up in his pocket. After brief hesitation, gripping the protective gear with one hand, he reached toward his pocket with the other.

Huh?

A diamond?

Taking it out to look, it was actually the pink diamond Diancie had given him a few days ago.

Hadn't it already dispersed?

At the time, Diancie couldn't control its power, and diamonds would dissipate on their own within ten minutes at most. To avoid affecting Diancie, he hadn't touched it much, pretending the diamond was still there.

Schrödinger's diamond.

As long as he didn't take it out, the diamond would always be there.

He just hadn't expected this diamond to actually still exist!

At the center of the pink diamond, a Mega Evolution symbol flickered faintly.

In the manga, Diancie gave a diamond to Bonnie, and that diamond never disappeared...

Looking at this diamond, Johan had a thought. Using aura again, his voice echoed in Diancie's mind below.

"Diancie, the diamond is still here!"

"Huh?"

Diancie looked up.

It saw Johan in the sky, riding on Dragonite's back, waving at it. That crystalline pink diamond was particularly eye-catching.

"The diamond... is still here..." Diancie's eyes grew brighter.

The diamond was still here!

"This is your power, Diancie. Believe in yourself!"

Believe in yourself!

Buzz—

Brilliant evolutionary light suddenly burst from Diancie's body.

"Diancie?" Korrina beside it was greatly surprised.

The diamond on Diancie's head became heart-shaped, the diamond crown dropped white veils, the crystalline transparent diamond dress was like wearing a perfect, flawless wedding gown...

"Mega Evolution?" Korrina murmured.

The sacred Diamond Princess!

Mega Diancie!

"Mega Diancie?" Steven also noticed this scene, looking at Mega Diancie's current appearance with slight distraction.

"This is my power!"

Mega Diancie raised both hands, pink life energy gathering in its palms.

Ding ding ding—

Crystalline pink diamonds instantly formed, sweeping toward Yveltal in a diamond-based storm.

Diamond Storm!

When this storm reached between Yveltal and Johan, it gathered into an enormous pink diamond, the Eternal Crystal!

Yveltal's Oblivion Wing struck it, trying to absorb the abundant life energy within, but the diamond radiated brilliant sacred light, blocking all the blood-colored energy outside the diamond.

It blocked it!

This was Oblivion Wing from Yveltal after it had fully recovered from its awakening state!

Yveltal's gaze also fell on Mega Diancie, eyes showing surprise.

Another one?

That's right, another one!

Taking advantage of Mega Diancie blocking the Oblivion Wing, Xerneas's attack followed immediately.

At this point.

Johan led Mega Gengar, Dragonite, and Regieleki in restraint, Steven and Xerneas provided damage, Mega Diancie handled defense...

Yveltal found itself unable to advance or retreat.

Moreover.

As the restraints deepened, the negative status effects stacking on Yveltal increased. Even as a legendary Pokémon, it couldn't withstand Mega Gengar constantly applying negative effects.

No wait.

Paralysis, burn, poison, freeze, plus occasional sleep interference—even Mega Gengar was getting relaxed, gaining opportunities to beat up Yveltal.

"Ka-kaah!"

Mega Gengar spat on its fist, then appeared behind Yveltal and delivered a close-range Giga Impact to its head.

Bang!!

Yveltal fell from the sky, this time unable to control its body mid-air, crashing heavily to the ground and raising large clouds of dust.

Looking at the fallen Yveltal, Xerneas was briefly dazed.

Honestly.

It had battled Yveltal many times over the long years, and they would fight every time they met, but never had it been this easy.

Even last time when it carried the Fairy Plate and suppressed Yveltal, it hadn't been this relaxed.

They'd suppressed it just like that?

Not only it was dazed, but also Johan's shoulder-riding Zygarde core.

It wasn't that Johan's strength was so powerful as to shock Zygarde.

It acknowledged that Johan and his Pokémon did have the strength to briefly confront Yveltal, but...

That confrontation and restraint method made Zygarde's heart tremble.

Good grief.

All those negative effects on Yveltal made even it feel scared.

The Zygarde core perched on Johan's shoulder glanced at him, secretly deciding this human could only be friend, not foe!

Winning or losing aside, those continuous, expertly applied negative status moves... were enough to give anyone a hard time.

Moreover, their coordination was truly seamless.

When Gengar used poison, other Pokémon absolutely wouldn't also use poison, but would use burn, freeze, paralysis and other status effects, highlighting perfect... coordination and expertise.

More importantly...

These negative effects actually worked on legendary Pokémon.

Gengar's poison, burn, Ninetales' freeze, even Johan's hypnosis...

A human's hypnosis could actually affect legendary Pokémon—who would believe that?

Yveltal didn't even get chances to use life energy for recovery.

Of course, without Xerneas providing main damage and Diancie's awakening defense, Johan and Steven alone trying to suppress Yveltal would be nearly impossible.

[Stop!]

Just as the next attack was about to land, a hoarse voice filled with suppressed anger roared in their minds.

This voice...

Yveltal?

"You can talk?" Johan, riding Dragonite as it landed, looked surprised.

He'd thought Yveltal couldn't communicate, was just a being existing purely for destruction, so he'd given up trying to communicate with Yveltal from the start.

Yveltal: "..."

[What do you want?]

Yveltal's gaze swept over.

Old rival Xerneas, the mighty Mega Metagross, thunder giant Regieleki, the elusive Gengar, the sacred and beautiful Mega Diancie... finally its gaze still fell on Johan.

Actually, Yveltal's sixth sense was quite accurate—it felt that everything before it was brought by this human, so it had fiercely chased Johan earlier, trying to eliminate him first.

However, things went against its wishes. It stubbornly attacked with various negative effects, ultimately becoming a living target.

"Stop," Johan said simply, just two words, noticing Yveltal's gaze.

[I am death. How can I stop?]

Life and death were inherently "rules." When life became too abundant, death would appear to harvest the excess.

"Then there's no choice."

Johan rolled up his sleeves, took out the Wheel of Time, and said to Mega Gengar: "Call for backup!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar grinned, tearing open a space rift to reveal the Distortion World.

At the same time, the calmed Yveltal finally sensed the auras on Johan besides Arceus—Ideal and Truth, Space and Time...

Good grief!

Was this human even human?

[Stop, stop, stop! I'll stop!]

Yveltal roared.

At worst, it just wouldn't harvest all life in one go. It could take it slowly...

Seeing the roaring Yveltal, Johan nodded with satisfaction.

"I heard... you have a Plate fragment?"

Yveltal looked toward Xerneas, who slightly turned its head away.

Damn.

[Here, here, here, can't I give it to you?]

Hearing this, Johan showed a brilliant smile, radiating "kind" aura.

"Then... nice to meet you, Yveltal."

Yveltal: "..."
