# 640: Xerneas's Gift (Two-in-One Chapter)

Yveltal very "generously" gave out another Fairy Plate fragment.

But speaking of which.

This thing really was useless to it. As a Dark-type Pokémon, what would it do with a Fairy Plate fragment—restrain itself?

And Xerneas quietly mentioned:

This Fairy Plate fragment was formed when it suppressed Yveltal last time, reformed from the life energy that had been absorbed by Yveltal's Oblivion Wing. It could increase the speed at which it recovered itself using life energy.

Though not by much.

But it did have some use.

However, Johan still shamelessly took it, since this thing would be much more useful in his hands than in Yveltal's.

With this.

Ninetales and Tinkaton, two little ones who weren't particularly proficient in Fairy-type moves, each received a Fairy Plate fragment. No more passing it back and forth, no more taking daily turns.

[Is that enough?]

Yveltal's tone was still not very good, somewhat aggressive.

But Johan quite appreciated its "rebellious and untamed" appearance, nodding:

"Thanks for your trouble, Yveltal. These... consider them compensation."

Saying this, he took out several boxes of energy cubes and placed them in front of Yveltal.

Hm?

Looking at those energy cubes, Yveltal was stunned, not having expected things to develop this way. For a moment, its previously bitter and resentful expression softened considerably.

[If there's nothing else, I'm leaving!]

Saying this, it picked up the energy cubes in its mouth, flapped its wings, and prepared to leave.

However, Johan quickly asked:

"Wait a moment!"

[What else?!]

Yveltal's eyes widened, becoming unfriendly again.

"I just wanted to ask, did you see King AZ?" Johan asked.

AZ had disappeared early in the morning. Though he said he was going to clear his mind, Johan felt... Yveltal's sudden awakening was somewhat related to him.

Hearing Johan ask about AZ, Yveltal snorted coldly with displeasure.

[He has already paid the price he should pay!]

After saying this, it flapped its blood-colored wings again, spreading them as it flew toward the outside of Orrans Forest.

Where it would go, no one knew.

But presumably, it wouldn't be like when it awakened this time, wantonly destroying and devouring all life.

"Cha..."

Tinkaton hugged its hammer, looking regretful.

Such a nice big bird...

Too bad it was too strong to keep.

However, since it gave a Fairy Plate fragment, it should count as a "good" bird, right?

[Don't worry, when Yveltal first awakens, it's mostly driven by instinct. After regaining consciousness, it won't go too far.]

Xerneas's gentle voice echoed in everyone's minds.

Everyone nodded thoughtfully.

At worst, they'd just beat it up again.

"What about those petrified Pokémon..." Steven spoke up.

Xerneas didn't speak, but its actions gave Steven an answer.

It gently raised its head, the branch-like antlers on top blooming with seven-colored light. A Fairy Aura spread from beneath its feet, vigorous life force rippling outward.

Some of the closer petrified Pokémon gradually recovered under this power.

This included the master thief Argus.

"Dad!!" Seeing the recovered Argus, Millis directly threw herself at him, tears streaming down.

The joy of reunion was certainly delightful, but...

Johan gave Regieleki a look.

"Regi..."

Regieleki scratched its head and made a throat-slitting gesture.

Kill them again?

Johan: "..."

"Watch them." Johan said helplessly.

No matter how touching Argus's earlier behavior of protecting his daughter was, it wasn't a reason to eliminate the "crimes" on their record.

"Eleki!"

Regieleki suddenly understood.

[Follow me.]

Xerneas moved with light steps toward the deep pit where Yveltal had been sleeping.

As it moved, the coverage of the Fairy Aura gradually expanded.

Soon.

At the deep pit in the center of Orrans Forest, by the dim pond, the seven-colored aura full of life energy swept past.

AZ, who had been petrified sitting on a rock by the pond, slowly recovered under this power.

"Jo-Johan?"

When AZ opened his eyes and saw Johan, Steven, and the others, his expression was somewhat dazed.

Wasn't he already dead?

"Xer-Xerneas!"

When AZ saw Xerneas behind Johan and the others, he suddenly stood up.

But Xerneas gently stepped back half a step.

Seeing this, AZ smiled bitterly and stopped trying to approach.

"King AZ, what were you..." Korrina couldn't help asking.

Had AZ awakened Yveltal, trying to use Yveltal's power to seek death?

AZ turned to look at the dim pond, saying in a low voice:

"I originally wanted to settle down here, partly to express my apology to Yveltal, and partly hoping that when Yveltal awakened someday, it could eliminate some hatred and resentment through me."

He hadn't expected to awaken Yveltal, just felt that if Yveltal woke up and petrified him first, perhaps it could spare one Pokémon's life.

"But you awakened Yveltal just by approaching?" Johan spoke up.

AZ nodded, "I didn't expect it either..."

If Xerneas was unwilling to see him, then the only one he could find was Yveltal.

[Yveltal sensed your aura and awakened early from the Cocoon of Destruction.]

At this time, Xerneas, which had stepped back, turned its head and softly explained the reason.

Hearing this, AZ was stunned, "So... that's how it was..."

Saying this, he suddenly shivered and grabbed Johan's shoulder, urgently asking: "Then what about Yveltal now? The situation outside..."

"It's already over, Mr. AZ." Johan said.

AZ immediately breathed a long sigh of relief, gratitude appearing in his eyes as he looked at Johan, Steven, Korrina, and the others.

But Johan continued: "It said you've already paid the price you should pay, and it forgives you."

"For-forgives me?"

AZ was completely stunned, his eyes reddening.

"Good... good..."

What else could be said about forgiveness earned with one's life?

Johan looked toward Xerneas.

Noticing his gaze, Xerneas sighed lightly.

[These years, I've seen everything you've done in Orrans Forest—planting trees, helping wild Pokémon.]

"Just trying to do... things that might make amends..."

[Since you've been given another chance at life, live well.]

Saying this, Xerneas lightly leaped, jumping above the deep pit.

AZ was stunned again, subconsciously looking at Johan.

Johan smiled: "Mr. AZ, it seems... they all forgive you."

[Johan, come up.]

Xerneas, which had jumped above the pit, didn't leave but called to Johan.

"Coming."

Johan stood on tiptoe, wanting to pat AZ's shoulder but found... he couldn't reach, so he patted his arm instead:

"Mr. AZ, I might... know where your Floette is. We'll talk about it later."

Without waiting for AZ's reaction, he got on Dragonite and came above the pit again.

Xerneas lowered its head, trying to look directly into Johan's eyes, saying with gratitude:

[Thank you for your help, messenger of Arceus, Johan.]

"No need to be polite." Johan waved his hand, "I just happened to encounter it and had the ability to intervene, so I did."

"Besides, I didn't come away empty-handed."

Two Fairy Plate fragments—just this alone was worth more than the effort.

Moreover.

Gengar had learned something from Xerneas's Fairy Aura and Yveltal's Dark Aura, confirming that its previously uncertain move that could be either a field or weather effect was indeed an aura.

Johan didn't know when his family's Gengar had started increasingly departing from the category of ordinary Pokémon.

This made Johan sigh.

How bold the ghost is, how productive the moves are. As long as you dare to think, there's nothing you won't dare to do.

Piecing together here and there, copying and learning everywhere, you can always learn something.

Facts proved.

Pokémon's potential might have limits, but Pokémon's imagination was endless.

And it wasn't just Pokémon.

Like the Draconid people of the Hoenn region, they recorded Rayquaza's "Dragon Ascent" on scrolls to help Rayquaza learn better.

But as for where the original "Dragon Ascent" came from and why Rayquaza needed to learn it again, that was unknown.

However, this also illustrated one thing.

Pokémon moves, even legendary Pokémon moves, weren't impossible to learn as long as compatibility matched.

The difference was just the difficulty of learning, and whether there was direct instruction from Pokémon made a big difference.

Of course, the biggest difference was definitely that legendary Pokémon, especially so-called "first-class legendaries" like Xerneas, weren't truly powerful because of their moves, but because of the "authority" they possessed.

Xerneas could manipulate life force, Yveltal could absorb life force—this was what other Pokémon couldn't learn.

Xerneas smiled.

What Johan gained was what he deserved, which didn't mean Xerneas had nothing to show for it.

[Your Gengar is learning auras, right?]

Xerneas nodded, saying: [Why not let it come out and learn more?]

"Ka-kaah?"

Before Johan could speak, Gengar emerged from behind him.

Learning auras, me? Me?

[Also, your Fairy-type Pokémon can accept my aura baptism.]

What a great gift...

Johan didn't hesitate, throwing out Poké Balls to summon Ninetales and Tinkaton again.

"Oowoo?" Ninetales looked at the elegant Xerneas.

"Cha?"

Tinkaton, which had been holding its hammer preparing to nap, scratched its head.

Johan still trusted Xerneas quite a bit. After all, this was one of the few legendary Pokémon that wouldn't immediately start fighting upon meeting.

[Here we go.]

Xerneas gave a gentle reminder.

Buzz—

From its body, an extremely powerful Fairy-type energy immediately released. The already spreading Fairy Aura surged again, even greater than when it had infused Diancie with Fairy Aura earlier.

"Ka-kaah~(_)"

Gengar wore its Wise Glasses, rubbing its chin while watching and nodding.

I see, I see...

The purest Fairy-type energy fell on Ninetales and Tinkaton, primarily... on Ninetales.

Both Fairy-type Pokémon—Ninetales excelled in Special Attack while Tinkaton was better at Physical Attack. Although Xerneas was good at both offensive stats, its battle style and abilities were more suited to Special Attack.

So...

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales' snow-white fur was immediately dyed with a layer of crystalline pink, its nine tails moving like flexible swimming fish. In its azure eyes, Xerneas's figure was reflected.

[More talented than expected.]

Xerneas's entire body was wrapped in energy, its feet slowly growing roots as its whole form gradually transformed toward a tree-like appearance.

Hm?

Witnessing this scene, Johan was somewhat surprised.

Xerneas... was going to sleep?

The peculiar Fairy Aura continued to overflow.

[Release your Misty Terrain.]

"Oowoo~~"

Ninetales raised its head lightly and howled, a light pink aura spreading from its body.

Tinkaton grabbed its hammer.

I don't know how...

"Feel it carefully." Johan patted Tinkaton's head.

Oh!

Tinkaton immediately became serious.

Johan's heart couldn't help but sigh.

Such rich Fairy energy—probably unique in the entire Pokémon world right now. No wonder the Kalos region was considered the origin of Fairy-type Pokémon. Xerneas's existence was key.

Even he felt his body seemed to be cheering, every cell in his body benefiting.

My lifespan shouldn't be extended, should it? Johan thought.

Hm?

However, before he could pay much attention to his own changes, his aura detected that Ninetales' Misty Terrain was changing.

That Fairy-type energy... seemed to be drawing power from the vast earth.

"This is..."

[Using your human terminology, it's called 'Geomancy.']

Xerneas provided an explanation.

Geomancy!

Xerneas's signature move.

After charging for a while, it could greatly boost a Pokémon's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed!

If Ninetales could learn this move...

Wow, epic enhancement!

But... wouldn't this be a bit too unreasonable?

Even though legendary Pokémon moves weren't impossible to learn...

[Your Ninetales is very clever. It knows how to use 'Misty Terrain' to utilize Fairy-type energy.]

Even Xerneas couldn't help but praise.

"Of course."

Faced with Xerneas's praise for his Ninetales, Johan was quite like a father whose daughter had been complimented, accepting it without any reservation.

If Ninetales could learn Geomancy, combined with its own personality and characteristics—Special Attack and Special Defense boosted, plus increased speed, constantly building ice walls and Aurora Veil...

Perfect match!

Snow weather brought physical defense increases to Ice-type Pokémon.

Both defenses were now covered.

The opponent couldn't break through, couldn't catch up, and couldn't withstand Ninetales' attacks.

Just...

How was his elegant and charming Ninetales getting further and further down the path of being a "mobile tank"?

Xerneas smiled.

[Gengar and Tinkaton aren't bad either.]

Gengar could simulate auras, and Tinkaton...

Johan looked at Tinkaton.

He found this girl was actually sleeping while hugging her hammer?!

This was called "not bad"?

But when he carefully sensed with aura, he discovered... Tinkaton was actually absorbing the life energy from Xerneas's Fairy Aura through her hammer?

Oh no!

The hammer absorbing life energy wouldn't come alive, would it?

It would really become the main body!

[More importantly.]

Xerneas looked at Johan, its eyes showing recognition.

[I can sense their dependence and bond with you. You are the key to guiding their growth.]

Johan adjusted his glasses, "Cough, well, the little ones work hard themselves..."

Who knew how much energy he had to spend every day to keep the house from being demolished?

Wait, energy...

After receiving Xerneas's Fairy Aura baptism, his little ones' energy would probably...

Johan turned to look at Dragonite.

He found it staring at him with sparkling "innocent" eyes, blinking twice.

At the same time.

Johan also sensed that not only Dragonite, but even the Pokémon in their Poké Balls had more or less received Xerneas's gift.

Just like when Diancie had received Xerneas's Fairy Aura baptism earlier, everyone's level had improved!

He was doomed.

However.

As the Fairy Aura continued, the process of Xerneas transforming into a tree also continued. Its condition visibly became tired.

[I hope we can meet again next time.]

Xerneas's voice gradually diminished, and the rich Fairy Aura slowly dissipated.

Finally.

The Life God Xerneas transformed into what appeared to be a quite sturdy tree, quickly sprouting branches. The ground around its feet, which had withered and decayed due to Yveltal's power, regained vitality.

Grass slowly covered the ground.

Xerneas had fallen into slumber.

[It seems it really recognizes you all.]

At this time.

The Zygarde core that had been silent finally spoke.

"How so?"

The Zygarde core perched on Johan's shoulder looked at the dispersing clouds in the sky, bathing in the falling sunlight, its body seeming to shimmer slightly.

[Yveltal's awakening destined Xerneas's slumber.]

This was balance.

When life brought too much vitality, death would always take some away.

Such were the rules, unchangeable by anyone.

[But before sleeping, it gave you all the life energy it had accumulated.]

"Tsk..."

Johan clicked his tongue, not having expected Xerneas to give so much.

"Thank you, Xerneas. If there's a chance in the future, maybe we can meet again."

But if Xerneas slept for a thousand years, forget it.

"Ka-kaah?!"

Eh?! Asleep?

Gengar, who had been pondering auras, suddenly jumped up.

Oh no, oh no!

Gengar paced back and forth.

Earlier it had been thinking that since Xerneas was the Life God, and AZ had gained immortality through the "Ultimate Weapon's" life energy radiation, maybe Xerneas could... also grant Johan immortality.

But it had been busy pondering auras and forgot.

However, Gengar quickly calmed down.

No problem, no problem, I still have backup plans.

Gengar patted its chest and breathed a sigh of relief.

Johan looked puzzledly at Gengar, which was alternately anxious and relieved, not knowing what was going through the purple fatty's little brain.

He shook his head and looked at Ninetales.

"How is it?"

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales affectionately nuzzled Johan, then nodded.

Learned it!

Johan was overjoyed.

This way, Gengar's normal strength was roughly Champion-level main team standard. Adding Mega Evolution and various miscellaneous special abilities, in surprise situations, it probably had strength above ordinary Champion ace level.

Ninetales had been slightly behind before, but now with Xerneas's greatest gift, its strength might... also be above ordinary Champion main team level.

A huge power increase!

Moreover, this "calculation" was under normal circumstances. If they "went all out," that was another story entirely. Anyone could potentially "go all out."

Although "going all out" wasn't like "corruption," which directly tripled strength, at least the upper limit wasn't bad.

Tinkaton was still sleeping, so Johan put it directly into the Luxury Ball.

He'd see when it woke up. At most... the hammer came alive.

In the Pokémon world, swords and shields could come alive, so what was a hammer coming alive?

Look at the Galar region's Zacian and Zamazenta—they were called legendary Pokémon, but were just sword and shield "stands."

"Speaking of which, do all legendary Pokémon in your Kalos region like 'earth'?" Johan said to the Zygarde core on his shoulder.

[What do you mean?]

"Look, Xerneas's Geomancy is clearly a Fairy-type move but named 'earth.' People who don't know might think it's a Ground-type move. You also have a move called 'Thousand Arrows,' right?" Johan counted on his fingers.

Don't let Larvitar find out that Ninetales learned a move called "Geomancy" and frantically demand to learn it too.

[How do you know?!]

The Zygarde core was very surprised.

It hadn't acted many times, and last time... human technology hadn't developed to current levels. How could its moves be known?

Wait.

[I am Ground-type by nature!]

The Zygarde core protested.

Zygarde was Ground and Dragon-type.

"Oh, right... another 'land dragon,' quadruple weak to Ice."

Zygarde core: "..."

"Haha, just joking, don't take it too seriously." Johan laughed.

[How could I stoop to your level?]

"So when will you make a mecha for me to pilot?"

[What is a 'mecha'?]

Johan pouted, not getting the expected reaction, slightly disappointed.

"Next time when there's a chance, have Rotom transform and show you. Basically, it looks similar to your Complete Form."

"Rotom?"

Rotom blinked.

Transform into a mecha? Me?

[Then you'll probably be disappointed. When combined with my partner, I might not be so agreeable.]

The Zygarde core raised its head slightly, showing some pride.

"Speaking of which, where is your partner?"

[It...]

Mentioning Zygarde's other core, its expression became somewhat unnatural.

[I've temporarily lost contact with it, probably due to the interference from Yveltal and Xerneas's battle auras...]

Lost contact?

Johan was stunned.

Could it be... captured by Team Flare?

Was Zygarde this easy to catch?

"Xerneas actually... turned into a tree?!"

Korrina, who had just come up, saw the tree and exclaimed.

Following her, Steven, AZ, and others also came up.

Everyone was surprised that Xerneas had transformed into a tree and fallen asleep.

AZ stood before the tree, his surprise mixed with more emotion and gratitude.

"Thank you, Xerneas." AZ said sincerely.

Then turning around, he also said to Johan and the others: "And thank you all..."

"You worked hard yourself." Mega Diancie, who hadn't yet returned to normal, curved her eyes.

"By the way, Diancie, this is your diamond." Johan took out the pink diamond with the Mega Evolution symbol at its center.

But Diancie shook her head, saying softly: "This is proof of our friendship."

Hearing this, Johan smiled and didn't say anything more, just smilingly put it in his inner pocket.

Seeing this, Steven felt somewhat envious.

A pink diamond...

Such a big one.

As it left Diancie, the Mega Evolution energy in the diamond would slowly dissipate, returning to Diancie itself, but this diamond's significance was more valuable than the diamond itself.

At this time, Diancie slightly bowed.

"I'd like to invite everyone to visit the Diamond Kingdom."

Having regained confidence, Diancie's every gesture showed self-assurance.

It wanted to invite everyone to witness it creating the "Eternal Crystal."

Steven's eyes immediately brightened.

Diamond Kingdom?

Wouldn't that have many rare stones?

"Just don't mind that Larvitar can eat." Johan watched Steven and saw what he wanted to see, saying with satisfaction.

Diancie shook her head.

"No problem, all you can eat!"

It had witnessed Larvitar's appetite.

Highlighting confidence and generosity.

Tsk—

Just from the "generosity" aspect, Johan felt... Diancie and Steven were quite similar.

"Sorry, Diancie."

AZ apologized.

He looked at the tree Xerneas had become, saying seriously: "I want... to stay here and restore the forest with Xerneas."

"Mr. AZ..." Korrina grabbed his arm.

AZ smiled, "Not that meaning. Before, I was for repentance, for forgiveness. Now I... want to do this from my heart."

One was with some purpose, the other was from the heart. AZ felt relieved.

"Mm!" Diancie didn't feel disappointed either, nodding with approval, "There will be many opportunities in the future!"

"However, Mr. AZ." Johan said: "Won't you go see Floette first?"

Hearing this, AZ was stunned.

"Johan, you know where Floette is?"

"Roughly... guessed."

Johan looked toward a distant direction, "A thousand years ago, Mr. AZ went to the Hoenn region, right?"

"Hm?"

"You planted a tree."

AZ's body trembled slightly, "You mean..."

"If I'm not mistaken, Floette has been near that tree all along."

Though it hadn't forgiven AZ, Floette had used its own way to accompany AZ.

Or rather...

"You've never been lonely these thousands of years."

AZ had also been accompanying Floette in his way.

AZ tilted his head slightly, and under the sunlight, two crystal lines appeared on his cheeks.

"I..." AZ began hoarsely.

"Of course, I can also help you bring Floette here, so you can both accompany Xerneas together."

Johan knew AZ was conflicted. Having just decided to help Xerneas, leaving right after saying it would probably feel bad.

"Thank you..." AZ felt relieved, then somewhat excited despite himself.

Having lived over three thousand years, but hearing news about Floette, his mentality was still like a child's.

The decayed, deteriorated aura on him also improved considerably.

"You're welcome." Johan waved his hand.

It was just a matter of making another trip.

Anyway, his summer vacation was still long.

After visiting the Diamond Kingdom, he'd go see Valerie, whom Cynthia had already arranged to meet.

Although Ninetales and Tinkaton had both received Xerneas's blessing, learning more about Fairy-type cultivation knowledge and techniques... was never wrong.

Moreover, Valerie had promised to help design an outfit for him.

He couldn't stand her up.

Right.

"Diancie, please wait a moment for me."

Johan remembered Argus and Millis, the father-daughter thief duo.

Though they weren't his main target for coming to the Kalos region, they might know... about the Pokémon hunter group Johan was looking for.

"Mm!" Diancie nodded obediently.

Johan returned to where they had been before.

He saw...

Regieleki sitting on what looked like a bench-shaped rock, hands supporting its head, staring straight at Argus and his daughter, along with their Pokémon.

Zzzt zzzt zzzt—

A golden lightning cage prevented Argus and his daughter and their Pokémon from moving, huddled like quails in the cage.

Johan couldn't help laughing.

Especially seeing Regieleki sitting on the little bench and staring, he laughed even more heartlessly.

"Regi?"

Hearing the sound, Regieleki turned around.

"Well done, Regieleki." Johan couldn't help reaching out to pat Regieleki encouragingly.

But then...

Crack!

Just touching it, a jumping arc directly gave him a heart-chilling shock.

He'd forgotten that Regieleki was a pure electrical current creature. This touch... was no joke.

Johan truly experienced what Ash felt when taking a Thunderbolt, deciding to let Ash enjoy it himself in the future.

"Eleki..."

Seeing Johan get shocked, the simple Regieleki was like a child who'd made a mistake.

"It's fine, it's fine." Johan exhaled black smoke, waving repeatedly, "No problem, next time I'll get gloves that insulate against electricity."

Volkner's pair looked quite good.

"Regi!"

Hearing there was a solution, Regieleki immediately perked up, letting out a low but energetic call.

Had to say.

The ancient giants really had very simple minds. Regigigas was like this, and the Regi trio it created were the same.

However, who wouldn't want to be friends with simple folks?

Johan took out energy cubes as a small reward for Regieleki.

Regieleki wasn't polite either, immediately sitting on the ground and eating the energy cubes, while keeping its gaze on Argus and his daughter.

No wonder ruins large and small always had Regis guarding them. With this serious attitude, who wouldn't feel at ease?

Johan then sat on the "little bench" Regieleki had been using, under its guidance.

Looking at Argus and his daughter.

Choosing his words carefully.

"You two... want to go mining, or spend forty or fifty years in prison?"

Hearing this, both Argus and Millis's faces immediately went pale.

----------

Powerstones?

# 641: It Smells So Good (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Officer Jenny, thank you for your trouble."

The Officer Jennys had been conducting exercises on the outskirts of this forest. Although the exercises had ended, they hadn't withdrawn that quickly. They had noticed the commotion from deep in the forest but hadn't been able to arrive in time.

Argus and Millis, the father-daughter thief duo, were taken away by the Officer Jennys.

However, what left Johan somewhat helpless was that he hadn't been able to learn information about his target Pokémon hunter group from this father-daughter thief pair.

Or rather.

There were too many large and small Pokémon hunter groups in the Kalos region, and Argus and his daughter didn't know which group Johan was specifically looking for.

The Officer Jennys left with the father and daughter to join the previous two "couple" thieves.

However, according to what Officer Jenny said, these few mostly focused on theft with capturing wild Pokémon as a secondary activity. Their crimes weren't as serious as Hunter J's group. If they behaved well in prison, there was a chance they could be released early.

Johan didn't say much about this—punishment should fit the crime, it was that simple.

After bidding farewell to Officer Jenny and the others, and saying goodbye to AZ, Johan, Steven, and Korrina followed Diancie to the Diamond Kingdom.

Dense forests, bright sunshine, active wild Pokémon gave everyone a leisurely feeling.

"Diancie, Diancie." Korrina skated on her roller blades.

"Mm?"

"Where is the Diamond Kingdom?"

There were rumors about this so-called "Diamond Kingdom" throughout the Kalos region, but very few people had actually seen it—you could even say none.

Johan and Steven were also somewhat curious about this.

"Underground throughout all of Kalos." Diancie curved her eyes, saying crisply.

"All of the Kalos region?" Even Steven was surprised.

Devon Corporation had acquired quite a few mineral veins and mines in the Kalos region, including large and small diamond mines, but had never seen any trace of the Diamond Kingdom.

"That was from a much older period. I didn't experience it myself, but at that time, the Diamond Kingdom truly spread throughout the underground of the entire Kalos region."

Diancie explained.

"But as the 'Eternal Crystal's' energy was gradually consumed, the Diamond Kingdom's scale became smaller and smaller. Many Carbink branches were forced to separate."

"So the diamond mines we usually encounter were actually originally part of the Diamond Kingdom?" Steven asked.

"Mm..." Diancie nodded. "Most of them, but some formed naturally, like the one I first encountered with Johan."

After pausing, it smiled again:

"Actually, even naturally born mineral veins and Carbink, after learning of the Diamond Kingdom's existence, mostly choose to join."

"They're all my subjects~"

Tsk tsk.

Listen to that.

In ancient times, humans fought bloody battles for control of the Kalos region, and AZ was just one of many kings.

And at that time, the Diamond Kingdom had spread throughout the entire Kalos region—a proper superpower.

"Another nation wealthy enough to rival countries..."

No wait, the Diamond Kingdom was already a country.

The others didn't hear Johan's muttering. Diancie was currently full of confidence.

It clenched its small fists and said: "I will definitely restore the Diamond Kingdom to its former glory!"

"You can do it, Diancie!" Korrina was the first to show support and truly believed Diancie could accomplish it.

"Mm-hmm!"

Though the former Diamond Kingdom was very large, the current Diamond Kingdom...

One day later.

"Princess! Princess, you've finally returned!"

Diamond Minister, whose appearance differed from ordinary Carbink, saw Diancie and excitedly rushed to greet her first.

Originally, Johan had actually considered taking Diancie to see more of the outside world and have some fun before returning.

But Diancie was eager to save her country, so they didn't delay further. They even used Steven's "resources," taking a private jet directly to the Diamond Kingdom's entrance.

"Diamond Minister, I'm fine." Facing the anxious Diamond Minister, Diancie smiled warmly.

Ever since learning that the Diamond Kingdom's "Eternal Crystal" was about to wither and disappear, Diancie had known the heavy responsibility on its shoulders.

So it often snuck out, wanting to find Xerneas.

Sometimes Diamond Minister and the others could find it, but sometimes they couldn't keep up. Now seeing Princess Diancie return, Diamond Minister was visibly relieved.

However, Diamond Minister soon sensed a change in Diancie.

"Princess, you..."

Diancie, having exited Mega Evolution, actually didn't look much different from before, but it gave Diamond Minister a very confident feeling.

This feeling made Diamond Minister's heart tremble slightly.

Could it be...

Diancie smiled and nodded, first introducing Johan and the others to Diamond Minister.

"This is Teacher Johan. He gave me tremendous help, and we..."

After hearing Diancie's brief account, Diamond Minister's eyes widened.

Met Xerneas, battled Yveltal?!

This...

"Should we go create the new 'Eternal Crystal' first?" Diancie said.

"Yes, yes, yes!" Diamond Minister, just recovering from shock, heard Diancie's words and quickly nodded.

And so.

Johan's group followed Diancie and Diamond Minister, escorted by numerous Carbink, into the Diamond Kingdom.

What should have been a dark underground world became bright due to brilliant diamonds everywhere. Everyone felt as if they'd entered a completely new world, where precious diamonds from outside were merely the most basic building materials of this kingdom.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar followed beside Johan, looking left and right. It and Victini floated to a diamond pillar, and the smooth diamond surface immediately reflected both little ones' images.

"Ka-kaah~(ω)" Gengar raised its eyebrows playfully.

"Vii~(≧≦)v" Victini made a "yeah" gesture.

"So beautiful..."

Korrina wasn't much better than the two little ones, her eyes full of diamonds and her face showing amazement.

Even Steven, seeing the Diamond Kingdom's scenery, couldn't help but be somewhat surprised.

"So this is the Diamond Kingdom?"

He wondered if there might be some rare stones besides diamonds.

Johan gripped the constantly vibrating Poké Ball at his waist, smiling as he listened to Diamond Minister's proud explanations.

This was someone else's home—Larvitar better not come out and demolish it.

"Eh? What are those red things..."

Korrina noticed that in some areas of the Diamond Kingdom, pillars and rock walls were covered with red, lava-like substances, making her quite curious.

Hearing this, Diamond Minister's pride faltered, and it sighed lightly:

"The 'Eternal Crystal's' depletion has made the Diamond Kingdom precarious..."

Those red things were actually originally diamonds like the surroundings, but after losing some power support, they were decaying.

Korrina and Steven understood.

"It's okay, Diamond Minister." Diancie said softly. "Teacher Johan has already taught me how to condense the 'Eternal Crystal.'"

"Good!" Diamond Minister regained confidence, looking at Johan with respect.

As Diamond Minister, it couldn't teach the princess, but this human had accomplished what it couldn't—he was the Diamond Kingdom's benefactor!

"Thank you so much, Teacher Johan..."

Johan quickly waved his hand, "This was Diancie's own effort."

While entering the Diamond Kingdom, Johan had actually been communicating with the Zygarde core that hadn't left yet using aura.

"As the 'Order God,' if the Diamond Kingdom were destroyed, would you maintain that kind of balance disruption?"

[I wouldn't interfere too much.]

The Zygarde core's answer was quite straightforward.

[But my partner would most likely intervene.]

"Oh?"

So the two Zygarde cores really did have different responsibilities.

Johan guessed that the current "Squishy" might represent Zygarde's "humanity."

While the "partner" it mentioned, the other Zygarde core, might represent "divinity," or rather... Zygarde's responsibility to maintain balance, with a somewhat "programmed" meaning.

[However, Princess Diancie's contact with Xerneas was destined.]

[It was precisely because of their contact, causing life energy to burst forth, that Yveltal was destined to awaken.]

Destined?

Although even without him, future Ash would probably help Diancie find Xerneas eventually, Johan had never agreed with this so-called "fatalism."

"We're here."

Just as Johan was communicating with the Zygarde core, under Diamond Minister and Princess Diancie's guidance, everyone arrived at the Diamond Kingdom's depths.

A huge, faintly glowing pink gem hovered above a bottomless chasm.

Looking carefully, one could see the diamond's surface was already covered with fine cracks.

"In the past ten years, the 'Eternal Crystal' hasn't produced any new Carbink." Diamond Minister said.

Diancie nodded and walked to the front.

"Teacher Johan..." Diancie called softly.

"Go for it." Johan responded.

Then.

Diancie took a deep breath and slowly raised both hands.

Buzz—

Brilliant Mega Evolution light burst from its body, and its appearance gradually changed.

When the light faded, Mega Diancie appeared.

Seeing Princess Diancie in this form, Diamond Minister excitedly prostrated itself, and the surrounding Carbink also prostrated themselves.

"Princess! The true Princess Diancie!"

As Mega Diancie released its power, countless pink diamonds formed a storm, surging from Mega Diancie's hands. Brimming with life energy, these diamonds quickly gathered into an enormous pink diamond.

"Eternal Crystal! It's a new Eternal Crystal!" Diamond Minister shouted tremblingly.

The new "Eternal Crystal" formed, replacing the previous massive diamond. The lifeless diamond completely "retired," becoming scattered pink diamond fragments.

With the new "Eternal Crystal's" appearance, the entire Diamond Kingdom burst with vitality again. Just under the "Eternal Crystal's" radiant illumination, three new Carbink were born from diamonds in the nearby rock walls.

The Diamond Kingdom would continue!

After condensing such a large "Eternal Crystal," Diancie appeared somewhat weak after exiting Mega Evolution.

But it smiled very happily.

It had finally done it!

"Diamond Minister." Diancie called.

"Princess Diancie!" The excited Diamond Minister immediately responded.

"Give Teacher Johan some diamonds."

"Huh?" Johan was stunned.

"No problem!" Diamond Minister immediately agreed.

It was just worrying about how to thank their "benefactor."

Though it didn't know what Johan needed diamonds for, Diamond Minister knew that in the outside world, diamonds were extremely scarce and precious crystals.

Though the Diamond Kingdom had become declining due to the "Eternal Crystal's" withering, it... still had plenty of diamonds, even an enormous amount. Digging some wouldn't have any impact.

It quickly directed the Carbink to take action.

At the same time.

Diancie gathered the fragments of the shattered "Eternal Crystal"—those pink diamond pieces of various sizes—and gave them all to Johan.

"Teacher Johan, though this 'Eternal Crystal' has lost its function for the Diamond Kingdom, I think it should still be useful for you and Larvitar." Diancie said.

Pink diamonds!

All the fragments of a large pink diamond.

"Yoji!!"

After Johan stopped pressing the Poké Ball, Larvitar finally "broke free," seeing the pink diamonds covering the ground. Drool couldn't help dripping from the corner of its mouth.

It didn't care whether the diamonds contained so-called "life energy"—it just wanted diamond food.

Pink diamonds... the taste must be different, right?

Larvitar didn't hesitate and immediately began eagerly munching.

This caused some Carbink who had brought over diamonds to see Larvitar's hearty eating and become afraid to approach.

Good grief... that Pokémon ate diamonds like cookies. What if it got excited and stuffed them whole into its mouth too?

This was even scarier than Sableye.

Besides Johan's diamonds.

Steven and Korrina also each received a pink diamond personally made by Diancie, with obviously excellent quality.

Just from Steven's expression after getting the pink diamond, Johan automatically provided mental soundtrack.

"Hehe, pink diamond, my pink diamond, hehe..."

Great, Steven's image in Johan's mind had completely collapsed.

"Quite a harvest."

When leaving the Diamond Kingdom and seeing the sky dyed red in the west, Johan couldn't help sighing.

The Carbink of the Diamond Kingdom and Diancie were really too enthusiastic.

With Diancie's command, Diamond Minister led the Carbink to dig diamonds. In less than half a day, they actually dug nearly ten times what Johan's group had previously mined from that small diamond vein!

Adding the huge pink diamond fragments from before...

Now, Larvitar's food supply was most likely something Johan truly didn't need to worry about anymore.

A weight off his shoulders.

Originally.

Diancie and Diamond Minister had actually wanted to keep Johan's group for dinner in the Diamond Kingdom.

But given the Diamond Kingdom's "feast," probably only Larvitar would know where to start eating.

So Johan's group immediately expressed their farewell.

And Diancie, having just created the new "Eternal Crystal," was quite weak. Plus with the vast Diamond Kingdom showing initial signs of life, Diancie couldn't leave and stayed in the Diamond Kingdom.

However, Diancie expressed that if there was a chance in the future, it hoped to continue traveling with Johan for a while to enrich its experience.

Johan naturally accepted gladly.

"It really is beautiful."

Korrina held the diamond up to the sun, refracting crystalline light, making her sigh in admiration.

"If diamonds like this were brought outside, they'd probably be frantically sought after, right?"

Johan and Steven exchanged glances and shook their heads simultaneously.

"Let the Diamond Kingdom's secret continue." Steven said.

Actually, Johan and Steven had considered taking Diamond Kingdom diamonds outside to sell, establishing trade channels with the League and the outside world.

With Johan's status and Steven's Devon Corporation, establishing such channels wouldn't be difficult.

But.

After brief discussion, both decisively chose to abandon the idea.

The profits would certainly be huge, but because they'd be too huge, they'd inevitably attract covetous attention.

Pokémon hunters, thieves, and others would definitely treat the Diamond Kingdom like a gold mountain. Even risking great danger, they'd attempt adventures.

Wealth moved hearts, and Pokémon hunters were already a group willing to take desperate risks. As long as the profits were sufficient, there was nothing they wouldn't dare do.

Better to let the Diamond Kingdom continue peacefully.

If someday the Diamond Kingdom could possess decent power to protect itself, they could try.

But now...

With the Diamond Kingdom's Carbink population declining and strength worrying, while possessing too much wealth, it was still too dangerous.

"Mm-hmm!"

Korrina wholeheartedly agreed with Steven's words.

She was just sighing—it didn't mean she wanted to do anything.

Compared to profit, she preferred seeing the smiles on Diancie and the Carbink's faces.

"Teacher, want me to take you to Laverre City?" Steven said.

Johan looked at Korrina.

Korrina put away the pink diamond and after slight contemplation said:

"I'm also preparing to return to Shalour City. Grandpa must be worried."

"Not challenging anymore?" Johan asked with a smile.

Korrina's cheeks reddened slightly as she shook her head.

"For now... not challenging."

After the previous battle, she'd witnessed Johan's power—even briefly contending with the legendary Yveltal. She couldn't even help, and the gap was obvious.

Though Korrina wouldn't give up challenging just because her opponent was too strong, but...

"However, I'll definitely challenge Teacher Johan again in the future!" Korrina said seriously.

This time, it wasn't just Johan and Diancie who had gained something.

She had also learned a lot.

The current Korrina felt she might be able to meet her grandfather's requirements and enter the Tower of Mastery.

"Always welcome." Johan gently patted Korrina's head.

Felt like he was adding a "enhanced version" opponent for future Ash.

Distortion World.

Giratina looked at the small island covered entirely with diamonds, supporting its head with its tail tip as it couldn't help curling its lips.

What was so good about these broken stones? Even specifically finding an island to store them, claiming they weren't garbage.

Ridiculous.

Was its "Distortion World" a garbage dump?

How could anything that entered possibly be garbage?

It glanced at the sparkling diamonds, having just picked up its teacup when it suddenly paused.

Got it!

Giratina's tail swayed as it flew to sit in front of the island, picking up two larger diamonds and fitting them together...

Buzz~~

The smooth diamond surface glowed faintly, projecting a scene from the outside world.

It works!

Giratina's eyes brightened.

It had been worrying about the small screen being somewhat troublesome to watch...

With so many diamonds... using some to piece together a screen should be fine, right?

The Cocoon of Destruction and Diancie incident officially ended.

Sitting on Steven's private jet heading to Laverre City, Johan lightly calculated this trip's gains.

Two Fairy Plate fragments took priority.

With these two plate fragments, developing Ninetales and Tinkaton's Fairy abilities should be no problem.

Next was the large quantity of diamonds.

This completely solved Johan's heart-breaking "Larvitar food supply" problem.

"Yoji~"

Crunch crunch—

Larvitar sat on the plane, loudly munching diamonds. Seeing Victini floating nearby, it offered a piece.

"Vii~ Vii~"

Victini waved repeatedly.

You eat, you eat.

"Yoji~"

Larvitar was used to it. Though it didn't quite understand why everyone didn't like eating such delicious diamonds, when it came to eating, it was better to enjoy alone than together.

After that was everyone, including Johan, receiving the rich Fairy Aura baptism before Xerneas's slumber.

Each Pokémon's level had improved to some degree.

"Larvitar's level isn't low anymore..." Looking at the increasingly solid little one, Johan thought to himself.

With large quantities of diamonds plus regular energy cubes and other food, Larvitar's current weight had reached quite an exaggerated level.

Don't look at its size seemingly unchanged, but picking it up... it was much heavier than before.

"Teacher still doesn't plan to let Larvitar evolve?" Steven, sitting across from Johan and noticing his gaze, couldn't help asking.

Larvitar's current condition... even Steven was secretly shocked.

Others usually tried to slow evolution for fast-evolving Pokémon to accumulate more foundation, and speed up evolution for slow-evolving Pokémon to show mature power earlier.

But Teacher Johan...

Good grief.

This Larvitar—Steven felt even if it encountered wild Tyranitar, it might not lose in arm wrestling.

As for Larvitar's strength.

Ordinary Gym Leaders' Pokémon definitely weren't its opponents. Even Elite Four main teams... were questionable.

Hard to imagine what level Larvitar's strength would reach after evolution.

"It's about time. I'm considering it too." Johan said honestly.

After Larvitar evolved, it would become Pupitar.

Pupitar was similar to Bug-type Pokémon's second stage—a cocoon state, unable to eat and extremely difficult to move.

If Larvitar evolved into Pupitar now, the accumulated power would definitely be sufficient. After Pupitar evolved into Tyranitar, the currently stored "food supply" would probably last Tyranitar a while.

Johan was somewhat tempted.

However...

Pupitar couldn't eat, and the poor little one would probably suffer for a while.

"I'll ask Larvitar's opinion."

Johan said.

Pupitar's inability to eat and difficulty moving would definitely be quite uncomfortable for the lively Larvitar.

"Teacher is as considerate of Pokémon's wishes as always." Steven sighed.

This might be why Teacher Johan could train Pokémon to their current level in such a short time.

When sincerely treating Pokémon and thinking from their perspective, Pokémon would give a 200% response.

Humans and Pokémon were roughly like this.

The usually very active Gengar seemed somewhat quiet now, making Johan feel somewhat unaccustomed.

This purple fatty was wearing Wise Glasses, huddled in a corner of the plane, hands kneading something blackish—probably a mass of Ghost-type energy.

From Xerneas and Yveltal, Gengar had learned some techniques about aura and energy usage. Just didn't know what level it had reached.

"Feel like it's necessary to visit Kanto and see Elite Four Agatha, ask if our family's Gengar is still normal..." Johan thought.

After all, in the entire Pokémon world, probably no one understood Gengar-type Pokémon better than Agatha.

Kalos region, Laverre City.

In a clothing store with quite Japanese-style decoration.

Laverre Gym Leader Valerie wore pink, purple, and orange clothing with lace-trimmed black stockings, sitting quietly on tatami mats.

Light incense floated in the room, naturally relaxing one's spirit.

"Teacher Johan, Mr. Steven." Valerie rose slightly to pour tea for both.

"Miss Valerie, no need to be so polite." Johan exchanged pleasantries.

Reportedly, though Valerie was a Kalos region Gym Leader, she was from Johto, said to have some connection with the geishas of Ecruteak City in the Johto region.

Valerie was originally a model who later became Laverre City's Gym Leader due to outstanding strength and understanding of Fairy-type Pokémon.

Her signature Pokémon was the rare Fairy-type Eevee evolution, Sylveon.

"Cynthia has already explained everything~"

Valerie lightly covered her mouth, smiling as her eyes curved, then slowly stood up.

"Please stand for a moment, Teacher Johan."

Stand?

Johan subconsciously stood up.

A side door opened, and several girls wearing heavy makeup and traditional clothing came out with rulers and other tools, directly beginning to measure Johan.

"This..."

Johan really hadn't expected it to suddenly become like this.

What was this?

Taking measurements?

Seeing his slightly embarrassed expression, Valerie's covered-mouth smile showed an even greater curve.

Even Steven had a "watching the show" expression, unable to resist wanting to take out his phone.

Teacher's embarrassed look wasn't often seen...

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar also quietly poked its head out from Johan's shadow behind him, holding a phone.

"Rotom!" Johan ignored Steven—Gengar would "discipline" him—but Rotom...

"I-I'm filming clothes, Rotom." Rotom pretended to film the exquisite clothing hanging in the store.

Click—click—

After symbolically taking two photos, it quietly turned back toward Johan. Finding he was still watching, Rotom hurriedly pretended to film clothes again.

After repeating this two or three times, Rotom decisively gave up "disguising."

Johan: "..."

Fortunately.

Valerie and her employees were professional, and Johan's measurements were quickly completed.

The relieved Johan sat down again.

"Please forgive us, Teacher Johan. We'll keep your body measurements for convenient future orders." Valerie said with slight apology.

No wonder Cynthia's clothes were all custom-made, and all the same style.

Johan looked at Steven.

Steven shrugged: "Teacher, I was measured long ago."

The north of Laverre City was the Kalos region's largest Poké Ball factory. Both Silph and Devon held considerable shares in that factory. Steven's familiarity with Laverre City obviously wasn't his first visit.

Fine.

As a clothing designer, Valerie was professional.

In the Kalos region, whether Gym Leaders, Elite Four, Champions, or ordinary trainers, anyone without a side business would be embarrassed to call themselves from Kalos.

Kalos region—land of side businesses.

A Kalos person without a side business wasn't a qualified trainer.

After taking body measurements, Johan and Steven got to the main topic.

Regarding Fairy-type Pokémon cultivation and condition.

Johan's Fairy-types were Ninetales and Tinkaton, while Steven also had a Mawile. Both had their own insights about training these Pokémon, but...

Where three gather, one teaches another.

Specialization matters.

In Fairy-type aspects, Johan and Steven's expertise definitely couldn't match Valerie's, even Champions without Fairy-type Pokémon would likely be similar.

"May I see them?" Valerie asked.

Johan and Steven didn't hesitate, throwing Poké Balls to summon their respective Pokémon.

"Such a beautiful Ninetales."

Seeing the snow-white, crystalline-furred Ninetales, Valerie couldn't help exclaiming.

This was the most graceful, smoothest-furred Pokémon she'd seen, perhaps even better than her Sylveon.

"Maw!"

Hearing Valerie praise Ninetales, Steven's Mawile pouted, crossing its arms and turning away.

Hmph!

Valerie smiled slightly: "Mawile's braids are also beautifully groomed today."

"Ma-maw..."

Mawile's face immediately reddened.

As for Tinkaton...

It was still hugging its hammer, fast asleep, showing no signs of waking.

"The little one sleeps so soundly." Valerie couldn't resist wanting to touch Tinkaton's braids but restrained herself, afraid of waking it.

Then confusion appeared in Valerie's eyes.

"I feel... Teacher Johan's training is quite excellent, even better than mine."

"Cough."

Johan coughed lightly.

No helping it.

Who knew that before meeting Valerie, Ninetales and Tinkaton had first experienced Xerneas's baptism, plus had Fairy Plate fragments.

"Mm... Mr. Steven, slightly..."

In front of Mawile, Valerie couldn't say too much, just extending her index finger and thumb to gesture a small gap, indicating "just this much difference."

It wasn't that Steven's training was bad, just... it depended on what Pokémon you compared with.

However, how could the clever Mawile not see what Valerie wanted to express?

"Maw!"

The little thing immediately got angry, putting hands on hips and puffing its cheeks.

Steven rubbed his temples with some headache.

But before he could speak.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales' tail gently patted Mawile's head, its azure eyes full of gentleness.

"Ma-maw! o(////▽////)q"

Mawile blushed and turned away, no longer angry.

"Actually, they're all very excellent Pokémon. I probably... can't provide substantial help, only share my training insights with everyone."

After all, facing Teacher Johan and Steven, they were among the very top Pokémon trainers.

What Johan and Steven wanted was exactly this part of training experience.

"Maw maw..."

Mawile carefully tugged at Steven's clothes, speaking quietly while glancing at Ninetales.

Its words made both Steven and Johan's expressions somewhat strange.

Roughly translated, it meant...

It smells so good...

# 642: Teacher Johan's Little Classroom (Two-in-One Chapter)

Valerie shared her experience in training Fairy-type Pokémon, while Johan and Steven also shared their experience in training other types of Pokémon.

Overall, everyone's gains were quite good.

This immediately made Johan think...

Could he organize some internal sharing sessions among top Pokémon trainers in the future?

Gathering everyone's training experience would surely bring considerable benefits to all Pokémon trainers.

He carefully calculated the top trainers he knew. Just among peers of similar age, there were...

Lance, Lorelei, Steven, Wallace, Cynthia, Flint, Lucian, Aaron, Caitlin, N, Diantha, Leon...

If you added the older generation, there could also be Agatha, Pryce, Drake, Bertha, Alder, Peony...

Hiss—

Not thinking about it was one thing, but when he did, Johan discovered he had actually acquired an extremely vast network of connections in the Pokémon world.

If this group of people gathered together, even the Pokémon League would probably speculate about what they were planning.

However.

Currently, everyone was quite busy with their own affairs. Most of them also shouldered League responsibilities, so gathering them together wouldn't be easy.

But...

"If offline gathering isn't possible, online still works."

Lying on the bed in Laverre City's Pokémon Center, Johan took out his phone and flipped through his contacts.

Actually, the League's software had a group chat system, and Johan used it quite frequently.

For example—

Jenny Family Love and Care.

Joy Girls Are All Beauties.

Cough.

Johan was one of the few people who had managed to get into these two groups, though he'd never spoken in them.

There were also—

Kanaz Pokémon Academy Faculty Group.

Pokémon Psychology Counseling Group.

Hoenn League High-Level Dining Group.

And so on.

What Johan found most amusing were those few from Sinnoh.

Big Sister Mood Intelligence Group, which didn't include Cynthia, consisted of Johan, Lucian, Flint, and Aaron, sharing real-time updates about Cynthia's mood.

There was also "Lucian Went to Work," which didn't include Lucian.

"Flint Is a Pig," which didn't include Flint.

"Aaron Is an Idiot," which didn't include Aaron.

Five people, four groups—that was quite miraculous.

"Wait." Johan suddenly sat up. "Five people should either be one group, or... it can't be four groups, so..."

Damn it, there must be one group that didn't include him!

Realizing this, Johan was so angry his teeth itched. "Flint, I'll remember this!"

Far away in Sinnoh, lost somewhere in a forest, Flint sneezed. He rubbed his nose. "Strange, didn't I just walk this path? Why hasn't that bastard Lucian come to pick me up yet?"

Johan actually didn't pay much attention to the numerous groups normally, except for the "Big Sister Mood Intelligence Group." Most of the time he lurked.

At most, he occasionally browsed the Jenny and Joy family groups, which did have quite a few selfies.

After browsing the Jenny and Joy family groups, Johan's mood immediately improved. He set about creating his first group—

Teacher Johan's Little Classroom.

Then he pulled in Lance, Steven, Wallace, Cynthia, Flint, Lucian, Aaron, Caitlin, Leon, and others he was fairly familiar with.

[Lucian]: ?

[Leon]: Teacher Johan's Little Classroom?

[Johan]: (Diancie.jpg)

[Cynthia]: This Pokémon is Diancie?!

[Caitlin]: Cynthia, cuddle~

[Cynthia]: Cuddle~

[Leon]: Diancie? Never seen this Pokémon before. Looks like Teacher Johan encountered it?

[Steven]: The teacher and I encountered it together. (Gengar Sunglasses.jpg)

[Johan]: (Mega Diancie.jpg)

Seeing Mega Diancie, the group filled with "wow"s.

[Lucian]: So... is Teacher Johan building this group to share rare Pokémon?

[Flint]: Never mind sharing—Lucian, you have time to chat but no time to pick me up?

[Lucian]: Busy.

[Flint]: Your uncle!

[Cynthia]: @Johan, how are the clothes?

[Johan]: Still being made, I haven't seen the finished product either.

[Flint]: What clothes? What clothes?

[Cynthia]: Take a photo when they're done.

[Johan]: (Victini OK.jpg)

[Caitlin]: So you built a group just to show off? Can't you two chat privately!

Cough cough.

Johan lightly rubbed his nose, bringing the group's content back to the main topic.

[Johan]: Diancie, a Mythical Pokémon capable of Mega Evolution, princess of the Diamond Kingdom, a Jewel Pokémon of Rock and Fairy types, capable of creating pink diamonds with life energy...

After Johan finished explaining.

Below came a stream of "learned something new" feedback, which Johan found quite satisfying.

[Steven]: (Pink Diamond.jpg)

Then Steven shamelessly showed off the pink diamond he'd received from Diancie.

[Johan]: (Pink Diamond.jpg) Mine's bigger!

[Lucian]: Either give some away or stop showing off! (Jealous Breakdown.jpg)

[Flint]: Lucian, you bastard—

[Lucian]: Leaving, leaving.

Johan's mouth twitched slightly.

Though Lucian was busy, he was quite active in group chats.

What did this prove?

That he wasn't busy enough!

[Lance]: Built a new group? Teacher Johan's Little Classroom?

At this point, Lance, who hadn't been talking much before, seemed to finally notice this group's existence.

Everyone chatted casually, and Lance also shared a Pokémon he'd encountered during a mission.

[Lance]: (Kabutops.jpg)

[Johan]: Too bad it's Kabutops, not Scyther. Quite handsome though.

[Lance]: ???

[Aaron]: Ah! It's Diancie!

[Everyone]: ???

Smiling, Johan put away his phone.

Sharing experiences, sharing encounters—everyone casually joking around when free was quite interesting.

Johan looked toward Larvitar sitting in the room's corner, currently munching on diamonds, and beckoned to it.

"Yoji?"

Larvitar wiped its mouth, stuck out its little bottom as it stood up, and trotted over to Johan's side.

Recently, Larvitar had been eating quite happily. Before, it mainly ate minerals with occasional diamonds, but now it had switched to an all-diamond diet.

Earth Plate fragments as pre-meal snacks, diamonds as the main course, World Tree branches for picking teeth—what a life.

"Larvitar, do you want to evolve?" Johan asked.

"Yoji?!"

Hearing "evolution," Larvitar's eyes immediately lit up, placing both hands on Johan's knees and nodding vigorously.

It had wanted to evolve for ages, just didn't know why it hadn't been able to. Seeing other Pokémon "dominating battlefields," Larvitar expressed that its teeth were already eager and impatient.

To evolve sooner, it had been eating desperately, constantly devouring—definitely not just to satisfy its appetite.

Mm!

Johan smiled and lightly tapped its little head, producing a dull "thunk" sound.

Confirmed—definitely solid.

"Yoji~"

Larvitar covered its head. Though it didn't hurt at all, it still put on a pitiful expression.

"Let me explain first—after evolution, you become Pupitar, and you won't be able to eat or move easily."

Johan grabbed the Rotom Pokédex.

It displayed Pupitar's appearance.

"Pupitar, the Hard Shell Pokémon, Rock and Ground type. Pupitar has a rather fiery temperament, probably due to the miraculous changes occurring inside its shell. It can move like a bullet by jetting gas, but cannot eat, Rotom!"

"Yo-Yoji?!"

After listening to Rotom and Johan's explanation, Larvitar cried out, its voice rising several pitches.

Then it clutched its chest, rolled its eyes back, and fell stiffly to the ground, creating a dull thud.

Bang—

The other little ones in the room heard the commotion and couldn't help looking over.

Fortunately, Larvitar's performance was just acting, so everyone looked away again.

Nothing else to say—Larvitar had learned decent "acting skills" from Gengar during this time.

But since this was the Pokémon world, it still needed practice.

For Larvitar, the news just now was "devastating."

Can't eat?

Wasn't this killing it?

After digesting this information, Larvitar "tremblingly" stood up and asked quietly.

"Yoji?"

So... how long would I have to fast?

Seeing its expression of wanting to evolve but fearing having nothing to eat, Johan couldn't help but chuckle.

Patting its head, he said:

"I'm not entirely sure either, but as a pseudo-legendary Pokémon... it should be at least three or four months?"

Larvitar clutched its chest again, opening its mouth wide with a breathless expression.

Three or four months?!

It had only been alive for five or six months total.

Though Larvitar was full of longing for evolution, its reaction had already confirmed one thing for Johan.

It wanted to evolve, but not now.

"Alright then, eat more now and accumulate more, trying to keep the Pupitar stage within a month for evolution." Johan said.

Speaking of which.

He actually hadn't known that Larvitar would become irritable after evolving into Pupitar. It was only when Rotom Pokédex explained Pupitar just now that he deliberately looked it up and discovered this.

Pupitar would cause trouble everywhere—it was a very dangerous pupa. This wasn't because it wanted to, but because instinct made it do so, related to the massive changes occurring inside its pupa.

If the little one evolved into Pupitar now, wouldn't he have to pay the Pokémon Center a lot in damages?

Making the Pupitar stage shorter would be safer for his own home too.

"Yoji—"

Larvitar immediately breathed a long sigh of relief.

Its expression became serious again.

It wanted to evolve, but also wanted to eat.

So.

The best method was—

Eat everything now that it wouldn't be able to eat during the Pupitar stage!

The more it ate, the shorter the Pupitar stage's power accumulation time would be. Perfect!

Larvitar clenched its little fists, then took out the Earth Plate fragment and, like sharpening a knife, opened its mouth and carefully ground its teeth back and forth several times. Then it marched confidently toward the diamond pile.

It was going to enter "Ultimate Foodie" mode!

Tonight—one Pokémon, one mouth, one pile of diamonds, one miracle!

Let's feast!

Then the room filled with "crunch crunch" sounds. Those who didn't know might think some Durant were demolishing the house.

"Garruu~"

Urshifu smiled.

This little one was eating more and more. For Coach Bear, being able to eat was a blessing, heaven's favor, but eating a lot while absorbing a lot was what mattered, so...

Tomorrow morning, train with me, Larvitar.

"Yoji~!"

Larvitar, cheeks bulging, nodded vigorously.

Over the next few days, Johan stayed in Laverre City, waiting for Valerie's custom clothing.

Steven left on his private jet, probably having heard about rare stones somewhere and rushed off to dig non-stop.

"Teacher Johan, how is it?"

In Valerie's clothing store, Johan put on a brand-new black fitted suit, standing before the mirror.

Honestly, the general style was similar to Steven's, but without the metal cufflinks or red silk tie at the collar. Instead, there was a black casual tie—the kind you didn't need to tighten—quite fitting Johan's steady temperament.

Of course, what was most eye-catching was the coat draped behind him, thinner than Cynthia's coat. Wearing it gave a feeling of...

"Like young Sirius stole Snape's clothes..." Johan murmured.

"What Sirius? Snape?" Valerie looked confused.

"Cough, nothing." Johan adjusted his clothes. "Very good, I'm quite satisfied."

Valerie smiled.

"I'm glad you're satisfied."

Being able to design satisfying clothing was Valerie's greatest joy.

Ding-a-ling—

The door was pushed open, and the wind chimes hanging on it rang.

Both looked toward the sound.

Entering was a woman of about thirty with a gentle smile, squinting eyes, wearing a dark red sweater and long skirt, with tooth-like decorations at her wrists and collar.

Valerie immediately recognized her—obviously a regular customer—and greeted her.

"Elite Four Drasna, here to buy clothes?"

Drasna?

Johan was startled.

In the Kalos region, or rather in the Kalos League, who was the most diligent? That would definitely be Drasna from Celestic Town in the Sinnoh region, who served as Elite Four in the Kalos region.

Dragon-type Elite Four!

Also the final Elite Four member of the Kalos region's Champion Road.

"Yes, Valerie."

Drasna's face always carried a gentle smile. She also noticed Johan, who had changed into his outfit.

"Nice to meet you, Teacher Johan." Drasna smiled and nodded.

"Elite Four Drasna, you're too kind. Just call me Johan." Johan quickly replied.

Drasna was to the Kalos region what Glacia was to Hoenn, and Lucian to Sinnoh—serious and responsible in her work.

More importantly...

Cynthia had told him that by seniority... Drasna was like her little aunt.

A family elder!

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar poked its head out from Johan's shadow behind him, waving at Drasna as a greeting.

"Cute child." Drasna bent down, wanting to pat Gengar's head, but Gengar directly "glub glub" dove back into the shadows.

Child?

I'm a thousand-year-old ghost!

Drasna wasn't annoyed, just covered her mouth and chuckled softly.

"Gym Leader Valerie, please prepare three more outfits in my previous style." Drasna said to Valerie.

"No problem!"

Valerie immediately went into the back room to prepare.

Drasna was not only a Kalos region Elite Four but also responsible for evaluating Kalos region Gym Leaders—Valerie's direct superior.

In the Kalos region, anyone without a side business would be embarrassed to call themselves a trainer, and Drasna's side business was... priestess!

That's why her clothing leaned slightly toward priestly styles.

After Valerie left, Drasna indicated that she hadn't come just to collect clothes, but also because Johan was here and she wanted to meet him.

Though not many people knew about what happened in Orrans Forest, the Officer Jennys were there, and Johan hadn't deliberately concealed it, so it was normal for Kalos League higher-ups to learn about it.

Therefore, Drasna came representing the Kalos League to express gratitude.

"Dragonium Z?"

When Johan saw what Drasna produced, he couldn't help being somewhat surprised.

Wait.

He was in the Kalos region, right?

Why was he receiving Z-Crystals instead of Mega Stones in the Kalos region?

But thinking carefully, this Pokémon world was in a fully enhanced open state.

Things like Dynamax and Terastalization were heavily restricted by location, while Mega Evolution and Z-Moves had fewer constraints.

And since Mega Evolution only benefited select Pokémon, Z-Moves became the most widely applicable enhancement method.

Of course, the "nobility" of Dragon types also made Dragonium Z more valuable than ordinary Z-Crystals.

"Don't you need it, Elite Four Drasna?" Johan couldn't help asking.

Drasna was a Dragon-type Elite Four, specializing in Dragon-type Pokémon—Dragonium Z would suit her best.

Hearing this, Drasna spoke with a magnetic voice, smiling:

"I already have one."

This was extra?

So... this was Elite Four treatment?

Whether Mega Stones or Z-Crystals, Elite Four as a region's high-end combat power would definitely be the first to receive them.

Thinking about this, he really felt tempted to become an Elite Four member.

"In that case... I won't refuse."

Johan accepted the Dragonium Z—it would be perfect for Dragonite.

Besides Dragonium Z, he also had a Groundium Z and Marshadow's exclusive Marshadium Z.

He'd never used Z-Moves—the embarrassing dance was always an insurmountable hurdle, but... Z-Crystals were valuable. Accepting them wouldn't be wrong.

Beautiful, at least another eight-figure sum.

If he could sell to someone who needed them, the price would probably be even higher.

Right, Lance?

After delivering the item and completing the Kalos League's task, Drasna looked Johan up and down with smiling eyes.

Under Drasna's gaze, Johan felt somewhat uncomfortable.

"Little Cynthia has good taste."

"Cough."

Johan didn't know how to respond for a moment, but regarding his appearance... he was somewhat confident.

Nothing else to say—at least he could suppress Steven when not counting wealth.

Of course, if you counted wealth, sorry, Steven crushed Johan.

"Interested in visiting the Poké Ball factory with me?" Drasna extended an invitation.

"Poké Ball factory?"

Johan was startled.

"Right now?"

"Valerie still needs time to prepare clothes, and another part of my work this time is inspecting the factory situation."

"Alright."

Facing an "elder's" invitation, Johan agreed after brief consideration.

Honestly.

Having used Poké Balls for so long, he was quite curious about the Poké Ball manufacturing process, especially the legendary "Master Ball."

The Poké Ball factory was located north of Laverre City, reachable without much travel time.

The Kalos region's Poké Ball factory was extremely large-scale, built and funded jointly by four parties, each holding certain percentages.

First was Silph Co. from the Kanto region, also the world's largest Poké Ball manufacturing company. The "Master Ball" that supposedly could catch any Pokémon was Silph's masterpiece.

Second was Devon Corporation from the Hoenn region—Steven's family. Devon wasn't as outstanding as Silph in Poké Ball manufacturing, but Devon started with steel and energy. Their Poké Balls could be said to be the most durable.

Third was the local Lysandre Labs from the Kalos region.

Lysandre Labs didn't sell Poké Balls externally and seemed to lack Poké Ball manufacturing technology, but this wasn't true.

What Lysandre possessed was ancient Poké Ball technology with quite a long history, though it was just a research institute Lysandre had established.

Johan knew something about this.

After all, Lysandre's ancestor was King AZ's younger brother from three thousand years ago, and Lysandre was one of the few who knew about the "Ultimate Weapon." With such a long historical inheritance, Lysandre possessed far more than imagined.

Finally, naturally, was the Kalos League.

Whether Silph, Devon, or Lysandre Labs mostly just provided funding and some Poké Ball manufacturing technology. The actual factory management was still the Kalos League's responsibility.

Even so, just from this Poké Ball factory, the three companies could receive extremely considerable annual profit shares.

Anyway, it was a long string of numbers that made Johan envious.

Moreover, management didn't require much effort. The Poké Ball factory was highly automated, needing only a few professional workers plus some Pokémon to keep the factory running smoothly.

What the Kalos League needed to do was periodically inspect the factory.

"Done!"

Drasna put down the checklist in her hands, breathing a long sigh.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar was currently pressed against the transparent glass of the factory workshop, its face squished into a black-purple pancake, looking enviously at the Poké Balls on the conveyor belt inside.

How much money was that...

"Vii?"

Victini scratched its head, not understanding why these balls were all different colors.

Johan felt quite regretful.

The Poké Ball factory didn't have "Master Balls."

However, when chatting with the factory manager, he clearly stated that Silph Co. did have Master Balls—he'd even seen one once.

But Master Ball manufacturing difficulty was too high, and success rates extremely low. Even Silph Co. itself had very, very little Master Ball production—no, you couldn't even use the word "production."

As for...

Whether Master Balls could capture legendary Pokémon was unknown.

"Rotom?"

Rotom Pokédex wanted to take photos but was stopped by an Elekid.

"Elekid!"

No photography allowed here!

Elekid spun its arms like windmills, electrical current bursting from its plug-like head.

"Rotom?"

Seeing that current, Rotom's eyes spun.

Zzzt—

Electrical current also burst from its body, stronger and brighter than Elekid's.

Seeing this, Elekid frowned slightly, suddenly increasing its arm rotation speed, making the current from its head more dense.

Rotom sighed.

Time to play the trump card.

It quietly approached Johan's waist and gently tapped one of the Poké Balls.

Tap tap—

"Anyone home? Rotom~"

Click—

The Poké Ball made a subtle sound, accompanied by red light as Electric Pillar Regieleki appeared.

When Elekid saw Regieleki and sensed the electrical intensity from its body... its hands tensioned against its legs, immediately becoming nervous.

"Regi?"

Regieleki scratched its head, looking at Rotom with some honest confusion.

"Rotom~"

Rotom gestured simply, and Regieleki understood.

"Eleki~"

Then Regieleki raised a hand, sending an electrical arc to Elekid's plug-like head. Elekid trembled as if electrocuted, then showed a lazy, enjoying, comfortable expression.

"Elekid~"

Elekid raised one finger, looking intoxicated as it called to Rotom.

Five minutes max, five minutes~

Rotom showed a smug smile.

Little thing, Rotom still prefers your previous rebellious attitude~

"This is also for you."

Meanwhile, Drasna took a box from the factory warehouse and handed it to Johan.

"Mine?"

Johan accepted it puzzledly.

"The previous Z-Crystal was thanks for what you did in Orrans Forest. This is for... the Kalos factory incident."

Opening the box, Johan found it was full of miniaturized Poké Balls.

The most basic red-white balls, then Great Balls, Ultra Balls, Level Balls, Moon Balls, Friend Balls, Dark Balls, etc.—almost a complete set of Poké Balls.

Except for unobtainable ones like Master Balls, Ultimate Balls, and usually useless ones like Safari Balls, Park Balls, Sport Balls, everything else was there.

A complete set!

Basic red-white balls aside, Great and Ultra Balls were fine, but the other Poké Balls... weren't cheap.

Especially that bright red Luxury Ball—its function might be ordinary, but its collectible value made it extremely precious.

Speaking of which.

Johan's Poké Balls were all Luxury Balls—the ten Luxury Balls he'd gotten when first claiming reimbursement from Drake. He hadn't bought Poké Balls since.

Now Gengar and the others all used Luxury Balls.

Counting what he'd used... two remained of the original ten.

If he wanted to capture more Pokémon later, two obviously wouldn't be enough.

And though Luxury Balls were good, some little ones might want to change their "residence."

"Ka-kaah~"

Speaking of which, Gengar immediately floated over, grabbed the box, and stuffed it in its mouth.

Johan knocked its head lightly with some exasperation.

You purple fatty being so eager, as if you usually stayed in Poké Balls.

Johan still thanked Drasna.

This was probably the main reason she'd invited Johan to visit the Poké Ball factory—a complete set of various Poké Balls.

Walking out of the Poké Ball factory, on the way back to Laverre City, Drasna suddenly stopped, looking at Johan with a smile.

"How about it? Want to have a battle?"

"Hm?"

So sudden?

The sudden battle invitation caught Johan off guard.

But seeing Drasna's smiling face, he suddenly realized.

This Dragon-type Elite Four, though appearing gentle and friendly, was also a famous "battle maniac."

Otherwise, how could she manage Kalos League affairs while having priestess as a side job, yet still become the Kalos League's final Elite Four?

Drasna really looked forward to battling strong, powerful trainers.

In the original story, Drasna's smile was summarized by Clemont as—everyone would be deceived by such a gentle, friendly smile, forgetting her essential nature as an Elite Four.

"I heard you calmed Dialga and Palkia's fury, which is quite admirable." Drasna praised.

As a Dragon-type Pokémon specialist, plus with her hometown being Celestic Town, Drasna wasn't unfamiliar with the space-time dragons—she even revered them quite a bit.

"If I could battle you, it should help train Pokémon better, right?"

Drasna tilted her head slightly, hands at her sides, eyes curved like crescents.

"Um..."

Johan squeezed his nose bridge.

This was truly... a completely unexpected battle invitation.

However...

Facing Dragon-type Pokémon specialists, Johan really wasn't that worried.

Just one Ice and Fairy-type Ninetales would be enough to give those Dragon-type specialists a hard time, not to mention he also had Tinkaton and Dragonite.

And Drasna had chosen a good time for this invitation—Ninetales and Tinkaton had just received Xerneas's Fairy Aura baptism and gotten Fairy Plate fragments.

In a sense, calling the current Johan a "Dragon Slayer" wouldn't be excessive.

Perfect.

He could see how well Ninetales and Tinkaton had absorbed their gains.

He didn't know how much of Xerneas's Geomancy Ninetales had learned, or what changes had occurred to Tinkaton's hammer.

Thinking of this.

Johan nodded: "Alright! You're the senior, you decide."

Hearing this, Drasna looked very happy. "Johan is quite nice~"

But gradually, her squinting eyes slowly opened, and the smile and gentleness on her face gradually faded.

She showed an extremely serious expression.

That look... those eyes... made Johan's heart skip a beat.

Good grief.

Could this be some trap specifically waiting for me to jump into... Johan thought suspiciously.
