# 646: Come Out and Fight Me One-on-One! (Two-in-One Chapter)

The sun was setting in the west, dyeing the sea surface a lovely rosy red, reflecting on people's faces so you couldn't tell if it was the color of dusk or the color of people.

"The scenery here is really nice."

On the hillside behind Fula City, colorful flowers of all kinds bloomed, swaying in the wind and blossoming under the dusk, accompanied by waves of refreshing floral fragrance.

Cynthia rode Garchomp and finally arrived at Fula City before nightfall.

"Yes, very nice."

Johan was absorbed in reading Cynthia's palm, looking at her life line, love line, and career line.

"Ka-kaah ka-kaah~~"

Gengar wrapped its arms around Garchomp's neck, pulling it to walk in another direction.

Come come come, let me tell you, there's a cat that can do backflips over there, let me show you.

"Cha?"

Tinkaton held its hammer, blocking Lucario's path.

Can you tell if my hammer has changed?

"It's evening now, even the Crobat are coming out." Cynthia looked up slightly.

"Speaking of which, this should be the best-looking bat, right?"

Previously, the career line looked longer than the love line, but now it seemed like the love line had overtaken it?

Johan muttered silently to himself.

Suddenly a hand gently patted his forehead.

Johan looked up.

Cynthia's eyes were calm: "First time asking me out, and you can't focus on me properly?"

"Cough cough."

Johan shifted his gaze but still held firmly onto the softness in his hands.

"I'm with you, I'm with you. You really are the most beautiful."

A faint blush spread from her neck to her cheeks, but it wasn't very obvious under the dusk.

The sea breeze blew through, passing through the forest's barrier and becoming a gentle breeze. Colorful flowers everywhere competed to release their fragrance, swaying in the wind. The flowers and leaves rubbed together making rustling sounds.

The two sat down in the flower field, their knees submerged in the sea of flowers.

"If we're really talking about beautiful flower fields, it would definitely be the Nebel Plateau in the Kalos region. The flower fields there are unique in the entire Pokémon world."

"Have you been there?" Cynthia turned her head, and his distinct features came into her eyes.

"No." Johan shrugged slightly. "There's someone guarding that place who's not easy to deal with."

The Nebel Plateau was a location from the movie "Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel," where abandoned or discarded Pokémon lived, with the mythical Pokémon Volcanion as their leader.

It wasn't very friendly toward humans.

"You talk about it like it's real." Cynthia wrinkled her nose, showing some cuteness.

"I'll take you to see it if there's a chance." Johan didn't argue, just spoke very gently and calmly.

"Mm."

For a moment, neither spoke.

Until Johan patted his shoulder.

Cynthia looked at him for a while, then slowly leaned over, resting her head on that not-too-broad shoulder. Johan couldn't help but smile, slowly wrapping his arm around from behind and gently embracing her shoulder.

[Never seen anything like this, have you?]

The Zygarde core, having lost its "territory" early on, looked at Victini, who had also lost its "territory," trying to find sympathy.

"Vii~~"

But Victini had no time to pay attention to it, just covered its eyes with both hands while leaving gaps between its fingers, watching the two figures nestled together and excitedly bouncing in mid-air.

The Zygarde core looked up to the sky, feeling lonely.

The sun set and moonlight fell, landing on every petal, making the petals appear even more crystalline, bright and charming.

Glittering like jewels, gentle breeze.

The two still said nothing, did nothing, just nestled together.

Johan slowly closed his eyes, feeling the warmth beside him. Whether it was floral fragrance or body fragrance, he didn't know—he just felt that if Dialga appeared now to freeze time, he would be quite willing.

Cynthia was tall, and you couldn't tell when she wore her coat normally, but when nestled together, Johan could feel her slenderness and those assets that were better than he had imagined.

Cough cough...

Time passed gradually.

Dark clouds appeared in the sky at some point, slowly obscuring the moon's light.

Johan frowned.

He'd have to discuss with Rayquaza tomorrow—the "Air Lock" ability should be used when needed.

"What's wrong?"

Seeming to notice Johan's expression change, Cynthia asked softly.

"Nothing..." Johan tightened his grip on her wrist. "Just suddenly thought of Rayquaza."

After hearing his explanation, Cynthia smiled like a flower. "Didn't you say you didn't want to deal with legendary Pokémon?"

"This is different." Johan said with a straight face, especially seriously.

Cynthia laughed so hard her body trembled slightly, and the two finally separated from their previous state. Johan felt somewhat disappointed.

In two lifetimes, he was also like a young bride on her wedding day—first time.

The bold live well, the timid starve to death!

"Can I..." Johan thought of how Cynthia got along with Caitlin and pointed to her lap.

"Mm..."

Finally.

Johan's head successfully found its wished-for place on the elastic yet soft position, looking up at the night sky while Cynthia quietly searched for white hairs.

Unfortunately, she found none...

"Are you tired lately?"

"A little..."

Cynthia's pressure wasn't small because she set high standards for herself, which naturally required more effort.

"Garchomp seems more robust."

"Mm, it eats so much."

"Hahaha—"

After another brief quiet moment.

"If you're really tired, why not give yourself more vacation time? Isn't there still Lucian you can boss around?"

"Aren't I on vacation now?"

True...

Cynthia looked down, their eyes met, and she smiled: "I'm waiting for you to call me 'Champion.' Then I can order you around."

Johan was speechless.

Just for this?

One above, one below, eyes meeting each other. Cynthia's cheeks climbed with color again, and Johan felt his heart beating heavily and violently, his ears feeling like going from extreme cold to extreme heat in winter, slightly itchy.

Thump—

"Garrr!!"

Garchomp, who had been dragged back by Gengar with great difficulty, saw this scene and suddenly pounded its chest.

Pain! So painful!

"Lucaa..."

Lucario had a bitter smile on its face—you couldn't say it was happy, but there was some heartache.

The cabbage they had protected for so long was finally taken by someone.

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

Gengar gently patted Garchomp's shoulder, indicating it was okay.

Don't worry, our Old Johan Family will be responsible.

"Mm..."

Sunlight came through the window, gently shining on his face.

Johan kept his eyes closed for a long while before stretching and reluctantly sitting up.

Beside him was Tinkaton lying in a "big" character shape drooling, and Ninetales curled up in the blankets. Obviously, there was no sign of Cynthia.

But what happened last night before sleep still made this first-time guy in two lifetimes full of reminiscence and nervousness, like a dream—he didn't know if it was real or fake.

He patted his cheeks and became a bit more alert.

"Rotom, what time is it?"

"It's already 10 AM, Rotom!" The Rotom Pokédex floated out from the side.

Ten o'clock?

Johan was stunned.

Gengar didn't wake him up?

Then he remembered that last night... Gengar had accompanied Garchomp in battle until very late to be "responsible," and was now still sleeping soundly on the ceiling.

And he had chatted with Cynthia until very late, finally sending her back to her room under the "murderous" gazes of Garchomp and Lucario.

"Sigh, lazy, lazy."

Johan threw off the covers and got up to wash.

Women?

They only slow down my getting up!

"Ka-kaah!"

Hearing the commotion, Gengar rolled over and got up, stretching long, then immediately perked up.

Today was the Wind Festival, the Pokémon Catch Race!

Gengar was full of energy.

"Pokémon Catch Race?"

Cynthia showed a look of realization.

Johan's liking for participating in "kiddie competitions" wasn't a secret among their group, and Cynthia saw it as Johan's "little quirk."

After all, who didn't have little quirks?

Noticing her expression, Johan understood that Cynthia had definitely misunderstood.

"It's Gengar who wants to participate." He explained.

"Mm, I know, I know." Cynthia nodded repeatedly, gently patting Johan's head like comforting a child.

Gengar on the side noticed his gaze and quickly crossed its arms, pouting and looking up at a 45-degree angle while whistling.

Johan: "..."

This purple fatty...

"What about you? What's this..."

Johan noticed the small bucket in Cynthia's hand.

"Going to dig up some flowers."

"Hm?"

"To take back and plant."

"Lucaa."

Lucario showed the small shovel in its hand—made by Tinkaton last night.

"Garrr!! (▼皿▼)"

Since this morning, Garchomp had been wearing Gengar's same style sunglasses, making it impossible to see its eyes clearly, but Johan always felt... like there were thorns in his back.

"Should I come with you?" Johan asked.

"Aren't you going to participate in the 'Pokémon Catch Race'?"

"There's still time..."

At this moment, Fula City's broadcast sounded.

"Attention trainers of Fula City! Attention trainers of Fula City! The Pokémon Catch Race is about to begin. Interested trainers please immediately gather at the Wind Festival venue center. Repeat, please immediately gather at the Wind Festival venue center!"

Johan: "..."

Cynthia smiled sweetly: "Go quickly. I'm just picking some flowers. Isn't there still the fireworks festival tonight?"

"Alright, I'll try to... make it quick."

Johan grabbed Gengar by the spike on the back of its head and headed toward the Wind Festival venue on the sea.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar put its hand to its forehead and waved vigorously at Cynthia and Garchomp.

See you later~

The Wind Festival was an activity and holiday created by Fula City to celebrate their pact with Lugia.

Because Fula City itself was quite distinctive, plus the Wind Festival venue's amusement park and its legend about the legendary Pokémon Lugia, quite a few people gathered here.

Wearing an Alolan floral shirt, flip-flops, a sun hat and sunglasses, Johan blended into the crowd and signed up for this Wind Festival's "Pokémon Catch Race."

"First, welcome everyone to Fula City for the annual 'Pokémon Catch Race.' Now let me explain the competition rules."

On the temporarily built stage, a rather flashily dressed host began.

"First, everyone please look to my left."

There, standing or lying, sleeping or playing, various Pokémon gathered.

These Pokémon weren't just from the Kalos region, but from all over the world.

Golduck, Sudowoodo, Pidgeot, Vileplume, Persian, Kingdra, Ampharos, Azumarill, Miltank, Mightyena, Luxray, Snivy, etc.

And the most eye-catching was undoubtedly the pseudo-legendary Pokémon Tyranitar.

It stood like a tyrant in the center of all the Pokémon, with no other Pokémon daring to approach it.

Uh... that wasn't quite right.

Behind Tyranitar leaned a Froslass, looking cold and aloof with its chin raised, seemingly not taking the Pokémon and trainers in front of it seriously.

Hm?

Was this a combo?

Desert Tyrant paired with Froslass?

That was quite unique.

All the Pokémon on the field, including the Tyranitar and Froslass in the center, had special tags on them, representing their special nature.

"I believe everyone has seen the tags on the Pokémon."

"That's right, they are the targets of this 'Pokémon Catch Race.' What all contestants need to do is use the Poké Balls we provide to catch as many of these Pokémon as possible!"

As he spoke, the host took out a dark blue specially-made Poké Ball.

Just like the "Bug Catching Contest" and "Pokémon Safari Zone," this "Pokémon Catch Race" also used specially-made Poké Balls for the competition.

"Each Pokémon will be scored according to its rarity and strength level, and the trainer with the highest final score will become the champion of this 'Pokémon Catch Race'!"

This was quite reasonable.

Pokémon like Tyranitar and Azumarill would definitely represent different point values, otherwise everyone wouldn't bother with Tyranitar.

The difficulty of catching a Tyranitar was much greater than catching an Azumarill.

"I believe everyone is very eager, but please don't rush. Let me show everyone the prize for this champion!"

A Z-Crystal!

Whoa!

The audience and contestants below erupted in amazement.

Even Johan was quite surprised.

Fula City... really went all out!

But looking at the surrounding crowd, the ever-present Magnemite broadcast cameras, and the number of participating contestants... it was much larger than the one Ash participated in from the movie "The Power of Us" that Johan knew about.

It seemed Fula City's publicity was quite good.

Look, with the champion prize announced, not only were the contestants more motivated, but the audience's enthusiasm was also stirred up, and there were many more online viewers watching the live stream.

"Whoa! Z-Crystal, Fula City is really generous."

"There's actually a Z-Crystal! I would have gone if I'd known."

"Speaking of which, what type is the Z-Crystal?"

"If I'm not mistaken, it's an Electrium Z!"

"Hey, that person looks familiar, who is it..."

The online streaming heat skyrocketed.

Wind Festival venue site.

Backstage.

Mayor Ollivier of Fula City, wearing a sharp suit, was tidying his clothes in front of a mirror, preparing to go on stage.

"Mr. Mayor, our prize this time, isn't it..." A secretary behind him hesitated.

Mayor Ollivier looked quite calm: "One Z-Crystal can make the trainers more enthusiastic and attract more live stream viewers. More and more people will know about Fula City and come to Fula City. This won't be a loss."

"Yes."

"Moreover..."

Mayor Ollivier turned his head to look at the "Sacred Flame" in the city center.

Fula City had developed and become famous because of the "pact with Lugia."

But only a few people knew, or remembered, that the legendary Pokémon Lugia hadn't come to Fula City for a long time.

He didn't know what method could make Lugia come again, but he thought... showing the enthusiasm of Pokémon and trainers shouldn't be a bad approach.

As long as Lugia could appear once, all the expenses would be worth it.

"Now, let us welcome the mayor of Fula City, Mr. Ollivier, to announce the start of the competition!"

The well-dressed Ollivier took the stage, grabbed the microphone, took a deep breath, and waved his arm shouting:

"Do you want the Z-Crystal? If you want it, then go catch Pokémon!"

The Pokémon Catch Race officially began!

As Mayor Ollivier's words fell, the Pokémon on the left side of the stage seemed to receive some command and scattered using their various methods.

In a few blinks, they disappeared from everyone's sight.

Next.

What the contestants needed to do was catch as many of these Pokémon as possible within the time limit, catching strong and rare Pokémon.

"Charge!"

Some chuunibyou youth shouted and charged out first, then the other contestants were stirred up and followed.

Johan, in his flip-flops, seemed rather out of place.

"Does asking for your help count as cheating?" Johan said softly.

[Hmph!]

The Zygarde core, still holding a grudge from yesterday when Johan had removed it from his shoulder, snorted coldly.

But still said:

[I don't have many cells scattered in and around Fula City.]

"Oh?"

[This is my partner's area of responsibility, and... there's a pretty decent guy in Fula City who maintains order here.]

"Batman?"

[What Batman?]

"Cough, nothing, I think I know who it is."

"Ka-kaah~!"

From a distant corner, Gengar cupped its hands like a megaphone and shouted at Johan.

Come quick, there's a target here!

Hearing this, Johan quickened his pace slightly.

Then he saw... this guy Gengar really had sharp eyes and quick hands, actually cornering a Sudowoodo in a dead-end alley.

"Sudo! Sudo!"

Sudowoodo was already nervous because of Gengar, and seeing Johan appear made it even more panicked.

Its branch-like hands scrabbled on the left wall, then it hurriedly ran to scrabble on the right wall, but obviously a Sudowoodo didn't have wall-climbing abilities.

"Sudo..."

Sudowoodo was so anxious it was sweating.

"Sudowoodo, Rock-type Mimic Pokémon. To avoid being attacked, they often disguise themselves as trees, but in fact... even young children are hard to fool, Rotom!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar rubbed its nose.

This Sudowoodo... couldn't be that one, could it?

Same timidity, same bit of silliness.

"Sudo!"

Suddenly, Sudowoodo cried out and pointed behind Johan and them.

Look, there's a very powerful rare Pokémon!

But neither Johan nor Gengar turned around.

"Where? Where? Where, Rotom?"

Rotom looked around and turned back, only to meet Johan and Gengar's "contemptuous" gazes.

At this moment.

In Johan and Gengar's minds, Rotom and Sudowoodo were put on the same level.

"Rotom..."

Realizing it had been fooled, Rotom floated to a corner and started drawing circles.

What hurt most wasn't actually Johan and Gengar's gazes, but Rotom realizing it had been "foolishly amusing."

"You want to participate in the competition, you do it."

Johan gestured toward Sudowoodo for Gengar.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar grinned wickedly, stuck out its tongue and spun it around, making the already frightened Sudowoodo's face turn completely white.

"Sudo!! Σ(д|||)"

However, Gengar didn't attack, but instead took a Poké Ball from Johan's waist and threw it out.

"Ka-kaah!"

Go, Larvitar!

Johan: "???"

Sudowoodo: "???"

Larvitar: "???"

The Larvitar that appeared looked completely confused, scratching its head.

Who called me?

Gengar turned Larvitar's gaze toward Sudowoodo, then indicated... don't look at it being a tree, but it's actually made of rock.

Rock?!

Larvitar's eyes began to glow.

"Sudo?"

Sudowoodo suddenly shivered, noticing Larvitar's "fiery" gaze and swallowed hard.

But...

The previous Gengar and Johan had made it extremely afraid, but now just a Larvitar... it might not necessarily lose!

"Sudo!"

Sudowoodo patted its cheeks, perked up, said "I can do it" to itself three times, then struck a master's pose and beckoned to Larvitar.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar grinned, clenched its little fists and slowly approached.

You asked for it.

The next second.

"Sudo——!!"

Sudowoodo's "miserable" cry echoed in the alley, lingering for a long time.

Three minutes later.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar patted Larvitar's shoulder encouragingly while tossing a contest-special Poké Ball, walking leisurely out of the alley.

Johan, following behind, had a strange expression.

Trainer Gengar?

With its Pokémon Larvitar, defeating Sudowoodo and successfully catching it?

Something felt weird about this.

But...

Not having to do it himself was good—Johan was happy to slack off.

Pulling down his hat brim, adjusting his sunglasses, hands in pockets, he honestly followed behind.

He didn't dare let Gengar take Larvitar out of his sight, or who knew what trouble these two could cause.

If they really made it big, sinking the entire Wind Festival venue island was possible.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar threw out the blue special Poké Ball and summoned the just-caught Sudowoodo.

"Sudo?"

The bruised and swollen Sudowoodo saw Gengar and Larvitar, this "fierce and vicious" combo, and trembled slightly.

These two guys... Gengar was one thing—it looked fierce from the start, but how was that seemingly baby Larvitar so ruthless too?

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar put its arm around Sudowoodo's shoulder.

As a "people expert," Gengar clearly knew that a Pokémon with Sudowoodo's personality being able to stay among those competition Pokémon definitely had its own abilities and methods.

So...

Come, tell me which guys are tougher and where they'll be.

The Wind Festival was held once a year, and each time there was a Pokémon Catch Race, with quite a few Pokémon participating year after year. Sudowoodo should know some things.

"Su-sudo..."

Sudowoodo shrank its neck and spoke hesitantly.

Under the "intimidation" of Gengar and Larvitar, it was hard not to show something...

Tyranitar and Froslass were the toughest...

Gengar rubbed its chin.

During the opening, it had also seen the Tyranitar and Froslass standing in the center.

"Yoji?"

Larvitar's eyes lit up.

What?

Tyranitar?

"Yoji——!!"

Larvitar clenched its fists and roared to the sky.

It wanted to fight Tyranitar!

"Sudo..."

Sudowoodo tilted its head and mentioned another Pokémon.

Oh, there's also a Snivy.

Snivy?

Johan, following behind, looked puzzled.

Tyranitar and Froslass were within his expectations—whoever could catch these two would probably have the championship locked up.

But why was there also a Snivy?

As the starter form of the Unova region Grass-type starter, Johan was naturally familiar with Snivy.

But this was just the initial form of a starter, right?

A Snivy following right behind Tyranitar and Froslass was somewhat surprising.

But why it ranked this way, Sudowoodo just gestured around without being able to give a specific reason.

However, Johan didn't pay much attention to it.

Snivy was Snivy—just catch Tyranitar, Froslass, and Snivy all, and the championship would be secured.

As expected.

Gengar put on sunglasses. "Ka-kaah~!"

Tyranitar, Froslass, Snivy—the targets are these three, let's go!

Larvitar marched forward proudly.

According to Sudowoodo's "intelligence," Tyranitar and Froslass would most likely be in the central plaza, waiting for "challengers" to come.

As the two strongest Pokémon in the Pokémon Catch Race, they hadn't been caught for several competitions.

When Gengar and Johan's group arrived at the central plaza, they found...

The Snivy that Sudowoodo mentioned was actually here too.

And.

It was challenging Froslass!

Hm?

Seeing the Snivy battling fiercely with Froslass, Johan raised an eyebrow.

He hadn't expected things to develop this way.

But Larvitar didn't care about any of that, charging straight up and running to Tyranitar.

"Yoji——!!"

Come out and fight me one-on-one!

"Tyra?"

Why "almost"?

Because...

This was based on the trainer who caught Tyranitar and Froslass continuing to catch Pokémon.

If others caught a large number of Pokémon in a short time and accumulated enough points, they naturally had a chance to overtake.

But at this time, something more important exploded online.

"Look! After comparison, this person is Teacher Johan! With Gengar, with Larvitar!"

"Holy crap! I thought he looked familiar earlier, but it's actually Teacher Johan?!"

"Baby Cup God! Teacher Johan loves participating in competitions like this!"

"Didn't they say Teacher Johan deliberately kept a Larvitar in baby state? So it was this Larvitar!"

"Baby? A Pokémon that can flip Tyranitar with one palm and knock down Tyranitar with one foot is a baby?"

"..."

Obviously.

With Gengar and Larvitar, plus some characteristics, Johan couldn't hide even if he wanted to. There were plenty of "experts" online.

And as Johan's identity was revealed, more and more people paid attention to this competition.

At the same time.

A group of people, taking advantage of everyone's attention being on the Wind Festival and Pokémon Catch Race, secretly snuck into the Pokémon Research Institute at the center of the Wind Festival venue.

"You all know, right? After the Pokémon Catch Race ends, those competition Pokémon will be temporarily placed here!"

"I heard there's even a pseudo-legendary Tyranitar inside!"

"Keep it down!"

"After this job, we're leaving this damn Kalos region! Going to the Alola region—development there is low, we can catch whatever Pokémon we want!"

"I said keep it down!"

However, they didn't know that just as they were having their so-called "quiet conversation," a young man in a white lab coat with long green hair and glasses witnessed the entire process from the corner.

"You—you guys are..." Toren stammered, pointing at the group.

# 648: Johan: So It's My Fault? (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Teacher Johan participating in competitions like this is really... too much bullying!"

Outside a café on the Wind Festival venue island, under a parasol, Johan heard the "complaints" of passing trainers and couldn't help pulling down his hat brim.

Glug glug—

The juice in his cup was finally finished, and Johan smacked his lips.

"It's nice to drink juice occasionally, changing flavors isn't bad."

A nearby passing contestant was still muttering.

"Exactly! Isn't this bullying? When we find him, I'm definitely going to... make him give me three autographs!"

"Three? Are you kidding? I'll name a number—thirty! Won't let him leave until he signs them all!"

"I heard someone saw Teacher Johan at the ferris wheel..."

"Let's go, let's go! Hurry!"

Tap tap tap—

Several people quickly ran off.

Johan breathed a slight sigh of relief. "Wonder if I have enough points for the championship now..."

As for... bullying?

Ridiculous!

A fair competition—where's the bullying? The Z-Crystal was quite valuable, and even if he didn't use it himself... collecting a complete set and selling a few would easily net several small goals.

Then he'd achieve financial freedom and buy a small island for vacation!

Johan thought happily to himself.

"Ka-kaah!"

"Yoji!"

"Sudo!"

Gengar returned with his "muscle" Larvitar and "intelligence officer" Sudowoodo after being busy for a while. Looking at the number of blue Poké Balls on Gengar's waist, their harvest seemed quite abundant.

"About done?"

Gengar, along with Larvitar and Sudowoodo, plopped down in their seats and immediately "chugged" the juice Johan had ordered for them.

Only Sudowoodo looked careful, seeming somewhat restrained and afraid.

Johan pointed to the chair beside him and said to Sudowoodo:

"Sit and drink. Don't copy them. Here, a straw."

"Sudo..."

Sudowoodo sat dazedly in the chair, taking the straw Johan handed over, feeling somewhat unaccustomed.

When it was at the Day Care, everyone didn't eat like this...

"Ka-kaah~"

When I make a move, of course it's easy work!

Gengar wiped its mouth, showing a row of white teeth.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar clenched its fists, swinging left and right, acting like it had just beaten down several opponents and was super amazing.

Johan just smiled, his peripheral vision glancing toward the rooftop of a building across the street, where a small green figure was secretly watching.

It was the Snivy from before.

Since Johan sat outside this café, it had been secretly watching. This naturally couldn't escape Johan's aura sensing, but he hadn't said anything.

But now...

"Want some?"

Johan picked up an "extra" glass of juice and gently shook it toward the Snivy across the street.

Suddenly discovered, Snivy almost fell off the rooftop, but seeing Johan's gesture, it crossed its arms and jumped toward the alley behind.

"Sni!"

Hmph~

"Alright then."

Johan put the juice on the table, stood up and stretched:

"Let's go. The competition isn't over yet. Let's see how Cynthia's digging is going."

Many people were looking for him now. If he wasn't careful, he'd be surrounded. Since the championship was secured, he should leave quickly and come back for the awards ceremony.

After leaving their seats and walking some distance, Johan suddenly stopped.

"Ka-kaah?"

Under Gengar's puzzled gaze, Johan smiled and looked back.

"Sni-Sni?"

Snivy suddenly raised its head from the juice cup, its face covered with red watermelon juice, eyes full of shock and fright.

Meeting Johan's gaze, Snivy's face turned completely red with a "whoosh," opening its mouth to defend itself but finding it couldn't...

"Sni!! (▼皿▼)"

"Hahaha—"

Johan laughed heartily, taking the similarly grinning Larvitar, Gengar and the others away.

In the flower field behind Fula City.

Cynthia held a small shovel, wandering through the flower field. Sometimes she thought this flower was nice, sometimes she thought that one over there seemed better, falling into a dilemma.

Meanwhile, Garchomp lay back in nearby flowers with two Flabébé playing on it.

This usually fierce-looking guy showed some gentleness when facing such cute Pokémon as Flabébé.

In contrast, Cynthia's Glaceon seemed much more lively, chasing Vivillon through the flower beds.

Johan approached with Gengar and the others.

He quietly walked behind Cynthia, showing a mischievous smile on his face. He wiped some mud on his hands and looked at Cynthia's clean face, quickly smearing the wet soil on her cheek.

The wind blew through the flowers.

Cynthia looked up, seeing Johan who had suddenly appeared, and smiled, saying like showing off a treasure:

"Look, these flowers are even more beautiful in daylight."

Johan smiled and raised his mud-stained finger in front of Cynthia, indicating he had just done something "naughty."

But Cynthia wasn't surprised by this, as if she had noticed it long ago.

Realizing this, Johan asked:

"Why didn't you dodge?"

"Why should I dodge?"

Cynthia smiled like a flower, grabbed Johan's hand, and smeared it on the other side of her face.

The elastic skin transmitted through the thin layer of soil to his fingertips, and her fair cheek gained another trace of mud.

I...

Johan immediately felt guilty.

Damn, Johan, you're being a bit of a jerk!

"Garrr!!"

Garchomp, who had been lying in the flower bed, witnessed the entire process and immediately stood up, transforming into a fierce beast.

Johan, you dog, I want you dead!!!

Fortunately.

Gengar hugged its arms from behind.

"Ka-kaah! Ka-kaah!"

Calm down! Sister Shark, calm down!

Johan "snatched" the small shovel from Cynthia's hands and started digging directly in the ground.

He knew Cynthia's choice paralysis had struck again, so he might as well... pack everything up and take it all!

Cynthia smiled sweetly, holding the juice Johan had brought, squatting beside him watching him dig while sipping in small mouthfuls.

"Don't dig all their topsoil bare, that's not good."

"It's fine." Johan wiped sweat from his forehead. "They're all wild anyway. I'll ask someone to help later, and they'll grow back quickly."

Zygarde core: Help? Who?

"Aren't you participating in that 'Pokémon Catch Race'..."

"Cynthia."

Before Cynthia could finish, Johan suddenly stopped his work and called her name.

"Hm?"

Called by name, Cynthia was stunned, not understanding why Johan suddenly called her.

She heard Johan turn his head, look into her eyes, and say quite seriously:

"I like you."

Hearing this, Cynthia was stunned again. Johan's face turned slightly red as he buried his head and huffed again.

Then she heard Cynthia also call out.

"Johan."

"Mm?"

"I like you too."

Hiss~

Johan stopped his actions and looked at her again, finding her eyes curved like crescents. The blush spread from her fair neck to her face and ears, but she just tilted her head looking at him.

Phew—

Johan let out a long breath, feeling his heart beating rapidly, hearing "thump thump" sounds in his ears, his whole body seeming filled with strength.

In Larvitar's words, that would be... Power!!

Plop—

From Johan's shoulder, the Zygarde core jumped down by itself.

Damn it!

It didn't come along to eat dog food!

It might get kicked off again later, so better be proactive.

"When did it start?" Before he could get excited for long, Cynthia blinked curious eyes and asked.

Johan: "..."

Do all girls ask questions like this?

Then it would be love, how much love, how long love, do you have someone else, and so on.

Previously Johan had only seen these online and found them amusing, thinking guys had it rough. He hadn't expected it to be his turn this time...

But he was straightforward. Since he'd already said the hardest words, he had nothing to be coy about.

"From the very beginning." Johan kept his head down, continuing to dig flowers while speaking.

"The very beginning?"

Cynthia blinked twice again.

"When we first met?"

It couldn't possibly be the first phone call, right?

That would be a bit much.

So...

"Garrr!!" Garchomp, held by Gengar, roared again.

You're shameless! You just lust after our cabbage's body!

"What about you?" Johan asked back.

Cynthia smiled mysteriously.

"Not telling you."

Johan: "..."

"You've dug quite a lot." Cynthia changed the topic.

"Still okay."

Looking at two buckets full of flowers.

Well, it was quite a lot.

"In the future, I'll plant you a flower field!" Johan patted the full buckets.

"I'll wait for it."

"Garchomp, come carry buckets." Johan stood up, inserting the small shovel into the flower bucket.

"Garrr—!!!"

Don't you dare order me around!

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

Calm down, calm down. The world is so beautiful, but you're...

"You still haven't said—weren't you participating in the competition? How did you end up here?"

"The competition was easily..."

Boom!!

Suddenly.

On the road between the Wind Festival venue and Fula City, a deep purple smoke exploded like a mushroom cloud.

This smoke didn't cause much damage, but spread toward Fula City at an exaggerated speed.

"What the hell..."

Seeing the deep purple smoke, Johan was stunned and instinctively spoke.

"This is..."

Cynthia was also stunned by the sudden explosion, somewhat confused.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar released Garchomp, putting its hand to its forehead to look.

Fireworks? Strange fireworks, purple ones too. I like them~

Purple has the most charm.

"Garrr!" Garchomp glanced at it irritably.

Idiot! This is obviously an attack!

"Ka-kaah?"

Larvitar, who had been sitting in the flowers gnawing on roots, scratched its head and stood up.

Big explosion?

They, including Cynthia, didn't understand what happened, but Johan knew something. He immediately took out his phone and called Matori.

"Teacher Johan?" Matori's voice came through the phone.

"Where are they?" Johan got straight to the point.

"They? They're filming on location in Hoenn."

"Got it."

Hanging up, Johan rubbed his temples.

Team Rocket trio was filming on location in Hoenn, so the explosion definitely wasn't caused by them. Then who could it be?

In the movie "The Power of Us," because Team Rocket trio took researcher Toren's research achievement "Spore Medicine" and accidentally caused the medicine to leak and explode, the spore medicine rapidly expanded and spread, threatening Fula City and wild Pokémon outside the city.

This "Spore Medicine" was extracted from the Pokémon ability "Spore," which would put people or Pokémon who accidentally inhaled it into a "paralyzed" state.

But...

With Team Rocket trio not here, who detonated this "Spore Medicine"?

"What's wrong?" Cynthia looked at Johan putting away his phone.

Johan squeezed his temples, shaking his head: "Don't know, but something definitely happened. That smoke looks like Pokémon spores."

"Spores?"

Cynthia frowned slightly.

Looking at the smoke's spread rate, plus the smoke's effects...

The entire city would probably be in trouble.

There were quite a few people who came to Fula City to celebrate the Wind Festival.

More importantly.

If this "Spore Medicine" leak was just accidental, that would be one thing, but if someone did it deliberately, then...

"We need to go check the situation quickly." Johan also understood the situation's importance.

Even if it wasn't deliberate, once the paralyzing smoke fully spread, people driving, cooking, bathing... major accidents could happen!

"Yes!"

Cynthia called Garchomp over. Johan also threw out a Poké Ball to summon Dragonite, quickly putting on protective gear and recalling the other little ones.

"Let's go! Dragonite!"

"Draaa~~"

Dragonite soared into the sky.

Garchomp wasn't snarling at Johan anymore at this time, just flying beside Dragonite.

The two quickly headed toward the explosion area.

Half-crouching on Garchomp's back, Cynthia suddenly asked:

"Was that a girl on the phone just now?"

"Huh?"

Outside Fula City, abandoned buildings.

"I brought you food, Moomoo Milk and Oran Berries." Risa walked lightly, curiously looking around while speaking softly.

But after waiting a while, there still wasn't any movement around. Risa showed a disappointed expression.

"I'll leave it under the tree, don't forget to eat."

Risa carefully placed the items under the tree on the ground, stepped back two steps, and waited a while more.

But there still wasn't any movement.

"Teddi~"

Teddiursa, who came with her, gently tugged at Risa's pants, pointing at the food under the tree.

"No, Teddiursa, didn't you just eat? You can eat more when we get home. This is for it."

"Teddi..."

Teddiursa drooped its ears.

"Ditto~"

Also coming with Risa was a Ditto, which seemed to discover something, pointing toward the dense forest not far away.

As soon as Risa looked over, she saw a Diggersby frantically darting out from the forest, looking very nervous.

The next second.

Bang!!

Like a gunshot, a large net shot out from the forest, pinning Diggersby to the ground.

"Diggersby!" Risa cried out.

"Now we're even catching trash Pokémon like this..."

"No choice, times are tough. We catch whatever we can."

Two burly figures walked out from the forest, cursing and holding net launchers.

Obviously, they were the ones who netted Diggersby.

"Once we get to the city, it'll be better. Didn't they say we'd do something big together?"

"Who knows how big this job really is..."

Before finishing, one of them noticed Risa in front of the ruins, along with her Teddiursa and Ditto.

The burly man's eyes lit up. "Look what I found—Teddiursa and Ditto! These are worth much more than Diggersby!"

Risa immediately understood their identity, quickly protecting Teddiursa and Ditto behind her. "You—you guys..."

The other, taller and thinner man waved casually. "Little girl, we're Pokémon Hunters. We won't trouble you. If you want to run, run quickly."

The burly man grinned. "Right. But you'll have to leave these two Pokémon."

They raised their net launchers.

"No, you can't!" Risa tensed her face, biting her teeth, protecting Teddiursa and Ditto as they retreated.

"Teddi..."

"Ditto..."

"Then don't blame us." The thin man sneered and pulled the trigger.

Bang! Bang!

Two nets shot out.

Risa closed her eyes in terror.

The next second.

Crackle—

A blue arc flashed, and both nets immediately shattered.

"What is this!"

The two looked at the sudden golden figure—extremely fast and a Pokémon they'd never seen before.

As experienced Pokémon Hunters, what Pokémon wouldn't even they recognize?

Only one answer.

Rare Pokémon!

And a rare Pokémon with considerable strength!

"Mightyena, Crunch!"

"Skuntank, Toxic!"

The two immediately threw Poké Balls, summoning their Pokémon.

"Zeraaa!"

Zeraora's eyes were sharp, lightning brewing around its body. The surrounding sky seemed to darken, leaving only blue lightning and eyes flashing with thunder.

All the lightning finally gathered in Zeraora's hands, and with its extreme speed, it punched out.

Plasma Fists!

Bang!! Bang!!

With lightning explosions and dull sounds, Mightyena and Skuntank were directly blasted away.

Seeing this scene made both Pokémon Hunters' expressions change, but then they were replaced by intense heat.

"Such fast speed!"

"This Pokémon must be very valuable!"

"Zeraaa!"

But as soon as Zeraora landed, as if touching some wound, it couldn't help half-kneeling on the ground.

"Zeraora, your injuries aren't healed yet!" Risa called out with worry.

Injuries not healed?

The two Pokémon Hunters exchanged glances, both showing smiles.

"Good opportunity! Mightyena, Fire Fang!"

"Skuntank, Sludge Bomb!"

"Zeraaa!"

Zeraora struggled to stand, spreading its hands like drawing a bow. Blue lightning blocked the charging Mightyena but was hit by Skuntank's Sludge Bomb.

Bang!!

"Zeraora!" Risa cried out.

Glug glug—

Zeraora staggered to its feet, purple poisoning symptoms appearing on its body.

It bared its teeth, trembling all over, and finally couldn't control itself, collapsing to the ground.

"Heh!"

Seeing this, the two Pokémon Hunters showed triumphant smiles.

Risa immediately ran in front of Zeraora, spreading her arms to protect it behind her, facing the two fierce Pokémon Hunters and shouting:

"If—if you dare come one step closer, I'll call people to arrest you! My dad knows very powerful trainers!"

"Very powerful trainers?"

"How powerful can they be? Hahaha—"

The two Pokémon Hunters didn't take Risa's words seriously at all, immediately pulling the net launcher triggers again.

Bang! Bang!

Two large nets shot out.

"Zeraaa!!"

Zeraora gritted its teeth, enduring pain trying to stand up.

Suddenly.

Bang—

A figure descended from the sky like a cannonball, stepping on both large nets and landing on the ground.

Rumble rumble—

The entire ground shook several times.

"What was that?"

"Yoji!"

Desert Tyrant cub Larvitar descended from the sky, roaring at the two Pokémon Hunters.

Do you want to taste my descending palm technique too!

"Lar—Larvitar?"

The two were stunned.

Then.

A figure appeared in front of Risa and Zeraora, wearing an Alolan floral shirt and beach shorts, flip-flops, hand pressing a cool hat, saying lightly:

"A trainer as powerful as me."

Continuing Risa's previous words.

"Who are you?" The thin Pokémon Hunter frowned.

At the same time.

Another graceful figure landed beside Risa, helping her up and smiling as she patted her head. "It's okay now."

"Me?"

Johan was stunned.

"Seems my reputation among Pokémon Hunters isn't big enough..."

He clicked his tongue.

"Gengar."

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar's voice suddenly appeared behind the two Pokémon Hunters, putting arms around their shoulders with a fierce grin.

When did this happen?!

Gengar?!

Bang—Bang—

Both men's eyes rolled back, foaming at the mouth as they fell to the ground.

Johan and Cynthia were on their way to Fula City when Gengar heard the battle sounds during flight, leading to this scene.

"Zeraora..."

Of course, Johan also noticed Zeraora's presence.

He hadn't expected... things would develop this way.

"Yoji~"

Larvitar walked to Zeraora, tilting its head.

Hey, buddy, you look pretty cool.

Zeraora: "..."

Larvitar offered status-restoring energy cubes.

Hungry guy, want some energy cubes to recover?

"Zeraaa."

Zeraora shook its head, staggering to its feet, looking toward Fula City with a frown.

The purple mist had gradually spread.

It had appeared earlier because it noticed this scene, plus Risa was in trouble.

"Eat it."

Johan also came over.

"Zeraaa?"

Seeing Johan approach, Zeraora frowned tightly, showing wariness and threat, then stepped back twice.

Toward humans, or rather toward humans other than Risa, Zeraora had an instinctive rejection.

Johan wasn't surprised by this. After all, this was a guy who had experienced the great mountain fire fifty years ago, plus being hunted by Pokémon Hunters—having rejection was normal.

So Johan didn't continue approaching, just spreading goodwill with his aura while saying:

"You want to help, right?"

"Zeraaa..."

"If you want to go, you'd better eat more and recover your condition so you can help more Pokémon." Johan said calmly.

"Yoji~"

Larvitar gestured again with the energy cubes in its hand.

"Zeraaa..."

After an internal "struggle," Zeraora finally grabbed the energy cubes Larvitar offered and roughly stuffed them in its mouth.

But as it ate, its chewing gradually slowed, its eyes slowly widened and began glowing.

This taste...

Johan smiled slightly.

Just eat it.

"There's more in this box, plus healing spray. Let me help you recover?"

"Zeraaa!"

Zeraora's fur stood up like an angry cat, seeming very resistant to Johan approaching, but...

The energy cubes' aroma entered its nostrils, plus... recovering more would help more Pokémon in the city. Zeraora tried to control its instincts and didn't speak.

Watching Johan approach with healing spray, Zeraora tried to control itself not to retreat.

But when hands touched its body, Zeraora's body trembled slightly, then it squinted.

So—so comfortable...

Why was it so comfortable?

Warm...

Zeraora's fur smoothed down, unconsciously showing a comfortable expression.

Zeraora: (≧ω≦)

Aura massage!

At the same time.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar floated to Johan's side, having obtained "intelligence" from those two Pokémon Hunters.

So.

Because of the recent massive Pokémon Hunter raids in the Kalos region, many people fled to the relatively isolated Fula City, which hadn't been raided.

Among them, a group had infiltrated Fula City, planning to target the "Pokémon Catch Race" Pokémon.

Who knew they'd get information about "Spore Medicine" from a strange researcher.

Although the medicine wasn't mature, they valued it.

If all the people and Pokémon in the city were paralyzed, couldn't they catch as many as they wanted?

The original plan was to release it after leaving Fula City, but the plan seemed to have problems.

These two were Pokémon Hunters invited to participate in the "grand event," but encountered Risa and Zeraora before entering the city, then were intercepted by Johan.

After hearing Gengar's brief account, Johan showed some realization.

"So this incident can actually be blamed on me?"

If he hadn't massively arrested Pokémon Hunters, these guys wouldn't have fled to Fula City, and wouldn't have desperately planned something big before escaping.

Tracing back to the original cause, he could actually be assigned some of this "blame."

Of course.

It couldn't be calculated this way.

After all, arresting Pokémon Hunters benefited the entire region.

Zeraora, who had also heard Gengar's account, looked at Johan with slightly changed eyes.

This human... didn't seem as "bad" as imagined?

A figure suddenly flashed through Johan's mind.

Snivy!

That little guy was also one of those Pokémon Hunters' targets, right?

# 649: Paralysis? Is It More Powerful Than Our Ghost's Tongue? (Two-in-One Chapter)

"What is this smoke? Why is it purple?"

"Actually... it looks pretty cool."

Tourists and trainers at the Wind Festival venue looked at the purple mist spreading from Fula City with curiosity.

But the next moment.

Those bold enough to first contact the purple mist suddenly trembled, freezing in place with facial twitches and terrified eyes.

Sharp-eyed people finally noticed something was wrong and hurriedly shouted:

"No good! This smoke has a 'paralysis' effect! Quick, pull them back!"

Whoosh whoosh—

A nearby Torterra immediately shot out vines and pulled back two paralyzed people and Pokémon.

While others helped, some fell into panic, shouting "run away."

The Wind Festival venue fell into great chaos.

At the same time, someone shouted:

"Since it's 'paralysis,' using Pecha Berries, Paralyze Heal, or moves like 'Safeguard' should work!"

Right!

This was how everyone usually dealt with 'paralysis' effects, wasn't it?

"No good!"

But soon, the first trainer who reacted and commanded Torterra to rescue the two people shouted loudly.

"Absolutely not! My Torterra felt numb just from its vines touching the mist. This purple smoke is too thick, the paralysis effect too strong—normal methods can't withstand it!"

Just a small part of the body touching it would cause paralysis?

Those who had suggested it earlier, along with some who remained calm, turned pale.

The main issue was being too close to the explosion site—the mist here was too dense. Even if they could hold out briefly with Pecha Berries and similar methods, how long could they last?

Could they last until getting out of the mist?

Obviously not.

"Then—then what do we do..."

Even those confident in their own strength couldn't help feeling panicked.

This naturally included the Torterra's trainer, even though he was the calmest among them.

He immediately took out his phone and made a call.

"This is International Police, codename 'Turtle.' A major accident has occurred in Fula City with unknown smoke..."

An International Police officer!

However, the International Police and League Police of the Kalos region were busy raiding Pokémon Hunters. This "Turtle" was actually from Sinnoh, currently on vacation.

But.

Before he could finish his report, his phone suddenly lost signal!

"What's going on..."

Turtle's expression was extremely grim.

"Everyone, find somewhere to hide quickly! Close doors and windows, don't come out no matter what, and wait for rescue!" Turtle took a deep breath and shouted loudly.

But in such a chaotic situation, very few could actually listen.

Fortunately, Fula City's leadership wasn't useless. They quickly formed a special task force after the explosion, confirmed the purple smoke's dangers, and had Mayor Oliver make a broadcast.

"...Therefore, please hide indoors, seal yourselves as much as possible, and wait for rescue. Safe locations at the Wind Festival venue include the research institute and Pokémon Center..."

The broadcast finally gave the panicked crowd some direction, and they quickly ran toward the research institute and Pokémon Center.

Although the crowd was temporarily calmed, the dense mist was still the biggest problem.

Fula City was a city that developed through wind, but during the Wind Festival was when winds were weakest. Such sea breezes could at most help disperse the smoke but couldn't completely blow it away.

The purple smoke was about to cover all of Fula City and risked spreading to the mountains...

Mayor Oliver remained relatively calm but really had no solutions now.

"Has the signal been restored? Have we found the cause?" Oliver and his secretary, along with special task force members, were all busy in the room.

"Found—found it! Someone deliberately destroyed the signal towers!"

Someone!

Oliver's worst fears had come true.

The appearance of this purple smoke wasn't an accident—it was man-made!

What to do...

Boom!!!

Suddenly, a huge explosion and roar erupted in the city.

"Zeraaa!"

Zeraora, having recovered somewhat, immediately transformed into blue lightning and rushed toward the city at extreme speed upon seeing flames shooting skyward.

"Yo—Yoji?"

Larvitar rubbed its eyes, waved its little hands up and down, pointed at Zeraora's retreating direction with a shocked expression.

This guy doesn't even have wings but can "fly" so fast?

Unreasonable! Dragonite's small wings being that fast was already unreasonable enough, but this guy could "fly" without wings—that was really unreasonable!

"Magnetic levitation." Johan explained.

Using electromagnetic and magnetic field reactions, like Metagross.

"Yoji..."

Larvitar looked down at its own feet.

Magnetic levitation?

If leveraging magnetic field reactions could enable flight, then could it... leverage the earth's gravity?

"Let's go." Johan called to Cynthia.

Having figured out what happened, it was time to solve this trouble.

"Yes." Cynthia nodded, lifting Risa and her Teddiursa and Ditto onto Garchomp's neck.

This violent shark lady was quite calm now.

"Is big brother really Teacher Johan?" Risa couldn't help asking curiously.

Teacher Johan!

Even she had heard this name many times.

"Yes." Cynthia rubbed Risa's head, smiling in response.

Garchomp below curled its lip.

Why was it "Teacher Johan this, Teacher Johan that" everywhere? Just wait until our cabbage showed her reputation—that would scare you!

"Draaa—!!"

"Garrr—!!"

Dragonite and Garchomp soared into the sky again, heading toward where flames shot skyward in the city.

"Don't! Don't use water!"

At the flame-shooting location, Mayor Oliver arrived first with his people. Seeing someone preparing to have Water-type Pokémon extinguish the fire, he hurriedly stopped them.

"This is a power substation!"

Power substation!

Fula City was famous for wind power generation, providing electricity to the city and many surrounding cities.

The power substation was key to integrating and redistributing wind-generated electricity...

Hearing this, everyone finally realized.

Water couldn't be used to extinguish fires at power substations!

"Mayor!"

Officer Jenny, who had also arrived, approached with a serious expression. "The suspicious group we were tracking—they ran into the power substation!"

When the purple smoke explosion occurred, Officer Jenny and the League Police had also sprung into action.

So the power substation accident was very likely caused by this group.

Even the earlier signal tower destruction might have been them!

"This group... what exactly are they?" Mayor Oliver's expression was grim.

Causing such chaos in Fula City—Oliver's expression couldn't be good.

"Very likely Pokémon Hunters!" Officer Jenny said gravely.

Pokémon Hunters?

Oliver was stunned.

Weren't these... guys who operated in mountain forests?

How did they come to the city and cause such a major incident?

Before Oliver could figure it out, Officer Jenny quickly added: "A group of... very powerful Pokémon Hunters!"

To gather in Fula City during the Kalos region's crackdown on Pokémon poaching and cause such trouble—these Pokémon Hunters were definitely not simple.

Moreover, during the earlier pursuit, Officer Jenny had briefly engaged them, and the result... naturally wasn't in her favor.

If this group hadn't been busy leaving, Officer Jenny and her team might have been in danger.

As for what these Pokémon Hunters wanted to do... that was currently unknown.

In any case.

What they needed to do now was save the power substation, restore city-wide electricity, capture or drive away these Pokémon Hunters, and solve Fula City's purple mist problem...

Counting them up, there were quite a few issues...

And none were simple.

"Mayor, what should we do now..." Officer Jenny asked.

Mayor Oliver rubbed his temples. "No matter what, evacuate the Pokémon from the power substation first!"

Many wild Pokémon lived in the power substation, mostly Electric-types but also others.

They wouldn't damage the substation and even protected it since they considered it home, so Oliver and other Fula City officials were happy to have them there.

But no one expected the power substation would have problems.

"Sni—Sni..."

No one noticed a Snivy in the corner of the power substation struggling to climb the fence with vines.

"Phew—"

Snivy wiped its forehead, looking at the Pokémon in the field.

"Sni!"

Snivy nodded firmly, seeming to encourage itself.

Crackle—

Suddenly.

A blue lightning bolt flashed across the sky and landed in the central plaza of the power substation.

"That's..." Oliver saw the golden Pokémon emerging from the lightning and was stunned.

"Zeraaa!!"

Amidst roaring flames, Zeraora flashed again, smashing falling debris and saving a Sentret that couldn't dodge in time.

It glared fiercely at Oliver and the others, blue arcs dancing around its body.

Under the blue and red reflection, Zeraora's eyes seemed blood-red.

In Zeraora's view, with the power substation suddenly catching fire and the Pokémon inside in danger, while Oliver, Jenny and others were right outside the substation, they very likely caused this destruction!

Plus Zeraora's inherent dislike of humans, it naturally showed extremely strong hostility.

At the same time.

The Pokémon Hunters preparing to evacuate inside the power substation also discovered the suddenly appearing Zeraora.

"It's that rare Pokémon!"

"Catching it before leaving isn't too late!"

"Maybe it's a rare mythical or even legendary Pokémon..."

Each Pokémon Hunter's eyes filled with burning intensity.

"Woo woo woo!!"

Beside them, a green-haired researcher was bound and restrained, struggling desperately but to no avail.

Also restrained was a Chansey.

"Quick battle, move out!"

The lead Pokémon Hunter with hideous scars on his face waved his hand.

"Houndoom, Flamethrower!"

As he acted, other Pokémon Hunters summoned their respective Pokémon.

Vicious Pokémon appeared one after another, surrounding Zeraora.

"Zeraaa!!"

Zeraora, dragging its weary body, split Houndoom's Flamethrower with one punch, its fur standing on end.

"Recovered well." The scarred Pokémon Hunter raised an eyebrow, somewhat surprised.

"Boss, this guy is strong."

"Hard to deal with."

The scarred Pokémon Hunter sneered. "We injured it before—same method works again!"

His gaze swept over the Pokémon Zeraora protected behind it, grinning wickedly:

"Houndoom, Flamethrower—attack those little ones!"

He was one who had captured Zeraora previously.

With Zeraora's strength, forced capture was nearly impossible due to its terrifying power, but Zeraora's weakness was too easy to target.

Sure enough.

As his words fell and Houndoom spat flames, Zeraora had to actively leap into the fire, using thunder to destroy the attack on innocent Pokémon.

Bang!!

Seeing this, the other Pokémon Hunters showed evil smiles.

"Weavile, Icicle Spear!"

"Drapion, Crunch!"

"Crobat, Toxic!"

"..."

Officer Jenny and others finally reacted, also summoning Pokémon.

"Arcanine, Extreme Speed!"

Other League Police threw Poké Balls too.

But...

As Officer Jenny said, this group of Pokémon Hunters was very strong!

More importantly, their methods were extremely despicable—attacking weak Pokémon, making Zeraora and Officer Jenny's group exhausted from defense with no chance to counterattack.

This way...

At the same time.

Seizing the opportunity, Snivy also acted. Its vines whipped rapidly, not choosing to help but striking at two Pokémon Hunters.

Snivy was smart, knowing that charging out now would at most help defend, but defeating some Pokémon Hunters would greatly reduce pressure on Zeraora and the others.

"Sni!"

I, Snivy, am very smart!

Snap! Snap!

The vines lashed out but failed to hit their targets, blocked by a Crobat.

The scarred man snorted lightly.

Directly attacking trainers?

"Hmph! In the wild, self-preservation is always a Pokémon Hunter's first priority!"

"Sni!" Snivy was furious and immediately stopped hiding, whipping vines for a full assault.

But the alerted Pokémon Hunters wouldn't let it act freely, especially the two who had almost been attacked.

"Little thing!" One gritted his teeth.

"This Snivy has potential—the price would be very good. Catch it!"

"Need you to say that?"

Several Pokémon Hunters threw more Poké Balls, summoning Pokémon to attack Snivy.

Suddenly.

Snivy also fell into an extremely dangerous situation.

"Zeraaa!"

Zeraora slapped out the flames on its body, painfully kneeling on one knee and breathing heavily.

Behind it, an Oddish and Sentret looked guilty.

If not for them, Zeraora wouldn't be stuck here.

But Zeraora was fierce to humans yet extraordinarily gentle with these Pokémon.

It tried controlling its claws, gently rubbing Sentret's head without speaking, just looking at the Pokémon Hunters with sharp eyes.

For some reason.

A figure suddenly appeared in Zeraora's mind.

This figure had descended from the sky to save it and Risa earlier.

If that person were here...

"Hmph! Futile resistance. Houndoom, Fire Fang!"

Suddenly.

"Sni!"

A tender but determined voice rang out.

Then two vines quickly lashed out with breaking sounds, heavily striking Houndoom's head.

Slam!

Bang!!!

Houndoom's attack trajectory was deflected, but the flames wreathing its teeth also burned the vines.

"Sni!"

Snivy groaned but landed squarely in front of Zeraora, breathing heavily with wounds all over.

The scarred Pokémon Hunter really hadn't expected this small Snivy to run out and interfere at this moment.

He looked fiercely at the two Pokémon Hunters who had tried to capture Snivy, finding their Pokémon already collapsed and unable to battle!

This guy...

The scarred Pokémon Hunter was filled with shock.

He thought encountering Zeraora was rare enough, but nearly missed this one too.

"Zeraaa..."

Zeraora looked at Snivy's small back, somehow slightly overlapping with the figure in its mind.

"Houndoom, Flamethrower!"

The scarred Pokémon Hunter waved his hand.

No matter how impressive, Snivy was still a Grass-type Pokémon, and a heavily injured one at that. Could it really turn things around?

"Sni!"

Snivy gritted its teeth, using one vine to brace against the ground and launch itself while the other wrapped around Zeraora and the power substation Pokémon behind it.

Boom—

The scorching fire column swept past Snivy's vine and struck the empty ground behind.

"Heh!" The scarred Pokémon Hunter grinned wickedly.

Snivy dodged Houndoom's Flamethrower but had two Sneasel charging from both sides, their sharp claws gleaming coldly in the moonlight.

"Vine Whip, up here!"

"Sni?"

Hearing the familiar voice, Snivy was momentarily stunned. Still wondering whether to act, its body moved quite honestly.

One vine shot upward, wrapping around an arm, then the vine contracted, and Snivy "flew" up.

It couldn't help looking up at the sky, confirming it was that familiar face, its nose slightly sour as it forcibly held back.

"Counter with Magical Leaf!"

Johan gripped the protective gear with one hand while holding Snivy's vine with the other, calling out softly.

"Sni! Ni!!"

Leaves wrapped in strange power appeared around Snivy, precisely and quickly hitting both Sneasel.

"Dragonite, Dragon Rush!"

Johan suddenly released his grip, letting his body fall freely. As he caught the wounded Snivy, Gengar emerged behind him, letting him land gently.

"It's okay now." Johan said gently to Snivy.

"Sni!" Snivy's body stiffened as it turned its head away, half-squinting.

You not coming wouldn't have mattered!

But its hands unconsciously gripped Johan's clothes.

"Garchomp—we'll Dragon Rush too!"

"Draaa—"

"Garrr—"

Long cries came from the sky.

Two dragons in blue-purple coats came crashing down from above.

Boom!!

With tremendous roaring sounds, Houndoom was directly sent flying and crashed to the ground.

Unable to battle!

Johan walked to Zeraora's side, extending his hand to help it up while slowly infusing aura and saying:

"Told you not to rush ahead like that. Look what happened..."

"Zeraaa!"

Zeraora snorted lightly and turned to look away.

Johan glanced at Snivy in his arms, then at Zeraora beside him.

Good, good, good—you two are really "perfectly" coordinated.

"Cough cough cough—"

From the rising dust, the scarred Pokémon Hunter coughed as he emerged, glaring fiercely at the suddenly appearing two women and one man with vicious eyes.

"Who are you! Cough cough cough—"

Johan surveyed the power substation situation, taking everything in, then looked at the scarred man with an extremely calm tone:

"I'll give you two choices."

"One, lie down now yourself."

"Two..."

Before finishing, the scarred man roared:

"I'll lie down your—"

"Ka-kaah!"

A Gengar appeared before him at ghostly speed, holding a black "iron fist" the size of a sandbag and punching the man's face.

Bang!!!

The scarred man seemed crushed by overwhelming gravity, his head slamming solidly into the ground and creating a crater.

"Ptui!"

Gengar spat at the man on the ground.

Had to say.

Sometimes Tinkaton's "hammer sleep" method was pretty good~

Johan shrugged. "Looks like you chose the second option."

He held Snivy and stepped forward, shouting loudly:

"Now, you're all under arrest. Anyone who doesn't want to end up like him should recall your Pokémon and squat on the ground obediently, otherwise..."

"You—you, who are you..."

"Teacher Johan!" Officer Jenny was first to recognize Johan in his Alolan floral shirt and sun hat.

Just without sunglasses, he was recognized immediately?

Teacher Johan?!

Hearing this title, the Pokémon Hunter side became agitated.

As Pokémon Hunters, how could they not know the name "Teacher Johan"?

The famous Pokémon Hunter J, Phantom Thief Ghost, and others were all reportedly arrested by him.

Even if not arrested by him, Teacher Johan was hailed as Champion-level...

More exaggerated was that Teacher Johan was famously the "Legendary Pokémon Man"—if he called some legendaries over...

"Run!"

Someone shouted, and the Pokémon Hunters used various methods to scatter and flee.

"Why bother..."

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar grinned wickedly, spreading its hands as Dark Voids instantly formed.

Small Dark Voids flew out, precisely hypnotizing all the Pokémon Hunters and their Pokémon.

If they had resisted, it might not have been so easy, but running without resistance made them perfect targets.

Snap snap snap—

Gengar clapped its hands and put on sunglasses.

Easy work.

Piece of cake.

Snivy and Zeraora stared blankly at this scene.

They had exhausted themselves, enduring massive damage and barely holding on until now.

Yet that Gengar solved it so easily?

All of them?

Unknown to them, the "Old Johan Family's" hypnosis was a method Johan prohibited using, except when facing Pokémon Hunters and evil organization groups.

Plus, with reputation preceding him and them not even resisting, it was naturally easy work.

Snivy and Zeraora almost instinctively exchanged glances, both seeing deep shock in each other's eyes.

"So—so amazing..." Risa said dazedly.

"Of course! This is Teacher Johan!" Officer Jenny said proudly.

Cynthia glanced at Jenny, then at Johan, pursing her lips.

"Teacher Johan, Miss Cynthia, please help our Fula City!" Mayor Oliver hurried over.

He recognized Cynthia.

Previously not knowing what to do, now finally having two pillars of support—such strong ones—Oliver felt relieved.

In terms of position, as "Police Superintendent," Johan's commanding authority during special times was even higher than Elite Four!

And now was clearly a special time.

Johan didn't refuse, accepting this responsibility.

"Need to put out the fire first..."

The power substation fire was growing fiercer.

He looked at Cynthia, who nodded and walked toward Garchomp.

"Larvitar."

The Poké Ball opened and Larvitar ran out.

Seeing the already-ended "battlefield," it immediately looked disappointed.

"Put out the fire—Sandstorm!"

"Yoji!"

Larvitar immediately raised sand and dust.

"Garchomp."

"Garrr—!!"

Combining Larvitar and Garchomp's power, a fierce sandstorm immediately rose. The flames gradually extinguished under the sand's impact and burial.

Obviously water couldn't be used on power substation fires—Larvitar and Garchomp working together was perfect.

"Yoji!"

Seeing the flames extinguish, Larvitar grinned widely and extended its fist toward Garchomp.

Garchomp glanced at it, then finally lightly bumped fists.

The Pokémon Hunters that Officer Jenny and others couldn't handle were easily solved by Johan's Pokémon.

The power substation fire that Mayor Oliver couldn't deal with was easily extinguished by Johan and Cynthia.

Had to say.

This was probably the power of top trainers in the Pokémon world.

And the influence this power brought was inevitable.

So seeing this scene, Oliver and Officer Jenny both relaxed.

They felt that with Teacher Johan and Miss Cynthia here, everything would definitely be fine...

Next was the purple mist about to spread throughout Fula City.

Johan looked up.

The mist was almost spreading here.

"Woo woo woo!!!"

At this moment, sobbing came from the Pokémon Hunter side.

Everyone looked toward the sound and found the bound researcher...

Toren?

Johan recognized him.

The spreading spore medicine this time was his creation—a usually solitary but genuinely capable researcher who loved Pokémon.

He was brought here by these Pokémon Hunters?

"Yoji!"

Larvitar swiped with its claw, cutting the special ropes binding Toren and Chansey.

"Lucky~" Chansey quickly thanked Larvitar and helped Toren up.

"I—I—I know—know how to..."

Toren felt everyone's gazes and became constrained, stuttering.

"No rush, take your time." Johan gave a reassuring look.

Toren's cheeks reddened.

Hm?

Why are you blushing like a teapot?

A guy.

"Lucky~"

But fortunately, while Toren wasn't articulate, his Chansey expressed things clearly. Johan used his aura power to understand Chansey's explanation.

So, those Pokémon Hunters had infiltrated the research institute, trying to capture the "Pokémon Catch Race" Pokémon after the competition ended, but were caught by Toren.

During their confrontation, they learned about Toren's medicine and its effects.

The Pokémon Hunters immediately changed plans, trying to use the unfinished "Spore Medicine" to paralyze as many Pokémon as possible for mass capture.

But because the medicine was unfinished and too strong—even contact without inhalation would cause paralysis—they changed plans again, preparing to kidnap Toren.

With Toren, they could have unlimited "Spore Medicine," "Sweet Scent Medicine," whatever they wanted.

Antidotes would be easy too.

But while taking Toren away, his resistance caused the "Spore Medicine" to break, releasing toxic mist.

So these Pokémon Hunters fled hastily, destroyed signal towers to reduce interference, and prepared to destroy the power substation to keep Fula City too busy to pay attention to them while they successfully retreated.

The result...

As for why Toren was blushing.

"Lucky~" Chansey smiled while supporting Toren, explaining the reason.

Because he was a fan of Teacher Johan.

Toren became even shyer.

"So you can make an antidote?" Cynthia asked.

Toren buried his head, nodding then shaking it. "I—I'm not sure. But—but I want to try!"

"You can do it." Johan gave an affirming and encouraging look.

Actually, Johan had another backup plan. He looked at Gengar, who had been muttering and pondering.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar opened its hands, showing the phone screen.

"Electronic pet" wasn't home.

Johan: "..."

Great.

Even Giratina had "run away from home."

"Need—need to restore power first!" Toren's speech gradually became smoother.

"The power substation's condition is probably..." Mayor Oliver looked troubled.

With the substation burned like this, immediate restoration was difficult.

"The mist! It's spreading!" Officer Jenny exclaimed.

"Zeraaa!"

Zeraora cried lowly, trying to step forward.

But Johan firmly gripped its arm, making it immobile.

"Zeraaa?"

It looked at Johan puzzledly.

Restoring electricity—didn't that depend on it?

And your grip is so strong?

Johan smiled slightly, patting its shoulder.

"When injured, rest properly."

Saying this, he took out a Poké Ball and threw it.

Red light became golden lightning.

"Regi?"

"Regieleki?" As a mythology scholar, Cynthia recognized this Pokémon.

Regieleki's appearance made Zeraora's body instinctively tense, then slowly relax.

This Pokémon...

"Eleki?"

Regieleki scratched its head.

Not fully awake yet—time for cards again?

"The mist is coming!" Officer Jenny shouted again.

Purple mist had spread into the power substation, even approaching Johan.

"Careful!"

But Johan just shrugged nonchalantly.

"Mere paralysis."

He put down Snivy and walked into the purple mist with the confused Regieleki.

Paralysis?

Is it more powerful than our ghost's tongue?
